AIR_BASE_GATHER_CURRENT:
#### Gather Current
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
You stir a small controlled Air Current in a 10-foot cube you can see within range.
When you create the Current, choose one Vector:
Lift: A willing creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends may add 5 feet to one jump or ignore the first 10 feet of falling damage before the Current ends.
Press: The first hostile creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends treats the Current’s space as Difficult Terrain.
Scatter: Nonmagical smoke, loose dust, harmless vapor, light fog, or similar airborne material in the Current is dispersed or shifted 10 feet.
Carry: A whisper, scent, ribbon, Tiny unattended object weighing no more than 1 pound, or comparable harmless sign may be carried from one point in the Current to another point in the Current.
Turn: The first ordinary Tiny projectile that passes through the Current before it ends has Disadvantage on its attack roll.
At Foundation Realm, the Current increases to a 15-foot cube. At Core Formation, it increases to a 20-foot cube.
AIR_BASE_WIND_HAND_TRAINING:
#### Wind-Hand Training
When you first gain the Air sphere, gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Acrobatics, Athletics, Perception, Performance, or Survival.
If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, choose one Mortal Realm Air talent instead.
You also learn Gather Current and Wind Lash.
AIR_BASE_WIND_LASH:
#### Wind Lash
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object you can see
Cost: None
You release a cutting or battering current at a target.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning or slashing damage equal to 1d8 + your Path key ability modifier.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
When Wind Lash hits, choose one basic Vector:
Push: Push the target 5 feet directly away from you if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Pull: Pull the target 5 feet directly toward you if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Cut: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
Lift: The target’s next jump before the start of your next turn is increased by 5 feet if the target is willing. If the target is unwilling, this option has no effect.
Scatter: One Tiny unattended object within 5 feet of the target moves up to 10 feet in a direction you choose.
Wind Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise.
ALCHEMY_BASE_ALCHEMY_CHECK:
### Alchemy Check
When a refinement, recipe, or alchemical project calls for an Alchemy Check, roll:
d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier
Before rolling, you may spend CP to steady the refinement. Spend up to your Proficiency Bonus CP. Each CP spent this way adds +1 to the Alchemy Check.
Unless a feature says otherwise, spending CP this way must be declared before the roll.
ALCHEMY_BASE_FIELD_FORMULA:
### Field Formula
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock
Requirement: Alchemist’s supplies and a cauldron, portable furnace, crucible, medicine gourd, smoke tube, formula satchel, or Body as Cauldron access
Release one prepared alchemical formula. Field Formula represents smoke packets, volatile pellets, corrosive dregs, sealed medicine fumes, powdered irritants, and quick-release pill shells prepared during the day’s refinement. It does not mean the cauldron itself attacks.
Choose one Field Formula you know and resolve its effect. You know the following Field Formulae when you learn Alchemy:
#### Medicinal Smoke
Choose yourself or one ally within range.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and may immediately repeat one saving throw against the Poisoned condition.
The Temporary HP increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
#### Numbing Smoke
Choose a point within range. Smoke briefly fills a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered there. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Poison damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and suffers no Reaction loss.
The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
#### Corrosive Dregs
Choose one creature or one 5-foot space within range. The target or each hostile creature of your choice in that space makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Acid damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and is covered in unstable residue until the start of your next turn. The first time it takes damage before then, it takes additional Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not covered in residue.
The initial damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
ALCHEMY_BASE_PILL_FORGING:
### Advanced Pill Forging - Refinement
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You may craft Rare and Very Rare recipes.
When you fail an Alchemy Check for a Rare or Very Rare recipe, you may spend 5 CP to reroll the check. You must use the new result.
You may use this reroll once per recipe attempt.
ALCHEMY_BASE_REAGENT_STOCK:
### Reagent Stock
Reagent Stock represents sealed combat vials, volatile pellets, powdered dregs, premeasured furnace fuel, medicinal smoke packets, and quick-release pill shells.
During a Long Rest, you may prepare a number of Reagent Stock uses up to:
Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier, minimum 1
Each use costs 10 gp in common reagents unless a talent states a different cost.
Unused Reagent Stock remains stable until your next Long Rest. At the end of that Long Rest, unused stock spoils or must be folded into the next day’s preparation.
A talent that spends Reagent Stock consumes one prepared use. Reagent Stock is not an item another creature can normally use unless a talent says so.
ASH_BASE_ASHFALL:
#### Ashfall
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Create an area of falling cinders and settled residue.
The area becomes Ash Terrain.
Unless a talent says otherwise, Ashfall remains where it was created.
##### Lingering Ashfall
Augment - 2 CP: Ashfall persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating Ashfall on your turn without spending an Action.
ASH_BASE_CINDER_BRAND:
#### Cinder Brand
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Release a streak of clinging ash.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Deal Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage equal to the listed dice + your Path key ability modifier and apply Ashen Brand.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 1d8 |
| 5-10 | 2d8 |
| 11-16 | 3d8 |
| 17-20 | 4d8 |
Once per turn when Cinder Brand hits, choose one:
reduce healing received by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn;
create one Remnant in an unoccupied space adjacent to the target;
move one Remnant within 30 feet up to 10 feet;
suppress one ordinary source of Temporary HP already affecting the target until the start of your next turn.
ASH_TAL_ASHEN_BURIAL:
#### Ashen Burial - Unique Ash Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature touching the ground.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Restrained by accumulated ash. At the start of each of its turns, take 2d8 Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage. Repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
ASH_TAL_CINDER_BURST:
#### Cinder Burst - Unique Ash Talent
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot cone
Cost: 1 CP
Creatures inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take Fire or Necrotic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 2d6 |
| 11-16 | 4d6 |
| 17-20 | 6d6 |
ASH_TAL_DEEP_CINDER_BRAND:
#### Deep Cinder Brand - Brand Augment
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Cost: +2 CP
When Cinder Brand or another Ash talent damages a creature, apply one additional pressure until the start of your next turn:
healing received is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus;
cannot gain Temporary HP;
Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw;
it cannot successfully take the Hide action solely by becoming Heavily Obscured or moving behind cover while the visible cinder trail remains exposed;
Speed reduced by 10 feet.
If the target stands inside Ash Terrain, add extra Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage:
| Cultivation Level | Extra Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 5-10 | 1d6 |
| 11-16 | 2d6 |
| 17-20 | 3d6 |
A creature may receive this extra damage only once per turn.
ASH_TAL_RUINOUS_ASH:
#### Ruinous Ash - Unique Ash Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 3 CP
Choose one object, Barrier, structure section, Formation Anchor, or Construct.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack if the target is mobile or actively defended.
Hit or Unattended Object: Deal Fire or Necrotic damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 5-10 | 5d8 |
| 11-16 | 7d8 |
| 17-20 | 9d8 |
This damage:
ignores an ordinary object’s Damage Threshold; it must still affect the object’s AC and reduce its HP;
deals double damage to wood, cloth, paper, brittle stone, and previously burned structures.
When Ruinous Ash destroys its target, create one Remnant in its space.
ASH_TAL_SMOTHERING_CLOUD:
#### Smothering Cloud - Ashfall Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Cost: 4 CP
A hostile creature entering Ashfall for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage and become Smothered until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 5-10 | 3d6 |
| 11-16 | 5d6 |
| 17-20 | 7d6 |
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
ASH_TAL_SOOT_IN_LUNGS:
#### Soot in the Lungs - Ashfall Talent
Cost: 1 CP
A hostile creature entering Ashfall for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature becomes Smothered until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.
ATHLETICS_BASE_ATHLETIC_TRAINING:
#### Athletic Training
When you learn the Athletics sphere, gain proficiency in one:
Strength (Athletics);
Dexterity (Acrobatics). If you are already proficient in both, choose one Athletics talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent.
ATHLETICS_BASE_COORDINATED_MOVEMENT:
#### Coordinated Movement
Whenever you take the Dash or Disengage Action as your Action, regain Martial Focus.
This does not trigger when taking Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action.
BEASTMASTERY_BASE_RIDER_PACKAGE:
#### Rider Package
You cultivate partnership through the saddle, harness, rein, knee, breath, and shared momentum.
Gain Skillful Riding.
##### Skillful Riding
While you ride a willing mount, when the mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage:
it takes no damage on a success;
it takes half damage on a failure.
BEASTMASTERY_BASE_TAMER_PACKAGE:
#### Tamer Package You cultivate patience, hierarchy, instinct, and training.
Gain Tame.
##### Tame
Train one non-sapient Beast to obey commands in and out of combat.
Requirements:
find, purchase, rescue, raise, or capture the creature;
spend 8 hours training one creature;
make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The DC is:
10 + the creature’s Challenge Rating
Successful Check: The creature becomes Tame.
Failed Check: The creature is not Tame. You may train again after addressing an appropriate narrative obstacle.
You may train only one creature at a time.
##### Tamer Capacity
You may maintain:
a number of Tame Creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus;
a total combined Challenge Rating no greater than the table. After the first CR 0 creature, treat each additional CR 0 creature as CR 1/8.
If training a creature would exceed a cap, release enough Tame Creatures to remain within the limit.
##### Commands
Tame Creatures follow your commands to the best of their ability.
Giving ordinary commands requires no Action unless a talent says otherwise.
Without a command, a Tame Creature acts according to its nature, training, and circumstances.
##### Contested Control
When another creature attempts to control one of your Tame Creatures, it must first make:
Charisma check
opposed by your:
Wisdom (Animal Handling) check
Failed Opposed Check: The control attempt fails.
Successful Opposed Check: Resolve the controlling effect normally.
##### Awakening
A beast that becomes sapient is no longer an ordinary Tame Creature.
Its future relationship should be resolved through:
consent;
narrative agreement;
a Beast Companion bond;
Beast-sphere cultivation;
Spirit practices;
or another appropriate feature. Combat Rule Reminders
BEAUTY_BASE_ADORN_THE_MOMENT:
## Core Ability: Adorn the Moment
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self, or one willing creature or object within touch
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP
You refine the appearance, bearing, aura, or symbolic presence of yourself, a willing creature, or an object.
Choose one:
- The target gains Advantage on the next Charisma (Performance), Charisma (Persuasion), Dexterity (Acrobatics), or Wisdom (Insight) check made before the effect ends, if the check depends on grace, poise, first impressions, etiquette, dance, beauty, or emotional presentation. A creature can benefit from this option only once per scene.
- The target becomes visually memorable. Creatures that see it during the duration have Advantage on checks to remember or identify it later.
- The target's aura becomes soft, graceful, haunting, radiant, refined, tragic, elegant, or terrible. This has no direct combat effect, but it may make certain social approaches possible.
A creature can benefit from only one use of Adorn the Moment at a time.
BEAUTY_BASE_CATCH_THE_EYE:
## Core Ability: Catch the Eye
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can perceive you
Duration: Until the end of your next turn for Captivated; 1 minute for Beauty Mark
Cost: 0 CP
Save: Wisdom
You arrange posture, voice, gaze, movement, spiritual pressure, or cultivated presence into a moment that the target cannot ignore.
Choose one creature within range that can perceive you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the target is Captivated by you until the end of your next turn, and you place a Beauty Mark on it for 1 minute.
On a successful save, the target is not Captivated, but you may still place a Beauty Mark on it until the end of your next turn.
A creature that succeeds on this saving throw has Advantage on saving throws against your Catch the Eye for 10 minutes.
BEAUTY_BASE_TURN_THE_BLADE_ASIDE:
## Core Ability: Turn the Blade Aside
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 60 feet
Trigger: A creature bearing your Beauty Mark targets you with an attack
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 1 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your beauty makes the attacker hesitate.
The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the triggering attack has Disadvantage.
On a successful save, the attack is resolved normally, and the Beauty Mark ends.
This ability cannot affect creatures immune to the Charmed condition unless another feature says otherwise.
BLACKSMITH_BASE_HAMMER_THE_MARK:
### Hammer the Mark
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Touch or reach
Target: Your current workpiece
Cost: None
Strike, heat, grind, align, polish, stitch, bind, chant over, or otherwise work the current workpiece.
Place 1 Forge Mark on it.
If you used your Action this turn to make an attack with a hammer, tool, weapon, or unarmed strike against an object or a creature’s equipment, you may use Hammer the Mark on that same target without spending a Bonus Action.
A workpiece cannot exceed your normal Forge Mark limit.
BLACKSMITH_BASE_QUENCH_THE_MARK:
### Quench the Mark
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: No action unless the response says otherwise
Trigger: A Blacksmith talent lets you spend a Forge Mark
Target: The marked workpiece
Cost: Spend 1 or more Forge Marks
Spend Forge Marks to activate a Blacksmith response, talent, or improvement.
A quench may be literal water, oil, snow, blood, spirit breath, cold iron, furnace wind, silence, or the moment when the hammer stops.
BLACKSMITH_BASE_SET_THE_WORKPIECE:
### Set the Workpiece
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Touch or reach
Target: One legal workpiece
Duration: 1 minute or current crafting scene
Cost: None
Choose one legal workpiece as your current workpiece.
Until the effect ends:
you can place Forge Marks on that workpiece;
you can spend Forge Marks from that workpiece;
you have Advantage on checks made to repair, adjust, fit, or identify that workpiece;
you cannot have more than one current workpiece unless a talent says otherwise.
If you choose a new current workpiece, the old one stops being current but keeps any Forge Marks already on it until those marks expire.
BLOOD_BASE_BLOOD_THREAD:
#### Blood Thread
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Choose one creature with meaningful circulation.
##### Willing Creature
Apply Blood Thread automatically.
The Thread lasts for 1 minute.
##### Unwilling Creature
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Deal Piercing or Necrotic damage equal to the listed dice + your Path key ability modifier and apply Blood Thread until the start of your next turn. The damage is 1d8 at CL 1-4, 2d8 at CL 5-10, 3d8 at CL 11-16, and 4d8 at CL 17-20.
If the target is Bloodied, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll.
Choose the damage type when attacking.
BLOOD_BASE_COAGULATE:
#### Coagulate - Thread Talent
When you learn the Blood sphere, you learn Coagulate automatically.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One willing creature bearing your Blood Thread
Cost: 1 CP
Choose one:
immediately stabilize the target if it is at 0 HP;
end one ordinary bleeding effect;
grant Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus + Path key ability modifier. At CL 11, add +1d8 Temporary HP.
At CL 17, add +2d8 Temporary HP.
BRUTE_BASE_BRUTAL_SHOVE:
#### Brutal Shove
Brutal Shove is a sphere-specific maneuver. It is not the ordinary 2024 Shove option.
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Target: One creature no more than one size larger than you
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action.
Make:
Strength (Athletics)
contested by the target’s:
Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics)
The target chooses its skill.
Success: Choose to push the target 5 feet away or give it the Prone condition. Then:
move it an additional 5 feet for every 5 points by which your Athletics check exceeds its opposing check;
apply this additional movement even when you chose Prone;
deal Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier, minimum 0;
apply one Manhandle talent you know.
Unless a talent says otherwise, Brutal Shove obeys the normal size limit above.
BRUTE_BASE_BRUTE_MANEUVERS:
#### Brute Maneuvers
The following are sphere-specific maneuver options. They are provided here because the 2024 core rules do not define universal Disarm, Overrun, or Shove Aside actions.
##### Disarm
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action.
Make a weapon attack roll contested by the target’s:
Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics)
The target chooses its skill.
Success: The target drops one held item of your choice. This maneuver deals no damage.
You have Disadvantage if the target holds the item in two or more hands.
The target has Advantage if larger than you and Disadvantage if smaller.
##### Overrun
As an Action or Bonus Action, attempt to move through one hostile creature’s space.
Make:
Strength (Athletics)
contested by the target’s:
Strength (Athletics)
Gain Advantage if larger than the target. Suffer Disadvantage if smaller.
Success: Move through the hostile creature’s space once during this turn. Treat that space as difficult terrain, and do not end movement in an occupied space.
##### Shove Aside
Use Brutal Shove to move the target into one different legal space within your reach rather than directly away.
Make the Brutal Shove contest with Disadvantage.
BRUTE_BASE_SPECIAL_ATTACKS:
#### Special Attacks
When a talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type.
DARK_BASE_DARKNESS:
### Darkness
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Create a sphere of supernatural Darkness centered anywhere within range.
The darkness radiates from a central point, spreads around corners, and cannot extend through walls.
A creature with Darkvision can see through this Darkness. Nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.
#### Contesting Light
If a Light-sphere effect is created inside your Darkness, the creator of the Light effect makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Successful Check: Your Darkness is countered and the Light effect functions normally.Failed Check: The Light effect functions only as an ordinary light source and cannot illuminate your Darkness.
#### Persistent Darkness
Augment - 2 CP: Your Darkness persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Darkness on your turn without spending an action.
DISEASE_BASE_RAISE_THE_QUARANTINE_VEIL:
#### Raise the Quarantine Veil
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 10-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You raise a visible or invisible veil of quarantine marks, medicinal smoke, spirit fever, miasma threads, salt circles, bone needles, paper seals, humming insects, or coughing ghosts.
When you create the veil, choose one mode: Containment or Outbreak.
##### Containment Mode
Choose any number of creatures in the area.
Chosen creatures gain Advantage on saving throws against Disease while they remain inside the veil.
Whenever a chosen creature starts its turn inside the veil, it may remove one Contagion Token from itself.
Disease effects created by you cannot spread from inside the veil to creatures outside the veil unless you allow it.
##### Outbreak Mode
When an enemy enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 1d6 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Sickened.
The damage increases by Realm.
Mortal: 1d6Foundation: 2d6Core Formation: 3d6Nascent Soul: 4d6
A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
DISEASE_BASE_SOW_THE_FEVER_SEED:
#### Sow the Fever Seed
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
You release infected qi, spores, diseased fluid, spiritual fever, coughing shadow, or parasitic essence.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack roll.
On a hit, the target takes Disease damage equal to the listed dice + your Path key ability modifier and gains one Contagion Token.
Mortal: 1d8Foundation: 2d8Core Formation: 3d8Nascent Soul: 4d8
Choose Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage when you use this ability.
A creature can gain only one Contagion Token from your Sow the Fever Seed each turn.
DREAMS_BASE_DREAMSCAPE:
#### Dreamscape
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Create one symbolic Dreamscape centered within range.
The Dreamscape is perceptible as drifting symbolism, altered emotional tone, half-heard music, impossible shadows, falling petals, remembered voices, or similar dreamlike impressions.
A Dreamscape does not automatically:
create false terrain;
block line of sight;
make creatures Hidden;
impose a condition;
reveal private memories;
grant literal information. Choose one Dreamscape talent you know and pay its CP cost.
##### Lingering Dreamscape
Augment - 2 CP: The Dreamscape persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Dreamscape on your turn without spending an Action.
DREAMS_BASE_DROWSY_THOUGHT:
#### Drowsy Thought - Seed Talent
When you learn the Dreams sphere, you learn Drowsy Thought automatically.
When an awake unwilling creature fails its saving throw against your Dream Seed, it also becomes Drowsy until the start of your next turn.
DREAMS_BASE_RESTFUL_DREAM:
#### Restful Dream - Rite Talent
When you learn the Dreams sphere, you learn Restful Dream automatically.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next short rest
Cost: 1 CP
Guide the target into a restorative dream during its next short rest.
After completing that rest, the target:
gains Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus;
may repeat one saving throw against Frightened;
may end one ordinary nightmare, minor sleep disturbance, or minor mental-stress effect;
gains Advantage on one check made to recover from ordinary exhaustion, stress, or mental fatigue. A creature may benefit from Restful Dream only once per long rest.
EARTH_BASE_SET_FOUNDATION:
#### Set Foundation
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet, subject to Path restrictions
Area: Up to two 5-foot Foundation Spaces
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: NoneConcentration: Not required
Tags: Foundation
You claim ground, body, or surface as an Earth Foundation.
Choose spaces on a legal solid or earthen surface you can see within range. The spaces may be connected or separate.
If your Earth is limited by Body Refining contact rules, the spaces must be legal for those rules.
The number of spaces you create increases as your cultivation deepens.
| Cultivation Level | Foundation Spaces Created |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 2 spaces |
| CL 5-10 | 3 spaces |
| CL 11-16 | 4 spaces |
| CL 17-20 | 5 spaces |
When a creature you did not designate as safe willingly moves at least 10 feet across, out of, or through your Foundation Spaces during one turn, you may give that creature one Burden Mark. This can happen only once per creature per turn.
EARTH_BASE_SPENDING_A_BURDEN_MARK:
#### Spending a Burden Mark
Once per round, when a marked creature or object you can perceive performs a triggering act, you may spend its Burden Mark without using an Action. Choose one Earth Response appropriate to the trigger.
##### Anchor Step
Trigger: The marked target begins movement while touching a surface, including walking, climbing, burrowing, jumping, forced movement, or standing from Prone.
Reduce one of the target’s Speeds by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. At CL 11, this reduction becomes 20 feet.
This cannot reduce a Speed below 0.
If the movement is forced movement, reduce the forced movement distance by the same amount.
##### Drag Down
Trigger: The marked target willingly moves at least 5 feet, jumps, climbs, flies upward while within 10 feet of a solid surface, or attempts to stand from Prone.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target falls Prone, or if already Prone, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn.
Successful Save: Reduce the target’s Speed by 5 feet until the end of the current turn.
A creature flying high in open air is affected only if it is within 10 feet of a solid surface, unless a talent says otherwise.
##### Bear the Blow
Trigger: The marked target deals damage to you, an ally, an object, or a Foundation Space while the damaged target is touching one of your Foundation Spaces or is within 5 feet of you.
Reduce the damage by:
1d8 + your Earth key ability modifier
At CL 5, this becomes 2d8 + modifier; at CL 11, 3d8 + modifier; at CL 17, 4d8 + modifier.
##### Shift the Load
Trigger: The marked target hits a creature with an attack roll while both are touching the ground or a legal Earth surface.
Before damage is rolled, choose one willing creature within 10 feet of the damaged creature, including yourself.
The chosen creature gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Earth key ability modifier, minimum 1.
If the chosen creature is touching one of your Foundation Spaces, double the Temporary HP.
##### Raise the Ridge
Trigger: The marked target makes a ranged attack roll, casts a spell, uses a sphere talent, or creates a harmful line or area effect while touching a surface within 60 feet of you.
Raise a low ridge, berm, stone lip, packed-earth mound, or similar obstruction in one unoccupied 5-foot space touching the marked target or the triggering line of effect.
The ridge lasts until the start of your next turn. It grants Half Cover against one attack or effect that crosses through its space, then crumbles.
Raise the Ridge does not block movement unless a talent says otherwise.
##### Settle the Impact
Trigger: The marked target would push, pull, knock Prone, shove, move, teleport, or otherwise displace another creature or object.
Reduce the displacement by 10 feet. At CL 11, reduce it by 20 feet.
If this reduces the displacement to 0, the displaced creature or object may immediately move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the marked target.
Settle the Impact does not prevent planar travel or teleportation unless the distance is reduced to 0 and the effect is not a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, or story-scale effect.
EARTH_BASE_WEIGHT_SEEKING_CLOD:
#### Weight-Seeking Clod
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet, subject to Path restrictions
Target: One creature or object
Cost: None
Tags: Attack, Burden
You strike with compacted earth, a thrown clod, stone-grit, a stomp carried through the ground, or a body-originating weight pulse.

EQUIPMENT_BASE_EQUIPMENT_TRAINING:
### Equipment Training

EQUIPMENT_BASE_FITTED_ARMOR_DESIGNATION:
### Fitted Armor
During a long rest, or by spending 10 minutes with a suit of armor you are proficient with, you may make that armor your Fitted Armor.
You can have only one Fitted Armor at a time. It remains fitted until you fit a different suit, lose proficiency with it, or the armor is destroyed.
Fitted Armor is not magical by default. It is simply the armor your Equipment talents are trained around.
EQUIPMENT_BASE_ONE_FREE_EQUIPMENT_TALENT: When you first gain the Equipment sphere, choose one Equipment talent and gain it for free. You must meet the talent's prerequisites.

#### Glass Shard
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet

Cost: 0 CP

GLASS_BASE_REFRACTION_RESPONSES:
#### Refraction Responses
When a creature, object, attack line, or Glass Surface with a Faultline Mark is involved in a triggering event, you may spend the mark to use one Refraction Response you know.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you may use only one Refraction Response per triggering event.
You know the following Refraction Responses when you learn Glass.
##### Turn the Angle
Trigger: A marked creature hits you or an ally within 5 feet of one of your tempered Glass Surfaces.
Reduce the triggering damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 5, reduce it by 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 11, reduce it by 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 17, reduce it by 4d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
If this reduces the damage to 0, the attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
##### Visible Crack
Trigger: A marked creature attempts to Hide, become Invisible, benefit from Cover, or conceal the origin of an attack or technique.
Until the start of your next turn, you and allies who can see one of your Glass Surfaces know the marked creature’s space, even if the creature is Invisible or hidden.
This does not reveal a creature through Total Cover unless the Glass Surface also has line of sight to the creature.
##### Bitter Edge
Trigger: A marked creature willingly moves 5 feet or more.
The creature takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
At CL 11+, you may also make the first square of movement through your adjacent space or your Glass Surface count as difficult terrain.
##### Shatter Warning
Trigger: A marked creature makes an attack roll through or against one of your Glass Surfaces.
Impose a -2 penalty on the triggering attack roll.
If the attack misses, the marked creature takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
##### Refracted Step
Trigger: You spend a Faultline Mark on a creature within 5 feet of you or your tempered Glass Surface.
Move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the marked creature.
At CL 5, move 10 feet. At CL 11, move 15 feet. At CL 17, move 20 feet.
##### Break the Line
Trigger: A marked object, barrier, weapon, shield, door, or Glass Surface takes damage.
Add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage dealt to that object or surface.
If the object is reduced to 0 HP, choose one creature within 5 feet of it. That creature takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
GLASS_BASE_TEMPER_GLASS_SURFACE:
#### Temper Glass Surface
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self, touch, or a held object
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP

GUARDIAN_BASE_CHALLENGE_PRACTICE:
### Challenge Practice
You cultivate the art of becoming the enemy’s most immediate problem.
#### Challenge
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can perceive your challenge
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: None
Issue a challenge through words, stance, weapon intent, a visible gesture, killing pressure, or another method the target can perceive.
An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature becomes Challenged by you for the duration.
Successful Save: No effect.
A mindless creature cannot be Challenged unless a talent explicitly says otherwise.
While a creature is Challenged by you:
it has Disadvantage on attack rolls that do not include you as a target;
it has Advantage on attack rolls targeting only you;
if it cannot legally perceive, reach, or target you, it does not suffer Disadvantage merely because it attacks another creature;
when you successfully Challenge another creature, your previous Challenge ends unless a talent says otherwise.
A creature may be affected by Challenges from multiple cultivators.
If it attacks at least one creature that has Challenged it, it does not suffer Disadvantage merely because another challenger was not included.
GUARDIAN_BASE_PATROL_PRACTICE:
### Patrol Practice
You cultivate the art of deciding which ground an enemy may cross only by answering you.
#### Patrol
Action Type: Action
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Establish a Patrol Zone centered on yourself.
The Patrol Zone extends a distance equal to:
your melee reach + 10 feet
When a hostile creature you can perceive moves into, out of, or through your Patrol Zone, you may make one Patrol Response.
#### Patrol Response
A Patrol Response allows you to:
move up to your remaining Patrol Movement into a legal space that brings the triggering creature within your melee reach;
make one opportunity attack against that creature.
The first Patrol Response you make before the start of your next turn requires your Reaction.
At higher Cultivation Levels, you gain additional Patrol Responses each round that do not require your Reaction:
| Cultivation Level | Additional Patrol Responses |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 0 |
| 5-10 | 1 |
| 11-16 | 2 |
| 17-20 | 3 |
These additional Patrol Responses are explicit exceptions to the ordinary rule that a creature has only one Reaction between the starts of its turns. They may be used only for Patrol Responses.
These additional Patrol Responses:
may be used only while Patrol remains active;
are still treated as Reactions for rules that limit one response to one trigger;
cannot trigger another Reaction talent from the same triggering movement;
do not restore your ordinary Reaction;
cannot be used more than once during the same creature’s turn.
#### Patrol Movement
When you establish Patrol, your total Patrol Movement before the start of your next turn equals your Speed.
Movement spent through Patrol Responses:
reduces your remaining Patrol Movement;
follows a legal route;
provokes opportunity attacks normally;
cannot exceed your remaining Patrol Movement;
does not reduce your Speed during your own turn.
#### Patrol Attack Limits
A Patrol attack:
is an opportunity attack;
may be made only once per triggering creature’s turn;
cannot trigger itself;
does not deal Sneak Attack damage or comparable precision damage unless a talent explicitly permits it;
still requires a legal melee attack and a weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon able to reach the target.
#### Zone Talent Limit
Choose one Patrol Zone talent you know whenever you establish Patrol.
Only one Zone talent normally modifies one Patrol.
HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_CLEAN_HARVEST:
### Clean Harvest
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 10 minutes for ordinary work; Action only if a talent says so
Requirement: appropriate tools or a justified improvised method
Make a Gathering Check against the source’s Harvest DC.
Success: You harvest one usable Lot or specific ingredient from the source.
Success by 5 or More: Choose one benefit:
harvest one additional Lot if the source has enough material;
create a Pure Lot;
avoid harming the root, nest, vein, corpse, or future site;
learn one additional fact from Read the Sign;
avoid one minor hazard associated with the harvest.
Success by 10 or More: Create a Perfect Lot if the source can support it, or choose two benefits from Success by 5 or More.
Failure by 5 or Less: You harvest a Bruised Lot, or the Lot requires immediate sealing to remain useful.
Failure by More Than 5: The attempted Lot is lost, spoiled, contaminated, scattered, or destroyed.
Natural 1: The attempted Lot is lost and a hazard triggers if one exists. Examples include poisonous spores, biting insects, a guardian beast’s attention, a snapped root, spiritual backlash, corrosive sap, falling stone, bad air, or a broken tool.
HARVESTING_GATHERING_BASE_SEAL_THE_ESSEN:
### Seal the Essence
When you finish a Short Rest or spend 10 minutes with a harvested Lot, you may seal a number of Lots equal to your Proficiency Bonus + Gathering key ability modifier, minimum 1.
Sealed Lots do not spoil under ordinary travel conditions for 7 days.
At CL 5, your sealed Lots remain stable for 30 days.
At CL 10, your sealed Lots remain stable for 1 year if stored properly.
At CL 15, your sealed Lots remain stable indefinitely unless damaged, cursed, stolen, spiritually consumed, or exposed to an incompatible environment.
Sealing does not protect against every supernatural condition. Fire orchids may still require heat. Moon dew may still require darkness. Thunder fruit may still need copper seals. The GM may require special containers for Rare or higher materials.
HUNGER_BASE_DIGESTIVE_MANTLE:
### Digestive Mantle
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Target: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP and 1 Satiety
You ignite one Satiety charge inside your meridians and wear its nourishment as a temporary cultivation state.
When you activate Digestive Mantle, gain Temporary HP equal to:
**twice your Proficiency Bonus + your Hunger key ability modifier**
Then choose one basic Mantle benefit appropriate to the consumed source.
Beast Strength: Gain Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws. Once before the Mantle ends, when you hit with a melee attack or unarmed strike, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll.
Predator Step: Your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once before the Mantle ends, when you move at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and hit it with an attack on the same turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll.
Iron Stomach: Gain Advantage on saving throws against Poisoned and Disease. When you succeed on such a saving throw while the Mantle is active, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Thick Hide: Once per round when you take Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Hunger key ability modifier.
Venom Belly: Once per turn when you hit with an attack, deal extra Poison or Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Hunger key ability modifier.
Furnace Belly: Once per turn when you hit with an attack, deal extra Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Hunger key ability modifier.
Elemental Gut: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, or Thunder, as appropriate to the Satiety source. You gain Resistance to that damage type while the Mantle lasts. If the source was only weakly associated with the type, the GM may limit this Resistance to the first triggering damage instance each round.
Deep Nourishment: When you activate the Mantle, end one nonmagical hunger, thirst, forced-march, or travel-fatigue penalty that has not become Exhaustion. While the Mantle lasts, you have Advantage on Constitution saving throws against Exhaustion caused by travel, starvation, thirst, exposure, disease, or hostile terrain.
Demon-Beast Course: Choose two basic Mantle benefits above that fit the demon beast instead of one. Gain 1 Impurity when the Mantle ends unless another talent changes this.
Cultivator Course: If a Forbidden Hunger talent lets you create Forbidden Satiety, a Digestive Mantle using that Satiety may choose one basic Mantle benefit that fits the consumed cultivator's Path or known sphere. Some Forbidden Hunger talents improve this benefit.
You can benefit from only one Digestive Mantle at a time. Activating a new Digestive Mantle ends the previous one.

HUNGER_BASE_TASTE_THE_QI:
### Taste the Qi
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, corpse, meal, ingredient, beast core, spiritual dish, visible residue, or container you can perceive
Cost: None
Duration: Until the end of your next turn, or 1 minute outside combat
You taste the spiritual pressure of the target.

- Is this creature Bloodied?

ICE_BASE_SPENDING_A_FRACTURE_MARK:
#### Spending a Fracture Mark
Once per round, when a marked creature or object you can perceive performs a triggering act, you may spend its Fracture Mark without using an Action. Choose one Fracture Response appropriate to the trigger.
Catch Step.
Trigger: the marked target begins movement, including special movement or teleportation. Reduce one of the target’s Speeds by 10 feet until the end of the current turn, or reduce the distance of one teleportation effect by 10 feet. At CL 11, this reduction becomes 20 feet. This cannot reduce a Speed or teleportation distance below 0.
Brittle Opening.
Trigger: the marked target is hit by an attack. The triggering attack deals extra Piercing or Cold damage equal to 1d4 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 11, the die becomes 1d6.
Crack Aim.
Trigger: the marked target makes an attack roll or Dexterity saving throw. Subtract 1d4 from the triggering roll. At CL 11, subtract 1d6 instead.
Shatter Space.
Trigger: the marked target enters, starts its turn in, or ends its turn in one of your Lattice Spaces. One Lattice Space occupied by the target shatters. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take Piercing or Cold damage equal to your Shard Needle damage and fall Prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and does not fall Prone. The chosen Lattice Space ends.
Lock Grip.
Trigger: the marked target uses an object, weapon, tool, focus, or held item. Until the start of its next turn, the target has Disadvantage on the next ability check or attack roll it makes using that item. If the item is unattended, you may instead freeze it to an adjacent surface until the start of your next turn. A creature can free the item early by using an Action and succeeding on a Strength check against your Ice Save DC.
Crystal Guard.
Trigger: the marked target is a willing creature and takes damage. Reduce the damage by 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier. This reduction increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. The mark then ends.
IMBUEMENT_BASE_COUNTER_MANDATE:

Range: 30 feet
Target: One active Mandate or similar enhancement/degradation effect
Cost: 1 CP
You attempt to suppress or overwrite an active property-command effect. Make an Imbuement Check against the effect’s DC. If the effect has no listed DC, use 10 + its Pattern Rank or 10 + the creator’s Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier.

IMBUEMENT_BASE_FRAY_MANDATE:

Range: 30 feet

Saving Throw: Wisdom negates unless talent says otherwise
You place one hostile Fray option you know into the target Vessel.
Choose one Fray talent you know and apply its listed effect. A creature receives a Wisdom saving throw. A creature also receives a Wisdom saving throw to resist a Fray effect targeting one of its held, worn, wielded, or carried objects.
At the end of each of its turns, an affected creature may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself or one of its possessions on a success.
IMBUEMENT_BASE_PLACE_MANDATE:
#### Place Mandate
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One willing creature, unattended object, willing item bearer, or legal Vessel
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 0 CP unless the Mandate talent says otherwise
Saving Throw: Wisdom negates if the target or item bearer is unwilling
You place one beneficial Imbue option you know into the target Vessel.

INK_BASE_INK_LASH:
#### Base Ability - Ink Lash
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: None.
Target: One creature or object you can see.
Effect: Make a ranged Cultivation Attack roll. On a hit, the target takes Slashing or Psychic damage. Choose the damage type when you attack.
Damage: At CL 1-4, the damage is 1d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 5-10, the damage is 2d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 11-16, the damage is 3d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 17-20, the damage is 4d8 + your key ability modifier.
Brush Shape: Ink Lash may appear as a cutting stroke, a hooked character, a whip of black ink, a vermilion slash, a painted fang, or a line of scripture.
Objects: Against unattended objects, Ink Lash may cut, stain, write across, or weaken the target at the GM’s discretion. It is not automatically a lockpick or disintegration tool.
INK_BASE_LIVING_INK:
#### Base Ability - Living Ink
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: No action to produce for ordinary use; part of the action for an Ink talent in combat
Range: Self.
Duration: 1 hour if unused; permanent for ordinary nonmagical writing if you choose to leave it behind.
Cost: None.
Effect: You conjure a supply of Living Ink sufficient for your techniques. The ink may appear from your fingertips, brush, weapon, mouth, blood, sleeve, shadow, or focus. It can write, stain, draw, mark surfaces, create calligraphy, and serve as the medium for Ink talents. Unused Living Ink fades after 1 hour and cannot be sold as a mundane commodity.
Ordinary Writing: You may use Living Ink for ordinary writing, calligraphy, labels, sketches, maps, and signatures. This writing can remain indefinitely if you choose, but it has no supernatural effect unless attached to an Ink talent, ritual, forged technique, or GM-approved project.
Spiritual Pressure: When you use an Ink talent openly, nearby observers usually see or sense supernatural calligraphy unless the talent is specifically concealed.
INK_BASE_PRESS_MARK:
#### Base Ability - Press Mark
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: None.
Target: One object, surface, doorway, container, weapon, tool, corpse, willing creature, or 5-foot section of wall, floor, or ceiling.
Effect: Place a simple Ink Mark. A simple Ink Mark has no special effect by itself, but it may serve as an anchor, origin, target, or requirement for Ink talents.
Unwilling Creature: If you try to Press Mark onto an unwilling creature, the target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the mark fails.
Combat Marking: A simple Ink Mark placed by Press Mark on a hostile creature is visible unless you spend 1 CP to conceal it as part of the same action.
INK_BASE_READ_THE_TRACE:
#### Base Ability - Read the Trace
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Cost: None.
Target: One written text, magical mark, seal, rune, painting, inscription, talisman, Formation mark, or Ink Mark.
Effect: You study the target and learn one of the following.
Whether it is ordinary, magical, spiritual, forged, or sphere-created.
Whether it contains an active Ink Mark, seal, curse, ward, or hidden script.
Whether it was written recently or long ago.
Whether it was written by a living hand, spirit, construct, item, formation, or sphere effect.
Whether it has been altered, forged, erased, or overwritten.
Check: For a concealed, hostile, or high-Realm inscription, make an Intelligence (Arcana), Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Insight), calligrapher’s supplies, painter’s supplies, or Cultivation Check against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC or a GM-set DC.
JESTER_BASE_DELIVER_THE_PUNCHLINE:
### Deliver the Punchline
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: Your Foil fulfills your chosen Proposition
Use one Punchline talent you know whose trigger is compatible with the fulfilled Proposition.
If the Punchline calls for a saving throw, use your Jester Save DC.
JESTER_BASE_SET_THE_SCENE:
### Set the Scene
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can see or hear you
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Choose one creature as your Foil and one Proposition.
You may have only one Foil at a time.
The creature knows that you are inviting a response, but it does not automatically know which Punchline talent you intend to use.
Choose one Proposition:
#### Come Closer
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil willingly moves at least 5 feet toward you or willingly enters your reach.
#### Strike the Fool
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil makes an attack roll against you.
#### Ignore the Fool
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil targets another creature with an attack roll or harmful effect while it can see or hear you.
#### Show Your Hand
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil takes the Magic action or activates an explicitly supernatural technique.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
forced movement does not fulfill a Proposition;
teleportation does not fulfill Come Closer;
a Proposition is fulfilled after the Foil commits to the triggering action but before the triggering attack roll or saving throws are resolved;
if a Punchline changes movement, resolve it after the triggering movement enters the relevant space but before movement continues;
one fulfilled Proposition allows one Punchline;
after you deliver a Punchline, Set the Scene ends.
LIFE_BASE_BORROWED_BREATH:
#### Borrowed Breath
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 0 CP
You lend temporary vitality to an injured creature.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target has 0 Hit Points and is living, the target becomes stable before receiving these Temporary HP. These Temporary HP do not restore the target to consciousness unless another feature says otherwise.
Borrowed Breath can only be used on an injured target. It cannot raise the target’s current Hit Points plus Temporary HP above the target’s Hit Point maximum unless a talent says otherwise.
Augment - Lasting Breath, 1 CP: The Temporary HP last until depleted or until you finish a long rest. You may apply this augment after creating Borrowed Breath on your turn without spending an action.
LIFE_BASE_LIFE_INITIATION:
#### Life Initiation
You gain training in the basic language of living patterns.
You can recognize obvious signs of bleeding, suffocation, poisoning, disease, dying, shock, spiritual drift, and broken meridian flow. This does not replace a Medicine check, Alchemy diagnosis, or Spirit Awakening perception when the cause is hidden.
You may use your Life key ability instead of Wisdom for Medicine checks made to stabilize a living creature or identify a wound, poison, disease, or condition that your Life talents could treat.
LIFE_BASE_MEND_THE_PULSE:
#### Mend the Pulse
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 1 CP
You restore the target’s living pattern. The target regains Hit Points based on your Realm.
Mortal: 1d8 + your key ability modifier.Foundation: 2d8 + your key ability modifier.Core Formation: 3d8 + your key ability modifier.Nascent Soul: 4d8 + your key ability modifier.
Mend the Pulse has no effect on undead or constructs unless a talent says otherwise.
LIFE_BASE_PURIFY_THE_PULSE:
#### Purify the Pulse
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 1 CP
You remove one disease or one of the following conditions from the target:
Blinded;
Deafened;
Paralyzed;
Poisoned.
If the condition is caused by an ongoing effect, Purify the Pulse suppresses that effect for a number of rounds equal to your key ability modifier, minimum 1 round. This does not end the source effect unless a talent says otherwise.
Purify the Pulse cannot remove curses, instantaneous effects, missing limbs, Exhaustion, ability score reductions, Hit Point maximum reductions, or spiritual bindings unless a talent says otherwise.
LIFE_BASE_READ_THE_PULSE:
#### Read the Pulse
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 0 CP
You read the target’s living pattern.
You learn whether the target is living, dead, dying, poisoned, diseased, Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. You also learn whether the target currently has 0 Hit Points.
You may place a Pulse Seal on the target.
If you use Read the Pulse as an Action instead of a Bonus Action, you also learn the general nature of one disease, poison, injury, or condition affecting the target. The GM may describe this in practical terms rather than revealing hidden stat-block names.
You may use Read the Pulse on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day. If you do, you learn the most obvious cause of death.
You may use Read the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal regardless of distance or line of effect, provided the creature is on the same plane of existence. When you do, you know the creature’s direction and distance from you.
Body Refiners cannot use this remote reading unless a talent, forged technique, or GM permission allows their Pulse Seal to remain physically meaningful at that distance.
METAL_BASE_MAGNET_HAND:

Timing Detail: Object Interaction
Range: 30 feet
Target: One unattended Tiny metal object you can see
Cost: None

METAL_BASE_METAL_APPRAISAL:

- Is this target strongly conductive, magnetic, brittle, hardened, hollow, or resonant?

METAL_BASE_METAL_QI_AWAKENING:

You awaken the ability to express Metal Qi through qualifying mediums.

METAL_BASE_SHARPEN:

Target: One target hit by the triggering attack or technique

Cost: None

Duration: 1 minute
Cost: None

you may choose a Tone for the performance;
creatures that can perceive the performance count as hearing your Music for talent purposes;
the performance ends early if you become Incapacitated or if a required sound/rhythm source is suppressed.

MUSIC_BASE_RESONANT_NOTE:

Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet

Cost: None

POISON_BASE_DELIVER_THE_DOSE:

Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet, or weapon range if delivered through a weapon
Target: One creature or object
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
You deliver venom, toxic qi, corrosive fluid, a poisoned needle, mineral dust, spirit spores, toxic breath, or a coated strike.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If you deliver the dose through a weapon attack, make the weapon attack normally instead.
On a hit, the target takes Poison or Acid damage equal to the listed dice + your Path key ability modifier, chosen when you attack.
Mortal: 1d8Foundation: 2d8Core Formation: 3d8Nascent Soul: 4d8
Once per turn when you hit a creature with Deliver the Dose, the target makes a Constitution saving throw.

POISON_BASE_INGRAIN_THE_TOXIN:
#### Ingrain the Toxin
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet, or touch for Body Refining use
Target: One creature with at least 2 Dose Marks from you
Duration: Until the target finishes a long rest or receives treatment
Cost: 2 CP
You spend 2 Dose Marks on the target and attempt to lodge a minor lingering toxin into the body, meridian flow, breath, or spirit.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one Minor Ingrained Toxin effect:
Bitter Breath. The target has Disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw before its next long rest.
Numb Channels. The target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until its next long rest.
Sour Blood. The next healing the target receives before its next long rest is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Clouded Senses. The target has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom (Perception) check before its next long rest.
Heavy Pulse. The target cannot benefit from the Dash action on its next turn, and has Disadvantage on its next Dexterity saving throw before its next long rest.
Successful Save: The Dose Marks are spent, but no Ingrained Toxin takes hold.
A Minor Ingrained Toxin is intentionally limited. Serious long-term poison requires Foundation, Core Formation, or Nascent Soul talents.
A creature can identify or treat a Minor Ingrained Toxin with appropriate Medicine, Alchemy, Life, Poison, or purification methods. The treatment DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
PRESSURE_POINTS_BASE_NUMBING_POINT:
### Numbing Point - Point
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: None
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
You numb a shallow nerve, tendon, joint, seam, or meridian crossing.
Choose one option:
Numb Arm: The target has Disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll, Unarmed Strike attack roll, or attack made with a held object before the effect ends.
Numb Leg: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it cannot take Opportunity Attacks.
Numb Grip: The target has Disadvantage on the next Strength saving throw, Strength (Athletics) check, or D20 Test made to resist Disarm, maintain a Grapple, or keep hold of an object before the effect ends.
Numb Reflex: The target has Disadvantage on the next Dexterity saving throw or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check it makes before the effect ends.
PROTECTION_BASE_AEGIS:
#### Aegis
An Aegis is a protective cultivation effect placed on one creature.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
A creature may benefit from only one Aegis created by the same cultivator at a time.
An Aegis uses Concentration unless made Persistent.
An Aegis may be ended early by its creator without spending an action.
An unwilling creature may make a Wisdom saving throw to resist receiving an Aegis. Aegis talents replace the Armored Aegis unless the talent explicitly says it augments another Aegis.
PROTECTION_BASE_ARMORED_AEGIS:
#### Armored Aegis
When you learn the Protection sphere, you learn this Aegis talent automatically.
Protective barriers wrap the target.
The target’s base AC becomes equal to your Cultivation Save DC.
The target does not add its Dexterity modifier to this AC.
Armored Aegis does not stack with worn armor, but the target may still benefit from a shield.
PROTECTION_BASE_BARRIER_WARD:
#### Barrier Ward
When you learn the Protection sphere, you learn this Ward talent automatically.
Create a mostly transparent wall along the Ward’s perimeter.
The Barrier blocks:
movement through its edge;
attacks crossing its edge;
breath weapons crossing its edge;
destructive blasts crossing its edge;
ghost strikes crossing its edge;
other effects that must physically travel to their destination. The Barrier does not automatically block teleportation, mind-affecting effects, gaze attacks, or abilities that do not travel through the wall.
##### Barrier Placement
If the Barrier cuts through a creature’s space when it appears, the creature chooses one side and is pushed into the nearest legal space on that side.
If the Barrier and another solid surface would completely enclose a creature, it may make a Dexterity saving throw.
Successful Save: The creature may use its Reaction to move up to its Speed into the nearest legal space outside the enclosure.
Failed Save: The creature remains enclosed.
The Barrier extends into the Ethereal Plane.
##### Barrier Statistics
If the Barrier reaches 0 HP, the Ward ends.
##### Overflow Damage
If an attack deals more damage than the Barrier’s current HP, the attacker may burst through.
Subtract the Barrier’s remaining HP from the attack’s damage.
If the attack can legally continue to a creature on the other side, make a new attack roll against one target within range.
On a hit, deal the remaining damage.
Area damage that bursts through affects creatures on the other side with its remaining damage.
##### Crushing Through
A creature may use an Action to attempt to shove or overrun the Barrier.
Make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Successful Check: The Barrier shatters and the Ward ends.
Failed Check: The Barrier remains.
PROTECTION_BASE_SUCCOR:
#### Succor
A Succor is a sacrificial rescue. The base Protection sphere does not grant a Succor effect automatically; Succor talents provide the triggers and effects.
To use Succor, a trigger stated by one Succor talent you know must occur and that talent must have an eligible target. The target must currently benefit from one of your Persistent Aegises. The detailed Reaction procedure appears under the base Succor ability below.
PUPPETRY_BASE_PUPPET_STRIKE:

Cost: 0 CP
Make a Puppetry attack roll from the puppet vessel’s space.

1d8 + your Puppetry key ability modifier
Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, chosen when you designate the vessel’s form.

PUPPETRY_BASE_RAISE_THE_VESSEL:

PUPPETRY_BASE_THREAD_THE_OBJECT:

You manipulate one unattended object no heavier than 10 pounds within range.

Thread the Object cannot attack, activate magic items, make tool checks, pick locks, disarm traps, or perform complex craft unless a talent says otherwise.

Cultivation Level: 5-10;

RADIANCE_TAL_DAWNLIT_REBUKE:

1d8 + your Radiance ability modifier

RADIANCE_TAL_SUN_WHITE_JUDGMENT_SPEAR:

RETRIBUTION_BASE_COUNTERSTRIKE:

Timing Detail: Ready Action; see Extra Attack and Multiattack below
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Prepare one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Counterstrike.
When you prepare a Counterstrike:
choose one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike you could legally make;
choose one perceivable trigger;
choose one Counter talent you know, if any.
When one of your chosen triggers begins, you may take your Reaction to make the prepared attack against the triggering creature.
A Counterstrike is a specific exception to the ordinary Ready Action:
it resolves before the triggering action, movement, or other activity finishes;
the triggering activity continues normally after your Counterstrike unless your attack, a Counter talent, or another rule prevents it;
you must be able to perceive the trigger;
the triggering creature must be a legal target for the prepared attack when your Counterstrike resolves;
you may ignore a trigger and continue waiting for another chosen trigger before the preparation ends.
Hit: Deal the attack’s ordinary damage and add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of the attack.
After a Counterstrike hits, you regain your Reaction if it is currently expended.
This restored Reaction is a specific exception to the ordinary Reaction limit. It may be spent normally, but it does not allow you to make a second Counterstrike during the same round.
You may make only one Counterstrike per round, regardless of how many triggers you chose or how many Reactions you can take.
SABERS_BASE_SABER_LINE_METHOD:
### Saber-Line Method
Action Type: Passive
Range: Self
Cost: None
Choose one qualifying saber-profile weapon, such as dao, duan dao, butterfly saber, cavalry saber, heavy saber, or a similar curved/chopping blade approved by the GM.
You gain proficiency with that weapon if you do not already have it.
You may use Sabers talents with qualifying saber-profile weapons. If a weapon is ambiguous, the GM decides whether it belongs to Sabers, Sword, Weapons, Axes, or another weapon sphere.
SABERS_BASE_SABER_LINE_PRESSURE:
### Saber-Line Pressure
Action Type: Passive
Timing Detail: Passive / once-turn rider
Range: Self
Cost: None
Once on each of your turns when you hit with a qualifying saber attack after moving toward the target, cutting around a guard, following a Sabers setup, or spending Edge Momentum, choose one:
- gain 1 Edge Momentum, up to your Proficiency Bonus;
- make the target Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn;
- if you practice Cruel Edge Method, apply one Saber Wound.
Saber-Line Pressure does not trigger from purely spell attacks, companion attacks, formation attacks, autonomous weapons, or non-saber attacks unless another feature explicitly says so.
SAND_BASE_GATHER_SAND:
#### Gather Sand
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: Up to two contiguous 5-foot squares
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP if drawing from an existing Sand Source; 1 CP if creating sand where no Sand Source exists
You call loose grains together, raise dust from dry ground, powder small mineral fragments, or conjure a controlled spill of cultivation-shaped sand.
Choose up to two contiguous 5-foot squares within range. Those squares become Shallow Sand Terrain for the duration.
As a Bonus Action on later turns, you may move one square of Sand Terrain created by this use up to 10 feet along a surface you can perceive. A square cannot move through a creature’s space unless a talent allows it.
At CL 5, this creates up to four contiguous 5-foot squares. At CL 11, up to six. At CL 17, up to eight.
SAND_BASE_SCOURING_HAND:
#### Scouring Hand
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object within range and within 5 feet of a Sand Source or Sand Terrain
Saving Throw: Dexterity
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 0 CP
You lash a target with cutting grit, rising dust, or a snapping rope of sand.
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 1d8 Slashing damage and suffers one of the following minor effects of your choice:
it cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn;
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn;
it has Disadvantage on the next Wisdom (Perception) check relying on sight it makes before the start of your next turn.
On a successful save, the target takes half damage and suffers no minor effect.
Damage increases to 2d8 at CL 5, 3d8 at CL 11, and 4d8 at CL 17.
SECT_STEWARDSHIP_BASE_MERIT_DICE:
### Merit Dice
Sect Stewardship uses Merit Dice.
Your Merit Die begins as a d4.
Your maximum number of Merit Dice is equal to your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 1.
You regain all spent Merit Dice when you finish a Long Rest if you are in good standing with at least one institution and spend at least 10 minutes fulfilling a duty, checking a ledger, reporting to a superior, instructing a junior, cleaning a shared space, or otherwise honoring your role.
If you are away from any institution, you regain one spent Merit Die when you finish a Long Rest by maintaining records, writing reports, preserving tokens, planning duties, or honoring the sect’s rules while traveling.
You can spend Merit Dice only on Sect Stewardship features unless another rule says otherwise.
Merit Dice cannot be converted into gold, trade goods, CXP, pills, talents, items, or political office unless a talent explicitly permits a limited exchange.
SECT_STEWARDSHIP_BASE_SECT_CHECK:
### Sect Check
When a Sect Stewardship talent calls for a Sect Check, roll:
d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Sect Stewardship key ability modifier
You may spend one Merit Die before or after rolling the d20 but before the GM declares the result. Roll the Merit Die and add it to the check.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you cannot add more than one Merit Die to the same d20 roll.
SECT_STEWARDSHIP_BASE_STANDING:
### Standing
Standing measures how an institution currently recognizes you.
Standing is not cultivation Realm, social class, noble rank, or universal reputation. It is local and contextual.
There are five ordinary Standing grades.
No Standing. You are a stranger, guest, prisoner, petitioner, or unknown worker.
Servant Standing. You may perform basic labor, receive food or shelter, and be ordered around.
Outer Standing. You are trusted for ordinary duties, simple missions, shared facilities, and basic records.
Inner Standing. You are trusted with restricted duties, better instruction, inner facilities, low-grade resources, and sensitive errands.
Core Standing. You are trusted with disciples, stores, restricted archives, important missions, hall authority, or a named courtyard.
Some institutions may also recognize Elder Standing, Guest Elder Standing, Lineage Heir Standing, Clan Standing, Official Standing, or other campaign-specific statuses. These are story positions and are not automatically gained from this sphere.
When you learn Sect Stewardship, choose one institution where you have Servant or Outer Standing, subject to GM approval. If the campaign begins before you have joined any group, you instead gain the Petitioner status and can use the sphere to earn your first recognized place.
SHIELD_BASE_ACTIVE_DEFENSE:
#### ACTIVE DEFENSE
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you are aware of makes an attack roll against you
Requirement: Wielding a Shield
Cost: None
Raise, angle, or turn your Shield against the incoming attack.
Increase your Shield Bonus to AC against the triggering attack by:
+2 AC
This is an additional increase to the AC already granted by the Shield.
You may use Active Defense after the attack roll is made but before damage or another hit effect resolves.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Active Defense without spending a Reaction.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
Active Defense applies only against the triggering attack;
Active Defense does not grant cover;
Active Defense does not block an effect that does not use an attack roll;
Active Defense does not function while you are unaware of the attacker;
Active Defense does not function while you cannot present the Shield toward the incoming attack;
each use of Active Defense may benefit from no more than one Deflect talent.
SHIELD_BASE_SHIELD_TRAINING:
#### SHIELD TRAINING
A standard Shield grants a +2 bonus to Armor Class only when the wielder has Shield training.
A creature may wield only one Shield at a time.
Donning or doffing a Shield requires the Utilize action.
Shield talents may explicitly equip, release, throw, recover, animate, or spiritually project a Shield more quickly.
SMOKE_BASE_DENSE_SMOKE:
#### Dense Smoke
Some talents make smoke Dense.
Dense smoke is Heavily Obscured for creatures that rely on sight.
Dense smoke does not automatically deafen creatures, poison creatures, block Tremorsense, or prevent creatures from making attacks into or out of it. It only changes what can be seen unless a talent adds more.
SMOKE_BASE_SMOKE_RESPONSES:
#### Smoke Responses
You know the following three Smoke Responses.
You may spend one Smoke Trace to use a Smoke Response.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you can use only one Smoke Response per round.
##### Blind the Line
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace makes an attack roll and the attack’s line of sight passes through your Smoke Veil
Spend the Smoke Trace.
The triggering attack has Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight.
Blind the Line does not affect attacks from creatures that do not rely on sight or that can see clearly through smoke.
##### Follow the Soot
Action Type: Bonus Action
Target: One creature, object, or space with your Smoke Trace
Spend the Smoke Trace.
Until the start of your next turn, you know the direction to the traced target while it remains within 120 feet of you.
If the target is Invisible, Hidden, or behind smoke, this does not reveal it to your allies, but it prevents it from being hidden from you by smoke alone.
##### Slip the Chimney Path
Action Type: Bonus Action
Target: One Smoke Trace on a space within your Smoke Veil
Spend the Smoke Trace.
Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures inside your Smoke Veil.
This movement must begin or end in your Smoke Veil.
SMOKE_BASE_SMOKE_VEIL:
#### Smoke Veil
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP
You create a veil of real supernatural smoke in an unoccupied space you can see within range.
The area is Lightly Obscured.
A creature entirely on the opposite side of the Smoke Veil from an observer is also lightly obscured from that observer if the line of sight passes through the veil.
As a Bonus Action while the veil persists, move it up to 10 feet to a space within range.
The veil cannot pass through solid barriers unless a talent says otherwise.
At CL 5, the area becomes two connected 10-foot cubes.At CL 11, it becomes three connected 10-foot cubes.At CL 17, it becomes four connected 10-foot cubes.
SOURCE_BASE_SOURCE_PULSE:
### Source Pulse
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature touching a mineral surface, or one unattended mineral object
Cost: 0
Make a Source attack roll against the target. On a hit against a creature, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage as buried source-light snaps through the ground, wall, crystal, jade, ore, or stone under it, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. On a hit against an unattended object, the object takes the damage only.
The damage becomes 2d8 at Foundation Realm, 3d8 at Core Formation Realm, and 4d8 at Nascent Soul Realm.
The Speed reduction from Source Pulse does not stack with itself. Source Pulse cannot target a creature that is not touching an eligible mineral surface unless another talent, variant, item, or GM ruling says otherwise. Source Pulse does not damage the ground, create difficult terrain, open seals, or break objects beyond its listed damage unless a talent says it does.
SOURCE_BASE_SOURCE_READING:
### Source Reading
Source Reading is the basic act of inspecting stone, earth, ore, jade, crystal, a mine face, a source object, a sealed stone, or a mineral surface.
As an Action, you may inspect one unattended mineral object, one visible seal on a mineral object, or one 5-foot section of mineral surface within reach. The GM tells you whether it has obvious active qi, obvious instability, obvious artificial sealing, obvious spiritual contamination, or obvious recent disturbance.
By spending 10 minutes, you may make a Source check against a DC set by the GM to learn one useful fact about one mineral object, chamber, vein, quarry face, ruin wall, mine tunnel, source deposit, sealed stone, or similar feature you can examine. Examples include whether it is natural or worked, whether it contains active source qi, whether it is unstable, whether it has been cut recently, whether a stronger vein lies in a visible direction, whether a seal is present, whether opening it is obviously dangerous, or whether a seal is meant to contain, preserve, warn, lock, hide, or punish.
Source Reading does not reveal exact treasure value, full maps, hidden creatures behind total cover, secret doors automatically, command words, sealed creature identities, or the full rules of another sphere. It gives one grounded fact through stone and source.
SOURCE_BASE_SOURCE_SEAL:
### Source Seal
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One unattended mineral object no larger than a 5-foot cube, one closed mineral container, one closed stone or metal door, one visible seal on a mineral object, or one 5-foot section of mineral surface
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0
You place a faint source seal on the target. The seal is visible as dust-light, pressure lines, mineral frost, dull jade script, or another obvious Source mark unless a talent says otherwise.
Choose one basic effect:
- **Warning Seal.** If the target is opened, broken, moved, or spiritually disturbed while you are within 60 feet, you know that the seal was disturbed.
- **Stillness Seal.** The target has Advantage on the next saving throw or check it makes before the seal ends to avoid cracking, discharging, collapsing, or releasing stored pressure. If the target does not normally make such a roll, this has no effect.
- **Reading Seal.** The next Source Reading check you make against the target before the seal ends has Advantage.
- **Fetter Seal.** This option can be placed only on a 5-foot section of mineral surface. The first time a creature of your choice enters that section or starts its turn there before the seal ends, you may end the seal. If you do, that creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of that turn.
Source Seal does not lock the target, prevent movement except through Fetter Seal, restrain a creature, suppress a magic item, dispel a talisman, overwrite a Formation, prevent teleportation, or create a permanent mark. Talents create stronger seals by modifying or replacing this basic effect.
You can maintain a number of active Source Seals equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you create another Source Seal beyond this limit, choose one existing Source Seal you created to end.
SOURCE_BASE_SOURCE_TRAINING:
### Source Training
Action Type: Passive
Range: Self
Target: Self
Cost: 0
When you gain the Source sphere, choose one Source talent and gain it for free. You also gain Source Reading, Source Pulse, and Source Seal.

STARS_TAL_METEOR_SHOWER:

STARS_TAL_STAR_PIERCING_LINE:

Action Type: Action

Draw a killing line between your cultivation and one named point in the constellation. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack against a creature bearing your Stellar Mark or a creature within 30 feet of one of your Star Anchors.
On a hit, choose Radiant, Force, or Cold damage and deal 8d8 damage. The target then makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot teleport, become Invisible, or benefit from Half Cover until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot teleport until the start of your next turn.
Star-Piercing Line does not ignore Total Cover unless a Forged Technique or Secret effect permits it.
SWORD_BASE_SWORD_BEYOND_HAND:
#### Sword Beyond Hand - Sword Qi Wave
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Release a crescent wave of Sword Qi.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Deal Slashing or Force damage equal to the listed dice + your Path key ability modifier and apply Sword Intent until the start of your next turn.

SWORD_BASE_SWORD_PRACTICE:
#### Sword Practice
When you learn Sword, choose one Practice.
Sword in Hand - martial expression.
Sword Beyond Hand - projected Sword-Qi expression.
You may gain the other Practice through Dual Practice.
##### Body Refining Restriction
A Body Refiner may always choose Sword in Hand.
A Body Refiner may learn Sword Beyond Hand only through:
Sword-Body Adept;
Swordless Sword;
an appropriate inheritance;
a Forged Technique;
another explicit feature.

SWORD_BASE_SWORD_TRAINING:
#### Sword Training
When you learn Sword:
gain proficiency with shortswords, longswords, and greatswords;
if already proficient with all three, gain +2 to attack rolls made with approved Sword weapons.
This bonus does not stack with another Sword-sphere feature granting the same benefit.
TALISMANS_BASE_EMERGENCY_STROKE:
