#### Emergency Stroke
Action Type: Action
Cost: 1 CP
Requirement: free hand, brush, ink, blood, chalk, or another visible writing method
Duration: 1 hour or until activated
You quickly draw a temporary Common talisman you know onto paper, cloth, skin, weapon wrap, wall, floor, shield, armor, or another legal surface.
This temporary talisman cannot be reusable, permanent, sold as stable goods, or used as a project component. It is visibly crude unless you have a talent that hides or refines it.
You may use Emergency Stroke a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. Additional uses cost 2 CP each.
TALISMANS_BASE_TALISMAN_SCRIBE:
#### Talisman Scribe
When you gain the Talismans sphere, you gain proficiency with Calligrapher’s Supplies. If you already have this proficiency, gain one additional Common formula.
You learn three Common formulae of your choice.
You may craft Common talismans using the Talisman Crafting procedure.
You can identify your own talismans automatically. You have Advantage on checks to identify a talisman formula you personally know.
TAL_AIR_AIRLESS_STEP:
#### Airless Step - Sky-Step
When you take the Dash action, you may move across fragile surfaces, thin branches, loose snow, shallow water, unstable rubble, or narrow rails without requiring an ability check, provided you end your movement on a surface that can support you.
This does not allow you to walk on empty air.
At Foundation Realm, if you pass through one of your Air Currents during the Dash, you may cross up to 10 feet of empty space during that movement.
TAL_AIR_ARROW_TURNING_BREATH:
#### Arrow-Turning Breath - Guard
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an ordinary ranged weapon attack
Cost: None
Roll an Air Check against the attack roll.
Success: Reduce the attack’s damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
Success by 5 or more: The attack misses instead.
At Foundation Realm, you may use this against magical ammunition and thrown weapons. At Core Formation, you may use it against a physical projectile created by a non-Secret technique if the GM agrees it has a clear moving projectile.
TAL_AIR_BREATHLESS_CHAMBER:
#### Breathless Chamber - Breath, Current
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Breath-Stealing Palm
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You create a pressure chamber where breath becomes difficult.
Breath-dependent hostile creatures in the area make a Constitution saving throw when they enter the area for the first time on a turn or start their turn there.
Failed Save: The creature cannot speak above a whisper, cannot take Reactions, and has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature cannot shout or use long-distance vocal commands until the start of its next turn.
This is not full suffocation. It does not affect creatures that do not breathe unless a talent or Path synergy permits an equivalent target.
TAL_AIR_BREATH_BEYOND_THE_SKIN:
#### Breath Beyond the Skin - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Air Qi can exist outside your lungs and limbs as a stable local current.
Gain the following benefits:
Your Gather Current duration becomes 1 minute if you maintain Concentration.
You may maintain two Air Currents at the same time.
Wind Lash’s forced movement options can affect creatures up to two sizes larger than you.
Your Air techniques can affect magical smoke, spiritual mist, ghost-breath, corpse-wind, and similar supernatural airlike phenomena if the GM agrees they have an exposed current.
You may create temporary breathable air for yourself for 10 minutes once per short or long rest.
Breath Beyond the Skin does not grant unrestricted flight, vacuum immunity, or control over all weather.
TAL_AIR_BREATH_BRACED_BODY:
#### Breath-Braced Body - Breath
You may use your breath to stabilize your body.
When you make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against being pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or moved by wind, pressure, or forced movement, you may add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll if you are not already adding it.
Once you use this benefit, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
TAL_AIR_BREATH_OF_NO_DISTANCE:
#### Breath of No Distance - Breath, Current
Prerequisite: CL 15+
You can carry breath through the world’s air.
As an Action, choose one creature you know on the same plane within 10 miles. You must have a clear symbolic or physical connection: name, token, blood mark, talisman, familiar scent, active formation link, or current line of sight.
You may send a spoken message of up to one hundred words to that creature. If the creature is willing, it may answer with up to one hundred words.
If the path between you is blocked by sealed barriers, underground isolation, planar interference, a stronger Formation, or Void concealment, make an Air Check against the obstacle’s DC. On a failure, the message scatters and both creatures hear only wind.
TAL_AIR_BREATH_STEALING_PALM:
#### Breath-Stealing Palm - Breath
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When Wind Lash hits a breath-dependent creature, you may replace its basic Vector with Steal Breath.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot speak above a strained whisper, cannot shout commands, and has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on the next check requiring speech, breath control, song, chant, roar, or verbal command.
This does not prevent all technique activation. It affects techniques that clearly require breath, voice, mantra, lungs, or exhalation.
TAL_AIR_CLEAR_THE_AIR:
#### Clear the Air - Current
When you use Gather Current, you may choose Clear as its Vector.
Clear disperses nonmagical smoke, harmless gas, dust, pollen, light fog, incense, or similar airborne material in the Current. If the material is magical or generated by a cultivation effect, make an Air Check against the effect’s save DC. On a success, suppress that material in the Current until the start of your next turn.
Clear does not neutralize poison already inhaled or remove conditions already suffered.
TAL_AIR_CLOUD_SLEEVE_GUARD:
#### Cloud-Sleeve Guard - Guard
Prerequisite: CL 5+
While you have an active Air Current, you may use your Reaction when an attack roll is made against you.
Roll 1d6 and subtract the result from the attack roll.
If this causes the attack to miss, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
At CL 11, the die becomes 1d8.
TAL_AIR_COURT_OF_THE_FOUR_WINDS:
#### Court of the Four Winds - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 12+, Breath Beyond the Skin
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Area: 60-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a court of moving air around yourself. Choose four winds when the court appears: North, South, East, and West. Each wind is assigned one Vector: Lift, Press, Cut, Carry, Turn, or Scatter. You cannot assign the same Vector to more than two winds.
For the duration:
You may maintain up to four Air Currents without counting them against your Air Control Limit.
Once on each of your turns, you may use Gather Current without an action.
When a creature starts its turn inside the court, you may move one active Current up to 20 feet.
Your Wind Lash may originate from any active Current inside the court.
Allied creatures inside one of your Currents gain +10 feet to Speed while moving in the direction you choose.
Hostile creatures moving against one of your Currents treat the space as Difficult Terrain.
Once per round when an ordinary ranged weapon attack passes through one of your Currents, you may impose Disadvantage on that attack without using your Reaction.
The court ends early if you are Incapacitated or if you enter an airless sealed region that prevents currents from existing.
TAL_AIR_CUTTING_WIND:
#### Cutting Wind - Cutting
When Wind Lash deals slashing damage, the target takes additional slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 11, if the target is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the start of your next turn.
TAL_AIR_CYCLONE_PRISON:
#### Cyclone Prison - Current, Storm
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You create a rotating prison of violent air.
When the Cyclone appears, creatures in the area make a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature is pulled 10 feet toward the center, lifted 10 feet, and Restrained by wind until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: A creature is pulled 5 feet and is not Restrained.
A creature Restrained by the Cyclone may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Restrained effect on itself on a success. The Cyclone’s area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. Ordinary ranged weapon attacks into, out of, or through the Cyclone have Disadvantage.
TAL_AIR_DOWNBURST_SEAL:
#### Downburst Seal - Current, Storm
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder
Cost: 1 CP
You slam air downward.
Creatures in the area make a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature takes Wind Lash damage, is pushed to the ground, and falls Prone if it is on a surface. If it is flying and does not hover, it descends up to 30 feet before falling Prone if it lands.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and does not fall Prone.
TAL_AIR_DRAWING_BREATH:
#### Drawing Breath - Vector
When Wind Lash hits, you may replace its basic Vector with Drawing Breath.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Pull the target 10 feet directly toward you.
Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet.
This movement cannot pull a creature into a space that cannot support it unless the creature can fly or hover.
TAL_AIR_EMPTY_LUNG_EDICT:
#### Empty-Lung Edict - Breath
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Breathless Chamber
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One breath-dependent creature
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest per target
You command the target’s breath to stop obeying it.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the target is Silenced, cannot take Reactions, cannot cast or activate techniques requiring speech, mantra, roar, song, or breath control, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.
This is not permanent suffocation. Creatures without breath are immune unless the GM permits an equivalent animating current to be targeted.
TAL_AIR_FEATHER_FALL_BREATH:
#### Feather-Fall Breath - Sky-Step
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or a creature within 30 feet falls 10 feet or more
Cost: None
You create a cushioning current. Reduce the fall distance used to calculate fall damage by 30 feet for the target.
At CL 5, reduce it by 60 feet. At CL 11, the target may also land on its feet if it is not Incapacitated. At CL 17, you may affect a number of falling creatures within range equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_AIR_FLOWING_STEP:
#### Flowing Step - Sky-Step
When you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you may ignore 5 feet of Difficult Terrain caused by nonmagical rubble, mud, shallow water, loose sand, snow, or crowding.
If you pass through a space affected by your Gather Current, you may also move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature of your choice.
TAL_AIR_GALE_COMMAND_BANNER:
#### Gale-Command Banner - Current, Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You may anchor an Air Current to a banner, flag, sleeve, war fan, spear tassel, kite, sail, or formation pennant that you carry or plant.
While anchored, the Current moves with the object. If the object is planted, the Current remains centered on it. If the object is broken, stolen, sealed, or placed in an airtight container, the Current ends.
Allied creatures who can see the banner gain Advantage on saving throws against being pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone by wind while within 30 feet of the Current.
TAL_AIR_GALE_PUSH:
#### Gale Push - Vector
When Wind Lash hits, you may replace its basic Vector with Gale Push.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push the target 10 feet directly away from you.
Successful Save: Push the target 5 feet.
If the target collides with a solid obstacle during this movement, it falls Prone instead of moving the final 5 feet.
TAL_AIR_HEAVEN_SPLITTING_GALE:
#### Heaven-Splitting Gale - Cutting, Storm
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Area: 300-foot line, 10 feet wide
Cost: 3 CP
Release a line of sky-cutting wind.
Creatures in the line make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature takes 8d8 slashing damage, is pushed 30 feet in a direction perpendicular to the line, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and is pushed 10 feet.
Objects, ordinary projectiles, banners, ropes, wooden doors, sails, and exposed siege mechanisms in the line may be severed or damaged at the GM’s discretion.
TAL_AIR_INVISIBLE_BLADE_CURRENT:
#### Invisible Blade Current - Cutting
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Cutting Wind
When you use Wind Lash from an active Air Current, you may choose to make the attack invisible until it strikes.
The target makes a Wisdom (Perception) check against your Cultivation Save DC before the attack roll.
Failure: The attack has Advantage.
Success: The attack is resolved normally.
A creature with blindsight, tremorsense that can read air pressure, Wind-Sense, or a comparable feature may have Advantage on this check.
TAL_AIR_PRESSURE_BREAK:
#### Pressure Break - Vector
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When Wind Lash hits, you may replace its basic Vector with Pressure Break.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push the target 20 feet away from the point of origin of the attack. If it collides with a solid obstacle or another creature, it falls Prone.
Successful Save: Push the target 10 feet.
This is the Air expression of destructive pressure imbalance.
TAL_AIR_SKY_CLEAVING_PRESSURE:
#### Sky-Cleaving Pressure - Vector
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Pressure Break
When you use Pressure Break, you may apply the forced movement vertically where the environment permits.
A flying creature that fails its saving throw may be driven toward the ground, hurled upward, or thrown away from protected airspace. If it impacts a surface, it falls Prone and takes additional bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d6.
A creature cannot be moved into a space too small for it or through a solid object.
TAL_AIR_SKY_ROAD:
#### Sky Road - Sky-Step, Current
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
Create a road of stable wind up to 120 feet long and 10 feet wide. The road may be horizontal, sloped, or gently curved, but it cannot pass through solid objects.
Creatures you designate may stand, walk, run, or fall Prone on the road as though it were solid ground. Other creatures treat the road as Difficult Terrain and must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw the first time they enter it on a turn or fall through.
If the effect ends while a creature is unsupported in the air, it falls.
TAL_AIR_SKY_SOVEREIGN_INCARNATION:
#### Sky-Sovereign Incarnation - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of the Four Winds
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You become a sovereign center of atmosphere.
For the duration:
You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can Hover.
You may maintain up to six Air Currents without counting them against your Air Control Limit.
Your Wind Lash range becomes 300 feet.
Once on each of your turns, you may use Wind Lash or Gather Current without an action.
You may use Arrow-Turning Breath without spending your Reaction once per round.
Hostile flying creatures that start their turn within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have their Fly Speed reduced by half until the start of their next turn.
Breath-dependent hostile creatures within 30 feet have Disadvantage on checks requiring speech, breath control, or verbal command.
You can speak and be heard clearly by chosen creatures within 1 mile if there is an open air path.
This incarnation does not function in a true vacuum unless you supply Created Air or another appropriate source.
TAL_AIR_SKY_STEP:
#### Sky-Step - Sky-Step
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Gather Current, you may choose Step as its Vector.
A willing creature that starts in or enters the Current may move up to 10 feet vertically or horizontally through the air without falling during that movement. The creature must land in a space that can support it unless it has a Fly Speed or another talent keeps it aloft.
At CL 11, this movement increases to 20 feet.
TAL_AIR_SLEEVE_FAN_METHOD:
#### Sleeve-Fan Method - Current
You may use a fan, sleeve, cloak, ribbon, spear tassel, banner, robe hem, scarf, feather, or similar object as an Air Source.
When you do, increase the range of Gather Current by 10 feet and the range of Wind Lash by 10 feet.
If the object is taken, bound, destroyed, or soaked in heavy material, you lose this benefit until you replace or free it.
TAL_AIR_STORM_EYE_STILLNESS:
#### Storm-Eye Stillness - Guard, Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You can make the center of your storm calm.
While you maintain a Storming Current or Court of the Four Winds, choose a 10-foot-radius space inside the effect at the start of each of your turns. Allied creatures in that space ignore the Difficult Terrain and projectile Disadvantage created by your Air talents. Hostile creatures do not gain this benefit.
Once per round, when a creature in the calm space would take bludgeoning, slashing, or thunder damage from wind, falling debris, or pressure, reduce the damage by your Cultivation Level.
TAL_AIR_STORM_WITHOUT_DIRECTION:
#### Storm Without Direction - Storm
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 120-foot Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You create a storm of contradictory currents around yourself.
Hostile creatures in the area cannot benefit from Advantage on ranged attack rolls unless the Advantage comes from a Secret Inheritance, artifact, or higher authority. Flying hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. Ordinary fog, smoke, dust, ash, leaves, cloth, and unsecured Tiny objects whirl through the area.
At the start of each of your turns, choose one additional effect until the start of your next turn:
No Straight Line: Ranged attacks passing through the area have Disadvantage.
No Steady Foot: Hostile creatures that move more than half their Speed must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone at the end of that movement.
No Safe Breath: Breath-dependent hostile creatures have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration.
No Fixed Direction: When a hostile creature is pushed or pulled in the area, increase that movement by 10 feet.
TAL_AIR_TEN_THOUSAND_ARROW_REVERSAL:
#### Ten-Thousand Arrow Reversal - Guard
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Turn the Hundred Arrows
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A volley, barrage, ordinary ranged weapon attack, or non-Secret physical projectile technique targets creatures in a 60-foot-radius area you can see
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Make an Air Check against the highest attack roll among the triggering attacks or against the attacker’s Cultivation Save DC if the volley uses saving throws.
Success: Negate the volley against creatures you choose in the area. You may redirect a number of projectiles equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus as harmless impacts or as attacks against new targets within the volley’s original range. Use your Cultivation Attack Modifier for redirected attacks.
Failure: Chosen creatures in the area gain Resistance to the volley’s damage.
Secret Inheritances, artifacts, siege-scale weapons, and domain-scale calamities may require an opposed Cultivation Check or may be immune.
TAL_AIR_TURN_THE_HUNDRED_ARROWS:
#### Turn the Hundred Arrows - Guard
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Arrow-Turning Breath
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: Two or more ordinary ranged weapon attacks are made against creatures inside one of your Air Currents
Cost: 1 CP
Choose a number of triggering attacks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each chosen attack has Disadvantage.
If an attack misses, you may move its projectile up to 30 feet before it falls harmlessly or sticks into a surface. You cannot redirect the projectile into a new damaging attack unless another talent permits it.
TAL_AIR_UPDRAFT_GATE:
#### Updraft Gate - Current, Sky-Step
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create a vertical cylinder of rising wind with a 10-foot radius and 30-foot height.
A willing creature that enters the Updraft or starts its turn there may rise up to 20 feet without spending movement. An unwilling creature that enters the Updraft for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It rises 10 feet and is suspended until the start of its next turn or until it leaves the Updraft.
Successful Save: It is not lifted, but the Updraft’s space is Difficult Terrain for it.
A suspended creature falls when the effect ends unless it can fly, hover, cling, or land on a surface.
TAL_AIR_VACUUM_NEEDLE:
#### Vacuum Needle - Cutting, Breath
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When Wind Lash deals slashing damage, you may compress the line into a pressure needle.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes additional slashing damage equal to 1d8 and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It takes no additional damage.
At CL 11, the additional damage becomes 2d8.
This does not affect creatures without bodies or pressure channels unless the GM agrees an equivalent animating current is exposed.
TAL_AIR_WHEN_HEAVEN_EXHALES:
#### When Heaven Exhales
Secret Air Inheritance
Prerequisites: Sky-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, access to a true sky scripture, storm-gate inheritance, or heavenly breath revelation
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 1-mile-radius sky and ground region centered on you
Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You make the sky exhale once.
Choose up to three of the following decrees. Each hostile creature, projectile, flying object, or active windlike technique in the area is affected as appropriate.
The Breath Returns: Breath-dependent hostile creatures make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they cannot speak, shout, chant, command, or use breath-required techniques until the end of your next turn. On a success, they cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
The Arrows Lose Their Road: Ordinary ranged weapon attacks, thrown weapons, volleys, and non-Secret physical projectile techniques in the area fail against targets you choose until the start of your next turn.
The Sky Rejects Weight: Allied creatures you choose gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and Hover until the end of your next turn.
The Ground Receives the Proud: Hostile flying creatures make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they descend up to 300 feet, land if possible, and fall Prone. On a success, their Fly Speed is halved until the end of their next turn.
The World Turns Sideways: Choose a direction. Hostile creatures and unattended objects not anchored to the ground are pushed 60 feet in that direction. A creature may make a Strength saving throw to halve the distance.
The Gate Opens: Create a Sky Road up to 1 mile long that lasts until the end of your next turn without Concentration.
After resolving the decrees, you may immediately move up to your Speed or Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Limits: When Heaven Exhales does not create regional weather permanently, erase mountains, move sealed buildings, kill breathless creatures automatically, or bypass stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check. Creatures inside airtight sealed structures are affected only if the chosen decree can reach them through an air path or through a superior inheritance-level contest.
TAL_AIR_WHISPER_CARRYING_WIND:
#### Whisper-Carrying Wind - Current
When you use Gather Current, you may choose Whisper as its Vector.
You may carry a message of no more than twenty-five words to a creature within the Current’s range that you can see or whose exact location you know. The message is audible only to the intended creature unless another creature has a feature capable of intercepting subtle sound or Air techniques.
At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 120 feet. At Core Formation, it can pass through small cracks, vents, arrow slits, and similar air gaps, but not through airtight seals or Total Cover without an air path.
TAL_AIR_WIND_BORNE_BODY:
#### Wind-Borne Body - Sky-Step
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You gain a Fly Speed of 20 feet until the end of your turn whenever you begin your turn inside one of your Air Currents or use Gather Current as a Bonus Action on that turn.
If you end your turn in the air without another feature keeping you aloft, you fall.
At CL 11, the Fly Speed increases to 30 feet.
TAL_AIR_WIND_GATE_GEOMETRY:
#### Wind Gate Geometry - Current
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you have two active Air Currents, you may designate them as paired Wind Gates.
Once per turn, a willing creature that enters one gate may exit from the other gate by spending 10 feet of movement. The creature must be able to fit through both Currents and both gates must be within 120 feet of each other with an open air path between them.
This is not teleportation. The creature is carried along a visible or traceable wind path. If that path is blocked by a sealed barrier, the gate fails.
TAL_AIR_WIND_RIDING_WEAPON:
#### Wind-Riding Weapon - Cutting
When you make a ranged weapon attack with a thrown weapon or ammunition while a target is inside one of your Air Currents, you may cause the attack to count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance and Immunity to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.
At CL 5, you may also ignore Disadvantage from long range once per turn if the attack travels through one of your Currents.
TAL_AIR_WIND_SCRIPT_DELIVERY:
#### Wind-Script Delivery - Current
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may use an Air Current to carry a Tiny talisman, folded paper, ribbon-script, incense spark, feather mark, or similar prepared object.
When you use Gather Current, you may move one such object up to 30 feet along an open air path. If the object is a talisman or consumable, this movement does not activate it unless its own rules permit activation.
At Core Formation, this movement can pass around one corner if air can pass around that corner.
TAL_AIR_WIND_WALL:
#### Wind Wall - Guard, Current
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create a wall of Driving Current up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick.
The wall grants Three-Quarters Cover against ordinary ranged weapon attacks that pass through it. Ordinary Tiny projectiles that pass through the wall have Disadvantage on attack rolls. Loose gas, smoke, dust, and Tiny unattended objects are pushed to one side of the wall when it appears.
A creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
At Core Formation, the wall may bend once at a right angle.
TAL_AIR_WORLD_WIND_ROAD:
#### World-Wind Road - Sky-Step, Domain
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Sky Road
When you create Sky Road, you may extend it up to 1 mile, provided you can see the destination or have a formation, talisman, ally signal, or known landmark to anchor the end.
The road lasts for 1 hour with Concentration. It can carry a number of creatures equal to ten times your Proficiency Bonus at a time.
Strong hostile weather, enemy Air techniques, anti-flight formations, sealed barriers, or Void concealment can break or divert the road.
TAL_ALCHEMY_ANTIDOTE_PILL:
### Antidote Pill - Recipe, Medicine
You learn the Antidote Pill recipe.
Rarity: Common.
Consumption: Bonus Action.
Effect: The consumer has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes against poison before it finishes a Short Rest. If the consumer currently has the Poisoned condition from an effect that allows repeated saves, it immediately repeats one save against that effect.
TAL_ALCHEMY_BACKDRAFT_FUMES:
### Backdraft Fumes - Furnace, Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
When a creature within 10 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you may use your Reaction, spend 1 CP, and spend one Reagent Stock to burst a packet of volatile fumes between you.
The attacker makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The attacker takes Poison or Fire damage equal to 2d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier, chosen when you use this talent, and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no Disadvantage.
The damage increases to 3d6 at CL 11 and 4d6 at CL 17.
TAL_ALCHEMY_BATCH_REFINEMENT:
### Batch Refinement - Refinement
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
When refining a recipe, you may refine multiple pills or doses of the same recipe simultaneously.
Maximum products in one batch: your Proficiency Bonus.
You must provide ingredients for each product. Increase the refinement time by 50 percent. Spend +1 CP for each product beyond the first.
Roll one Alchemy Check for the batch. If the batch fails, all products share the failed result.
TAL_ALCHEMY_BINDING_DREGS:
### Binding Dregs - Furnace, Dregs
You learn the Binding Dregs Field Formula.
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Field Formula
Range: 30 feet.
Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock.
Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the target is standing on a solid surface, it also cannot take the Dash action until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_ALCHEMY_BITTER_DREGS:
### Bitter Dregs - Dregs, Volatile
When you create a Broken product, you may preserve its failed residue as Bitter Dregs instead of discarding it.
You may maintain a number of Bitter Dregs up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each Bitter Dregs spoils when you finish a Long Rest.
When you use Field Formula, you may spend one Bitter Dregs instead of one Reagent Stock. If the technique deals damage, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll, but if the attack misses or all targets succeed on their saves, you take Poison damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_ALCHEMY_CALMING_HEART_PILL:
### Calming Heart Pill - Recipe, Medicine
You learn the Calming Heart Pill recipe.
Rarity: Common.
Consumption: Bonus Action.
Effect: For 1 hour, the consumer gains +1 to saving throws against the Charmed condition, the Frightened condition, Heart Demon effects, and effects that would disturb cultivation meditation.
TAL_ALCHEMY_CAULDRON_GUARD:
### Cauldron Guard - Cauldron
When a creature you can see hits you with an attack while you are adjacent to your cauldron or using Body as Cauldron, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to gain a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
TAL_ALCHEMY_CHOKING_SMOKE_PELLET:
### Choking Smoke Pellet - Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the Choking Smoke Pellet Field Formula.
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Field Formula
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 10-foot-radius Sphere.
Cost: 2 CP and one Reagent Stock.
A pellet bursts into acrid smoke, ash, and bitter medicinal vapor. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 2d6 Poison damage, cannot speak above a hoarse whisper, and cannot supply Verbal components until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no speech restriction.
At CL 11, the damage becomes 3d6. At CL 17, it becomes 4d6.
Creatures that do not breathe have Advantage on this save unless the GM decides the formula attacks their spiritual circulation instead.
TAL_ALCHEMY_CLEAN_FURNACE_METHOD:
### Clean Furnace Method - Refinement
When you finish a Short Rest, you may clean and stabilize one cauldron you used since your last Long Rest.
The next Alchemy Check made with that cauldron before your next Short or Long Rest ignores one Broken Product flaw or reduces backlash damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_ALCHEMY_CORROSIVE_DISTILLATE:
### Corrosive Distillate - Furnace, Volatile
When you use Corrosive Dregs or another Field Formula that deals Acid damage, choose one nonmagical object worn or carried by one affected creature that you can see. Until the start of your next turn, the object takes a -1 penalty to AC if it grants AC, or the target takes a -1 penalty to the next attack roll made with that object.
This talent cannot destroy an object by itself and cannot affect artifacts unless the GM permits it.
TAL_ALCHEMY_ENHANCED_PILL_EFFECT:
### Enhanced Pill Effect - Refinement
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
When refining a pill, spend additional CP to add one enhancement.
+2 CP: Increase rolled healing or CP recovery by 50 percent.
+3 CP: Double duration, maximum 24 hours.
+4 CP: Increase the affected recipe's Save DC by 2.
+4 CP: Reduce Saturation by 1, minimum 0.
+6 CP: Apply two compatible enhancements.
The GM may forbid incompatible enhancements.
TAL_ALCHEMY_EXPLOSIVE_PILL:
### Explosive Pill - Recipe, Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the Explosive Pill recipe.
Rarity: Uncommon.
Ingredient
Cost: 150 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 3 CP.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 10-foot-radius Sphere.
Throw or launch one prepared Explosive Pill. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison when you refine the pill.
Failed Save: The creature takes damage based on your CL.
Successful Save: Half damage.
CL 5-10: 4d6.
CL 11-16: 6d6.
CL 17-20: 8d6.
TAL_ALCHEMY_FALSE_MEDICINE_PILL:
### False Medicine Pill - Recipe
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the False Medicine Pill recipe.
Rarity: Uncommon.
A False Medicine Pill resembles one beneficial recipe you know. Identifying the deception requires a Study action using Intelligence (Investigation), Intelligence (Arcana), or an appropriate alchemical check against your Cultivation Save DC.
When consumed, the pill has no beneficial effect and the consumer must make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The consumer is Poisoned until it finishes a Short Rest.
Successful Save: The consumer is Poisoned until the end of its next turn.
False Medicine Pill is a treacherous technique. Open sects may forbid it.
TAL_ALCHEMY_FASTING_PILL:
### Fasting Pill - Recipe
You learn the Fasting Pill recipe.
Rarity: Common.
Consumption: Action.
Effect: The consumer needs no food or water for 7 days. This does not remove existing Exhaustion from starvation or thirst.
TAL_ALCHEMY_FURNACE_MASTERY:
### Furnace Mastery - Refinement
Gain +2 to Alchemy Checks made with a proper cauldron.
This bonus does not stack with a cauldron quality bonus. Use the higher bonus.
You may use an improvised cauldron for Common and Uncommon recipes without the usual -4 penalty.
TAL_ALCHEMY_FURNACE_VENT:
### Furnace Vent - Furnace, Volatile
You learn the Furnace Vent Field Formula.
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Field Formula
Area: 15-foot cone.
Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock.
You crack a sealed heat-packet, smoke tube, or small furnace vent, releasing scalding medicinal vapor and bitter fumes. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Poison or Fire damage equal to 1d8 + your Alchemy key ability modifier, chosen when you use this formula, and has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no Disadvantage.
The damage increases to 2d8 at CL 5, 3d8 at CL 11, and 4d8 at CL 17.
TAL_ALCHEMY_HEALING_PILL:
### Healing Pill - Recipe, Medicine
You learn the Healing Pill recipe.
Rarity: Common.
Consumption: Bonus Action.
Effect: Restore 2d4 + 2 HP.
A creature can benefit from this exact recipe a number of times per Long Rest equal to its Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_ALCHEMY_INGREDIENT_SUBSTITUTION:
### Ingredient Substitution - Refinement
You may replace one required ingredient with another compatible ingredient of equal value.
Each substitution increases the Alchemy Check DC by 2.
Ingredient Substitution does not create rare ingredients from common ones. The replacement must still make narrative and alchemical sense.
TAL_ALCHEMY_MERIDIAN_SEALING_PILL:
### Meridian-Sealing Pill - Recipe, Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the Meridian-Sealing Pill recipe.
Rarity: Uncommon.
Ingredient
Cost: 150 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 3 CP.
You may administer the pill to a willing or helpless creature as an Action, or release it as a Field Formula pellet.
When released as a Field Formula, choose one creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target cannot recover CP until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: The target cannot recover CP until the start of its next turn.
This does not remove CP the target already has.
TAL_ALCHEMY_NUMBING_POWDER:
### Numbing Powder - Furnace, Volatile
You learn the Numbing Powder Field Formula.
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Field Formula
Range: 30 feet.
Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock.
Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 1d6 Poison damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no Reaction loss.
The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
TAL_ALCHEMY_PILL_APPRAISAL:
### Pill Appraisal - Refinement
You have Advantage on Study checks to identify pills, elixirs, alchemical powders, medicinal ashes, cauldrons, and recipe fragments.
With 10 minutes of study, you can identify a Common or Uncommon pill automatically unless it has been deliberately disguised by a higher-Realm technique.
This talent identifies ingredients but does not locate, grow, or harvest them.
TAL_ALCHEMY_PILL_OF_RESTORATION:
### Pill of Restoration - Recipe, Medicine
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the Pill of Restoration recipe.
Rarity: Uncommon.
Ingredient
Cost: 150 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 3 CP.
Consumption: Action.
Choose one effect:
remove one disease;
end the Poisoned condition if caused by a poison or alchemical effect;
reduce Exhaustion by one level if the Exhaustion was caused by poison, disease, suffocation, starvation, thirst, or alchemical backlash;
end one minor alchemical side effect;
grant Advantage on the next saving throw against a curse or Heart Demon effect before the consumer finishes a Long Rest.
TAL_ALCHEMY_POISON_PILL:
### Poison Pill - Recipe, Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn one poison pill formula: Venom Pill, Nerve Pill, or Rotting Pill. You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different formula each time.
Rarity: Uncommon.
Ingredient
Cost: 150 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 3 CP.
When released as a Field Formula, choose one creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Venom Pill
Failed Save: 6d6 Poison damage and Poisoned for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the Poisoned condition on a success.
Venom Pill
Successful Save: Half damage and Poisoned until the start of your next turn.
Nerve Pill
Failed Save: 3d6 Poison damage, and the target cannot take Reactions or Bonus Actions until the start of your next turn.
Nerve Pill
Successful Save: Half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Rotting Pill
Failed Save: 3d6 Necrotic or Poison damage, and the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Rotting Pill
Successful Save: Half damage.
TAL_ALCHEMY_QI_INFUSION_PILL:
### Qi Infusion Pill - Recipe
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the Qi Infusion Pill recipe.
Rarity: Uncommon.
Ingredient
Cost: 150 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 3 CP.
Consumption: Bonus Action.
Effect: Recover 2d6 + Proficiency Bonus CP.
A creature can benefit from this recipe once per Short Rest.
TAL_ALCHEMY_RAPID_REFINEMENT:
### Rapid Refinement - Refinement
When refining a Common or Uncommon recipe, you may spend +2 CP to reduce the refinement time to one quarter of normal.
You may use Rapid Refinement a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_ALCHEMY_SEALED_DOSE_METHOD:
### Sealed Dose Method - Refinement
Your Reagent Stock maximum increases by your Proficiency Bonus.
In addition, one ally may carry one sealed dose you prepared. The ally can administer that dose as an Action if the dose is a Medicinal Smoke, Healing Pill, Antidote Pill, or another recipe the GM agrees is safe for field use.
TAL_ALCHEMY_STAMINA_BOILING_PILL:
### Stamina Boiling Pill - Recipe
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You learn the Stamina Boiling Pill recipe.
Rarity: Uncommon.
Ingredient
Cost: 150 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina if created through Body as Cauldron.
Consumption: Bonus Action.
Effect: Recover 2d6 + Proficiency Bonus Stamina.
A creature can benefit from this recipe once per Short Rest.
TAL_ATHLETICS_AFTERIMAGE:
#### Afterimage - Motion
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you move more than 20 feet during your turn, leave one visible afterimage until the start of your next turn.
When a creature that can see the afterimage attacks you or targets you with a visible targeted supernatural effect, roll a d2.
1: The creature targets the afterimage instead.
2: The creature targets you normally.
The afterimage is destroyed when targeted successfully.
Afterimage has no effect if the attacker cannot perceive it.
TAL_ATHLETICS_AIR_STUNT:
#### Air Stunt - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Wall Stunt, CL 5+
Treat the air as a wall for Wall Stunt.
If you end your turn unsupported in the air, you still fall unless another talent prevents it.
TAL_ATHLETICS_CAPOEIRA_SPIN:
#### Capoeira Spin - Technique
You do not have Disadvantage on unarmed strikes merely because you are Prone.
When you start your turn Prone, stand as a Bonus Action and make one unarmed strike as part of that Bonus Action.
TAL_ATHLETICS_CLOSE_QUARTERS_TRAINING:
#### Close Quarters Training - Technique
You may enter, move through, and fight inside a hostile creature’s space.
To enter its space, make:
Dexterity (Acrobatics)
contested by the creature’s:
Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics)
The creature chooses which skill to use.
Failed Check: Your movement ends in the previous space and the creature may make an opportunity attack against you.
Attacks you make while sharing a hostile creature’s space have Disadvantage unless made with:
Light weapons;
natural weapons;
unarmed strikes.
##### Cover If you and the hostile creature are the same size, each grants the other Half Cover against creatures outside the shared space.
If one creature is larger, the smaller creature gains Three-Quarters Cover and the larger creature gains no cover.
If this cover causes an outside attack to miss, resolve the attack against the other creature using the original attack roll.
TAL_ATHLETICS_DIZZYING_TUMBLE:
#### Dizzying Tumble - Motion
When you exit a space adjacent to a hostile creature, spend 10 feet of movement to force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: It becomes immune to your Dizzying Tumble until you complete a short or long rest.
TAL_ATHLETICS_HELICOPTER_DESCENT:
#### Helicopter Descent - Technique
Prerequisite: Polearm Vaulter or Rope Swing Adept, CL 5+
When you end your turn in the air while wielding an appropriate polearm, rope, chain, whip, or tether item, use your Reaction and expend Martial Focus.
For rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus:
fall no faster than 60 feet per round;
take no falling damage if you land before the effect ends;
land on your feet.
TAL_ATHLETICS_MIGHTY_CONDITIONING:
#### Mighty Conditioning - Technique
Whenever you make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, use Strength or Dexterity for the check, choosing each time.
You may use Dexterity instead of Strength when determining jump distance or height.
TAL_ATHLETICS_MOBILITY:
#### Mobility - Motion
Opportunity attacks made against you for leaving a creature’s reach have Disadvantage.
TAL_ATHLETICS_MOVING_TARGET:
#### Moving Target - Motion
When you move more than 20 feet during your turn, gain Half Cover against ranged attacks and ranged supernatural effects until the start of your next turn.
If you move at least 40 feet, expend Martial Focus to gain Three-Quarters Cover instead.
##### Second Purchase
Take Moving Target a second time.
Its cover applies against melee attacks as well.
TAL_ATHLETICS_MULTIPLE_MOTIONS:
#### Multiple Motions - Focus
When moving, expend Martial Focus to apply two Motion talents to the same movement sequence.
TAL_ATHLETICS_POLEARM_VAULTER:
#### Polearm Vaulter - Technique
You no longer need to spend an Action or pass a check to pole vault.
When pole vaulting, expend Martial Focus as a Bonus Action to increase:
horizontal jump distance by 10 feet; or
jump height by 5 feet. This increase does not depend on Strength, Dexterity, or remaining movement.
TAL_ATHLETICS_POWERFUL_WINGS:
#### Powerful Wings - Technique
If you possess a Fly Speed through physical wings, you may Hover.
TAL_ATHLETICS_RAPID_MOTION: #### Rapid Motion - Technique Dash as a Bonus Action.
TAL_ATHLETICS_ROPE_SWING_ADEPT:
#### Rope Swing Adept - Technique
Attach an appropriate Rope Swing item as a Bonus Action.
Detach it without spending an Action.
While swinging:
end movement in the air as though you possessed a temporary Fly Speed;
swing upward to the anchor point as a quick climb.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SCALE_FOE:
#### Scale Foe - Technique
Climb onto a Bigger Creature as a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
A creature you cling to has Disadvantage on attacks made against you.
This does not apply to checks made to dislodge you.
##### Cross-Sphere Notes
If you possess an appropriate Beast Taming talent, use an approved handling skill in place of Strength (Athletics) where reasonable.
If you possess the Wrestling sphere, climbing a larger creature may count as Grappling it for appropriate Wrestling talents.
Close Quarters Training applies while clinging to a larger creature.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SHARK_SWIM:
#### Shark Swim - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Gain Swim Speed equal to your land Speed.
If you possess Strong Lungs, instead hold your breath for hours equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 hour.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SPARROW_S_PATH:
#### Sparrow’s Path - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Air Stunt, Wall Stunt, CL 7+
Gain Fly Speed equal to half your base land Speed.
This flight expresses continuous wuxia stepping, body control, and cultivated momentum.
It is not automatically silent.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SPEED_BOOST:
#### Speed Boost - Focus
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When taking Dash or Disengage as an Action, move an additional 10 feet.
You may also expend Martial Focus to increase all movement Speeds by 50 feet for rounds equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 round.
When the duration ends, gain one level of Exhaustion until completing a short or long rest.
This Exhaustion applies even if you are normally immune.
You cannot activate this boost while your Exhaustion exceeds 2.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SPIDER_S_TOUCH:
#### Spider’s Touch - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Gain Climb Speed equal to your land Speed.
If you possess Sure Grip:
climb vertical surfaces;
climb upside down across ceilings;
keep at least one hand free while climbing.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SUDDEN_FLANK:
#### Sudden Flank - Motion
When you successfully Tumble through a hostile creature’s space, gain Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your turn.
TAL_ATHLETICS_SWIFT_MOVEMENT: #### Swift Movement - Focus While holding Martial Focus, increase all movement Speeds by 10 feet.
TAL_ATHLETICS_TUMBLING_RECOVERY:
#### Tumbling Recovery - Technique
Drop Prone at any time, including outside your turn.
Whenever you fall Prone or deliberately drop Prone, use a Bonus Action or Reaction to move up to 10 feet in one direction.
When used to avoid an attack or area effect:
impose Disadvantage on the attack roll;
gain Advantage on one Dexterity saving throw against the area effect.
TAL_ATHLETICS_UNBROKEN_PURSUIT:
#### Unbroken Pursuit - Motion
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a creature within your Speed moves willingly, use your Reaction and expend Martial Focus.
Move up to half your Speed.
This movement:
must end closer to the triggering creature;
does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature;
may include Wall Stunt, Air Stunt, or Rope Swing movement when legal.
TAL_ATHLETICS_UNIMPEDED_POSITIONING: #### Unimpeded Positioning - Focus While holding Martial Focus, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain.
TAL_ATHLETICS_UNWILLING_BOOST:
#### Unwilling Boost - Technique
Convert another creature’s attack into momentum.
When your movement provokes an opportunity attack from a creature at least your size, increase movement for the round by:
5 feet x the creature’s Strength modifier
minimum 5 feet.
Choose horizontal movement or half as much vertical movement.
To gain this movement:
the attack must hit; or
if it misses, use your Bonus Action to convert the attack into momentum. An ally may use its Reaction to assist as though making an opportunity attack against you.
You must still use your Bonus Action to exploit a missed assisted attack.
TAL_ATHLETICS_WALL_STUNT:
#### Wall Stunt - Technique
Run up or along walls as though they were ground.
Treat the wall as difficult terrain.
You may treat a creature at least two sizes larger than you as a wall, with GM approval.
Doing so provokes an opportunity attack from that creature.
If you end your turn on a wall without something to hold onto, you fall.
TAL_ATHLETICS_WHIRLWIND_FLIP:
#### Whirlwind Flip - Focus
Whenever you succeed on a Tumble check against a hostile creature, regain Martial Focus.
TAL_AXES_ARMOR_JOINT_HOOK:
### Armor Joint Hook - Hook, Split
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When Hewing Strike hits a creature wearing armor, natural armor, heavy robes, a shell, scales, or a comparable protective layer, you may choose Armor Joint Hook instead of a normal Hewing rider.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the next attack roll made against the target by you or an ally gains a +2 bonus.
Successful Save: Until the end of your current turn, your next attack roll against the target gains a +2 bonus.
This talent does not reduce AC permanently and does not destroy armor.
TAL_AXES_AXE_AND_SHIELD_PRESS:
### Axe-and-Shield Press - Hew, Split
When you use Hewing Strike while wielding a one-handed axe and a shield, you may choose Press instead of a normal Hewing rider.
On hit, the target gains Bite and cannot move through your space or the spaces of allies adjacent to you until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw.
If the target fails the save by 5 or more, it is also pushed 5 feet.
This talent does not grant Shield-sphere reactions or Shield Faces.
TAL_AXES_AXE_BITES_THE_FORMATION:
### Axe Bites the Formation - Split, Bite
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Hewing Intent
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach, or 30 feet if you project axe qi through Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening
Target: One visible formation node, barrier panel, talisman circuit, summoned shell, qi construct, ward hinge, or comparable temporary structure
Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina
Make an Axes Check against the target effect's save DC, formation DC, creator's Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: The target structure gains Bite from you for 1 minute. While it bears this Bite, its creator has Disadvantage on the next check or saving throw made to maintain, repair, expand, or redirect that structure.
Success by 5 or more: The structure is also suppressed in a 5-foot section, one node, or one target-facing panel until the start of your next turn.
Failure: The structure resists. You learn whether it was too strong, improperly targeted, protected by a hidden anchor, or not truly structural.
This talent does not destroy major formations, Domains, or Secret Inheritances by itself.
TAL_AXES_BARK_SPLITTING_CAST:
### Bark-Splitting Cast - Cast, Woodcutter
When you use Cast Axe against an unattended object, wooden barrier, rope, vine, net, banner pole, wagon wheel, door latch, or similar target, you may treat the attack as if the target were within normal range, even if it is within the weapon's long range.
On hit, add one roll of your weapon damage die to the damage against that object.
At Foundation Realm, if the target is holding a creature restrained by vines, rope, netting, or wooden stocks, you may avoid damaging the creature if the attack hits.
TAL_AXES_BEARDED_HOOK_METHOD:
### Bearded Hook Method - Hook, Bite
When Hewing Strike hits and you choose Bite, you may immediately move the target 5 feet to another space within your reach if the target is no more than one size larger than you.
If the target cannot move into the chosen space, it remains in place but has Disadvantage on the next opportunity attack it makes before the start of your next turn.
TAL_AXES_BITING_WHEEL_KATA:
### Biting Wheel Kata - Hew, Movement
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Splitting Step
Once on each of your turns, when you hit with Hewing Strike or consume Bite, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature damaged by your axe this turn.
If this movement places a different creature within your reach, your next Hewing Strike against that creature before the end of your turn may choose two Hewing riders instead of one.
TAL_AXES_CAST_AXE:
### Cast Axe
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Parent Action: Attack
Replaces Attacks: 1
Range: Weapon thrown range, or 20/60 feet for a handaxe-like thrown axe
Target: One creature or object
Cost: None
Requirement: You must throw an axe weapon with the thrown property or a GM-approved throwing axe.
Make a thrown weapon attack with the axe. On a hit, the attack deals normal weapon damage. Then choose one Cast rider.
**Shock Cast.** The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
**Lodging Cast.** The axe lodges and the target gains Bite from you until the start of your next turn. A creature can remove the lodged axe as an Object Interaction if it has a free hand and is not Incapacitated.
**Turning Cast.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, it must choose either to be pushed 5 feet or to have its Speed reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
**Splinter Cast.** If the target is an unattended object, wooden barrier, fragile cover, shield, banner pole, rope, vine, or similar object, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.
If you throw your only axe, you are no longer wielding it until you retrieve it, draw another weapon, or a talent returns it.
TAL_AXES_CLEAVING_ARC:
### Cleaving Arc - Hew
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit with Hewing Strike while wielding an axe in two hands or wielding a Great Axe or Poleaxe profile weapon, you may spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus to threaten a second creature within your reach and within 5 feet of the original target.
Make a second melee weapon attack against that creature. On hit, it takes the weapon's normal damage but cannot receive a Hewing rider from this talent.
If the first target had Bite from you and you consumed it with another Axes talent this turn, the second attack has Advantage.
TAL_AXES_CLOSE_HAFT_STRIKE:
### Close Haft Strike - Poleaxe, Hew
When a creature within your reach has Bite from you, you may make a haft, butt, shoulder, or back-spike strike as a Bonus Action.
Make a melee weapon attack with the same axe. On hit, the target takes bludgeoning damage equal to 1d4 + the ability modifier used for the attack. The target then chooses one:
- it loses Bite but is pushed 5 feet;
- it keeps Bite and cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
At CL 5, the damage becomes 1d6. At CL 11, it becomes 1d8.
TAL_AXES_DEEP_BITE:
### Deep Bite - Realm Evolution, Bite
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Bite can last longer when you commit to the cut.
When you place Bite on a creature or object with Hewing Strike or Cast Axe, you may spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus to make the Bite last for 1 minute.
A creature bearing Deep Bite may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the Bite on a success. Another creature adjacent to the target may use the Help action to grant Advantage on this check.
Deep Bite still counts against your Bite limit.
TAL_AXES_DRAGON_FELLING_CHOP:
### Dragon-Felling Chop - Hew, Hook
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit a creature larger than you with Hewing Strike, you may choose Dragon-Felling Chop instead of a normal Hewing rider.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn, and it cannot benefit from a climb speed, burrow speed, or special charge movement until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
If the target is mounted, climbing, or flying by wings rather than hovering, it has Disadvantage on the save.
This talent does not cause a flying creature to fall unless another rule or talent says so.
TAL_AXES_EXECUTION_MARK:
### Execution Mark - Execution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit a Bloodied creature with Hewing Strike or Cast Axe, you may place an Execution Mark instead of a normal rider.
The mark lasts until the start of your next turn and counts as Bite for your Axes talents.
The first time before the mark ends that the target regains HP, teleports, turns Invisible, or takes the Disengage action, you may use your Reaction to make one axe weapon attack against it if it is within your weapon's reach or within the legal range of a lodged or thrown axe line you control.
TAL_AXES_FALLING_MOUNTAIN_JUDGMENT:
### Falling Mountain Judgment
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Law of the Falling Tree
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot cone or 60-foot line from you
Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina
You hew downward and make the air, dust, fragments, shields, and fear fall with the blow.
Creatures of your choice in the area make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature takes 8d6 bludgeoning or slashing damage, falls Prone, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and does not fall Prone.
Objects, fragile cover, unattended shields, loose barricades, and nonmagical wooden or bone structures in the area may be damaged at the GM's discretion.
This is not a Weather, Earth, or Destruction domain. It is the shock of an axe blow spreading through things already able to fall, split, or break.
TAL_AXES_FOREST_OF_FALLING_STANDARDS:
### Forest of Falling Standards - Authority, Split
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Sever the Standard
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: Up to six visible standards, banners, command objects, formation pennants, signal drums, siege ropes, or comparable objects
Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina
You send hewing intent through the symbols that hold an army's posture.
Make one Axes Check. Compare the result to each target object's AC, object DC, or controlling creature's save DC.
Success against an object: The object is cut, knocked down, marked by Bite, or rendered unusable until the start of your next turn.
For each hostile command source whose object is affected, choose one command, morale, or formation benefit currently depending on that object. That benefit is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
Success by 5 or more against at least three objects: hostile creatures of your choice within 30 feet of one affected object cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This talent does not replace Warleader's command engine. It attacks the visible symbols and anchors that command is using.
TAL_AXES_FRANCISCA_OPENING:
### Francisca Opening - Cast
When you use Cast Axe against a creature that has not yet taken a turn in this combat or against a creature that moved at least 10 feet since the end of your last turn, you may choose two Cast riders instead of one.
If the attack misses, you may still force the target to choose one: it cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn, or its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_AXES_GATE_SPLITTING_BLOW:
### Gate-Splitting Blow - Split, Woodcutter
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you make an axe attack against an unattended object, door, barricade, wagon, bridge support, chain, vine mass, root wall, wooden statue, bone gate, brittle stone panel, or comparable structure, you may spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus before the attack roll.
On hit, add 2d8 slashing or bludgeoning damage to the damage roll. If the target has a Damage Threshold, reduce that threshold by your Proficiency Bonus for this attack only.
This talent cannot damage Domains and does not automatically disable Formations or Barriers unless the object is a real anchor or panel the GM has identified as vulnerable.
TAL_AXES_HAFT_GUARD:
### Haft Guard - Poleaxe, Guard
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see hits you with a melee attack while you are wielding an axe in two hands or wielding a Poleaxe-profile weapon
Cost: None
You catch the blow on haft, beard, or shoulder of the axe. Reduce the triggering attack's damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
If this reduces the damage to 0, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker, or you may place Bite on the attacker's weapon until the start of your next turn.
At CL 5, the reduction becomes 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 11, it becomes 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 17, it becomes 4d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_AXES_HEADSMAN_S_CALM:
### Headsman's Calm - Execution, Authority
When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP with an axe attack, break a significant object with an axe attack, or end a hostile summoned minion with an axe attack, you may regain Martial Focus if it is absent.
Once per short or long rest, when this happens, you may also choose one hostile creature that can see or hear the blow within 30 feet. That creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the end of its next turn.
TAL_AXES_HEADSMAN_S_MANDATE:
### Headsman's Mandate
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Execution Mark
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Parent Action: Attack
Replaces Attacks: 1
Target: One Bloodied creature within axe reach, or one creature bearing Execution Mark from you
Cost: 3 CP, 3 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus and 2 CP/Stamina
Make a melee weapon attack with an axe. On hit, the target takes normal weapon damage plus 6d8 slashing, force, or psychic damage, chosen when you use the talent according to Path expression.
The target then makes a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw, target's choice.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot regain HP, cannot benefit from Temporary HP, and cannot teleport or turn Invisible unless the effect is Secret, artifact-backed, or stronger than your Realm.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot regain HP.
If this attack reduces the target to 0 HP, hostile creatures of your choice within 30 feet that saw the blow must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
This talent is not an automatic execution and does not kill creatures at 0 HP unless the campaign's ordinary rules would do so.
TAL_AXES_HEADSMAN_S_RED_LINE:
### Headsman's Red Line - Execution, Authority
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Headsman's Calm
When you hit a Bloodied creature with an axe attack, you may spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot willingly move closer to one ally of your choice that it can see or hear.
Successful Save: The target can move normally, but it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against that ally before the start of your next turn.
This is fear of judgment, not mind control. Creatures immune to Frightened have Advantage on the saving throw.
TAL_AXES_HEWING_INTENT:
### Hewing Intent - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Your axe no longer needs to bite only flesh, wood, or shield. You can read the grain of posture, qi flow, barrier tension, battlefield formation, and false authority.
Gain the following benefits:
- Your Bite limit increases by 1.
- When you place Bite on a target, you may choose for the Bite to be physical, qi-visible, or spirit-visible. The choice affects which creatures can perceive it, but not its mechanical effects.
- Your Hewing Strike can place Bite on a non-Secret temporary Barrier, qi construct, summoned shell, or visible formation panel if the GM agrees there is a defined structure to bite.
- Once per turn, when you consume Bite, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target whose Bite you consumed.
- Your axe attacks count as magical for overcoming ordinary Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
Hewing Intent does not let you damage Domains, erase major Formations, cut concepts, or sever souls unless a later talent says so.
TAL_AXES_HEWING_STRIKE:
### Hewing Strike
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Parent Action: Attack
Replaces Attacks: 1
Range: Weapon reach
Target: One creature or object within reach
Cost: None
Requirement: You must be wielding an axe weapon.
Make a melee weapon attack with an axe weapon. On a hit, the attack deals its normal weapon damage. Then choose one Hewing rider.
**Bite.** The target gains Bite from you until the start of your next turn.
**Drive.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, push it 5 feet directly away from you.
**Hook.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, pull it 5 feet toward you or move it 5 feet to another space within your reach.
**Split Guard.** Until the end of your current turn, the target cannot benefit from Shield AC against the next axe attack you make against it.
**Hamper.** The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
You may choose only one rider unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_AXES_HOOK_THE_GIANT_S_KNEE:
### Hook the Giant's Knee - Hook
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Dragon-Felling Chop
When you hit a creature larger than you with Hewing Strike, you may spend 2 CP, 2 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus and 1 CP/Stamina.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one movement mode the target is using or could use: walk, climb, burrow, swim, fly, mounted movement, or charge. Until the end of its next turn, that movement mode is reduced by half. If the target is flying without hover and is within 30 feet of a surface, it descends safely to that surface and falls Prone.
Successful Save: The target's Speed for that movement mode is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
This talent does not affect teleportation.
TAL_AXES_LAW_OF_THE_FALLING_TREE:
### Law of the Falling Tree - Hew, Authority
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you knock a creature Prone, reduce a creature to 0 HP, destroy a significant object, or suppress a barrier panel with an Axes talent, you may spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus.
Choose one creature within 10 feet of the fallen target or broken object. That creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone or is pushed 10 feet away from the fall.
Successful Save: It moves 5 feet to a space of its choice that is not closer to you, if it can.
This represents the danger and morale shock of a falling body, shield, tree, gate, or line, not telekinesis.
TAL_AXES_LODGED_AXE_PULL:
### Lodged Axe Pull - Cast, Hook, Bite
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When Cast Axe places Bite on a creature or object, you may attach the axe by rope, chain, qi line, spirit thread, or haft-intent if the weapon and Path expression support it.
While the Bite lasts, you may use a Bonus Action to pull against the lodged axe.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: If the target is no more than one size larger than you, pull it 10 feet toward you. If the target is larger or fixed in place, you may pull yourself 10 feet toward it instead.
Successful Save: No movement occurs, but the Bite remains.
If the line is physical, it can be attacked or broken. If the line is qi or spirit-based, a creature may contest it with an appropriate ability check against your Cultivation Save DC.
TAL_AXES_LOW_CHOP:
### Low Chop - Hew
When Hewing Strike hits and you choose Hamper, the Speed reduction becomes 10 feet instead of 5 feet.
If the target is standing on difficult terrain, mud, snow, roots, rubble, stairs, a narrow bridge, or a sloped surface, it must also succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone.
TAL_AXES_MANDATE_AXE_PRESENCE:
### Mandate Axe Presence - Authority
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Headsman's Red Line
When you visibly carry a Ceremonial Axe profile weapon or have reduced a hostile creature to 0 HP with an axe during this scene, you may spend 1 minute declaring a lawful execution, clan judgment, sect punishment, battlefield ultimatum, or ancestral warning.
Make an Axes Check contested by the highest Wisdom (Insight), Charisma (Intimidation), or appropriate authority check among opposing listeners.
Success: Creatures who heard and understood the declaration cannot claim they did not know your terms. Until the end of the scene, you have Advantage on Intimidation checks against those creatures when enforcing the declared judgment.
Success by 5 or more: The first hostile creature that violates the declared terms before the scene ends gains Execution Mark from you until the start of your next turn.
This is social and spiritual pressure. It does not compel obedience.
TAL_AXES_MOON_CLEAVER_RETURN:
### Moon-Cleaver Return
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Returning Axe Line
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina
You throw an axe along a returning crescent path.
Choose up to four creatures or objects within range. Each target must be within 30 feet of the previous target, and no target may be behind Total Cover from the path.
Make one thrown weapon attack with an axe and compare it to each target's AC.
Hit: A target takes normal weapon damage. One hit target of your choice also gains Bite from you until the start of your next turn.
Miss by 5 or less: A target takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
After resolving all targets, the axe returns to your hand unless it is stopped by a stronger effect, lodged by your choice, or blocked by Total Cover.
TAL_AXES_ONE_AXE_OPENS_THE_GATE:
### One Axe Opens the Gate - Split
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Axe Bites the Formation
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach, or 60 feet if projecting axe qi through Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening
Target: One visible gate, barrier, ward panel, formation node, sealed door, conjured wall, summoned shell, or comparable structure
Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina
Make an Axes Check against the target effect's save DC, formation DC, creator's Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: Open, suppress, or split a passage up to 10 feet wide through the target structure until the end of your next turn.
Success by 5 or more: The passage lasts for 1 minute or until the creator uses an Action and succeeds on a check against your Cultivation Save DC to seal it.
Failure: The structure holds, but you learn one of the following: its weakest visible point, its dominant qi expression, whether it is anchored elsewhere, or whether it is protected by a higher authority.
This talent cannot open Domains or immortal-scale seals without a special contest or GM permission.
TAL_AXES_POLEAXE_ARMOR_COURT:
### Poleaxe Armor Court - Poleaxe, Hook, Guard
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Poleaxe Gate
While wielding a Poleaxe-profile weapon, you threaten armor joints, knees, reins, straps, weapon hafts, and shield rims inside your reach.
When a creature inside your reach misses you with a melee attack, you may use your Reaction to place Bite on that creature, its weapon, or its shield until the start of your next turn.
If the creature was mounted, flying by wings, climbing, or using a charge movement, it must also succeed on a Strength saving throw or its remaining movement this turn becomes 0.
TAL_AXES_POLEAXE_GATE:
### Poleaxe Gate - Poleaxe, Hook
Prerequisite: CL 5+
While wielding a Poleaxe-profile weapon, your Hewing Strike may target a creature up to 10 feet away if the weapon's reach or form reasonably permits it.
When you choose Hook on Hewing Strike with a Poleaxe-profile weapon, you may either pull the target 10 feet, knock it Prone on a failed Strength saving throw, or prevent it from moving closer to you until the start of your next turn.
A creature more than one size larger than you has Advantage on the saving throw.
TAL_AXES_RENDING_HEW:
### Rending Hew - Hew, Bite
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit a target that already has Bite from you with Hewing Strike, you may consume the Bite and spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus.
The target takes additional slashing damage equal to 2d6 + your Proficiency Bonus and must make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target can regain HP normally.
At CL 11, the additional damage becomes 3d6 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 17, it becomes 4d6 + your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_AXES_RETURNING_AXE_LINE:
### Returning Axe Line - Cast
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You learn to recover a thrown axe through chain, rope, magnetized metal, qi line, spirit thread, or practiced rebound.
Once on each of your turns, after you resolve Cast Axe, you may return the thrown axe to your hand if:
- the attack missed; or
- the target did not gain Bite; or
- you immediately end Bite on the target.
The returning axe cannot pass through Total Cover or a sealed barrier unless the line or Path expression has a legal route.
If a hostile creature is holding the axe or the axe is lodged in a resisting target, you cannot return it with this talent unless another talent permits it.
TAL_AXES_SEVER_THE_STANDARD:
### Sever the Standard - Execution, Authority
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach, or thrown range if using Cast Axe
Target: One banner, command focus, visible talisman standard, formation pennant, officer's signal weapon, war drum frame, or similar command object
Cost: 2 CP, 2 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus and 1 CP/Stamina
Make an axe attack against the object. On hit, deal normal weapon damage. If the object is destroyed, knocked down, cut free, or visibly marked by Bite, choose one hostile creature within 60 feet that was using the object for command, morale, formation alignment, or technique coordination.
That creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, it cannot grant command bonuses, activate command reactions, or issue a technique that requires allies to see or hear that object.
Successful Save: Its next such command before the start of your next turn has Disadvantage on its attack roll or grants Advantage on the first saving throw made against it.
This talent does not replace Warleader. It attacks a physical or symbolic command focus through axe authority.
TAL_AXES_SHIELD_CATCHING_BEARD:
### Shield-Catching Beard - Hook, Split
When Hewing Strike hits a creature wielding a shield, you may choose Shield-Catching Beard instead of a normal Hewing rider.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot benefit from Shield AC against your attacks.
Successful Save: Until the end of your current turn, the target cannot benefit from Shield AC against your next axe attack.
This talent does not destroy the shield.
TAL_AXES_SHIELD_WALL_SPLITTER:
### Shield-Wall Splitter - Split, Authority
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Shield-Catching Beard
When you hit a creature benefiting from a shield, Half Cover, or Three-Quarters Cover with Hewing Strike, you may spend 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus.
Choose one:
**Split the Shield.** The target cannot benefit from Shield AC against any of your axe attacks until the start of your next turn.
**Split the Cover.** If the cover is a breakable object or carried defensive object, deal your weapon damage to the cover as well as the target. If this destroys or moves the cover, the target loses that cover normally.
**Split the Line.** One ally within 5 feet of you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
This talent does not bypass Total Cover.
TAL_AXES_SPLITTING_STEP:
### Splitting Step - Movement, Hew
When you hit with Hewing Strike, you may move 5 feet immediately after the attack. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the target hit by the attack.
If the attack consumed Bite or destroyed an unattended object, you may move 10 feet instead.
TAL_AXES_SPLIT_THE_CHAIN:
### Split the Chain - Split
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a creature within your reach is Grappled, Restrained, bound by chains, vines, ropes, nets, thread, wax, webbing, or a comparable physical restraint, you may use Hewing Strike against the restraint instead of the creature.
On hit, deal damage to the restraint. If the attack would destroy, sever, or meaningfully disrupt the restraint, the restrained creature is freed from that restraint.
If the restraint is created by a cultivation effect, make an Axes Check against the effect's save DC. On a success, suppress the restraint on that creature until the start of your next turn. On a success by 5 or more, end the restraint on that creature if the effect is not Secret, Domain-scale, or artifact-backed.
TAL_AXES_SPLIT_THE_SHIELD_WALL:
### Split the Shield Wall - Split, Hew
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Shield-Wall Splitter
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach or 15-foot line from you if wielding a Great Axe or Poleaxe profile weapon
Cost: 2 CP, 2 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus and 1 CP/Stamina
You hew through a defensive line.
Choose up to three creatures in range that are adjacent to each other, benefiting from shields, benefiting from cover, using a defensive stance, or standing in a line formation.
Make one melee weapon attack and compare the result to each target's AC.
Hit: A target takes normal weapon damage and loses the benefit of Shield AC, Half Cover, or Three-Quarters Cover against the next attack made against it before the start of your next turn.
