Miss: The target takes no damage, but if the attack roll missed by 5 or less, it cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
This talent does not ignore Total Cover.
TAL_AXES_TWO_HANDED_COMMITMENT:
### Two-Handed Commitment - Hew
When you hit with Hewing Strike while wielding an axe in two hands and you are not wielding a shield or second weapon, you may reroll one weapon damage die. You must use the new roll.
If the attack placed Bite, you also gain Advantage on the next Strength (Athletics) check you make before the start of your next turn to pull, shove, drag, climb, hold, or break an object connected to that Bite.
TAL_AXES_WHEN_HEAVEN_CHOOSES_THE_ROOT:
### When Heaven Chooses the Root
Secret Axes Inheritance
Prerequisites: CL 17+, Mountain-Felling Axe Body, One Axe Opens the Gate, access to a true headsman's scripture, mountain-felling inheritance, ancestral execution axe, or heavenly woodcutter revelation
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 120-foot Emanation centered on you
Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn
Cost: 5 CP or 5 Stamina
Use Limit: Once per week
You raise the axe and demand that Heaven show the root of what stands before you.
Choose up to three decrees.
**The Guard Was a Branch.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the area that are benefiting from shields, defensive stances, Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, or non-Secret temporary guard effects make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, one such benefit is suppressed until the end of your next turn. On a success, that benefit is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
**The Gate Had a Grain.** Choose one visible barrier, gate, ward panel, wall section, formation node, conjured shell, or comparable structure in the area. Make an Axes Check against its DC. On success, open a 15-foot passage through it until the end of your next turn. On failure, mark its weakest visible point; the next attack or check made by you or an ally against that point before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
**The Oath Had a Neck.** Choose one visible command object, oath banner, officer focus, talisman standard, summoner's control mark, or spirit-binding token in the area. The controlling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, that object cannot be used to issue commands, maintain morale benefits, or direct summoned assets until the end of your next turn. On a success, its next such use before the end of your next turn is made with Disadvantage or grants Advantage on the first saving throw against it.
**The Giant Had a Knee.** Choose up to three creatures larger than you in the area. Each makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, its Speed is halved, it cannot take Reactions, and if flying without hover within 60 feet of a surface, it descends to that surface and falls Prone. On a success, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
**The Blood Had a Door.** Choose one Bloodied creature in the area that you can see. It makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it cannot regain HP, gain Temporary HP, teleport, or become Invisible until the end of your next turn. On a success, it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
**The Forest Fell Away.** Choose a 120-foot line or 60-foot cone in the area. Mundane roots, brambles, barricades, rope fields, wooden obstacles, fragile cover, deadwood, bone thickets, and similar obstructions in that area are cut, scattered, or opened enough to remove difficult terrain and clear a 10-foot-wide route until the end of your next turn. Cultivated obstructions require an Axes Check against their DC.
After resolving the decrees, you may immediately move up to half your Speed and make one Hewing Strike without spending an additional action.
Limits: When Heaven Chooses the Root does not kill creatures automatically, fell mountains casually, erase Domains, destroy ancient formations, bypass Total Cover without a path, or sever abstract concepts without an appropriate target object, oath focus, spirit mark, or exposed structure. Stronger authorities may require opposed Cultivation Checks or may be immune.
TAL_BARRAGE_ARROW_CATCHING_REVERSAL:
#### Arrow-Catching Reversal
Prerequisite: Intercepting Shot, CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You successfully negate or reduce a physical projectile attack through Intercepting Shot
Choose one:
catch the projectile if you have a free hand;
redirect it into one legal target within your weapon range by making a ranged weapon attack;
use it as ammunition for your next Barrage before the end of your next turn. The projectile must be physically suitable.
TAL_BARRAGE_BLITZ_FOCUS:
#### Blitz Focus - Focus
Whenever at least two attacks hit during one Barrage, regain Martial Focus.
TAL_BARRAGE_BLOWBACK_BARRAGE:
#### Blowback Barrage
When the same creature is hit at least twice during one Barrage, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push it 5 feet.
Successful Save: No movement.
If the forced movement would drive the creature into a solid object, it falls Prone instead.
TAL_BARRAGE_CONE_OF_DEATH:
#### Cone of Death - Volley
Prerequisite: Spinning Shot, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Make one ranged weapon attack against every creature of your choice within a 30-foot cone.
Requirements:
spend one projectile or thrown weapon per target;
make a separate attack roll for each target;
apply weapon range and ammunition rules normally. Cone of Death is a Volley, not a Barrage.
TAL_BARRAGE_COURT_OF_FALLING_STARS:
#### Court of Falling Stars - Martial Domain “The sky did not become crowded. The cultivator simply stopped accepting empty angles.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
For the duration:
##### You
increase ranged and thrown weapon normal range by 30 feet;
ignore Half Cover;
draw ammunition and thrown weapons without spending an Action;
regain Martial Focus once per turn when at least two Barrage attacks hit;
make one ranged opportunity attack each round without expending your Reaction when a hostile creature willingly moves more than 10 feet within your normal weapon range.
##### Allies Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus allies when activating the Court.
They gain:
+2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks against visible creatures you have attacked this round;
Advantage on one attack roll against a creature hit by at least two of your Barrage attacks before the start of your next turn. Court of Falling Stars ends early if you become Incapacitated.
TAL_BARRAGE_COVERING_VOLLEY:
#### Covering Volley - Blitz Forgo the Bonus Action attack.
Choose one ally within 30 feet.
Until the start of your next turn, the first opportunity attack made against that ally has Disadvantage.
If the attack misses, the ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
TAL_BARRAGE_DISTRACTING_SHOT:
#### Distracting Shot - Blitz
Intentionally forgo the Bonus Action attack from your Barrage.
Gain Advantage on the primary Barrage attack.
The sacrificed attack represents a feint, warning shot, debris strike, or projectile used to force the target’s guard open.
TAL_BARRAGE_HAMMERING_SHOTS:
#### Hammering Shots - Focus
When making a Barrage, expend Martial Focus.
Bonus Action attacks in that Barrage add your ability modifier to damage normally.
TAL_BARRAGE_HEAVEN_SPLITTING_LINE:
#### Heaven-Splitting Line
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 300-foot line, 10 feet wide
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Release a condensed line of projectiles and martial intent.
Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take damage equal to ten weapon damage dice plus twice your ability modifier and fall Prone.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
Objects and temporary Barriers inside take double damage.
Heaven-Splitting Line does not automatically destroy:
artifacts;
Formation cores;
Realm-defining barriers;
Domains;
Secret Inheritances.
TAL_BARRAGE_HUNDRED_ARROW_PASSAGE:
#### Hundred-Arrow Passage - Volley
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120-foot line, 10 feet wide
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Release a dense lane of projectiles.
Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take damage equal to four weapon damage dice plus your ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
Spend one ammunition unit or thrown weapon per 10 feet of line, minimum 10 projectiles.
Ceaseless Ammunition may satisfy ordinary nonmagical ammunition requirements.
TAL_BARRAGE_PINNING_VOLLEY:
#### Pinning Volley - Blitz
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When at least two attacks in your Barrage hit the same creature, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Pinning Volley represents projectiles catching clothing, armor, limbs, terrain, or movement rhythm.
Creatures without a meaningful body may be immune.
TAL_BARRAGE_RETURNING_ARSENAL:
#### Returning Arsenal - Arsenal
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Thrown weapons used in your Barrage return to your hand at the end of your turn if:
they remain within 60 feet;
no creature securely holds them;
no sealed barrier blocks the route. You may catch a number of returning weapons equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Excess weapons land in unoccupied spaces near you.
TAL_BARRAGE_SKY_NET_SUPPRESSION:
#### Sky-Net Suppression - Volley
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Fill an area with threatening projectiles.
A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside chooses:
##### Slow Down
movement costs 2 feet for every 1 foot traveled;
cannot Dash;
attacks have a -2 penalty until the start of its next turn.
##### Push Through Make one ranged weapon attack against that creature.
On a hit, deal weapon damage normally and reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Each creature triggers this attack once per turn.
TAL_BARRAGE_SPINNING_SHOT:
#### Spinning Shot - Blitz
Expend Martial Focus.
Make two Bonus Action attacks instead of one.
Every attack in the Barrage must target a different creature.
TAL_BARRAGE_SUPPRESSING_FIRE:
#### Suppressing Fire - Blitz
Forgo the normal Bonus Action attack.
Fire two wild shots at one creature.
The target chooses:
##### Evade
The shots automatically miss.
Until the end of the target’s next turn:
Speed is halved;
attacks have a -2 penalty;
Wisdom (Perception) checks have a -2 penalty.
##### Ignore the Pressure Roll both attacks with Disadvantage.
The target suffers no suppression penalties.
TAL_BARRAGE_TEN_THOUSAND_PROJECTILE_RAIN:
#### Ten-Thousand Projectile Rain
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 150 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Release a sky-filling rain of projectiles.
Choose hostile creatures inside the area.
Each chosen creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Take damage equal to eight weapon damage dice plus your ability modifier and become Pinned until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
##### Pinned
A Pinned creature:
has Speed reduced to 0;
cannot take Reactions;
may use an Action to remove or break free from the projectile pressure, ending Pinned. Spend at least 20 ordinary projectiles.
Ceaseless Ammunition or Sovereign Arsenal Incarnation may satisfy this requirement.
TAL_BARRAGE_VIGILANT_SHARPSHOOTER:
#### Vigilant Sharpshooter
While holding Martial Focus, make Opportunity Attacks with a ranged weapon you wield.
Treat the weapon as though it had Reach for this purpose.
You still require ammunition or a throwable weapon.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_ACCOMPLICE:
#### Accomplice - Tamer
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Joint Bonus Action
You or one Beast Ally within reach takes the Help Action to assist the other.
The assisted participant gains Advantage on one attack roll before the end of your turn.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_BEASTBACK_RELAY:
#### Beastback Relay - Rider
Prerequisite: CL 12+
When you begin your turn riding one willing mount, transfer onto another willing mount within 15 feet without spending an Action.
This movement:
does not provoke Opportunity Attacks;
may occur during movement;
allows one mounted attack before or after the transfer.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_BEAST_TAMER:
#### Beast Tamer - Tamer, Coercive
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Choose one creature eligible for Tame.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: It serves as a temporary Tame Creature for the duration and counts against your limits.
Successful Save: It becomes immune to your Beast Tamer until you complete a long rest.
The effect ends early if:
you or your allies harm the creature;
you command an obviously suicidal action;
the creature exceeds your Tamer capacity;
a stronger control effect succeeds. A non-Beast gains:
+2
to its saving throw.
Beast Tamer is temporary dominance, not friendship.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_BRONCO_BUSTER:
#### Bronco Buster - Rider, Coercive
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you Grapple a larger Beast or climb onto a larger Beast, attempt to force it to act as your mount.
The creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn:
it acts as a willing mount;
it takes only Actions you direct;
it cannot take other Actions.
Successful Save: It resists.
At the start of each turn, it repeats the saving throw.
If it escapes control while you remain mounted, use an Action to attempt control again.
If you possess Tamer and Broad Skills, use Bronco Buster against another creature eligible for Tame.
A non-Beast gains:
+2
to its saving throw.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_CALL_ACROSS_THE_WILD_WO:
#### Call Across the Wild Worlds
Prerequisite: Call Beast, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Call one Beast Ally, mount, or Bonded Companion on the same plane.
The creature appears in one visible unoccupied space within 30 feet.
This effect cannot call:
an unwilling creature;
a creature sealed behind a Dimensional Lock;
a creature imprisoned by a stronger effect;
a creature on another plane.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_CALL_BEAST:
#### Call Beast
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Call all Beast Allies to your side.
They must be within:
1 mile x Cultivation Level
They travel at their best safe speed, using their normal Actions and avoiding obvious hazards.
At CL 11+, Beast Allies need only remain on the same plane, but travel time still applies unless another effect changes it.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_DEFENSIVE_RIDER:
#### Defensive Rider - Rider
When an attack targets your mount, redirect the attack to yourself.
No Action is required.
You must be riding the mount and remain a legal target.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_DEFENSIVE_TEAMWORK:
#### Defensive Teamwork - Tamer
Action Type: Reaction
While within one Beast Ally’s reach, when an attack targets you or that ally, the other participant grants:
+2 AC
against the triggering attack.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_DISTANT_TAMER:
#### Distant Tamer - Tamer
Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, CL 7+
Increase Beast Tamer range to 120 feet.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_DOUBLE_TEAM:
#### Double Team - Tamer
Action Type: Reaction
When one Tame Creature or Bonded Companion succeeds on a Grapple or Shove, make one weapon attack or unarmed strike against the same target.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_ENDURING_CONTROL:
#### Enduring Control - Tamer, Coercive
Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, CL 7+
Increase Beast Tamer duration to 8 hours.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_EXTRA_BEASTMASTERY_PACK:
#### Extra Beastmastery Package
Choose one Beastmastery Package you do not possess.
Gain that Package.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_FOCUSING_CONNECTION:
#### Focusing Connection - Tamer, Focus
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Joint Bonus Action
Make physical contact with one Tame Creature or Bonded Companion within your natural reach.
Regain Martial Focus.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_GREAT_BEAST_CHARGE:
#### Great Beast Charge - Rider
Prerequisite: Trampling Line, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Joint Action
You and your mount move up to the mount’s Speed.
During this movement:
ignore nonmagical difficult terrain;
do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one chosen creature;
move through one hostile creature’s space if your mount succeeds on Overrun. At the end, you or the mount makes one melee attack.
Hit: Add:
3d8
Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Force damage.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push 15 feet or knock Prone.
Successful Save: Push 5 feet.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MASS_TAME:
#### Mass Tame - Tamer, Coercive
Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, CL 10+
When using Beast Tamer, target creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus within range.
Each target saves separately.
Your Tamer capacity still applies.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_MEAT_SHIELD:
#### Meat Shield - Rider
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until ended
Cost: None
While mounted on a creature of your size or larger, choose one edge of your space.
Your mount grants Total Cover against attacks targeting you that cross that edge.
The mount remains targetable normally.
You cannot use Defensive Rider while using the mount as cover.
##### Reactive Cover
Expend Martial Focus to activate Meat Shield as a Reaction when targeted by an attack roll.
The attack targets the mount instead.
End Meat Shield without spending an Action on your turn.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_RUN_DOWN:
#### Run Down - Rider
Your mount may attempt Overrun as an Action or Bonus Action.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_SHARED_GUARD:
#### Shared Guard - Bond
Prerequisite: Beast Companion or another Bonded Companion, CL 10+
Your Bonded Companion gains Shared Guard according to the Companion Rules chapter.
If it already possesses Shared Guard through automatic Realm Evolution, improve one use per round:
when adjacent to you, either participant may grant the other +2 AC against one attack as a Reaction; or
when one participant takes damage, the other may move 5 feet toward them without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Shared Guard does not grant an additional Reaction.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_SKIRMISH_RIDER:
#### Skirmish Rider - Rider
Your mount may Disengage as a Bonus Action.
TAL_BEASTMASTERY_SPIRIT_BEAST_COVENANT:
#### Spirit-Beast Covenant - Bond
Prerequisite: Tamer Package, CL 7+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 8 hours
Target: One willing spirit beast or demon beast

TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_BASE_SPHERE_ABI:
### Base Sphere Abilities
When you learn Daemonic Cultivation, gain Demon Seed, Devour Essence, and Daemonic Augment.
#### Demon Seed
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Plant or awaken a Demon Seed in your body, dantian, meridians, or soul. The Seed is a forbidden method-root, not a Demon Core. It does not make you a demon; it opens the second furnace through which the daemonic scripture can breathe.
While Demon Seed is active:
your Daemonic talents may be used;
you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Daemonic key ability modifier;
once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack, add 1d4 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage;
you have Advantage on saving throws against Frightened;
you have Disadvantage on checks made to appear spiritually pure unless you suppress all visible signs.
At CL 5, the extra damage becomes 1d6.
At CL 11, the extra damage becomes 1d8.
At CL 17, the extra damage becomes 1d10.
When Demon Seed ends, if you used Overdraw during its duration, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, gain 1 additional Corruption.
#### Devour Essence
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: bonus_action, reaction
Timing Detail: Bonus Action or Reaction
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=BONUS_ACTION_DEVOUR->bonus_action, REACTION_DEVOUR->reaction
Range: 30 feet
Cost: None
Use Devour Essence when one of the following happens within range:
a hostile creature is reduced to 0 HP;
a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Daemonic talents;
you score a Critical Hit;
a creature bearing your demonic mark takes damage;
an ongoing summoned, possessed, spirit, fiendish, undead, or demonic effect ends.
Gain 1 Devoured Essence.
You can use Devour Essence once per round.
If the triggering creature is at least your Realm or has a CR/level equal to at least half your CL, you may instead gain 2 Devoured Essence, but you also gain 1 Corruption.
#### Daemonic Augment
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: No Action, once per turn
Cost: 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or 1 Devoured Essence
Trigger: You use a sphere talent, weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack that deals damage, imposes a condition, moves a creature, creates a zone, or forces a saving throw.
Twist the technique with daemonic hunger. Choose one:
add Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll;
impose Disadvantage on one Concentration saving throw caused by the triggering effect;
if the triggering effect moves a creature, increase the movement by 5 feet;
if the triggering effect creates Difficult Terrain, one creature that fails a save also cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn;
if the triggering effect deals Necrotic, Psychic, Fire, Poison, Acid, Force, or weapon damage, ignore ordinary Resistance to one of those damage types for that instance;
mark one damaged creature until the start of your next turn. The first time you damage the marked creature before the mark ends, gain 1 Devoured Essence.
Daemonic Augment may modify non-Daemonic sphere talents, but only once per turn. This is one of the main reasons the sphere is forbidden.

Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Devoured Essence
Choose one creature you can see.
The creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: It bears your Demon Mark.
While marked:
once per turn when you damage it, add Proficiency Bonus to the damage;
when it drops to 0 HP, gain 1 Devoured Essence;
it has Disadvantage on checks made to hide from you while within 60 feet.
The mark is not exact tracking. It does not reveal the target through Total Cover or across planes.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_DEMON_SEED:
#### Demon Seed
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Plant or awaken a Demon Seed in your body, dantian, meridians, or soul. The Seed is a forbidden method-root, not a Demon Core. It does not make you a demon; it opens the second furnace through which the daemonic scripture can breathe.
While Demon Seed is active:
your Daemonic talents may be used;
you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Daemonic key ability modifier;
once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack, add 1d4 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage;
you have Advantage on saving throws against Frightened;
you have Disadvantage on checks made to appear spiritually pure unless you suppress all visible signs.
At CL 5, the extra damage becomes 1d6.
At CL 11, the extra damage becomes 1d8.
At CL 17, the extra damage becomes 1d10.
When Demon Seed ends, if you used Overdraw during its duration, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, gain 1 additional Corruption.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_DEMON_SHADOW_ST:
#### Demon-Shadow Step - Mutant, Parasite
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 2 CP, 2 Stamina, or 2 Devoured Essence
Teleport to an unoccupied space within range that is adjacent to one creature bearing your Demon Mark, one Frightened creature, or one creature below half HP.
You must be able to see the destination.
After teleporting, your next melee attack before the end of the turn deals additional Necrotic or Psychic damage equal to Proficiency Bonus.
This is short-range predatory movement, not Space cultivation.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_DEMON_SKIN_REIN:
#### Demon-Skin Reinforcement - Mutant, Seed
Reaction
Trigger: You take damage while Demon Seed is active.
Cost: 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or 1 Devoured Essence
Reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Daemonic key ability modifier.
If you reduce the damage to 0, gain 1 Devoured Essence.
If you Overdraw this talent, your skin visibly blackens, scales, smokes, or cracks until your next Short Rest.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_DEVOUR_ESSENCE:
#### Devour Essence
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: bonus_action, reaction
Timing Detail: Bonus Action or Reaction
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=BONUS_ACTION_DEVOUR->bonus_action, REACTION_DEVOUR->reaction
Range: 30 feet
Cost: None
Use Devour Essence when one of the following happens within range:
a hostile creature is reduced to 0 HP;
a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Daemonic talents;
you score a Critical Hit;
a creature bearing your demonic mark takes damage;
an ongoing summoned, possessed, spirit, fiendish, undead, or demonic effect ends.
Gain 1 Devoured Essence.
You can use Devour Essence once per round.
If the triggering creature is at least your Realm or has a CR/level equal to at least half your CL, you may instead gain 2 Devoured Essence, but you also gain 1 Corruption.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_DREAD_APPETITE:
#### Dread Appetite - Tyrant
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Devoured Essence
Choose one creature that can see or hear you.
It makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot be affected by your Dread Appetite again until your next Short Rest.
If the target is already Frightened, you may instead reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_HEAVEN_SPITING_:
#### Heaven-Spiting Recovery - Hunger
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Reaction
Trigger: You would be reduced to 0 HP while Demon Seed is active.
Cost: 3 CP, 3 Stamina, or 3 Devoured Essence
You drop to 1 HP instead.
Then gain Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus and stand if Prone.
Afterward, gain 1 Corruption.
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_HELL_OPENS_BENE:
#### Hell Opens Beneath the Sect Gate - Domain
Prerequisite: Demon Sovereign Aura, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Area: 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 15 CP or 15 Devoured Essence
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
Open a temporary demonic territory: black banners, bone pillars, hungry rivers, furnace pits, red moons, screaming sutras, or upside-down palaces.
The area becomes Difficult Terrain for enemies.
Enemies that start their turn inside make Wisdom saving throws.
Failed Save: Choose one:
take 8d8 Psychic, Necrotic, Fire, or Force damage;
become Frightened until the start of the next turn;
cannot regain HP until the start of the next turn;
cannot take Reactions until the start of the next turn;
lose Resistance to one damage type of your choice until the start of the next turn;
gain your Demon Mark for 1 minute.
Successful Save: Take damage equal to Proficiency Bonus and treat the area as Difficult Terrain until the start of the next turn.
Allies you choose inside gain Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns and may spend 1 Hit Die when they reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP.
After the Domain ends, the site remains spiritually stained unless purified.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_HUNGER_REFINING:
#### Hunger-Refining Breath - Hunger
Action Type: Action
Range: 30-foot cone
Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina
Exhale black smoke, blood mist, corpse-cold vapor, ash, demonic incense, or furnace breath.
Creatures in the cone make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 2d6 Necrotic or Poison damage and suffer Disadvantage on the next saving throw made before the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
At CL 5, damage becomes 3d6.
At CL 11, damage becomes 5d6.
At CL 17, damage becomes 7d6.
A creature reduced to 0 HP by this talent grants you 1 Devoured Essence.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_PARASITE_MERIDI:
#### Parasite Meridian Needle - Parasite
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Range: Melee reach or 30 feet through a visible daemonic thread, claw, needle, smoke, or mark
Cost: 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or 1 Devoured Essence
Make a melee weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Deal normal damage and the target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn;
it has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn;
it loses 5 feet of Speed until the start of your next turn;
you learn whether it has more, fewer, or equal current CP compared to you.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_PROFANE_BREAKTH:
#### Profane Breakthrough Pressure - Seed
Prerequisite: CL 5+
During a cultivation session, you may accept daemonic pressure to increase the result of one Breakthrough, cultivation meditation, or CXP-related check by your Proficiency Bonus.
After the roll, gain 1 Corruption.
If the check fails despite this bonus, gain 1 additional Corruption.
This talent is one of the sphere’s greatest temptations. It does not create CXP by itself; it helps force a door open.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_THOUSAND_HUNGER:
#### Thousand-Hunger Adaptation - Mutant
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you take Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Psychic, Radiant, Thunder, or Force damage while Demon Seed is active, you may spend 1 Devoured Essence.
Gain Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn.
At CL 11, the Resistance lasts until the end of your next turn.
At CL 17, when you gain this Resistance, your next damage roll with a Daemonic talent deals additional damage of that type equal to Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_THOUSAND_MOUTH_:
#### Thousand-Mouth Devouring Art - Hunger
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: Up to Proficiency Bonus creatures you can see
Cost: 7 CP or 7 Devoured Essence
Black mouths, shadow wounds, hungry sutras, fang-shaped qi, or ghostly demon faces bite at selected enemies.
Each target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 6d8 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage, and you gain 1 Devoured Essence.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
If a target is Frightened, below half HP, or bearing your Demon Mark, it has Disadvantage on the save.
Gain 1 Corruption if this talent reduces two or more creatures to 0 HP.
TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_WORLD_DEVOURING:
#### World-Devouring Maw
Prerequisite: Thousand-Mouth Devouring Art, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 40-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 12 CP or 12 Devoured Essence
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
Open a vast daemonic mouth in the world.
Creatures you choose inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 12d10 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage, are pulled 30 feet toward the center, and gain your Demon Mark for 1 minute.
Successful Save: Take half damage and are pulled 10 feet.
Objects, unattended materials, minor summoned creatures, and ordinary terrain inside may be shredded, swallowed, or ruined at GM discretion.
For each creature reduced to 0 HP by World-Devouring Maw, gain 2 Devoured Essence and regain HP equal to your CL.
After using this talent, gain 1 Corruption.
TAL_DARK_BLACK_LUNG:
### Black Lung - Darkness
Your Darkness becomes foul and miasmic.
A breathing creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Poisoned until it leaves the Darkness.
A creature Poisoned by Black Lung that attempts to activate an ability requiring clear speech must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the activation fails and the action and any CP spent are lost.
Creatures that do not breathe are unaffected.
Augment - 1 CP: When creating Black Lung, consume one dose of contact or inhalation poison held in your hand. A creature that fails against Black Lung also makes a saving throw against the poison’s DC. A creature immune to Black Lung is also immune to the imbued poison.
TAL_DARK_BLINDFOLD:
### Blindfold - Meld
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Saving Throw: Wisdom negates
Concentrate the target’s shadow into a band of supernatural Darkness across its senses.
Failed Save: The target is Blinded and the range of all other senses is reduced by half.
The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Darkvision does not overcome Blindfold. A creature that can see through supernatural Darkness is immune.
TAL_DARK_CLEARSIGHT:
### Clearsight - Meld
The target is immune to negative effects created by your Darkness talents.
Clearsight does not automatically grant sight through Darkness. A creature with Darkvision may see through your Pure Darkness while Clearsight is active.
An allied cultivator may choose to let your Clearsight apply to Darkness effects they create.
TAL_DARK_CLINGING_DARKNESS:
### Clinging Darkness - Augment
Augment - 0 CP: Center an area of Darkness on one creature or object rather than a stationary point.
If targeting a creature or its worn or held object, that creature may make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The Darkness is anchored to the creature or object and moves with it.
An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
TAL_DARK_CONTESTING_LIGHT:
#### Contesting Light
If a Light-sphere effect is created inside your Darkness, the creator of the Light effect makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Successful Check: Your Darkness is countered and the Light effect functions normally.Failed Check: The Light effect functions only as an ordinary light source and cannot illuminate your Darkness.
TAL_DARK_CREEPING_LETHARGY:
### Creeping Lethargy - Darkness
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, CL 5+Augment - 1 CP
Your Darkness fogs the mind and draws creatures toward sleep.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until it starts a turn outside the Darkness, the creature may take an Action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both.
If a creature suffering this penalty starts its turn inside the Darkness, it repeats the Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Fall Unconscious for 1 minute or until the creature starts a turn outside the Darkness, whichever occurs first.
A sleeping creature repeats the saving throw at the start of each of its turns, waking on a success. It also wakes if it takes damage or another creature uses an Action to wake it.
TAL_DARK_DARKVISION:
### Darkvision - Meld
When you learn the Dark sphere, you learn this Meld talent automatically.
Grant the target Darkvision out to 60 feet.
If the target already possesses Darkvision, increase its Darkvision range by 30 feet instead.
Augment - 2 CP: Increase the granted Darkvision range to 120 feet. If the target already possesses Darkvision, increase its range by 60 feet instead.
TAL_DARK_DARK_SLAUGHTER:
### Dark Slaughter - Meld
While the target stands inside an area of your Darkness, it deals additional damage whenever it attacks with Advantage or attacks a creature unable to perceive it.
| CL | Additional Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 1d6 |
| 5-10 | 1d8 |
| 11-16 | 1d10 |
| 17-20 | 1d12 |
This damage is multiplied on a critical hit and may stack with Sneak Attack or a comparable precision-damage feature.
TAL_DARK_DIRECTIONAL_DARKNESS:
### Directional Darkness - Augment
Augment - 1 CP: Your Darkness blocks vision from only one chosen vantage.
For a wall-shaped effect, choose which side is obscured.
For a sphere, choose one:
Creatures inside see outward clearly.
Creatures outside see inward clearly.
The boundaries remain obvious to creatures that can see through the effect.
TAL_DARK_DISORIENTING_DARKNESS:
### Disorienting Darkness - Darkness
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, CL 5+
Your Darkness makes routes unreliable.
The first time on a turn that a creature attempts to enter, leave, or move through the area, it makes an Intelligence saving throw.
Failed Save: Roll 1d8 to determine the creature’s direction of travel. 1 is the intended direction; 2-8 rotate clockwise around the creature. The creature moves as though the rolled direction were its intended route.
The creature does not realize it moved off course until its next turn or until it leaves the Darkness.
#### Second Purchase - Core Formation Upgrade
If you purchase Disorienting Darkness a second time, gain both augments below.
Augment - 0 CP: When a creature fails its save and attempts to move, you may spend your Reaction to choose its direction instead of rolling randomly.
Augment - 1 CP: When a creature that failed its save makes an attack or uses an ability with a specified target before the end of that turn, randomly redirect the attack or ability to another legal target within range. If no other legal target exists, the action is unaffected.
If the ability targets multiple creatures, randomly choose each legal target.
TAL_DARK_ETERNAL_DARKNESS:
### Eternal Darkness - Augment
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, CL 10+Augment - 2 CP
Your Darkness becomes permanent until dispelled.
Permanent Darkness is stationary. It cannot be centered on a creature or object through Clinging Darkness and cannot be moved by Rolling Blackout.
TAL_DARK_EXTINGUISH:
### Extinguish - Augment
Augment - 0 CP: When your Darkness is created, extinguish all nonmagical light sources inside it rather than merely suppressing them.
This includes flame, incandescence, and alchemical light. Coals cool, glowing metal dims, and luminous chemicals become inert.
You may also attempt to counter or dispel one magical flame effect inside the area. Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC.
Extinguish does not damage creatures composed of flame or luminous energy.
TAL_DARK_FEARFUL_DARKNESS:
### Fearful Darkness - Darkness
Your Darkness plays upon fears that remain unnamed.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Frightened until it ends its turn outside the Darkness.
A creature that succeeds but remains inside may repeat the saving throw at the start of each subsequent turn, ending the Frightened condition on itself on a success.
TAL_DARK_FEED_ON_DARKNESS:
### Feed on Darkness - Meld
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
At the start of each of the target’s turns while it remains inside your Darkness, it gains Temporary HP equal to your key ability modifier.
These Temporary HP last for 1 round after leaving your Darkness.
TAL_DARK_GREATER_DARKNESS:
### Greater Darkness - Augment
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the radius of your Darkness to 30 feet.
If combined with Wall of Darkness, double the number of 10-foot cubes.
TAL_DARK_HIDE_IN_DARKNESS:
### Hide in Darkness - Meld
While the target stands inside an area of your Darkness, it may take the Hide action even while clearly visible. This specifically overrides the ordinary Hide action’s line-of-sight requirement while the target remains inside your Darkness.
TAL_DARK_HUNGRY_DARKNESS:
### Hungry Darkness - Darkness
Your Darkness saps vitality.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Necrotic damage equal to your Cultivation Level.
A creature may take this damage only once per round, regardless of how often it enters or leaves the Darkness.
TAL_DARK_LIGHTLESS_PENUMBRA:
### Lightless Penumbra - Meld
Prerequisite: Shadowed Mien, Foundation Realm, CL 5+Augment - 1 CP
Render Shadowed Mien entirely opaque.
The target gains protection from ordinary and magical daylight, Advantage on saving throws against Light and sight-based effects, and is treated as averting its gaze against gaze attacks without suffering the normal penalties.
TAL_DARK_LOOMING_DARKNESS:
### Looming Darkness - Darkness
Creatures inside your Darkness have Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability checks and saving throws.
TAL_DARK_MELD:
### Meld
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour
Cost: None
Grant the target one Meld talent you know.
An unwilling creature may make a Wisdom saving throw to resist receiving the Meld.
#### Persistent Meld
Augment - 2 CP: The Meld persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after granting the Meld on your turn without spending an action.
TAL_DARK_MIDNIGHT:
### Midnight - Augment
Prerequisite: Greater Darkness, Nascent Soul Realm, CL 15+Augment - 2 CP
Increase the radius of your Darkness to 2 miles.
A Darkness effect augmented by Midnight cannot also carry a Darkness talent.
TAL_DARK_NIGHT_THAT_SWALLOWS_THE_LANTERN:
### Night That Swallows the Lantern
“Some nights are not the absence of day. They are older than the first sunrise.”
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, CL 17+, One With The Night, hidden primordial-night inheritance
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You would be reduced to 0 HP, fail a saving throw, or become unable to act while standing inside Dim Light or Darkness
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one:
Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.
Succeed on the triggering saving throw.
End one ordinary Grappled, Restrained, Blinded, or Stunned condition affecting you.
Move up to 60 feet into one unoccupied space located in Dim Light or Darkness.
Immediately activate One With The Night without paying its CP cost.
Until the end of your next turn:
You may see through ordinary and supernatural Darkness.
You gain Resistance to all damage except Radiant, Force, and Void effects.
Ordinary nonmagical light sources within 30 feet of you are extinguished.
You cannot make attacks unless you rematerialize first.
TAL_DARK_NUMBING_DARKNESS:
### Numbing Darkness - Darkness
Creatures inside your Darkness have Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution ability checks and saving throws.
TAL_DARK_OBFUSCATION:
### Obfuscation - Augment
Augment - 1 CP: Creatures and objects inside your Darkness, or affected by one of your Meld talents, cannot be located through ordinary scrying or divination.
A sufficiently specialized penetrating divination may attempt a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC to bypass Obfuscation.
Obfuscation does not interfere with your own divinations.
TAL_DARK_OBSCURE_PASSAGE:
### Obscure Passage
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One visible surface
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Place a black circle on a surface and create a temporary passage.
The passage has a diameter in feet equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
| Realm | Maximum Depth |
| --- | --- |
| Mortal Realm | 5 feet |
| Foundation Realm | 10 feet |
| Core Formation Realm | 15 feet |
| Nascent Soul Realm | 20 feet |
Obscure Passage cannot penetrate a surface of exceptional hardness, such as adamantine.
If the surface is too thick or hard, the talent fails and the CP is lost.
When the effect ends, the surface returns whole and unmarred.
Light does not pass through the passage. Ordinary low-light vision and Darkvision cannot see through it. Clearsight and abilities that explicitly allow sight through supernatural Darkness may do so.
A creature standing over the passage when it opens may make a Dexterity saving throw, moving to the nearest safe space on a success.
TAL_DARK_ONE_WITH_THE_NIGHT:
### One With The Night
Prerequisite: Step Through Darkness, Core Formation Realm, CL 12+
Action Type: Action
Target: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
Become an area of your own Darkness.
You become Incorporeal, gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet, and Hover.
You may move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain. If you end your turn inside an object, take 1d10 Force damage.
You cannot make attacks, manipulate objects, or use your items. You may still activate sphere effects that do not require a physical action, focus, tool, weapon, or other component your incorporeal form cannot provide.
You gain Resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
As a Bonus Action, change your radius from 5 feet up to the maximum radius of one area of Darkness you control.
When you activate this talent, you may imbue yourself with one Darkness talent by paying its normal CP cost. As an Action, replace the active Darkness talent by paying the normal CP cost of the new talent.
End One With The Night early as a Bonus Action and rematerialize in one unoccupied space inside your personal Darkness area.
TAL_DARK_PERSISTENT_DARKNESS:
#### Persistent Darkness
Augment - 2 CP: Your Darkness persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Darkness on your turn without spending an action.
TAL_DARK_PERSISTENT_MELD:
#### Persistent Meld
Augment - 2 CP: The Meld persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after granting the Meld on your turn without spending an action.
TAL_DARK_PITCH_BLACK:
### Pitch Black - Augment
Prerequisite: Pure Darkness, Foundation Realm, CL 5+Augment - 1 CP
Apply Pure Darkness in addition to one other Darkness talent modifying the same area.
Pay the normal CP cost of every applied talent.
TAL_DARK_PURE_DARKNESS:
### Pure Darkness - Darkness
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, CL 5+
Darkvision is reduced to 5 feet inside your Darkness.
All other senses, including Blindsight and Scent, have their range reduced by half.
You may also dim sound traveling into, out of, or through the Darkness. Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing have Disadvantage.
TAL_DARK_ROLLING_BLACKOUT:
### Rolling Blackout - Augment
Augment - 0 CP: Move one area of Darkness you created up to 30 feet as an Action or Bonus Action, remaining within the effect’s maximum range.
A creature leaving the area immediately stops suffering ongoing effects that depend upon remaining inside it.
TAL_DARK_SHADOWED_MIEN:
### Shadowed Mien - Meld
Cloak the target in menacing shadow that conceals appearance, subtle movements, and intentions.
The target gains Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks.
Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern the target’s intentions have Disadvantage.
The target sees outward normally. Darkvision does not penetrate the effect.
Clearsight and abilities that explicitly allow sight through supernatural Darkness reveal the target clearly and suppress these social benefits for that observer.
Augment - 1 CP: Grant the target Temporary HP equal to your Cultivation Level for the duration. Losing those Temporary HP does not end the remaining benefits.
TAL_DARK_SHADOW_SLICK:
### Shadow Slick - Darkness
Your Darkness becomes nearly frictionless.
A creature that attempts to move more than half its Speed through the area makes a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Check: Fall Prone.
Creatures inside the area have Advantage on Dexterity checks made to escape the Grappled condition.
TAL_DARK_SHADOW_STASH:
### Shadow Stash
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Target: One object
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
Store one nonliving object inside your cast shadow.
The object appears as part of your silhouette and has no weight while stored. Stored objects cannot be used, activated, or provide passive bonuses.
You may store up to 5 x CL pounds.
Retrieve one stored item as a Bonus Action.
A stored object cannot be stolen or targeted unless the creature attempting to do so also knows Shadow Stash.
If your shadow is removed, animated, or suppressed, you cannot access the stash until your shadow returns.
If you die, stored objects appear in the nearest unoccupied space.
Augment - 1 CP: Retrieve an item without spending an action during your turn, or retrieve one as a Reaction.
TAL_DARK_SHADOW_TAG:
### Shadow Tag - Darkness, Meld
A creature passing through your Darkness picks up a trace of your cultivation in its shadow.
For 8 hours, you know the creature’s approximate direction and whether it is alive, unconscious, or dead.
As a Meld talent, apply the same effect directly to one creature.
You may track a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you exceed this limit, choose one older tag to end.
The effect ends immediately if the creature moves more than 1 mile away from you.
TAL_DARK_SHADOW_WALKER:
### Shadow Walker - Meld
Prerequisite: Step Through Darkness, Core Formation Realm, CL 14+Augment - 1 CP
The target must stand in Dim Light or Darkness when this Meld is granted.
The target temporarily steps out of the Material Plane and enters the shadowed border where the Material Plane touches the realm beyond ordinary light.
While traveling there:
Travel at up to 50 miles per hour.
Perceive an approximate relationship to the Material Plane.
See terrain only as blurred and unreliable outlines.
Gain no precise scouting, spying, mapping, or surveillance benefit.
The target may return to the Material Plane at any time.
When returning, roll 1d10 x 100 feet. The target appears that distance away from the desired endpoint in a random horizontal direction.
If this would place the target inside a solid object, roll 1d10 x 1,000 feet and shunt the target that distance in the same direction.
If this would still place the target inside a solid object, place it in the nearest unoccupied space and give it 1 level of Exhaustion.
Shadow Walker cannot cross a Dimensional Lock or comparable sealed boundary.
TAL_DARK_SNAGGING_DARKNESS:
### Snagging Darkness - Darkness
Your Darkness fills with grasping tendrils.
A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Restrained until the start of its next turn.
A Restrained creature may use a Bonus Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.
TAL_DARK_STEP_THROUGH_DARKNESS:
### Step Through Darkness - Meld
While the target stands in Dim Light or Darkness, it may use a Bonus Action to teleport up to half its Speed to one visible unoccupied space also located in Dim Light or Darkness.
The target may carry equipment up to its ordinary carrying capacity.
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the teleport distance to the target’s full Speed.
TAL_DARK_TENEBROUS_LEGERDEMAIN:
### Tenebrous Legerdemain - Darkness
Manipulate objects inside your Darkness.
As a Bonus Action, attempt to steal one worn or held object from a creature inside the area.
Make either a ranged Cultivation Attack or a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature’s Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
Success: Pull the object away and move it to another space inside the same Darkness.
You have Disadvantage if the object is firmly secured or held in two hands.
Unattended objects may be moved without a check.
You may move objects weighing up to 5 x CL pounds.
TAL_DARK_THICK_DARKNESS:
### Thick Darkness - Darkness
Your Darkness becomes difficult terrain.
Creatures inside move at half Speed and cannot take the Dash or Disengage actions.
TAL_DARK_WALL_OF_DARKNESS:
### Wall of Darkness - Augment
Augment - 0 CP: Arrange your Darkness as a number of contiguous 10-foot cubes equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus instead of a sphere.
You must be able to perceive every space the effect will occupy.
TAL_DEATH_BONE_BASTION:
#### Bone Bastion - Corpse
Prerequisite: Bone Ward, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 3 CP
You raise a barricade of bone, grave stone, funerary tablets, corpse-ash, or spiritual ribs.
Choose a point within range. You create a 15-foot-long, 10-foot-high, 1-foot-thick barrier. The barrier provides Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and effects that pass through it.
The barrier has AC 15 and HP equal to 5 x your CL. It is immune to Poison and Psychic damage.
If created from an available corpse, bone pile, grave marker, or battlefield remains, the barrier gains Temporary HP equal to your CL.
The barrier is an object, not a creature. It does not attack.
TAL_DEATH_BONE_WARD:
#### Bone Ward - Corpse
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: 1 CP
A shard of bone, ash, grave cloth, funerary paper, or pale grave Qi rises to intercept harm.
Reduce the triggering damage by an amount based on your CL.
CL 1-10: 1d8 + your key ability modifier.
CL 11-16: 2d8 + your key ability modifier.
CL 17-20: 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
If a corpse, bone pile, grave marker, or funerary object is within 10 feet of the protected creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction.
TAL_DEATH_COMMAND_THE_UNQUIET:
#### Command the Unquiet - Command, Ghost
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 6 CP
Choose one undead creature or ghost within range. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. If the target is already controlled by another creature, that creature may make an opposed Cultivation Check using its relevant save DC or command DC.
Failed Save: The target is Charmed by you for the duration. While Charmed in this way, it treats your spoken or spiritual commands as coming from a superior grave authority. It will not obey commands that directly destroy itself unless it is mindless or already self-destructive.
Successful Save: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of your next turn.
This talent does not work on undead whose CR, Realm, or story importance is higher than your GM permits without an opposed Cultivation Check. It does not give permanent control.
TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_COURIER:
#### Corpse Courier - Corpse
Prerequisite: Rouse Lesser Dead
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: No action when you create a Lesser Corpse Servant
Cost: None
Your Lesser Corpse Servants are better suited for utility.
When you create a Lesser Corpse Servant, choose one utility adaptation:
Climb Speed equal to its Speed.
Swim Speed equal to its Speed.
It can carry twice normal load.
It can follow a route up to 1 mile long and return.
It can perform one repetitive labor task without further commands.
It can deliver one sealed object or message to a named location it can reach.
A servant with this talent is still not intelligent. It cannot solve complex problems, negotiate, interpret social cues, or improvise beyond the task.
TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_EXPLOSION:
#### Corpse Explosion - Corpse, Withering, Forbidden
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere centered on one corpse or undead servant
Cost: 3 CP
You rupture a corpse, undead servant, or grave mass into bone shards and deathly force.
Creatures in the area make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: A creature takes 4d6 Necrotic or Piercing damage, your choice.
Successful Save: A creature takes half damage.
At CL 11, the damage becomes 6d6. At CL 17, the damage becomes 8d6.
The corpse is destroyed. If you used one of your Death servants, that servant is destroyed.
Using this on a protected corpse, sacred corpse, ancestor, ally, or socially claimed body is usually a severe forbidden act.
TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_SERVANT:
#### Corpse Servant - Corpse, Command
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Target: One Common or Notable corpse
Duration: Until destroyed or dismissed
Cost: 4 CPControl Load: 1
You animate a corpse as a full Corpse Servant.
A Corpse Servant does not contain the original soul unless another talent says so. It can fight, guard, carry, dig, perform simple labor, patrol a known route, or follow brief instructions.
You may maintain any number of Corpse Servants up to your Death Control Limit.
If you animate a Notable corpse, the GM may require a ritual check, social permission, funerary sanction, or opposed spiritual resistance.
TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_SERVANT_STAT_BLOCK:
#### Corpse Servant Stat Block
Creature Type: UndeadSize: Medium or Small, matching the corpse when possibleAC: 12 + your Proficiency BonusHP: 5 x your CL + your key ability modifierSpeed: 30 feetDamage Immunities: PoisonCondition Immunities: Charmed, Frightened, PoisonedSenses: Darkvision 60 feet, passive Perception 8 + your Proficiency BonusLanguages: understands your commands; may speak broken phrases if the corpse could speak in life
Grave Strike: Melee attack using your Cultivation Attack Modifier, reach 5 feet, one target.
Hit: 2d6 + your key ability modifier Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Necrotic damage.
Grave Body: The servant has Advantage on saving throws against effects that would Exhaust, Poison, or Frighten it.
TAL_DEATH_COURT_OF_THE_NINTH_GRAVE:
#### Court of the Ninth Grave - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation centered on you
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 7 CP
You establish a grave court around yourself. The air cools, sound becomes muffled, lanterns dim, names appear on funerary paper, and every breath sounds borrowed.
While the Domain lasts:
Grave Sense functions automatically inside the Domain.
You know the location of corpses, undead, ghosts, dying creatures, and living creatures inside the Domain unless concealed by a stronger effect.
You gain Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Allies inside gain Advantage on death saving throws and Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Your Death servants inside the Domain may move through nonmagical Difficult Terrain without extra movement.
Once during each of your turns, when a creature inside the Domain cannot regain HP, you may command one Death servant inside the Domain without using your Bonus Action.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one effect:
the enemy takes 2d8 Necrotic damage;
the enemy cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn;
the enemy’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
the enemy cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Healing the enemy receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of its next turn.
A creature is affected by this start-of-turn effect only once per turn.
TAL_DEATH_DEATHLESS_GUARD:
#### Deathless Guard - Corpse, Command
Prerequisite: Corpse Servant, CL 5+
Your Corpse Servants can protect the living or the dead.
A Corpse Servant you command may take the Guard action.
Until the start of your next turn, when a creature within 5 feet of the servant is hit by an attack, the servant may use its Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. If this reduces the damage to 0, the servant may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
At CL 11, the reduction becomes 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 17, it becomes 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_DEATH_DEATH_MASK:
#### Death Mask - Rite
Action Type: Action
Range: Self or touch
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 1 CP
You veil a living creature in the stillness of the grave.
For the duration, the target gains Advantage on ability checks made to appear dead, avoid detection by unintelligent undead, or hide its life signs from ordinary examination.
Grave Sense, Spirit Awakening techniques, Medicine checks, or a direct physical examination may contest the effect with a check against your Cultivation Save DC.
If the target attacks, casts, uses a loud technique, or moves more than half its Speed on a turn, the effect ends.
TAL_DEATH_FUNERARY_PRESERVATION:
#### Funerary Preservation - Rite
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One corpse, set of remains, grave relic, or funerary chamber
Duration: 7 days
Cost: 1 CP
You preserve remains against decay, ordinary scavengers, mundane rot, and uncontrolled undeath.
For the duration:
the corpse does not naturally decay;
ordinary undead cannot rise from it without overcoming your Cultivation Save DC;
Speak with the Departed gains Advantage on checks involving the corpse;
resurrection or reincarnation remains possible if the setting otherwise permits it;
tampering with the corpse leaves a spiritual mark you can sense with Grave Sense.
At CL 10, the duration becomes 30 days. At CL 15, it lasts until dismissed or ritually broken.
TAL_DEATH_GHOSTLY_RETINUE:
#### Ghostly Retinue - Ghost, Rite
Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening or Ghost Lantern, CL 10+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 6 CP
You invite willing funerary spirits, ancestor echoes, battlefield dead, or household ghosts to accompany you.
Choose two benefits:
You gain Advantage on checks made to detect ghosts, possession, or Death effects.
Your Ghost Lantern cannot be destroyed by ordinary damage.
Once per short rest, add your Proficiency Bonus to one saving throw.
Once per short rest, ask the spirits one brief question about a nearby death, corpse, or ghost.
One Corpse Servant you control gains +2 AC.
Once per turn, Withering Hand may deal Psychic instead of Necrotic damage.
When you use Speak with the Departed, you may ask one additional question.
The spirits are not slaves. They may refuse tasks that violate their nature, insult their dead, or assist in soul enslavement.
TAL_DEATH_GHOST_LANTERN:
#### Ghost Lantern - Ghost, Rite
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 3 CP
You summon a floating funerary lantern of pale flame, bone paper, moth wings, or ancestral ash.
The lantern occupies a Tiny space, floats, and moves up to 30 feet when you use a Bonus Action. It emits Dim Light in a 20-foot radius.
Inside the light:
ordinary ghosts, possession signs, and undead traces become visible;
creatures have Advantage on checks made to identify undead, possession, or Death effects;
Invisible undead do not benefit from Invisible against creatures who can see the lantern’s light unless the invisibility is stronger than your Death cultivation;
your Grave Sense can focus as a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
The lantern has AC 14, 1 HP, and immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. If destroyed, the effect ends.
TAL_DEATH_GRAVE_CHILL:
#### Grave Chill - Withering
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: 2 CP
Choose one creature within range. It makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 2d6 Necrotic damage and cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage, and healing it receives before the start of your next turn is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 11, the damage becomes 4d6. At CL 17, the damage becomes 6d6.
TAL_DEATH_GRAVE_FORMATION:
#### Grave Formation - Corpse, Command
Prerequisite: Corpse Servant, CL 10+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Target: A pile of corpses, battlefield remains, ossuary, mass grave, or prepared corpse array
Duration: 24 hours, or until the formation is destroyed or dismissed
Cost: 8 CP
Control Load: 3
Requirement: You must have enough unused Death Control Limit to maintain the formation, and the remains must be sufficient to support its chosen size.
You bind the target remains into one Grave Formation using the Grave Formation stat block below. The formation appears in legal spaces occupied by or adjacent to the prepared remains, has full Hit Points, and is one undead asset regardless of how many corpses compose it.
A Grave Formation is a mass creature, not dozens of individual creatures or turns. It acts immediately after your turn and is commanded according to Commanding Death Servants. A single command causes it to take one action from its stat block. If it is not commanded, it takes the Dodge action and moves only as permitted by those rules.
The Grave Formation counts as 3 Control Load. You may maintain Grave Formations only within your Death Control Limit. You may dismiss one you created without taking an action on your turn.
TAL_DEATH_GRAVE_FORMATION_STAT_BLOCK:
#### Grave Formation Stat Block
Creature Type: Undead
Size: Large or Huge, depending on remains
AC: 12 + your Proficiency Bonus
HP: 10 x your CL
Speed: 20 feet
Damage Immunities: Poison
Condition Immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned
Senses: Darkvision 60 feet, passive Perception 8 + your Proficiency Bonus
Grave Assault: Melee attack using your Cultivation Attack Modifier, reach 10 feet, one target.
Hit: 4d8 + your key ability modifier Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Necrotic damage. If the formation has half its HP or fewer, the damage becomes 2d8 + your key ability modifier.
Mass of Dead: The formation can occupy spaces as a Large or Huge creature. It cannot squeeze through spaces that could not fit the mass of corpses.
Corpse Engine: If the formation starts its turn within 10 feet of a corpse, it regains HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This cannot restore it above half its maximum HP unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_DEATH_GRAVE_MERIDIAN_AWAKENING:
#### Grave Meridian Awakening - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Death talents awaken the meridians of stillness.
Gain the following benefits:
Grave Sense range becomes 60 feet.
Your Death talents can affect incorporeal undead, ghosts, and possessing spirits normally if the talent’s fiction can reach them.
Withering Hand may deal Necrotic or Cold damage when you use it.
When you use a Death talent on a creature that cannot regain HP, you may move one undead asset you control up to 10 feet without using an action.
When you create a Death servant, it gains a visible death-sign such as bone script, grave ash, funerary paper, frost, spectral sutures, a lantern flame, or black-gold talisman threads.
This evolution does not automatically allow you to bind souls or create self-willed undead.
TAL_DEATH_GRAVE_TAX:
#### Grave Tax - Withering, Forbidden
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet regains HP or gains Temporary HP
Cost: 4 CP
You levy the grave’s due.
Reduce the healing or Temporary HP gained by an amount equal to 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
If this reduces the healing or Temporary HP to 0, choose one:
you regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus, not exceeding your maximum CP;
one Death servant you control regains HP equal to the prevented amount;
the target gains a Grave Mark until the end of your next turn;
the target cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn.
Using this talent to feed on the desperate, wounded, or dying is considered forbidden in most orthodox traditions.
TAL_DEATH_HARVEST_THE_FALLEN:
#### Harvest the Fallen - Withering, Corpse
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within 60 feet dies or drops to 0 HP
Cost: 2 CP
You catch the released grave Qi before it scatters.
Choose one:
regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus, not exceeding your maximum CP;
one Death servant you control regains HP equal to 2 x your CL;
immediately move one Death servant you control up to its Speed;
apply a Grave Mark to one creature within 30 feet of the fallen creature;
preserve the corpse for 24 hours as if with Funerary Preservation.
You cannot use this talent on the same creature more than once.
Using Harvest the Fallen on an ally, innocent, ancestor, or protected foe may carry social or karmic consequences.
TAL_DEATH_LESSER_CORPSE_SERVANT_STAT_BLO:
#### Lesser Corpse Servant Stat Block
Creature Type: Undead
Size: Medium or Small, matching the corpse when possible
AC: 10 + your Proficiency Bonus
HP: 3 x your CL + your key ability modifier
Speed: 25 feet
Damage Immunities: Poison
Condition Immunities: Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned
Senses: passive Perception 8 + your Proficiency Bonus
Languages: understands your commands; cannot speak unless a feature says otherwise
Grave Strike: Melee attack using your Cultivation Attack Modifier, reach 5 feet, one target.
Hit: 1d6 + your key ability modifier Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Necrotic damage.
Inert Servant: If not commanded, the servant takes the Dodge action.
TAL_DEATH_MARK_FOR_THE_GRAVE:
#### Mark for the Grave - Withering
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 2 CP
Choose one creature within range. It bears your Grave Mark.
The first time each turn the marked creature takes Necrotic damage from you or one of your Death servants, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll.
While marked, the target also has Disadvantage on the first death saving throw it makes during the duration.
A creature can bear only one Grave Mark from you at a time.
TAL_DEATH_MORTALITY_SEAL:
#### Mortality Seal - Withering
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 6 CP
Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: For the duration, the target suffers all of the following:
it cannot regain HP;
it cannot gain Temporary HP;
regeneration is suppressed;
the first death-prevention effect that would keep it above 0 HP during the duration is suppressed until the start of its next turn.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: Healing the target receives is halved until the start of your next turn.
Mortality Seal does not suppress Secret Inheritances, divine protections, artifact immortality, or story-scale resurrection clauses unless the GM permits an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_DEATH_NO_RETURN_EDICT:
#### No Return Edict - Withering
Prerequisite: Mortality Seal, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 12d10 Necrotic damage. Until the end of your next turn, it cannot regain HP, cannot gain Temporary HP, and cannot benefit from an effect that would prevent it from dropping to 0 HP.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage, and healing it receives is halved until the start of your next turn.
If the creature dies from this damage, ordinary revival fails until the next dawn. The soul remains intact unless another effect says otherwise.
Legendary, Secret, divine, artifact, or story-scale resurrection may require an opposed Cultivation Check rather than being automatically stopped.
TAL_DEATH_QUIET_BURIAL:
#### Quiet Burial - Rite
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action or Ritual
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=RITUAL_BURIAL_RITE
Range: Touch
Target: One corpse, undead remains, haunted object, or grave site
Cost: 1 CP
You perform a swift burial mudra, closing minor death echoes.
Choose one effect:
end one ordinary haunting attached to a corpse or grave object;
prevent one corpse from being animated for 24 hours;
cause one destroyed undead creature’s remains to become spiritually quiet;
grant Advantage on one check made within the next hour to track a ghost, murderer, or necromancer through death residue;
let one dying creature within reach immediately make a death saving throw with Advantage.
This does not destroy a soul or defeat a powerful curse by itself.
TAL_DEATH_ROTTING_GRASP:
#### Rotting Grasp - Withering
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Range: Melee reach
Cost: 1 CP
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action.
Make a melee Cultivation Attack roll against one creature or unattended nonmagical object.
Hit: The target takes your Withering Hand damage. If the target is a creature, it also has Disadvantage on the next Strength saving throw or Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.
If the target is an unattended nonmagical object made of wood, cloth, leather, bone, rope, paper, or other decaying material, you may instead deal maximum damage to the object.
TAL_DEATH_ROUSE_LESSER_DEAD:
#### Rouse Lesser Dead
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One Common corpse or suitable set of remains
Duration: 8 hours, or until the servant is destroyed or dismissed
Cost: 1 CP
Control Load: 1
Requirement: You must have enough unused Death Control Limit to maintain the servant, and the target must be a legal corpse under the Corpse Availability rules.
You animate the target with grave Qi as one Lesser Corpse Servant. It appears in the corpse's space with full Hit Points and uses the Lesser Corpse Servant stat block below.
The servant is one undead asset. It counts against your Death Control Limit, acts immediately after your turn, and is commanded according to Commanding Death Servants. If it is not commanded, it takes the Dodge action and moves only as permitted by those rules.
A Lesser Corpse Servant does not contain the original soul unless another talent says so. It can follow simple commands, perform labor, carry objects, open doors, keep watch, pull carts, dig, clean, guard a threshold, or fight if commanded.
You may maintain only one Lesser Corpse Servant created by this base ability at a time. You may dismiss that servant without taking an action on your turn. If you complete this ritual while one of your Lesser Corpse Servants from this ability still exists, the earlier servant must be dismissed before the new one is created.
If the corpse is protected, sacred, claimed, preserved, or socially taboo, animating it may be impossible without a rite, permission, or a successful opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_DEATH_SOUL_FUNERAL:
#### Soul Funeral - Ghost, Rite
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One ghost, undead creature, possessing entity, or soul-bound creature
Cost: 5 CP
You perform a funeral strike, not merely an attack.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 6d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage, your choice, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. If it is possessing another creature, it is forced out into the nearest unoccupied space it can occupy.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage.
At CL 17, the damage becomes 8d8.
Soul Funeral does not destroy a soul automatically. It ends a possession, damages a spiritual entity, or forces a ghost to confront the rite of departure.
TAL_DEATH_SOUL_HOOK:
#### Soul Hook - Ghost, Forbidden
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one ghost, possessing spirit, incorporeal undead, or soul-bound creature within range. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is hooked by grave chains. Its Speed is reduced to 0, and it cannot willingly move more than 10 feet from the space it occupied when it failed the save. If it is possessing another creature, the possessed creature gains Advantage on saving throws against the possession.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Soul Hook restrains movement; it does not grant ownership of the soul. Talents that enslave souls should remain rare, Forbidden, and campaign-facing.
TAL_DEATH_SOUL_TREASURY:
#### Soul Treasury - Ghost, Forbidden
Prerequisite: Soul Hook, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within 60 feet dies
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You seize the soul at the threshold and place it in a temporary grave treasury.
The soul is not destroyed, but it cannot pass onward, be resurrected, be questioned by others, or be claimed by ordinary effects while held.
During the duration, you may ask the soul up to three questions as if using Speak with the Departed, except the soul may resist with a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC for each question. On a success, it refuses that question.
At the end of the duration, the soul is released unless you perform a longer campaign-facing forbidden rite.
This talent is almost always forbidden unless used as emergency protection against a worse soul-consuming effect.
TAL_DEATH_SPEAK_WITH_THE_DEPARTED:
#### Speak with the Departed - Rite, Ghost
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One corpse, skull, grave marker, funerary tablet, or lingering death echo
Cost: 1 CP
You ask up to three brief questions of the dead or the death-imprint attached to the remains.
The answer is limited to what the creature knew in life, what the corpse experienced near death, what the lingering ghost remembers, or what the remains spiritually recorded.
The dead may answer in words, images, gestures, smells, cold, blood patterns, grave insects, flickering lantern light, or other signs.
The effect may fail or become unclear if:
the corpse is too damaged;
the soul has passed beyond reach;
the corpse is protected by rites;
another Death cultivator has sealed it;
the dead refuse to speak;
the question concerns secrets protected by stronger spiritual law.
TAL_DEATH_THRONE_OF_BORROWED_BONES:
#### Throne of Borrowed Bones - Corpse, Command
Prerequisite: Bone General, CL 15+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Choose one Corpse Servant or Grave Formation you control within 60 feet.
For the duration, you may perceive through it and speak through it. Once during each of your turns, when you use Withering Hand or a Death talent with range other than Self, you may originate it from that undead asset instead of yourself.
If the undead asset is destroyed, the effect ends and you take Psychic damage equal to your CL.
TAL_DEATH_WITHERING_FIELD:
#### Withering Field - Withering, Domain
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 4 CP
You open a field of grave frost, ash rain, pale insects, black flowers, or deathly silence.
When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 3d6 Necrotic damage and healing it receives is halved until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
At CL 11, the damage becomes 5d6. At CL 17, the damage becomes 7d6.
TAL_DEATH_WITHERING_HAND:
#### Withering Hand
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Special Attack or Action
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=MELEE_ATTACK_REPLACEMENT->action, RANGED_ACTION->action
Range: Melee reach or 60 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: None
You strike with grave Qi, either through a touch, weapon, talisman, funerary seal, or bolt of pale force.
When you take the Attack action, you may replace one attack with Withering Hand, making a Cultivation Attack roll against one creature within melee reach. Alternatively, you may use an Action to make a ranged Cultivation Attack roll against one creature within 60 feet.
Hit: The target takes Necrotic damage based on your CL.
CL 1-4: 1d8 Necrotic damage.
CL 5-10: 2d8 Necrotic damage.
CL 11-16: 3d8 Necrotic damage.
CL 17-20: 4d8 Necrotic damage.
Once per turn when you hit a creature with Withering Hand, healing the target receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn.
This healing reduction applies once to each healing event. It does not reduce healing below 0.
