TAL_DESTRUCTION_DESTRUCTIVE_BLAST:
#### Destructive Blast
Base Sphere Ability
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature or object
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 0 CP
You release cultivated destruction against one creature or object within range.
Choose one Blast Type talent you possess. You may also apply no more than one Blast Shape talent you possess.
If you do not apply a Blast Shape talent, release an unshaped blast:
make one ranged Cultivation Attack against one creature or object within range;
on a hit, the target takes your Destructive Blast damage and suffers any applicable effects of the selected Blast Type.
If you know no other Blast Type, you use Unadorned Ruin.
TAL_DREAM_DREAM_MIRROR:
#### Dream Mirror - Lucid Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet targets you with Charmed, Frightened, Psychic damage, Dream Sleep, nightmare, or mental intrusion
Cost: 3 CP
The attacker makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
the triggering effect fails against you;
the attacker takes 3d8 Psychic damage;
the attacker becomes Drowsy until the start of its next turn;
the attacker has Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Reduce Psychic damage from the triggering effect by half.
TAL_DREAM_DREAM_NEEDLE:
#### Dream Needle - Unique Dreams Talent
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Release a sharpened symbolic impression.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Deal Psychic damage equal to the dice below for your Cultivation Level + your Path key ability modifier.
| Cultivation Level | Dream Needle Damage |
| --- | ---: |
| CL 1-4 | 1d8 Psychic |
| CL 5-10 | 2d8 Psychic |
| CL 11-16 | 3d8 Psychic |
| CL 17-20 | 4d8 Psychic |
Once per turn on a hit, choose one:
the target becomes Drowsy until the start of your next turn;
learn the target’s strongest current emotion;
plant Dream Seed until the start of your next turn;
the target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against Frightened before the start of your next turn.
TAL_DREAM_DREAM_PRISON:
#### Dream Prison - Slumber Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target becomes trapped in a looping waking dream:
Speed becomes 0;
cannot take Reactions;
cannot willingly target creatures more than 10 feet away;
repeats the saving throw at the end of each turn.
Successful Save: Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the saving throw with Advantage.
TAL_DREAM_DREAM_WARD:
#### Dream Ward - Lucid Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet makes a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Dream Sleep, nightmare, memory intrusion, or Psychic damage
Cost: 1 CP
Add your Proficiency Bonus to the saving throw result.
You may use Dream Ward after seeing the roll but before knowing the outcome.
TAL_DREAM_FALSE_AWAKENING:
#### False Awakening - Slumber Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature bearing your Dream Seed succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Dreams talents
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per round
The target makes a second Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It becomes Drowsy until the start of its next turn and cannot take Reactions.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
False Awakening does not cause the original failed talent to take effect.
TAL_DREAM_HALF_WAKING_HAZE:
#### Half-Waking Haze - Dreamscape Talent
Cost: 1 CP
A hostile creature entering the Dreamscape for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.
TAL_DREAM_LUCID_ESCAPE:
#### Lucid Escape - Lucid Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You fail a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Dream Sleep, Illusion, mental control, nightmare, or Psychic damage
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Choose one:
succeed on the saving throw instead;
reduce Psychic damage to 0;
end one ordinary Dreams or Illusion effect affecting you;
move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks after the triggering effect resolves.
TAL_DREAM_LUCID_VEIL:
#### Lucid Veil - Dreamscape Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Cost: 3 CP
Inside the Dreamscape:
##### Allies
gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, and Dream Sleep;
may communicate through brief symbolic impressions;
gain Advantage on checks made to recognize Illusions and mental influence.
##### Enemies A hostile creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom (Perception) check before the start of its next turn.
TAL_DREAM_NIGHTMARE_CHAIN:
#### Nightmare Chain - Nightmare Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: At the start of each of its turns, the target suffers all of the following effects:
- takes Psychic damage according to your Cultivation Level;
- becomes Drowsy until the start of its next turn;
- has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the end of that turn.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Initial Save: The target takes the Nightmare Chain damage once and suffers no ongoing effect.
| Cultivation Level | Nightmare Chain Damage |
| --- | ---: |
| CL 5-10 | 2d8 Psychic |
| CL 11-16 | 3d8 Psychic |
| CL 17-20 | 4d8 Psychic |
TAL_DREAM_NIGHTMARE_GLIMPSE:
#### Nightmare Glimpse - Nightmare Talent
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 2 CP
Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed or currently Drowsy.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Psychic damage according to your Cultivation Level and become Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half as much Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
| Cultivation Level | Nightmare Glimpse Damage |
| --- | ---: |
| CL 1-4 | 2d6 Psychic |
| CL 5-10 | 3d6 Psychic |
| CL 11-16 | 4d6 Psychic |
| CL 17-20 | 5d6 Psychic |
TAL_DREAM_SLEEP:
#### Sleep - Slumber Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed or currently Drowsy.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Enter Dream Sleep. Repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn.
The creature awakens early if it takes damage or another creature uses an Action to awaken it.
TAL_DREAM_WAKING_DREAM_PASSAGE:
#### Waking Dream Passage - Unique Dreams Talent
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 4 CP
Step through a moment of unreality.
Teleport into one visible unoccupied space inside:
one Dreamscape you created;
your Dreams Domain;
the space of a sleeping willing creature;
a prepared dream-road anchor. Waking Dream Passage cannot cross a Dimensional Lock, sealed barrier, or planar boundary.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_ACCIDENTAL_COUNTER:
### Accidental Counter - Counter
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack
Make one Unarmed Strike using the Damage option or one improvised melee weapon attack against the triggering creature.
If the triggering creature was Off-Rhythm from you, you gain Advantage on this attack.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_ACCIDENTAL_WEAPON:
### Accidental Weapon - Improvised
You are proficient with improvised weapons used as part of Drunken Style talents.
When you hit with an improvised weapon as part of Broken-Rhythm Strike, the weapon’s damage die becomes 1d6 unless it would already be higher.
After the attack resolves, you may drop, toss, kick, or stow the improvised object with no Action required.
This talent does not make the object magical or grant a weapon mastery property.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_AFTERIMAGE_SWAY:
### Afterimage Sway - Chaos-Step, Sway
When you use Swaying Guard, you may use it against spell attacks, Cultivation Attack rolls, ranged weapon attacks, and spiritual attacks that require an attack roll.
If the triggering attack misses, a faint afterimage remains until the start of your next turn. The next attack roll against you before then has Disadvantage if the attacker is within 30 feet and can perceive the afterimage.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_BORROWED_MISFORTUNE:
### Borrowed Misfortune - Counter
Prerequisite: CL 11+
When a hostile creature you can see within 60 feet rolls a natural 1 on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you may use your Reaction.
Choose another hostile creature within 30 feet of the triggering creature. That creature becomes Off-Rhythm from you and has Disadvantage on the next D20 Test it makes before the start of your next turn.
If the triggering creature was already Off-Rhythm from you, you regain Martial Focus.
This talent does not cause automatic failure beyond the original natural 1.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_BORROWED_MOMENTUM:
### Borrowed Momentum - Rhythm
When you hit an Off-Rhythm creature with an Unarmed Strike or melee weapon attack, you may move the target 5 feet into a legal unoccupied space.
The target must end on a surface that can support it. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
If the target cannot be moved, you may instead move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_BROKEN_GOURD_RECOVERY:
### Broken Gourd Recovery - Sway
When you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you may expend Martial Focus to reroll the saving throw. You must use the new result.
If the new result succeeds, you may move up to 10 feet to a legal space. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_BROKEN_RHYTHM_STRIKE:
### Broken-Rhythm Strike
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Range: Weapon reach or unarmed reach
Cost: None
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action.
Make an Unarmed Strike using the Damage option, an improvised melee weapon attack, or a melee weapon attack.
Hit: The attack deals normal damage, and the target becomes Off-Rhythm from you until the start of your next turn.
Miss by 5 or Less: You may choose to create a False Opening for the target. If you do, the target becomes Off-Rhythm from you immediately after it next attacks you before the start of your next turn.
Miss by More than 5: No effect.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_CHAOS_STEP_AWAKENING:
### Chaos-Step Awakening - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your broken rhythm becomes openly supernatural.
Gain the following benefits:
Reeling Step increases to 20 feet.
You may use Reeling Step along walls, railings, ropes, furniture, branches, or unstable surfaces during the movement, provided you end on a surface that can support you.
Your Drunken Style talents can affect creatures that perceive by blindsight, tremorsense, lifesense, spiritual perception, or similar senses, provided they perceive timing, motion, pressure, or intent.
Once per turn, when an Off-Rhythm creature misses you with an attack, you may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
Chaos-Step Awakening does not grant flight, teleportation, phasing, immunity to falling, or movement through sealed Barriers.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_COURT_OF_BROKEN_RHYTHM:
### Court of Broken Rhythm - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 11+, Chaos-Step Awakening
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a court of staggering steps, delayed Qi, laughing feints, and impossible recovery angles.
For the duration:
Reeling Step does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from any creature currently Off-Rhythm from you.
The first time each round a hostile creature in the Domain misses you or an ally with an attack roll, that creature becomes Off-Rhythm from you.
Once on each of your turns, you may use Reeling Step without spending a Bonus Action.
When you use Swaying Guard inside the Domain and the attack misses, you may move up to 15 feet instead of 5 feet.
Once per round when a hostile Off-Rhythm creature in the Domain misses an attack roll, you may redirect that attack to another legal target inside the Domain, comparing the original attack roll to the new target’s AC.
Allies of your choice inside the Domain may move 5 feet when an Off-Rhythm creature misses them with an attack roll. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature.
The Domain moves with you. It does not create physical cover, difficult terrain, or a Barrier.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_CROOKED_CUP_PROCESSION:
### Crooked-Cup Procession - Domain
Prerequisite: Court of Broken Rhythm
While your Court of Broken Rhythm is active, your Reeling Step may move through the spaces of hostile creatures that are no more than one size larger than you.
Each hostile creature whose space you pass through must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It becomes Off-Rhythm from you and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It becomes Off-Rhythm from you but keeps its Reactions.
A creature can be affected by this talent only once per turn.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_CROOKED_ORBIT_STEP:
### Crooked Orbit Step - Chaos-Step, Rhythm
When you hit an Off-Rhythm creature with Broken-Rhythm Strike, you may force it to make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: You and the target exchange spaces if both spaces are legal. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Successful Save: You may move 10 feet around the target to a legal space you can see. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the target.
You cannot exchange spaces with a creature more than one size larger than you unless the GM decides the terrain and fiction make it possible.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_DRUNKEN_MONKEY_THEFT_O:
### Drunken Monkey Theft of Balance - Rhythm
When you hit an Off-Rhythm creature with an Unarmed Strike or improvised weapon attack, you may choose not to deal damage.
If you do, the target must make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Prone, cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn, and you may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it.
Successful Save: The target becomes Off-Rhythm from you and cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_DRUNKEN_STYLE_TRAINING:
### Drunken Style Training
When you first gain the Drunken Style sphere, you gain proficiency in either Acrobatics or Performance.
If you are already proficient in both, choose one Mortal Realm Drunken Style talent instead.
You also gain Reeling Step and Swaying Guard.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_FALLING_LEAF_DROP:
### Falling-Leaf Drop - Sway
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature more than 5 feet away makes a ranged attack roll against you
You may drop Prone before the attack resolves.
If dropping Prone would impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack under the ordinary Prone rules, apply that Disadvantage.
If the attack misses, you may stand from Prone immediately by spending 5 feet of movement, instead of half your Speed. If you have no movement remaining, you remain Prone.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_FALSE_FALL_TRUE_ESCAPE:
### False Fall, True Escape - Chaos-Step
When a creature hits you with an attack while you are Prone or while you are falling, you may expend Martial Focus as a Reaction.
Reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Drunken Style key ability modifier.
You may then move up to 15 feet to a legal space you can see. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
If this movement ends the fall on a surface that can support you, you land without taking falling damage for the distance moved by this talent.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_IMPOSSIBLE_ANGLE_COUNT:
### Impossible Angle Counter - Counter, Chaos-Step
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet misses an attack roll against you or an ally
Move up to 20 feet to a legal space within reach of the triggering creature. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature.
Then make one Unarmed Strike, improvised weapon attack, or melee weapon attack against it.
If the triggering creature was Off-Rhythm from you, the attack has Advantage.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_LAUGHING_AT_CERTAIN_DE:
### Laughing at Certain Death - Counter
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: An attack roll hits you, or you fail a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You turn a doomed beat into a ridiculous angle.
If the trigger is an attack roll, force the attacker to reroll the attack with Disadvantage. If the rerolled attack misses, you may redirect it to another legal target within its reach or range.
If the trigger is a failed Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw, reroll the saving throw with Advantage. If the new result succeeds, you may move up to half your Speed after the effect resolves. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
A Legendary, Secret Inheritance, or comparable apex effect may require an opposed Cultivation Check instead of being automatically affected.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_LAUGHING_QI_MISDIRECTI:
### Laughing Qi Misdirection - Counter, Chaos-Step
When an Off-Rhythm creature misses you with an attack roll, you may expend Martial Focus as a Reaction.
Choose another legal target within the attack’s reach or range. Compare the original attack roll to the new target’s AC.
If the original attack roll would hit the new target, the attack hits that target instead.
If no legal target exists, you may instead move 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_LOOSE_CUP_FOOTWORK:
### Loose-Cup Footwork - Rhythm
Increase the movement granted by Reeling Step by 5 feet.
During this movement, you may move through nonmagical difficult terrain without spending extra movement.
If you end Reeling Step adjacent to a creature that failed its saving throw against Reeling Step, you gain Advantage on the next Broken-Rhythm Strike you make against that creature before the end of your turn.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_LUCKY_LOOKING_MISS:
### Lucky-Looking Miss - Counter
When you miss a creature with Broken-Rhythm Strike by 5 or less and create a False Opening, you regain Martial Focus if you did not already have it.
If the target attacks you before the start of your next turn and misses, you gain Advantage on the next attack roll you make against it before the end of your next turn.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_NO_PATTERN_TO_COUNTER:
### No Pattern to Counter - Sway
Prerequisite: CL 15+
While holding Martial Focus, you gain Advantage on saving throws and ability checks made to resist effects that predict, read, lock, trace, or punish your movement pattern.
Examples include divinations that read your next step, techniques that trigger when you repeat an attack pattern, stances that punish direct approach, and formation effects that require a stable movement path.
This talent does not block ordinary sight, blindsight, tremorsense, true seeing, or a creature simply watching you. It protects against predictive control, not perception itself.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_OPEN_PALM_CLOSED_DOOR:
### Open Palm, Closed Door - Rhythm
When you hit a creature with Broken-Rhythm Strike, you may choose not to deal damage.
If you do, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn, and it becomes Off-Rhythm from you.
Successful Save: The target becomes Off-Rhythm from you, but it can still take Reactions.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_REELING_STEP:
### Reeling Step
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Cost: None
You move up to 10 feet in a loose, swaying, indirect, or foolish-looking path.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see.
Before or after this movement, choose one creature within 10 feet that can see you. That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Drunken Style Save DC.
Failed Save: The creature becomes Off-Rhythm from you until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature is not Off-Rhythm, but it cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you during the movement granted by this Reeling Step.
You cannot use Reeling Step if your Speed is 0.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_SLAPSTICK_ESCAPE:
### Slapstick Escape - Sway
When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
If the attacker was Off-Rhythm from you, you may move 10 feet instead.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_SLEEVE_BOWL_AND_BOOT:
### Sleeve, Bowl, and Boot - Improvised
When you use Reeling Step, you may draw or pick up one unattended Tiny or Small mundane object within your reach as part of the same Bonus Action.
Until the end of your turn, you may use that object as an improvised weapon for Drunken Style talents.
The object must be something you can plausibly manipulate with one hand, foot, sleeve, hip, or shoulder.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_SLIPPING_PALM:
### Slipping Palm - Rhythm
When you hit an Off-Rhythm creature with Broken-Rhythm Strike, you may force it to make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
push the target 5 feet;
knock the target Prone if it is no more than one size larger than you;
move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
Successful Save: You may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_SOVEREIGN_CHAOS_STEP_I:
### Sovereign Chaos-Step Incarnation - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of Broken Rhythm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You manifest the sovereign body of impossible imbalance: a laughing silhouette, a robe of false falls, footsteps that land before your weight moves, afterimages in collapsing postures, or a soul that sways half a heartbeat outside the world’s rhythm.
For the duration:
You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can Hover, but only while moving in visibly irregular, swaying, or broken paths.
Reeling Step increases to 30 feet.
You may move through hostile creatures’ spaces, though you cannot end in them.
You do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures Off-Rhythm from you.
Once per round, you may use Swaying Guard without spending your Reaction or Martial Focus.
You gain one additional Reaction each round, which can be used only for Drunken Style talents.
The first time each round you would be hit by an attack roll from an Off-Rhythm creature, you may force that attack to be rerolled. The attacker must use the new result.
When a creature misses you by 5 or more, it becomes Off-Rhythm from you until the end of your next turn.
This incarnation does not grant random luck, immunity to damage, teleportation, or the ability to ignore sealed Barriers.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_STAGGERING_SHOVE:
### Staggering Shove - Rhythm
When you use the Shove option of Unarmed Strike against an Off-Rhythm creature, the target has Disadvantage on its saving throw.
If the Shove succeeds, you may also move 5 feet into a legal space. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the shoved creature.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_STRIKE_FROM_THE_MISSIN:
### Strike From the Missing Step - Counter, Chaos-Step
Prerequisite: CL 15+
When a creature within 60 feet that is Off-Rhythm from you misses an attack roll, fails a saving throw, or fails an ability check, you may expend Martial Focus as a Reaction.
Move up to your Speed to a legal space within reach of that creature. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Then make one Broken-Rhythm Strike against the creature. On a hit, the attack deals an additional 3d10 damage of the attack’s type, and the target cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_STUMBLE_THROUGH_BLADES:
### Stumble Through Blades - Chaos-Step
During Reeling Step, you may move through the space of one hostile creature that is no more than one size larger than you.
That creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It becomes Off-Rhythm from you, and this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from it.
Successful Save: You may still move through its space, but the movement provokes Opportunity Attacks normally unless another feature prevents them.
You cannot end your movement in another creature’s space.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_SWAYING_GUARD:
### Swaying Guard
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see makes an attack roll against you
Cost: None
You loosen your body, slip the line, lean late, or let the strike pass through the place you appeared to occupy.
Use Swaying Guard in one of the following ways:
If the attacker is Off-Rhythm from you, impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll.
If you moved at least 5 feet since the end of your last turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against the triggering attack.
You choose after seeing the attack roll but before knowing whether the attack hits or misses.
If the triggering attack misses, you may move 5 feet. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering attacker.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Swaying Guard without spending your Reaction. Once you do so, you cannot use Swaying Guard again until the start of your next turn.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_THE_FLOOR_BETRAYS_YOU:
### The Floor Betrays You - Rhythm
Prerequisite: CL 11+
When you hit an Off-Rhythm creature with Broken-Rhythm Strike, you may expend Martial Focus.
The target must make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Prone and Dazed until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target is Prone, or it is Dazed until the start of your next turn, your choice.
Dazed is a Tianxia custom restriction. A Dazed creature cannot take Reactions and may take either an Action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_THE_WORLD_SWINGS_WIDE:
### The World Swings Wide - Domain, Chaos-Step
Prerequisite: Court of Broken Rhythm, CL 15+
When your Court of Broken Rhythm is active, hostile creatures inside the Domain cannot gain Advantage on attack rolls against you unless they are immune to being Off-Rhythm from you or the Advantage comes from a Secret Inheritance, Legendary action, Lair action, or comparable apex effect.
In addition, once during each of your turns while the Domain is active, you may choose one Off-Rhythm creature inside the Domain. Until the start of your next turn, attacks made by that creature cannot score critical hits against you or allies of your choice inside the Domain.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_THOUSAND_MISTAKE_PARAD:
### Thousand-Mistake Parade - Domain, Rhythm
Prerequisite: Court of Broken Rhythm
When you hit an Off-Rhythm creature inside your Court of Broken Rhythm, you may choose a second hostile creature inside the Domain that can see either you or the target.
The second creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It becomes Off-Rhythm from you and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It becomes Off-Rhythm from you.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_TOO_FOOLISH_TO_PIN:
### Too Foolish to Pin - Rhythm
You have Advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Grappled condition if the creature attempting to Grapple you is Off-Rhythm from you.
When you escape a Grapple, you may use Reeling Step as part of the same Action, but only to move away from the creature whose Grapple ended.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_UNRELIABLE_CENTER_STAN:
### Unreliable Center Stance - Sway
Prerequisite: CL 11+
While you are holding Martial Focus, creatures do not gain Advantage on attack rolls against you merely because you are Grappled, Prone, Restrained by a nonmagical effect, squeezing, or balancing on unstable footing.
This does not remove those conditions or prevent Advantage from other sources.
When an attack against you would have Advantage from one of those listed circumstances, you may expend Martial Focus to cause the attack to be made without Advantage.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_WRONG_HAND_STRIKE:
### Wrong-Hand Strike - Rhythm
When you use Broken-Rhythm Strike with an Unarmed Strike, improvised melee weapon, or melee weapon without the Heavy property, you may use Dexterity instead of Strength for the attack and damage roll.
If another feature already allows you to use a different ability modifier, choose which legal modifier to use when you make the attack.
TAL_DRUNKEN_STYLE_WRONG_TARGET_RIGHT_LES:
### Wrong Target, Right Lesson - Counter
When a creature attacks you while affected by your False Opening and misses, you may expend Martial Focus.
Choose one creature other than you within the triggering attack’s reach or range. Compare the original attack roll to the new target’s AC.
If the original attack roll would hit the new target, the attack hits that target instead.
The new target must be a legal target for the original attack. You cannot redirect an area effect, a self-targeting effect, or an attack whose source cannot plausibly be misaligned.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_CRITICAL_FOLLOW_UP:
#### Critical Follow-Up - Rhythm
Your Paired Strike scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
Critical Follow-Up applies only to the Paired Strike. It does not change the Critical Hit range of your other attacks.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_CYCLONE_CUT:
#### Cyclone Cut - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Dual Wielding sphere, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Requirement: Wielding a Qualifying Pair
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Area: 15-foot Emanation originating from you
Twirl your paired weapons with enough force and precision to create a damaging cyclone of air.
Each other creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Roll the normal weapon damage die of each weapon in your Qualifying Pair once and add the results together.
Failed Save: The creature takes Bludgeoning damage equal to the total.
Successful Save: The creature takes half as much damage.
Cyclone Cut does not add:
your ability modifier;
magic-item bonuses to damage;
extra damage dice;
Weapon Mastery effects;
Pair talents;
on-hit riders from either weapon.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_DANCING_DISPLAY:
#### Dancing Display - Pair
When your Paired Strike hits a creature, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature for the rest of the current turn.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_DEFENSIVE_WHIRL:
#### Defensive Whirl - Pair
Trigger: Your Paired Strike hits a creature.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Until the end of that creature’s next turn, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_DIZZYING_COMBINATION:
#### Dizzying Combination - Pair
Trigger: Your Paired Strike hits a creature.
Use Limit: Once per turn.
The target must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: Each of the target’s Speeds is halved for 1 minute.
Successful Save: No effect.
At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_FOCUSING_DEFENSE:
#### Focusing Defense - Guard
When you take the Dodge action while wielding a Qualifying Pair, the AC bonus from Balanced Defense increases from +1 to +3 until the start of your next turn.
If you cease wielding a Qualifying Pair, you lose this increased bonus until you again satisfy the requirement.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_HIGH_LOW_COMBINATION:
#### High-Low Combination - Rhythm
Trigger: During your turn, you hit the same creature with your Lead Weapon and your Answering Weapon.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Use Limit: Once per turn.
Immediately after resolving the second hit, make one Unarmed Strike against that creature using only the Shove option. This requires no additional action.
Use the ordinary 5.5e Shove rules, including the target’s size limit and choice of Strength or Dexterity saving throw.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_PAIRED_RHYTHM:
#### Paired Rhythm
Once per turn, when you hit one or more creatures with both weapons from your Qualifying Pair during the same turn, regain Martial Focus.
The two hits may target the same creature or different creatures.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_PERFECT_SET_UP:
#### Perfect Set-Up - Pair
When you would make your Paired Strike, replace it with the Help action’s Assist an Attack Roll option.
Choose one enemy within 5 feet of you. The next attack roll made by one of your allies against that enemy has Advantage. This benefit expires at the start of your next turn.
Perfect Set-Up does not allow you to use the Help action’s ability-check option through this talent.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_SYNCHRONOUS_ACCURACY:
#### Synchronous Accuracy - Pair
Trigger: During your Attack action, an attack with your Lead Weapon misses and you are eligible to make a Paired Strike.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Use Limit: Once per turn.
When you make your Paired Strike, make two attacks with your Answering Weapon instead of one.
Resolve both attacks as part of the same Bonus Action, or as part of the same Attack action if the Paired Strike was moved into that action by Ambidexterity or Nick.
You may apply one Pair talent to each of these attacks, but the two Pair talents must be different.
The second attack:
does not add a positive ability modifier to damage unless another rule explicitly permits it;
counts as a Paired Strike for the Pair talent attached to it;
does not allow a third Pair talent during the same turn.
TAL_DUAL_WIELDING_THREE_SWORD_STYLE:
#### Three-Sword Style - Unique Dual Wielding Talent
Prerequisite: Dual Wielding sphere, CL 5+
You learn to wield a third weapon.
If you possess an additional hand, tail, prehensile limb, telekinetic grip, or another explicitly approved method, you may use it to wield the third weapon.
If you possess no such method, you may wield the third weapon in your teeth.
The third weapon must be a one-handed melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property.
While holding a weapon in your teeth:
you cannot provide Verbal spell components;
you cannot speak clearly;
you cannot make an ability check that requires clear speech or singing;
you may still communicate in a garbled fashion when the GM determines that communication is possible.
##### Third Strike
Trigger: You make your Paired Strike while wielding a third weapon.
Cost: Expend your Reaction.
Use Limit: Once per turn.
Make one additional melee weapon attack with the third weapon as part of the same Bonus Action, or as part of the same Attack action if the Paired Strike was moved into that action by Ambidexterity or Nick.
The Third Strike:
does not add a positive ability modifier to damage unless another rule explicitly permits it;
is not a Paired Strike;
cannot receive a Pair talent;
cannot be used if your Reaction is unavailable.
TAL_EARTH_BURDEN_THE_BLADE:
### Burden the Blade - Earth Response, Burden
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a marked creature hits with a weapon attack, spend its Burden Mark.
The target of the attack gains Resistance to the triggering attack’s Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
After the attack resolves, the attacker’s weapon, natural weapon, or striking limb becomes heavy with settling force. The attacker has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with the same weapon or limb before the end of its next turn.
TAL_EARTH_BURDEN_THE_FLYING_THING:
### Burden the Flying Thing - Burden, Projected
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You can make Earth answer a creature that tries to escape all ground.
When a creature with your Burden Mark flies, levitates, jumps, teleports, hovers, or is otherwise unsupported within 60 feet of a legal Earth surface, spend the mark.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It descends up to 30 feet toward the nearest legal Earth surface and cannot gain altitude until the start of its next turn. If it reaches a surface, it falls Prone.
Successful Save: It descends 10 feet and cannot gain altitude until the end of the current turn.
This talent does not affect creatures on another plane, creatures protected by a Realm technique that explicitly ignores grounding, or creatures whose flight is purely narrative scale unless the GM permits it.
Body Refiners require an external projection permission to use this talent unless the creature is within reach or the effect originates from a surface they touch.
TAL_EARTH_BURIED_FOUNDATION_REMEMBERS:
### Buried Foundation Remembers - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 12+
When a creature enters one of your Foundation Spaces, you may know whether that creature has entered that same space before within the last 24 hours.
If it has, you may give it one Burden Mark, no Action required.
You do not learn the creature’s thoughts, identity, name, alignment, or reason for returning.
Outside combat, you can spend 10 minutes reading a road, courtyard, campsite, tomb, gate, or battlefield. Ask the GM one of the following questions:
What kind of heavy movement passed here recently?
Was a group carrying wounded, treasure, prisoners, or bodies?
Did something burrow, land, flee, or fall here?
Was this ground deliberately concealed, packed, disturbed, or repaired?
The GM answers truthfully based on signs the ground could reasonably preserve.
TAL_EARTH_BURIED_TRACE:
### Buried Trace
When you spend 1 minute touching ground, you may erase or preserve tracks across a number of 5-foot spaces equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Earth key ability modifier.
Choose one:
erase tracks and surface signs, imposing Disadvantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to follow those tracks;
preserve tracks and surface signs, granting Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to study those signs for the next 24 hours.
Buried Trace does not hide scent, magic auras, blood inside a body, memories, or witness testimony.
TAL_EARTH_DEEP_ROOT_STANCE:
### Deep Root Stance - Body, Foundation
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
You treat your own space as a Foundation Space even if it would not otherwise count against your Foundation limit.
While Deep Root Stance lasts:
gain Advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to resist being moved or knocked Prone;
reduce forced movement against you by 5 feet;
if a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may give it one Burden Mark.
At CL 10, reduce forced movement against you by 10 feet instead.
TAL_EARTH_DOORSTONE_SEAL:
### Doorstone Seal - Foundation, Settlement
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 1 CP
Touch a door, gate, hatch, window, tunnel mouth, coffin, jar, chest, or similar opening set into a solid frame.
Earth pressure settles around it.
For the duration:
the opening cannot be opened by ordinary Strength checks unless the creature succeeds on a Strength check against your Earth Save DC;
creatures have Disadvantage on Dexterity checks made to pick or manipulate mundane locks on it;
if the opening is forced, broken, or magically bypassed, you know the seal was broken if you are within 1 mile and on the same plane.
Doorstone Seal does not prevent teleportation, planar travel, gaseous movement, incorporeal passage, or a creature already inside from breaking the object unless a feature says otherwise.
TAL_EARTH_EARTHBIND_LINE:
### Earthbind Line - Foundation, Burden
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet, subject to Path restrictions
Area: 20-foot line on a solid or earthen surface
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create a narrow Foundation line across the ground.
The line is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.
The first time on a turn that a hostile creature crosses the line, it gains one Burden Mark. If it already has your Burden Mark, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the turn.
TAL_EARTH_EARTHEN_HANDHOLD:
### Earthen Handhold - Foundation
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Touch, or 30 feet if Projected Earth is legal for you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: None
Choose one wall, cliff, slope, ceiling, tree-sized root mass, stone surface, or similar solid surface.
Small ridges, handholds, footholds, and packed ledges appear across one 10-foot square area.
Creatures climbing that area have Advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to climb, and a creature that falls from that area reduces its falling distance by 10 feet.
If used on hostile terrain, the GM may require a Cultivation Check against an environmental DC.
TAL_EARTH_EARTH_CARRIES_THE_FALLEN:
### Earth Carries the Fallen
Prerequisite: CL 15+
When a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points while touching a solid surface, use your Reaction and expend 5 CP.
The creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and is immediately moved up to 10 feet along the surface without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
The place where it would have fallen becomes a Foundation Space until the end of your next turn.
Use Earth Carries the Fallen once per long rest.
If the triggering damage was from a critical hit or a Secret Inheritance, the creature must also succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the attacker’s save DC or your Earth Save DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, it drops to 0 Hit Points as normal.
TAL_EARTH_EARTH_DOMAIN_COURT_OF_BEARING_:
### Earth Domain: Court of Bearing Ground
“In this court, even arrogance must stand somewhere.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you, subject to Path restrictions
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Tags: Domain, Foundation
You establish a court of bearing ground.
For the duration:
the area counts as your Foundation for Earth features;
hostile creatures treat nonmagical ground in the area as difficult terrain;
when a hostile creature willingly moves at least 10 feet while touching the area, it gains one Burden Mark;
you and willing creatures you choose have Advantage on saving throws against being moved or knocked Prone while touching the area;
once per round, when a hostile creature in the area spends a Burden Mark, takes the Dash action, flies upward from the ground, teleports from the area, or forces movement on another creature, you may use one Earth Response without expending a Burden Mark.
If your Earth is limited by Body Refining contact rules, the Domain must remain centered on you or on a surface you touch unless you have a feature that permits projected Domains.
TAL_EARTH_FURROW_SHIELD:
### Furrow Shield - Foundation, Earth Response
When you use Raise the Ridge, the ridge grants Three-Quarters Cover instead of Half Cover against the triggering attack or effect.
After granting this cover, the ridge crumbles unless you expend 1 CP. If you expend the CP, the ridge remains until the start of your next turn and counts as a 5-foot Foundation Space.
TAL_EARTH_HUMBLE_WALL:
### Humble Wall - Foundation, Settlement
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch, or 30 feet if Projected Earth is legal for you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Raise a low wall, berm, packed-earth screen, stone lip, or defensive ridge in up to two contiguous 5-foot spaces on a solid or earthen surface.
Each wall section is 5 feet long, 3 feet high, and 1 foot thick. It provides Half Cover to a Medium or smaller creature behind it. It has AC 12 and Hit Points equal to 10 + your Cultivation Level. It is immune to Poison and Psychic damage.
The wall does not block line of sight to Large or larger creatures unless the fiction and positioning make that reasonable.
At CL 5, you may create three sections. At CL 11, four sections. At CL 17, five sections.
TAL_EARTH_INCARNATION_OF_THE_PATIENT_MOU:
### Incarnation of the Patient Mountain
“The mountain did not rise to strike. It waited until the blow admitted that it needed a place to land.”
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Tags: Realm Evolution, Foundation
You embody the bearing mountain.
For the duration:
your space and all spaces within 10 feet of you count as Foundation Spaces that do not count against your Foundation limit;
you cannot be moved or knocked Prone against your will while touching a solid surface unless the effect is a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, or story-scale effect;
allies within 10 feet of you have Advantage on saving throws against being moved or knocked Prone;
once per round, when a hostile creature within 30 feet moves, attacks, casts a spell, uses a sphere talent, teleports, or forces movement, give it one Burden Mark;
when you spend a Burden Mark, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you move more than half your Speed during one turn, the emanation shrinks to your own space until the start of your next turn.
TAL_EARTH_LANDSLIDE_ARGUMENT:
### Landslide Argument - Earth Response, Burden
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a marked creature moves at least 10 feet downhill, across rubble, across your Foundation Spaces, or through terrain made difficult by your Earth features, spend its Burden Mark.
The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone, slides up to 15 feet in a direction you choose along the surface, and takes 3d8 Bludgeoning damage.
Successful Save: It does not fall Prone but still slides 5 feet.
The slide cannot move the creature into obviously lethal terrain unless the space was already hazardous and visible to it.
TAL_EARTH_LOAD_BEARING_BACK:
### Load-Bearing Back - Body
When you carry, drag, lift, shove, or support weight, treat your carrying capacity as doubled.
In combat, when an adjacent willing creature would be moved against its will, use your Reaction to reduce that movement by 10 feet. If you are in Deep Root Stance or standing on one of your Foundation Spaces, also give the source of the movement one Burden Mark if you can perceive it.
TAL_EARTH_MULE_SHOULDER_METHOD:
### Mule-Shoulder Method - Body
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you would suffer Exhaustion from forced marching, carrying extreme weight, digging, excavation, long labor, or environmental travel across earth or stone, make a Constitution saving throw against DC 10 + the number of hours of strain beyond the first.
On a success, you delay that Exhaustion until the next long rest. If you rest before gaining additional Exhaustion, it never applies.
In combat, once per short rest, when you would gain a Burden Mark, a Grappled condition, or be knocked Prone by an Earth, Stone, Force, or similar weight-based effect, ignore that mark or condition.
TAL_EARTH_OX_BEARING_FOUNDATION:
### Ox-Bearing Foundation - Body, Foundation
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Deep Root Stance, choose one willing creature within 5 feet of you.
Until the stance ends:
the chosen creature gains the same Advantage against being moved or knocked Prone;
when the chosen creature takes damage, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus if both of you are touching the same surface;
if the chosen creature is moved against its will, you may move 5 feet with it without provoking Opportunity Attacks, provided you end adjacent to it and on a legal surface.
TAL_EARTH_PACKED_ROAD_STEP:
### Packed Road Step - Foundation
Your movement through your own Foundation Spaces does not cost extra movement from nonmagical difficult terrain.
When you create Foundation Spaces with Set Foundation, choose one willing creature you can see. Until the start of your next turn, that creature also ignores nonmagical difficult terrain in those spaces.
At CL 5, choose two willing creatures. At CL 11, choose three.
TAL_EARTH_PATIENT_ROADMAKER:
### Patient Roadmaker - Foundation, Settlement
When you spend at least 1 minute using Earth cultivation outside combat, create a stable path through mud, rubble, shallow water, loose gravel, broken road, or similar terrain.
The path may cover a number of 5-foot spaces equal to 5 x your Cultivation Level.
For 1 hour, nonmagical difficult terrain in those spaces does not cost extra movement for creatures you choose.
Patient Roadmaker does not bridge empty air, cross deep chasms, safely tunnel through unstable structures, or create permanent roads unless the GM frames it as a project.
TAL_EARTH_PROVINCE_ROAD_SCRIPTURE:
### Province Road Scripture - Foundation, Settlement
Prerequisite: Patient Roadmaker, CL 10+
When using Patient Roadmaker, the path may cover a number of 5-foot spaces equal to 20 x your Cultivation Level and lasts for 24 hours.
During combat, as an Action and by expending 2 CP, create a road of packed earth, stable footing, stepping stones, or terrace lines up to 60 feet long and 10 feet wide on legal terrain within range.
For 1 minute:
willing creatures you choose ignore nonmagical difficult terrain on the road;
hostile creatures treat the road as difficult terrain;
the first hostile creature each round that moves 10 feet along the road gains a Burden Mark.
TAL_EARTH_RAISE_THE_LOAD_BEARING_WALL:
### Raise the Load-Bearing Wall - Foundation, Settlement
Prerequisite: Humble Wall, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch, or 60 feet if Projected Earth is legal for you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Raise a wall of packed earth, stone, clay, terrace-brick, or root-threaded ground.
Create up to six connected 5-foot wall sections. Each section is up to 10 feet high, 5 feet wide, and 1 foot thick.
Each section has AC 15, Hit Points equal to 20 + twice your Cultivation Level, and immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
A wall section provides Total Cover through its space and blocks movement through that space. It does not automatically block teleportation, planar travel, incorporeal movement, burrowing beneath it, or effects that do not physically cross the wall.
If created under a creature’s space, that creature chooses which side of the wall to occupy. This talent cannot trap a creature inside a wall.
TAL_EARTH_SEAL_THE_FAULT_BELOW:
### Seal the Fault Below
Prerequisite: Doorstone Seal, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Seal one tunnel, fissure, gate, tomb door, cave mouth, mine shaft, burrow route, sewer passage, planar fissure anchored in terrain, or similar passage no larger than a 20-foot cube.
For the duration:
ordinary movement cannot pass through the sealed passage;
burrowing through the sealed passage requires a Strength check against your Earth Save DC for every 5 feet of progress;
teleportation into or out of the sealed passage requires the user to succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Earth Save DC;
creatures attempting to damage the seal deal half damage to it unless they use Siege equipment, a relevant sphere talent, or a feature that damages objects or structures.
The seal has AC 17, Hit Points equal to 50 + five times your Cultivation Level, and immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
Seal the Fault Below does not permanently imprison creatures unless the story, terrain, and available resources support that consequence.
TAL_EARTH_SINK_THE_WHEEL_RUT:
### Sink the Wheel-Rut - Foundation
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet, subject to Path restrictions
Area: 15-foot square on a solid or earthen surface
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
The area becomes dragging earth, deep ruts, settling clay, ankle-deep mud, loose gravel, or pressure-heavy ground.
The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.
A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn, and it gains one Burden Mark.
Successful Save: It gains one Burden Mark only if it moves at least 10 feet inside the area before the end of the turn.
TAL_EARTH_STONE_LUNG_SHELTER:
### Stone-Lung Shelter - Foundation, Settlement
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch, or 30 feet if Projected Earth is legal for you
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 1 CP
Raise a small shelter, trench lip, half-buried alcove, or earthen lean-to large enough to hold up to four Medium creatures.
Creatures inside gain Half Cover from attacks originating outside the shelter. The shelter does not provide total safety, block line of effect entirely, create breathable air, or survive structural collapse unless the GM rules otherwise.
The shelter has AC 12 and Hit Points equal to 20 + twice your Cultivation Level. It is immune to Poison and Psychic damage.
TAL_EARTH_TERRACED_ASCENT:
### Terraced Ascent - Foundation, Settlement
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch, or 60 feet if Projected Earth is legal for you
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 1 CP
Create stairs, ramps, terraces, footholds, or a compacted slope across a solid surface.
The structure covers up to eight 5-foot spaces. It may ascend or descend up to 30 feet total, provided there is a solid surface or terrain mass to shape.
Terraced Ascent cannot create a freestanding bridge across empty air unless you also have a feature that permits raised Earth structures.
TAL_EARTH_THE_BURDEN_OF_TEN_THOUSAND_STE:
### The Burden of Ten Thousand Steps
Prerequisite: Buried Foundation Remembers, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within 120 feet moves at least 30 feet in one turn, teleports, Dashes, or crosses three or more of your Foundation Spaces
Cost: 5 CP
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, it gains one level of Exhaustion that lasts until the end of the encounter, and it falls Prone if touching a surface.
Successful Save: Its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
A creature can suffer temporary Exhaustion from this talent only once per long rest.
This Exhaustion represents crushing burden, not starvation, sleep deprivation, or disease.
TAL_EARTH_THE_GRAVE_REFUSES_THE_STEP:
### The Grave Refuses the Step - Foundation, Burden
Prerequisite: CL 12+
When a creature inside your Foundation Spaces teleports, burrows, phases, becomes incorporeal, or uses a supernatural movement mode to leave the space, use your Reaction and expend 2 CP.
The creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The movement fails and the creature remains in its original space. If the effect spent CP, a spell slot, or another resource, that resource is still spent.
Successful Save: The movement succeeds, but the creature gains one Burden Mark and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The Grave Refuses the Step does not stop Secret Inheritances, artifact movement, story-scale divine movement, or movement that does not begin inside your Foundation Spaces.
TAL_EARTH_THE_GROUND_KEEPS_SCORE:
### The Ground Keeps Score - Burden
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a creature with your Burden Mark misses an attack, fails a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, or fails to move you or an ally against your will, move the Burden Mark to another creature you can see within 30 feet that is touching the same surface.
The new target must have contributed to the same hostile action, such as by granting advantage, maintaining the effect, commanding the attacker, or standing inside the same hostile formation.
TAL_EARTH_THE_WORLD_RESTS_ON_MY_PALM:
### The World Rests on My Palm
“The immortal lowered one hand. The army did not fall. It simply discovered what it had always been standing on.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Bearing Ground, hidden earth-root scripture
Action Type: Action
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on a point on the ground you can perceive or have ritually marked
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per month or once per major story arc, as determined by the GM
You claim the burden of a battlefield, valley, mountain pass, city gate, sect courtyard, mine, tomb complex, or other grounded region.
Choose one principle when you activate this inheritance.
#### Nothing Unmoored May Rule
Creatures hostile to you cannot teleport into, teleport out of, burrow through, phase through, or use planar movement through the area unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Earth Save DC.
On a success, the movement works, but the creature gains one Burden Mark and takes 6d10 Force damage as the world makes it pay the weight of departure.
This does not block deity-scale movement, artifact-scale movement, or GM-declared story-scale passage.
#### The Ground Bears the Innocent
Choose any number of creatures you can name, see, or ritually identify as protected.
While a protected creature touches ground in the area:
it has Advantage on death saving throws;
it cannot be moved against its will by ordinary forced movement;
the first time each minute it would take damage, reduce that damage by 10d10;
if it would be buried, trapped, crushed, or fall into a fissure caused by terrain, move it to the nearest safe ground you choose within 60 feet.
#### The Burden Returns to the Violent
The first time each round that a hostile creature in the area deals damage, forces movement, destroys terrain, collapses a structure, or kills a creature, it gains one Burden Mark.
When you spend that mark, add 5d10 Bludgeoning damage or 5d10 Force damage to the Earth Response.
If the creature is already marked, it instead makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The World Rests on My Palm does not create permanent political ownership, legal title, or divine authority over the region.
It makes the region briefly answer your Dao of foundation and burden.
TAL_EARTH_TREMOR_LISTENING_PALM:
### Tremor-Listening Palm - Body, Burden
While you are touching a solid or earthen surface, use a Bonus Action to listen through it until the start of your next turn.
Until then, you know the location of creatures touching the same continuous surface within 30 feet of you, unless they are behind 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or an effect that blocks tremors.
This is not blindsight and does not let you see creatures. It tells you where weight and motion touch the surface.
At CL 10, the range becomes 60 feet.
TAL_FATE_BINDING_WORD:
#### Binding Word - Word, Curse
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Magic Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: 2 CP
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target has the Restrained condition until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_FATE_BLESSING_WORD:
#### Blessing Word - Word
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Magic Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: 1 CP
The next d20 Test the target makes before the end of its next turn has Advantage.
TAL_FATE_BORROWED_LIFESPAN_TALISMAN:
#### Borrowed Lifespan Talisman
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A willing creature within 30 feet would drop to 0 HP
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest per creature
The creature drops to 1 HP instead.
Then choose one cost:
you take Necrotic damage equal to twice your CL;
the protected creature gains one Exhaustion level;
you gain 2 Heaven’s Notice;
the protected creature cannot benefit from this talent again until it completes a meaningful repayment oath.
This talent cannot prevent death from old age, completed execution, disintegration, divine decree, or a Secret technique unless the GM permits an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_FATE_BOUND_EDICT:
#### Bound Edict - Edict
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you create an Edict, you may center it on one space, object, doorway, altar, banner, contract, corpse, or written name you can touch instead of centering it on yourself.
The Edict remains centered on that point or object and does not move with you.
If the object is destroyed or carried to another plane, the Edict ends.
TAL_FATE_CALAMITY_FINDS_A_PATH:
#### Calamity Finds a Path
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Magic Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: A plausible chain of calamities strikes the target. It takes 10d10 damage. Choose the damage type that best fits the scene: Psychic, Force, Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Fire, Cold, Lightning, or Thunder.
The target also suffers two of the following until the start of your next turn:
falls Prone;
drops one held object;
cannot take Reactions;
Speed becomes 0;
AC is reduced by 2;
healing it receives is halved.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and suffers one of the listed effects until the start of your next turn.
The calamity must be described through the environment, enemy mistakes, broken tools, collapsing stone, ricochets, unstable formations, snapped ropes, bad footing, or similar plausible causes.
Using this talent gains 1 Heaven’s Notice.
TAL_FATE_CHAIN_OF_MISFORTUNE:
#### Chain of Misfortune - Curse
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Magic Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The first time each round the target misses an attack, fails a saving throw, fails an ability check, falls Prone, or takes damage from a hazard, choose one:
it takes 2d8 Psychic damage;
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
one ally within 30 feet gains Advantage on the next attack roll against it before the start of your next turn.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the curse on a success.
Successful Initial Save: The next time before the start of your next turn that the target misses an attack or fails a saving throw, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its following turn.
TAL_FATE_CLEAR_MIRROR_JUDGE_AUSPICE:
#### Clear Mirror Judge Auspice - Auspice

Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=TEN_MINUTE_AUSPICE, ACTION_FAST_CAST

Release: The target releases this Auspice to reveal invisible or hidden enemies within 10 feet until the end of the target’s next turn. Revealed creatures are not automatically visible to everyone unless ordinary senses can perceive them.
TAL_FATE_COINCIDENTAL_DISCOVERY:
#### Coincidental Discovery - Unique
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual, 10 minutes
Range: Self
Cost: 2 CP
Focus on one immediate practical problem, such as finding a hidden entrance, remembering where an object was placed, locating a missing ordinary tool, discovering a weak support, noticing a useful route, or meeting a plausible local contact.
Make a Cultivation Check against a DC set by the GM.
Success: A plausible clue, opportunity, or coincidence appears.
Failure: No useful coincidence appears, and the CP is spent.
Coincidental Discovery cannot solve an entire mystery, summon an impossible ally, create information nobody could reasonably possess, reveal a Secret Inheritance, or produce an artifact.

TAL_FATE_CONSECRATED_GROUND:
#### Consecrated Ground - Edict
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Bound Edict
When you create a Bound Edict, you may increase its cost by 3 CP.
If you do, the duration becomes 8 hours and does not require Concentration.
At CL 15, you may increase the cost by 8 CP instead. If you do, the duration becomes permanent until dispelled, broken by an appropriate ritual, or ended by you.
A permanent Edict created this way immediately gains 1 Heaven’s Notice.
TAL_FATE_CONSEQUENCE_EDICT:
#### Consequence Edict - Edict, Curse
Action Type: Action
Area: 10-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Violence ripens quickly inside your aura.
Once per round, when a creature inside the aura damages another creature, the damaging creature takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You may designate a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus when you create the aura. Designated creatures are immune to this Edict.
TAL_FATE_COURT_OF_THE_HEAVENLY_LEDGER:
#### Court of the Heavenly Ledger - Fate Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Magic Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
The local ledger opens. Every action inside the court feels recorded before it is finished.
You and Allies:
Gain +1 AC.
Gain +1 to saving throws.
Cannot be Surprised while conscious.
Once per round, when an ally inside the Domain makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you may roll 1d6 and add it to the roll before the outcome is known.
Enemies:
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
it subtracts 1d4 from its next attack roll before the start of its next turn;
it subtracts 1d4 from its next saving throw before the start of its next turn;
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.
You may affect a creature with the enemy portion of this Domain only once per turn.
Using this Domain gains 1 Heaven’s Notice.

+1 to saving throws;

Failed Save: Choose one:
subtract 1d6 from its next attack roll before the start of its next turn;
subtract 1d6 from its next saving throw before the start of its next turn;
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

Creature, Open: The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, choose eyes or mouth. The chosen feature is forced open until the start of your next turn.

TAL_FENCING_ARM_STRIKE:

Choose one arm, forelimb, tentacle, or comparable limb used by the target to attack, hold an object, or manipulate its surroundings.

attack rolls made with a weapon, natural weapon, or object held or controlled primarily by that limb; and
Strength and Dexterity ability checks that rely primarily on that limb.

TAL_FENCING_BLEED_AIR:
##### Bleed Air - Exploit
Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 11+
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
If the target is below its Hit Point maximum, twist your strike through a lung or comparable organ of breath.
The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: Roll 1d4. After that many rounds, the target begins choking. While choking, it follows the ordinary 5.5e Suffocation hazard.
Successful Save: No effect.
The effect ends before choking begins if the target is restored to its Hit Point maximum.
After choking begins, the effect ends if any of the following occurs:
the target is restored to its Hit Point maximum;
the target gains an effect that allows it to breathe without the injured organ;
a creature within reach of the target takes the Utilize action and succeeds on a Wisdom (Medicine) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
A creature that does not need to breathe or lacks a comparable vulnerable organ is immune to Bleed Air.
TAL_FENCING_CHEST_STRIKE:
##### Chest Strike - Exploit
The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No effect.
A creature without a vulnerable chest, core, or comparable center of breath is immune to Chest Strike.
TAL_FENCING_COURT_OF_MEASURED_OPENINGS:

you may perform one Feint during each of your turns with no Action required;
when a hostile creature within your melee reach misses you with an attack, you may perform a Feint against that creature with no Action required;
when you apply an Exploit, you may apply two different Exploits you know instead of one without expending Martial Focus;

TAL_FENCING_CRANE_WING_ADVANCE:

TAL_FENCING_DISTRACTING_BLADES:

TAL_FENCING_EMPTY_HAND_OPEN_MERIDIAN:

10 x Proficiency Bonus
you know its approximate direction.

Successful Save: The trace fails.

TAL_FLOWERS_TRAVELING_GARDEN:
#### Traveling Garden - Blossom Augment
Prerequisite: CL 7+

When a Blossom blooms into an area, you may anchor that area to a creature or object carrying the Blossom.
