TAL_FLOWERS_UNWILLING_CREATURE:
##### Unwilling Creature
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Apply the Blossom.
Miss: No effect.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_BEND_THE_BLADE:
### Bend the Blade - Response, Redirection
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a melee attack misses you because of Flowing Response, expend Martial Focus.
Choose one creature other than you within the triggering attacker’s reach and within the attack’s original range.
Resolve the same attack roll against the chosen creature’s AC.
Hit: The chosen creature suffers the attack’s ordinary hit effects.
Miss: No effect.
Bend the Blade does not force the attacker to spend another Action or resource. It redirects the committed attack already made.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_CIRCULAR_THROW:
### Circular Throw - Response, Redirection
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When your Flowing Response succeeds against a creature within reach, the triggering creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Move the creature up to 10 feet to one legal space you can see. If the movement ends adjacent to a wall, Barrier, large object, or another creature, the target also falls Prone.
Successful Save: Move the creature 5 feet to one legal space adjacent to you.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_COURT_OF_RETURNING_WAT:
### Court of Returning Water - Flowing River Domain
“Within this court, every hard line learns it has already bent.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You establish a 30-foot-radius Domain centered on yourself. It moves with you.
While the Domain lasts:
You
may use Flowing Response twice per round, but no more than once during the same turn;
regain Martial Focus once per round when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack;
may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker whenever a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack.
Allies
Allies of your choice inside the Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone or moved against their will.
Once per round, when a hostile creature misses one of those allies with a melee attack, that ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
Enemies
Once per turn when a hostile creature inside the Domain misses with a melee attack or fails to Grapple, Shove, move, or knock a creature Prone, you may force it to make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Move it 10 feet to one legal space inside the Domain, or give it the Prone condition.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
The Domain ends early if you become Incapacitated.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_CURRENT_BETWEEN_STEPS:
### Current Between Steps - Footwork
When you take the Disengage Action, choose one creature whose reach you leave during that movement.
The next melee attack roll that creature makes against you before the start of your next turn has Disadvantage.
If the creature misses you with that attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_CURRENT_CARRIES_THE_AL:
### Current Carries the Ally - Footwork
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Flowing Response and move at least 5 feet, choose one willing ally within 5 feet of your starting space.
That ally may use its Reaction to move 5 feet into one legal space you vacated or passed through.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_DRAW_PAST:
### Draw Past - Response, Redirection
When your Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Move the creature 5 feet into one legal space adjacent to you.
Successful Save: No movement.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Draw Past cannot move a creature through a wall, Barrier, occupied space, or other illegal space.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_DROWN_THE_KILLING_INTE:
### Drown the Killing Intent - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 17+
When a creature misses you with a melee attack while you are benefiting from Dodge, you may force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn, the creature cannot willingly make another attack against you unless you are the only creature it can perceive as a legal target.
Successful Save: The creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of its next turn.
A creature immune to the Frightened condition has Advantage on this saving throw, but the effect is not the Frightened condition.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_EMPTY_BANK_EVASION:
### Empty Bank Evasion - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you make a Dexterity saving throw against an effect you can see, expend Martial Focus.
If the saving throw succeeds, you take no damage from the effect and may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures whose effects you avoided.
If the saving throw fails, you take half damage from the effect if it deals damage.
Empty Bank Evasion applies only to the damage of the triggering effect. It does not automatically prevent conditions, forced movement, or other non-damage effects unless the effect says a successful save would do so.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_EMPTY_STEP:
### Empty Step - Response, Footwork
When your Flowing Response succeeds, increase the movement granted by Flowing Response from 5 feet to 10 feet.
If you took the Dodge Action on your last turn, this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from any creature that attacked you and missed before the start of your next turn.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_FLOWING_RESPONSE:
#### Flowing Response
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: When a creature you can see makes a melee attack roll against you; when a creature within your reach attempts to Grapple or Shove you; or when a creature within your reach forces you to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid being moved, knocked Prone, Grappled, or Restrained.
Cost: None
Use Limit: Once per round
You receive an incoming force and decide where it continues.
You may use Flowing Response when one of the following triggers occurs:
a creature you can see makes a melee attack roll against you;
a creature within your reach attempts to Grapple or Shove you;
a creature within your reach forces you to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid being moved, knocked Prone, Grappled, or Restrained.
Choose the matching response.
##### Yield Against an Attack
Increase your AC against the triggering melee attack by your Proficiency Bonus.
If the attack misses, the response succeeds. After the attack resolves, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then apply one Response talent you know.
##### Yield Against Control
Gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw against the Grapple, Shove, forced movement, Prone effect, or Restrained effect.
If you succeed on the saving throw, the response succeeds. After the effect resolves, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then apply one Response talent you know.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_FLOWING_RIVER_TRAINING:
#### Flowing River Training
When you learn Flowing River, gain proficiency in one of the following:
Strength (Athletics);
Dexterity (Acrobatics);
Wisdom (Insight).
If you are already proficient in all three, choose one Mortal Realm Flowing River talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent.
You also learn Flowing Response and Gather the Current.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_GATHER_THE_CURRENT:
#### Gather the Current
Whenever you take the Dodge or Disengage Action as your Action, regain Martial Focus.
This does not trigger when you Dodge or Disengage as a Bonus Action unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_HAND_ON_THE_WRIST:
### Hand on the Wrist - Response
When your Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_LOW_RIVER_STANCE:
### Low River Stance - Footwork
You may drop Prone at any time, including outside your turn.
Standing from Prone costs you only 5 feet of movement.
While Prone, you may use Flowing Response against melee attacks made by creatures within your reach. You do not gain this benefit against ranged attacks merely because they are made within reach.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_PATIENT_WATER:
### Patient Water - Focus
When you take the Dodge Action and no hostile creature makes an attack roll against you before the start of your next turn, regain Martial Focus at the start of that turn.
You regain Martial Focus only if it is currently absent.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_REED_IN_STORM:
### Reed in Storm - Focus
When a creature misses you with a melee attack while you are benefiting from the Dodge Action, regain Martial Focus.
You regain Martial Focus only if it is currently absent.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_RETURN_THE_GRIP:
### Return the Grip - Response
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When your Flowing Response succeeds against a Grapple or Shove attempt, the triggering creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which.
Failed Save: Choose one:
the creature is pushed 10 feet away from you;
the creature falls Prone;
the creature gains the Grappled condition until the start of your next turn, if you have a free hand or another eligible grappling body part.
Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_RETURN_THE_MOUNTAIN_TO:
### Return the Mountain to the Mountain - Redirection
Prerequisite: Bend the Blade, CL 15+
When a melee attack misses you because of Flowing Response, expend Martial Focus.
Choose one legal target within 30 feet of you that the triggering attack could physically reach along a clear path if redirected by weapon angle, body turn, rebound, or momentum.
Resolve the same attack roll against the chosen target’s AC.
Hit: The chosen target suffers the attack’s ordinary hit effects.
Miss: The chosen target takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Return the Mountain to the Mountain cannot pass through Total Cover, a sealed Barrier, or a space the original attack could not plausibly be redirected through.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_RIVER_CROSSING_STEP:
### River Crossing Step - Footwork
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When Flowing Response lets you move, you may move through one hostile creature’s space during that movement.
Treat that creature’s space as Difficult Terrain.
You may not end movement in an occupied space.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_RIVER_TAKES_THE_SPEAR:
### River Takes the Spear - Response
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When your Flowing Response succeeds against a melee attack made with a weapon, the attacker makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn, the attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks with that weapon, and the next attack roll it makes with that weapon has Disadvantage.
Successful Save: The attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks with that weapon until the start of its next turn.
River Takes the Spear does not disarm the weapon.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_RIVER_THAT_CARRIES_ARM:
### River That Carries Armies - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+
When you move without provoking Opportunity Attacks through a Flowing River talent, choose a number of willing allies up to your Proficiency Bonus who are within 30 feet and can see or hear you.
Each chosen ally may use its Reaction to move up to 10 feet.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures that missed you, failed to control you, or were moved by your Flowing River talent this round.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_SOFT_CAPTURE:
### Soft Capture - Response
When your Flowing Response succeeds against a creature within reach, the triggering creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The creature gains the Grappled condition until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No effect.
You must have a free hand or another eligible grappling body part. This grapple follows the ordinary 2024 rules for ending a grapple unless another feature changes them.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_TEN_THOUSAND_EDGES_FIN:
### Ten Thousand Edges Find No Center - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you take the Dodge Action, the first melee attack each round that would hit you before the start of your next turn misses instead.
After this attack misses, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
This movement is not Flowing Response and does not apply a Response talent.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_THE_RIVER_THAT_RETURNS:
### The River That Returns the Blade Before It Is Drawn
Prerequisites: Flowing River sphere, No Center Under Heaven, CL 17+
“The master did not dodge the sword. The river had already persuaded the sword to regret its path.”
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive hits you with a melee attack, Grapples you, Shoves you, knocks you Prone, Restrains you, or moves you against your will
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Declare that the attack or controlling force has already entered the river.
Cancel the triggering hit, Grapple, Shove, Prone effect, Restrained effect, or forced movement against you.
Then choose up to three of the following effects:
move yourself up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
move the triggering creature up to 15 feet to one legal space you can see;
give the triggering creature the Prone condition;
force the triggering attack to resolve against one other legal target within the attacker’s reach;
end one Grappled or Restrained condition currently affecting you;
regain Martial Focus at the start of your next turn.
If you choose to redirect the attack against another target, use the original attack roll.
This inheritance does not cancel area effects, ranged attacks, teleportation, possession, mental influence, or effects that do not physically express force through the body unless the GM rules the scene’s metaphysics make the force directly receivable.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_TURNING_GUARD:
### Turning Guard - Footwork
When you take the Dodge Action, choose one creature you can see.
Until the start of your next turn, when that creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it.
This movement is not Flowing Response and does not apply a Response talent.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_TURN_THE_FOOT:
### Turn the Foot - Response
When your Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
the creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
the creature has Disadvantage on the next Opportunity Attack it makes before the start of its next turn;
the creature falls Prone if it moved at least 10 feet immediately before triggering Flowing Response.
Successful Save: No effect.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_TWO_CURRENTS_MEET:
### Two Currents Meet - Focus
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When Flowing Response succeeds, expend Martial Focus to apply two different Response talents you know to the same successful response.
Both talents must be legal for the same triggering creature.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_WATER_WEARS_STONE:
### Water Wears Stone - Response
When your Flowing Response succeeds, deal Bludgeoning damage to the triggering creature equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
This damage represents a joint tap, elbow turn, shoulder check, foot sweep, or other small use of the enemy’s own pressure. It is not a separate attack.
TAL_FLOWING_RIVER_WAVE_BREAKER:
### Wave Breaker - Response
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may use Flowing Response when a creature you can see makes a ranged weapon attack against you.
When used this way, Yield Against an Attack increases your AC against the triggering ranged weapon attack by your Proficiency Bonus.
If the attack misses, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature of your choice, but you may apply only the following Response talents:
Empty Step;
Hand on the Wrist, if the attacker is within your reach;
Water Wears Stone, if the attacker is within your reach.
TAL_FORCE_ANCHORED_PASSAGE:
### Anchored Passage - Anchor Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Increase Set Anchor range to 60 feet.
When you use Set Anchor, create up to two external Pressure Anchors instead of one. Each anchor must have a separate legal target within range.
TAL_FORCE_BODY_CONDUCTED_IMPACT:
### Body-Conducted Impact - Impact Talent
Trigger: You hit with one melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or natural weapon attack
Cost: 1 CP
Use Limit: Once per turn
Conduct pressure through the successful attack.
Choose one:
push the target 5 feet directly away from you if it does not exceed your Force Limit;
deal additional Force or Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
deal double damage from the triggering attack to one unattended object or ordinary Barrier.
Body-Conducted Impact does not count as activating Impact and does not replace the triggering attack’s ordinary damage.
TAL_FORCE_CASCADING_COLLISION:
### Cascading Collision - Impact Augment
Prerequisite: Hammerfall, CL 7+
Cost: +2 CP
When Impact pushes a creature into another creature, both creatures make Strength saving throws.
Failed Save: Take Bludgeoning damage equal to 2d8 + Path key ability modifier and fall Prone.
Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing.
A creature can take Cascading Collision damage only once per turn.
TAL_FORCE_CLINGING_ANCHOR:
### Clinging Anchor - Anchor Augment
Cost: +1 CP
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
When Impact hits a creature that does not exceed your Force Limit, place one external Pressure Anchor on that creature.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The anchor remains for the duration.
Successful Save: The anchor lasts until the start of your next turn.
At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw, ending the anchor on a success.
The anchor counts against your normal maximum number of external Pressure Anchors.
TAL_FORCE_COMPRESSION_FIELD:
### Compression Field - Field Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Compress the area with sustained resistance.
The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.
When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. If it already suffers this reduction from Compression Field, it also falls Prone.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.
Compression Field does not alter weight and does not automatically prevent flight.
TAL_FORCE_COUNTERPRESSURE:
### Counterpressure
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You, a creature, or an object within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet takes damage, would be pushed or pulled, or would be knocked Prone
Cost: 1 CP
Release opposing pressure.
Choose one:
#### Cushion the Blow
Reduce the triggering damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier |
#### Refuse the Movement
Reduce the triggering forced movement by the listed distance.
| Cultivation Level | Forced-Movement Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 10 feet |
| 5-10 | 15 feet |
| 11-16 | 20 feet |
| 17-20 | 30 feet |
If the triggering effect would knock the target Prone, the target also gains Advantage on one saving throw or contested check made to resist that Prone condition.
If no saving throw or contested check would normally occur, Counterpressure does not invent one. It reduces forced movement normally but does not prevent the Prone condition unless another talent says so.
TAL_FORCE_COURT_OF_THE_ANSWERING_WORLD:
### Court of the Answering World - Force Domain
“The enemy mistook the courtyard for empty ground. The courtyard had already chosen a side.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Every meaningful surface inside the Domain remembers how to answer pressure.
While the Domain persists:
#### You
Treat every solid surface inside the Domain as one of your Pressure Anchors.
Use Impact from one legal origin inside the Domain without needing a prepared external anchor.
Use Counterpressure when its protected target is within 5 feet of any solid surface inside the Domain.
Use Pressure Step once per turn without spending CP.
#### Allies
Gain Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement and falling Prone.
Reduce falling and collision damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
After a hostile creature misses an ally with a melee attack, that ally may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
#### Enemies
Treat the Domain as difficult terrain while moving across a solid surface.
Have Disadvantage on Strength checks made to break one of your Barriers.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain while touching a solid surface, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
push it 10 feet along the surface;
knock it Prone;
reduce its Speed to 0 until the start of its next turn;
deal 2d8 Force or Bludgeoning damage.
Successful Save: Reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.
A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.
Court of the Answering World does not grant telekinesis, flight, or control over creatures that are not touching a meaningful surface.
TAL_FORCE_CUSHION_THE_BLOW:
#### Cushion the Blow
Reduce the triggering damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier |
TAL_FORCE_FORCE_MANTLE:
### Force Mantle - Unique Force Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Wrap your body in answering pressure.
Gain:
+2 AC;
Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement;
Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to avoid falling Prone;
once per turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to one Force or Bludgeoning damage roll caused by one of your Force talents.
Force Mantle does not create a Barrier and does not automatically protect another creature.
TAL_FORCE_FORCE_WALL:
### Force Wall - Barrier Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Create a Barrier beginning in one unoccupied space adjacent to the origin.
The wall is composed of contiguous 5-foot-by-5-foot panels.
Maximum wall dimensions:
30 feet long;
10 feet high;
1 foot thick.
Each panel has:
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | 15 + Proficiency Bonus |
| HP | 3 x CL |
| Resistances | Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing |
| Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic |

TAL_FORCE_GROUND_ANSWERING_PALM:
### Ground-Answering Palm - Impact Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor placed on a solid surface that you can perceive within 60 feet
Area: 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line along a connected solid surface
Cost: 3 CP
Transmit impact through the connected surface.
Creatures standing on the affected surface make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take Force or Bludgeoning damage and fall Prone.
Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 7-10 | 4d6 |
| 11-16 | 5d6 |
| 17-20 | 7d6 |
Choose the damage type when activating the talent.
Ground-Answering Palm cannot cross a gap, sealed discontinuity, or surface too unstable to carry the pressure.
TAL_FORCE_HAMMERFALL:
### Hammerfall - Impact Augment
Cost: +1 CP
When Impact hits, increase its forced movement by 5 feet.
If the target collides with a solid surface before completing that movement, it takes additional Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target does not exceed your Force Limit, it also makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Fall Prone.
Successful Save: Remain standing.
A creature suffers Hammerfall’s additional damage only once per turn.
TAL_FORCE_HEAVEN_CRUSHING_PALM:
### Heaven-Crushing Palm - Impact Talent
Prerequisite: Hammerfall, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Release a catastrophic pressure strike.
Creatures and objects inside make Strength saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 12d10 Force or Bludgeoning damage, push 20 feet directly away from the origin if the creature does not exceed your Force Limit, and fall Prone.
Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement.
Choose the damage type when activating the talent.
Objects, structures, and Barriers take double damage.
Heaven-Crushing Palm does not automatically destroy a major structure, artifact barrier, city wall, or narrative-scale defense. Apply appropriate object rules, damage thresholds, and project-scale adjudication.
TAL_FORCE_IMPACT:
### Impact
Action Type: Action
Range: Special
Cost: None
Choose yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet as the origin.
Choose one visible creature or object within 30 feet of that origin. The target must not have Total Cover from the origin.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If the target is within your natural reach, you may make a melee Cultivation Attack instead.
Hit: Deal Force or Bludgeoning damage equal to the listed dice + your Path key ability modifier. Choose the damage type when attacking.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 1d8 |
| 5-10 | 2d8 |
| 11-16 | 3d8 |
| 17-20 | 4d8 |
On a hit, you may push the target 5 feet directly away from the origin if it does not exceed your Force Limit.
Impact is cultivated pressure becoming consequence at one chosen point.
TAL_FORCE_INVISIBLE_MOUNTAIN:
### Invisible Mountain - Field Talent
Prerequisite: Compression Field, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Create a field of overwhelming compressed resistance.
The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.
A hostile creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Force damage and become Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 10-16 | 4d8 |
| 17-20 | 6d8 |
A creature makes this saving throw and takes this damage only once per turn.
Invisible Mountain does not change a creature’s weight. It compresses the route through which the creature attempts to move.
TAL_FORCE_KINETIC_RESERVOIR:
### Kinetic Reservoir - Counter Talent
Prerequisite: Returning Impact, CL 10+
When Counterpressure reduces damage, you may store some of the caught pressure.
Track stored pressure equal to the damage reduced, to a maximum of:
5 x CL
Stored pressure lasts until the end of your next turn.
Once before the stored pressure ends, when you deal damage with Impact, Shockwave, Ground-Answering Palm, or Returning Impact, expend any amount of stored pressure and add that amount as Force damage to one target damaged by the technique.
You cannot store damage prevented by Resistance, Immunity, Temporary HP, or another creature’s defensive feature unless Counterpressure itself reduced that damage.
You may maintain only one Kinetic Reservoir at a time.
TAL_FORCE_MERIDIAN_OF_IMPACT:
### Meridian of Impact - Impact Talent
Prerequisite: Ground-Answering Palm, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor placed on a solid surface that you can perceive within 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line along connected solid surfaces
Cost: 6 CP
Send a disciplined rupture through stone, wood, metal, or another connected solid surface.
Creatures standing on the affected route make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 6d8 Force or Bludgeoning damage, fall Prone, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing.
Choose the damage type when activating the talent.
Objects, structures, and Barriers along the route take one additional damage die.
Meridian of Impact cannot jump across an unsupported gap or bypass Total Cover through a disconnected surface.
TAL_FORCE_MOMENTARY_RAMPART:
### Momentary Rampart - Barrier, Counter Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: An attack, projectile, breath weapon, line effect, or similar physically traveling hostile effect would pass within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Create one 5-foot-by-5-foot Barrier adjacent to the chosen origin.
Choose its orientation when creating it.
The Barrier has:
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | Your Cultivation Save DC |
| HP | CL + Proficiency Bonus |
| Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic |
The triggering attack or effect resolves against the Barrier first if the Barrier physically interrupts its path.
Momentary Rampart is an immediate answer, not a persistent wall.
TAL_FORCE_PRESSURE_PIN:
### Pressure Pin - Field Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet
Range: 10 feet from the origin
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature that does not exceed your Force Limit.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Become Restrained by concentrated pressure.
Successful Save: Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
A Restrained creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Pressure Pin does not move the target and does not command its actions.
TAL_FORCE_RAMPART_OF_STILL_AIR:
### Rampart of Still Air - Barrier Talent
Prerequisite: Force Wall, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 90 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Create one hemispherical dome or sealed sphere centered on the origin.
Choose a radius up to 15 feet.
The Rampart has:
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | 16 + Proficiency Bonus |
| HP | 8 x CL |
| Resistances | All damage except Force and Void effects |
| Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic |
The Rampart blocks effects that physically cross its boundary.
It does not automatically block teleportation, gaze attacks, mind-affecting effects, or effects originating inside the Rampart.
TAL_FORCE_REBOUNDING_PASSAGE:
### Rebounding Passage - Unique Force Talent
Prerequisite: Rising Step, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Cost: 5 CP
Choose yourself and a number of willing creatures within 10 feet equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Launch every chosen creature through one legal route to one visible unoccupied destination within 60 feet.
Each creature must arrive in a separate legal space.
This movement:
does not provoke opportunity attacks;
may travel horizontally or vertically;
cannot pass through solid objects;
is not teleportation.
A creature that ends the movement without support falls normally.
TAL_FORCE_RECOIL_WARD:
### Recoil Ward - Counter Talent
When Counterpressure reduces damage dealt by a creature within 30 feet of the protected target, you may pay 1 additional CP.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push the creature 5 feet directly away from the protected target if it does not exceed your Force Limit.
Successful Save: No movement.
Recoil Ward does not affect damage caused by terrain, environmental hazards, or effects with no identifiable creature as their source.
TAL_FORCE_REFUSE_THE_MOVEMENT:
#### Refuse the Movement
Reduce the triggering forced movement by the listed distance.
| Cultivation Level | Forced-Movement Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 10 feet |
| 5-10 | 15 feet |
| 11-16 | 20 feet |
| 17-20 | 30 feet |
If the triggering effect would knock the target Prone, the target also gains Advantage on one saving throw or contested check made to resist that Prone condition.
If no saving throw or contested check would normally occur, Counterpressure does not invent one. It reduces forced movement normally but does not prevent the Prone condition unless another talent says so.
TAL_FORCE_RETURNING_IMPACT:
### Returning Impact - Counter Talent
Prerequisite: Recoil Ward, CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: Counterpressure reduces damage from a melee attack, ranged weapon attack, thrown weapon attack, collision, or other physical impact caused by a creature
Cost: 2 CP
After resolving Counterpressure, return the caught pressure toward the source.
The source creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Force damage equal to the amount of damage reduced by Counterpressure, to a maximum of 3 x CL, and push 10 feet directly away from the protected target if it does not exceed your Force Limit.
Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement.
Returning Impact does not reflect poison, Psychic damage, ongoing damage, or a supernatural effect with no meaningful physical impact.
TAL_FORCE_RISING_STEP:
### Rising Step - Unique Force Talent
Prerequisite: Pressure Step, CL 5+
When using Pressure Step, move up to 30 feet instead of 10 feet.
You may carry one willing creature of your size or smaller.
The creature must begin adjacent to you and arrive in one legal unoccupied space adjacent to your destination.
If either creature ends the movement without support, that creature falls normally.
TAL_FORCE_SHOCKWAVE:
### Shockwave - Impact Talent
Action Type: Action
Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet
Area: 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin
Cost: 2 CP
Release pressure in every direction.
Creatures of your choice inside the area make Strength saving throws.
Failed Save: Take Force or Bludgeoning damage and, if the creature does not exceed your Force Limit, push it 10 feet directly away from the origin.
Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 2d6 |
| 11-16 | 3d6 |
| 17-20 | 4d6 |
Choose the damage type when activating the talent.
Unattended objects weighing no more than 20 pounds x CL are pushed 10 feet automatically if a legal route exists.
TAL_FORCE_SINGLE_BREATH_FOOTHOLD:
### Single-Breath Foothold - Barrier Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or one willing creature within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet begins falling
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Create one horizontal 5-foot-by-5-foot Barrier immediately beneath the target.
The target lands on the Barrier if space permits.
The Barrier supports up to 100 pounds x CL.
The Barrier has:
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | Your Cultivation Save DC |
| HP | CL + Proficiency Bonus |
| Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic |
Single-Breath Foothold is a momentary catch, not a floating platform or permanent bridge.
TAL_FORCE_SUNDERING_PRESSURE:
### Sundering Pressure - Impact Augment
Cost: +1 CP
When Impact damages one object, structure, Barrier, or Construct, deal one additional Impact damage die.
Sundering Pressure does not automatically ignore damage thresholds, Resistance, Immunity, or the special rules of a major structure.
TAL_FORCE_TEN_THOUSAND_REBOUNDS:
### Ten Thousand Rebounds - Counter Talent
Prerequisite: Kinetic Reservoir, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You activate Counterpressure
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Until the start of your next turn, the first time each hostile creature deals physical damage to you or an ally within 30 feet, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 4d8 Force damage and push 10 feet directly away from the damaged creature if it does not exceed your Force Limit.
Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement.
A creature is affected by Ten Thousand Rebounds only once during the duration.
Ten Thousand Rebounds does not respond to poison, Psychic damage, ongoing damage, or effects with no meaningful physical impact.
TAL_FORCE_UNANSWERABLE_RAMPART:
### Unanswerable Rampart - Barrier, Counter Talent
Prerequisite: Rampart of Still Air, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A visible attack, projectile, breath weapon, line effect, cone, or similar physically traveling hostile effect would pass through one point within 120 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Create a sovereign Barrier up to 60 feet long and 30 feet high.
The Barrier appears before the triggering effect resolves.
It has:
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | 20 |
| HP | 20 x CL |
| Resistances | All damage except Force and Void effects |
| Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic |
If the triggering effect destroys the Barrier, remaining damage or area effect may continue through it when physically appropriate.
Unanswerable Rampart does not automatically stop teleportation, gaze attacks, mind-affecting effects, or effects originating beyond the Barrier without crossing it.
TAL_FORCE_UNBROKEN_BRACE:
### Unbroken Brace - Counter Talent
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or one willing creature within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 90 feet fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw against forced movement, falling Prone, a collision, or a physically traveling area effect
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
The target succeeds on the saving throw instead.
Unbroken Brace does not affect a saving throw against poison, disease, mind-affecting effects, spiritual corruption, or another effect with no meaningful physical pressure.
TAL_GLASS_BREAK_THE_PROUD_WEAPON:
### Break the Proud Weapon
Prerequisite: CL 12+
When a marked creature hits with a weapon attack, you may use your Reaction and spend the mark.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The weapon, natural weapon, or striking limb is fractured by clear lines until the start of your next turn. The attack still resolves, but the marked creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with the same weapon or limb before the effect ends.
If the attack was made with a nonmagical object or mundane weapon, also apply Break the Line to the weapon.
Successful Save: Reduce the triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_GLASS_CAREFUL_FEET_ON_BROKEN_LIGHT:
### Careful Feet on Broken Light
You ignore difficult terrain from Shattered Glass Terrain you created.
When you move through Shattered Glass Terrain you created, choose one creature that can see you. Until the start of your next turn, you have Advantage on the next Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or Dexterity saving throw you make against that creature’s effect.
TAL_GLASS_CONTACT_PANE:
### Contact Pane
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Touch a solid surface no larger than a 5-foot square or one Medium or smaller object.
The touched surface becomes a Glass Surface. It remains in place and keeps its original size and shape.
If a creature breaks, opens, crosses, strikes through, or relies on the surface for Cover, you may place a Faultline Mark on that creature.
Contact Pane does not create a free-floating pane. It changes the behavior of a surface you physically touch.
TAL_GLASS_FAULTLINE_TRANSFER:
### Faultline Transfer
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you spend a Faultline Mark, you may move one different Faultline Mark from a creature within 30 feet to another creature, object, or Glass Surface within 5 feet of the original target.
Use Faultline Transfer once per round.
TAL_GLASS_FLAW_WITHIN_THE_GOLDEN_TECHNIQ:
### Flaw Within the Golden Technique
Prerequisite: Spell-Line Crack, CL 15+
When a creature with a Faultline Mark uses a Domain, Realm Evolution, major forged technique, or other high-cost supernatural feature within 60 feet, use your Reaction and spend the mark.
The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
reduce the triggering effect’s damage against all targets by 4d8;
one ally affected by the triggering effect automatically succeeds on one saving throw against it;
reduce the triggering effect’s duration by 1 round, minimum 1 round;
the creature cannot use the same feature again until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: One ally affected by the triggering effect gains Resistance to one damage type dealt by the effect until the end of the current turn.
Flaw Within the Golden Technique does not affect Secret Inheritances unless the GM says the inheritance has already exposed a visible faultline.
TAL_GLASS_GLASS_BONE_GUARD:
### Glass-Bone Guard
Your body may serve as your primary Glass Surface.
When you use Temper Glass Surface on your own body, choose one benefit until the effect ends:
gain +1 AC while not wearing heavy armor;
reduce the first Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage you take each round by your Proficiency Bonus;
when a creature hits you with a melee attack, place a Faultline Mark on that creature.
This talent does not create glass outside your body.
TAL_GLASS_GLASS_COFFIN_WITHOUT_DEATH:
### Glass Coffin Without Death
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One willing, unconscious, Petrified, dying, cursed, poisoned, diseased, or spiritually unstable creature
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 5 CP
Encase the target in a transparent preservation shell.
While encased:
the target is Incapacitated and has Total Cover;
the shell has AC 15 + your Proficiency Bonus and HP 10 x your CL;
poison, disease, bleeding, ordinary decay, and ongoing environmental exposure do not worsen;
the target does not need to breathe;
hostile creatures can see the target clearly, but cannot touch the target without breaking the shell.
You may end the shell as an Action while touching it.
Glass Coffin Without Death preserves a state. It does not heal the target by itself.
TAL_GLASS_GLASS_DOMAIN_COURT_OF_VISIBLE_:
### Glass Domain: Court of Visible Faults
“Every pane showed a different angle. Every angle agreed on where the enemy was already broken.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Create a court of visible faultlines around yourself.
For the duration:
your body counts as a tempered Glass Surface;
each ally inside may treat their worn armor, held weapon, or held shield as a Glass Surface for your Glass talents;
the first time each round that a hostile creature inside damages an ally, crosses a Glass Surface, attacks through a Glass Surface, or damages a Glass Surface, you may place a Faultline Mark on that creature;
once per round, you may use a Refraction Response without spending your Reaction;
Shattered Glass Terrain you create inside the Domain lasts until the Domain ends.
If you are a Body Refiner, this Domain manifests as glass-bone pressure radiating from your stance and contact points. It does not require you to create free-floating panes.
TAL_GLASS_GLASS_ROAD:
### Glass Road - Projected
Prerequisite: Raised Pane Scripture, CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Create a narrow transparent road of glass panels across open space, water, mud, broken ground, or a gap.
The road can be up to 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. It must begin from a solid surface within range.
Creatures may move across it normally.
When a hostile creature willingly moves across the road, you may place a Faultline Mark on it once per turn.
If the road is reduced to 0 HP or you dismiss it, creatures standing on it fall unless they have another legal support.
A Body Refining cultivator may learn this talent only with external-projection permission.
TAL_GLASS_HEAVEN_REVEALS_THE_SINGLE_FAUL:
### Heaven Reveals the Single Faultline
“The cultivator lifted one finger. Every pane in the world agreed where the impossible technique was already cracked.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Glass Domain: Court of Visible Faults, hidden glass scripture or equivalent inheritance
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 120 feet declares an attack, spell, sphere talent, Domain, Realm Evolution, Secret Inheritance, or other supernatural technique
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Before the triggering effect resolves, choose one visible or spiritually perceptible faultline in the declared action.
The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
split the effect: one target of your choice is unaffected by it;
refract the effect: choose one legal target within 30 feet of the original target to suffer half of the effect’s damage or consequence instead;
shatter the effect’s path: reduce all damage dealt by the triggering effect by half;
expose the technique: the triggering creature loses all benefits of Invisible, Hidden, or unseen-origin effects until the end of your next turn, and every enemy who can see it may place one narrative or tactical question to the GM about the technique’s visible weakness.
Successful Save: The triggering effect resolves normally, but the creature gains three Faultline Marks. These marks can exceed your normal limit and last until the end of your next turn.
This inheritance does not make Glass a universal counterspell. It works only because the declared action exposed a line, target, path, boundary, or contradiction that Glass can reveal.
TAL_GLASS_HIDDEN_CRACK_STUDY:
### Hidden Crack Study
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When you take the Study action to examine a creature, object, barrier, Formation, or supernatural effect through a Glass Surface, add your Proficiency Bonus to the check if it is not already included.
On a success, place a Faultline Mark on the studied target or on one relevant object or surface connected to it.
This reveals structural or tactical weakness, not private thoughts.
TAL_GLASS_LENS_OF_STORED_PRESSURE:
### Lens of Stored Pressure
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you reduce damage with Turn the Angle, store part of the pressure in a legal Glass Surface.
The next time before the end of your next turn that you hit with Faultline Strike or Glass Shard, add damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 11+, add 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus instead.
TAL_GLASS_LENS_OF_THE_HONEST_CRACK:
### Lens of the Honest Crack
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature you can see through a Glass Surface
Cost: 0 CP
Study the target through a tempered Glass Surface.
Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target makes an attack roll, casts a spell, spends CP, activates a supernatural feature, or attempts to Hide, you may place a Faultline Mark on it.
TAL_GLASS_LIVING_PANE_SUTRA:
### Living Pane Sutra
Prerequisite: Walking Pane Body, CL 10+
When your body is a tempered Glass Surface, gain the following benefits:
Resistance to Slashing damage;
Advantage on saving throws against being Blinded;
when a creature scores a critical hit against you, place two Faultline Marks on that creature instead of one.
Once per short rest, when you would be reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, you may shatter your outer glass-bone shell and drop to 1 HP instead. When you do, create Shattered Glass Terrain in each space adjacent to you.
TAL_GLASS_MIRROR_BRIGHT_WITNESS:
### Mirror-Bright Witness
When a creature with a Faultline Mark hits a creature other than you with an attack, you may use your Reaction to make the mark flare visibly.
The attacked creature gains +2 AC against the triggering attack.
If the attack misses, the marked creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
TAL_GLASS_MIRROR_CLEAR_TESTIMONY:
### Mirror-Clear Testimony
Prerequisite: CL 12+
When a creature lies, hides a hostile action, or conceals the origin of an attack while reflected in or seen through one of your Glass Surfaces, you may force the surface to remember the contradiction.
For the next hour, a creature studying that Glass Surface with a successful Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Insight), or relevant Cultivation check against your Glass Save DC can perceive a brief visual echo of the contradiction.
This does not reveal private thoughts. It preserves visible or spiritually reflected inconsistency.
TAL_GLASS_PANE_STEP_PROJECTION:
### Pane-Step Projection - Projected
Prerequisite: Raised Pane Scripture, CL 5+
When you create a projected Glass Pane, you may create it within 10 feet of you without anchoring it to a solid surface.
The pane collapses at the end of your next turn unless it becomes anchored before then.
A Body Refining cultivator may learn this talent only if they have external-projection permission.
TAL_GLASS_POLISHED_WARNING:
### Polished Warning
When a creature you can see targets you with an attack, you may use your Reaction to angle a tempered Glass Surface.
Gain +2 AC against the triggering attack.
If the attack misses, place a Faultline Mark on the attacker.
If you do not have a legal Glass Surface, you cannot use this talent.
TAL_GLASS_PRISM_STEP:
### Prism Step
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Refracted Step, you may move through a space occupied by one willing ally or through one space adjacent to a Glass Surface you control without treating that space as difficult terrain.
At the end of this movement, choose one creature you moved away from. That creature has Disadvantage on the next Opportunity Attack it makes before the start of your next turn.
TAL_GLASS_RAISED_PANE_SCRIPTURE:
### Raised Pane Scripture - Projected
Prerequisite: Qi Cultivation, Spirit Awakening, or external-projection permission
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create one transparent Glass Pane in an unoccupied space you can see within range.
The pane is a 5-foot-by-5-foot square. It must be vertical, horizontal, or angled, and must be anchored to a solid surface or another Glass Pane.
The pane has:
AC equal to 12 + your Proficiency Bonus;
HP equal to 5 x your CL;
immunity to Poison and Psychic damage;
vulnerability to Thunder damage.
When reduced to 0 HP, the pane shatters and creates Shattered Glass Terrain in its space until the end of your next turn.
At CL 5, create two connected panes. At CL 11, create three connected panes. At CL 17, create four connected panes.
TAL_GLASS_REFRACTION_OF_THE_OBVIOUS_BLOW:
### Refraction of the Obvious Blow
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a marked creature misses you with an attack roll, use one Refraction Response that targets that creature without spending your Reaction.
Use Refraction of the Obvious Blow once per round.
TAL_GLASS_SHARD_NEEDLE:
### Shard Needle
When you use Glass Shard, increase its normal range to 60 feet if the shard comes from a held, worn, or touched Glass Surface.
If you are a Body Refiner using your own body as the source, you may keep the range at 30 feet and add your Constitution modifier to one damage roll from Glass Shard once per turn.
TAL_GLASS_SPELL_LINE_CRACK:
### Spell-Line Crack
Prerequisite: Hidden Crack Study, CL 10+
When a marked creature casts a spell, spends CP, or activates a supernatural feature while you can see it through a Glass Surface, use your Reaction and spend the mark.
The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
reduce the damage of the triggering effect by 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus against one target;
one target of the effect gains Advantage on one saving throw against it;
if the effect requires Concentration, the creature has Disadvantage on the first Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain that Concentration before the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Spell-Line Crack does not cancel the triggering effect.
TAL_GLASS_TEN_ANGLE_REFRACTION:
### Ten-Angle Refraction
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you spend a Faultline Mark, choose one ally within 30 feet who can see a Glass Surface you control.
That ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the marked creature.
If the ally ends this movement behind Cover, holding a Glass Surface, or adjacent to Shattered Glass Terrain you created, the ally gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_GLASS_THOUSAND_PANE_PALACE:
### Thousand-Pane Palace - Projected
Prerequisite: Palace Lens Array, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: Up to ten 5-foot panes arranged within range
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Create a palace of suspended transparent panes, lenses, and angular roads.
For the duration:
each pane is a Glass Surface;
hostile creatures that move through a space adjacent to two or more panes gain a Faultline Mark, once per turn;
allies adjacent to a pane gain Half Cover against ranged attacks;
you may use Refracted Step from one pane to another pane within 30 feet of it;
when one pane breaks, create Shattered Glass Terrain in its space until the effect ends.
A Body Refining cultivator may learn this talent only with external-projection permission.
TAL_GLASS_TRANSPARENT_DEFENSE:
### Transparent Defense
When you benefit from Cover granted by a transparent Glass Surface, you may still draw line of sight through that surface for your Glass talents.
This does not let you draw line of effect through a surface that physically blocks the effect.
TAL_GLASS_WALKING_PANE_BODY:
### Walking Pane Body
Prerequisite: Glass-Bone Guard, CL 5+
When your body is your tempered Glass Surface, you may maintain two Glass-Bone Guard benefits at once.
In addition, once per round when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you may place a Faultline Mark on that creature without using your Reaction.
If you spend that mark before the end of your next turn, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_GLASS_WALL_TOUCH_SCRIPTURE:
### Wall-Touch Scripture
Prerequisite: Contact Pane, CL 5+
When you use Contact Pane, you may affect a continuous surface up to two 5-foot squares.
At CL 11, this increases to three squares. At CL 17, this increases to four squares.
A creature that willingly crosses a Contact Pane surface may gain a Faultline Mark even if it does not damage the surface.
TAL_GRAVITY_ANCHOR_STANCE:
#### Anchor Stance
Tag: Weight Art, Anchor Art.
While Body Heavying is active and you are touching a solid surface, you reduce forced movement affecting you by 10 feet.
If this reduces the movement to 0, you may use your Reaction to regain Martial Focus, if your table uses Martial Focus for martial spheres.
At CL 5, you may also extend this benefit to one willing adjacent ally until the start of your next turn.
TAL_GRAVITY_CRUSHING_FIELD:
#### Crushing Field
Tag: Field Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 4 CP or Stamina.
The area becomes difficult terrain for hostile creatures. When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 3d6 Force damage and falls Prone.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and does not fall Prone.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
Scaling:
CL 11: damage becomes 5d6.
CL 17: damage becomes 7d6.
TAL_GRAVITY_EXTERNAL_WEIGHT_SHIFT:
### Base Technique - External Weight Shift
Tag: Field Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 1 CP or Stamina.
Choose one creature or object no larger than Large. If the target is willing, you may choose Body Lightening or Body Heavying for it. If the target is unwilling, choose Burden or Uplift.
Burden: The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet, its jump distance is halved, and it has Disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful initial save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Uplift: The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its first movement on its next turn is unstable: it must spend 10 feet of movement to remain grounded, or it rises 10 feet upward and then falls at the end of the turn if nothing holds it aloft. On a successful save, it rises only 5 feet or may immediately fall Prone to avoid the rise.
Objects: The GM determines how increased or decreased weight affects doors, bridges, ropes, carts, armor, siege engines, or carried objects. Gravity does not automatically destroy objects without a talent that deals damage or causes structural stress.
TAL_GRAVITY_FALLING_HAMMER:
#### Falling Hammer
Tag: Weight Art, Fall Art.
When you fall or descend at least 10 feet before hitting a creature with a melee attack on the same turn, you may activate Weighted Strike without requiring Body Heavying to be active.
If the attack hits, add an extra 1d6 Force damage in addition to the normal Weighted Strike damage. You take no falling damage from the first 30 feet of the descent.
At CL 11, the extra damage becomes 2d6.
TAL_GRAVITY_FLIGHT_SUPPRESSION:
#### Flight Suppression
Tag: Field Art, Anchor Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 5 CP or Stamina.
Creatures inside the area cannot fly easily. A creature flying inside the area makes a Strength saving throw at the start of each of its turns.
Failed Save: Its Fly Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Its Fly Speed is halved until the start of its next turn.
A creature without Hover falls when its Fly Speed becomes 0.
TAL_GRAVITY_GRAVITY_WELL:
#### Gravity Well
Tag: Field Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere.
Cost: 3 CP or Stamina.
Creatures of your choice inside the area make Strength saving throws.
Failed Save: Pull the creature up to 20 feet toward the center.
Successful Save: Pull the creature 5 feet toward the center.
A creature pulled into the center falls Prone unless it succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw.
Unsecured objects and loose terrain may also slide toward the center.
TAL_GRAVITY_WEIGHT_OF_THE_MOUNTAIN:
#### Weight of the Mountain
Tag: Field Art, Anchor Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 4 CP or Stamina.
Choose one creature no larger than Huge. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained by multiplied weight. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
A flying creature that fails the save falls if it cannot Hover.
TAL_GRAVITY_WEIGHT_SHIFT_BASE:
### Base Ability - Weight Shift
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self.
Duration: Until the start of your next turn.
Cost: 0 for the basic self version.
Choose one mode: Body Lightening, Body Heavying, or Neutral Weight.
You may change modes only once on each of your turns unless a talent says otherwise. If you are Incapacitated, your Weight Shift becomes Neutral Weight.
#### Body Lightening
Until the start of your next turn, your body becomes lighter, quicker, and less bound to the ground.
Benefits:
Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
Your jump distance increases by a number of feet equal to 5 + your Proficiency Bonus.
You reduce any falling damage you take by an amount equal to 5 times your Proficiency Bonus.
You gain Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to escape a Grapple or move across narrow, fragile, or unstable footing.
If you move at least 10 feet before making a melee attack on your turn, you may use your Gravity key ability in place of Strength or Dexterity for that attack roll if the weapon is an unarmed strike, simple melee weapon, monk-like martial implement, spear, sword, staff, or other GM-approved mobile martial weapon.
Body Lightening does not grant flight by itself.
#### Body Heavying
Until the start of your next turn, your body becomes denser, more rooted, and harder to displace.
Benefits:
Your Speed is reduced by 5 feet, to a minimum of 5 feet.
You count as one size larger when resisting Shove, Grapple, forced movement, and effects that would knock you Prone.
You gain Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws made to resist forced movement or being knocked Prone.
Your carrying, dragging, lifting, and pushing capacity doubles.
If you do not move more than half your Speed on your turn, the first melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike you hit with before the start of your next turn deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The damage type is the attack’s normal damage type, or Force if the attack is a supernatural Gravity technique.
Body Heavying does not increase your size and does not automatically increase weapon reach.
#### Neutral Weight
You return to normal weight. Ending Weight Shift early requires no action on your turn.
TAL_GUARDIAN_COMPLEX_PATROL:
### Complex Patrol — Focus Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When establishing Patrol, expend Martial Focus.
Apply two Zone talents you know instead of one.
TAL_GUARDIAN_COURT_OF_THE_UNBROKEN_GATE:
### Court of the Unbroken Gate — Guardian Domain
“Behind me.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You become the living center of a defensive court.
For the duration:
#### You
Increase your Held Harm Pool maximum by your Cultivation Level.
Reduce forced movement affecting you by 20 feet.
Gain Advantage on checks and saving throws made to resist Grappled, Prone, or Restrained.
Use Interpose once per round without spending your Reaction.
#### Allies Inside the Court
Gain +1 AC.
Gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened.
Reduce forced movement affecting them by 10 feet.
Gain Half Cover while within 10 feet of you.
#### Enemies Inside the Court
Treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain.
Provoke opportunity attacks from you when entering your melee reach.
Court of the Unbroken Gate ends early if you become Incapacitated.
TAL_GUARDIAN_DEEP_RESERVOIR:
### Deep Reservoir — Resilience Talent
Increase your Held Harm Pool maximum by:
your Cultivation Level
You may learn Deep Reservoir twice.
Its effects stack.
TAL_GUARDIAN_DISRUPTIVE_PATROL:
### Disruptive Patrol — Zone Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a hostile creature inside your Patrol Zone begins activating a supernatural effect that requires an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, it provokes a Patrol Response from you before completing the activation.
If your Patrol attack deals damage, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw as though maintaining Concentration.
Failed Save: The activation fails. The Action is spent, but CP, spell slots, and comparable limited-use resources are not spent.
Successful Save: The activation resolves normally.
Disruptive Patrol does not interrupt:
passive effects;
effects requiring no Action;
Domains already active;
Secret Inheritances unless they explicitly permit interruption.
TAL_GUARDIAN_EXPANDED_GUARDIAN:
### Expanded Guardian
Gain one Guardian Practice you do not already possess.
You gain its base ability.
TAL_GUARDIAN_FLUSH_OF_VICTORY:
### Flush of Victory — Challenge Talent
When a creature Challenged by you is reduced to 0 HP, gain Temporary HP equal to:
your Cultivation Level
The creature must be a meaningful threat.
A creature with a Challenge Rating lower than half your Cultivation Level normally does not qualify unless the GM determines that its defeat mattered meaningfully in the scene.
TAL_GUARDIAN_FORTRESS_BREAKER_S_DENIAL:
### Fortress-Breaker’s Denial — Patrol Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One hostile creature within 30 feet moves, teleports, or is forcibly moved
Use Limit: Once per round
Move up to half your Speed into one legal unoccupied space adjacent to the creature.
This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
its movement ends immediately;
it falls Prone;
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Reduce its remaining movement by 10 feet.
Fortress-Breaker’s Denial cannot prevent movement caused by a Secret Inheritance, major calamity, or effect that explicitly cannot be interrupted.
TAL_GUARDIAN_GUARDIAN_S_REPRISAL:
### Guardian’s Reprisal — Rescue Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Trigger: You use Interpose or Take the Blow
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per turn
After the triggering effect resolves, make one melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or natural weapon attack against the attacker if it remains within your melee reach.
Hit: Deal the attack’s ordinary damage plus 2d8 additional damage of the same type.
TAL_GUARDIAN_HEAVEN_DEFYING_BULWARK:
### Heaven-Defying Bulwark
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or allies within 30 feet would take damage from one effect
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose any number of affected creatures within 30 feet.
Reduce the damage dealt to each chosen creature by:
5d10 + your key ability modifier
If one chosen creature takes no damage after this reduction, it may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after the triggering effect resolves.
Heaven-Defying Bulwark may reduce area damage.
TAL_GUARDIAN_INESCAPABLE_CHALLENGE:
### Inescapable Challenge — Challenge Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a creature Challenged by you willingly attempts to move farther away from you, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Its attempted movement ends before carrying it farther away.
Successful Save: It moves normally.
If the movement is created by teleportation or another supernatural effect:
a failed saving throw prevents that movement;
the Action is spent;
CP, spell slots, item charges, or comparable limited resources are not spent unless another effect says otherwise.
Inescapable Challenge does not stop forced movement caused by another creature.
TAL_GUARDIAN_I_WILL_COME:
### I Will Come — Rite Talent
Prerequisite: I Will Hear, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Target: One creature carrying your I Will Hear vow that has called you
Use Limit: Once per bonded creature per long rest
Teleport into one legal unoccupied space within 10 feet of the calling creature.
You may bring:
equipment up to your ordinary carrying capacity;
a number of willing creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Every creature traveling with you must remain in physical contact with you or with another creature in the traveling group.
A Large creature counts as two creatures. A Huge creature counts as four. A Gargantuan creature counts as eight.
I Will Come cannot cross planar boundaries until CL 17.
At CL 17:
I Will Hear functions across planar boundaries;
you learn which plane contains the calling creature;
I Will Come may cross planar boundaries if no specialized seal, Dimensional Lock, or comparable effect prevents it.
TAL_GUARDIAN_I_WILL_HEAR:
### I Will Hear — Rite Talent
Prerequisite: Interpose, CL 10+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Until ended
Form a guardian vow with the target.
A creature carrying your vow may call your name, title, or agreed signal as a Reaction.
While you remain on the same plane and within:
10 miles × your Cultivation Level
you immediately know:
that the creature called;
its approximate direction;
whether it is uninjured, Bloodied, Unconscious, or dying.
You may maintain a number of I Will Hear vows equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you exceed this limit, choose one older vow to end.
You may end one vow without spending an Action.
I Will Hear is a supernatural guardian bond, not telepathy. It does not reveal an exact square, transmit a conversation, or compel you to answer.
TAL_GUARDIAN_MAGEGUARD:
### Mageguard — Challenge Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
A creature Challenged by you has Disadvantage on saving throws made to maintain Concentration while it remains within your melee reach.
TAL_GUARDIAN_PUNISHING_CHALLENGE:
### Punishing Challenge — Challenge Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Use Limit: Once per turn per creature
When a creature Challenged by you makes an attack roll with Disadvantage because it did not include you as a target, it takes your choice of Psychic or Radiant damage equal to:
your Cultivation Level
Choose the damage type when you learn this talent.
TAL_GUARDIAN_PUNISHING_REBUKE:
### Punishing Rebuke — Zone Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a hostile creature inside your Patrol Zone makes an attack roll against an ally other than you, that creature provokes a Patrol Response from you after the attack resolves.
Punishing Rebuke can trigger only once per creature’s turn.
TAL_GUARDIAN_PUNISHMENT_RETURNED:
### Punishment Returned — Resilience Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Trigger: You hit one creature with a melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or natural weapon attack while your Held Harm Pool contains damage
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per round
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take additional damage equal to the current damage stored in your Held Harm Pool.
Successful Save: Take half as much additional damage.
The additional damage has the same type as the triggering attack.
Punishment Returned does not empty or reduce your Held Harm Pool.
If you are delaying one effect through Durable or Cold Iron Call, you may choose to attempt to transmit one delayed effect instead of dealing the additional damage.
The target makes the saving throw originally allowed by that effect, using its original DC where available or your Cultivation Save DC otherwise.
Failed Save: The transmitted effect applies to the target.
Successful Save: The transmission fails.
Whether the transmission succeeds or fails, the delayed effect ends for you.
A Domain, Secret Inheritance, curse, or major narrative effect cannot be transmitted this way unless it explicitly permits it.
TAL_GUARDIAN_SHIELD_COMPANION:
### Shield Companion — Rescue Talent
When an ally adjacent to you makes a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that deals half damage on a successful save, use your Reaction.
Grant the ally:
+ your Proficiency Bonus
to the saving throw result, potentially turning failure into success.
If the ally succeeds, you may move it 5 feet into one legal space adjacent to you after the effect resolves.
This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
TAL_GUARDIAN_SINGULARITY_PATROL:
### Singularity Patrol — Zone Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Your Patrol Zone becomes spiritually heavy with your insistence that enemies answer you first.
When a hostile creature starts its turn inside your Patrol Zone, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Pull the creature 5 feet toward you, stopping when it becomes adjacent to you.
Successful Save: No pull.
Movement directed away from you costs a hostile creature 10 feet of movement for every 5 feet traveled while it remains inside the Patrol Zone.
At CL 11, increase the pull distance to 10 feet.
Singularity Patrol does not provoke opportunity attacks through its forced movement.
TAL_GUARDIAN_STAND_AGAINST_THE_CALAMITY:
### Stand Against the Calamity
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Plant your stance and refuse destruction.
For the duration:
you cannot willingly move;
allies inside gain +2 AC;
allies inside gain Advantage on saving throws;
allies inside reduce all damage taken by your Proficiency Bonus;
structures and Formation Anchors inside gain Resistance to all damage;
an enemy attempting to forcibly move one creature inside makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The forced movement fails.
Successful Save: Move the target only half the normal distance.
Stand Against the Calamity ends early if you become Incapacitated or willingly move.
TAL_GUARDIAN_STAND_STILL:
### Stand Still — Zone Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit a hostile creature with a Patrol attack, reduce its Speed to 0 until the start of its next turn.
TAL_GUARDIAN_STEEL_HEDGE:
### Steel Hedge — Zone Talent
Hostile creatures treat your Patrol Zone as difficult terrain.
Steel Hedge does not increase the cost of forced movement.
TAL_GUARDIAN_STEEL_HIDE:
### Steel Hide — Challenge Talent
When a creature Challenged by you scores a critical hit against you, you may end your Challenge on that creature.
If you do, the triggering attack deals ordinary damage instead of critical-hit damage.
Steel Hide does not prevent additional effects caused specifically by a critical hit unless those effects depend on the additional critical-hit damage.
TAL_GUARDIAN_SWIFT_GUARDIAN:
### Swift Guardian — Focus Talent
When activating Challenge or Patrol, expend Martial Focus to change its Action Type:
activate Challenge without spending an Action during your turn;
activate Patrol as a Bonus Action.
If you possess Mass Challenge, expend Martial Focus to use Mass Challenge as a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
TAL_GUARDIAN_TAKE_THE_BLOW:
### Take the Blow — Rescue Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: None
Take half of the triggering damage, rounded down, instead of the ally.
The ally takes the remaining damage.
Your portion:
retains the original damage types until reductions are applied;
may be reduced by your Resistance, Immunity, or ordinary damage reductions;
may then be redirected into Held Harm normally;
cannot be transferred again.
After taking your portion, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_ICE_AVALANCHE_WRITING:
#### Avalanche Writing
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature falls Prone, is pushed, pulled, knocked back, or moved by one of your Ice features
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP
You extend the lattice along the creature’s failed path. Create a number of Lattice Spaces equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each new space must be adjacent to the triggering creature’s path, destination, or starting space.
These spaces last until the end of your next turn and do not count against your Lattice Limit.
TAL_ICE_BITTER_EDGE:
#### Bitter Edge
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You coat one weapon, natural weapon, or unarmed strike with hard ice. Once on each of the wielder’s turns, when it hits a creature with that weapon or strike, it may deal extra Cold or Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target is standing on one of your Lattice Spaces, it also gains a Fracture Mark.
TAL_ICE_CRYSTAL_STEP:
#### Crystal Step
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Cost: 1 CP
You move along your lattice as though sliding through a written line. Teleport from one of your Lattice Spaces you occupy to another of your Lattice Spaces within 60 feet that you can see.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. If you appear adjacent to a creature with a Fracture Mark, you may immediately move that mark to another creature within 10 feet of you.
TAL_ICE_CRYSTAL_WEATHER_SCRIPT:
#### Crystal Weather Script
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Snow-grain ice and floating crystal lines fill the area. The area is Lightly Obscured and is difficult terrain for hostile creatures.
When a hostile creature starts its turn in the area, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take Cold damage equal to your Shard Needle damage and gain a Fracture Mark.
A strong wind does not disperse this weather, but a Fire sphere technique, Weather sphere technique, or comparable effect of equal or higher Realm may end it at the GM’s discretion.
TAL_ICE_DIAMOND_RIME_BODY:
#### Diamond Rime Body
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Your body becomes lined with rime channels and crystalline qi. For the duration:
you gain Resistance to Cold damage;
you have Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone or moved against your will;
when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you may create one Lattice Space under yourself or the attacker without using an Action;
the first time each round you use Crystal Guard on yourself, you do not count it against your once-per-round limit on spending Fracture Marks.
This talent does not make you immune to freezing, suffocation, restraint, or environmental hazards unless those hazards deal Cold damage and the Resistance applies.
TAL_ICE_FROST_SHEATHED_GUARD:
#### Frost-Sheathed Guard
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: You or one willing creature
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Guard, Lattice
A thin lattice of ice forms over the target’s clothing, armor, skin, or aura. The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier.
While any of these Temporary HP remain, the first creature that hits the target with a melee attack before the effect ends gains a Fracture Mark.
A creature can benefit from only one Frost-Sheathed Guard at a time.
TAL_ICE_FROZEN_MERIDIAN_BIND:
#### Frozen Meridian Bind
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Fracture Mark with Catch Step and the target is on or adjacent to one of your Lattice Spaces
Cost: 1 CP
The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Restrained by ice until the end of its next turn. A Restrained creature can use its Action to repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A creature that succeeds on the initial save has its Speed reduced by the Catch Step effect but is not Restrained.
TAL_ICE_FROZEN_RIVER_REVERSAL:
#### Frozen River Reversal
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with a Fracture Mark moves or teleports from one space in your Frost Lattice to another space within 120 feet
Cost: 3 CP
The target must make a Strength saving throw if it moved physically, or a Charisma saving throw if it teleported. On a failed save, the movement resolves, then the target is returned to the space where the triggering movement began, or the nearest unoccupied space if that space is occupied.
On a success, the movement is not reversed, but the target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
This talent does not undo attacks, spellcasting, object interactions, or other effects performed before or after the movement. It only reverses the movement path.
TAL_ICE_FROZEN_TRAJECTORY_SEAL:
#### Frozen Trajectory Seal
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A ranged attack, line effect, thrown object, or visible projectile passes through or within 5 feet of one of your Lattice Spaces
Cost: 4 CP
