The projectile’s path crystallizes. Reduce the triggering attack roll by 1d10, or grant one target of the triggering line effect a +1d10 bonus to its saving throw.
If this causes the attack to miss or the target to succeed on the saving throw, you may suspend the visible projectile or line in ice until the start of your next turn. During that time, the path is visible, harmless, and counts as Frost Lattice for your Ice talents. At the start of your next turn, the suspended path shatters and ends.
This does not stop effects that have no visible path, no projectile, no line, or no trajectory through space.
TAL_ICE_GLACIER_WALL:
#### Glacier Wall
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Tags: Barrier, Lattice
You create a wall of solid ice on surfaces within range. The wall is made of up to six 5-foot panels. Each panel must be contiguous with another panel or a solid surface. A panel can be vertical, horizontal, or angled.
Each panel is an object with AC 12 + your Proficiency Bonus, Hit Points equal to 10 + twice your Cultivation Level, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage, and Vulnerability to Fire damage. A panel provides cover normally for a solid object of its size and blocks line of effect through its space.
A Glacier Wall panel counts as one of your Lattice Spaces for talents that refer to your Frost Lattice, but it does not count against your Lattice Limit.
TAL_ICE_HEAVEN_SEALING_ICE_SCRIPT:
#### Heaven-Sealing Ice Script
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with a Fracture Mark within 60 feet begins casting a spell, using a sphere talent, spending CP, or activating a named supernatural feature
Cost: 3 CP
You do not counter the technique. Instead, you freeze its outer path. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or choose one:
the triggering effect’s range is reduced by 30 feet, to a minimum of touch;
the triggering effect’s area is reduced by 10 feet in one dimension, to a minimum of 5 feet;
the triggering effect cannot move creatures or objects more than 10 feet;
the triggering effect’s first damage roll is reduced by your Cultivation Level.
If none of these choices can apply, this talent has no effect and the CP is not spent.
TAL_ICE_ICE_COFFIN:
#### Ice Coffin
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature with a Fracture Mark that is on or adjacent to one of your Lattice Spaces
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it becomes Restrained inside a shell of ice. While Restrained this way, the creature has Cover against attacks from outside the shell, cannot move from its space, and its voice is muffled but not silenced.
At the end of each of its turns, the target may repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. The shell is also an object with AC 12 + your Proficiency Bonus and Hit Points equal to 10 + twice your Cultivation Level. If the shell is destroyed, the effect ends.
This talent does not paralyze the target, prevent teleportation, stop purely mental actions, or prevent features that do not require physical movement unless the feature says otherwise.
TAL_ICE_ICE_DOMAIN_PALACE_OF_WRITTEN_WIN:
#### Ice Domain: Palace of Written Winter
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Tags: Domain, Lattice
You unfold a crystalline palace of frozen lines. The ground, walls, water, and suitable surfaces in the area become your Frost Lattice for the duration. This does not count against your Lattice Limit.
While the Domain lasts:
you may use Fracture Responses against marked creatures anywhere in the Domain;
a hostile creature that moves at least 10 feet inside the Domain gains a Fracture Mark at the end of that movement;
your safe creatures ignore difficult terrain caused by ice or snow inside the Domain;
when you spend a Fracture Mark inside the Domain, you may create one Lattice Space in the Domain without using an Action.
When the Domain ends, all temporary Lattice Spaces created by it end.
TAL_ICE_ICE_SEALS_THE_DOOR:
#### Ice Seals the Door
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One door, chest, gate, window, latch, hinge, wheel, lever, or similar object no larger than a 10-foot cube
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You freeze a mundane mechanism in place. A creature must use an Action and succeed on a Strength check against your Ice Save DC to open, force, turn, or operate the object.
This does not prevent magical opening, teleportation, incorporeal passage, or effects that ignore the object unless the GM rules the effect physically interacts with the frozen mechanism.
At CL 11, the duration becomes 10 minutes.
TAL_ICE_IMMORTAL_WINTER_CRUCIBLE:
#### Immortal Winter Crucible
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
You become the center of a slow, grinding winter. For the duration:
whenever you create one or more Lattice Spaces, create one additional Lattice Space;
once on each of your turns, you may spend a Fracture Mark without counting against your once-per-round limit;
when a Lattice Space you created is destroyed, you may deal Cold or Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to one hostile creature within 5 feet of that space;
you have Resistance to Cold and Piercing damage.
When this talent ends, you must choose half of your active Lattice Spaces, rounded down, to end immediately.
TAL_ICE_LIVING_GLACIER_ADVANCE:
#### Living Glacier Advance
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 2 CP
Move any number of your Lattice Spaces up to 10 feet each along surfaces they could legally occupy. A Lattice Space cannot move through a creature’s space unless the creature is willing or Incapacitated.
A hostile creature whose space is entered by a moving Lattice Space must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or be pushed 5 feet in the direction the lattice moved and gain a Fracture Mark. On a success, the creature chooses whether to move 5 feet to an unoccupied adjacent space or allow the lattice to pass harmlessly beneath it.
TAL_ICE_MIRROR_SLICK_FLOOR:
#### Mirror-Slick Floor
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: A creature gains a Fracture Mark because it moved across one of your Lattice Spaces
Cost: None
The marked creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. A creature that moved half its Speed or less during the turn has Advantage on this save.
A creature that succeeds on the save is immune to your Mirror-Slick Floor until the start of your next turn.
TAL_ICE_NINEFOLD_CRACK_CALCULATION:
#### Ninefold Crack Calculation
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Fracture Mark
Cost: 1 CP
Choose a second Fracture Response that has a different trigger from the first but can reasonably apply to the same event. Apply both responses to the marked target.
For example, when a marked creature moves across your lattice, you might use Catch Step and Shatter Space. When a marked creature is hit by an attack while standing on your lattice, you might use Brittle Opening and Shatter Space.
You cannot choose the same response twice.
TAL_ICE_PALACE_WHERE_FOOTSTEPS_BECOME_WA:
#### Palace Where Footsteps Become Walls
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Ice Domain: Palace of Written Winter
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: A hostile creature in your Ice Domain moves at least 10 feet
Cost: 2 CP
After the movement resolves, create a number of Glacier Wall panels equal to your Proficiency Bonus along spaces the creature moved through or adjacent to those spaces. These panels last until the start of your next turn and do not cost additional CP.
The panels cannot appear in occupied spaces, but they may split groups, block retreat, seal doors, divide lines of sight, or create cover.
TAL_ICE_RIME_HOOK:
#### Rime Hook
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Fracture Mark with Catch Step or Shatter Space
Cost: None
You may move the marked target 5 feet to an unoccupied space that is part of your Frost Lattice or adjacent to it. This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
At CL 11, you may move the target 10 feet instead.
TAL_ICE_RIME_MIRROR_SURFACE:
#### Rime Mirror Surface
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One of your Lattice Spaces
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
The chosen Lattice Space becomes a clear mirror of ice. While you are within 60 feet of it, you can see and hear from that space as if standing there. You are Blinded and Deafened to your own body’s senses while using the mirror in this way, unless you end the perception at any time.
A creature that studies the mirror with the Study action and succeeds on an Intelligence (Arcana or Investigation) check against your Ice Save DC realizes it is being used as a sensory focus.
TAL_ICE_SHATTER_BLOOM:
#### Shatter Bloom
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One or more of your Lattice Spaces
Cost: 2 CP
Tags: Shatter
Choose up to a number of your Lattice Spaces equal to your Proficiency Bonus within range. Each chosen space shatters and ends. Each creature in a chosen space or within 5 feet of one must make a Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes Cold or Piercing damage equal to your Shard Needle damage + your Key Ability modifier and falls Prone. On a success, it takes half as much damage and does not fall Prone.
A creature can be affected by only one shattering space from this talent each time you use it.
TAL_ICE_SNOW_SCRIPT_TOOL:
#### Snow-Script Tool
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: None
You create a simple tool, wedge, spike, hook, cup, splint, key blank, mirror, measuring rod, or similar handheld object of ice. The object cannot function as a weapon unless the GM allows it to count as an improvised weapon. It melts or shatters when the duration ends.
The object is clear enough to hold simple writing or a diagram within it. You may use this talent to preserve a footprint, seal impression, wound outline, drop of liquid, or similar physical trace inside ice for the duration.
TAL_ICE_SURE_FOOTED_DISCIPLE:
#### Sure-Footed Disciple
Action Type: Passive
Cost: None
You have trained your body and qi to read ice as a written path. You ignore difficult terrain created by ice, snow, frost, or your own Ice sphere features.
When you create Lattice Spaces, you may designate two additional safe creatures.
TAL_ICE_THE_WORLD_BECOMES_A_SINGLE_CRYST:
#### The World Becomes a Single Crystal
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, GM permission
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 120-foot-radius sphere centered on you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 10 CPRecharge: Once per Long Rest
Tags: Secret Inheritance, Domain, Lattice
You reveal the forbidden completion of the Ice Dao: for one minute, every path in the battlefield is part of a single crystal.
For the duration:
all ground, walls, ceilings, liquids, bridges, stairs, and similar surfaces in the area count as your Frost Lattice;
this lattice does not count against your Lattice Limit;
hostile creatures cannot benefit from being safe on your lattice unless you choose them;
the first time each hostile creature moves at least 5 feet on its turn, it gains a Fracture Mark;
you may spend Fracture Marks twice per round instead of once per round;
when you use Shatter Space, you may choose not to end the Lattice Space if that space is part of the Secret Inheritance’s area rather than a separate Lattice Space you created.
Once during the duration, when a creature with a Fracture Mark within the area begins movement, makes an attack roll, forces a saving throw, teleports, or activates a named technique, you may declare that the world has found the crack in that act. The creature must make a saving throw appropriate to the act: Strength for physical movement or melee force, Dexterity for ranged attack or evasive motion, Constitution for breath/body/meridian pressure, Intelligence for spell geometry or Formation logic, Wisdom for spiritual pressure, or Charisma for teleportation, command, or soul assertion.
On a failed save, the triggering act still begins, but its path freezes before completion. The movement is reduced to 0, the attack misses, one target automatically succeeds on the saving throw, the teleport fails to move the creature, or the named technique loses its first damage roll or movement effect, as appropriate to the trigger. On a success, the triggering act resolves normally, but the creature takes Cold or Piercing damage equal to twice your Shard Needle damage and loses its Fracture Mark.
This Secret Inheritance cannot erase an event that has already fully resolved. It freezes the path before completion.
When the duration ends, all ice created by this Secret Inheritance cracks at once. Each hostile creature of your choice standing on the lattice must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone.
TAL_ICE_THOUSAND_FACET_PRISON:
#### Thousand-Facet Prison
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Ice Coffin
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: One creature with a Fracture Mark
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
The target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is trapped in a many-faceted prison of ice and is Restrained. While Restrained this way, the target cannot benefit from teleportation that would move it outside the prison unless it first succeeds on a Charisma saving throw against your Ice Save DC as part of the teleportation effect.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Strength saving throw, ending the prison on itself on a success. Each failed repeat save gives the target one additional Fracture Mark, ignoring your usual one-mark limit for that target. When the prison ends, all Fracture Marks on the target beyond one immediately end.
The prison is an object with AC 15 + your Proficiency Bonus and Hit Points equal to 20 + three times your Cultivation Level. Destroying the prison ends the effect.
TAL_ICE_WHITE_STEP_COUNTER:
#### White Step Counter
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive moves out of a space within 10 feet of one of your Lattice Spaces
Cost: None
You make the path behind the creature crack in pursuit. The triggering creature gains a Fracture Mark.
If the creature was moving away from you or from one of your allies, you may also move 5 feet onto one of your Lattice Spaces without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
TAL_ICE_WINTER_PALACE_REMEMBERS_THE_INTR:
#### Winter Palace Remembers the Intruder
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Passive
Whenever a creature with a Fracture Mark damages one of your Lattice Spaces, destroys a Glacier Wall panel, or escapes one of your Ice restraints, it remains written into your lattice for 1 minute.
For that duration, the first time on each of your turns that the creature touches one of your Lattice Spaces, you may give it a Fracture Mark without using an Action. You always know whether that creature is touching your Frost Lattice while it is within 1 mile of you, unless blocked by a higher-Realm concealment or Void effect.
TAL_ICE_WINTER_STORES_THE_BLOW:
#### Winter Stores the Blow
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see takes damage while standing on one of your Lattice Spaces
Cost: 1 CP
The lattice stores part of the impact. Reduce the triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier. One Lattice Space under or adjacent to the creature gains a stored fracture.
The next time you use Shatter Space or Shatter Bloom on that space before the end of your next turn, add the amount reduced by this talent to one damage roll against one creature affected by that shatter.
TAL_ICE_WORLD_FANG_ICEFALL:
#### World-Fang Icefall
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 150 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder
Cost: 6 CP
Tags: Lattice, Shatter
You call down a formation of falling ice spears, plates, and crystalline script. The area becomes Frost Lattice until the end of your next turn and does not count against your Lattice Limit.
Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes Cold or Piercing damage equal to twice your Shard Needle damage, falls Prone, and gains a Fracture Mark. On a success, it takes half damage and does not fall Prone or gain a mark.
Until the lattice ends, the area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and the first time a hostile creature moves at least 10 feet in the area, you may use Shatter Space against it without spending a Fracture Mark. You must still obey the once-per-round limit unless another feature changes it.
TAL_ILLUSION_APPLY_GLAMER:
#### Apply Glamer
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or object
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: As the glamer talent
Tags: Glamer, Veil
You attach an illusion to a creature or object. Choose one Glamer talent you know and apply it to the target. The glamer moves with the target.
A glamer does not create an independent creature or object. It changes how the target is perceived. The target’s physical statistics, equipment, and true position do not change unless the talent says otherwise.
Augment 2 CP: The glamer lasts for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment on your turn after creating the glamer without using an Action.
TAL_ILLUSION_BORROWED_VOICE:
#### Borrowed Voice
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: None
Tags: Image, Figment
You create a voice, cry, animal call, whisper, echo, chant, shouted order, or other audible illusion at a point within range. The sound can repeat, carry a short message, or move up to 30 feet on each of your turns as a Bonus Action.
A creature that hears the sound may Study it. A creature familiar with a specific voice has Advantage on the check unless you have heard that voice for at least 1 minute or the creature is currently within 60 feet and speaking.
When a creature acts on the sound as if it were real, you may use Create Figment’s False Premise trigger even if the illusion has no visual component.
TAL_ILLUSION_COMPLEX_FIGMENTS:
#### Complex Figments
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Part of Create Figment
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Figment
When you use Create Figment, you may split the illusion into several smaller figments. You can control all figments created by the same use of this talent with the same Action.
| CL | Number of Figments |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 3 figments |
| 5-10 | 4 figments |
| 11-16 | 5 figments |
| 17-20 | 6 figments |
Each figment can be no larger than half your normal figment size. The figments must remain within the original range.
TAL_ILLUSION_CONTROL_FIGMENT:
#### Control Figment
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One figment you can perceive
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Figment
You attempt to seize control of an existing figment. Make a Cultivation Check against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC. On a success, you control the figment for as long as you maintain Concentration or until the original creator ends it.
You may command the figment as if you had created it, but you do not change its original CL, duration, sensory talents, or other variables. If the figment required Concentration, you must assume Concentration over it.
TAL_ILLUSION_COURT_FALSE_PREMISES:
#### Illusion Domain: Court of False Premises
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CPConcentration: Required
Tags: Premise, Image, Veil
You establish a Domain in which the first interpretation is never safe.
When you create the Domain, choose one dominant illusion: false battlefield geometry, a crowd of illusory bodies, false weather, a false sect hall, an impossible mirrorless court, a false moonlit road, a ritual stage, a phantom army, or another strong premise approved by the GM.
While the Domain lasts:
your Illusion talents have their range increased by 30 feet while targeting a creature or space inside the Domain;
once per round, when a hostile creature inside the Domain fails a saving throw or Study check against your Illusion talent, you may trigger a Misdirection Response without ending that talent;
creatures of your choice have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth), Charisma (Deception), and Charisma (Performance) checks made inside the Domain;
your figments and glamers inside the Domain may include sight and sound without paying the 1 CP augment.
A hostile creature that starts its turn inside the Domain and can perceive it may use its Action to Study the Domain. On a success, that creature ignores the Domain’s broad false scenery, but not your individual Illusion talents.
TAL_ILLUSION_CREATE_FIGMENT:
#### Create Figment
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: None
Tags: Image, Figment, Premise
You create the image or sound of something that is not actually there. Examples include a wall, beast, cultivator, banner, footstep, voice, warning bell, spirit-lantern, falling stone, corpse, door, or patch of false terrain.
The figment’s maximum area increases with your Cultivation Level.
| CL | Maximum Figment Size |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 10-foot cube |
| 5-10 | 15-foot cube |
| 11-16 | 20-foot cube |
| 17-20 | 25-foot cube |
As long as you are within range of the figment, you may use your Action to move it to another point within range. As it moves, you may alter its appearance so the movement seems natural, such as making a false beast run or a false guard gesture. If you do not use your Action to control it, the figment repeats a simple motion or remains still.
When a creature that can perceive the figment makes an attack roll, targets a creature with a harmful effect, moves willingly, takes a Reaction, or makes a Perception, Insight, Investigation, or Survival check while acting on the figment as if it were real, you may force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature gains one False Premise from you until the start of your next turn.
Augment 1 CP: The figment includes both sight and sound. If you have Sensory talents, you may apply any of those sensory layers as part of the same figment.
Augment 1 CP: Increase the figment’s maximum area by one step: 20-foot cube at CL 1-4, 30-foot cube at CL 5-10, 40-foot cube at CL 11-16, and 50-foot cube at CL 17-20.
Augment 2 CP: The figment lasts for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment on your turn after creating the figment without using an Action.
TAL_ILLUSION_FALSE_DOUBLE:
#### False Double
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive targets you with an attack roll
Range: Self
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Decoy, Glamer
A false double splits from your body at the moment of danger. Roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the attack targets the double instead of you. The double’s AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. If the attack hits the double, the double is destroyed and the attack misses you.
The double occupies your space, moves with you, and mimics your actions. It does not count as a creature, does not threaten, and cannot be targeted by effects that do not target attack rolls unless a rule says otherwise.
Augment 1 CP: Create additional doubles equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down. When you have four or more doubles, you redirect the attack on a 4 or higher. With three doubles, redirect on a 6 or higher. With two doubles, redirect on an 8 or higher. With one double, redirect on an 11 or higher.
TAL_ILLUSION_FALSE_OBSTRUCTION:
#### False Obstruction
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Obstruction, Image
You create an obstruction that interferes with sight inside the area. Everything within the area appears blurred, misaligned, doubled, or hidden behind false angles. The area is Lightly Obscured. Attack rolls against a creature inside the area have Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight and cannot otherwise perceive the target clearly.
False Obstruction is not a physical object. It does not provide Cover, block movement, or block line of effect.
Augment 1 CP: The area becomes Heavily Obscured to creatures that rely on sight, but creatures inside the area are also Heavily Obscured to one another unless you use Selective Premise or another talent to exempt them.
Augment 1 CP: The obstruction muffles sound. Creatures entirely inside the area are Deafened to sounds outside the area, and sounds inside the area cannot be heard from outside it. This does not create real silence unless the GM allows it for minor sound effects; it does not prevent spellcasting unless you also spend 1 additional CP. If you do, spells with verbal components and sphere talents requiring speech cannot be used while entirely inside the area.
TAL_ILLUSION_GREATER_ILLUSION:
#### Greater Illusion
Tags: Sensory
Your illusions can affect smell, taste, touch, and apparent temperature in addition to sight and sound.
When you augment Create Figment to include both sight and sound, you may also add smell, taste, touch, and apparent temperature. Illusory food can smell delicious, illusory fire can feel hot, illusory silk can feel smooth, and illusory rot can taste bitter. These sensations cannot deal damage, heal, poison, burn, feed, deafen, suffocate, or physically move anything unless another talent says so.
Casual touch no longer automatically reveals your figments or Illusory Disguise. Direct contradiction still can. A creature trying to climb an illusory wall still falls through it unless a talent makes it substantial.
TAL_ILLUSION_ILLUSIONARY_TERRAIN:
#### Illusionary Terrain
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Part of Create Figment
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Figment, Image
Your figments can alter the apparent terrain inside their area. You can make grassland appear as forest, a wall of fire appear as harmless mist, a pit appear as floor, a bridge appear broken, a door appear absent, or a safe road appear flooded.
The terrain is not physically changed. The effect does not create real Difficult Terrain, Cover, bridges, pits, fire, water, or hazards. However, a creature that fails to Study the illusion and chooses its route based on the false terrain may gain a False Premise from you. You may trigger a Misdirection Response when that creature moves willingly through or around the false terrain.
Augment 1 CP: Choose a creature affected by a False Premise from the terrain. Until the start of your next turn, the creature treats one 10-foot square of your choice inside the figment as Difficult Terrain. This is hesitation, not physical terrain.
TAL_ILLUSION_ILLUSORY_DISGUISE:
#### Illusory Disguise
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One willing creature or unattended object
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Glamer, Veil
You change the target’s apparent appearance. A creature may appear up to 1 foot shorter or taller, thin, heavy, differently dressed, differently marked, or as another ancestry with the same basic arrangement of limbs. An object may appear as another object of similar size and rough shape.
This glamer changes appearance and voice. It does not change body type, actual size, weight, statistics, equipment, creature type, or true spiritual signature.
A creature may use Study to inspect the disguise. Physical interaction can reveal contradictions. If a creature recognizes the disguise as illusory, it does not automatically see the true appearance clearly unless the GM rules the contradiction is obvious.
Augment 1 CP: If you have Greater Illusion, the disguise can include scent, taste, and tactile details. Touching the disguise does not automatically reveal the deception, but the disguise still has no real substance.
TAL_ILLUSION_INSISTENT_PREMISE:
#### Insistent Premise
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=MODIFY_CREATED_ILLUSION->passive
Timing Detail: Part of creating a Figment, Glamer, Obstruction, or False Premise
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Premise
Choose one creature you can perceive. That creature has Disadvantage on the next Study check or saving throw it makes against that specific illusion before the end of its next turn.
TAL_ILLUSION_MISDIRECTION_RESPONSES:
#### Misdirection Responses
When you trigger a Misdirection Response, choose one option from the list below.
| Response | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| False Opening | The next attack roll made against the target before the start of your next turn has Advantage. |
| Wrong Angle | The target has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll or ability check. |
| Lost Timing | The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. If the triggering event was a Reaction, that Reaction fails. |
| Stolen Step | The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn, and one creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that target. |
| Misread Target | If the triggering event targets a creature and another legal target is within 5 feet of the original target, the triggering creature has Disadvantage on the triggering roll or saving throw pressure against the original target. This does not force the effect to target an illegal creature. |
You can trigger only one Misdirection Response per round unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_ILLUSION_OBSCURING_GLAMER:
#### Obscuring Glamer
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One willing creature or object
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Tags: Glamer, Veil
You blur the target’s outline. Attack rolls against the target have Disadvantage. The effect ends early if the target attacks, casts a spell, uses a sphere talent, or deals damage.
Augment 1 CP: The target becomes Invisible instead of blurred. The invisibility follows the ordinary Invisible condition and ends early if the target attacks, casts a spell, uses a sphere talent, or deals damage.
Augment 1 CP: The effect does not end when the target attacks, casts a spell, uses a sphere talent, or deals damage.
Augment 1 CP: Muffle the target. The target does not suffer Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks from heavy armor, and creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to hear the target.
Augment 0 CP: If you have Greater Illusion, creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to smell the target.
TAL_ILLUSION_PHANTOM_STING:
#### Phantom Sting
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Attack: Ranged Cultivation Attack
Tags: Phantasm, Premise
You create a false attack that causes real psychic distress. On a hit, the target takes Psychic damage based on your CL.
| CL | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 1d8 |
| 5-10 | 2d8 |
| 11-16 | 3d8 |
| 17-20 | 4d8 |
If the target can perceive the false attack, you may also force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it gains one False Premise from you until the start of your next turn.
Phantom Sting is not a weapon attack. It does not create a real object and does not benefit from weapon properties or Weapon Mastery.
TAL_ILLUSION_POTENT_PHANTASM:
#### Potent Phantasm
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=AUGMENT_FIGMENT_OR_PHANTOM_STING->passive
Timing Detail: Part of Create Figment or Phantom Sting
Cost: Varies
Tags: Phantasm, Premise
Your figments can become so intense that they affect creatures even after doubt begins.
Choose one of the following augments when you create a figment. A creature that starts its turn inside the figment’s area makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, it suffers the chosen effect. A creature that successfully Studies the figment has Advantage on future saving throws against this use of Potent Phantasm.
| Cost | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| 1 CP | The creature is Deafened until the start of its next turn. |
| 2 CP | If you have Greater Illusion, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to 1d4 per tier: 1d4 at CL 5, 2d4 at CL 11, and 3d4 at CL 17. |
| 2 CP | If you have Greater Illusion, the creature is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. |
| 2 CP | If you have Veiled Illusion, the creature is Frightened until the start of its next turn. |
| 3 CP | The creature is Blinded until the start of its next turn. |
Potent Phantasm cannot apply more than one effect to the same creature from the same figment at the same time.
TAL_ILLUSION_PREMISE_CHAIN:
#### Premise Chain
Prerequisite: Premise Transfer
Once per round when you trigger a Misdirection Response against a creature, you may spend 1 CP to avoid ending the False Premise that produced it. That False Premise still ends at its normal duration.
TAL_ILLUSION_PREMISE_TRANSFER:
#### Premise Transfer
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature’s False Premise from you ends without you triggering a Misdirection Response
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Premise
Choose another creature within range of the original target that can perceive the same illusion or its consequence. The new target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it gains the same False Premise until the start of your next turn.
TAL_ILLUSION_PROGRAMMED_ILLUSION:
#### Programmed Illusion
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Part of Create Figment
Cost: 1 CP
Tags: Figment
When creating a figment, you may cause it to remain dormant and invisible until a trigger occurs. The trigger can be as general or detailed as you like, but it must be based on visual, audible, tactile, scent, aura, or simple environmental conditions that occur within 30 feet of the figment’s location.
Until triggered, the figment is imperceptible. Once triggered, it performs a simple sequence you set when you create it, with a maximum duration of 5 minutes. After that sequence ends, the figment disappears.
If you also use an effect that makes the figment permanent, it resets after its sequence ends and waits for the trigger again.
TAL_ILLUSION_SELECTIVE_PREMISE:
#### Selective Premise
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Embedded; no separate action
Timing: When you create an illusion with an Illusion talent
Target: Up to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus that you can perceive
Duration: The duration of the chosen illusion
Cost: None
Tags: Premise
When you create the illusion, choose up to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. For each chosen creature, choose one of the following separately:
The creature automatically recognizes that specific illusion as false. It treats the illusion according to the normal rules for a creature that has recognized it as false.
If that illusion has a harmless or hindering effect, the creature is immune to that effect for the illusion's duration.
Selective Premise modifies only the illusion being created. It does not reveal your other illusions, grant immunity to unrelated effects, or require an additional action.
TAL_ILLUSION_VEILED_ILLUSION:
#### Veiled Illusion
Prerequisite: Illusion, CL 5+
Tags: Sensory, Veil
Your illusions can imitate, distort, or hide auras.
When you create a figment or glamer, you may give it an apparent magical aura, cultivation aura, alignment-like impression, creature-type impression, sect emblem, or similar readable signature. You may also suppress such auras from a creature under one of your glamers.
Your Illusion talents do not detect as magical or cultivation effects unless you choose to let them, though a creature that successfully Studies the illusion may recognize the aura as false.
This does not perfectly mimic a unique soul, Dao mark, bloodline, Secret Inheritance, oath, or artifact signature unless a higher-Realm talent says so.
TAL_IRON_FIST_AXE_KICK_DESCENT:
##### Axe-Kick Descent - Form
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you fall at least 10 feet, jump down, or descend from a higher space and hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn, add 2d6 Bludgeoning or Force damage.
If the target was already Opened, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Fall Prone.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
Reduce any falling damage you take during this descent by 5 × your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_IRON_FIST_BODY_CONDITIONING:
##### Body Conditioning - Guard
While holding Martial Focus and not wielding a Shield, gain a +1 bonus to AC.
When you take Bludgeoning damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_IRON_FIST_BREAKING_KNUCKLE:
##### Breaking Knuckle - Form
When your Unarmed Strike deals damage, add Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target was already Opened, it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the end of your next turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_CENTERED_BREATH:
##### Centered Breath
When you take the Dodge action while unarmed or using only Unarmed Strikes, regain Martial Focus if it is absent.
Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike while holding Martial Focus, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
TAL_IRON_FIST_COUNTER_PALM:
##### Counter Palm - Guard, Focus
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within reach misses you with a melee attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Make one Unarmed Strike against the triggering creature.
If the attack hits, you may apply one Form talent you know.
TAL_IRON_FIST_COURT_OF_ONE_HUNDRED_FORMS:
##### Court of One Hundred Forms - Martial Domain
“The enemy saw one body. The mistake was counting only two hands.”
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Create a 30-foot Emanation of disciplined martial pressure. Within the Court, every step, turn, breath, and stance change becomes part of a larger form.
For the duration:
your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 5 feet;
once per turn when you Open a creature, apply one Form talent you know without counting against your normal one-Form limit;
once per turn when you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike, regain Martial Focus if absent;
when you take the Dodge action, make one Unarmed Strike before the end of that action;
hostile creatures you have Opened treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain;
when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
Court of One Hundred Forms ends early if you become Incapacitated.
This Domain does not create independent duplicates, command allies, or turn the entire battlefield into difficult terrain. It represents your body controlling the nearby exchange.
TAL_IRON_FIST_CRANE_STEP_COMBINATION:
##### Crane-Step Combination - Sequence
After you hit with an Unarmed Strike, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
If your next Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn targets a different creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to its damage on a hit.
TAL_IRON_FIST_DRIVING_HEEL:
##### Driving Heel - Form
When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Shove option and you push it, increase the push distance by 5 feet.
If the creature was already Opened, increase the push distance by 10 feet instead, and you may move 5 feet toward the creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it.
This movement is not an Impact Collision and does not trigger Brute Collision talents.
TAL_IRON_FIST_ELBOW_IN_THE_DOOR:
##### Elbow in the Door - Form
When your Unarmed Strike deals damage to a creature within 5 feet, choose one space adjacent to both you and the target.
Until the start of your next turn, the target treats that space as difficult terrain.
If the target was already Opened, you may also prevent it from willingly moving through that space until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against your Iron Fist Save DC.
TAL_IRON_FIST_EMPTY_HAND_BREAKS_THE_FORM:
##### Empty-Hand Breaks the Formation Door
Prerequisite: One-Inch Heavenquake, CL 15+
When One-Inch Heavenquake hits a temporary Barrier, Formation Anchor, sealed door, artifact shell, or other defensive structure, add 6d8 Force damage.
If the target is not an artifact, Domain, Secret Inheritance, or Realm-defining structure, you may also force a Cultivation Check against your Iron Fist Save DC.
Failed Check: Suppress one defensive property of the target until the end of your next turn.
Successful Check: No suppression.
A permanent Formation, artifact, sect gate, or comparable structure may require a dedicated scene or project to fully destroy.
TAL_IRON_FIST_EMPTY_PALM_STOPS_THE_BLADE:
##### Empty Palm Stops the Blade - Guard
Prerequisite: Iron Forearm Guard, CL 5+
When Iron Forearm Guard reduces damage from a melee weapon attack, you may expend Martial Focus.
Make an Unarmed Strike attack roll against the attacker’s AC.
Hit: Choose one:
disarm the triggering weapon into a legal adjacent space;
reduce the triggering damage by an additional 2d8;
make the attacker Opened by you until the end of your next turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_FALLING_LEAF_SWEEP:
##### Falling Leaf Sweep - Form
Prerequisite: Sweeping Kick, CL 5+
When a creature fails its saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Shove option and you give it the Prone condition, choose one other creature within 5 feet of the target.
That second creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
If the original target was already Opened, choose two creatures within 5 feet instead of one.
TAL_IRON_FIST_FISTS_RING_LIKE_BELLS:
##### Fists Ring Like Bells - Unique Iron Fist Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot cone
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Release a series of compressed palm strikes.
Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 4d8 Thunder or Force damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no additional effect.
Creatures already Opened by you have Disadvantage on the saving throw.
TAL_IRON_FIST_FLOWING_COMBINATION:
##### Flowing Combination - Sequence
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Once per turn after you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you may immediately use the Grapple or Shove option of Unarmed Strike against that same creature without spending an additional attack.
If the creature was already Opened, it makes the saving throw against this Grapple or Shove with Disadvantage.
TAL_IRON_FIST_FOCUSING_BREATH:
##### Focusing Breath - Focus
When you use Centered Breath to regain Martial Focus by taking the Dodge action, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Once per turn when you Open a creature and then end your turn within 5 feet of it, regain Martial Focus if it is absent.
TAL_IRON_FIST_HEAVEN_SEIZING_CLINCH:
##### Heaven-Seizing Clinch
Prerequisite: Dragon-Step Clinch, CL 15+
You may use Dragon-Step Clinch against creatures up to two sizes larger than you.
When you maintain a body clinch, you are no longer slowed by that clinch.
Once per turn when you hit a creature you are Grappling or body-clinching with an Unarmed Strike, choose one:
move the creature 10 feet with you into legal spaces;
force it to make a Constitution saving throw or become unable to take Reactions until the start of your next turn;
add 2d8 Force damage.
Heaven-Seizing Clinch does not allow you to carry a mountain-sized monster, living fortress, divine manifestation, or scene-defining creature merely because it uses a standard size category.
TAL_IRON_FIST_HUNDRED_FORM_COMBINATION:
##### Hundred-Form Combination - Sequence
Prerequisite: Flowing Combination, CL 10+
When you take the Attack action and make at least two Unarmed Strikes, choose two different Form talents you know.
Until the end of your turn, each chosen Form may be applied once without counting against your normal one-Form limit.
You cannot apply the same Form twice to one strike.
TAL_IRON_FIST_INTERNAL_HAMMER:
##### Internal Hammer - Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike, expend Martial Focus.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one ongoing physical or martial effect affecting the target, such as a stance, guard, body enhancement, rage-like state, mobility technique, or temporary damage reduction. Suppress that effect until the end of the target’s next turn.
Successful Save: The effect is not suppressed, but the target cannot benefit from Advantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
Internal Hammer does not suppress Domains, Secret Inheritances, permanent transformations, artifacts, or effects that do not depend on the target’s bodily or spiritual structure.
TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_FIST_BREAKS_THE_WEAPO:
##### Iron Fist Breaks the Weapon - Guard, Meridian
Prerequisite: Empty Palm Stops the Blade, CL 10+
When a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, expend Martial Focus.
Make an Unarmed Strike against the attacker or against the weapon used for the triggering attack.
If you target the attacker and hit, apply one Form talent.
If you target the weapon and hit, the weapon takes the attack’s damage. If the weapon is nonmagical and the damage equals or exceeds its Damage Threshold or GM-set durability, it breaks. A magical weapon, artifact, or soul-bound weapon may resist with a Cultivation Check against your Iron Fist Save DC.
TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_FIST_FLURRY:
##### Iron Fist Flurry - Sequence, Focus
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you take the Attack action and make at least one Unarmed Strike, expend Martial Focus to make one additional Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action.
If another feature already allows you to make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action, you may instead add your Iron Fist ability modifier to the damage of one Unarmed Strike you hit with before the end of your turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_FOREARM_GUARD:
##### Iron Forearm Guard - Guard
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see hits you with a melee attack
Cost: None
Reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Iron Fist ability modifier.
If this reduces the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Opened by you until the end of your next turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_IRON_SHIRT_PRACTICE:
##### Iron Shirt Practice - Unique Iron Fist Talent
After each long rest, choose one damage type:
Bludgeoning;
Piercing;
Slashing.
While holding Martial Focus and wearing no Heavy armor, reduce damage of the chosen type by your Proficiency Bonus when it is dealt by a nonmagical weapon, natural weapon, or Unarmed Strike.
At CL 10+, you may choose Force as the damage type if the damage comes from a physical impact or martial technique.
TAL_IRON_FIST_MEDICINE_OF_THE_CLOSED_GAT:
##### Medicine of the Closed Gate - Meridian
Prerequisite: Proficiency in Wisdom (Medicine), CL 5+
When you spend 1 minute treating a willing creature, make a Wisdom (Medicine) check against DC 15.
Success: End one ordinary muscle cramp, joint strain, breath disruption, or similar nonmagical penalty caused by a martial technique.
During combat, you may use an Action and expend Martial Focus to apply this treatment to yourself or a willing creature within reach. On a successful check, the target may immediately repeat one saving throw against a Meridian talent, Grappled condition, Prone-related martial hindrance, or similar bodily disruption.
TAL_IRON_FIST_MERIDIAN_LOCK:
##### Meridian Lock - Meridian
Prerequisite: Meridian-Sealing Palm, CL 10+
When a creature fails its saving throw against Meridian-Sealing Palm, choose two seals instead of one.
If the creature was already Opened, you may instead choose one seal and impose the following additional effect:
Body-Locked: The target’s Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
TAL_IRON_FIST_MERIDIAN_SEALING_PALM:
##### Meridian-Sealing Palm - Meridian, Form
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike that deals damage, expend Martial Focus.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one seal until the end of its next turn.
Arm Seal: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with one arm or comparable limb.
Leg Seal: The target’s Speed is reduced by 15 feet.
Breath Seal: The target cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes.
Voice Seal: The target cannot speak above a whisper or activate an ability requiring clear speech.
Successful Save: The target cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
A creature without recognizable anatomy may still be affected if it has comparable movement, attack, breath, voice, or spiritual channels.
TAL_IRON_FIST_NINE_BELL_MERIDIAN_PALM:
##### Nine-Bell Meridian Palm
Prerequisite: Meridian Lock, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Make one Unarmed Strike.
Hit: Add 6d10 Thunder or Force damage. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose three seals from Meridian-Sealing Palm. The seals last for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending one seal of its choice on a success.
Successful Save: Choose one seal from Meridian-Sealing Palm until the end of the target’s next turn.
If the target was already Opened, it has Disadvantage on the first saving throw.
TAL_IRON_FIST_ONE_INCH_HEAVENQUAKE:
##### One-Inch Heavenquake - Meridian, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Make one Unarmed Strike against a creature or object within reach.
On a hit, add 4d8 Force damage.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It is Stunned until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
If the target was already Opened, the attack ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning and Force damage.
One-Inch Heavenquake can damage unattended objects and temporary Barriers. It does not automatically destroy artifacts, Domains, Formation cores, or Realm-defining structures.
TAL_IRON_FIST_OPEN_HAND_DISARM:
##### Open-Hand Disarm - Unique Iron Fist Talent
When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you may forgo Open the Gate to attempt to disarm one object it is holding.
Make an Unarmed Strike attack roll contested by the target’s Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics), target’s choice.
Success: The target drops one held object of your choice.
Failure: No additional effect.
You have Disadvantage on the attack roll if the target holds the object with two or more hands. The target has Advantage if larger than you and Disadvantage if smaller.
If you possess the Scoundrel sphere, you may immediately use Steal against the dropped object if it is within your reach.
TAL_IRON_FIST_PALM_FEINT:
##### Palm Feint - Form, Focus
Before making an Unarmed Strike, expend Martial Focus.
Gain Advantage on the attack roll, or impose Disadvantage on the target’s saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple or Shove option.
If the target was already Opened, regain Martial Focus after the strike resolves.
TAL_IRON_FIST_PALM_THAT_MOVES_THE_EMPTY_:
##### Palm That Moves the Empty Bell
Prerequisite: Breath-Extended Strike, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Strike one visible creature, object, or temporary Barrier with a palm force that travels through air, water, or a continuous solid surface.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack using your Iron Fist ability.
Hit: Deal 8d8 Force damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Move it 20 feet in one legal direction and knock it Prone.
Successful Save: Move it 5 feet in one legal direction.
This is not general Force control. The attack must travel along a clear route or continuous surface from you to the target.
TAL_IRON_FIST_QUIVERING_GATE_STRIKE:
##### Quivering Gate Strike - Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per creature per long rest
Make one Unarmed Strike.
Hit: The target takes normal damage and gains a hidden quivering mark for 1 minute.
While the mark lasts, you may use an Action to release it if the target is within 120 feet and on the same plane.
When released, the target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 10d10 Force damage and become Stunned until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
The mark ends after release. A creature can bear only one of your Quivering Gate Strike marks at a time.
TAL_IRON_FIST_RISING_KNEE:
##### Rising Knee - Form
When your Unarmed Strike deals damage to a creature you are Grappling, or to a creature Grappling you, deal additional Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6.
If the target was already Opened, also reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_ROOTING_STANCE:
##### Rooting Stance - Guard, Focus
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Root your breath and lower body.
Until the duration ends:
gain Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws against effects that would move you or knock you Prone;
reduce forced movement affecting you by 5 feet;
if a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
If you expend Martial Focus when entering Rooting Stance, reduce forced movement by 10 feet instead.
TAL_IRON_FIST_SKY_SHATTERING_AXE_KICK:
##### Sky-Shattering Axe Kick - Form
Prerequisite: Axe-Kick Descent, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Leap, descend, or drive a vertical kick through the target’s guard.
Choose one creature within your movement reach. Move up to half your Speed to a legal space adjacent to it. This movement may include a vertical leap up to 15 feet and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the target.
Make one Unarmed Strike.
Hit: Add 4d6 Bludgeoning or Force damage. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Fall Prone and become Opened until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_SWEEPING_KICK:
##### Sweeping Kick - Form
When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Shove option and you choose to give it the Prone condition, it also takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Iron Fist ability modifier, minimum 1.
If the creature was already Opened, standing from Prone costs it an additional 10 feet of movement before the end of its next turn.
TAL_IRON_FIST_THOUSAND_HAND_WAR_BODY:
##### Thousand-Hand War Body
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Your afterimages, breath, and striking intent fill the area with a storm of blows.
Choose any number of creatures in the area. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 8d8 Bludgeoning or Force damage, become Opened until the end of your next turn, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and become Opened until the start of your next turn.
After resolving the technique, move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
TAL_IRON_FIST_TIGER_CRANE_ALTERNATION:
##### Tiger-Crane Alternation - Sequence
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, choose Tiger or Crane.
Tiger: Add your Iron Fist ability modifier to the next Shove or Grapple Save DC you impose before the end of the turn.
Crane: Move up to 15 feet before your next Unarmed Strike this turn without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the creature you hit.
If the target was already Opened, gain both benefits.
TAL_IRON_FIST_WALL_REBOUND_KICK:
##### Wall-Rebound Kick - Sequence
Prerequisite: CL 5+
If you move at least 10 feet and pass adjacent to a wall, pillar, larger creature, tree, or other solid surface, your next Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn gains one benefit:
add 1d8 damage;
increase its reach by 5 feet;
after it resolves, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
This talent does not allow general wall-running. For sustained traversal, use Athletics.
TAL_IRON_FIST_WRIST_TRAPPING_HAND:
##### Wrist-Trapping Hand - Form
When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple option, choose one object it is holding.
Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls made with that object against creatures other than you.
If the target was already Opened, it also cannot use that object to make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
TAL_KARMA_INVOKE_THE_LEDGER:
#### Invoke the Ledger
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Karmic Imprint
Target: One creature carrying one of your Karmic Imprints
You expend one Imprint to call a small consequence.
Debt. The target subtracts 1d4 from the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
Grace. The target adds 1d4 to the next attack roll, ability check, or saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn.
A creature can be affected by only one Invoke the Ledger die from you at a time.
At CL 11, the die becomes 1d6. At CL 17, the die becomes 1d8.
TAL_KARMA_LEDGER_EYE:
#### Ledger Eye
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Target: One creature, object, oath, corpse, location, or visible supernatural bond you can perceive
You open the Ledger Eye and read visible consequence around the target.
Choose one question:
Does the target carry one of your Karmic Imprints?
Is the target bound by an oath, curse, contract, possession bond, summoning bond, or supernatural obligation?
Has the target recently caused a death, betrayal, rescue, or oath-breaking within the last 24 hours?
Is the target concealing strong guilt, resentment, obligation, gratitude, or grievance?
Is a Fate, Divination, Karma, Curse, or Oath effect altering the target’s road?
Is this location unusually burdened by death, betrayal, worship, grievance, or fulfilled vows?
The GM answers truthfully, but the answer may be symbolic rather than exact. Ledger Eye does not automatically identify names, motives, or hidden details.
At CL 5, you may ask two questions. At CL 11, you may ask three questions.
TAL_KARMA_SETTLE_MINOR_ACCOUNT:
#### Settle Minor Account
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one matching Imprint
Target: One creature carrying one of your Karmic Imprints
You settle a small debt or reward a small grace.
Debt. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes Psychic damage equal to 1d8 + your key ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and keeps its Reactions.
Grace. The target gains Temporary HP equal to 1d8 + your key ability modifier and may immediately end one of the following minor effects on itself: Grappled, Prone, or Disadvantage on its next ability check.
At CL 5, the die becomes 2d8. At CL 11, 3d8. At CL 17, 4d8.
TAL_LIGHTNING_ARC_PRIMER:
### Arc Primer - Arc
When Lightning Lash hits and you choose its Arc rider, the Arc can target one creature or object within 10 feet instead of 5 feet.
If the Arc target is Conductive, it also becomes Charged until the start of your next turn.
This Arc still cannot trigger additional Arcs unless another talent allows it.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CHAIN_BOLT:
### Chain Bolt - Arc, Shock
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: One creature or object you can see
Cost: 1 CP
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: The target takes Lightning Lash damage and becomes Charged. You may then Arc to a second target within 15 feet of the first target. The second target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The second target takes lightning damage equal to half the Lightning Lash damage and becomes Charged.
Successful Save: The second target takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and is not Charged.
If both targets were Conductive before this technique resolved, you may Arc to a third target within 15 feet of the second target. The third target takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and is not Charged.
No creature can be damaged more than once by this technique.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CHARGED_COUNTERMEASURE:
### Charged Countermeasure - Reaction, Overload
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet uses a reaction, counter, parry, interception, opportunity attack, or comparable immediate defensive technique
Cost: 1 CP
The triggering creature must be Charged, Conductive, or using a visible qi circuit.
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The triggering reaction or counter has Disadvantage if it uses a roll. If it does not use a roll, its damage reduction, AC bonus, shield value, or movement prevention is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Successful Save: The reaction or counter proceeds normally, but the creature loses its Charge if it had one.
This talent cannot suppress legendary resistance, Secret inheritances, or passive defenses that are not reactions or immediate counters.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CHARGED_NEEDLE:
### Charged Needle - Imbuement, Shock
Prerequisite: The Piercing Needle sphere or GM permission
You may deliver Lightning through needles, pins, acupuncture tools, darts, or comparable precision implements.
When you hit with a needle attack or successfully apply a pressure-point technique, you may place a Charge on the target without using Gather Charge.
If the target is already Charged, you may consume the Charge. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target cannot regain CP until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target cannot regain CP until the end of the current turn.
This does not remove CP the target already has.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CONDUCTIVE_FIELD:
### Conductive Field - Charge, Circuit
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You create a field of charged air, crawling sparks, and conductive tension.
The area is Conductive. The first time a hostile creature enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes lightning damage equal to 1d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier and becomes Charged until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Charged.
This is a Lightning field, not a Weather field. It does not create rain, wind, fog, Sky Mantles, Cloud Shrouds, or Weather severity.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CONDUCTIVE_STRIKE:
### Conductive Strike - Imbuement, Shock
When you make a melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or thrown weapon attack, you may use Lightning as part of the attack if the weapon, limb, or projectile is Charged, metallic, wet, or otherwise Conductive.
On a hit, the attack deals additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and the target becomes Conductive until the start of your next turn.
You may use Conductive Strike once per turn.
At CL 5, if the target is already Charged, you may consume the Charge to increase the additional lightning damage to 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_LIGHTNING_COURT_OF_CHARGED_PATHS:
### Court of Charged Paths - Circuit, Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Current Beyond the Skin
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Area: 60-foot emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a court of lightning logic around yourself.
For the duration:
- Your Charge limit increases by your Proficiency Bonus.
- Once on each of your turns, you may use Gather Charge without an action.
- Your Lightning Lash may originate from any Charged space or Charged object inside the court that you can see.
- When a hostile creature starts its turn Charged inside the court, you may move the Charge to another visible creature, object, or space within 10 feet of it.
- The first time each round a hostile creature inside the court takes lightning damage from one of your talents, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Allied creatures of your choice inside the court have Advantage on saving throws against lightning and thunder effects you create.
The court ends early if you are Incapacitated.
Court of Charged Paths is a Lightning domain, not Weather. It does not create sustained weather or Weather severity.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CRACKLING_ARROW:
### Crackling Arrow - Imbuement, Arc
When you make a ranged weapon attack with ammunition or a thrown weapon, you may treat the ammunition or weapon as Conductive for Lightning talents until the attack is resolved.
If the attack hits a Charged target, you may consume the Charge to deal additional lightning damage equal to 1d8 and choose one creature within 5 feet of the target. That creature takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 11, the Arc range for this talent becomes 15 feet.
TAL_LIGHTNING_CURRENT_BEYOND_THE_SKIN:
### Current Beyond the Skin - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Lightning Qi can remain stable outside your body for short tactical windows.
Gain the following benefits:
- Your Charge limit increases by 1.
- Gather Charge range becomes 60 feet.
- Lightning Lash range becomes 90 feet.
- Your Arc range increases to 15 feet.
- A target you Charge remains Charged until the end of your next turn instead of the start of your next turn, unless the Charge is consumed.
- Your Lightning talents can attempt to affect magical lightning, storm charge, qi circuits, talisman circuits, minor formation nodes, and spirit-thread conductors if the talent permits it.
Current Beyond the Skin does not grant sustained weather control, free flight, storm creation, or automatic formation-breaking.
TAL_LIGHTNING_ELECTRIC_FIST_METHOD:
### Electric Fist Method - Shock, Lightning Body
Your unarmed strikes and close-contact blows can carry Lightning Qi into nerves and meridians.
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or melee attack within your reach, you may force the target to make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
You may use Electric Fist Method a number of times per short or long rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Creatures without nerves, meridians, muscles, or comparable animating channels are immune to the Speed reduction but not to the reaction denial unless immune to lightning or bodily shock.
TAL_LIGHTNING_FIRST_CIRCUIT_METHOD:
### First Circuit Method
Action Type: Passive
Timing Detail: Passive / Charge Rider
Range: Self
Cost: None
When you first gain the Lightning sphere, your meridians learn to hold a brief seed of unstable potential. This is called a First Circuit.
A First Circuit is not a full Charge and does not make you vulnerable to hostile Lightning talents unless a feature specifically says so. It is the internal spark that lets Lightning cultivation move through the body before it escapes into the world.
Once on each of your turns, when you use Gather Charge on yourself, a held weapon, a worn item, or a Lightning focus you are touching, choose one Circuit expression. The chosen expression lasts until the Charge ends.
**Body Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you deal lightning damage or consume a Charge, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature damaged by your Lightning sphere this turn.
**Edge Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, the next time you hit with an unarmed strike, weapon attack, Lightning Lash, or Lightning talent delivered through a held implement, you deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Nerve Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you would have your Speed reduced, be knocked Prone, or be denied Reactions by a non-Secret effect, you may discharge the Circuit to gain Advantage on the saving throw against that effect. If no saving throw is allowed, reduce the penalty by one step: ignore a Speed reduction of 10 feet or less, stand from Prone by spending 5 fewer feet of movement, or regain your Reaction at the start of your next turn.
**Conduction Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you apply Charge to a creature, object, formation node, talisman, weapon, armor, or 5-foot space, you may make yourself Conductive until the start of your next turn. While Conductive this way, your next Lightning talent that requires a Conductive Path may treat yourself, your held weapon, or your worn armor as the starting point of that path.
You may discharge only one First Circuit per round.
TAL_LIGHTNING_FIVEFOLD_THUNDER_CIRCUIT:
### Fivefold Thunder Circuit - Arc, Thunder
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Chain Bolt
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 2 CP
Choose up to five creatures or objects you can see. The first target must be within range. Each later target must be within 20 feet of a previous target and must be Conductive, Charged, metallic, wet, or part of the same formation, ward, or battlefield circuit.
Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: A target takes 4d8 lightning damage and becomes Charged.
Successful Save: A target takes half damage and is not Charged.
If at least three targets fail their saves, choose one target that failed. Thunder cracks around that target; creatures of your choice within 10 feet of it cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_FLASH_REVEAL:
### Flash Reveal - Charge, Shock
When you hit a creature with Lightning Lash or Conductive Strike, you may cause sparks to cling to its outline.
Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot benefit from being Invisible or Hidden against you unless it has Total Cover, superior concealment, Void separation, or an effect that specifically defeats lightning detection.
At Foundation Realm, if the target is within 10 feet of another Charged creature, you may reveal both creatures with the same effect.
TAL_LIGHTNING_FLASH_STEP:
### Flash Step - Movement
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Spark Step
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Cost: 1 CP
You move up to 30 feet in a straight line to an unoccupied space you can see. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures whose reach you leave during the movement.
You must have a clear path. Flash Step is not teleportation. It cannot pass through walls, sealed barriers, Total Cover, or spaces too small for you.
If you start or end adjacent to a Charged creature or Conductive object, you may turn once during this movement.
At CL 11, you may move through a creature’s space during Flash Step if that creature is Charged, but you cannot end there.
TAL_LIGHTNING_FORMATION_EXTINGUISHING_ED:
### Formation-Extinguishing Edict - Overload
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Formation-Splitting Bolt
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Target: One visible formation node, domain anchor, ward engine, talisman array, qi construct, or summoned asset anchor
Cost: 3 CP
Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s DC, the creator’s Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: Suppress the target until the end of your next turn if it is non-Secret and your Realm or lower. If it is stronger, reduce one major numerical benefit by your Cultivation Level and impose Disadvantage on the next check made to maintain, command, or repair it before the end of your next turn.
Success by 5 or More: Arcs lash through the connected structure. Choose up to three connected creatures, nodes, or constructs within 60 feet. Each takes lightning damage equal to 4d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier.
Failure: The structure resists. You still learn one hidden rule of the structure’s conductivity, grounding, or node hierarchy.
This talent cannot casually erase ancient city arrays, immortal formations, sect grand protections, or world-scale wards.
TAL_LIGHTNING_FORMATION_SPLITTING_BOLT:
### Formation-Splitting Bolt - Overload
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Overload Ward
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One formation node, qi construct, ward anchor, talisman array point, summoned asset anchor, or temporary technique-state you can see
Cost: 2 CP
Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s DC, creator’s Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: The target is suppressed until the end of your next turn if it is a non-Secret temporary effect of your Realm or lower. If it is stronger, instead reduce one of its numerical effects by your Cultivation Level until the start of your next turn, if applicable.
Success by 5 or More: You may also place Charges on up to three connected nodes, anchors, constructs, or creatures within 20 feet of the target.
Failure: The target is not suppressed, but you learn one of the following: its strongest phase, whether it is Conductive, whether it is protected against Lightning, or whether another node is supporting it.
Ancient city arrays, sect grand formations, Secret inheritances, artifacts, and Realm-superior domains require opposed authority checks or may be immune.
TAL_LIGHTNING_GATHER_CHARGE:
### Gather Charge
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: Yourself, one object you can see, one weapon you are holding, one willing creature you can see, one formation node you can see, or one unoccupied 5-foot space you can see
Cost: None
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
You gather unstable Lightning Qi and place a Charge on the target.
If you Charge a weapon you are holding, the next time you hit with that weapon before the Charge ends, you may consume the Charge to deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you Charge yourself, you gain Advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the Charge ends against lightning, thunder, paralysis, forced movement, or being knocked Prone.
If you Charge a 5-foot space, the space becomes Conductive. The first time a creature enters that space before the Charge ends, you may end the Charge to deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to that creature. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 60 feet. At Core Formation, you may create two Charges with one use of Gather Charge, provided they are within range and do not exceed your Charge limit.
TAL_LIGHTNING_GROUNDING_BREATH:
### Grounding Breath - Lightning Body
You learn to ground hostile shock through breath, stance, and meridian compression.
When you make a saving throw against lightning damage, thunder damage, paralysis, being knocked Prone, or being forcibly moved by a lightning or thunder effect, you may add your Proficiency Bonus if you are not already adding it.
Once you use this benefit, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_CHAINS:
### Lightning Chains - Arc, Circuit
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit a Charged creature with Lightning Lash, you may spend 1 CP to create a short-lived lightning link between it and one creature or object within 15 feet.
The second target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes lightning damage equal to 1d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier, and both targets are linked until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and no link forms.
While linked, if either target willingly moves more than 10 feet away from the other, it takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and the link ends.
The link is not a physical chain and does not restrain unless another talent says so.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_GOD_BODY:
### Lightning-God Body - Lightning Body, Movement
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You realign your meridian flow into jagged lightning arcs and enter a personal Lightning Body state.
For the duration:
- Your Speed increases by 10 feet.
- Once per turn when you hit with an unarmed strike, melee weapon attack, or Lightning Lash, you deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- You have Advantage on saving throws against paralysis and effects that reduce Speed.
- When a creature misses you with an Opportunity Attack, you may place a Charge on that creature.
Lightning-God Body ends early if you are Incapacitated.
This talent is internal Lightning cultivation. It does not create weather, storm fields, or detached lightning domains.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_LASH:
### Lightning Lash
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object you can see
Cost: None
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: The target takes lightning damage equal to 1d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
When Lightning Lash hits, choose one basic rider:
Charge: The target gains a Charge until the start of your next turn.
Jolt: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
Flash: Sparks reveal the target’s outline. Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot benefit from being unseen against you unless it has Total Cover or a stronger concealment effect.
Arc: If another creature or object within 5 feet of the target is Conductive or Charged, it takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This Arc cannot trigger additional Arcs unless a talent says otherwise.
Lightning Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_PRISON_BARS:
### Lightning Prison Bars - Circuit, Shock
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Lightning Chains
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: One Charged creature or one creature standing inside a Conductive Field
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Lightning bars form around the target. The target is Restrained until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
A creature Restrained by the bars may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Restrained effect on itself on a success.
If the target takes thunder damage while Restrained by this talent, it has Disadvantage on its next repeat saving throw before the end of its next turn.
The bars are not physical objects. Total Cover or a stronger grounding effect may break line of effect for later Lightning talents.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_SOVEREIGN_INCARN:
### Lightning Sovereign Incarnation - Realm Evolution, Lightning Body
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of Charged Paths
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You become a sovereign center of lightning, nerves, thunder, and charged consequence.
For the duration:
- You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can Hover.
- You have Resistance to lightning and thunder damage.
