- Your Lightning Lash range becomes 300 feet.
- Your Charge limit doubles.
- Once on each of your turns, you may use Lightning Lash or Gather Charge without an action.
- The first time each round you deal lightning damage to a creature, that creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- You may use Static Guard without spending your Reaction once per round.
- You may treat visible non-Secret formation nodes, talisman circuits, qi constructs, and summoned asset anchors within 120 feet as Conductive.
The incarnation ends early if you are Incapacitated.
This incarnation does not create regional weather. If used inside a Weather storm created by another effect, the GM may describe the signs as stormlike, but the mechanics remain Lightning unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_WINGS_BURST:
### Lightning Wings Burst - Movement, Shock
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Cost: 1 CP
You unfold brief wings, fins, afterimages, or trailing arcs of Lightning Qi.
Until the end of your turn, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking Speed, but you must end the movement on a surface that can support you or you fall.
If you pass within 5 feet of a Charged creature during this movement, you may deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to that creature. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
At CL 11, you do not need to end this movement on a surface if you also maintain Concentration until the start of your next turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_LIGHTNING_WINGS_OF_THE_HEA:
### Lightning Wings of the Heavenly Body - Movement, Lightning Body
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Lightning Wings Burst
While Lightning-God Body, True Lightning-God Mantle, or Lightning Sovereign Incarnation is active, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking Speed and can Hover.
Once per turn when you move at least 30 feet before hitting a target with a Lightning attack or Conductive Strike, add 2d8 lightning damage to the hit.
If you end your turn in the air without Lightning-God Body, True Lightning-God Mantle, Lightning Sovereign Incarnation, Weather support, flight equipment, or another feature keeping you aloft, you fall normally.
TAL_LIGHTNING_MERIDIAN_STOPPING_SPARK:
### Meridian-Stopping Spark - Shock, Overload
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Electric Fist Method
When you hit a creature with Electric Fist Method, Charged Needle, or a melee Conductive Strike, you may spend 1 CP to intensify the meridian shock.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot regain CP, has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration, and cannot take Reactions.
Successful Save: Until the start of its next turn, the target cannot regain CP and has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration.
This does not remove CP the target already has.
TAL_LIGHTNING_ONE_CIRCUIT_UNDER_HEAVEN:
### One Circuit Under Heaven - Circuit, Arc
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Cost: 3 CP
Choose any number of Charged creatures, objects, spaces, formation nodes, or qi constructs you can see within range, up to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
Each hostile creature chosen this way makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 6d8 lightning damage, cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, and loses one Charge.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage, can take Reactions normally, and loses one Charge.
Chosen objects, constructs, and nodes take lightning damage equal to your Cultivation Level x 2 unless immune.
After resolving the damage, you may move one remaining Charge from any chosen target to any other visible target within range.
TAL_LIGHTNING_OVERLOAD_WARD:
### Overload Ward - Overload
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One visible ward, barrier, talisman effect, qi shield, formation node, or Construct-like temporary qi effect you can see
Cost: 1 CP
Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s save DC, formation DC, creator’s Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: The target effect flickers until the start of your next turn. During that time, the next attack roll or saving throw made against the effect has Advantage, or the effect’s next attack roll or save DC is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus, chosen when you succeed.
Success by 5 or More: The effect is also suppressed until the start of your next turn if it is a non-Secret temporary effect of your Realm or lower.
Failure: You learn whether the effect is Conductive, but you do not disrupt it.
Overload Ward cannot destroy permanent formations, artifacts, sect-protecting arrays, or Secret inheritances by itself.
TAL_LIGHTNING_OZONE_READING:
### Ozone Reading - Utility
You can read the taste of lightning before it becomes visible.
You have Advantage on checks to notice or identify recent lightning damage, charged metal, storm-charged objects, active Lightning techniques, overloaded talismans, unstable formation circuits, creatures currently carrying a Lightning Charge, lightning-aspected herbs, and electrical traps.
With 1 minute of inspection, you can determine whether a visible object, corpse, ward, talisman, or formation node was damaged by natural lightning, cultivated Lightning Qi, Weather thunder, Fire, Force, or a non-lightning effect, unless a stronger technique conceals the trace.
At Foundation Realm, you can also tell whether a visible ward, talisman, construct, or formation node is Conductive.
At Core Formation Realm, you can identify whether a visible Lightning effect is primarily external, internal, thunder-based, conductive, or formation-disruptive.
TAL_LIGHTNING_RETURN_STROKE_THROUGH_THE_:
### Return Stroke Through the Void - Movement, Arc
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Ride the Return Stroke
When a creature you can see within 300 feet takes lightning damage or loses a Charge from one of your Lightning talents, you may spend 2 CP to move to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of that creature.
This movement follows a visible or spiritual lightning path and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. It can pass through openings, around corners, along Conductive paths, or through active lightning arcs. It cannot pass through sealed anti-space barriers, superior Void separation, or a closed space with no symbolic or conductive path unless you win an opposed Lightning Check against the obstacle.
After you arrive, you may make one Lightning Lash against the triggering creature without using an action. You cannot use Return Stroke Through the Void again until the start of your next turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_RIDE_THE_RETURN_STROKE:
### Ride the Return Stroke - Movement, Circuit
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Flash Step
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature or object within 120 feet becomes Charged, loses a Charge, or takes lightning damage from your Lightning talent
Cost: 1 CP
You move up to 60 feet toward an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the triggering creature or object. This movement follows a visible lightning path and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
You must have a clear path through open space or a Conductive route. This is not teleportation unless a forged technique combines Lightning with Space.
If you end this movement adjacent to the triggering target, your next melee attack against it before the end of your next turn deals additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_LIGHTNING_SKY_FIRE_NERVE_NET:
### Sky-Fire Nerve Net - Shock, Circuit
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Meridian-Stopping Spark
When a creature fails a saving throw against Meridian-Stopping Spark, you may choose one additional Charged creature within 20 feet of it.
The additional creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn and has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: It loses its Charge.
This talent can affect only one additional creature each turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_SPARK_INSTRUMENT_METHOD:
### Spark-Instrument Method - Imbuement, Thunder
You may use a drum, bell, lute, zither, flute, chime, bowstring, weapon ring, armor plate, or comparable resonant object as a Lightning focus.
When you use Thunderclap Palm or Lightning Lash through such an object, you may choose thunder damage instead of lightning damage.
If the target is Charged, the first creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target hears a sharp report and has Disadvantage on the next Wisdom (Perception) check it makes before the start of your next turn.
This talent does not grant the Music or Sound spheres.
TAL_LIGHTNING_SPARK_LATTICE_PRESERVATION:
### Spark Lattice Preservation - Charge, Utility
You can hold delicate substances inside a harmless charged lattice.
During 10 minutes of work, you may place a stable Charge around a vial, pill, corpse sample, spirit herb, drop of blood, small crystal, written talisman, or comparable Tiny object.
For 24 hours, the object resists ordinary spoilage, contamination, minor dampness, and mundane insects. The object is not immune to fire, theft, deliberate poison, curses, or hostile techniques.
At Foundation Realm, you may spend 1 CP to preserve an object this way for 7 days.
TAL_LIGHTNING_SPARK_STEP:
### Spark Step - Movement
When you use Gather Charge on yourself, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see.
If you move at least 10 feet on your turn before using Lightning Lash, you may increase Lightning Lash’s range by 10 feet for that attack.
At CL 5, the free movement becomes 10 feet.
TAL_LIGHTNING_SPIRIT_CIRCUIT_SHOCK:
### Spirit-Circuit Shock - Spirit, Overload
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Spirit Awakening Path or GM permission
Your Lightning can jolt spirit channels, possession threads, dream projections, and soul-static.
When you hit a spirit, ghost, possessed creature, spiritual projection, dream-body, or summoned spirit asset with Lightning Lash, you may spend 1 CP to force a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target cannot benefit from being Invisible, spiritually hidden, or possession-masked against you until the end of your next turn. If it is possessing another body, the host may immediately repeat one save or contest allowed by the possession effect.
Successful Save: The target becomes Charged until the start of your next turn.
This talent does not exorcise by itself unless a separate feature says so.
TAL_LIGHTNING_STATIC_GUARD:
### Static Guard - Shock, Reaction
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack
Cost: None
You release defensive static through skin, armor, weapon, or breath.
The attacker takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you are Charged, you may consume your Charge to force the attacker to make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The attacker cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The attacker cannot take Opportunity Attacks against you until the end of the current turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_TALISMAN_BURNOUT:
### Talisman Burnout - Overload
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet activates a talisman, stored-command technique, scroll, charm, seal, or comparable prepared qi medium
Cost: 1 CP
Make a Lightning Check against the user’s Cultivation Save DC or the item’s DC.
Success: The talisman or prepared medium sputters. The triggering effect still occurs, but its range, duration, or damage is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus x 5 feet, one round, or your Proficiency Bonus damage, as appropriate. The GM chooses the relevant reduction if unclear.
Success by 5 or More: If the effect is non-Secret and no higher than your Realm, the triggering creature must choose: the effect fails and the use is not spent, or the effect occurs and the medium is burned out after use.
Failure: No effect.
Artifacts, sealed inheritances, and superior talisman authorities may be immune or may require an opposed check.
TAL_LIGHTNING_THOUSAND_SPARK_VOLLEY:
### Thousand-Spark Volley - Imbuement, Arc
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Thunder Arrow
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon range or 120 feet, whichever is lower
Cost: 2 CP
Make one ranged weapon attack or ranged Cultivation Attack against a target in range.
Hit: The target takes the attack’s normal damage plus 3d8 lightning damage and becomes Charged.
Then choose a number of secondary targets up to your Proficiency Bonus within 20 feet of the first target. Each secondary target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: A secondary target takes 2d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: A secondary target takes half damage and suffers no reaction denial.
Miss: Choose one secondary target within 20 feet of the original target. It takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_LIGHTNING_THUNDERCLAP_PALM:
### Thunderclap Palm - Thunder
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 10-foot cone
Cost: None
You release compressed thunder from your palm, weapon, stomp, shout, or striking surface.
Creatures in the cone make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature takes thunder damage equal to 1d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier and is pushed 5 feet away from you.
Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and is not pushed.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
At Foundation Realm, a creature that fails the save is also Deafened until the start of your next turn.
TAL_LIGHTNING_THUNDERHEAD_LATTICE:
### Thunderhead Lattice - Circuit, Utility
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Spark Lattice Preservation
You can stabilize charged lattices at larger scale.
During 10 minutes of work, you may create a charged lattice around a chest, ritual circle, corpse, small altar, medicine cabinet, crystal vessel, or formation component no larger than a 10-foot cube.
For 24 hours, the lattice preserves the contents against mundane spoilage, dampness, minor spiritual leakage, ordinary insects, and casual handling. The lattice also counts as a visible ward for Ozone Reading and for Lightning talents that require a visible Conductive ward or circuit.
If a creature opens, disturbs, or breaks the lattice without your permission, it takes lightning damage equal to your Cultivation Level and the lattice ends.
A creature can disarm the lattice with a successful Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Intelligence (Arcana), or Lightning Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
TAL_LIGHTNING_THUNDER_ARROW:
### Thunder Arrow - Imbuement, Thunder
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Crackling Arrow
When you hit with a ranged weapon attack using ammunition or a thrown weapon, you may spend 1 CP to release a thunder report from the impact.
The target takes additional lightning or thunder damage equal to 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
Creatures of your choice within 10 feet of the target make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature takes thunder damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
If the attack hits a Charged target, increase the thunder radius to 15 feet.
TAL_LIGHTNING_THUNDER_BREAKS_COMMAND:
### Thunder Breaks Command - Thunder, Overload
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet issues a command, begins a command technique, starts a chant, activates a shout, gives a formation order, or uses a feature that clearly relies on voice, rhythm, command, or battlefield direction
Cost: 1 CP
The triggering creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The command is disrupted. If the feature requires speech or audible command, it fails unless it is Secret, artifact-backed, or higher authority. If the feature does not fail, the triggering creature has Disadvantage on its first attack roll, check, or save DC calculation associated with that command before the end of the turn.
Successful Save: The command proceeds, but the triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Thunder Breaks Command does not create magical silence and does not replace the Sound sphere.
TAL_LIGHTNING_THUNDER_THAT_ANSWERS_FIRST:
### Thunder That Answers First - Thunder, Reaction
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Thunder Breaks Command
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A hostile creature you can see within 300 feet begins a technique, command, domain activation, formation order, Secret preparation, or battlefield-wide instruction
Cost: 3 CP
The triggering creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Thunder arrives before the command completes. The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn, has Disadvantage on the triggering technique’s attack roll or save DC contest if any, and allied creatures relying on that command do not gain Advantage from it.
Successful Save: The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
If the triggering effect is Secret, artifact-backed, or higher Realm, this talent does not cancel it by itself. It imposes the listed penalties unless the opposing authority defeats your Lightning Check.
TAL_LIGHTNING_TRUE_LIGHTNING_GOD_MANTLE:
### True Lightning-God Mantle - Lightning Body
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Lightning-God Body
When you activate Lightning-God Body, you may spend 2 CP instead of 1 CP to enter the True Lightning-God Mantle.
For the duration, you gain all benefits of Lightning-God Body, plus:
- Your Speed increases by 20 feet instead of 10 feet.
- You gain Resistance to lightning damage.
- Once per round when you are hit by a melee attack, you may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks after the attack resolves.
- Your first Electric Fist Method or Conductive Strike hit each turn deals additional lightning damage equal to 1d8.
- When you reduce a creature to 0 HP or cause a creature to fail a save against Meridian-Stopping Spark, you may place a Charge on another creature you can see within 20 feet.
When the mantle ends, you cannot use Lightning-God Body again until you finish a short or long rest unless you succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your own Cultivation Save DC. On a failure, you take lightning damage equal to your Cultivation Level and do not activate the state.
TAL_LIGHTNING_WORLD_NERVE_JUDGMENT:
### World-Nerve Judgment - Shock, Overload
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Sky-Fire Nerve Net
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature you can see that is Charged, Conductive, concentrating, possessing another creature, or maintaining an active technique-state
Cost: 3 CP
The target makes a Constitution saving throw. A spirit, ghost, possession entity, or dream-body may instead make a Wisdom saving throw if that is more appropriate.
Failed Save: The target takes 8d8 lightning damage, cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and immediately makes one Concentration save or maintenance check for each active effect it is sustaining, with Disadvantage.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage, cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, and makes one Concentration save or maintenance check of your choice without Disadvantage.
This talent does not automatically end effects that do not require maintenance, Concentration, command, or active qi flow.
TAL_MAGMA_BLACKGLASS_RAMPART:
#### Blackglass Rampart - Terrain, Siege
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 4 CP
Raise hardened obsidian from cooled magma or volcanic force.
Create up to four connected 5-foot panels. Each panel is 5 feet wide, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick.
Each panel has:
• AC 16;
• HP equal to 5 × your CL;
• Vulnerability to Thunder damage;
• Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
Panels provide Cover normally.
A hostile creature that climbs or moves across a panel takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn.
TAL_MAGMA_BLACKGLASS_RIVER:
#### Blackglass River - Terrain
Prerequisite: Lava Flow, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 60-foot line, 15 feet wide
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
A river of lava pours across the battlefield, then cools into jagged black glass at its edges.
The area is Molten Terrain.
The outer 5 feet along each side is also Obsidian Terrain.
When a creature enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 6d6 Fire damage and 2d6 Slashing damage, and Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
As a Bonus Action while concentrating, move the river 10 feet along a continuous surface.
TAL_MAGMA_BOILING_ASH_SKY:
#### Boiling Ash Sky - Smoke, Eruption
Prerequisite: Volcanic Smoke, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

TAL_METAL_MERIDIAN_NAIL:
### Meridian Nail - Needle, White Tiger
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: 2 CP
Make a Metal Cultivation Attack.
Hit: the target takes **2d8 Piercing damage**, and you choose one nail effect until the start of your next turn:
- reduce the target's Speed by 10 feet;
- the target cannot take Reactions;
- the target has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes to maintain flight, teleportation, phasing, or a movement technique;
- the target has Disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw to maintain a technique.
The nail is qi, not a physical permanent object. It vanishes when the effect ends.
TAL_METAL_METAL_BODY_FORMATION:
### Metal Body Formation - Iron-Body
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Cost: 4 CP
Duration: 1 minute
You form a temporary metal-body circulation.
For the duration:
- gain Temporary HP equal to three times your Proficiency Bonus;
- your Sharpen extra damage increases by your Metal key ability modifier once per turn;
- when you are moved against your will, reduce the movement by 10 feet;
- your unarmed strikes, armor spikes, teeth, nails, and held metal weapons count as qualifying Metal Qi attacks.
When the duration ends, you cannot use Metal Body Formation again until you finish a short rest.
TAL_METAL_MOUNTAIN_ORE_DICTATE:
### Mountain-Ore Dictate - Ore-Root, Loadstone
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 40-foot-radius sphere on metal-rich or mineral ground, or centered on a Huge or larger metal object or structure
Cost: 8 CP
Duration: Until the end of your next turn
You command ore veins, buried iron, mineral ribs, weapon fields, or metal architecture.
Enemies in the area treat it as difficult terrain.
When you create the area and again at the start of your next turn, choose one effect:
- pull creatures wearing significant metal 15 feet toward the center unless they succeed on Strength saves;
- raise temporary metal/mineral ribs that grant half cover to creatures of your choice;
- cause buried iron and mineral edges to deal **4d8 Piercing damage** to enemies who fail Dexterity saves;
- lock one non-artifact metal gate, chain, bridge, portcullis, or mechanism in place until the duration ends.
This talent cannot permanently create a mine, collapse a city, or rewrite terrain beyond its duration.
TAL_METAL_NEEDLE_FLICK:
### Needle Flick - Needle
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or object
Cost: 1 CP, or 0 CP if you use an actual needle, coin, nail, dart, or comparable Tiny metal object as the medium
Make a Metal Cultivation Attack.
Hit: the target takes **1d8 + your Metal key ability modifier** Piercing damage.
If the target is concentrating, maintaining a technique, holding a delicate object, or drawing a talisman, it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw or ability check it makes before the start of your next turn to maintain that activity.
At Foundation Realm, the damage becomes 2d8. At Nascent Soul Realm, it becomes 4d8.
TAL_METAL_NINEFOLD_ADAMANT_BODY:
### Ninefold Adamant Body - Iron-Body
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Cost: 8 CP
Duration: 1 minute
Your body becomes a walking metal scripture.
For the duration:
- gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage;
- gain Advantage on Strength and Constitution saving throws;
- your Sharpen extra damage becomes twice your Proficiency Bonus;
- when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you may use your Reaction to deal Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Metal key ability modifier.
When the duration ends, gain one level of Exhaustion unless you spend 2 additional CP or Stamina as the metal-body pressure vents.
TAL_METAL_ORE_ROOT_SNARE:
### Ore-Root Snare - Ore-Root, Loadstone
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 10-foot square on metal-rich, mineral, worked-stone, or ore-bearing ground
Cost: 2 CP
The ground grows heavy with mineral hooks and buried iron.
The area is difficult terrain for enemies until the end of your next turn.
The first enemy that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
This does not work on pure wood, open water, clouds, empty air, or magically sealed floors unless the GM agrees the surface contains usable mineral or metal.
TAL_METAL_ORE_SENSE_BREATH:
### Ore-Sense Breath - Ore-Root
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Search action
Range: Self, 30-foot radius
Cost: None
Until the end of your next turn, you sense obvious metal, ore, mineral dust, worked metal, buried iron, metal armor, major weapons, chains, bars, bells, coins, and metal-bearing formation nodes within range.
This sense does not reveal exact shapes through walls, hidden compartments, extradimensional storage, or sealed formation vaults. It also cannot distinguish friend from enemy by itself.
Outside combat, Ore-Sense Breath can be maintained for 1 minute while you move at half speed.
TAL_METAL_RING_THE_FLAW:
### Ring the Flaw - Bell
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Study action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature wearing armor, one weapon, shield, restraint, gate, lock, construct part, metal object, or metal-bearing formation node
Cost: None
Make a Metal Check against DC 12 for mundane objects, DC 15 for spiritual equipment or active combat targets, or DC 18 for artifacts, formation nodes, or concealed weaknesses.
Success: choose one benefit before the end of your next turn:
- your next Metal attack against the target gains Advantage;
- your next Metal attack against the target ignores half cover from metal, shield angle, armor plate, or comparable metal obstruction;
- you learn whether the target is brittle, reinforced, cursed, hollow, magnetic, conductive, oath-bound, or already damaged.
Failure: you learn only whether the target is mundane or spiritually reinforced.
TAL_METAL_THOUSAND_EDGE_RAIN:
### Thousand-Edge Rain - Needle
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 4 CP
You rain needles, shards, coins, filings, or blade-light.
Creatures of your choice in the area make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failure: take **5d8 Piercing damage**.
Success: take half damage.
A creature wearing significant metal, carrying many metal weapons, standing on metal-rich ground, or already affected by a Metal talent this turn has Disadvantage on the saving throw.
TAL_METAL_WHITE_TIGER_GLANCE:
### White Tiger Glance - White Tiger
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature you can see that you damaged this turn with a Metal attack or technique
Cost: 1 CP
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failure: it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
If the target is Bloodied, it also has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.
Success: it cannot take Opportunity Attacks against you until the start of its next turn.
TAL_METAL_WHITE_TIGER_KILLING_STAR:
### White Tiger Killing Star - White Tiger
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature you can see
Cost: 8 CP
Make a Metal Cultivation Attack.
Hit: the target takes **10d8 Slashing damage**.
If the target is Bloodied after the damage, it must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failure: it is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn and cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Success: it is not Frightened but still cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
If this attack reduces the target to 0 HP, you may immediately use Metal Appraisal on one metal object, armor piece, weapon, or formation node within 60 feet without spending an action.
TAL_METAL_WHITE_TIGER_SEVEN_SLAUGHTER_CA:
### White Tiger Seven-Slaughter Canon - Secret, White Tiger, Edge
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, White Tiger teacher, killing-edge scripture, execution hall inheritance, or comparable revelation
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You open the White Tiger killing star inside your Metal Qi. Your eyes, breath, weapon, nails, needles, or aura take on a pale cutting radiance. Until the state ends, your Metal talents become Seven-Slaughter expressions.
While the Canon is active, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a Metal talent, weapon attack carrying Metal Qi, or White Tiger Method talent, choose one slaughter sign:
- **No Mending Under the Star.** The target cannot regain HP or gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn.
- **Cut the Coward Road.** The target cannot benefit from teleportation, phasing, burrowing, or invisibility to escape you until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw.
- **Open the Guard.** The next attack against the target before the start of your next turn gains a bonus to the attack roll equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- **Sever the Command.** The target cannot grant allies Advantage, command a formation, or issue a battlefield order until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw.
- **Tiger Eats the Fear.** If the target is Bloodied, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
Once while the Canon is active, when you reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP or score a critical hit with a Metal talent, you may immediately regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus and end one Frightened or Charmed effect on yourself.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the first slaughter sign you choose each round may affect one additional creature within 30 feet that you damaged with a Metal talent this turn.
This Canon is not subtle. Orthodox witnesses recognize it as a temple-grade or execution-grade killing scripture.
TAL_METAL_WHITE_TIGER_SEVERANCE:
### White Tiger Severance - White Tiger, Edge
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Cost: 4 CP
Make a Metal Cultivation Attack.
Hit: the target takes **6d8 Slashing damage**.
If the target is Bloodied or has already taken Slashing or Piercing damage this round, it cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the damage becomes 8d8.
This is killing edge, not blood control. It does not manipulate blood and does not drain life.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_BORROWED_TREASURE:
#### Borrowed Treasure - Trick
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Finish
Range: 5 feet
Cost: Spend a Monkey Link
Chain Role: Finish
Attempt to steal one accessible object carried by a creature you moved past, hit, feinted, or forced to miss you this turn.
Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the target’s Wisdom (Perception) check.
Success: Take the object, immediately hold or stow it, and move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.
Failure: You do not take the object.
You cannot steal worn armor, a massive item, an item sealed inside secure storage, an object physically fused to the body, a soul-bound artifact, a Secret Inheritance, or a Realm-defining treasure without a specific feature.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_CLOUD_SKIPPING_STEP:
#### Cloud-Skipping Step - Caper, Climb
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Opener; modifies Capering Footwork
Duration: Until the end of your current turn
Cost: +1 Stamina or +1 CP when activating Capering Footwork
Chain Role: Opener, Link
When you activate Capering Footwork, you may pay this additional cost to cloud-skip.
Until the end of your turn:
move across liquids;
run along walls;
move across fragile surfaces without breaking them if they could plausibly support a light step;
increase jump distance fivefold;
ignore falling damage from a distance no greater than your remaining Speed;
treat narrow rails, branches, ropes, rooflines, banners, and similar surfaces as normal ground.
The first time this movement changes elevation by at least 10 feet, creates a wall-run, or crosses liquid or air-supported footing, you create a Monkey Link.
You fall normally if you end your turn unsupported.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_COURT_OF_THE_LAUGHING_S:
#### Court of the Laughing Sage - Domain, Caper
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 Stamina or 7 CP
Chain Role: Domain, Engine
The fool controls the room because everyone watches the fool.
Inside the Domain:
You:
Speed increases by 20 feet;
opportunity attacks against you have Disadvantage;
you may move through hostile spaces as difficult terrain;
you may hold up to two Monkey Links at a time, though you can still spend only one per turn unless another talent says otherwise;
once per turn, after an enemy misses you, move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
Allies:
gain +10 feet Speed;
gain Advantage on checks made to escape Grappled or stand from Prone under pressure.
Enemies:
The first time an enemy attacks you during each of its turns, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The attack has Disadvantage.
Successful Save: The attack resolves normally.
This is a Domain and follows the setting’s Domain safeguards.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_DRUNKEN_MONKEY_STANCE:
#### Drunken Monkey Stance - Caper, Trick
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 Stamina or 3 CP
Chain Role: Engine, Reversal
Sway, stumble, laugh, and move unpredictably.
For the duration:
gain +2 AC;
gain Advantage on checks made to escape Grappled;
when a creature misses you with a melee attack, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from it;
once per round, when a creature misses you, create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn.
The stance ends early if you are Incapacitated, Restrained, or unable to move.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_GOLDEN_HOOP_STAFF:
#### Golden Hoop Staff - Staff
Prerequisite: Staff of the Laughing Sage, CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 4 Stamina or 4 CP
Chain Role: Engine, Finish
Empower one staff, polearm, spear, ladder, oar, banner pole, or suitable long weapon.
For the duration:
the weapon’s reach increases by 10 feet on your turn;
the weapon counts as magical when a rule distinguishes magical and nonmagical attacks;
the weapon’s damage die becomes at least 1d10;
it may shrink to the size of a needle or expand into a 20-foot pole as part of drawing, stowing, or attacking with it;
as an Action, plant it into the ground to create a climbable pole up to 60 feet high.
Once per turn when you hit with the empowered weapon while you have a Monkey Link, you may spend the link to force the target to make a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push or pull the target 15 feet.
Successful Save: Move the target 5 feet.
This movement is forced movement and does not provoke opportunity attacks.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_HEAVEN_BRIDGE_SWING:
#### Heaven-Bridge Swing - Climb, Caper
Prerequisite: Cloud-Skipping Step, CL 10+
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Opener; modifies Capering Footwork
Duration: Until the end of your turn
Cost: +2 Stamina or +2 CP when activating Capering Footwork
Chain Role: Opener, Link
Create a brief chain of handholds from branches, roof-beams, banners, poles, air-steps, or tail-like Qi.
Until the end of your turn:
gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed, but you must end the movement on a surface, object, creature, or climbable feature that can support you;
opportunity attacks against this movement have Disadvantage;
after you change elevation by at least 10 feet, create a Monkey Link;
after you spend a Monkey Link created by this talent, your next melee attack before the end of the turn deals extra damage equal to Proficiency Bonus.
If you end unsupported, you fall.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_HEAVEN_UPROOTING_STAFF:
#### Heaven-Uprooting Staff - Staff
Prerequisite: Golden Hoop Staff, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Cost: 10 Stamina or 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Chain Role: Finish
Strike a point on the ground within your reach.
If you spend a Monkey Link as part of this Action, increase the radius by 10 feet.
Creatures of your choice inside a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 10d10 Bludgeoning or Force damage and fall Prone.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
Structures and unattended objects take double damage.
This damage uses normal AC, HP, object Damage Thresholds, and Barrier rules unless a feature says otherwise.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_HIGH_BRANCH_GUARD:
#### High Branch Guard - Climb, Caper
Chain Role: Link, Reversal
While you are climbing, hanging, balancing on a narrow surface, or standing at least 5 feet above a hostile creature within 10 feet of you, gain +1 AC against that creature’s melee attacks.
When that creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet along a climbable or elevated surface without provoking opportunity attacks from it. If Capering Footwork is active or was active on your previous turn, this movement creates a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_HUNDRED_HANDED_TRICKSTE:
#### Hundred-Handed Trickster - Trick, Prop
Prerequisite: Borrowed Treasure, CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 Stamina or 5 CP
Chain Role: Engine, Finish
Your hands, feet, sleeves, tail-like Qi, and weapon movements become impossibly fast.
For the duration:
draw, stow, or pick up any number of ordinary unattended objects during your turn;
gain Advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks;
you may create a Monkey Link once per turn by interacting with a prop or accessible object even if Capering Footwork is not active;
Borrowed Treasure may be used once per turn without spending a Monkey Link, but only after you hit, feint, move through a creature’s space, or cause a creature to miss you;
your improvised weapons deal at least 1d8 damage.
You still cannot steal sealed, soul-bound, Realm-defining, or inaccessible objects without a specific feature.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_IMPROVISED_MASTER:
#### Improvised Master - Prop
Chain Role: Engine, Finish
Your Monkey Style improvised weapons deal 1d8 damage instead of 1d6.
While Capering Footwork is active, if you hit with an improvised weapon and spend your Monkey Link on Tap Finish, increase the extra damage to 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 11, the improvised weapon die becomes 1d10.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_LAUGHING_STAFF_AND_BORR:
#### Laughing Staff and Borrowed Weapon - Base Weapon Tool
You are proficient with quarterstaffs, staffs, and improvised weapons used through Monkey Style.
Your Monkey Style improvised weapons deal 1d6 damage unless their normal damage would be higher.
Examples include stools, bottles, bricks, cooking pots, chains, loose stones, ladders, teapots, fruit, shoes, roof tiles, sleeves weighted with coins, and stolen weapons used incorrectly.
While Capering Footwork is active, hitting with a staff, Unarmed Strike, or improvised weapon may spend your Monkey Link on a base Finish.
Your Monkey Style improvised weapons count as magical while you wield them when a rule distinguishes magical and nonmagical attacks.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_LAUGHING_THEFT_OF_TIMIN:
#### Laughing Theft of Timing - Trick
Prerequisite: Mischievous Feint or Borrowed Treasure, CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you affected with a Monkey Style Trick, Finish, or feint this turn makes an attack roll or saving throw before the start of your next turn
Cost: 5 Stamina or 5 CP
Chain Role: Reversal, Finish
Roll 1d6 and subtract the result from the triggering d20 roll.
If the triggering roll fails because of this penalty, choose one:
move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature;
make one improvised-weapon attack against that creature;
steal one accessible unattended object within 5 feet of you;
create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_LAUGHING_TRIP:
#### Laughing Trip - Caper, Trick
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Cost: 1 Stamina or 1 CP
Chain Role: Finish
Make one Unarmed Strike, staff attack, or improvised-weapon melee attack.
Hit: Deal normal damage. If you have a Monkey Link, you may spend it to force the target to make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target falls Prone.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
If the attack was made after changing elevation or moving through the target’s space, the target has Disadvantage on this saving throw.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_MIRROR_MONKEY_TECHNIQUE:
#### Mirror-Monkey Technique - Afterimage
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 Stamina or 5 CP
Chain Role: Engine, Reversal
Create two afterimages in spaces within 10 feet of you.
When you are targeted by an attack, roll 1d6.
1-2: The attack targets an afterimage.
3-6: The attack targets you.
An afterimage disappears when it is targeted.
As a Bonus Action while the technique remains active, recreate all missing afterimages.
If an enemy destroys an afterimage while Capering Footwork is active or while Drunken Monkey Stance is active, you create a Monkey Link.
Afterimages do not block movement, provide Cover, make attacks, or count as creatures.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_MISCHIEVOUS_FEINT:
#### Mischievous Feint - Trick
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: No Action when you activate Capering Footwork
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 0
Chain Role: Opener, Link
When you activate Capering Footwork, choose one creature within range that can see or hear you. You mock, grin, stagger, flourish, expose a false opening, or make a ridiculous posture.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: You create a Monkey Link. The link can be spent only against that target before the end of your turn.
Successful Save: The target sees through the bait.
Whether the save succeeds or fails, the target knows you are trying to bait it.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_MONKEY_CATCHES_THE_MOON:
#### Monkey Catches the Moon - Caper, Trick
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet misses you or an ally with a ranged attack
Cost: 4 Stamina or 4 CP
Chain Role: Reversal, Finish
Move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
If you end this movement adjacent to the missed attack’s path or target space, choose one:
catch or deflect a mundane projectile that could fit in one hand;
create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn;
make one improvised-weapon attack against a creature within 20 feet using the projectile or a nearby object;
give the missed ally Half Cover until the start of your next turn.
You cannot catch siege ammunition, area effects, spells, or projectiles made from a Secret Inheritance unless a special feature says otherwise.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_PEACH_THIEF_ESCAPE:
#### Peach-Thief Escape - Caper, Afterimage
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You take damage, fail a Dexterity saving throw, or become Grappled or Restrained
Cost: 4 Stamina or 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Chain Role: Reversal
Move up to half your Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
You may move through hostile spaces and across vertical surfaces during this movement.
If this movement places you outside the triggering effect’s area or reach, choose the appropriate result:
avoid the triggering attack’s damage;
avoid the triggering area effect’s damage;
escape the Grappled or Restrained condition if the condition depended on the original reach, grasp, net, or restraint position.
You leave behind a harmless decoy such as a cloak, shoe, stolen fruit, puff of dust, discarded staff, or laughing afterimage.
If this movement changes elevation, moves through a hostile space, or uses a prop or handhold, create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn.
The GM may rule that restraints physically locked to you, magical bindings, or sealed Barriers require an additional check or cannot be escaped with movement alone.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_SNATCH_AND_SCATTER:
#### Snatch and Scatter - Trick, Caper
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 5 feet misses you with a melee attack
Cost: 1 Stamina or 1 CP
Chain Role: Reversal
Choose one:
move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the attacker;
create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn;
attempt to Disarm the attacker;
pick up or steal one accessible unattended object;
draw one carried item and immediately stow another.
If you attempt to Disarm the attacker, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It drops one held object of your choice.
Successful Save: It retains the object.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_STAFF_OF_THE_LAUGHING_S:
#### Staff of the Laughing Sage - Staff
Prerequisite: Staff-Swing Step or Staff Sage, CL 5+
Chain Role: Finish
While wielding a staff, spear, polearm, ladder, oar, banner pole, or suitable long object:
increase your reach by 5 feet on your turn with that weapon;
the weapon counts as magical when a rule distinguishes magical and nonmagical attacks;
once per turn on hit while Capering Footwork is active, you may spend a Monkey Link to choose one Staff Finish.
Sweeping Tail: Push the target 10 feet.
Crooked Branch: Pull the target 10 feet.
Peach-Stealing Tap: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Upside-Down Strike: Move yourself 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.
This reach increase does not apply to opportunity attacks unless another feature says otherwise.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_STONE_SKIPPING_STRIKE:
#### Stone-Skipping Strike - Prop
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Range: 30/90 feet
Cost: 1 Stamina or 1 CP
Chain Role: Finish
Throw a stone, coin, fruit, cup, weapon, roof tile, or other suitable object.
Make one ranged weapon attack using your Monkey Style Attack Modifier.
Hit: Deal 2d6 + Monkey Style key ability modifier Bludgeoning damage.
If you have a Monkey Link, you may spend it to ricochet the object toward another creature within 10 feet of the target. Make a second attack roll.
Second Hit: Deal 1d6 + Monkey Style key ability modifier Bludgeoning damage.
At CL 5, the first hit becomes 3d6 and the second hit becomes 2d6.
At CL 11, the first hit becomes 4d6 and the second hit becomes 3d6.
At CL 17, the first hit becomes 5d6 and the second hit becomes 4d6.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_TAIL_QI_HOOK:
#### Tail-Qi Hook - Trick, Climb
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: bonus_action, passive
Timing Detail: Bonus Action, or no Action while Capering Footwork is active
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=BONUS_ACTION_HOOK->bonus_action, NO_ACTION_CAPERING_HOOK->passive
Range: 10 feet
Cost: 0
Chain Role: Link
Use a hook, sash, toe, sleeve, staff-tip, or tail-like thread of Qi to manipulate one unattended object within range.
Choose one:
pull a Tiny unattended object to your hand;
push or drag a Small unattended object 5 feet;
open or close an unlocked door, drawer, curtain, or latch;
pull yourself 5 feet toward a stable object or climbable surface.
If Capering Footwork is active and this interaction changes your position, changes elevation, or moves a useful prop, you create a Monkey Link.
This cannot make attacks, pick locks, manipulate worn armor, or steal a held item unless another talent permits it.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_VAULTING_STRIKE:
#### Vaulting Strike - Caper
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Cost: 1 Stamina or 1 CP
Chain Role: Finish
Requirement: You moved at least 10 feet this turn before making the attack
Make one melee attack.
Hit: Deal normal damage plus 1d8 Bludgeoning damage.
If you have a Monkey Link, you may spend it to force the target to make a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
push the target 10 feet;
knock the target Prone;
move yourself 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.
Successful Save: Move yourself 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target.
TAL_QIWEAVING_ADDITIONAL_QIWEAVING_PACKA:
#### Additional Qiweaving Package
Choose one Qiweaving Package you do not already possess. You gain that package’s base ability and may select talents from that package.
You may learn this talent more than once. Each time, choose a different package.
TAL_QIWEAVING_APPLY_MODULATION:
##### Apply Modulation
Once per turn, when you activate a sphere technique you know, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to that technique and pay the listed cost.
TAL_QIWEAVING_BORROWED_MODULATION:
#### Borrowed Modulation
Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A willing creature within 30 feet activates a sphere technique
Cost: 1 CP plus the Modulation’s cost
Apply one Modulation talent you know to the triggering creature’s technique.
The triggering creature must be willing, must be able to perceive your assistance, and must pay any costs required by the original technique.
You pay the Modulation cost.
TAL_QIWEAVING_CALM_THE_WILD_MERIDIAN:
#### Calm the Wild Meridian
Prerequisite: Turbulence Package, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature, object, Active Qi Pattern, or 20-foot-radius area suffering from wild Qi, Qi deviation, uncontrolled backlash, or unstable magical turbulence.
Make a Qiweaving Check against the instability’s DC or 10 + its Pattern Rank.
Successful Check: Suppress the instability for 1 minute. If it was caused by an ongoing effect with Pattern Rank no higher than your Proficiency Bonus, you may end it instead.
Failed Check: The instability remains, but creatures of your choice inside the affected area have Advantage on saving throws against it until the start of your next turn.
TAL_QIWEAVING_CIRCUIT_LOCK:
#### Circuit Lock
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 10+
Cost: 2 CP
When you apply Throttle Current, you may intensify it into a Circuit Lock.
The bonded target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the target cannot spend more CP on a single technique than your Proficiency Bonus.
Successful Save: Throttle Current applies normally.
Circuit Lock does not prevent a creature from using a Secret Inheritance, but the inheritance’s visible Qi pattern may become strained or narratively exposed at the GM’s discretion.
TAL_QIWEAVING_CONDUCTIVE_TOUCH:
#### Conductive Touch
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package or Pressure Points sphere, CL 5+
When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, natural weapon, or light melee weapon, you may spend 1 CP to create a Qi Bond to that creature without using a Bonus Action.
If the target is unwilling, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The Qi Bond forms.
Successful Save: No bond forms.
TAL_QIWEAVING_COUNTERWEAVE:
#### Counterweave
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within Unweave Pattern range activates a spell, sphere technique, or other Active Qi Pattern
Cost: 1 CP and expend Martial Focus
Use Unweave Pattern against the triggering technique as it is being activated.
On a success, the technique fails. Any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent to activate it is lost.
On a failure, the technique resolves normally.
Counterweave cannot counter a Secret Inheritance unless the inheritance specifically permits it.
TAL_QIWEAVING_COURT_OF_TEN_THOUSAND_CURR:
#### Court of Ten Thousand Currents - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You establish a Domain in which active Qi patterns become visible as braided currents.
While the Domain lasts:
you know the location of Active Qi Patterns inside the Domain that are not behind Total Cover;
you have Advantage on Qiweaving Checks made against patterns inside the Domain;
your Unweave Pattern and Qi Bond range extends to any valid target inside the Domain;
once during each of your turns, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to a technique you activate without paying that Modulation’s additional CP cost, unless the talent’s cost is 3 CP or higher;
when a willing creature inside the Domain activates a sphere technique, you may use your Reaction to grant it a +1 bonus to its Cultivation Save DC for that activation;
when a hostile creature inside the Domain activates a sphere technique that costs CP, you may use your Reaction to force it to pay 1 additional CP or make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the technique is visibly distorted, and creatures have Advantage on the first saving throw they make against it before the end of the turn.
A creature can be affected by only one cost increase from this Domain per turn.
Court of Ten Thousand Currents is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove it unless the technique explicitly affects Domains.
TAL_QIWEAVING_DAZING_UNWEAVE:
#### Dazing Unweave - Unweaving
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you successfully counter a technique with Unweave Pattern, the creature whose technique you countered makes an Intelligence saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls made as part of magical or cultivation techniques, and creatures have Advantage on saving throws against its magical or cultivation techniques.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
TAL_QIWEAVING_DISTANT_MODULATION:
#### Distant Modulation - Modulation
Prerequisite: Modulation Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you activate a sphere technique with a range of at least 10 feet, increase its range by 30 feet.
At CL 11, increase the range by 60 feet instead.
Distant Modulation does not change the size of an area and cannot make a touch-range technique ranged unless a talent explicitly permits it.
TAL_QIWEAVING_DRAW_CURRENT:
#### Draw Current - Bond
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package
When you apply this Bond talent to an unwilling bonded creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target loses 1 CP, and you gain 1 Temporary CP.
Successful Save: No CP is lost.
Temporary CP gained this way lasts until the end of your next turn.
A creature cannot lose more CP to your Draw Current than your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.
If the target has no CP, this talent has no effect unless a feature explicitly treats another resource as CP.
TAL_QIWEAVING_FALSE_COMPLETION:
#### False Completion - Unweaving
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you successfully counter a technique with Unweave Pattern, the creature whose technique you countered makes an Intelligence saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature believes the technique had its intended outward effect until the end of its next turn or until obvious evidence proves otherwise.
This is an illusion-like misreading of the broken Qi pattern. It does not create a full illusion, harm the target, or force other creatures to believe the result.
TAL_QIWEAVING_FRIEND_IN_THE_STORM:
#### Friend in the Storm - Turbulence
Prerequisite: Turbulence Package
Choose a number of creatures up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1, when you create Turbulent Field.
Chosen creatures are not affected by your Turbulent Field unless they choose to be.
As a Bonus Action, you may change one chosen creature while the field lasts.
TAL_QIWEAVING_GENTLE_MODULATION:
#### Gentle Modulation - Modulation
Prerequisite: Modulation Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you activate a sphere technique that affects an area, choose a number of creatures in the area up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1.
The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against that activation, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.
Gentle Modulation cannot protect a creature from an effect that does not allow a saving throw.
TAL_QIWEAVING_GRAND_UNWEAVING:
#### Grand Unweaving
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 3 CP
Choose any number of Active Qi Patterns inside the area that you can perceive.
Make one Qiweaving Check and compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC separately.
Success Against a Pattern: That pattern ends.
Failure Against a Pattern: That pattern remains.
Grand Unweaving cannot affect Domains, Secret Inheritances, Formation projects, artifacts, or campaign-scale workings unless a feature explicitly permits it.
TAL_QIWEAVING_OPEN_CIRCUIT:
#### Open Circuit
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 5+
Your Qi Bond may target an Active Qi Pattern directly even when you cannot target the creature bearing it, provided you can perceive the pattern and it is not behind Total Cover.
While bonded to an Active Qi Pattern, you may apply Bond talents to the pattern rather than to a creature.
Examples:
Read Current identifies the pattern’s sphere resonance and Pattern Rank category.
Throttle Current increases the CP cost of the next attempt to sustain or extend the pattern.
Draw Current can drain 1 CP from a maintained pattern if it has stored CP or a sustaining creator.
The GM determines which Bond talents make sense for a non-creature pattern.
TAL_QIWEAVING_PAIRED_RESONANCE:
#### Paired Resonance - Harmonic
Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, two non-Qiweaving spheres
Choose two spheres you know when you learn this talent.
Once per turn, when you apply a mark, thread, seed, anchor, brand, or similar sphere-specific tag from one chosen sphere to a creature, you may cause that creature to count as visibly touched by the other chosen sphere until the start of your next turn.
This does not apply the other sphere’s actual mark, thread, seed, anchor, or brand unless a talent says so. It merely satisfies talents that require the target to be affected by or recently touched by that sphere, subject to GM approval.
TAL_QIWEAVING_QI_BOND:
##### Qi Bond
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Attempt to form a thread between your circulation and the target’s Qi pattern.
A willing creature, an unattended object, or an Active Qi Pattern you created is bonded automatically.
Against an unwilling creature, attended object, or hostile Active Qi Pattern, make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If the target is an Active Qi Pattern, treat its AC as equal to its creator’s Cultivation Save DC. If the creator is unknown, use 10 + Pattern Rank.
Hit: Create a Qi Bond.
Miss: No bond forms.
While the bond lasts, you may use your Action on each of your turns to apply one Bond talent you know to the target.
Unless a Bond talent says otherwise, the Qi Bond ends if:
the target is ever outside your Qi Bond range;
the target has Total Cover from you;
you use your Action for anything other than applying or maintaining a Bond talent;
you lose Concentration.
###### Persistent Qi Bond
Augment - 2 CP: The Qi Bond persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the bond on your turn without spending an Action.
TAL_QIWEAVING_QUIET_MODULATION:
#### Quiet Modulation - Modulation
Prerequisite: Modulation Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you activate a sphere technique, suppress obvious sound, spoken formula, visible hand-sign flare, or unnecessary spectacle from the activation.
The technique’s normal effects remain visible once they appear.
Quiet Modulation does not make an attack Hidden, conceal a projectile, hide obvious damage, remove material components, or allow a technique to bypass a feature that specifically detects magic or cultivation.
TAL_QIWEAVING_QUIET_THE_FLAW:
#### Quiet the Flaw - Turbulence
Prerequisite: Turbulence Package
When a willing creature inside your Turbulent Field would suffer a wild Qi or Qi-deviation complication, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP.
Reduce the severity of the complication by one step, or allow the creature to reroll the instability result and use the new result.
If the campaign does not use an instability table, the creature gains Advantage on the saving throw against your Turbulent Field instead.
TAL_QIWEAVING_REGULATED_BREATHING:
#### Regulated Breathing
Prerequisite: Turbulence Package or Qi Bond Package, CL 5+
As an Action, choose one willing creature within 30 feet whose circulation is unstable, turbulent, poisoned by Qi deviation, or suffering from a temporary backlash effect.
The target may immediately repeat one saving throw against that instability or backlash, adding your Key Ability modifier to the roll.
A creature can benefit from your Regulated Breathing once per short rest.
TAL_QIWEAVING_RETUNE_CURRENT:
#### Retune Current
Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 5+
Cost: +1 CP
When you activate a sphere technique that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder damage, choose one damage type from that list that another sphere you know could plausibly produce.
Change one damage roll of the technique to the chosen damage type.
Retune Current cannot create a damage type that none of your known spheres can justify.
TAL_QIWEAVING_RETURN_THE_TEN_THOUSAND_CU:
#### Return the Ten Thousand Currents to One Breath
Prerequisite: Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden Qiweaving scripture or equivalent sect transmission
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You name the first current beneath the battlefield. For one breath, every active technique inside the area remembers that it is only borrowed Qi.
Choose any number of Active Qi Patterns inside the area that you can perceive.
Make one Qiweaving Check with Advantage.
Compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC.
##### Success Against a Mortal, Foundation, or Core Pattern
The pattern ends.
##### Success Against a Nascent Soul Pattern or Domain
The pattern is suppressed until the end of your next turn.
If the pattern’s text allows it to be ended by superior unweaving, it ends instead.
##### Success Against a Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation project, or campaign-scale working
The pattern is not ended.
Choose one:
suppress one non-central function until the start of your next turn;
reveal one structural weakness, anchor, cost, or condition required to challenge it;
prevent it from expanding, moving, or being reinforced until the start of your next turn;
shield a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus from one immediate expression of it.
##### Failure Against a Pattern
The pattern is exposed until the start of your next turn.
Attacks and Qiweaving Checks against exposed patterns have Advantage, and creatures have Advantage on saving throws against exposed hostile patterns.
##### Aftermath
After resolving the inheritance, choose a number of willing creatures inside the area up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1.
Each chosen creature regains 1 CP or gains 1 Temporary CP if it is already at maximum CP.
Then you lose access to Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation until you finish a long rest.
Return the Ten Thousand Currents to One Breath cannot permanently remove a Path, Realm, bloodline, soul, artifact, sect Formation, or destiny. It can reveal how such things are being sustained and create a moment in which they may be challenged.
TAL_QIWEAVING_REVERSIBLE_PATTERN:
#### Reversible Pattern
Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 10+
Cost: +2 CP
When you activate a sphere technique with a duration of at least 1 minute, inscribe a reversible pattern into it.
Once before the technique ends, you may use a Bonus Action to reverse one non-damaging directional choice made when the technique was created.
Examples include:
reverse the direction a rotating field moves;
change which side of a line-shaped effect is safe;
swap the inward or outward pressure of an area;
reverse a permitted push into a pull if the original technique could plausibly support it.
Reversible Pattern cannot change targets, change damage into healing, alter a saving throw type, or rewrite a technique’s basic identity.
TAL_QIWEAVING_REWRITE_THE_RETURNING_BREA:
#### Rewrite the Returning Breath
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A willing creature within 60 feet would spend CP
Cost: 3 CP
The triggering creature spends 1 less CP, minimum 0.
Then choose one:
the creature gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Key Ability modifier;
the creature may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
the creature gains Advantage on the first Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn;
the creature’s technique ignores one instance of Disadvantage on its first attack roll before the end of the turn.
A creature can benefit from your Rewrite the Returning Breath once per long rest.
TAL_QIWEAVING_SEIZE_PATTERN:
#### Seize Pattern
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 10+
Cost: +2 CP
When you successfully counter a technique that targets one or more creatures or objects, you may reassign the technique’s targets instead of ending it.
Choose new legal targets within the original range and targeting limits.
If the technique requires Concentration, you take over Concentration for the original creator. The original creator cannot end the effect voluntarily while you concentrate on it.
Seize Pattern cannot make an illegal target legal, change an area into a single target, or seize a Secret Inheritance.
TAL_QIWEAVING_SEVER_LINK:
#### Sever Link
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 5+
Cost: +1 CP
When you use Unweave Pattern against a mark, thread, seed, anchor, brand, or similar connection between two creatures, objects, or spaces, you may sever the connection without ending the entire parent technique.
Examples include cutting a tracking mark, ending one creature’s Blood Thread, removing one Shadow Mark, disconnecting one pressure anchor, or breaking one talisman link.
The GM determines whether a connection is separable.
TAL_QIWEAVING_SHARED_COST_SCRIPTURE:
#### Shared Cost Scripture - Harmonic
Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, two non-Qiweaving spheres
When you activate a Harmonic talent requiring two spheres, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 1.
You may use this reduction a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.
TAL_QIWEAVING_SHARED_RESERVOIR:
#### Shared Reservoir
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 10+
When you maintain Qi Bond on a willing creature, you and the bonded creature may transfer CP between yourselves as an Action.
The creature giving CP chooses how much to give, up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Transferred CP cannot exceed the recipient’s normal maximum CP.
A creature can receive CP through your Shared Reservoir once per long rest.
TAL_QIWEAVING_STABILIZING_CIRCUIT:
#### Stabilizing Circuit
Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 5+
When you apply Stable Modulation, you may also add your Proficiency Bonus to the first Concentration saving throw made for that technique before the start of your next turn.
If another effect already adds your Proficiency Bonus to that save, do not add it twice.
TAL_QIWEAVING_STABLE_MODULATION:
#### Stable Modulation - Modulation
Prerequisite: Modulation Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you activate a sphere technique that requires Concentration, gain Advantage on the first Concentration saving throw you make for that technique before the start of your next turn.
At CL 11, this benefit lasts until the end of your next turn.
TAL_QIWEAVING_THROTTLE_CURRENT:
#### Throttle Current - Bond
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package
When you apply this Bond talent to a bonded creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The next technique the target activates before the start of your next turn that costs CP costs 1 additional CP.
If the target cannot or will not pay the additional CP, the technique fails and any Action spent on it is lost. The original CP is not spent.
Successful Save: No effect.
A creature can suffer this added cost from you only once per round.
TAL_QIWEAVING_TURBULENT_BACKLASH:
#### Turbulent Backlash
Prerequisite: Turbulence Package, CL 10+
When a hostile creature fails its saving throw against your Turbulent Field, you may spend 1 CP.
The creature takes Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Key Ability modifier, and it has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn.
TAL_QIWEAVING_TURBULENT_FIELD:
##### Turbulent Field
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 5-foot-radius Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
You emit a field of unstable Qi.
If the campaign uses wild magic or Qi-deviation rules, increase the instability chance of creatures inside the area by 50 percent.
If the campaign does not use a separate instability system, use the following fallback.
The first time on a turn that a creature inside the area activates a technique that costs CP or casts a spell using a spell slot, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The technique is Turbulent until it resolves. A Turbulent technique suffers one complication chosen by the GM or rolled from a campaign-appropriate table, such as visible backlash, noisy activation, reduced range, accidental self-exposure, or minor damage to an unattended nearby object.
The fallback complication should be inconvenient but should not normally waste the technique unless another Turbulence talent says so.
The area radius increases by Realm:
Cultivation Level: 1-4 - Radius: 5 feet
Cultivation Level: 5-10 - Radius: 10 feet
Cultivation Level: 11-16 - Radius: 15 feet
Cultivation Level: 17-20 - Radius: 20 feet
###### Lingering Turbulence
Augment - 2 CP: The Turbulent Field persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the field on your turn without spending an Action.
TAL_QIWEAVING_TWIN_SPHERE_MODULATION:
#### Twin-Sphere Modulation
Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, CL 10+
When you activate a Harmonic talent requiring two spheres, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to that activation even if you already applied another Modulation this turn.
You must still pay the Modulation’s cost.
TAL_QIWEAVING_UNWEAVE_PATTERN:
##### Unweave Pattern
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, location, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
Attempt to end one Active Qi Pattern on the target.
If the pattern’s Pattern Rank is equal to or lower than half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, it ends automatically.
Otherwise, make a Qiweaving Check against the pattern.
Successful Check: The pattern ends.
Failed Check: The pattern remains.
Unweave Pattern cannot end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, Formation project, artifact-level effect, or campaign-scale working unless a talent, project, or GM ruling explicitly permits it.
###### Rapid Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the Action Type to Action.
If you Ready this Action to disrupt a technique as it is activated, resolve Unweave Pattern when the triggering technique is being created. On a successful check, the technique fails and any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent on it is lost.
###### Broad Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Attempt to unweave a number of additional Active Qi Patterns on the same target equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down.
Make a separate Qiweaving Check for each pattern that is not ended automatically.
###### Certain Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: The automatic-ending threshold becomes your Proficiency Bonus instead of half your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_QIWEAVING_VICIOUS_UNWEAVE:
#### Vicious Unweave - Unweaving
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package
Cost: +1 CP
When you successfully end or counter an Active Qi Pattern with Unweave Pattern, choose one creature bearing, maintaining, or creating that pattern.
That creature takes Force damage.
Cultivation Level: 1-4 -
Damage: 1d10
Cultivation Level: 5-10 -
Damage: 2d10
Cultivation Level: 11-16 -
Damage: 3d10
Cultivation Level: 17-20 -
Damage: 4d10
A creature can take this damage from you only once per turn.
TAL_QIWEAVING_WORLD_CIRCUIT_SEVERANCE:
#### World-Circuit Severance
Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose up to a number of Active Qi Patterns you can perceive within range equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Make one Qiweaving Check with Advantage.
Compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC.
Success Against a Pattern: The pattern ends.
Failure Against a Pattern: The pattern is suppressed until the start of your next turn instead.
World-Circuit Severance may suppress a Domain until the start of your next turn on a successful check, but it does not end the Domain unless the Domain’s text permits it.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_ANSWER_BEFORE_THE_QUESTI:
### Answer Before the Question Is Spoken
“The strike did not interrupt the technique. For one breath, cause and answer simply arrived in the wrong order.”
Prerequisites: Court of the Awaiting Blade, Spell Breaker, CL 17+
Use Limit: Once per long rest
When a creature you can perceive within 60 feet begins an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or willing movement, invoke this inheritance before the triggering activity resolves.
Move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
This movement may cross liquids and vertical surfaces without falling until the movement ends, but it cannot pass through occupied spaces, Total Cover, sealed barriers, or impossible routes.
If you end within reach of the triggering creature, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it.
This attack counts as a Counterstrike and may apply one Counter talent.
Hit: Deal normal Counterstrike damage. The target then makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The triggering activity fails before it resolves. Any Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, spell slot, CP cost, item charge, or other committed resource is lost. If the trigger was movement, the movement ends immediately.
Successful Save: The triggering activity continues normally after the attack resolves.
Answer Before the Question Is Spoken may interrupt an activity that would not ordinarily be a legal Counterstrike trigger.
It cannot prevent an effect that has already resolved.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_CHASING_ASSAULT:
### Chasing Assault - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Launching Uppercut, CL 10+
Whenever you launch a hostile creature through Launching Uppercut, leap into the air beside it.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against the launched creature.
Hit: Deal normal damage, drive the target immediately to the ground, and double the falling damage caused by this launch.
You descend safely at the end of the target’s turn and take no falling damage from this technique.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_CLINCH:
### Clinch - Counter
After your Counterstrike hits, you may spend the Reaction restored by Counterstrike to attempt to Grapple the same target through an Unarmed Strike.
You must have a free hand or another body part capable of maintaining the Grapple.
The target chooses Strength or Dexterity and makes the corresponding saving throw against your Unarmed Strike Grapple DC.
Failed Save: The target has the Grappled condition.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
Clinch follows the ordinary 2024 rules for Grappling unless another talent changes them.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_COUNTER_FOCUS:
### Counter Focus - Focus
After your Counterstrike deals damage to a meaningful hostile creature, you may spend the Reaction restored by Counterstrike to regain Martial Focus.
A meaningful hostile creature normally has a Challenge Rating of at least half your Cultivation Level, rounded down, minimum 1/2.
The GM may allow an equivalent threat without a Challenge Rating to qualify.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_COURT_OF_THE_AWAITING_BL:
### Court of the Awaiting Blade - Retribution Domain
“Inside this court, every intention casts a shadow before the body moves.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Manifest a 30-foot-radius aura centered on yourself.
For the duration:
when you prepare Counterstrike, choose one additional trigger;
once per turn when you prepare Counterstrike, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
once per round when your Counterstrike hits, regain Martial Focus;
when your Counterstrike hits, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
you may apply Read the Tell to every hostile creature you can see inside the Domain rather than only one creature.
The Court ends early if you become Incapacitated.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_CROSS_COUNTER:
### Cross Counter - Unique Retribution Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within your reach makes an Opportunity Attack against you
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Before the triggering Opportunity Attack resolves, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against that creature.
Hit: Deal normal damage. The triggering Opportunity Attack has Disadvantage.
Cross Counter is not a Counterstrike unless another talent explicitly says otherwise.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_DUG_IN_BLOW:
### Dug-In Blow - Counter
After your Counterstrike hits, choose one instance of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage dealt by the target before the start of your next turn.
You have Resistance to that damage instance.
Dug-In Blow applies only once per successful Counterstrike.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_HEADFAKE:
### Headfake - Guard
While you hold Martial Focus, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_INTENSE_CONDITIONING:
### Intense Conditioning - Counter
Prerequisite: CL 5+
After your Counterstrike hits, expend Martial Focus.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For 1 minute, the target becomes conditioned against the precise trigger that provoked your Counterstrike.
Whenever it attempts that same category of action again, it must repeat the Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The attempted action, movement, or activation fails before it resolves. The creature may choose another legal action if it still has one available. A spell slot, CP cost, item charge, or other limited-use resource is not spent unless the resource was already committed before the saving throw.
Successful Save: It may proceed normally.
A creature immune to the Frightened condition is immune to Intense Conditioning.
Examples of trigger categories include:
making an attack roll;
willingly leaving a space;
casting a spell or activating a sphere talent;
drawing or equipping a weapon;
speaking audibly.
