Intense Conditioning does not prohibit every possible activity merely because one narrow trigger applied.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_LAUNCHING_UPPERCUT:
### Launching Uppercut - Counter
Prerequisite: CL 5+
After your Counterstrike damages a creature no more than one size larger than you, expend Martial Focus.
Launch the creature 10 feet upward.
Its current movement ends. It then falls normally.
Under the 2024 falling rules, a creature that falls 10 feet normally takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and gains the Prone condition when it lands unless it avoids taking any falling damage.
#### Ally Launch
You may use Launching Uppercut on one willing ally other than yourself without expending Martial Focus.
The attack hits automatically and deals no damage.
The ally’s current movement does not end. Until that movement ends, it may move horizontally through the air as though it had a Fly Speed equal to its remaining movement.
The ally still falls normally when its movement ends.
If the ally makes a melee attack against a creature as it lands, the ally takes no falling damage from this launch and does not gain the Prone condition from landing.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_LIVER_SHOT:
### Liver Shot - Counter
After your Counterstrike hits, reduce all of the target’s Speeds to 5 feet until the end of its next turn.
A creature without meaningful anatomy or locomotion may be immune at the GM’s discretion.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_PATIENT_BREATH:
### Patient Breath - Focus
Prerequisite: CL 5+
If your prepared Counterstrike expires at the start of your turn without being used, regain Martial Focus.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_POWERFUL_COUNTER:
### Powerful Counter - Counter
Prerequisite: Extra Attack or Multiattack
When you prepare Counterstrike by replacing one attack from your Attack Action or Multiattack, you may forgo one or more of the remaining attacks.
For each attack forgone, add 1d8 damage to your Counterstrike on a hit.
When you make the Counterstrike attack roll, you may also expend Martial Focus to gain Advantage on that attack roll.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_REFLEXIVE_PREPARATION:
### Reflexive Preparation - Focus
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Prepare Counterstrike without taking the Ready Action or replacing an attack.
Reflexive Preparation follows all ordinary Counterstrike rules.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_SET_UP:
### Set Up - Unique Retribution Talent
When you prepare Counterstrike, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against one creature within your reach.
Hit: Deal no damage. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the creature willingly moves, it must end that movement in a space adjacent to you.
The creature may use a Bonus Action to attempt to break the Set Up.
It makes a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check opposed by your Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. Each creature chooses which skill to use.
Successful Check: Set Up ends.
Set Up does not prevent forced movement, teleportation, or movement that cannot legally end adjacent to you.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_SPELL_BREAKER:
### Spell Breaker - Counter
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When your Counterstrike damages a creature while it is casting a spell, activating a sphere talent, or using another interruptible supernatural effect, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
The DC equals 10 or half the damage dealt by your Counterstrike, rounded down, whichever is higher, to a maximum DC of 30.
This uses the 2024 Concentration-save formula.
Failed Save: The triggering activation fails. The action and any spell slot, CP, item charge, or other resource committed to the activation are lost.
Successful Save: The activation continues normally.
Spell Breaker is a specific interruption rule. A normal Counterstrike does not automatically interrupt a spell merely because it deals damage before the spell resolves.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_SUCKER_PUNCH:
### Sucker Punch - Focus
When you make a legal Opportunity Attack, expend Martial Focus to treat that attack as a Counterstrike.
Choose one Counter talent you know when making the attack.
If you use Sucker Punch, on your next turn you may take only the Dodge or Disengage Action unless another rule explicitly says otherwise.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_TERRIFYING_HOOK:
### Terrifying Hook - Counter
After your Counterstrike hits, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
The ordinary Frightened rules apply.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_TIGHT_GUARD:
### Tight Guard - Guard
Whenever you take the Dodge Action or prepare Counterstrike, gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.
At CL 11, this bonus increases to +2.
Tight Guard counts as the AC bonus from a Shield and does not stack with the AC bonus from using a Shield.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_TWO_ANSWERS_WITHIN_ONE_B:
### Two Answers Within One Breath - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 17+
While Court of the Awaiting Blade is active, you may make up to two Counterstrikes per round rather than one.
Each Counterstrike still requires:
an available Reaction;
a legal chosen trigger;
a legal target within reach.
A successful Counterstrike may restore the Reaction used to make it as normal.
You cannot make more than one Counterstrike during the same creature’s turn.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_UNBROKEN_PREPARATION:
### Unbroken Preparation - Guard
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a chosen trigger begins and you use Counterstrike, a missed Counterstrike does not end your preparation.
You may continue waiting for another chosen trigger before the start of your next turn.
You still may make only one Counterstrike per round.
TAL_RETRIBUTION_VIOLENT_PRESSURE:
### Violent Pressure - Unique Retribution Talent
When you prepare Counterstrike, you may use a Bonus Action to choose one hostile creature within 30 feet that can perceive you.
The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: No effect.
After a creature makes this saving throw, it is immune to your Violent Pressure until you complete a long rest.
TAL_SAND_ABRADING_WARD:
#### Abrading Ward - Scour
Whenever a hostile creature starts its turn in Sand Terrain you control, you may deal Slashing damage to it equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
A creature can take this damage from you only once per round.
TAL_SAND_BURIAL_OF_THE_NAMELESS_ARMY:
#### Burial of the Nameless Army - Burial, Domain
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius area of Sand Terrain, loose earth, dust, or mineral ground
Saving Throw: Strength
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
You command the battlefield to remember every army it has swallowed.
Hostile creatures of your choice in the area make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature is Buried and Restrained. On a successful save, it is Buried until the start of your next turn.
While the effect lasts, a hostile creature that starts its turn Buried in the area takes 3d8 Bludgeoning damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
A creature can use an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending Buried and Restrained on a success. A creature that succeeds may move up to half its Speed immediately as part of that Action.
TAL_SAND_COURT_OF_TEN_THOUSAND_DUNES:
#### Court of Ten Thousand Dunes - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP; once per short or long rest
You establish a domain of commanded sand, mirage heat, unstable dunes, and listening grains.
For the duration, the area around you becomes your Court. The Court moves with you.
Within the Court:
ground spaces of your choice become Shallow Sand Terrain when they enter the Court;
as a Bonus Action, you may change a number of Sand Terrain squares in the Court up to your Proficiency Bonus into Deep or Storming Sand Terrain until the start of your next turn;
hostile creatures treat all Sand Terrain in the Court as Difficult Terrain;
once on each of your turns, you may use Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dust Veil, or Dune Bank without spending an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction;
you know the location of any creature touching Sand Terrain in the Court unless it is protected by a stronger concealment, Void effect, or superior stealth technique;
when a hostile creature falls Prone, becomes Buried, or fails a saving throw against your Sand talent in the Court, you may move one Sand Terrain square up to 20 feet.
The Court does not create solid walls, block teleportation, prevent flight by itself, or suppress other Domains automatically. If two Domains contest the same area, use the campaign’s Domain conflict rules or an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SAND_DESERT_DRINKS_THE_RIVER:
#### Desert Drinks the River - Desiccation
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature, object, area of water, water-based effect, plant mass, ooze, or fluid-bodied creature
Saving Throw: Constitution
Cost: 4 CP
You invoke the dry law of the desert.
Choose one:
Dry the Body: One creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d8 Necrotic or Force damage, your choice, and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and healing it receives before the start of your next turn is halved.
Break the Water: Make a Cultivation Check against one ongoing water, fog, mist, rain, slime, plant-growth, or fluid terrain effect. On a success, suppress a 20-foot-radius section until the start of your next turn.
Desiccate the Object: One nonmagical plant, rope, paper, leather, wooden object, wet clay object, or similar moisture-dependent object becomes brittle. It takes 6d8 damage and has Vulnerability to the next Fire, Slashing, or Bludgeoning damage it takes before the end of your next turn.
This talent does not broadly replace Water, Life, or Death. It is a dry-law interference technique.
TAL_SAND_DESERT_SKIN_METHOD:
#### Desert Skin Method - Desiccation
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You dry your surface Qi and learn to shed heat, grit, and thirst.
For the duration:
you have Resistance to Fire damage caused by environmental heat, hot sand, or mundane flame;
you have Advantage on saving throws against Exhaustion caused by heat, thirst, forced marches through desert, or dry environments;
hostile Sand Terrain does not count as Difficult Terrain for you;
your unarmed strikes and weapon attacks may leave harmless visible sand marks or dry cracked prints.
This talent does not replace broad Fire resistance against magical fire unless the fire is clearly desert, sand, or heat-exposure based.
TAL_SAND_DEVOURING_DUNE_MOUTH:
#### Devouring Dune Mouth - Burial
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius area of Sand Terrain
Saving Throw: Strength
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
A pit-like dune mouth opens and pulls creatures inward.
The area becomes Deep Sand Terrain. When a hostile creature starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled 10 feet toward the center and becomes Buried. If already Buried, it is Buried and Restrained. On a successful save, it is not pulled but its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
As a Bonus Action while the effect lasts, you may force each hostile Buried creature in the area to repeat the save. On a failure, it takes 3d8 Bludgeoning damage as the dune compresses.
TAL_SAND_DUNE_BANK:
#### Dune Bank - Terrain
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or a creature within 5 feet of Sand Terrain you control is targeted by an attack roll
Cost: 0 CP
You raise a short bank of sand between the attack and its target.
The target gains Half Cover against the triggering attack. The sand bank collapses immediately after the attack resolves.
At CL 11, if the target is standing in Deep or Storming Sand Terrain you control, the target instead gains Three-Quarters Cover against the triggering attack.
TAL_SAND_DUNE_HEART_SAND:
#### Dune-Heart Sand - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Sand techniques become openly supernatural.
You gain the following benefits:
You may use Gather Sand without an existing Sand Source by spending 1 CP, even on worked floors, stone, rooftops, ships, or other surfaces that contain mineral dust or can bear conjured sand.
Sand Terrain you create may climb low obstacles, flow up stairs, and pass through gaps at least 1 inch wide.
You may move one Sand Terrain square you control up to 20 feet when you use Gather Sand’s Bonus Action movement.
Your Sand Terrain can affect creatures with magical flight if grains can physically reach them, but it does not automatically ground them unless a talent says so.
Your Sand talents count as magical or cultivation effects for overcoming resistance to nonmagical damage.
Dune-Heart Sand still cannot pass through sealed Barriers, sealed containers, Total Cover without a route, or a creature’s intact body unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_SAND_DUNE_SEA_ADVANCE:
#### Dune Sea Advance - Terrain, Dune-Step
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: Up to six Sand Terrain squares you control
Cost: 1 CP
You command the dune-line to advance.
Move each chosen Sand Terrain square up to 30 feet along surfaces you can perceive. A square may pass through a hostile creature’s space during this movement.
The first time this movement passes through a hostile creature’s space on a turn, that creature must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pushed 10 feet in the direction the sand moved and is Buried until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it is not pushed but cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SAND_DUNE_SLIDE:
#### Dune Slide - Dune-Step
Action Type: Bonus Action
Requirement: You are standing on Sand Terrain or loose dry ground
Cost: 0 CP
You slide on a controlled wave of grains.
Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures whose spaces are adjacent to Sand Terrain you control. This movement must remain along a surface.
At CL 5, the movement increases to 15 feet. At CL 11, 20 feet. At CL 17, 30 feet.
TAL_SAND_DUNE_WALL:
#### Dune Wall - Terrain
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: A straight line up to 30 feet long, 5 feet thick, and 10 feet high
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You raise a dune wall of packed sand.
The wall grants Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and effects that pass through it. The wall is not solid enough to block movement completely, but its spaces are Deep Sand Terrain. A creature moving through the wall must spend 4 feet of movement for every 1 foot moved.
A Large or larger creature may force through a 5-foot section by using an Action and succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) check against your Cultivation Save DC. A section also collapses if it takes damage equal to 10 + your CL.
TAL_SAND_DUST_VEIL:
#### Dust Veil - Veil, Terrain
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One Sand Terrain area you control
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 0 CP
You stir the surface of your sand into a choking veil.
The chosen Sand Terrain becomes lightly obscured until the start of your next turn. A creature inside the area has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
If the Sand Terrain is Storming Sand Terrain, you may instead make the area heavily obscured until the start of your next turn, but doing so ends the Storming state at the end of that duration.
TAL_SAND_ERODE_THE_PATH_OF_RETURN:
#### Erode the Path of Return - Scour, Veil
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive teleports, burrows, turns invisible, or leaves your Sand Terrain by magical movement
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 3 CP
You send grains into the departing line of motion.
The triggering creature makes a Dexterity or Charisma saving throw, its choice. On a failed save, choose one:
the movement fails and the triggering resource is spent;
the creature moves only half the intended distance and appears Buried in the nearest legal Sand Terrain or loose ground along its route;
the creature completes the movement, but you learn its destination direction and distance, and it leaves a visible trail of sand-marks until the end of your next turn.
On a successful save, the movement succeeds, but the creature cannot benefit from being Invisible against you until the start of your next turn if any sand or dust can cling to it.
Secret Inheritances, superior Space effects, and major escape artifacts may require an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SAND_EROSION_SCRIPTURE:
#### Erosion Scripture - Scour, Desiccation
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: One object, structure, Barrier surface, formation anchor, armor, shield, weapon, or construct touching Sand Terrain or a Sand Source
Cost: 2 CP
You command grains to grind the target’s edges, seams, joints, inscriptions, or surface Qi.
Choose one effect:
Object Wear: Deal 4d8 Slashing damage to an object or structure. This damage ignores resistance to nonmagical damage.
Armor Abrasion: A creature wearing armor or bearing a shield must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its AC is reduced by 1 until the end of your next turn. This cannot reduce AC below 10 + Dexterity modifier unless the armor is broken or removed by other means.
Anchor Scour: Make a Cultivation Check against a formation anchor, Barrier surface, or ongoing terrain effect. On a success, suppress one 5-foot section or one minor anchor benefit until the start of your next turn.
Scene-defining structures, artifacts, major formations, and superior barriers may require an extended project or opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SAND_GLASS_DESERT_JUDGMENT:
#### Glass Desert Judgment - Glass, Scour
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius area of Sand Terrain
Saving Throw: Dexterity
Duration: Instantaneous, then 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
You flash-fuse a field of sand into jagged glass and command it to bloom upward.
Creatures in the area make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 6d8 Piercing damage and is Restrained by glass until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not Restrained.
The area then becomes Glass Terrain for 1 minute. Glass Terrain is Difficult Terrain. A creature that moves more than 5 feet through Glass Terrain on a turn takes Piercing damage equal to your CL. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
Glass Terrain counts as Sand Terrain and a Sand Source for your Sand talents, but it cannot be moved by talents that move loose sand unless you first shatter it.
TAL_SAND_GLASS_EDGE_SCRIPTURE:
#### Glass Edge Scripture - Glass
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Sand Scour talents may deal Slashing or Piercing damage, chosen each time you use the talent.
In addition, when you deal Scouring damage to a creature that is Buried, you may cause glassy grains to cling to it. Until the start of your next turn, the first time the creature moves 5 feet or more, it takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
TAL_SAND_GLASS_MIRAGE_REFLECTION:
#### Glass Mirage Reflection - Glass, Veil
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive targets you with an attack roll or single-target visible technique while you are within 5 feet of Sand Terrain or glass you created
Cost: 2 CP
You flash a mirror of fused sand and false angle.
The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the attack or technique targets a sand-glass reflection in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of you and automatically misses you. On a successful save, you gain Half Cover against the triggering effect.
This does not redirect area effects, effects that do not require targeting, or Secret Inheritances unless the GM allows an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SAND_GLASS_PRISON:
#### Glass Prison - Glass, Burial
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One Buried creature or one creature standing in Deep Sand Terrain you control
Saving Throw: Dexterity
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You fuse the surrounding grains into a cutting glass shell.
On a failed save, the target is Restrained inside a fragile glass prison. While restrained this way, it has Half Cover, cannot move from its space, and takes Piercing damage equal to your CL the first time each turn it makes an attack, casts a technique with somatic or whole-body movement, or attempts to escape.
The target or an adjacent creature can use an Action to attack the prison. The prison has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and Hit Points equal to 10 + your CL. If destroyed, the target is freed and takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
On a successful save, the target is not restrained, but glass cuts reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
TAL_SAND_GRIT_IN_THE_EYES:
#### Grit in the Eyes - Scour, Veil
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: When you use Scouring Hand
Target: The same target
Saving Throw: Constitution
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 0 CP
If the target fails its Dexterity save against Scouring Hand, you may force it to make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it is Blinded until the start of your next turn. A creature without eyes or comparable exposed sensory organs has Advantage on this saving throw. A creature that does not rely on sight may be immune at the GM’s discretion.
TAL_SAND_HIDDEN_CACHE_OF_GRAINS:
#### Hidden Cache of Grains - Terrain
You can carry a small ritual gourd, sash pouch, sleeve-pocket, hollow anklet, paper talisman packet, or similar container of prepared sand.
As long as you possess this cache, you always count as having a Sand Source for Mortal Realm Sand talents. If the cache is lost, destroyed, soaked, sealed away, or stolen, you can prepare a new one during a short or long rest using dry mineral material.
This cache is not required for the sphere unless you take a drawback that says so.
TAL_SAND_LOOSE_FOOTING:
#### Loose Footing - Terrain
When a hostile creature enters Sand Terrain you control for the first time on a turn, you may use your Reaction to make the ground slip.
The creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. A creature that succeeds is immune to your Loose Footing until the start of its next turn.
TAL_SAND_QUICKSAND_GATE:
#### Quicksand Gate - Burial, Terrain
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot square of Sand Terrain you control
Saving Throw: Strength
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You deepen controlled sand into a hungry gate.
The area becomes Deep Sand Terrain for the duration.
When a hostile creature starts its turn in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is Buried until it escapes. If it was already Buried, it is Buried and Restrained until it escapes.
A creature can use an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending Buried and Restrained on a success.
TAL_SAND_SAND_BURROW_STEP:
#### Sand Burrow Step - Dune-Step
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Requirement: You are standing on Sand Terrain or loose earth
Cost: 1 CP
You sink into one patch of sand and emerge from another.
Teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also on Sand Terrain, loose earth, dust, gravel, or dry soil. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
You cannot pass through sealed Barriers, cross planar boundaries, or enter a space too small for your body.
TAL_SAND_SAND_CLONE_DECOY:
#### Sand Clone Decoy - Veil
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
You raise a hollow sand silhouette that copies your posture for a heartbeat.
Until the start of your next turn, the first attack roll against you that misses may instead strike the decoy. If the attack misses you by 5 or more, you may move up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, and the decoy collapses into Storming Sand Terrain in one 5-foot square.
A creature with truesight, tremorsense, blindsight, or a superior perception technique may make a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC when it attacks you. On a success, it ignores this decoy.
TAL_SAND_SAND_COFFIN:
#### Sand Coffin - Burial
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One Buried creature in Sand Terrain you control
Saving Throw: Strength or Constitution, target’s choice
Duration: Until the end of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Sand closes around the target’s limbs, throat, or torso.
On a failed save, the target is Restrained and cannot speak clearly until the end of your next turn. It cannot provide verbal components, mantras, roars, or other activation requirements that require clear breath or speech.
On a successful save, the target is not Restrained, but it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This does not automatically suffocate the target.
TAL_SAND_SAND_DRAG:
#### Sand Drag - Terrain, Burial
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature standing on Sand Terrain you control
Saving Throw: Strength or Dexterity, target’s choice
Cost: 0 CP
The sand grips a target’s ankles and drags.
On a failed save, move the target up to 10 feet along the ground within contiguous Sand Terrain you control. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. If the movement ends in Deep Sand Terrain, the target is Buried until the start of your next turn.
On a successful save, the target is not moved, but its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SAND_SAND_MEMORY_WITNESS:
#### Sand Memory Witness - Veil
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One area of sand, dust, ash-like grain, powdered stone, or dry soil no larger than a 30-foot cube
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 1 CP
You read the memory of disturbed grains.
Ask up to three questions about events that physically disturbed the area within the last 24 hours. Examples:
What creatures crossed here?
What was carried, dragged, buried, or unearthed?
Was blood spilled here?
Was a body buried here?
Did a formation, teleportation, flight, burrow, or Void technique disturb the grains?
Which way did the strongest disturbance go?
The answer appears as tactile impressions, heat traces, grain-flow diagrams, or brief sand silhouettes. This does not reveal private thoughts, secret names, unseen future events, or facts that left no physical trace.
At CL 17, you may read up to the last 7 days.
TAL_SAND_SAND_MIRROR_MIRAGE:
#### Sand Mirror Mirage - Veil
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Heat shimmer and dust reflection blur your position.
Until the start of your next turn, attack rolls against you have Disadvantage while you are within 5 feet of Sand Terrain you control or while you are in bright light, desert heat, furnace heat, or a visibly dusty environment.
This is a physical mirage, not a mental illusion. A creature that does not rely on sight is immune.
TAL_SAND_SAND_NEEDLE_VOLLEY:
#### Sand Needle Volley - Scour, Glass
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: Up to three creatures within range, each within 10 feet of Sand Terrain or a Sand Source
Saving Throw: Dexterity
Cost: 1 CP
You harden grains into cutting darts.
Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a target takes 2d8 Piercing damage and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and suffers no Speed reduction.
Damage increases to 3d8 at CL 11 and 4d8 at CL 17.
TAL_SAND_SAND_SHELL:
#### Sand Shell - Terrain
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You wrap your skin, clothing, or armor in a shifting shell of sand.
For the duration, you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. While any of these Temporary HP remain, the first creature that hits you with a melee attack on each round takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
The shell ends early if you are submerged in water, restrained in a sealed fluid medium, or lose all Temporary HP from the shell.
TAL_SAND_SAND_STEP:
#### Sand Step - Dune-Step
You ignore Difficult Terrain created by sand, dust, gravel, or dry loose earth.
In addition, while you are standing on Sand Terrain you control, Opportunity Attacks against you are made with Disadvantage.
TAL_SAND_THE_MOUNTAIN_REMEMBERS_IT_IS_DU:
#### The Mountain Remembers It Is Dust
Secret Sand Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sand-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, discovery of a desert-ending scripture, burial of a mountain oath, or inheritance from an ancient dune sovereign
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Area: One battlefield feature, formation section, structure, army-line, massive creature, or 60-foot-radius terrain area
Duration: Instantaneous, then 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP; once per week
You speak the first erosion scripture: the law that every shape is temporary.
Choose one legal target within range. The target must be a battlefield-scale physical feature, a structure, a terrain zone, a formation section with physical anchors, a siege engine, a wall, a bridge, a gate, a vehicle, a mass of troops, or one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. Pure ideas, souls, memories, laws, oaths, and nonphysical effects are not legal targets unless the GM treats them as having a physical anchor.
Resolve one of the following modes.
##### Grind the Shape
A structure, wall, gate, bridge, siege engine, vehicle, or formation anchor section takes 12d10 Force damage. This damage represents supernatural erosion and ignores resistance to nonmagical damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points or overcomes its threshold, it collapses into Sand Terrain under your control.
If the target is a major formation, artifact-reinforced structure, city wall, sect gate, or scene-defining object, make an opposed Cultivation Check. On a success, suppress or breach one meaningful section for 1 minute instead of automatically destroying the whole target.
##### Bury the Line
Choose a 60-foot-radius ground area. It becomes Deep and Storming Sand Terrain for 1 minute. Hostile creatures of your choice in the area make a Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature is Buried and Restrained for 1 minute. While restrained this way, it is also Blinded by sand unless it does not rely on sight. It may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effects on itself on a success.
On a successful save, it is Buried until the start of your next turn and its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
##### Erode the Giant
Choose one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. It makes a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes 10d10 Force damage, loses any Burrow Speed or Climb Speed until the end of your next turn, cannot regain Hit Points until the end of your next turn, and falls Prone if it can be knocked Prone.
On a successful save, it takes half damage and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
##### Claim the Desert
For 1 minute, all ground in a 60-foot-radius area becomes your Sand Terrain. You decide whether each square is Shallow, Deep, or Storming whenever a creature starts its turn there. Your Sand Control Limit does not apply to this area for the duration.
Once during each of your turns while the inheritance lasts, you may use Gather Sand, Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dune Bank, Dust Veil, or Quicksand Gate in the area without spending an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or CP.
When the inheritance ends, created sand collapses into ordinary loose ground or remains as a changed battlefield feature if the GM rules the terrain was permanently altered.
TAL_SAND_THOUSAND_GRAIN_GRIP:
#### Thousand-Grain Grip - Burial
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature Buried by your Sand talent attempts to escape or move 5 feet or more
Cost: 0 CP
The grains tighten.
The creature makes its escape check or relevant saving throw with Disadvantage. If it fails, it takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
TAL_SAND_THOUSAND_MILE_SANDSTORM_BODY:
#### Thousand-Mile Sandstorm Body - Veil, Scour
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Your body becomes the eye of a controlled sandstorm.
The area is Storming Sand Terrain and lightly obscured for creatures of your choice. Hostile creatures that start their turn in the area or enter it for the first time on a turn make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 Slashing damage and is Blinded until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not Blinded.
While the effect lasts, ranged weapon attacks that pass through the area are made with Disadvantage unless the attacker is you or a creature you designate.
TAL_SAND_TRACK_SPEAKING_SAND:
#### Track-Speaking Sand - Veil
Action Type: Action
Range: Self or one Sand Terrain area you touch
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 0 CP
You read disturbances in sand, dust, loose soil, or powder.
Choose one question about tracks, movement, or recent disturbance in the area:
How many creatures crossed this area recently?
Which direction did the most recent creature travel?
Was a creature running, limping, carrying weight, dragging something, or hiding its steps?
Was a heavy object moved through this area?
Was cultivation, flight, teleportation, or incorporeal movement obviously involved?
The GM answers truthfully based on available traces. This does not reveal identity, Path, Realm, exact stat block, or secret technique unless the evidence would clearly show it.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_BOB_AND_WEAVE:
#### BOB AND WEAVE - ESCAPE
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Target: Self
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Requirement: One willing adjacent ally or one adjacent object must plausibly cover at least half your body.
Choose one qualifying ally or object as your cover anchor. You gain Half Cover while you remain adjacent to that anchor and it remains capable of plausibly covering at least half your body.
The benefit ends early if you are no longer adjacent to the chosen anchor, the anchor is destroyed or removed, or it can no longer plausibly cover at least half your body. You cannot change the chosen anchor without using Bob and Weave again.
The chosen ally spends no action and gains no benefit from this talent.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_CLEANED_OUT:
#### CLEANED OUT - TRICK
When you succeed on Steal, take or reposition up to two accessible objects instead of one.
Resolve both objects through the same successful check. You still need free hands or legal spaces for the objects.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_COUNTER_THEFT:
#### COUNTER THEFT - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Master Thief
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range attacks you with a handheld weapon
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Attempt to Steal the weapon before the attack resolves.
Success: Choose one:
catch the weapon if you have a free hand;
cause the weapon to fall into one legal space within 30 feet of you;
plant one Tiny object you hold into the attacker’s now-empty hand.
The triggering attack is lost.
Failure: The attack resolves normally.
Counter Theft does not affect a natural weapon, Unarmed Strike, fused weapon, artifact that resists removal, or weapon protected by a stronger technique without an appropriate opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_CUT_AND_RUN:
#### CUT AND RUN - ESCAPE
While holding Martial Focus, whenever you use your Action to succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal, move up to half your Speed.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the target of the maneuver.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_DIRTY_TRICK:
#### DIRTY TRICK
Action Type: Action
Range: Natural reach
Cost: None
Attempt an underhanded maneuver against one creature you can physically hinder.
Describe the method: throw grit into its eyes, knot a sleeve, stamp on a foot, box its ears, loosen a belt, hook a leg, slap a talisman across its vision, overturn a stool beneath it, or use another plausible tactic.
Make a Scoundrel Check against the target.
Success: Choose one appropriate result:
Eyes Spoiled. The target has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn.
Ears Ringing. The target has the Deafened condition until the start of your next turn.
Tangled Footwork. Halve the target’s Speed until the start of your next turn.
Low Sweep. The target has the Prone condition.
Jammed Guard. The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Open the Guard. Apply Exploited Opening.
The GM may approve a comparable effect when the description, anatomy, and surroundings support it. A base Dirty Trick should not inflict a stronger condition than those listed above.
A creature without the relevant anatomy or vulnerability is immune to an inappropriate effect.
If a talent extends a physical Dirty Trick beyond the start of your next turn, the target or an adjacent creature can normally take the Utilize action to end that physical hindrance early.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_DISTRACTING_TRICKERY:
#### DISTRACTING TRICKERY - TRICK
When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal, the target cannot make Opportunity Attacks against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_DOUBLE_DIP:
#### DOUBLE DIP - TRICK
When you succeed on Dirty Trick, expend Martial Focus to choose two different Dirty Trick effects instead of one.
If both effects can be ended early through separate physical actions, removing one does not remove the other.
Double Dip does not allow a second Trick talent by itself.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_EVERYTHING_IN_THE_WRONG_PL:
#### EVERYTHING IN THE WRONG PLACE - REALM EVOLUTION
Prerequisite: Empty-Sleeve Hand, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
Choose a number of hostile creatures inside the area up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one result for that creature:
steal one accessible held item;
move the creature up to 15 feet along the ground into legal spaces;
give it the Prone condition;
prevent it from taking Reactions until the end of your next turn;
apply Exploited Opening;
cause one ordinary accessible item it carries to fall into one legal space within 30 feet of you.
Successful Save: Apply Exploited Opening or move the creature 5 feet along the ground into one legal space.
Objects stolen or dropped through this talent appear in legal spaces of your choice inside the area.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_FANCY_FOOTWORK:
#### FANCY FOOTWORK - TRICK
When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature no more than one size larger than you, move that creature 5 feet into one legal space.
This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_FILTHY_DISTRACTION:
#### FILTHY DISTRACTION - TRICK
When you succeed on Dirty Trick against a creature that was unaware of you, it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks until the end of your next turn.
Its Passive Perception is reduced by 5 for the same duration.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_FOCUSING_THIEVERY:
#### FOCUSING THIEVERY - FOCUS
Whenever you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal, regain Martial Focus as a Bonus Action.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_GRAND_SWITCHEROO:
#### GRAND SWITCHEROO - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: Switcheroo, CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range activates one accessible handheld consumable, talisman, mundane tool, magic item, focus, or device
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Attempt Steal before the activation resolves.
Success: Choose one legal result:
steal the triggering object, causing its activation to fail;
replace it with one valid substitute you hold, causing the substitute to activate instead when legal;
redirect the activation to another legal target;
cause the object to activate harmlessly;
plant the object onto another creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range before it activates, when that creature is a legal recipient.
Failure: The original activation resolves normally.
Grand Switcheroo does not affect a technique with no accessible anchor or automatically overcome an artifact.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_HIDDEN_TOOL_CACHE:
#### HIDDEN TOOL CACHE - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Target: One object revealed from your concealed preparations
Use Limit: Once per Short or Long Rest
Cost: None
Reveal one plausible Tiny mundane object that you prepared or acquired before the current scene and could reasonably have concealed on your person. You do not need to name the specific object before using this talent, but the object must have been reasonably available to you and must fit your established preparations, clothing, containers, and circumstances. The GM decides whether a proposed object is plausible.
Place the object in one of your free hands. If you have no free hand, place it in your space or in one accessible worn container you possess.
The revealed object is a real, ordinary object. It remains after being revealed until it is used, lost, destroyed, or discarded. Revealing it does not activate, Utilize, apply, throw, plant, or attack with it; any later use follows the object's normal rules and action economy.
The object cannot be magical, alchemical, poisonous, unusually valuable, an item that could not reasonably have been acquired before the scene, or a substitute for another sphere talent. It cannot be a complete tool kit, a costly consumable, or an object whose possession would bypass a meaningful security, scarcity, or story restriction.
Examples include chalk, a coin, one ordinary lockpick, a tiny mirror, a nail, a ceramic shard, a fishhook, a key blank, a small folding tool, or a short weighted cord.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_IMPOSSIBLE_FASTENING:
#### IMPOSSIBLE FASTENING - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a physical Dirty Trick you impose would end at the start of your next turn, expend Martial Focus to extend it to 1 minute.
The target or an adjacent creature can take the Utilize action to end the hindrance early by undoing the knot, clearing the eyes, loosening the strap, removing the object, or otherwise solving the physical problem.
Impossible Fastening cannot extend Prone or Exploited Opening.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_MASTER_THIEF:
#### MASTER THIEF - EMPTY-SLEEVE
When you use Steal, expend Martial Focus to ignore Disadvantage caused by an object being securely fastened, worn tightly, or held in two hands.
If you successfully disarm a held object and possess a free hand, catch it instead of causing it to fall.
Master Thief does not make a soul-bound object, artifact, body part, or complete suit of worn armor ordinarily accessible.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_MISDIRECTED_ATTACK:
#### MISDIRECTED ATTACK - ESCAPE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature makes an Opportunity Attack against you for your movement
Attempt Dirty Trick against the attacking creature before the attack resolves.
Success: Do not apply a normal Dirty Trick result. Redirect the triggering attack against one other legal target within the attacker’s reach. Use the original attack roll against the new target’s AC.
You suffer no damage or additional effect from the triggering attack.
Failure: Resolve the Opportunity Attack against you normally.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_QUICK_THIEVERY:
#### QUICK THIEVERY - FOCUS
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Expend Martial Focus to use Dirty Trick or Steal as a Bonus Action.
Use Quick Thievery only once per turn.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_RANGED_TRICKERY:
#### RANGED TRICKERY - TRICK
While holding Martial Focus, use Dirty Trick against a creature within 10 feet rather than only within your natural reach.
Describe a plausible physical delivery method such as thrown grit, a cord, a hooked tool, a kicked object, or a snapped sleeve-weight.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL:
#### STEAL
Action Type: Action
Range: Natural reach
Cost: None
Choose one accessible object. Attempt to take it, reposition it, or plant one Tiny object in an accessible location.
##### Aware Target
Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature.
##### Unaware Target
Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check against the target’s Passive Perception.
##### Difficult Object
Make your check with Disadvantage if the object is securely fastened, worn tightly, held in two hands, or similarly difficult to remove.
##### Success
Choose one appropriate result:
take the object into a free hand;
cause the object to fall into an unoccupied space within your reach;
reposition the object to another accessible location on the same target;
plant one Tiny object in an accessible location on the target.
You may use Steal to remove an object from a creature’s hand as a local Scoundrel disarm rule.
Steal does not automatically activate, identify, attune to, or safely handle the object.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_CHARM:
#### STEAL CHARM - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to take a sliver of its social ease rather than an object.
For 10 minutes:
the target has Disadvantage on Charisma checks and Influence checks;
gain Advantage on your next Charisma check before the duration ends.
The target does not automatically realize what was stolen.
At CL 11+, the duration becomes 1 hour.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_HEART:
#### STEAL HEART - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to take its hostility toward you rather than an object.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The target has the Charmed condition toward you for 1 minute.
Successful Save: No effect.
The effect ends early if you or an ally damage the target.
Once a creature has been affected by or succeeds against your Steal Heart, it cannot be affected by your Steal Heart again until you finish a long rest.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_IDENTITY:
#### STEAL IDENTITY - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to take its visible mannerisms, posture, vocal rhythm, and surface behavioral tells rather than an object.
For 1 hour, gain Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to impersonate that creature.
A disguise, transformation, illusion, or Forged Technique may still be needed to reproduce physical appearance.
Steal Identity does not grant private memories, passwords, cultivation secrets, or perfect knowledge of relationships.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_MOMENTUM:
#### STEAL MOMENTUM - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you perceive within 60 feet willingly moves, teleports, charges, or is carried by one of its own techniques
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per round
Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature’s Cultivation Save DC.
Success: End the triggering movement after the first 5 feet traveled. Then move up to the distance the target lost without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Failure: The target moves normally. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Steal Momentum does not automatically stop a Secret Inheritance, major calamity, scene-defining movement, or stronger Space technique. Those may require an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_ONGOING_TECHNIQUE:
#### STEAL ONGOING TECHNIQUE - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Empty-Sleeve Hand range
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest per creature
Choose one creature benefiting from a non-Secret ongoing magical, martial, or supernatural effect.
Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature’s Cultivation Save DC. A stronger protected effect may instead require an opposed Cultivation Check.
Success: Transfer one eligible beneficial effect from the target to yourself for up to 1 minute.
the target ceases benefiting while the effect is stolen;
time spent stolen counts against the effect’s duration;
take over Concentration when applicable;
if the effect ends while stolen, it does not return;
if it remains active when this theft ends, it returns to the original creature for its remaining duration;
you must be a legal recipient of the effect.
You may maintain only one stolen ongoing technique at a time.
Steal Ongoing Technique does not steal curses, harmful effects, a Path, a Realm, an inherent body, artifact attunement, a Legendary transformation, or a Secret Inheritance.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_SKILL:
#### STEAL SKILL - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus and name one skill proficiency the target possesses or that you reasonably believe it possesses.
For 1 minute:
the target loses proficiency in that skill;
gain proficiency in that skill;
if the target has Expertise in the skill, gain Expertise for the duration.
If the guess is incorrect, the effect fails but Martial Focus is still expended.
A creature affected by your Steal Skill cannot be affected by it again until you finish a short or long rest.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_THE_DECISIVE_MOMENT:
#### STEAL THE DECISIVE MOMENT - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you perceive within 60 feet succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Describe a narrow but audacious expression: a thrown coin, stolen foothold, loosened strap, missing breath, shifted talisman, abruptly absent weapon, interrupted line of sight, or perfectly mistimed step.
Turn the triggering success into a failure.
Then choose one:
move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
use Dirty Trick against the triggering creature;
use Steal against the triggering creature;
redirect one handheld object involved in the triggering action to one legal space inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range.
A Legendary, Secret, or equivalent effect may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check.
Steal the Decisive Moment interrupts an exposed instant. It does not rewrite a previous turn or broadly manipulate Fate.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_STEAL_VOICE:
#### STEAL VOICE - EMPTY-SLEEVE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to steal the breath, cadence, or spiritual pressure by which its voice enters the world.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn:
it cannot speak clearly;
it cannot provide Verbal spell components;
it cannot activate an ability that explicitly requires intelligible speech;
it has Disadvantage on checks requiring speech.
Successful Save: It has Disadvantage on its next check requiring speech before the end of its next turn.
At CL 10+, on a failed save the effect lasts for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Steal Voice does not prevent every technique merely because the technique has a name or command phrase in its description. The technique must genuinely require speech.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_SWITCHEROO:
#### SWITCHEROO - TRICK
When you succeed on Steal, replace the stolen object with one different Tiny object you hold or plausibly carry.
Place the replacement in an empty hand, pocket, pouch, sleeve, or another accessible location on the target.
Switcheroo does not create the replacement object. A volatile, alchemical, poisoned, or talismanic item still follows its normal preparation, trigger, activation, and consumption rules.
TAL_SCOUNDREL_TWIST_THE_KNIFE:
#### TWIST THE KNIFE - TRICK
Once per turn when you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature within melee reach, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it as part of the same Action.
This additional attack cannot trigger Twist the Knife again or trigger another additional attack.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_CLEAN_LEDGER_HAND:
### Clean Ledger Hand - Ledger
You are difficult to cheat with paperwork.
You have Advantage on checks to notice forged receipts, altered contribution totals, missing supply entries, false attendance marks, or dishonest duty records.
When you complete a Duty and someone attempts to deny that it happened, you may spend one Merit Die to produce or identify a witness, mark, receipt, schedule entry, or other ordinary proof, if such proof could plausibly exist.
This does not fabricate documents. It means you kept them properly.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_COMMUNAL_RICE_BOWL:
### Communal Rice Bowl - Household
You know where ordinary survival lives: kitchens, wells, firewood stores, robe laundries, barns, and servant paths.
When you Petition the Hall for food, lodging, work clothes, common tools, a bath, or safe storage for ordinary possessions, treat a Merit Die result of 1 as a 3.
If an ally lacks Standing but travels under your responsibility, you may include that ally in your petition if the request is ordinary and non-sensitive.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_COURTYARD_ALLOTMENT:
### Courtyard Allotment - Household, Steward
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can secure a place where people can breathe.
When you spend downtime in an institution where you have at least Outer Standing, you may spend one Merit Die to secure modest private or semi-private space for yourself and a small group for 24 hours.
The space may be a guest room, side courtyard, shed, classroom, empty shrine room, unused lecture alcove, medicine cot, or supervised cultivation room.
While using the space for rest, study, crafting, ordinary healing, or cultivation meditation, one creature may add your Merit Die to one relevant non-combat check.
This talent cannot create luxury, privacy against high-ranking inspection, or a room inside a forbidden area.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_DISCIPLINE_MEDIATIO:
### Discipline Mediation - Etiquette, Lineage
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You know how to move a dispute from the courtyard to the arbitration bench.
When a non-combat dispute between sect members, workers, villagers, or guests is about to escalate into punishment, humiliation, expulsion, duel, or public scandal, spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.
On a success, the immediate escalation is delayed long enough for one formal hearing, apology, witness statement, elder review, or negotiated settlement.
This does not prove anyone innocent. It creates procedure.
A creature who wants violence for its own sake may ignore this talent, but doing so can create a social consequence if the institution values procedure.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_FIELD_AND_KITCHEN_R:
### Field and Kitchen Roster - Duty, Household
You understand the quiet backbone of sect life: who cooks, who harvests, who cleans, who carries water, who repairs tools, and who gets blamed when no one planned the work.
When you spend 10 minutes organizing ordinary labor for a farm, kitchen, dormitory, stable, laundry, medicine yard, or storehouse, choose a number of willing ordinary workers up to your Proficiency Bonus + Sect Stewardship key ability modifier.
For the next 4 hours, those workers have Advantage on checks made to perform the assigned ordinary labor safely and efficiently.
This does not magically grow crops, increase yields beyond what good labor could accomplish, or replace the Harvesting and Gathering sphere.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_HALL_OF_ARBITRATION:
### Hall of Arbitration - Etiquette, Steward
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You know how to make people answer in front of witnesses.
When a dispute concerns property, duty, mission credit, sect law, hall access, injury, insult, debt, teaching rights, or contribution records, spend one Merit Die to convene or request arbitration if the institution has any recognized process.
Until the hearing, involved parties who care about institutional legitimacy suffer social consequences if they escalate the dispute outside procedure.
At the hearing, you may add the Merit Die to one Sect Check made to present evidence, question a witness, cite a precedent, or preserve face for a settlement.
This does not guarantee justice. Corrupt sects can have corrupt arbitration.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_MEDICINE_HALL_QUEUE:
### Medicine Hall Queue - Steward, Household
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You know when to wait, when to bow, and which clerk decides whether a minor injury becomes a major problem.
When you Petition the Hall for ordinary medical treatment, antidotes, bandages, supervised recovery, or a Medicine Hall appointment, roll your Merit Die twice and use the higher result.
In addition, during downtime you may spend one Merit Die to reduce by half the wait time for one ordinary treatment, if the institution has capacity.
This does not create pills or replace Alchemy, Life, Blood, or Medicine abilities.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_MISSION_TEAM_ORGANI:
### Mission Team Organizer - Mission, Etiquette
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
When you Accept a Duty or mission that can reasonably involve helpers, spend one Merit Die during preparation to organize a small support team.
Choose one support package:
Porters: carry mundane supplies and reduce travel fatigue from ordinary loads.
Guides: provide Advantage on one navigation or local custom check.
Scribes: preserve records and grant Advantage on one later report or audit check.
Assistants: grant Advantage on one downtime tool check.
Witnesses: provide credible testimony that a duty was attempted or completed.
Junior Disciples: help with safe, non-combat tasks appropriate to their training.
The team avoids combat and danger. If placed in combat, disaster, or lethal hazard, they flee, hide, surrender, or require rescue.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_NOTICE_BOARD_READER:
### Notice Board Reader - Mission, Ledger
You read mission boards like weather signs.
When you inspect a task board, public notice, tithe list, duty roster, or mission writ for at least 1 minute, make a Sect Check.
On a success, ask the GM two questions:
Which task is safer than it looks?
Which task is more dangerous than it looks?
Which task is underpaid?
Which task is politically sensitive?
Which task has a hidden sponsor?
Which task matches my current Role or Duty?
Which task would improve my Standing fastest?
Which task is likely to require a sphere or talent we lack?
On a success by 5 or more, ask one additional question.
This talent does not reveal secret traps automatically, but it gives the GM a clear way to signal obvious institutional risk.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_OUTER_GATE_ROUTINE:
### Outer Gate Routine - Duty, Ledger
You know how to turn repetitive work into recognized merit.
When you complete a Duty that involves ordinary labor, service, cleaning, farming, copying, cooking, carrying, sorting, or tending, regain one spent Merit Die.
You can regain a Merit Die this way once per Long Rest.
In addition, when you spend at least 1 hour helping with ordinary sect chores during downtime, you can secure food and safe lodging for yourself and up to five companions of equal or lower Standing for the next 24 hours.
This does not create food. It obtains a proper share from existing stores, kitchens, dormitories, hostels, or village households.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_QUIET_APOLOGY_METHO:
### Quiet Apology Method - Etiquette
You know how to apologize without making the insult larger.
When a non-combat social scene worsens because of a minor etiquette mistake, missed honorific, late arrival, improper form, or accidental slight, you may spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.
On a success, reduce the immediate social consequence by one step. An offended person may still be annoyed, but they do not escalate the matter unless they already intended to do so.
This does not undo deliberate insults, crimes, betrayals, public humiliation, or loss of face caused by serious failure.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_SECT_TOKEN_ETIQUETT:
### Sect Token Etiquette - Etiquette
You know how to read tokens, robes, seals, belts, hall badges, speech patterns, and seniority markers.
You have Advantage on Sect Checks made to identify a person’s apparent Standing, hall affiliation, disciple grade, service role, or whether a displayed sect token looks false.
When you enter a new sect, clan, academy, or organized village, you can spend one Merit Die to avoid a minor etiquette mistake that would otherwise offend a local functionary, guard, outer disciple, or servant.
This does not protect you from deliberate insults, major protocol breaches, or lying about your rank.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_SENIOR_BROTHER_S_ER:
### Senior Brother’s Errand - Mission, Etiquette
You know how to carry small responsibilities without inflating them into disasters.
When you Accept a Duty that involves carrying a message, token, package, guest, junior disciple, or instruction from one place to another, gain one additional Merit Die that can be spent only on checks made to complete that Duty.
This temporary Merit Die vanishes when the Duty is completed or abandoned.
If the item is sealed, sacred, dangerous, illegal, or politically explosive, this talent does not make it safe. It only helps you handle the errand correctly.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_TEN_THOUSAND_DISCIP:
### Ten Thousand Disciples’ Ledger - Ledger, Steward, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+.
You can read a sect as a living circulation system.
After spending at least one day reviewing reports, rosters, ledgers, petitions, stores, and mission outcomes for a large institution, spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.
On a success, learn the answer to three of the following:
Which hall is under-resourced?
Which duty is creating resentment?
Which mission category is consuming too many disciples?
Which storehouse is being quietly drained?
Which elder’s policy is failing in practice?
Which group is about to revolt, desert, or collapse?
Which ordinary workers are holding the sect together?
Which resource shortage will become a crisis next season?
Which branch is lying in its reports?
Which junior or clerk deserves promotion?
On a success by 5 or more, also identify one practical reform that would help without requiring combat.
This talent gives administrative truth, not automatic political power.
TAL_SECT_STEWARDSHIP_WORKER_S_FRIEND:
### Worker’s Friend - Etiquette, Household
You know the names of the people most disciples ignore.
Servants, cooks, field hands, porters, gate clerks, stable workers, and outer yard laborers are inclined to treat you as respectful unless you have personally mistreated them.
When you ask ordinary workers for non-secret help, directions, warnings, or introductions, you may spend one Merit Die and add it to the social check.
On a success, the worker also tells you one practical complication that higher-status disciples often miss.
TAL_SHADOW_AMBUSH_FROM_BELOW:
### Ambush From Below
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature bearing your Shadow Mark moves, attacks, or ends its turn within 60 feet
Cost: 2 CP
The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Ambush From Below damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half as much Ambush From Below damage and suffers no Reaction loss.
Ambush From Below damage is determined by your Cultivation Level.
| CL | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 5-10 | 3d8 |
| 11-16 | 4d8 |
| 17-20 | 5d8 |
A creature can trigger Ambush From Below only once per turn.
TAL_SHADOW_COURT_OF_THE_SECOND_SILHOUETT:
### Court of the Second Silhouette
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Every visible shadow inside the Domain becomes a temporary Shadow Anchor for you.
#### You and Allies
Gain +1 AC.
Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
May move through allied spaces.
May move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after an enemy misses them.
#### Enemies
Cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible against you.
Treat movement away from their own silhouettes as difficult terrain.
Have Disadvantage on checks made to Hide.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
Apply your Shadow Mark.
Deal 2d8 Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage.
Reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Prevent Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Pull the creature 10 feet toward its own shadow.
Successful Save: Apply your Shadow Mark until the start of its next turn.
TAL_SHADOW_LONG_ROAD_BETWEEN_LANTERNS:
### Long Road Between Lanterns
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 1 mile
Cost: 5 CP
Teleport from one of your Shadow Anchors into another Shadow Anchor within range.
You may bring a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Each creature must begin within 5 feet of the starting anchor and arrive within 5 feet of the destination anchor.
Long Road Between Lanterns cannot cross a sealed barrier, Dimensional Lock, or planar boundary.
TAL_SHADOW_SECOND_SILHOUETTE:
### Second Silhouette
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: See text
Cost: None
Choose one visible creature, object, or 5-foot space containing a Cast Shadow or located inside Dim Light or Darkness.
#### Space or Object
Create one Shadow Anchor.
The anchor lasts for 1 hour.
#### Willing Creature
Apply your Shadow Mark.
The mark lasts for 1 minute.
#### Unwilling Creature
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Apply your Shadow Mark until the start of your next turn.
A creature may carry only one of your Shadow Marks at a time.
TAL_SHADOW_SEIZE_THE_SECOND_BODY:
### Seize the Second Body
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 5 CP
Choose one creature bearing your Shadow Mark.
The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
Pull it up to 20 feet toward its own shadow.
Move its shadow up to 20 feet and force its body to follow.
Reduce its Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.
Prevent Reactions until the start of your next turn and knock it Prone.
Successful Save: Pull the creature 5 feet or reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SHADOW_SEVER_THE_SECOND_SILHOUETTE:
### Sever the Second Silhouette
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature bearing your Shadow Mark.
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 12d10 Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage. Its Speed becomes 0 and it cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Until the end of your next turn, the target’s separated shadow remains in its current space as a Shadow Anchor.
TAL_SHADOW_SHADOWLESS_REVERSAL:
### Shadowless Reversal
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You are hit by an attack
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per round
Leave a false silhouette behind and use Shadow Step immediately.
If you move outside the attack’s reach, line, or area, the attack misses.
Your abandoned silhouette remains until the start of your next turn.
The first creature entering its space or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature is Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
TAL_SHADOW_SHADOW_BIND:
### Shadow Bind
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature bearing your Shadow Mark or standing inside one of your Shadowed Spaces.
The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature is Restrained.
Successful Save: The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
A Restrained creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
TAL_SHADOW_SHADOW_EXCHANGE:
### Shadow Exchange
Prerequisite: Shadow Ward, CL 7+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet is hit by an attack
Cost: 4 CP
Teleport the protected creature into one visible, unoccupied Shadowed Space within 20 feet. The destination must not be blocked by a solid obstacle.
If this movement carries the creature outside the triggering attack’s reach, line, or area, the attack misses that creature.
Shadow Exchange cannot cross a sealed barrier or Dimensional Lock.
TAL_SHADOW_SHADOW_THAT_OUTLIVES_THE_BODY:
### Shadow That Outlives the Body
“The enemy destroyed the cultivator. The shadow remained unconvinced.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Shadow-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-shadow inheritance
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You would drop to 0 HP, fail a saving throw, or be struck by a critical hit
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one:
Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.
Succeed on the triggering saving throw.
Turn the triggering critical hit into a miss.
Move up to 60 feet into a visible Shadowed Space and leave a shadow corpse behind.
End one ordinary restraint, grapple, or physical prison affecting you.
Until the end of your next turn:
Become Incorporeal.
Gain Resistance to all damage except Radiant, Force, and Void effects.
May move through occupied spaces and ordinary barriers as difficult terrain.
Cannot end your turn inside a barrier.
TAL_SHADOW_STEP_BEHIND_THE_BODY:
### Step Behind the Body
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Cost: +1 CP
When a creature bears your Shadow Mark, its silhouette becomes a legal Shadow Step destination.
You may end your Shadow Step in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that creature.
This does not allow you to cross Total Cover, a sealed barrier, or a Dimensional Lock.
TAL_SHADOW_TWO_SHADOWS_CROSSING:
### Two Shadows Crossing
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Cost: +2 CP
Carry one willing creature of your size or smaller through Shadow Step.
The creature must begin adjacent to you and arrive in an unoccupied space adjacent to your destination.
TAL_SHADOW_UNWILLING_CREATURE:
#### Unwilling Creature
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Apply your Shadow Mark until the start of your next turn.
A creature may carry only one of your Shadow Marks at a time.
TAL_SHADOW_WILLING_CREATURE:
#### Willing Creature
Apply your Shadow Mark.
The mark lasts for 1 minute.
TAL_SHADOW_WORLD_OF_LIVING_SHADOWS:
### World of Living Shadows
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Every visible silhouette inside the area becomes part of your battlefield.
#### Allies
Gain +1 AC.
Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
May use one visible shadow inside the area as a Shadow Step destination once per turn.
#### Enemies
Cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible.
Treat the area as difficult terrain.
Have Disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks.
When an enemy enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 4d8 Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage and becomes Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Restrained.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
TAL_SHIELD_BLOCKADE:
#### BLOCKADE
You may use Active Defense when you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage.
When used this way:
add your Shield Bonus to the Dexterity saving throw instead of increasing your AC;
a successful saving throw causes you to take no damage from the effect;
choose no Deflect talent unless another talent explicitly allows one.
Blockade does not automatically protect against an effect that cannot reasonably be met by presenting the Shield toward its route.
TAL_SHIELD_CELESTIAL_DISC_SWEEP:
#### CELESTIAL-DISC SWEEP - COUNTER
Prerequisite: Returning Shield Disc, CL 12+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Cone or 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Throw the Shield along a sweeping path before it returns to your hand.
Each hostile creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Bludgeoning damage and choose whether the Shield knocks the creature Prone or pushes it 15 feet away from the path.
Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no additional effect.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 12-16 | 4d8 |
| 17-20 | 6d8 |
Unattended ordinary projectiles and fragile objects in the area may be scattered or broken.
TAL_SHIELD_COURT_OF_TEN_THOUSAND_TURNING:
#### COURT OF TEN THOUSAND TURNING FACES - DOMAIN
“The enemy found an opening and struck. The opening turned sideways.”
Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per Short Rest
Establish a Court of orbiting Shield-Qi surfaces, reflected angles, shield shadows, and ancestral ramparts.
For the duration:
Projected Shield Face and Cover Ally may protect any ally inside the Court when you can perceive the incoming route.
Once per round, use Active Defense inside the Court without spending a Reaction or expending Martial Focus.
When you establish Flexible Cover, choose up to three different edges or connected 5-foot segments inside the Court. Each becomes a projected Shield Face until the start of your next turn.
When an attack misses because of your Active Defense, move one projected Shield Face up to 10 feet to another legal edge or connected segment inside the Court without spending an Action.
Allies of your choice inside the Court gain Half Cover against ranged attacks originating outside the Court.
When you use Redirecting Shield, the new target may be any legal target inside the Court that the redirected attack can reach after touching one of your projected Shield Faces.
The Court does not automatically:
create Total Cover;
stop teleportation;
block possession or gaze effects;
protect against effects originating inside a protected space;
become permanent Formation infrastructure;
redirect a narrative-scale calamity without a higher-Realm talent.
TAL_SHIELD_COVER_ALLY:
#### COVER ALLY
You may use Active Defense when an attack targets one ally within your natural reach.
You must be aware of the attacker and able to present the Shield between the attack and the ally.
The ally gains the Active Defense AC increase against the triggering attack.
When a Shield talent refers to a creature benefiting from your Active Defense, an ally protected through Cover Ally qualifies.
TAL_SHIELD_EXTENSIVE_DEFENSE:
#### EXTENSIVE DEFENSE - FOCUS
Expend Martial Focus without spending an Action, including when it is not your turn.
Until the start of your next turn, apply Active Defense against every valid triggering attack without spending a Reaction.
If you know Cover Ally, apply this benefit to yourself and allies within your natural reach whenever the attack route permits you to present the Shield.
Each triggering attack remains a separate use of Active Defense and may benefit from one Deflect talent.
TAL_SHIELD_FLEXIBLE_COVER:
#### FLEXIBLE COVER - FACE
Action Type: Action
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Choose one edge of your space and establish a physical Shield Face.
The Shield Face provides Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and effects whose routes cross the chosen edge toward a protected creature directly behind that face.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Flexible Cover as a Bonus Action.
As a Reaction, change the selected edge of your space.
Flexible Cover does not provide sufficient concealment to allow the Hide action by itself.
TAL_SHIELD_GREATER_DEFLECT:
#### GREATER DEFLECT - FOCUS
When using Active Defense, expend Martial Focus to apply two different Deflect talents instead of one.
Resolve both talents in the order you choose.
TAL_SHIELD_GUARDED_STANCE:
#### GUARDED STANCE
You may use Active Defense when you are not equipped with a Shield.
Choose one weapon you are wielding. Treat that weapon as a Shield for talents that reference your Shield.
The chosen weapon has a Shield Bonus of 0 unless another feature grants it a Shield Bonus.
Active Defense still grants its additional +2 AC against the triggering attack.
A weapon used through Guarded Stance is not a Shield for unrelated rules and does not grant ordinary Shield training.
TAL_SHIELD_HEAVEN_CRUSHING_SHIELD_DESCEN:
#### HEAVEN-CRUSHING SHIELD DESCENT - COUNTER
Prerequisite: Celestial-Disc Sweep, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
Manifest a vast Shield Soul above one point within range and drive it downward.
Each hostile creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Bludgeoning or Force damage, fall Prone, and become Restrained beneath the Shield-Qi face until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and move to the nearest legal space outside the area without falling Prone.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 15-16 | 8d8 |
| 17-20 | 10d8 |
A creature may use an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the Restrained condition on itself or one adjacent creature on a success.
At the GM’s discretion, the technique may damage fragile terrain, suppress ordinary projectiles, or create a temporary crater.
TAL_SHIELD_HEAVEN_WARDING_BLOCKADE:
#### HEAVEN-WARDING BLOCKADE
Prerequisite: Blockade, Projected Shield Face, CL 7+
When using Blockade against an effect whose route physically crosses your projected Shield Face, you may extend Blockade to allies protected behind that face.
Each protected ally adds your Shield Bonus to its Dexterity saving throw.
Each ally that succeeds takes no damage from the effect.
Use Heaven-Warding Blockade only once per round.
TAL_SHIELD_INTERPOSING_SHIELD:
#### INTERPOSING SHIELD
A creature benefiting from your Active Defense reduces damage taken from the triggering attack by:
your Proficiency Bonus
Apply this reduction before Resistance.
TAL_SHIELD_MOUNTAIN_ROOTED_RIM:
#### MOUNTAIN-ROOTED RIM
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Whenever you use Active Defense or Blockade, reduce forced movement affecting the protected creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
If the protected creature would gain the Prone condition from the triggering attack or effect, it has Advantage on the saving throw or contest made to resist that condition.
TAL_SHIELD_PERFECT_REDIRECTION:
#### PERFECT REDIRECTION - DEFLECT, COUNTER
Prerequisite: Redirecting Shield, CL 7+
You may use Redirecting Shield against spell attacks and Cultivation Attack rolls.
You may describe the defense as reflecting a ray, tilting a spell-light trajectory, turning a ghost strike, or catching a projected technique on the Shield’s cultivated face.
Perfect Redirection does not redirect saving-throw effects or effects that cannot legally reach the new target.
TAL_SHIELD_PUNCH_BLOCK:
#### PUNCH BLOCK
When you use Active Defense, you may make an attack roll with an Unarmed Strike and use the result in place of your AC for resolving the triggering attack, even if the result is lower.
