You still count as using Active Defense and may apply one Deflect talent.
Punch Block represents catching the attack with the shield rim, gauntlet, forearm, shoulder, or an aggressively timed strike.
TAL_SHIELD_RAIN_ON_THE_LOTUS_DEFLECTION:
#### RAIN-ON-THE-LOTUS DEFLECTION - DEFLECT
Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, CL 5+
When Active Defense causes a ranged weapon attack to miss, choose one:
catch one ordinary projectile in a free hand;
cause the projectile to fall harmlessly into one legal space within 10 feet;
send the projectile back toward the attacker, making a ranged weapon attack with the projectile as part of the same defense.
Use Dexterity for the returned attack.
The returned attack deals the projectile’s ordinary damage and does not automatically apply the original attacker’s class features, talents, poisons, or expendable effects.
TAL_SHIELD_REACTIVE_DEFENSE:
#### REACTIVE DEFENSE - COUNTER
Whenever you take the Dodge action while wielding a Shield, you may make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Reaction against one creature that misses you with an attack before the start of your next turn.
You may make this attack only once per use of Dodge.
TAL_SHIELD_REDIRECTING_SHIELD:
#### REDIRECTING SHIELD - DEFLECT, COUNTER
When a weapon attack misses a creature benefiting from your Active Defense, you may expend Martial Focus.
Choose one new legal target for the attack.
For a melee attack, the new target must be within the attacker’s original reach.
For a ranged attack, the new target must be within the attack’s original range from the attacker.
Compare the original attack roll to the new target’s AC.
The attack retains its original damage and effects.
Redirecting Shield does not affect siege weapons, massive weapons, area effects, or attacks that cannot legally reach the new target.
TAL_SHIELD_RETURNING_SHIELD_DISC:
#### RETURNING SHIELD DISC - MOVEMENT, COUNTER
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may throw your Shield as a returning weapon.
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Range: 30/90 feet
Requirement: Wielding a Shield
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action.
Make a ranged weapon attack using Strength or Dexterity.
Hit: Deal Bludgeoning damage:
1d8 + the chosen ability modifier
After the attack resolves, the Shield returns to your hand and is immediately re-equipped without using the Utilize action.
While the Shield is away from your hand, you do not gain its Shield Bonus and cannot use Shield talents unless another talent says otherwise.
At CL 11+, the attack deals:
2d8 + the chosen ability modifier
At CL 17+, the attack deals:
3d8 + the chosen ability modifier
TAL_SHIELD_SHIELD_FLIGHT_RESCUE:
#### SHIELD-FLIGHT RESCUE - MOVEMENT
Prerequisite: Returning Shield Disc, Cover Ally, CL 7+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: An ally you can perceive within 30 feet is targeted by an attack roll
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Throw your Shield toward the ally before the attack resolves.
The ally benefits from your Active Defense against the triggering attack.
After the attack resolves, choose one:
the Shield returns to your hand and is immediately re-equipped;
the Shield remains equipped by the ally until the start of your next turn, provided the ally has a free hand and is willing.
If the Shield remains with the ally, you do not gain its Shield Bonus and cannot use talents requiring you to wield it until it returns.
TAL_SHIELD_SHIELD_OF_THE_SECOND_ANSWER:
#### SHIELD OF THE SECOND ANSWER - DEFLECT
Prerequisite: Greater Deflect, CL 12+
When Active Defense causes an attack to miss, retain one echoing Shield Face until the start of your next turn.
The next valid attack against the same protected creature before the echo ends receives the Active Defense AC increase without spending your Reaction or Martial Focus.
The echo may benefit from one Deflect talent.
Use Shield of the Second Answer only once per round.
TAL_SHIELD_TEN_THOUSAND_REFLECTIONS:
#### TEN THOUSAND REFLECTIONS - DEFLECT, COUNTER
Prerequisite: Court of Ten Thousand Turning Faces or Sovereign Shield-Soul Incarnation, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A hostile creature makes an attack roll against you or an ally you can perceive within 60 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Manifest reflected Shield Faces around up to your Proficiency Bonus legal targets within 60 feet.
Apply Active Defense against the triggering attack and against the next valid attack targeting each chosen creature before the start of your next turn.
Each protected creature may benefit from one Deflect talent against one attack.
TAL_SHIELD_THE_MOUNTAIN_FITS_BEHIND_ONE_:
#### THE MOUNTAIN FITS BEHIND ONE SHIELD - FACE
Prerequisite: Moving Rampart, CL 12+
When you establish Flexible Cover or Seal the Breach, increase the projected face to up to:
30 feet wide and 20 feet high
You may reduce its size when creating it.
When a creature behind the face would be pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone by an effect crossing the face, reduce the forced movement by 20 feet and grant Advantage on one saving throw made to resist Prone.
TAL_SHIELD_UNBROKEN_RIM:
#### UNBROKEN RIM
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When your Shield would break, be disarmed, become suppressed, or be destroyed by an ordinary effect, expend Martial Focus.
Choose one:
the Shield remains intact and equipped;
the Shield becomes cracked but functional until the end of your next turn;
immediately catch and re-equip the Shield after it is disarmed.
Unbroken Rim does not automatically preserve an ordinary Shield against a superior Realm-defining sunder, artifact-destroying technique, or narrative-scale calamity.
TAL_SMOKE_ASHEN_BLINDFOLD:
### Ashen Blindfold - Veil, Trace
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When you use Blind the Line, the attacker also makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot see through your Smoke Veil until the start of its next turn, even if the veil is only Lightly Obscured.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
This does not affect Blindsight, Tremorsense, or Truesight unless another talent says so.
TAL_SMOKE_ASHEN_COURT_RECORD:
### Ashen Court Record - Domain, Witness
Prerequisite: Court of Hidden Witnesses, CL 10+
When a creature inside your Smoke Domain makes an attack roll, casts a spell, spends CP, uses a spell slot, uses a supernatural technique, or becomes Invisible, you may place a Smoke Trace on it even if it does not pass through an existing Smoke Veil line of sight.
Use Ashen Court Record once per round.
TAL_SMOKE_ASHEN_LUNG_SEALS_THE_DRAGON_CR:
### Ashen Lung Seals the Dragon Cry
Prerequisite: Smothering Mandate, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace uses a breath weapon, shout, roar, song, spoken command, verbal-component spell, or breath-based supernatural technique
Cost: 5 CP
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The triggering technique fails and its cost or use is spent.
Successful Save: The triggering technique resolves, but attack rolls it makes have Disadvantage and targets have Advantage on saving throws against it.
This talent does not affect techniques that are not meaningfully expressed through breath, voice, or exhalation.
TAL_SMOKE_ASH_ON_THE_FOOTPRINTS:
### Ash on the Footprints - Witness
When a creature leaves your Smoke Veil, you may place a Smoke Trace on the space it left even if you have already placed a Smoke Trace this round.
Until the trace ends, creatures have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) or Wisdom (Perception) checks made to notice that something passed through that space.
TAL_SMOKE_BLACKEN_THE_FLAME:
### Blacken the Flame - Cinder, Trace
You gain a new Smoke Response.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: Fire damage is dealt inside your Smoke Veil or through your Smoke Veil
Spend one Smoke Trace on the source, target, or affected space.
Reduce the Fire damage dealt to one creature or object by:
1d6 + your key ability modifier
The reduction increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
TAL_SMOKE_BLACK_CHIMNEY_ROUTE:
### Black Chimney Route - Domain, Drift
Prerequisite: Chimney Escape Method, CL 10+
When you use Slip the Chimney Path inside your Smoke Domain, increase the movement to 30 feet.
If you start and end inside the Domain, this movement does not require line of sight, but you must know the destination space is open.
TAL_SMOKE_BLACK_LUNG_CLOUD:
### Black-Lung Cloud - Veil, Breath
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you create or move your Smoke Veil, spend 1 CP to make it choking for 1 round.
The first time a hostile creature enters the veil on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It is Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
A creature that does not breathe has Advantage on the save.
TAL_SMOKE_BREATH_THREAD_LISTENING:
### Breath-Thread Listening - Breath, Witness
Prerequisite: CL 5+
While you are inside your Smoke Veil, you can hear whispers, breathing, coughing, and verbal components inside the same Smoke Veil as if you were within 10 feet of the speaker.
A creature with a Smoke Trace cannot hide its breath or speech from this talent unless it is behind total cover or protected by a stronger silence effect.
TAL_SMOKE_CENSER_COURT_METHOD:
### Censer Court Method - Domain, Breath
Prerequisite: Court of Hidden Witnesses, CL 10+
Allies inside your Smoke Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened and Poisoned.
When you use Incense Calm inside the Domain, choose up to two targets instead of one.
TAL_SMOKE_CHIMNEY_ESCAPE_METHOD:
### Chimney Escape Method - Drift
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When you use Slip the Chimney Path, you may move from one space in your Smoke Veil to another space in the same Smoke Veil without crossing the intervening space.
The destination must be within 30 feet and must be a space you can see or a space containing one of your Smoke Traces.
This is supernatural movement through smoke, not teleportation through solid barriers.
TAL_SMOKE_CINDER_WISP:
### Cinder Wisp - Cinder, Trace
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or object you can see
Cost: 0 CP
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: The target takes 1d6 + your Path key ability modifier Fire or Poison damage and gains a Smoke Trace.
Choose the damage type when you use this talent. The damage represents ember, soot, ash, or lung-sting; it is an expression of Smoke, not the sphere identity.
The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
TAL_SMOKE_CINDER_WITHOUT_FLAME:
### Cinder Without Flame - Cinder
Prerequisite: Cinder Wisp, CL 10+
When you use Cinder Wisp, choose Fire, Poison, or Necrotic damage.
If the target is inside your Smoke Veil, it also makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
This is soot and lung-sting as a Smoke expression. It does not make Smoke a Disease or Death sphere.
TAL_SMOKE_DENSE_VEIL:
### Dense Veil - Veil
When you create or move your Smoke Veil, it becomes Dense until the start of your next turn.
If you maintain the same Smoke Veil without moving it on your next turn, it remains Dense.
TAL_SMOKE_EMBERBANK_STORAGE:
### Emberbank Storage - Cinder
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When Fire damage is dealt inside your Smoke Veil, store one emberbank charge until the end of your next turn.
You can hold one emberbank charge at a time.
When you use Cinder Wisp or Blacken the Flame, spend the charge to add one of the following effects:
increase Fire damage by 1d6;
reduce Fire damage by an additional 1d6;
place a Smoke Trace on one additional creature or object inside the same Smoke Veil.
TAL_SMOKE_FUNERAL_INCENSE_BOUNDARY:
### Funeral Incense Boundary - Breath, Witness
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Smoke Veil can preserve the immediate traces of violence.
When a creature drops to 0 HP or dies inside your Smoke Veil, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction.
Until the end of your next long rest, the space where it fell retains a visible or spiritual Smoke Trace that records:
the direction from which the last harmful effect came;
whether the harm was weapon, spell, sphere, poison, disease, or environmental hazard;
whether Fire, Poison, Necrotic, Radiant, or Psychic damage was involved.
This does not identify the attacker by name unless another feature would.
TAL_SMOKE_INCENSE_CALM:
### Incense Calm - Breath
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Your Smoke Veil
Cost: 1 CP
Choose yourself or one ally inside your Smoke Veil.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
The target also has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn against Frightened, Poisoned, or an effect that would prevent speech or breathing.
TAL_SMOKE_SECOND_VEIL:
### Second Veil - Veil
When you create a Smoke Veil, create one additional 5-foot cube of smoke within 30 feet of the original veil.
This second veil follows the same duration and concentration.
At CL 5, the second veil becomes a 10-foot cube.
TAL_SMOKE_SMOKE_DOMAIN_COURT_OF_HIDDEN_W:
### Smoke Domain: Court of Hidden Witnesses
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: Three connected 20-foot cubes within 120 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You create a court of smoke that remembers every passage.
The area is Dense Smoke.
For the duration:
you may place one additional Smoke Trace each round;
your Smoke Traces inside the Domain last until the end of your next turn after they leave the Domain;
when a hostile creature starts its turn inside the Domain, you may place a Smoke Trace on it;
when you use Follow the Soot inside the Domain, the direction remains known for 1 minute;
once per round, you may use Blind the Line, Follow the Soot, or Slip the Chimney Path without spending the Smoke Trace.
The Domain does not create solid walls or true Cover.
TAL_SMOKE_SMOKE_MIRROR_TRAIL:
### Smoke Mirror Trail - Trace, Witness
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When one creature inside your Smoke Veil becomes Invisible, successfully Hides, teleports, or leaves the veil without using normal movement, you may place a Smoke Trace on it without using your once-per-round Smoke Trace.
Until that trace ends, you know the direction to the target while it remains within 120 feet.
TAL_SMOKE_SMOKE_STEP:
### Smoke Step - Drift
When you use Slip the Chimney Path, increase the movement to 15 feet.
At CL 5, increase it to 20 feet.
TAL_SMOKE_SMOTHERING_MANDATE:
### Smothering Mandate - Breath
Prerequisite: Smother the Breath, CL 10+
When a creature fails its saving throw against Smother the Breath, choose one additional effect:
it cannot speak above a whisper until the end of its next turn;
it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn;
it cannot repeat the same breath, voice, or verbal-component technique until the end of its next turn.
This does not prevent speechless techniques.
TAL_SMOKE_SMOTHER_THE_BREATH:
### Smother the Breath - Breath, Trace
You gain a new Smoke Response.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace speaks, casts with a verbal component, uses a breath weapon, or begins a supernatural technique expressed through breath, voice, or exhalation
Spend the Smoke Trace.
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature coughs, chokes, or loses the clean line of breath. It has Disadvantage on the triggering d20 Test if the trigger includes one. If the trigger does not include a d20 Test, the creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Smother the Breath does not prevent ordinary speech after the triggering moment unless a talent says otherwise.
TAL_SMOKE_SOOT_EATS_THE_PATH:
### Soot Eats the Path - Veil, Trace
Prerequisite: CL 12+
When a creature with your Smoke Trace willingly moves through your Smoke Veil, you may spend the trace without an action.
The creature treats the smoke as difficult terrain until the end of the current turn.
If it ends that movement inside your Smoke Veil, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
TAL_SMOKE_SOOT_MARKED_WITNESS:
### Soot-Marked Witness - Witness, Trace
You gain a new Smoke Response.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature within range bearing your Smoke Trace
Cost: Spend the target's Smoke Trace
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Spend the Smoke Trace on the target.
Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot be Hidden from you solely because it is concealed by smoke, fog, mist, steam, or nonmagical darkness. If it was Hidden from you solely for one or more of those reasons, it immediately ceases to be Hidden from you, and you know its location while it remains within range.
This effect does not grant sight through the concealment. Attacks and other effects still suffer any normal penalties for being unable to see the target. It does not defeat Total Cover, unrelated invisibility, concealment from another source, an effect such as Truesight, or a successful Hide supported by circumstances other than the listed concealment.
TAL_SMOKE_SOOT_SCENT_TRAIL:
### Soot-Scent Trail - Trace, Witness
When you use Follow the Soot, the duration becomes 1 minute.
The target may attempt a Dexterity (Stealth) check against your Smoke Save DC at the end of each of its turns, ending this extended trace on a success.
TAL_SMOKE_THE_SMOKE_KNOWS_WHO_LIED:
### The Smoke Knows Who Lied
Prerequisite: Soot-Marked Witness, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Target: One creature with your Smoke Trace within 120 feet
Cost: 5 CP
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For 1 minute, whenever the target speaks a deliberate lie while within 120 feet of you, visible soot gathers at its mouth, hand, or shadow.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, you know whether the target is attempting to conceal hostile intent from you.
This talent reveals the presence of deliberate falsehood. It does not force the creature to speak or reveal the truth.
TAL_SMOKE_THOUSAND_CHIMNEY_ESCAPE:
### Thousand-Chimney Escape
Prerequisite: Black Chimney Route, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or one ally inside your Smoke Veil would be hit by an attack or fail a Dexterity saving throw
Cost: 5 CP
Move the target up to 60 feet to another space inside one of your Smoke Veils or Smoke Domain.
If this movement places the target outside the triggering attack’s reach or area, the attack misses or the target takes no damage from the triggering effect.
The movement cannot pass through airtight barriers or solid walls.
TAL_SMOKE_VANISHING_EXHALATION:
### Vanishing Exhalation - Veil, Drift
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You take the Hide action, become Invisible, or move behind Cover
Create a 5-foot cube of smoke in the space you left.
The smoke lasts until the start of your next turn and may receive Smoke Traces normally.
TAL_SMOKE_WALL_OF_SMOKE:
### Wall of Smoke - Veil
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you create Smoke Veil, arrange its cubes as a wall.
Each cube must share a face with another cube.
While the wall is Dense, ranged attacks that pass through at least two of its cubes have Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight.
This wall is not solid and does not provide Cover.
TAL_SNIPER_BOUNCING_SHOT:
#### Bouncing Shot - Snipe, Line
When making a Snipe Shot, you may expend Martial Focus to bounce your attack off a visible ceiling, floor, wall, shield face, pillar, stone, or comparable hard surface.
The shot may turn once at the bounced surface before reaching the target. The bounced surface takes no damage unless you choose to damage it and the GM agrees.
Use the total distance traveled when determining range.
This shot can attack a target protected by ordinary cover if the bounce creates a legal attack path, but it cannot bypass Total Cover unless an opening, route, or higher-Realm talent allows it.
TAL_SNIPER_BREATH_HELD_SHOT:
#### Breath-Held Shot - Focus
Prerequisite: CL 5+
If you take no movement on your turn before making a Snipe Shot, you may spend 1 CP or expend Martial Focus to add your Proficiency Bonus to the attack’s damage.
If the attack misses, you may keep the CP or Martial Focus spent, but your Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SNIPER_COURT_OF_THE_UNERRING_LINE:
#### Court of the Unerring Line - Domain
Prerequisites: Qi-Line Sight, CL 11+
“When the court is established, every exposed angle becomes testimony.”
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 120-foot Emanation from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a Court of the Unerring Line. Within the Court, your spirit marks trajectories, ricochet surfaces, exposed weak points, and careless movements.
For the duration:
You know whether each creature you can perceive inside the Court has Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, or Total Cover from your current position.
Once during each of your turns, you may make one Snipe Shot without applying the normal one-Snipe-talent limit to your Attack action. This does not grant an extra attack; it changes one attack you make.
You may apply two different Snipe talents to one Snipe Shot if at least one is a Line or Mark talent.
Your Bouncing Shot can turn up to three times, using total distance traveled.
When a hostile creature inside the Court makes a ranged attack, casts a ranged spell attack, or activates a line-based technique, you may use Intercepting Shot against it even if the attack is not a mundane projectile. If the attack is a spell attack or cultivation technique, you must expend Martial Focus or spend 1 CP.
When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a Snipe Shot inside the Court, choose one other hostile creature that can see the shot. That creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
The Court does not let you attack targets whose exact location is unknown, ignore sealed Total Cover, or shoot through a sealed Barrier unless another talent allows it.
TAL_SNIPER_DEADLY_SHOT:
#### Deadly Shot - Snipe
When making a Snipe Shot, you may take a -5 penalty to the attack roll.
If the attack hits, it deals +10 damage.
This talent is compatible with Head Shot, but all attack penalties and Advantage or Disadvantage are applied normally before the hit is determined.
TAL_SNIPER_DISABLE_THE_COMMAND_HAND:
#### Disable the Command Hand - Snipe, Mark
Prerequisites: Weapon Shot, CL 11+
When you hit with Weapon Shot, you may target a command fan, wand, seal, hand bell, formation rod, banner, talisman brush, reins, command token, spellcasting focus, or comparable command implement.
On a failed save, the target drops the item as normal and also cannot activate abilities requiring that implement until it retrieves, replaces, or re-centers it.
On a successful save, the target keeps the item but cannot use Reactions and has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Artifacts, soul-bound items, and office-bearing regalia may require an opposed Cultivation Check or be immune until first weakened.
TAL_SNIPER_FAR_SHOT:
#### Far Shot - Line
Attacking at long range does not impose Disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
This does not increase a weapon’s maximum range unless another talent says so.
TAL_SNIPER_HEAD_SHOT:
#### Head Shot - Snipe
You take careful aim at a weak point: head, eye, throat, heart-line, exposed joint, control gem, pressure valve, skull seam, or equivalent vulnerable structure.
When making a Head Shot, you cannot make additional attacks from the Extra Attack feature during the same Attack action.
If you would have been able to make additional attacks through Extra Attack, increase this attack’s damage by +1d8 for each additional attack you gave up.
Multiattack counts as Extra Attack for this purpose when converting a monster or NPC technique; only ranged attacks after the first count as additional attacks.
If this attack deals damage equal to at least half the creature’s current Hit Points, you may expend Martial Focus to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, choose one:
the target is Stunned until the end of your next turn;
the target falls Prone and cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn;
if the target is a non-legendary creature whose current Hit Points after damage are no more than your Sniper level or CL plus your Proficiency Bonus, it drops to 0 Hit Points.
The GM may rule that creatures without discernible weak points, oozes, swarms, amorphous bodies, or beings with distributed anatomy are immune to the drop-to-0 option unless a higher-Realm talent applies.
TAL_SNIPER_HEAVEN_HUNTING_EYE:
#### Heaven-Hunting Eye - Realm Evolution
Prerequisites: Court of the Unerring Line, CL 15+
Your sight, breath, weapon, and projectile become parts of one hunting principle. Distance becomes a quantity you measure, not a protection the enemy owns.
Gain the following benefits while holding Martial Focus:
You can perceive your own Aimed Lines as visible, audible, or spiritual threads.
Your Snipe Shot range increases by 300 feet, and long range does not impose Disadvantage.
Once per round, when you miss with a Snipe Shot, you may move the projectile up to 30 feet after the miss and make a Scoot Shot against an unattended object, exposed mechanism, or fragile surface.
You may use Intercepting Shot against ranged spell attacks and ordinary projectile-like cultivation attacks without spending CP, though you still need a Reaction.
When a talent requires exact location, you may satisfy it through a spiritual Mark you created even if the target is currently unseen.
You may apply Sniper talents to ranged spell attacks if the spell attack is a single-target attack roll and you can describe a clear line of delivery.
This does not turn every spell into a projectile, does not affect saving-throw-only spells, and does not let you shoot unknown targets.
TAL_SNIPER_HINDERING_PROJECTILE:
#### Hindering Projectile - Snipe
Your shot leaves a weapon, arrow, bolt, needle, shard, or Qi-weighted impact lodged in a place that disrupts motion.
On a hit, the target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until it uses an Action to remove the projectile or correct the lodged injury.
On a successful save, the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.
The effect ends early if the projectile is removed, the wound is sealed by sufficient healing, or the GM rules the target lacks a body that can be hindered in this way.
TAL_SNIPER_INTERCEPTING_SHOT:
#### Intercepting Shot - Counter-Shot
You may Ready a ranged weapon attack to intercept another ranged attack you can perceive.
You cannot intercept spell attacks or massive ranged weapons such as boulders, ballista bolts, siege stones, or ship-scale projectiles unless your weapon or technique is comparable in scale.
When the triggering attack is made, make your ranged attack as normal.
If your attack roll is higher than the triggering attack roll, the triggering attack is negated.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Intercepting Shot as a Reaction without first taking the Ready action.
TAL_SNIPER_KILLING_APERTURE:
#### Killing Aperture - Snipe
Prerequisites: Head Shot, CL 11+
When you make a Head Shot through an Aimed Line and the attack hits, the extra damage dice from Head Shot become d10s instead of d8s.
If the attack reduces the target to 0 Hit Points, you may choose to make the result clean, silent, and physically precise. The target drops without obvious gore unless the damage type or weapon would make that impossible.
If the target is Bloodied before the attack and the attack deals damage equal to at least half its current Hit Points, the Constitution saving throw from Head Shot is made with Disadvantage.
Legendary creatures, major villains, named cultivators, and creatures protected by superior fate, divine mandate, or Secret Inheritance may replace this Disadvantage with an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SNIPER_PERFECT_SHOT:
#### Perfect Shot - Focus, Line
As a Bonus Action, expend Martial Focus to gain Advantage on the next ranged weapon attack you make before the end of your turn.
If that attack is a Snipe Shot, it also counts as having an Aimed Line.
TAL_SNIPER_PHASIC_SHOT:
#### Phasic Shot - Snipe, Line
Prerequisites: Perfect Shot, CL 15+
Your shot cuts through the bonds of ordinary position.
When making a Snipe Shot through an Aimed Line, expend Martial Focus and spend 2 CP.
For this attack, you ignore cover, including Total Cover, between you and the target. You also ignore effects that specifically hinder ordinary ranged attacks, such as arrow-deflecting winds, projectile screens, missile wards, and mundane Deflect Missiles-style techniques.
You must still know the target’s exact location.
Phasic Shot cannot pass through a sealed Barrier, divine prohibition, artifact vault, world-bound formation, demiplane boundary, or Secret Inheritance defense unless you win an opposed Cultivation Check or the story has established a legal weakness.
TAL_SNIPER_PIERCING_SHOT:
#### Piercing Shot - Snipe, Line
Your attack pierces the target and can strike another creature in line behind it.
To use this talent, you must be able to trace a line from your space through the first target and into the second target’s space.
On a hit against the first target, make a secondary ranged attack against the second target. The secondary attack has Disadvantage and cannot extend beyond the weapon’s long range.
If the secondary attack hits and damages its target, the projectile may continue to a third target in the same line. Each additional attack has Disadvantage, and the GM may limit the number of targets based on weapon, ammunition, terrain, and creature size.
You cannot apply additional Snipe talents to secondary attacks unless another feature says so.
TAL_SNIPER_PINNING_SHOT:
#### Pinning Shot - Snipe
Your shot pins clothing, armor straps, limb, shadow, sleeve, wing membrane, or carried gear to nearby terrain.
On a hit, the target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, the target is Grappled until it uses an Action to remove the projectile or until the pinned object is destroyed or torn free.
The escape DC is your Sniper Technique Save DC. A creature can also end the effect by succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against that DC as an Action.
A target must be adjacent to a surface, object, ground, wall, tree, vehicle, corpse, heavy furnishing, or similar anchor that can plausibly hold the pin. A flying creature can be pinned only if the projectile can pin it to a legal anchor or if a higher-Realm talent says otherwise.
TAL_SNIPER_PIN_THE_SHADOW:
#### Pin the Shadow - Snipe, Mark
Prerequisite: Pinning Shot, CL 5+
When you hit with Pinning Shot, you may pin not only the body but the target’s shadow, sleeve-line, spirit pressure, or footprint.
The target may be pinned even without a solid wall if it stands on a surface that can hold the projectile or Qi mark.
On a failed save, the target is Grappled as normal and cannot teleport or use a movement technique that requires a step, shadow, footprint, or bodily repositioning unless it first succeeds on a Charisma saving throw against your Sniper Technique Save DC.
This does not stop teleportation that does not involve the body, shadow, step, or current position unless the GM agrees.
TAL_SNIPER_PUSH_SHOT:
#### Push Shot - Snipe
On a hit, you push the target 5 feet directly away from you or along the shot’s line.
If this movement forces the target into a solid object, it instead falls Prone and the movement ends.
A creature more than one size larger than you may make a Strength saving throw to resist the push. On a successful save, it is not pushed, but it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SNIPER_QI_LINE_SIGHT:
#### Qi-Line Sight - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your aim awakens into visible or invisible Qi geometry. You do not merely look at a target; you read the line by which force will arrive.
Gain the following benefits:
Snipe Shot range increases by 30 feet for thrown weapons and by 60 feet for ranged weapons.
Bouncing Shot may turn twice instead of once if you expend Martial Focus.
Perfect Shot may be used with a ranged spell attack you make before the end of your turn.
You may treat a Tiny gap, arrow slit, cracked door, torn curtain, broken window, loose roof tile, moving sleeve, or similar opening as a legal line if the GM agrees a projectile can pass through it.
You can make Scoot Shot against unattended Tiny or Small objects. Small objects have AC 13 for this purpose.
Qi-Line Sight does not let you shoot through sealed walls, sealed Barriers, intact Total Cover, closed containers, or unknown locations.
TAL_SNIPER_RANGEFINDING_BREATH:
#### Rangefinding Breath - Mark, Line
As a Bonus Action, choose one creature or object you can perceive within your weapon’s long range.
Until the end of your next turn, you know whether the target is within normal range, long range, or beyond the weapon’s range. If the target remains within range and does not gain Total Cover, your next ranged attack against it gains an Aimed Line.
If you also hold Martial Focus, you learn whether the target benefits from Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, or Total Cover against your current position.
TAL_SNIPER_SEVERING_THE_FLIGHT_LINE:
#### Severing the Flight Line - Counter-Shot
Prerequisites: Intercepting Shot, CL 11+
When a creature you can perceive within your weapon’s long range flies, teleports, dashes, charges, leaps, or uses a movement technique, you may expend Martial Focus and use your Reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against it.
On a hit, the target’s movement ends after it travels 10 feet, and it must make a Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, it falls Prone if on the ground, or descends up to 30 feet if airborne. If it cannot safely descend, it falls normally.
This does not stop Secret Inheritance movement, major Space techniques, or scene-defining movement unless you win an opposed Cultivation Check.
TAL_SNIPER_SHIFT_POSITION:
#### Shift Position - Focus
If you move no more than 5 feet during your turn, you may regain Martial Focus as a Bonus Action.
You can use this talent while Prone if you do not stand up, crawl more than 5 feet, teleport, or otherwise change position beyond the limit.
TAL_SNIPER_SHOT_THAT_SILENCES_THE_BELL:
#### Shot That Silences the Bell - Snipe, Counter-Shot
Prerequisites: Disable the Command Hand, CL 15+
When a creature you can perceive within range begins casting a spell, activating a sphere technique, issuing a command through an implement, starting a chant, ringing a bell, raising a flag, or triggering a formation by gesture, you may expend Martial Focus and use your Reaction to make a Snipe Shot.
On a hit, the target must make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the triggering activation fails and any Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, CP, spell slot, or comparable cost is spent.
On a successful save, the triggering activation resolves, but the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or saving throw DC it creates before the end of its next turn.
Legendary actions, Secret Inheritances, and major calamity activations may require an opposed Cultivation Check instead of the saving throw.
TAL_SNIPER_SIGNAL_SHOT:
#### Signal Shot - Utility, Mark
As an Action, make a ranged attack against AC 10 targeting a visible empty space, object, wall, banner, tree, roof tile, hanging bell, formation plaque, or terrain feature within range.
On a hit, choose one ally who can see or hear the signal. Until the start of your next turn, that ally has Advantage on the next Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Survival), Intelligence (Investigation), or attack roll made to locate, identify, or attack a creature or object indicated by the shot.
If the shot also deals damage to a fragile signal object, the GM may allow a louder or more visible signal.
TAL_SNIPER_SNIPER_TRAINING:
#### Sniper Training
When you gain the Sniper sphere, gain the following benefits:
You gain proficiency with one ranged weapon of your choice, or one thrown weapon of your choice.
If you are already proficient with all weapons relevant to your concept, choose one Mortal Realm Sniper talent instead.
You gain Deadly Aim.
You gain Snipe Shot.
You learn one Mortal Realm Snipe talent.
TAL_SNIPER_STILL_SCOPE_POSTURE:
#### Still-Scope Posture - Focus
If you begin your turn Prone or behind cover and do not move before making a Snipe Shot, you may regain Martial Focus immediately after the attack resolves if the attack misses.
If the Snipe Shot hits, you may instead move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
TAL_SNIPER_TARGETED_ASSAULT:
#### Targeted Assault - Snipe
When making a Snipe Shot, you may expend Martial Focus to ignore the target’s Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for that attack.
At Foundation Realm, this may also ignore Resistance created by a visible body-hardening technique if the attack is made through an Aimed Line.
At Core Formation or higher, this may affect one Immunity to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage if your weapon or projectile is magical, spiritual, or cultivation-enhanced.
TAL_SNIPER_THREAD_THE_CLOSED_GATE:
#### Thread the Closed Gate - Snipe, Line
Prerequisites: Star-Scraper Line, CL 15+
When using Star-Scraper Line, you may attack a target anywhere within 1 mile even if the path requires the shot to pass through multiple open spaces, windows, tunnels, courtyards, arrow slits, moving gates, gaps between shields, or other narrow openings.
You must know the target’s exact location and the route must still have at least one continuous sequence of physical or supernatural openings.
If an ally with an appropriate scouting, divination, spirit, formation, or Hidden Eye technique guides the shot, you may treat their exact location information as your own.
This talent cannot hit a creature completely enclosed by protective surfaces unless you also use Phasic Shot or a Secret Inheritance.
TAL_SNIPER_THROUGH_THE_WRONG_DOOR:
#### Through the Wrong Door - Snipe, Line
Prerequisite: Bouncing Shot, CL 5+
When you use Bouncing Shot, the attack may ignore Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover if the bounce creates a believable attack angle.
If you expend Martial Focus, you may also ignore the Disadvantage from attacking a target you cannot see, provided you know its exact location and the shot can physically travel to that location by the bounced path.
This talent does not ignore Total Cover unless an opening exists.
TAL_SNIPER_TRAP_TECHNICIAN:
#### Trap Technician - Line, Utility
You can expend Martial Focus to attempt to disable a visible trap, exposed mechanism, pressure plate, tripwire, rune trigger, latch, lock-pin, gear, or trap focus with a ranged attack.
Make a ranged weapon attack and use the attack roll in place of the normal ability check using thieves’ tools.
You must be able to identify the part of the trap you are targeting. Failure may trigger the trap if the GM rules the shot struck the wrong component or moved the mechanism incorrectly.
This talent does not let ordinary ammunition solve every complex trap; it lets your shot substitute for a precise tool interaction when the target component is visible and physically vulnerable.
TAL_SNIPER_WEAPON_SHOT:
#### Weapon Shot - Snipe
On a hit, choose one weapon or held item the target is holding.
The target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, target’s choice. The target has Advantage on this saving throw if the object is held in two or more hands.
On a failed save, the target drops the chosen object. It lands up to 10 feet away in a direction of your choice.
On a successful save, the target keeps the object but has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or ability check made with that object before the start of your next turn.
If you use this talent with Scoot Shot against an unattended Tiny object, you may move it 10 feet in any direction rather than only away from you. If you have a free hand and are close enough for the object to reach you legally, you may catch it.
TAL_SNIPER_WORLD_NEEDLE_RICOCHET:
#### World-Needle Ricochet - Snipe, Line
Prerequisites: Bouncing Shot, CL 11+
When you use Bouncing Shot, you may bounce your shot from surfaces you can perceive through direct sight, spirit sense, or a Sniper mark. You may bounce from a creature’s shield, armor plate, weapon, horn, scale, or comparable hard surface if the attack roll equals or exceeds that creature’s AC.
If you bounce from a creature or attended object, the bounced creature takes no damage unless you also hit it with the attack or another talent says otherwise.
At the end of the shot’s route, you may ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
TAL_SOUND_BELL_OF_CLARITY:
#### Bell of Clarity - Instrument, Soul-Sound
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 3 CP
Sound one clarifying tone.
Choose creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus within range.
Each target may immediately repeat one saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Deafened, magical confusion, hostile possession pressure, or an effect imposed through voice, song, command, or sound.
On a success, the effect ends for that target.
If the effect was caused by a creature, the source hears the bell unless blocked by Silence.
TAL_SOUND_BELL_SHELL_GUARD:
#### Bell-Shell Guard - Instrument, Resonance
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or one ally within 30 feet takes Thunder damage, is Deafened, or fails a Concentration saving throw caused by sound, voice, thunder, or vibration
Cost: 1 CP or expend Martial Focus if using an approved bell, gong, shield-chime, or body-resonance variant
Reduce the triggering Thunder damage by:
1d8 + your Sound key ability modifier
If the trigger was Deafened or Concentration loss, grant the target a reroll. The target must use the new result.
At CL 11, increase the reduction to:
2d8 + your Sound key ability modifier
TAL_SOUND_BELL_THAT_BREAKS_THE_FORMATION:
#### Bell That Breaks the Formation - Shatter
Prerequisite: Harmonic Weakness, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One visible barrier, Formation Anchor, ward node, gate-bell, seal-pillar, instrument array, or resonant structure
Cost: 8 CP
Make a Sound Cultivation Attack against a GM-set DC.
Success: Deal 8d10 Thunder damage to the target. This damage ignores ordinary Resistance and hardness.
If the target is an ordinary temporary barrier or lesser ward node and the damage reduces it to 0, it breaks.
If the target is a major Formation Anchor, artifact, Domain core, sect gate, or Realm-defining structure, this talent may create a weakness, suppress one minor function until the end of your next turn, or reveal a vulnerability. It does not automatically destroy it.
TAL_SOUND_BODY_RESONANCE_STRIKE:
#### Body Resonance Strike - Voice, Shatter
Prerequisite: Body Refining or GM approval
When you hit with an Unarmed Strike or melee weapon attack, you may spend 1 Stamina or 1 CP to release a close vibration through the target.
Add 1d6 Thunder damage.
If the target is wearing armor, carrying a shield, holding a weapon, or is a construct, apply Resonance until the start of your next turn.
At CL 11, increase the bonus damage to 2d6.
Body Resonance Strike does not turn all melee attacks into Sound talents unless another feature says so.
TAL_SOUND_CARRYING_BELL:
#### Carrying Bell - Instrument
You can prepare one small bell, chime, drum, singing bowl, tuning fork, throat bead, or resonant charm during a Long Rest.
While the object is on your person:
Carry Voice range doubles for targets familiar with the sound;
Read the Vibration gains Advantage when examining bells, instruments, doors, locks, walls, or hollow spaces;
once per short rest, use Resonant Note without sound audible beyond 30 feet.
If the object is broken or stolen, you lose these benefits until you prepare another.
TAL_SOUND_CARRY_VOICE:
#### Carry Voice
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Bonus Action or 1 minute
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=ONE_MINUTE_EXTENDED_VOICE
Range: 120 feet normally, or longer through prepared echoes
Cost: None, or 1 CP for extended use
You can carry a brief message to one creature you can see within 120 feet. The target hears the message as a whisper, tone, bell-note, or inner vibration. This does not require the target to share a language, but the message must be understandable by ordinary means.
By spending 1 CP and concentrating for 1 minute, you may send a short message to a familiar location, prepared bell, resonant object, or creature whose voice you have studied within 1 mile. The target hears the message if a path of sound, structure, spirit resonance, or prepared anchor reasonably exists.
Carry Voice is not telepathy. Barriers, Silence, anti-divination wards, distance, or hostile territory may block it.
TAL_SOUND_COUNTER_CHANT:
#### Counter-Chant - Voice, Silence
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can hear within 60 feet speaks a command word, uses a Voice talent, casts a spell with a verbal component, or begins a supernatural chant
Cost: 2 CP
Make a Sound Check opposed by the target’s spellcasting ability check, cultivation check, or saving throw DC converted to a check DC.
Success: The target’s voice cracks. Choose one:
it has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll or ability check;
one target of the triggering effect has Advantage on its saving throw;
the triggering sound is audible but distorted, preventing clear communication;
if the effect is harmless communication only, it fails to carry beyond 30 feet.
Counter-Chant does not automatically counter spells. It disrupts voice-dependent execution.
TAL_SOUND_COURT_OF_THE_WORLD_RINGING_BEL:
#### Court of the World-Ringing Bell - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 9 CP
Establish a Sound Domain of bells, strings, thunder pressure, or silent resonance.
When you create the Domain, choose Ringing Court or Silent Court.
Ringing Court:
allies inside gain Resistance to Thunder damage;
allies inside may communicate in whispers across the Domain;
hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: They take 4d8 Thunder damage and gain Resonance.
Successful Save: They gain Resonance.
Silent Court:
ordinary speech and loud sound cannot pass beyond the Domain boundary;
allies inside gain Advantage on saving throws against voice, command, and sound effects;
hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: They cannot speak above a whisper until the start of their next turn.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
A creature can take damage from Court of the World-Ringing Bell only once per round.
TAL_SOUND_DAMPEN_SOUND:
#### Dampen Sound
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Area: 10-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create a zone of controlled dampening.
For the duration:
ordinary sound from inside the area is muffled;
creatures outside the area have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing to notice sounds from inside;
creatures inside have Advantage on checks to move quietly if the only issue is sound;
Thunder damage dealt entirely inside the area is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Dampen Sound is not full magical Silence. It does not prevent verbal components, speech, command words, or thunder damage unless a talent upgrades it.
TAL_SOUND_DISSONANT_PULSE:
#### Dissonant Pulse - Resonance
Trigger: You damage a creature with Resonant Note or another Sound talent.
Cost: 1 CP
Use Limit: Once per turn

Failed Save: Choose one:
Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn;
cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn;
reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn;
apply Resonance until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Apply Resonance until the start of your next turn.
TAL_SOUND_ECHO_DECOY:
#### Echo Decoy - Echo
Prerequisite: Echo Position, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Create a sound-body decoy in an unoccupied space.
The decoy produces footfalls, breathing, speech fragments, weapon sounds, and clothing rustle appropriate to one creature you choose.

On a failure, the creature treats the decoy as a plausible creature for hearing-based targeting and may waste one attack, pursuit, or reaction against it.
The decoy has AC 10, 1 HP, and disappears when damaged, touched, or exposed by special senses not based on sound.
TAL_SOUND_ECHO_POSITION:

Range: 60 feet

Create a false sound-position in a space you can perceive. Until the echo ends, a creature relying on hearing to locate you or one willing ally of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or treat the echo’s space as the source of the sound.
This can impose Disadvantage on one attack roll made before the start of your next turn if the attacker relies on hearing or sound to locate the target.
Echo Position does not fool sight, blindsight that is not sound-based, tremorsense, or true magical perception.
TAL_SOUND_FORBIDDEN_SILENCE_FIELD:
#### Forbidden Silence Field - Silence
Prerequisite: True Silence, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Create a heavy silence that presses on voice, breath, and spirit.

ordinary sound cannot be created or pass through;
creatures are Deafened;
verbal components and voice-dependent talents fail;
creatures cannot benefit from hearing-based blindsight;

hostile creatures entering for the first time on a turn or starting their turns there make Constitution saving throws.

Successful Save: No additional effect.
You may use Sound talents inside the Field only if they explicitly function through silent vibration, contact resonance, soul-sound, or a special feature.
TAL_SOUND_HARMONIC_HEALING_TONE:

At CL 17, healing increases to 6d8.

TAL_SOUND_HARMONIC_WEAKNESS:

Foundation: 1d8.

TAL_SOUND_MOUNTAIN_CRACKING_BELL:

Successful Save: Take half damage and gain Resonance.

TAL_SOUND_MUFFLE_FOOTFALL:

Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 1 CP
Choose yourself or one willing creature within 30 feet.

the target has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to avoid sound detection;
the target’s armor, gear, breathing, and footfalls are muted;
ordinary loose stones, creaking boards, and dry leaves make less sound when disturbed by the target.

TAL_SOUND_NAME_STRIKING_TONE:
#### Name-Striking Tone - Voice, Soul-Sound
Prerequisite: Soul-Echo Hearing, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 6 CP
Speak, ring, or resonate a creature’s name, title, cultivation epithet, true voice-pattern, or battle-call.

The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 6d8 Psychic or Thunder damage and choose one:
Frightened of you until the end of your next turn;
cannot willingly move closer to you until the end of your next turn;
Disadvantage on the next saving throw against your Sound talents before the end of your next turn;
apply Resonance until the end of your next turn.

TAL_SOUND_RESONANCE_FIELD:
#### Resonance Field - Resonance
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Area: 15-foot-radius aura
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

Your tone saturates nearby space.

TAL_SOUND_RESONANCE_MIRROR:

Cost: 5 CP

Successful Save: No effect.

TAL_SOUND_RESONANT_NOTE:
#### Resonant Note
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet

Make a Sound Cultivation Attack against the target.
Hit: The target takes Thunder damage and gains your Resonance until the start of your next turn.

the target has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn;
the target cannot benefit from ordinary sound-based hiding until the start of your next turn;

TAL_SOUND_RESONANT_SHATTER:

Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action

Area: 30-foot line or 10-foot-radius sphere

Successful Save: Take half damage.

CL 5-10: 5d8.
CL 11-16: 7d8.

TAL_SOUND_SHATTER_THE_CHANT:

the triggering effect occurs, but one target has Advantage on its saving throw;
the triggering effect occurs, but its range is halved;
the triggering effect occurs, but it cannot affect you;
if the effect is communication, command, or coordination only, it fails.

TAL_SOUND_SHATTER_VESSEL:

3d8 + Proficiency Bonus

suppress one mundane alarm, bell, chime, or sound trap attached to the object;

creatures are Deafened;

TAL_SOUND_THUNDERING_VOICE:
#### Thundering Voice - Voice
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot cone
Cost: 1 CP
Release a shout, bell-pulse, clap, or mantra burst.

CL 1-4: 2d6.
CL 5-10: 3d6.
CL 11-16: 5d6.
CL 17-20: 7d6.
TAL_SOUND_TREMOR_LISTENING:

TAL_SOUND_TRUE_SILENCE:

Prerequisite: Dampen Sound, CL 5+
Action Type: Action

Area: 15-foot-radius sphere

Create a field of cultivated silence.

creatures are Deafened;
ordinary sound cannot be created or pass through;
verbal components and voice-dependent talents fail unless a feature says they function without audible sound;

TAL_SOUND_VOICE_HEARD_ACROSS_THE_MOUNTAI:

a known receiving bell or instrument;
a creature whose voice you know well;
a sect token or oath-chime;

TAL_SOUND_WORLD_RINGING_NOTE:

TAL_SPACE_FOLD_STEP:
### Base Ability - Fold Step
Tag: Fold Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self.
Cost: 1 CP.
Teleport up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
You may bring worn and carried equipment.
Fold Step does not provoke Opportunity Attacks because you do not move through the intervening spaces.
Fold Step cannot pass through Dimensional Lock, a sealed formation, a closed spatial boundary, or a stronger Space effect.
Scaling:
Fold Step does not gain automatic range from CL. Its ordinary range improves through Extended Fold and similar explicit talents. This keeps the base technique reliable while making investment matter.
Ordinary Cap: Unless a higher-Realm talent, anchor, Domain, or variant explicitly says otherwise, ordinary unassisted Fold Step cannot exceed 50 feet. Fifty feet of uninterrupted teleportation with no path drawback is already a powerful battlefield movement tool.
Fold Step is a battlefield step, not long-distance travel magic.

CL 1-4: 1d8.
CL 5-10: 2d8.
CL 11-16: 3d8.

Action Type: Action
Range: Spear Line or 90 feet through Spear Light
Cost: 6 Spear Resource Choose one creature, unattended object, temporary Barrier, or visible ordinary ongoing supernatural defense.
TAL_SPEAR_HEART_OF_THE_SPEAR:

Prerequisite: CL 5+ Form a stable Spear Heart. At the start of your turn while wielding an approved Spear weapon, choose one posture until the start of your next turn.

#### Heaven-Piercing Spear Light - Spear-Qi
Prerequisite: Penetrating Rainbow, CL 12+
Action Type: Action
Range: 150-foot line, 5 feet wide
Cost: 8 Spear Resource Creatures in the line make Dexterity saving throws.

You have Advantage on the next Charisma, Wisdom, or Cultivation Check you make to communicate with, soothe, bargain with, bind, host, exorcise, or command a target bearing your Spirit Regard.
You may maintain a number of Spirit Regards equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_SPIRIT_COMPANIONS_TEMPORARY_SCENE_BO:
### Temporary Scene Bond
As an Action, you may spend 1 CP to create a temporary bond with a willing minor spirit, a spirit bearing your Spirit Regard, or a spirit whose Need you immediately satisfy.
The bond lasts for 1 scene.
During that scene, you may ask the spirit for one minor service, one piece of advice, one omen, one safe passage, one momentary manifestation, or one simple Nature Expression approved by the GM.
Temporary Scene Bonds do not count against your Major Spirit Bond limit unless the spirit fights for you or uses a major sphere effect.

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_ADROIT_FOCUS:
##### Adroit Focus - Research

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_ADVISORY_RESEARCHER:
##### Advisory Researcher - Research, Coordination

Choose one Research talent you know when you share the analysis. Those allies gain the benefit of that talent against the shared target.
An ally does not gain your other Research talents, learn the target’s characteristics, or gain permission to share the analysis again.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_ADVISORY_STALKER:

TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_ASSASSINATE:

After resolving the attack, compare your recorded Dexterity (Stealth) check against the Passive Perception of each creature that could detect you. A creature whose Passive Perception equals or exceeds your recorded check finds you.
Assassinate overrides only the normal rule that making an attack roll ends your hidden state. You still stop being hidden if another rule ends it, such as making a sound louder than a whisper or moving into a position where concealment is no longer possible.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_ASSAULT_ANALYSIS:

You may learn this talent twice.
After learning it a second time, you may use your sphere key ability for any weapon attack and damage roll made against a creature Analyzed by you.
Assault Analysis does not change the ability used for a saving throw, class feature, spell attack, or Unarmed Strike unless another rule says otherwise.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_BASE_SPHERE_FEATURES:

Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Choose a number of willing allies within range equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
For the duration, while an affected ally remains within range, that ally may use the result of your triggering Perception check in place of its own Passive Perception when attempting to notice a creature, object, hazard, or change in the environment that you could also perceive.
This does not share your senses. An ally cannot perceive through Total Cover, beyond the ally’s available senses, or beyond the limits of the triggering observation.
Using Cooperative Perception again ends the previous use.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_COOPERATIVE_STEALTH:
##### Cooperative Stealth - Coordination
Range: 60 feet
When you successfully take the Hide action, choose a number of willing allies within range equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Each chosen ally that currently satisfies the normal requirements to Hide may use your recorded Dexterity (Stealth) check total in place of its own check total when it takes the Hide action before the start of your next turn.
While you hold Martial Focus, double the number of allies you may choose.
Cooperative Stealth does not let an ally Hide in plain sight, ignore line of sight, or remain hidden after doing something that normally ends the hidden state.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_DEADLY_STRIKE:
##### Deadly Strike - Stalker
While hidden, your melee and ranged attacks deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
When you make your first melee or ranged attack during a turn while hidden, you may expend Martial Focus before making the attack roll. If the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6 damage per point of your Proficiency Bonus instead of the normal additional damage from this talent.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_DISCERN_ILLUSIONS:
##### Discern Illusions - Awareness
Range: 30 feet
While you hold Martial Focus, you have Advantage on saving throws and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to discern, resist, or see through Illusion spells, Illusion sphere techniques, and similar magical deceptions.
As a Bonus Action, you may expend Martial Focus to grant this benefit to allies of your choice within range for a number of rounds equal to your Path key ability modifier, minimum 1 round.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_EMPIRICAL_TRACKER:
##### Empirical Tracker - Approach
You may use Wisdom (Survival) when attempting to Analyze a creature.
You do not need to see the creature. Instead, target tracks, residue, a trail, a campsite, shed material, or another physical sign left by that creature within your Analyze range.
Unless the GM decides that the evidence remains unusually clear, the sign must be no more than 24 hours old.
When using this talent, the Analyze range measures the distance between you and the evidence, not the current distance between you and the creature.
Empirical Tracker does not reveal the creature’s current location.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_EXPEDITED_CUNNING:
##### Expedited Cunning - Stalker
While hidden, you have Advantage on Initiative rolls.
While you hold Martial Focus, traveling at a Normal pace does not impose Disadvantage on your Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Expedited Cunning does not remove the Disadvantage imposed by traveling at a Fast pace.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_EXPERT_SCOUT:
##### Expert Scout - Unique Talent
Choose Investigation, Perception, Stealth, or Survival. You must already have proficiency in the chosen skill.
Gain Expertise in that skill.
You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different skill each time.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_EXPLOIT_WEAKNESS:
##### Exploit Weakness - Research
When you would make a weapon attack against a creature Analyzed by you, you may make that attack as an Exploit Weakness special attack.
If the attack hits, resolve its normal damage and effects. The target must then make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The target takes an additional 1d10 damage of the weapon’s damage type.
Successful Save: No additional damage.
Use Exploit Weakness only once per turn.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_FAR_SIGHT_ANALYSIS:
##### Far-Sight Analysis
Increase the range of Analyze to 120 feet.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_FAST_STEALTH:
##### Fast Stealth
You may take the Hide action as a Bonus Action.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_FIND_GAP:
##### Find Gap - Research
Your attack rolls against creatures Analyzed by you score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
If another feature gives an equal or wider Critical Hit range, use the wider range. Do not add the ranges together.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_FOLKLORIST:
##### Folklorist - Approach
You may use Intelligence (History) when attempting to Analyze a creature.
When your Analyze check exceeds the target’s Analyze DC by 5 or more, learn one additional Analyzable Characteristic.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_FOLLOW_FOOTWORK:
##### Follow Footwork - Research
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature Analyzed by you that you can see moves during its turn.
Move up to half your Speed directly toward or directly away from the triggering creature.
You may expend Martial Focus to move up to your full Speed instead.
This movement occurs immediately after the triggering creature finishes the portion of movement that triggered your Reaction. Your movement provokes Opportunity Attacks as normal.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_GREATER_STALKER:
##### Greater Stalker
Your Stalker talents also function while you have the Invisible condition from a source other than the Hide action or while you are in a Heavily Obscured area.
While you hold Martial Focus, your Stalker talents also function while you are in a Lightly Obscured area.
Greater Stalker does not grant the Invisible condition, make you hidden, prevent enemies from locating you, or remove the ordinary requirements of the Hide action.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_HEAVEN_KEEPS_NO_SECRE:
##### Heaven Keeps No Secret from the Patient Eye
“The world did not betray you. It answered the questions you asked with every careless breath.”
Prerequisite: Hidden Eye sphere, CL 17 or higher
Time: 1 Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature you can perceive or your current rival
Duration: 1 minute
Uses: Once per week
Open the perfected record of the target’s revealed existence.
The target becomes Analyzed by you for the duration even if it would normally be protected from Analyze. Learn every Analyzable Characteristic the target possesses that is not concealed by an artifact, a Realm-defining protection, or another Secret Inheritance of equal or greater narrative weight.
For the duration:
you know the target’s direction and approximate distance while it remains on the same plane;
the target cannot benefit from being hidden from you;
you perceive the target if it is Invisible and not behind Total Cover;
allies of your choice within 120 feet treat the target as Analyzed by you for the purpose of one Research talent you know, chosen when you activate the Inheritance;
once during each of your turns when you damage the target, choose one known Damage Resistance to suppress until the start of your next turn;
once during the duration when you damage the target, you may treat one known Damage Immunity as Resistance for that instance of damage.
This Inheritance does not automatically defeat a superior Realm, destroy an artifact, negate a Formation core, reveal a creature behind Total Cover, or overwrite another Secret Inheritance without a cultivation-scale contest.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_HIDDEN_FOCUS:
##### Hidden Focus - Stalker
Range: 120 feet
While you are hidden from every enemy within range, you may use a Bonus Action to regain Martial Focus.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_IDENTIFY_RHYTHMS:
##### Identify Rhythms - Research
Gain a bonus to AC equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, against attacks made by creatures Analyzed by you.
While you hold Martial Focus, add the same bonus to saving throws you make against effects created by creatures Analyzed by you.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_INIMICAL_GAZE:
##### Inimical Gaze - Approach, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Rapid Analysis
Action Type: Action
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Choose one Approach you know. Make one Analyze check using that Approach and compare the result against the Analyze DC of each creature within your Analyze range that the Approach can validly target.
On each success, learn one Analyzable Characteristic of that creature and it becomes Analyzed by you.
Each creature counts as a separate Analyze attempt for your normal attempt limit.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_LURKER:
##### Lurker - Stalker
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature makes a Wisdom (Perception) check to find you while you are hidden.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
The triggering creature has Disadvantage on the check.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_MAGEHUNTER_S_VISION:
##### Magehunter’s Vision - Awareness, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Magical Cognizance
While you hold Martial Focus, the passive detection range of Magical Cognizance extends as far as you can see.
Active Search checks made through Magical Cognizance still use its normal range unless another talent says otherwise.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_MAGICAL_COGNIZANCE:
##### Magical Cognizance - Awareness
Range: 10 feet
You may use the Search action to detect the presence and general location of an ongoing magical effect within range.
If the effect does not provide a DC, use the creator’s Cultivation Save DC or spell save DC. If no such DC exists, use DC 15.
A successful check reveals that a magical effect is active and its general location. It does not automatically identify the effect, its creator, its school, its sphere, its duration, or a method of ending it.
While you hold Martial Focus, calculate your Passive Cognizance as 10 + your highest bonus among Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Perception), and Wisdom (Survival). The GM may use that score to determine whether you notice an ongoing magical effect when you pass within range without actively searching.
Magical Cognizance is a magical cultivation effect.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_MODIFY_CHARACTERISTIC:
##### Modify Characteristics - Research, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Part-Breaker
Trigger: You score a Critical Hit against a creature Analyzed by you.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Duration: 1 hour
Choose one characteristic you previously learned about the target. Apply one eligible modification below.
A creature may suffer only one modification from your Modify Characteristics talent at a time. Applying a new modification ends your previous one on that creature.
| Known Characteristic | Modification |
| --- | --- |
| Armor Class | Reduce AC by 2. |
| One Speed | Reduce that Speed by 10 feet, minimum 0 feet. |
| One Ability Score | Reduce that score by 2, minimum 1. |
| One Saving Throw | Reduce that saving throw bonus by 2. |
| One Sense | Reduce that sense’s range by 10 feet, minimum 0 feet. |
| Maximum Hit Points | Reduce Hit Point maximum by 10, minimum 1. Current Hit Points cannot exceed the new maximum. |
| One Damage Resistance | Suppress that Resistance. |
| One Condition Immunity | The target loses that Immunity and instead has Advantage on saving throws against that condition, if a saving throw is involved. |
| One Damage Immunity | Replace that Immunity with Resistance. |
| One special resistance | Suppress that resistance, subject to GM approval. |
| Another characteristic | Modify it with GM approval. |
You may create a Damage Vulnerability only if you previously learned the target’s relevant Damage Resistances and Damage Immunities. Choose one damage type to which the target does not currently have Resistance or Immunity. The target gains Vulnerability to that damage type for the duration.
Modify Characteristics is a magical cultivation effect representing meridian disruption, anatomical sabotage, spiritual diagnosis, or a precisely exploited flaw.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_NOTICE_PROFILING:
##### Notice Profiling - Awareness
Range: 120 feet
While you hold Martial Focus, you know whenever a creature within range uses Analyze or another feature that explicitly learns one of your Analyzable Characteristics.
When this occurs, you may expend Martial Focus to learn:
which of your characteristics the creature learned during the current round; and
which creatures within range learned those characteristics.
Notice Profiling does not detect ordinary observation, guessing, or knowledge a creature possessed before entering range.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_NO_FOOTSTEP_ESCAPES_T:
##### No Footstep Escapes the World - Awareness, Research, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Worthy Opponent
You always know the direction of your rival while you and your rival are on the same plane of existence.
If your rival is within 1 mile, you also know its approximate distance from you.
If your rival is protected by a higher-Realm concealment effect, a Secret Inheritance, a Realm-defining Formation, or an artifact, resolve the conflict using the campaign’s normal cultivation-scale adjudication.
No Footstep Escapes the World is a magical cultivation effect. It does not reveal a path through an impassable barrier, permit teleportation, or grant sight of the rival.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_PART_BREAKER:
##### Part-Breaker - Approach
Trigger: You make a weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against a creature.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Declare Part-Breaker before making the attack roll.
If the attack hits, resolve its normal damage and effects, then automatically Analyze the target without making an ability check. Learn one Analyzable Characteristic.
If the attack is a Critical Hit, learn two Analyzable Characteristics instead.
Part-Breaker counts as an Analyze attempt against that creature. If the creature is already Analyzed by you, Part-Breaker still teaches you the listed number of additional characteristics.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_PERSISTENT_ANALYSIS:
##### Persistent Analysis
You may attempt to Analyze each individual target a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_PHYSICAL_EXAMINATION:
##### Physical Examination - Approach, Research
You may use Wisdom (Medicine) when attempting to Analyze a creature.
In addition, you always know the general physical condition of a creature Analyzed by you, as shown below.
| Condition | General Health |
| --- | --- |
| Normal | At least 90 percent of its Hit Point maximum remains. |
| Fair | At least 30 percent but less than 90 percent of its Hit Point maximum remains. |
| Poor | More than 0 but less than 30 percent of its Hit Point maximum remains, or it suffers a major visible injury. |
| Weak | It has 0 Hit Points or suffers an immediately life-threatening condition. |
This does not reveal the target’s exact current Hit Points unless another rule does so.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_PIERCING_SENSES:
##### Piercing Senses - Awareness
Range: 30 feet
When you make an attack roll against a target within range, you do not have Disadvantage on that attack roll solely because:
the target has the Invisible condition;
the target is in a Heavily Obscured area; or
you have the Blinded condition.
You still need to know or correctly guess the target’s location. Piercing Senses does not grant sight, reveal the target’s space, ignore Total Cover, or remove Disadvantage from another source.
If a spell or effect creates multiple illusory duplicates and randomly determines whether your attack targets a duplicate, roll twice when resolving that random determination and use the result you prefer.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_PROGNOSIS:
##### Prognosis - Research
The first time during each turn that your weapon attack damages a creature Analyzed by you, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No effect.
In addition, when a creature Analyzed by you regains Hit Points from a discrete healing effect, it regains additional Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you created that healing effect, the creature also has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.
A creature gains the additional healing from Prognosis only once per turn. Prognosis does not increase regeneration or another effect that restores Hit Points automatically over time.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_RAPID_ANALYSIS:
##### Rapid Analysis
Analyze requires 1 minute instead of 10 minutes.
You may expend Martial Focus to Analyze as a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
In addition, when you roll Initiative, you may immediately attempt to Analyze one creature you can see within Analyze range without spending an Action or expending Martial Focus.
The attempt still counts against your normal limit for that individual target.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_REFLEXIVE_STEALTH:
##### Reflexive Stealth
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against an effect that targets an area.
Immediately attempt to Hide.
For this attempt only, you may take the Hide action even if you do not currently meet its normal cover or obscurement requirements. Describe how smoke, debris, movement, foliage, darkness, collapsing terrain, or another feature of the effect briefly conceals you.
If you do not satisfy the normal Hide requirements by the end of your next turn, the hidden state ends at that time.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SABOTAGE_MOBILITY:
##### Sabotage Mobility - Research
The first time during each round that your weapon attack damages a creature Analyzed by you, that creature must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: Each of the target’s Speeds is reduced by a number of feet equal to 5 times your Path key ability modifier, minimum 5 feet, until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No effect.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SENSE_AND_RESIST_SCRY:
##### Sense and Resist Scrying - Awareness
Range: 30 feet
You may use the Search action to detect a magical sensor within range as though it were an Invisible creature. Use the creator’s spell save DC or Cultivation Save DC as the DC of the Wisdom (Perception) check.
While you hold Martial Focus, you immediately become aware when a magical effect attempts to observe, hear, sense, or scry you remotely.
If the source or sensor is within range, you also learn its location.
When you become aware of such an effect, you may contest the surveillance. Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check. The effect’s creator makes an ability check using its spellcasting ability or sphere key ability. If your check equals or exceeds the creator’s check, the effect cannot obtain information about you or creatures and spaces within this talent’s range for the remainder of its current duration.
Sense and Resist Scrying is a magical cultivation effect.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SEVER_THE_ESCAPE_ROUT:
##### Sever the Escape Route - Research, Realm Evolution
Trigger: A creature Analyzed by you that you can see begins moving.
Action Type: Reaction
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Choose one of the creature’s Speeds that you previously learned through Analyze.
Until the end of the current turn, the creature cannot use that Speed. If it has no remaining legal Speed, its movement ends.
Sever the Escape Route does not interrupt teleportation unless another rule explicitly says so.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SHIFTY_POISONER:
##### Shifty Poisoner - Stalker
Range: 120 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
When you make an attack against a creature within range while hidden from that creature, it has Disadvantage on saving throws against diseases and poisons you subject it to until the talent ends.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SIGHT_BEYOND_SIGHT:
##### Sight Beyond Sight - Awareness
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Gain Tremorsense within the listed range until the talent ends.
You may expend Martial Focus when activating this talent to gain Blindsight within the listed range instead.
| Cultivation Level | Range |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 10 feet |
| CL 5-9 | 20 feet |
| CL 10-14 | 30 feet |
| CL 15+ | 40 feet |
Tremorsense pinpoints eligible creatures and moving objects but does not count as sight. Blindsight counts as sight within its range.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SKILL_AFFINITY_STEALT:
##### Skill Affinity: Stealth
Gain proficiency in Dexterity (Stealth).
If you already have proficiency in Stealth when you learn this sphere, learn one Mortal-Realm Hidden Eye talent of your choice instead.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SOCIAL_ENGINEERING:
##### Social Engineering - Approach
You may use Charisma (Deception), Charisma (Intimidation), or Charisma (Persuasion) when attempting to Analyze a creature.
To use this Approach, the target must be able to perceive and meaningfully react to your words, body language, threat, bargaining position, or social pressure.
A target does not need to understand your language if the GM decides that its reactions remain readable.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SOMNAMBULANCE:
##### Somnambulance - Awareness
Natural sleep does not cause you to lose Martial Focus.
While you are sleeping naturally as part of a Long Rest, you do not automatically fail Wisdom (Perception) checks solely because you have the Unconscious condition. Your Passive Perception also continues to function.
Somnambulance does not remove the other effects of the Unconscious condition. You remain Incapacitated, Prone, unable to move, vulnerable to attacks, and unaware of your surroundings except to the limited extent represented by Perception checks.
See Walking-Dream Sentinel for the Foundation-Realm evolution.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SPIRIT_TRACE_PURSUIT:
##### Spirit-Trace Pursuit - Awareness, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Empirical Tracker or Magical Cognizance
You may use Empirical Tracker on a spiritual trace, cultivation residue, lingering emotional imprint, blood scent, shed qi, or magical residue left by a creature.
Unless the GM decides that the trace is unusually strong, it must be no more than 24 hours old.
When you successfully Analyze a creature through Spirit-Trace Pursuit, you also learn the direction in which the trace continued when it left the scene.
Spirit-Trace Pursuit does not reveal the creature’s exact location and does not create a permanent tracking mark.
Spirit-Trace Pursuit is a magical cultivation effect.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_SUDDEN_ACUITY:
##### Sudden Acuity - Awareness
You may take the Search action as a Bonus Action.
