TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_THOROUGH_ANALYSIS:
##### Thorough Analysis
When you successfully Analyze a creature, learn an additional number of Analyzable Characteristics equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_THOUSAND_LANTERN_SWEE:
##### Thousand-Lantern Sweep - Awareness, Realm Evolution
Action Type: Action
Area: 120-foot Emanation originating from you
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Take the Search action once. Compare the result against each concealed creature, hidden object, ordinary trap, magical sensor, and ongoing magical effect in the Emanation that your available senses and talents could detect.
Thousand-Lantern Sweep does not see through Total Cover or automatically reveal the exact nature of a detected effect.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_TRUE_SIGHT:
##### True Sight - Awareness, Realm Evolution
Prerequisites: Discern Illusions and Piercing Senses
Range: 120 feet
While you hold Martial Focus, gain Truesight within range.
True Sight does not penetrate solid objects, grant X-ray vision, reveal creatures hidden behind Total Cover, or automatically expose a mundane disguise that remains convincing for reasons unrelated to vision.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_UNCANNY_STALKER:
##### Uncanny Stalker - Stalker
While hidden, reduce the time required to Analyze a creature by one step.
| Normal Analyze Time | Analyze Time with Uncanny Stalker |
| --- | --- |
| 10 minutes | 1 minute |
| 1 minute | 1 Action |
| 1 Action | 1 Bonus Action |
| 1 Bonus Action | 1 Reaction |
When Analyze is reduced to a Reaction, use that Reaction immediately before you make an attack against the target or immediately when the target enters your Analyze range.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_VANISH_BETWEEN_HEARTB:
##### Vanish Between Heartbeats - Stalker, Realm Evolution
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature misses you with an attack roll, or you succeed on a Dexterity saving throw.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus.
Move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then attempt to Hide.
For this Hide attempt, you may Hide while Lightly Obscured or while within 5 feet of a creature, object, or environmental feature at least one size smaller than you that could momentarily break line of sight.
If you do not satisfy the normal Hide requirements by the end of your next turn, the hidden state ends at that time.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_WIND_READER:
##### Wind Reader - Awareness
While you hold Martial Focus, weather such as wind or rain does not impose Disadvantage on your ranged weapon attacks.
Wind Reader does not remove Disadvantage caused by long range, an Invisible target, a hostile creature within 5 feet, or another source.
TAL_THE_HIDDEN_EYE_WORTHY_OPPONENT:
##### Worthy Opponent
When you successfully Analyze a creature, you may designate it as your rival.
Your rival remains Analyzed by you until you choose another rival, even if you finish a Long Rest or more than 24 hours pass.
You may have only one rival at a time. When you choose a new rival, the previous rival stops being Analyzed by you unless another rule preserves that analysis.
You may choose a new rival only after you finish a Long Rest or after your current rival is reduced to 0 Hit Points.
TAL_THREAD_BINDING_SLEEVE_METHOD:
#### Binding Sleeve Method
Talent Type: Control.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Effect: When you hit with Binding Knot, you may choose to bind a limb, sleeve, weapon hand, wing, tail, or similar appendage instead of imposing the Grappled condition. Until the target escapes, one chosen mode is impaired.
Weapon Hand: Disadvantage on attacks using that hand or manipulator.
Footwork: Speed reduced by 15 feet.
Wing: Flying speed reduced by 20 feet. If reduced to 0 and the creature lacks Hover, it falls.
Tail or Balance: Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
The target may escape as normal for Binding Knot.
TAL_THREAD_BORROW_THE_ALLY_S_ARM:
#### Borrow the Ally’s Arm
Talent Type: Support.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A willing ally connected to one of your Thread Lines misses with a melee attack or fails a Strength or Dexterity ability check.
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: You pull, guide, brace, or correct the ally’s motion. The ally may add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. This can turn a failure into a success.
Limits: The ally must be willing and physically capable of the action. This is guidance, not possession.
TAL_THREAD_MERIDIAN_SNARE:
#### Meridian Snare
Talent Type: Control.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or replace one attack
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_MERIDIAN_SNARE->action, ATTACK_REPLACEMENT_MERIDIAN_SNARE->action
Range: Qi Thread range.
Cost: 2 CP.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack. On a hit, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, choose one meridian snare until the end of your next turn.
Arm Line: The target has disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with one arm, weapon, or manipulator.
Leg Line: The target’s speed is reduced by 15 feet.
Breath Line: The target cannot benefit from Advantage on Constitution saving throws.
Focus Line: The target has disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw or similar cultivation-maintenance check it makes.
Repeat Use: A creature affected by Meridian Snare has advantage on saves against your Meridian Snare until the end of your next turn.
TAL_THREAD_MERIDIAN_STITCH:
#### Meridian Stitch
Talent Type: Healing and Control.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch, or 30 feet through an active Qi Thread.
Cost: 2 CP.
Effect: You stitch a damaged meridian, pressure channel, breath path, or spiritual circulation point. Choose one effect on a willing creature.
End one effect causing the creature to be Poisoned if the poison is physical, qi-borne, or meridian-disruptive.
End one effect reducing the creature’s speed if it comes from a wound, tendon injury, pressure disruption, or meridian constriction.
Allow the creature to immediately stand from Prone without spending movement.
Restore CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus, but a creature can benefit from this CP restoration once per Long Rest.
Hostile Use: You may instead target an unwilling creature with an active Thread Line. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it cannot regain hit points or CP until the start of your next turn. On a success, it is unaffected.
TAL_THREAD_NEEDLE_THREAD_PHYSICIAN:
#### Needle-Thread Physician
Talent Type: Healing.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Effect: Surgeon’s Stitch improves. When a creature spends a Hit Die through Surgeon’s Stitch, it adds your Proficiency Bonus to the healing. You may also remove one of the following from the target if the GM agrees it can be treated with needle, thread, pressure, or qi stitching.
Bleeding or open wound.
One mundane poison’s ongoing damage.
One nonmagical disease symptom for 1 hour.
One level of Exhaustion caused by bleeding, starvation, or physical overexertion, but the target cannot benefit from this Exhaustion reduction again until it finishes a Long Rest.
TAL_THREAD_REELING_SILK_BODY:
#### Reeling Silk Body
Talent Type: Martial.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Effect: You cultivate spiral tension through the body. Once per turn when you hit with Threaded Strike or Draw the Line, you may move either yourself or the target 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target. The movement must follow the line’s direction or a circular step around the connected creature.
Internal Tension: When you use Dodge, you may regain Martial Focus if you are maintaining at least one Thread Line.
TAL_THREAD_SILK_WEB_FIELD:
#### Silk Web Field
Talent Type: Loom.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 15-foot square or 10-foot radius.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 2 CP.
Effect: You create a field of thread lines, mundane rigging, qi silk, or both. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. The first time a hostile creature enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or have its speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
Success: On a successful save, the creature ignores the speed reduction but the area remains Difficult Terrain.
Cutting the Field: A creature may use an action to attack or tear open a 5-foot section. Use your Cultivation Save DC as the AC for the field section. Destroying a section creates a 5-foot safe gap.
TAL_THREAD_STITCH_THE_FALLING_BODY:
#### Stitch the Falling Body
Talent Type: Movement and Protection.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or a creature within Thread range falls, is pushed, is pulled, or is knocked Prone.
Cost: 1 CP or expend Martial Focus.
Effect: You attach a thread and catch the movement. Reduce falling damage by 5 times your CL, and you may move the target up to 10 feet to a safe surface or leave it hanging from a line. If the trigger would knock the target Prone, the target may make a Dexterity saving throw against the triggering effect’s DC or your Cultivation Save DC, whichever is higher, to remain standing.
TAL_THREAD_THE_SINGLE_THREAD_THROUGH_HEA:
#### The Single Thread Through Heaven
Talent Type: Secret Inheritance.
Prerequisite: CL 17+, GM approval, and a major Thread inheritance.
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet.
Duration: Instantaneous, then 1 minute.
Cost: 8 CP.
Effect: You perceive one line of connection running through the battlefield: weapon to hand, killer to victim, oath to speaker, spell to caster, wound to blade, door to key, anchor to gate, master to puppet, or life to body. Choose one connection you can perceive or reasonably name. The GM may require a Cultivation Check for hidden, divine, Fate-protected, or higher-Realm connections.
On a success, choose one miracle.
Sever: End or suppress the chosen connection for 1 minute.
Bind: Prevent the chosen connection from being broken for 1 minute.
Draw: Pull one endpoint up to 60 feet toward the other endpoint if movement is physically possible.
Stitch: Restore a broken immediate connection, such as a disarmed weapon to hand, a breached seal to its door, or a dying creature’s life to its body.
Reveal: Make the connection visible to all creatures for 1 minute.
Limits: This cannot casually rewrite Fate, destroy a divine oath, enslave a soul, sever a campaign-defining bond, or bypass an artifact-level protection. If used against something greater than the cultivator’s Realm, the effect may partially succeed, reveal the stronger power, or create a backlash.
Backlash: After using this Secret Inheritance, you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest. If the connection involved life, death, oath, or destiny, the GM may also impose a story cost.
TAL_THREAD_THREADED_WEAPON_ORBIT:
#### Threaded Weapon Orbit
Talent Type: Martial.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: 1 CP or expend Martial Focus.
Effect: One thread-eligible weapon you wield or have thrown remains connected by a Thread Line for 1 minute. While connected, you may make one attack with it on your turn as though it were in your hand, provided the target is within 15 feet of you or the weapon’s current space.
Limits: This is not autonomous. The weapon cannot act without your attack. It cannot pass through walls or ignore cover unless another talent allows it.
TAL_THREAD_THREAD_THROUGH_THE_CROWD:
#### Thread Through the Crowd
Talent Type: Mobility.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: Until the end of your turn, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures connected to your Thread Lines. You may also pass through the spaces of such creatures as Difficult Terrain.
Extra: If at least two creatures are connected by your Thread Lines, you may move in a line or arc between them, up to 20 feet total, as though pulled by a wire.
TAL_TRAP_AERIAL_RIGGING:
### Aerial Rigging — Trigger Talent, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your traps may threaten flying creatures above their occupied spaces.
Aerial trigger height:
CL 5–9: 10 feet
CL 10–14: 20 feet
CL 15+: 30 feet
A trap can threaten aerial spaces only when its wires, hooks, launched net, overhead anchors, suspended mechanism, or terrain make that threat physically plausible.
When an aerial trap causes a flying creature to gain the Prone condition or reduces its Fly Speed to 0, that creature falls unless it can Hover.
When Net or Noose affects a hovering creature, pull that creature harmlessly into one of the trap’s spaces before applying the remaining effect.
TAL_TRAP_AIMED_SHOT:
### Aimed Shot — Dart Talent
When you set Dart Mechanism, choose to target the creature that triggers the trap instead of firing along a fixed line.
Increase the Dart damage die from d6 to d8.
If you know a compatible Sniper talent, the GM may allow you to apply one compatible Sniper talent chosen when setting the trap.
TAL_TRAP_ALARM_TRAP:
### Alarm Trap — Snare Talent
Create a bell, clacker, whistle, snapped line, or comparable alarm.
When triggered, the trap produces a loud noise audible within 300 feet.
In a particularly quiet environment, the GM may increase this range.
Alarm Trap does not harm the triggering creature.
TAL_TRAP_BLUNT_DART:
### Blunt Dart — Dart Talent
Your Dart Mechanism deals Bludgeoning damage and increases its damage die from d6 to d10.
When this trap reduces a conscious and stable creature to 0 HP, you may choose for that creature to become Unconscious and stable rather than dying.
TAL_TRAP_CHAINED_MECHANISM:
### Chained Mechanism — Trigger Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When one of your traps triggers, choose one other trap you set within 30 feet.
If the second trap has a legal target or area, it triggers immediately after the first trap resolves.
A trap may trigger only once per turn through Chained Mechanism.
TAL_TRAP_DEADLY_DART:
### Deadly Dart — Dart Talent
Your Dart Mechanism deals Piercing or Slashing damage, chosen when the trap is set, and increases its damage die from d6 to d10.
TAL_TRAP_FALLING_SKY_MECHANISM:
### Falling-Sky Mechanism — Dart Talent, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Aerial Rigging, CL 10+
When you set Dart Mechanism, orient it upward, downward, or diagonally through aerial spaces.
If the dart hits a flying creature, that creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Fly Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
A creature that cannot Hover falls normally.
TAL_TRAP_FALSE_TRIGGER:
### False Trigger — Trigger Talent
Create a delayed trigger.
The first time the trap would trigger, it instead produces an audible and obvious warning such as a click, snap, or sudden shift.
The trap does not activate at that time.
The next time it triggers before expiring:
Dart Mechanism has Advantage on its attack roll;
creatures have Disadvantage on saving throws caused by the trap.
TAL_TRAP_FLASH_TRAP:
### Flash Trap — Snare Talent
Create a burst of powder, sparks, mirrored fragments, or another physically plausible blinding mechanism.
When triggered, each creature within 5 feet of one of the trap’s spaces makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature has the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.
Flash Trap is not magical unless a separate effect makes it magical.
TAL_TRAP_HEAVEN_NET_BATTLEFIELD:
### Heaven-Net Battlefield — Snare Talent, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Aerial Rigging, CL 15+
When you set Net or Terrain Trap, create a physically anchored lattice extending upward through the full height of Aerial Rigging.
The trap affects legal aerial spaces throughout that height.
A creature with a Fly Speed treats those spaces as Difficult Terrain while the lattice remains.
A creature restrained by Heaven-Net Battlefield is pulled to the nearest legal anchored space rather than automatically falling.
TAL_TRAP_INTERLOCKING_LATTICE:
### Interlocking Lattice — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Increase your active temporary-trap limit by your Proficiency Bonus.
When one of your traps is disarmed or destroyed, one other trap you set within 10 feet may remain concealed from the creature responsible until that creature takes the Search Action or triggers it.
TAL_TRAP_LAYERED_MECHANISM:
### Layered Mechanism — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When setting a trap, expend Martial Focus to apply one additional compatible Dart, Snare, or Trigger talent to that trap.
You cannot apply the same talent twice unless it explicitly says otherwise.
The GM decides whether two physical mechanisms are compatible.
TAL_TRAP_NOOSE:
### Noose — Snare Talent
Create a tightening noose, cable loop, or constricting catch.
When a creature triggers the snare, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature has the Restrained condition. While Restrained by this noose, it also cannot speak, supply Verbal components, or breathe normally.
The creature may escape as described by Net.
A creature that does not breathe is still Restrained but ignores the breathing restriction.
TAL_TRAP_OPPORTUNIST:
### Opportunist — Unique Trap Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive triggers one of your traps within your weapon’s legal range
Make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against that creature.
Opportunist is not an Opportunity Attack unless another rule explicitly says otherwise.
TAL_TRAP_PERSISTENT_TRAP:
### Persistent Trap — Deployment Talent
You may spend 10 minutes setting a trap instead of 1 minute.
A trap set this way lasts for 24 hours or until triggered.
TAL_TRAP_PREPARED_ESCAPE_ROUTE:
### Prepared Escape Route — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a trap you set triggers within 30 feet of you, use a Reaction to move up to half your Speed.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature.
TAL_TRAP_PURSUIT_LATTICE:
### Pursuit Lattice — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: Stop, Drop, and Control, CL 10+
When you use Stop, Drop, and Control, set up to two traps in different unoccupied spaces you move through during that turn.
Both traps count against your active trap limit.
TAL_TRAP_RAZOR_WIRE:
### Razor Wire — Snare Talent
When you set Tripwire, choose for it to deal Slashing damage to a creature that fails its saving throw.
Razor Wire damage:
CL 1–4: 1d6
CL 5–10: 2d6
CL 11–16: 3d6
CL 17–20: 4d6
TAL_TRAP_REMOTE_TRIGGER:
### Remote Trigger — Trigger Talent
While within 30 feet of one of your traps, use a Reaction to trigger it when one creature comes within 30 feet of the trap.
The trap must still have a legal target or area for its pattern.
Alternatively, when a creature makes a Dexterity saving throw against one of your traps within 30 feet, use a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on that saving throw.
TAL_TRAP_SNEAKY_TRAPPER:
### Sneaky Trapper — Deployment Talent
When you set a temporary trap while observed, make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by each observer’s Passive Perception.
On a success against an observer, that observer does not automatically notice you setting the trap.
Sneaky Trapper does not make a trap invisible. A creature may still notice the concealed trap normally.
TAL_TRAP_STOP_DROP_AND_CONTROL:
### Stop, Drop, and Control — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you take the Disengage Action, expend Martial Focus to set one trap in an unoccupied space you move through during that turn.
The trap lasts for 1 minute or until triggered.
This placement does not require an additional Action.
TAL_TRAP_TERRAIN_TRAP:
### Terrain Trap — Snare Talent
Create a scattered field of wire, hooks, caltrops, debris, or comparable hindering material.
When triggered, create a 10-foot-radius area of Difficult Terrain centered on one corner of one trap space chosen when you set the trap.
The Difficult Terrain lasts for 1 minute.
You may choose to trigger Terrain Trap immediately when you set it.
TAL_TRAP_THE_ROUTE_WAS_CHOSEN_ALREADY:
### The Route Was Chosen Already — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 17+
When Initiative is rolled, reveal up to your Proficiency Bonus concealed traps that you prepared during the previous hour.
Each revealed trap must occupy a legal space within 60 feet that you could physically have reached during your preparation.
A revealed trap counts against your active trap limit.
This talent does not conjure traps into impossible locations. It represents advance planning, cached mechanisms, disguised components, and preparation so subtle that the battlefield seemed empty until the first breath of violence.
Use this talent once per long rest.
TAL_TRAP_TRAPPED_SHIELD:
### Trapped Shield — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you expend Martial Focus to set Dart Mechanism as an Action, attach that mechanism to a shield you wield instead of placing it on a surface.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature misses you with a melee attack while you wield the shield
Trigger the Dart Mechanism against that attacker.
If you know a compatible Shield-sphere technique, a Forged Technique may allow the trap to trigger through an appropriate Deflect effect without requiring an additional Reaction.
TAL_TRAP_TRAPPER_S_RECOVERY:
### Trapper’s Recovery — Focus Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive fails a saving throw against one of your traps or takes damage from one of your traps
Regain Martial Focus.
TAL_TRAP_TRAP_LAUNCHER:
### Trap Launcher — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you expend Martial Focus to set a trap as an Action, use a Bonus Action to launch the trap kit onto one physically viable surface within the normal range of one ranged weapon you wield.
The projectile must have a legal route.
Trap Launcher does not allow a trap to pass through Total Cover or attach to an unsupported space.
TAL_TRAP_TRAP_WIELDER:
### Trap Wielder — Deployment Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you expend Martial Focus to set a trap as an Action, place it directly in the space of one creature within your reach.
The trap immediately triggers against that creature and then falls apart.
A Snare affecting multiple creatures in one space affects each of those creatures normally.
Trap Wielder does not leave an active trap behind.
TAL_TRAP_WARNING_TRIGGER:
### Warning Trigger — Trigger Talent
When you set a trap, designate any number of creatures you can see and warn.
A warned creature does not trigger that trap unless it chooses to.
A creature may be warned later if it can see and hear you and you can identify the relevant trap clearly.
TAL_UNMAKING_BITTER_RELEASE:
### Bitter Release — Overdraw
When you Overdraw, increase the added damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target is Bloodied, impaired, cracked, restrained, stunned, incapacitated, or unable to take Reactions, increase the added damage by twice your Proficiency Bonus instead.
TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_TRACE:
### Black Trace
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** One creature or object you can see
**Cost:** None
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
On hit, the target takes Ruin damage based on your Realm.
| Realm | Safe Black Trace Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 1d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Foundation | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Core Formation | 3d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Nascent Soul | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
On hit, choose one Trace effect:
**Fray.** The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
**Crack.** If the target is an object, construct, armor, shield, barrier, or temporary qi structure, it takes additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Sting.** The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
**Mark.** The next Unmaking talent that damages the target before the end of your next turn deals additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You may Overdraw when Black Trace hits.
#### Unbound Trace
Before making the Black Trace attack, you may make the Trace unstable.
On hit, the damage becomes the Unbound Trace value instead.
| Realm | Unbound Trace Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Foundation | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Core Formation | 6d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Nascent Soul | 8d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
After the attack resolves, whether it hits or misses, choose one:
- gain 1 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**;
- one suitable focus, needle, talisman, weapon, or External Channel gains 1 Crack.
You may Overdraw when Unbound Trace hits.
---
TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_VEIN_PALM:
### Black-Vein Palm — Black Vein
When you use Ruin Channel on an unarmed strike, fist, palm, claw, spear-hand, or other Internal Channel, increase the Ruin Channel bonus damage by 1d8.
If the attack hits a creature, choose one:
- the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn;
- the target has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn;
- the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
After resolving the attack, gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_VEIN_STEP:
### Black-Vein Step — Black Vein
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
When you Overdraw, you may move up to 10 feet after the triggering talent resolves. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures damaged by that talent.
If you end this movement adjacent to a creature damaged by the talent, you may gain 1 additional Black Vein Strain to make one unarmed strike against that creature.
TAL_UNMAKING_CRACK_THE_GUARD:
### Crack the Guard — Crack
When you hit a creature using a shield, armor, parrying weapon, warding bracer, or comparable defensive implement with a Ruin Channel attack, the target must succeed on a Strength or Constitution saving throw, target’s choice.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot add shield AC against your attacks, and the defensive implement gains 1 Crack if it is not an artifact.
Successful Save: The target keeps its defense, but the defensive implement gains 1 Crack if it is not an artifact.
TAL_UNMAKING_CRACK_THE_NAME_OF_THE_TOOL:
### Crack the Name of the Tool — Spirit
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Spirit Awakening Path or GM permission
When you damage a summoned creature, puppet, spirit projection, possession vessel, bound companion, or animated construct with an Unmaking talent, you may target the link holding it together.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws to maintain form, and checks to obey commands.
Successful Save: It has Disadvantage on the next such roll before the start of your next turn.
After using this talent, gain 1 Black Vein Strain or take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6.
---
TAL_UNMAKING_DEVOURING_DREGS:
### Devouring Dregs — Overdraw
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
When you Overdraw and the target is reduced to 0 HP, destroyed, or broken by the triggering damage, you may immediately remove 1 Black Vein Strain or remove 1 Crack from the Channel used.
If the destroyed target was a living creature, this creates a visible black-vein flare and may be considered taboo, forbidden, or corruptive by witnesses.
---
TAL_UNMAKING_DISSOLVE_THE_SEAM:
### Dissolve the Seam — Anti-Structure
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** Touch
**Target:** One object, door, lock, wall section, chain, shield, ward plate, armor plate, formation tile, or temporary barrier
**Cost:** 1 CP
Make an Unmaking Check against the object or effect’s DC.
If no DC is known, use:
- DC 13 for ordinary objects;
- DC 16 for reinforced objects;
- DC 19 for cultivation-grade barriers;
- DC 22+ for major sect or formation work.
Success: Deal 8d10 Ruin damage to the target object or structure. If this breaks or disables it, the broken section leaves no clean salvage.
Failure: Deal half damage, and your Channel gains 1 Crack or you gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
You may Overdraw to add 6d10 Ruin damage to the object or structure instead of the normal Overdraw damage.
TAL_UNMAKING_EXECUTION_THROUGH_THE_FAULT:
### Execution Through the Fault — Execution
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+
When you damage a Bloodied creature with an Unmaking talent, you may spend 2 CP and Overdraw.
Instead of the normal Overdraw bonus, add 10d8 Ruin damage to the target.
After resolving the damage, suffer Ruin Backlash.
If this reduces the target to 0 HP, you may remove 2 Black Vein Strain.
If it does not reduce the target to 0 HP, you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn.
TAL_UNMAKING_FIRST_RUIN_FORM_EXTERNAL_VE:
### First Ruin Form: External Vessel Mandate — Ruin Form, Channel
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Cost:** 1 CP
You bind Unmaking qi to an External Channel and force the weapon or implement to survive longer than it should.
Choose one held weapon or implement. For the duration:
- once per turn, when you hit with the chosen Channel, deal additional Ruin damage equal to 2d8;
- when the chosen Channel would gain Crack, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the Crack is delayed until the form ends;
- when the form ends, all delayed Crack applies at once.
If the Channel breaks when the form ends, you may immediately make one Black Trace attack against a creature within 30 feet as the weapon dies. This attack cannot Overdraw.
TAL_UNMAKING_FOURTH_RUIN_FORM_BLACK_VEIN:
### Fourth Ruin Form: Black-Vein Body — Ruin Form, Black Vein
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Second Ruin Form: Black Palm Vessel
**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Cost:** 2 CP
Your body becomes a dangerous vessel for Unmaking qi.
For the duration:
- you gain Resistance to Necrotic damage and Force damage;
- your melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes may deal Ruin damage;
- once per turn, when you hit with a melee attack, add 3d10 Ruin damage;
- creatures that hit you with melee attacks take Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
- you have Advantage on saving throws against being Grappled, Restrained, or Paralyzed.
At the end of each of your turns, gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
If you reach 6 Black Vein Strain during this form, suffer Ruin Backlash, but the added damage from this form becomes 4d10 until the form ends.
When the form ends, you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn.
TAL_UNMAKING_HOLLOWING_FIELD:
### Hollowing Field — Anti-Structure, Overdraw
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 90 feet
**Area:** 20-foot-radius sphere
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute
**Cost:** 2 CP
You create a field where cohesion thins.
When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: 5d8 Ruin damage, and the creature cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage.
Objects, barriers, temporary qi structures, and summoned constructs in the area have Vulnerability to Ruin damage from your Unmaking talents while inside the field.
At the end of each of your turns while maintaining Hollowing Field, choose one:
- take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6;
- gain 1 Black Vein Strain;
- one External Channel used to sustain the field gains 1 Crack.
If Concentration breaks because of damage, suffer Ruin Backlash.
TAL_UNMAKING_HOLLOW_THE_ARMOR:
### Hollow the Armor — Crack
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
When you hit a creature wearing armor or protected by a natural armored shell with Ruin Channel or Black Trace, you may spend 1 CP.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target takes a -2 penalty to AC against the next attack made against it.
Successful Save: The target takes a -1 penalty instead.
This does not stack with itself.
TAL_UNMAKING_LAST_INCH_CONTROL:
### Last Inch Control — Black Vein
When you would gain Black Vein Strain from an Unmaking talent, you may make a Constitution saving throw against your own Unmaking Save DC.
Success: Take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus instead of gaining the Strain.
Failure: Gain the Strain normally.
You may use this talent once per turn.
---
TAL_UNMAKING_LATTICE_UNRAVELING:
### Lattice Unraveling — Anti-Structure
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 90 feet
**Target:** One visible formation node, ward, talisman effect, barrier, summoned construct, or ongoing non-Secret technique-state
**Cost:** 2 CP
Make an Unmaking Check against the effect’s save DC or formation DC.
Success: Suppress the target effect until the start of your next turn. If the target is a creature or construct, it instead takes 8d10 Ruin damage and has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.
Success by 5 or more: The suppression lasts until the end of your next turn.
Failure: The effect is not suppressed, but it takes 4d10 Ruin damage if it has HP or structure. You gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
This cannot suppress Secret Inheritances, Realm Tribulations, divine domains, ancient city formations, or superior authority without an opposed check and GM permission.
TAL_UNMAKING_MERIDIAN_RUIN_SHOCK:
### Meridian Ruin Shock — Black Vein
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+, Black-Vein Palm or Ruin Needle
When you hit a creature with an Internal Channel or Ruin Needle, you may spend 1 CP.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot regain CP, has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration, and cannot take Reactions.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot take Reactions.
After resolving this talent, gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_BITTEN_EDGE:
### Ruin-Bitten Edge — Channel
When you use Ruin Channel on a melee weapon, the weapon’s next hit also reduces the target’s Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
If the weapon gains Crack after the attack, the target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet instead.
TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_CHANNEL:
### Ruin Channel
**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Range:** Self or touch
**Cost:** None
**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn
You run Unmaking qi through one Channel you are touching.
Choose one:
- a held weapon;
- an unarmed strike;
- one hand or limb;
- a talisman, needle, chain, or tool;
- another object the GM agrees can briefly hold Unmaking qi.
The next time before the duration ends that you hit with that Channel, deal additional Ruin damage based on your Realm.
| Realm | Ruin Channel Bonus Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 2d8 |
| Foundation | 3d8 |
| Core Formation | 5d8 |
| Nascent Soul | 7d8 |
After the attack resolves, choose one cost:
- the Channel gains 1 Crack if it is an External Channel;
- you gain 1 Black Vein Strain if it is an Internal Channel;
- you take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**, and the Channel does not gain Crack or Strain.
If the attack misses, the Channel remains active until the duration ends. If the duration ends without a hit, you take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Ruin Channel may be applied to a ranged weapon, thrown weapon, or ammunition only if you are touching it when you use the feature.
You may Overdraw when a Ruin Channel attack hits.
TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_NEEDLE:
### Ruin Needle — Channel
You may use needles, darts, hairpins, bone spikes, or similar Tiny piercing implements as External Channels for Ruin Channel.
When you hit with a Ruin Needle attack, choose one:
- the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn;
- the target cannot regain CP until the start of your next turn;
- the target has Disadvantage on the next check made to maintain a stance, form, or ongoing technique before the end of its next turn.
The needle gains 1 Crack and is usually destroyed after the attack.
TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_SHEATH_METHOD:
### Ruin Sheath Method — Channel
You learn how to keep a dangerous Channel quiet for a few breaths.
When you use Ruin Channel, its duration becomes until the end of your next turn.
If the Channel expires without hitting, you may choose for the Channel to gain 1 Crack or for you to gain 1 Black Vein Strain instead of taking self-damage.
TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_WAVE:
### Ruin Wave — Trace
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** Self
**Area:** 30-foot line, 5 feet wide
**Cost:** 1 CP
You release a narrow wave of Unmaking qi.
Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 6d8 Ruin damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no Reaction loss.
Objects, fragile barriers, and temporary qi structures in the line take the damage automatically.
After resolving the technique, choose one:
- gain 1 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6 + your Proficiency Bonus;
- one External Channel used to shape the wave gains 1 Crack.
You may Overdraw, adding the Overdraw damage to one creature or object that failed its save.
At CL 11, damage becomes 8d8. At CL 17, damage becomes 10d8.
TAL_UNMAKING_SECOND_RUIN_FORM_BLACK_PALM:
### Second Ruin Form: Black Palm Vessel — Ruin Form, Black Vein
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+, Black-Vein Palm
**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Cost:** 1 CP
You allow Unmaking qi to circulate through your hands and forearms.
For the duration:
- your unarmed strikes may deal Ruin damage instead of their normal damage type;
- once per turn, when you hit with an unarmed strike, add 2d10 Ruin damage;
- when you use Ruin Channel through an Internal Channel, add your Proficiency Bonus to the bonus Ruin damage;
- at the end of each of your turns in which you damaged a creature with this form, gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
If this would trigger Ruin Backlash, the form does not immediately end, but you cannot regain HP until the form ends.
TAL_UNMAKING_SEVER_THE_MOUNTAIN_S_MEMORY:
### Sever the Mountain’s Memory — Anti-Structure
**Prerequisite:** CL 15+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** Touch
**Target:** One structure, wall section, gate, large barrier, formation plate, bridge support, mountain seal, or comparable major object
**Cost:** 4 CP
Make an Unmaking Check against the target’s DC.
Success: The target takes 24d10 Ruin damage and loses one major structural function chosen by the GM: support, seal, hinge, warding surface, channel alignment, load-bearing integrity, concealment, or containment.
Success by 5 or more: The target also becomes unstable. The next significant impact, forced movement, tremor, siege attack, or damaging technique before the end of the scene deals maximum damage to it.
Failure: The target takes half damage, and you suffer Ruin Backlash.
This talent cannot casually collapse mountains, sect headquarters, city-scale formations, or divine architecture. It creates or exploits a fault; it does not overrule superior authority without a contest.
---
TAL_UNMAKING_SHRED_THE_TEMPORARY_SHAPE:
### Shred the Temporary Shape — Anti-Structure
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
When you damage a summoned creature, temporary construct, qi clone, puppet body, spirit projection, barrier, shield effect, or ongoing technique-state with an Unmaking talent, you may spend 1 CP.
The target or effect takes additional Ruin damage equal to 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
If this damage reduces it to 0 HP, ends it, or breaks it, you regain 1 CP.
You cannot regain more than 1 CP per turn this way.
TAL_UNMAKING_SIXTH_RUIN_FORM_STAR_SUNDER:
### Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut — Ruin Form, Execution
**Prerequisite:** CL 15+, Third Ruin Form: Severing Wave
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 300 feet
**Area:** 300-foot line, 10 feet wide
**Cost:** 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You release a single line of pure Unmaking.
Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 16d10 Ruin damage. The creature cannot regain HP or CP until the end of its next turn. If the creature is a summoned construct, puppet body, temporary clone, projected vessel, or non-true body, it takes an additional 8d10 Ruin damage.
Successful Save: Half damage. The creature cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Objects, barriers, doors, siege engines, temporary qi structures, and non-Secret constructs in the line take 24d10 Ruin damage automatically.
After resolving the cut, suffer all of the following:
- gain 3 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to 8d6 + your Cultivation Level;
- one External Channel used to shape the technique is destroyed unless it is an artifact;
- you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn.
This technique does not automatically defeat superior authority, divine bodies, Secret Inheritances, ancient formations, or higher-Realm domains. Against such targets, the GM may require an opposed Cultivation Check. On a failure, the target takes half damage after its saving throw result.
TAL_UNMAKING_SPLINTERING_TRACE:
### Splintering Trace — Trace
When Black Trace hits an object, construct, armor, shield, barrier, or temporary qi structure, add one extra d10 Ruin damage.
At CL 11, add two extra d10 instead.
You may Overdraw on this hit even if you have already used Overdraw this turn, but if you do, gain 2 Black Vein Strain instead of 1.
TAL_UNMAKING_THIRD_RUIN_FORM_SEVERING_WA:
### Third Ruin Form: Severing Wave — Ruin Form, Trace
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Ruin Wave
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** Self
**Area:** 60-foot line, 10 feet wide
**Cost:** 2 CP
You release a compressed blade of Unmaking qi.
Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 10d8 Ruin damage. The creature cannot regain HP or CP until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage. The creature cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Objects, barriers, constructs, and temporary qi structures in the line take 12d8 Ruin damage automatically.
After resolving the technique, choose one:
- gain 2 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to 4d6 + your Cultivation Level;
- one External Channel used to shape the wave gains 2 Crack.
You may Overdraw. If you do, add the Overdraw damage to every failed-save target instead of only one target, then suffer Ruin Backlash after the technique resolves.
TAL_UNMAKING_UNBODY_THE_FALSE_VESSEL:
### Unbody the False Vessel — Anti-Structure, Spirit
**Prerequisite:** CL 15+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 120 feet
**Target:** One summoned creature, puppet body, clone, projection, possession vessel, construct, or temporary body
**Cost:** 4 CP
The target makes a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw, whichever is better for it.
Failed Save: 14d10 Ruin damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the effect that created or sustained it ends immediately.
Successful Save: Half damage.
If the target is sustained by a visible caster, master, owner, or summoner within 120 feet, that creature also takes Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d10 on a failed save.
After using this talent, gain 2 Black Vein Strain or suffer Ruin self-damage equal to 5d6.
TAL_UNMAKING_UNBOUND_TRACE:
#### Unbound Trace
Before making the Black Trace attack, you may make the Trace unstable.
On hit, the damage becomes the Unbound Trace value instead.
| Realm | Unbound Trace Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Foundation | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Core Formation | 6d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Nascent Soul | 8d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
After the attack resolves, whether it hits or misses, choose one:
- gain 1 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**;
- one suitable focus, needle, talisman, weapon, or External Channel gains 1 Crack.
You may Overdraw when Unbound Trace hits.
---
TAL_UNMAKING_UNMAKE_THE_ANSWER:
### Unmake the Answer — Reaction, Anti-Structure
**Prerequisite:** CL 10+
**Action Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** A creature you can see within 60 feet creates a barrier, shield, temporary construct, talisman effect, summoned asset, or ongoing defensive technique
**Cost:** 2 CP
Make an Unmaking Check against the triggering effect’s save DC.
Success: The effect still appears, but it begins cracked. The first time it prevents damage, grants AC, absorbs damage, or blocks movement before the end of its creator’s next turn, reduce that protection by 5d10.
Success by 5 or more: Also deal 5d10 Ruin damage to the effect or its creator, chosen by you if both are legal targets.
Failure: You take Ruin self-damage equal to 3d10 and gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
TAL_UNMAKING_WEAPON_PAYS_FIRST:
### Weapon Pays First — Channel
When an External Channel would gain Crack from one of your Unmaking talents, you may choose to take Ruin self-damage equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus instead.
If you do, the item does not gain that Crack.
You may use this talent once per turn.
TAL_UNMAKING_WOUND_THAT_REFUSES:
### Wound That Refuses — Execution
When you damage a creature with Ruin Channel or Black Trace, the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
If the target already had this healing denial from one of your Unmaking talents, it instead cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn.
This does not prevent resurrection, regeneration, or Secret-grade healing unless a higher-Realm talent says so.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_BARK_BACK_GUARD:
### Bark-Back Guard - Canopy, Graft
When you create a Living Claim on your body, armor, held shield, or held wooden object, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
While you have those Temporary HP, the first creature that hits you with a melee attack takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Use Bark-Back Guard once per round.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_BRAMBLE_REFUSAL:
### Bramble Refusal - Thorn, Root
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a creature with one of your Growth Marks makes a melee attack against you or an ally adjacent to one of your Living Claims, spend 1 Growth Mark.
The creature takes 1d8 Piercing damage and makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It has Disadvantage on the triggering attack.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_CANOPY_OF_TEN_THOUSAN:
### Canopy of Ten Thousand Leaves - Canopy
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius Emanation from a Living Claim
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
A canopy of leaves, branches, reeds, or spirit-boughs spreads from the claim.
Choose any number of creatures when you create the canopy.
Chosen creatures gain Half Cover while inside.
Other creatures treat the area as Lightly Obscured.
Ranged attacks passing through at least 10 feet of the canopy have Disadvantage unless the attacker is inside the canopy and attacking a target inside the canopy.
Fire damage that affects the canopy deals damage to the Living Claim normally and may destroy sections at the GM’s discretion.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_CULTIVATED_OVERGROWTH:
### Cultivated Overgrowth - Projected, Root
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot square touching a legal Living Medium
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
The area fills with roots, vines, grass, reeds, fungus, moss, or low branches.
The area is difficult terrain for enemies of your choice.
The first time an enemy enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, place 1 Growth Mark on it.
A creature may use its Action to clear one 5-foot square.
If no Living Medium exists in the area before casting, this talent is Projected.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_DEEP_ROOT_HOLDS_THE_G:
### Deep Root Holds the Gate - Root
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a creature with at least 2 of your Growth Marks attempts to leave a space adjacent to one of your Living Claims, spend 2 Growth Marks.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature is Restrained until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature is Grappled until the end of the current turn.
The restrained creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_FARMER_S_PATIENT_HAND:
### Farmer’s Patient Hand
Gain proficiency in Wisdom (Survival), Intelligence (Nature), Wisdom (Medicine), or an appropriate tool such as herbalism kit, woodcarver’s tools, carpenter’s tools, or farming implements.
If you already have proficiency in the chosen option, gain Expertise instead.
Outside combat, you can identify ordinary crops, poisonous plants, medicinal herbs, plant diseases, soil exhaustion, grafting signs, and cultivation-assisted growth with a successful Study action.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_FEED_THE_ROOT:
### Feed the Root
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You place a Growth Mark on a creature, object, or space touching one of your Living Claims
Use Limit: Once per turn
Choose one of your Living Claims within 60 feet.
It gains one Root Feed until the end of your next turn.
A Living Claim can hold Root Feed up to your Proficiency Bonus.
When you use a Verdant Response from or through that Living Claim, you may spend 1 Root Feed as if it were 1 Growth Mark on the affected creature, space, or object.
Root Feed represents the growth itself being fed by pressure, blood, breath, water, motion, or attention.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_FOREST_REMEMBERS_THE_:
### Forest Remembers the Path - Root, Vine
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a creature with one of your Growth Marks teleports, flies, jumps, or moves through a space within 60 feet, spend 1 Growth Mark.
Choose one space the creature left or entered.
Create a Living Claim there if the space can support it.
If the movement was teleportation, the Living Claim forms at the departure or arrival point after the movement resolves. This does not prevent the teleportation.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_FOREST_WITHOUT_CENTER:
### Forest Without Center
Prerequisite: Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch, CL 15+
When your Grove Domain is active, choose up to three Living Claims inside it.
Each chosen claim becomes a Grove Node.
Once on each of your turns, originate a Verdant Growth talent or Verdant Response from one Grove Node instead of yourself.
A Body Refiner may use this only while the Grove Node remains connected to the Body Refiner by contiguous plant growth, touched ground, roots, wooden surfaces, or an active Domain line.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_GRAFT_THE_WOUND_SHUT:
### Graft the Wound Shut - Bloom, Graft
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Cost: 1 CP
Touch one willing creature or yourself.
The target spends one Hit Die and regains HP equal to the roll plus your key ability modifier.
If the target is touching one of your Living Claims or a carried Living Medium, add your Proficiency Bonus to the HP regained.
This is plant-assisted stabilization and medicinal growth. It does not regrow limbs, cure disease, remove curses, or restore a creature to life.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_GREEN_LADDER:
### Green Ladder - Vine
When you use the Climb Verdant Response, the chosen creature also gains Advantage on the first Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check it makes to climb, balance, or move along the created growth before the end of your next turn.
At CL 5+, the creature may move 5 feet as part of the response.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_GROVE_DOMAIN_COURT_OF:
### Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch - Realm Evolution
“Within the grove, every path is a promise made to the roots.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
A temporary cultivation grove grows through legal Living Mediums in the area. If the area contains no legal medium, the Domain begins from your body, carried seeds, or touched ground and spreads as far as the GM agrees the scene can support.
For the duration:
create one Living Claim at the start of each of your turns without using a Bonus Action;
enemies treat spaces containing your Living Claims as difficult terrain;
when an enemy starts its turn in a Living Claim, place 1 Growth Mark on it;
allies in a Living Claim gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns;
once per round, use one Verdant Response without spending a Growth Mark.
The Domain does not create permanent plants, food, lumber, medicine, or safe architecture.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_HUNGRY_ROOT_DRINKS_TH:
### Hungry Root Drinks the Spill - Root, Bloom
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a creature within 60 feet regains HP while touching one of your Living Claims, you may place 1 Growth Mark on that creature or on the Living Claim.
If the creature is unwilling, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Successful Save: No mark is placed.
This talent does not reduce the healing.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_MEDICINAL_SPROUT:
### Medicinal Sprout - Bloom
When you use Shelter on an ally, choose to grow cooling leaves, clotting fiber, bitter herbs, or calming flowers.
The ally gains Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn against Poisoned, disease, exhaustion from environmental exposure, or ongoing poison damage.
Medicinal Sprout does not remove a condition by itself.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_REED_SCREEN:
### Reed Screen - Canopy
When you use Shelter to make a space Lightly Obscured, choose to make the screen thicker.
The space remains Lightly Obscured for 1 minute or until your Living Claim is destroyed.
A creature can clear one 5-foot square of Reed Screen by using the Utilize action or by dealing at least 5 Slashing, Fire, or Acid damage to the growth.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_ROOT_SNARE_STEP:
### Root-Snare Step - Root
When a creature with one of your Growth Marks willingly moves 10 feet or more on its turn, spend 1 Growth Mark.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its movement ends after the current 5-foot step.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the turn.
Root-Snare Step does not stop teleportation.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SEED_POUCH_METHOD:
### Seed Pouch Method - Graft
You carry cultivated seeds, knots, cuttings, bark slips, dried moss, and herb strings prepared for Verdant Growth.
You always count as carrying a legal Living Medium for non-Projected Verdant Growth talents unless you are deprived of your equipment.
In addition, you can use Sow Living Claim on your own space even on sterile ground.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SEED_SCRIPT_MARKER:
### Seed-Script Marker - Bloom
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may create small seed-script marks on plants, bark, paper, wooden objects, soil, or carried seeds.
A seed-script mark may store a simple message of up to 25 words, a scent trail, or a harmless visual sign visible only to creatures you designate.
The mark lasts 24 hours, or 7 days if placed during downtime with proper tools and no combat pressure.
This does not create a magical trap by itself.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SEED_THORN_STRIKE:
### Seed-Thorn Strike
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet or weapon reach
Cost: 0 CP
Make a ranged or melee Cultivation Attack against one creature.
On a hit, deal:
1d6 + your Path key ability modifier Piercing damage
and place 1 Growth Mark on the target.
The damage increases at higher level:
| CL | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 1d6 |
| 5-10 | 2d6 |
| 11-16 | 3d6 |
| 17+ | 4d6 |
If you use Seed-Thorn Strike through a wooden weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, thorn graft, or held plant medium, use the weapon’s normal reach or range. This version is not Projected.
If you use Seed-Thorn Strike at range without a thrown/shot object or existing Living Medium, it is Projected.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SHELTER_GROVE_POSTURE:
### Shelter-Grove Posture - Canopy
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Shelter on an ally, choose two Shelter options instead of one.
If one option grants Half Cover, that cover applies only to one attack or one Dexterity saving throw before the start of your next turn.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SOFT_STEP_UNDER_LEAVE:
### Soft Step Under Leaves - Canopy
While you are within 5 feet of one of your Living Claims, you may take the Hide action even if only Lightly Obscured by your own Verdant Growth.
You must still meet the other requirements of the Hide action, and a creature that can clearly see your space may still find you normally.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SOW_LIVING_CLAIM:
### Sow Living Claim
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Touch or 30 feet, depending on Path and medium
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP
Create one Living Claim in a legal Living Medium.
If you are a Body Refining cultivator, the Living Claim must begin on your body, armor, worn item, held wooden object, carried seeds or herbs, a creature or object you touch, or a surface within your reach unless you have explicit projection permission.
If you are a Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening cultivator, create the Living Claim in a legal Living Medium within 30 feet.
You may have a number of Living Claims active equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you create a Living Claim beyond this number, choose one old Living Claim to wither.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_SPRING_AFTER_CALAMITY:
### Spring After Calamity
Prerequisite: Orchard of Bitter Medicine, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 30-foot radius centered on a Living Claim
Cost: 6 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
A burst of spring growth restores breath and direction.
Choose up to six creatures in the area.
Each chosen creature gains one of the following benefits:
spend up to two Hit Dice and regain HP normally;
end the Poisoned condition;
stand from Prone without spending movement;
move up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks from creatures with your Growth Marks;
gain Temporary HP equal to 2 x your CL.
This feature does not restore dead creatures, regrow limbs, remove curses, cure all disease, or replace Life sphere healing.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_STAFF_BECOMES_BRANCH:
### Staff Becomes Branch - Graft
A staff, club, spear haft, wooden shield, bow, instrument, paper fan, brush, or similar plant-derived object you hold can serve as a Living Medium.
Once per turn when you hit with a weapon made mostly of wood, place 1 Growth Mark on the target.
This does not change the weapon’s damage type unless another feature says otherwise.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_THORNED_WARNING:
### Thorned Warning - Thorn
When a creature damages or destroys one of your Living Claims, place 1 Growth Mark on that creature if it is within 60 feet and you can perceive it.
If you spend that Growth Mark with Thorn before the end of your next turn, add your key ability modifier to the damage.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_THORN_CROWN_REVERSAL:
### Thorn Crown Reversal - Thorn
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a marked enemy deals damage to one of your allies within 60 feet and either the enemy or ally is touching one of your Living Claims, spend up to 3 Growth Marks from the enemy.
For each mark spent:
reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus;
the enemy takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_THOUSAND_ROOT_PRISON:
### Thousand-Root Prison
Prerequisite: Deep Root Holds the Gate, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: One creature with at least 3 of your Growth Marks
Cost: 5 CP
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained for 1 minute by roots, vines, bark hoops, reeds, or living grafts.
Successful Save: The target is Grappled until the end of your next turn.
A restrained target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
If the target teleports, the roots tear away and the effect ends, but the target takes 4d10 Piercing damage.
Thousand-Root Prison does not prevent teleportation unless another feature says otherwise.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_VERDANT_CRAFTING_POST:
### Verdant Crafting Posture
Prerequisite: CL 10+
During downtime, use Verdant Growth to assist agriculture, grafting, medicine preparation, orchard design, living architecture, paper cultivation, woodcraft, or herbal work.
This does not replace tool checks.
When you use an appropriate tool proficiency or skill for such work, add your Proficiency Bonus again if you are already proficient, or gain proficiency for that check if you are not.
Long-term benefits require downtime, materials, land, caretakers, and GM approval.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_VINE_BRIDGE:
### Vine Bridge - Vine
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Create a temporary vine, root, branch, or reed bridge up to 30 feet long and 5 feet wide between two legal anchor points.
The bridge lasts for 1 minute.
It can support creatures and objects up to a total weight appropriate for a normal wooden bridge of its size, as determined by the GM.
A creature may destroy a 5-foot section of the bridge. Each section has AC 12 and HP equal to 10 + your CL.
If you create this bridge without an existing Living Medium at both anchor points, it is Projected.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_WILD_TRELLIS_STEP:
### Wild Trellis Step - Vine
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you move while touching a Living Claim, plant, wooden object, soil, or your own grafted growth, you may move across vertical surfaces and uneven plant growth during the current turn without falling during the movement.
If you end the turn without a surface that could support you, you fall normally.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_WILLOW_BEND_DEFENSE:
### Willow-Bend Defense - Graft
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you are pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or moved against your will while touching a Living Medium, reduce the forced movement by 10 feet.
If this reduces the movement to 0, place 1 Growth Mark on the creature or effect’s origin if you can perceive it and it is within 60 feet.
TAL_VERDANT_GROWTH_WOOD_DRAGON_CLIMBS_TH:
### Wood Dragon Climbs the Sky
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Vine Bridge or Wild Trellis Step
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 120 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
A massive vine, root, branch, bamboo column, or spirit tree-line climbs through legal anchor points.
Create a connected path up to 120 feet long and 10 feet wide.
The path may rise vertically, curve around obstacles, and cross gaps if both ends are anchored in legal medium or a Grove Node.
Allies treat the path as normal terrain.
Enemies treat it as difficult terrain.
The first time an enemy enters the path on a turn or starts its turn there, place 1 Growth Mark on it.
A 10-foot section has AC 14 and HP equal to 20 + your CL.
If created without legal anchors or Grove Nodes, this talent is Projected.
TAL_VOID_ABSOLUTE_QUIET_GAP:
### Absolute Quiet Gap - Quiet, Gap
Prerequisite: Quiet Gap, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina
Create a court of almost-silence and dim absence.
Inside the area:
ordinary sound cannot be heard from more than 10 feet away;
Bright Light becomes Dim Light;
Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or sight have Disadvantage;
Verbal components fail unless the creature succeeds on a Constitution saving throw when beginning the casting or technique;
teleportation into or out of the area requires a successful Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Absolute Quiet Gap is not supernatural Darkness and does not create Total Cover.
TAL_VOID_BARRIER_EMPTYING_NEEDLE:
### Barrier-Emptying Needle - Null
Prerequisite: Void Needle, Unmake Barrier, CL 10+
When Void Needle damages a temporary Barrier, add one extra Void Needle damage die.
If this destroys the Barrier, choose one creature adjacent to the Barrier. That creature takes Force or Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_VOID_BARRIER_GNAW:
### Barrier Gnaw - Null
When Void Needle damages a temporary Barrier, object, summoned object, Force object, or Formation Anchor, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.
If you also choose Fray Barrier, apply both benefits.
TAL_VOID_CAUSE_EMPTYING_REVERSAL:
### Cause-Emptying Reversal
Prerequisite: Return to Zero, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 90 feet activates an ordinary temporary effect that would grant a benefit, teleport it, or reduce a cost
Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina
Make a Cultivation Check against the triggering creature’s Cultivation Save DC, spell save DC, or 8 + its Proficiency Bonus + its relevant ability modifier.
Successful Check: The triggering benefit fails. If the triggering effect has other effects, they still resolve normally.Failed Check: The benefit functions, but the target becomes Hollowed until the start of your next turn.
Cause-Emptying Reversal cannot cancel a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation core, Realm-defining transformation, or permanent feature.
TAL_VOID_COLLAPSING_GAP:
### Collapsing Gap - Gap
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 5 CP or 5 Stamina
Choose a point within range.
Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Pull the creature up to 20 feet toward the center and deal 4d8 Force or Necrotic damage.
Successful Save: Pull the creature up to 5 feet toward the center and deal half damage.
This pull is forced movement and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
A creature cannot be pulled through Total Cover, a sealed Barrier, or a solid obstacle.
TAL_VOID_CONSUME_SPELLWORK:
### Consume Spellwork - Null, Ward
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet activates a spell, sphere talent, or supernatural technique that targets only you
Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina
Make a Cultivation Check against:
10 + the triggering effect's CP cost or spell level + the triggering creature's Proficiency Bonus
If the effect has no CP cost or spell level, use half the triggering creature’s CR or CL, rounded up.
Successful Check: Choose one:
reduce the damage against you by half;
gain Advantage on one saving throw against the triggering effect;
use Empty Step before the effect resolves;
suppress one ordinary rider effect against yourself.
Failed Check: The triggering effect resolves normally.
Consume Spellwork cannot affect area effects unless you are the only target chosen by the effect.
TAL_VOID_COST_DENYING_NEEDLE:
### Cost-Denying Needle - Null
When Void Needle hits and you choose Cost Lock, the target also cannot regain CP or Stamina from ordinary temporary effects until the start of your next turn.
TAL_VOID_COURT_OF_THE_EMPTY_HORIZON:
### Court of the Empty Horizon - Void Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP or 7 Stamina
Every technique enters the court carrying a name. None leaves with certainty.
#### You
Gain +2 AC.
Gain Resistance to Force, Necrotic, and Psychic damage.
Use Empty Step once on each of your turns without spending CP or Stamina.
#### Allies
Allies inside the Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against teleportation, banishment, forced transformation, and possession.
When an ally inside the Domain takes damage from a supernatural area effect, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
#### Enemies
Enemies inside the Domain:
cannot reduce CP, Stamina, or other printed technique costs below the listed cost;
cannot gain Temporary HP;
treat the area as Difficult Terrain.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
it takes 2d8 Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage;
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
it cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn;
it cannot teleport until the start of its next turn;
it has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of its next turn.
TAL_VOID_EMPTY_PALM_SCRIPTURE:
### Empty Palm Scripture - Hollow
Prerequisite: CL 5+Special Attack
Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina
Make one unarmed strike.

Successful Save: The target cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn.
TAL_VOID_EMPTY_STEP:

Range: 20 feet
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within range.
This is teleportation and follows the Empty Step rules above.
TAL_VOID_HEAVEN_EMPTYING_LANCE:
### Heaven-Emptying Lance - Null
Prerequisite: Unmake Barrier, Void Needle, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 12 CP or 12 Stamina
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Release a single line of absence.
Choose one creature, temporary Barrier, object, summoned object, Force object, or Formation Anchor within range.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.

If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It is Hollowed for 1 minute.
Successful Save: It is Hollowed until the start of your next turn.
At the end of each of the creature’s turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the 1-minute Hollowed effect on itself on a success.
Against objects and Barriers, Heaven-Emptying Lance ignores ordinary object Damage Thresholds and deals double damage to temporary supernatural Barriers.

TAL_VOID_HOLLOW_PATH_STEP:
### Hollow Path Step - Gap

When a creature misses you with an attack roll, you may spend 2 CP or 2 Stamina to use Empty Step as a Reaction.
If the attacker was Hollowed, this teleportation costs 1 CP or 1 Stamina instead.
TAL_VOID_HOLLOW_REBUKE:
### Hollow Rebuke - Ward, Null
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A Hollowed creature within 60 feet hits you or an ally with an attack roll
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Reduce the attack’s damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
The attacker cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
TAL_VOID_HOLLOW_TOUCH:

Action Type: Action

Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina

reduce the target’s Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

TAL_VOID_QUIET_GAP:
### Quiet Gap - Quiet, Gap
Action Type: Action

ordinary sound becomes faint;

creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or sight;
verbal communication beyond 10 feet becomes difficult;
tracking through sound becomes unreliable.

TAL_VOID_RETURN_TO_ZERO:
### Return to Zero - Null

Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina
Choose one ordinary temporary benefit from the triggering effect.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.

Successful Save: The chosen benefit is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
Return to Zero cannot prevent an entire spell, talent, or technique unless its only effect is the chosen benefit.
TAL_VOID_STILL_TALISMAN:
### Still Talisman - Null
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
Touch one object, doorway, 5-foot square, or willing creature.
Until the effect ends, the first hostile teleportation effect that would move through, into, or out of the protected target must succeed on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Check: The teleportation fails and the Still Talisman ends.Successful Check: The teleportation succeeds and the Still Talisman ends.
Still Talisman does not stop planar travel, forced movement, ordinary movement, or teleportation created by a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, or Realm-defining effect unless the GM rules that the talisman was prepared for that specific phenomenon.
TAL_VOID_TEN_THOUSAND_EMPTY_NEEDLES:
### Ten-Thousand Empty Needles

Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina
Choose a number of creatures, objects, or temporary Barriers within range up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Make a separate ranged Cultivation Attack against each target.
Each hit deals Void Needle damage and applies one Void Pressure.
A creature can be affected by only one Void Pressure from this talent per use.
TAL_VOID_UNMAKE_BARRIER:
### Unmake Barrier - Null
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina
Choose one temporary Barrier, wall, ward, construct, Force object, Formation Anchor, structure section, or summoned object within range.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Hit: Deal Force or Necrotic damage.

TAL_VOID_VOID_FIELD:

TAL_VOID_VOID_MERIDIAN_SEAL:

Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP or 6 Stamina
Choose one creature within range.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Hollowed while this talent lasts.
Successful Save: The target is Hollowed until the start of your next turn.
At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the ongoing Hollowed effect on itself on a success.
TAL_VOID_VOID_NEEDLE:
### Void Needle
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature, object, or temporary Barrier
Cost: None
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.

TAL_VOID_VOID_PRISON:
### Void Prison - Null, Gap
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet

Cost: 6 CP or 6 Stamina
Choose one creature within range.

TAL_VOID_VOID_WALKING_GUARD:
### Void-Walking Guard - Ward, Gap
Prerequisite: Empty Step, Void Ward, CL 5+
When you use Void Ward, you may also teleport 10 feet to an unoccupied space you can see after the triggering damage is resolved.
This teleportation follows the Empty Step rules and does not cost additional CP or Stamina.

### Void Ward - Ward
Action Type: Reaction

Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Reduce the triggering damage.

CL: 11-16; Damage Reduction: 2d8 + key ability modifier

TAL_WATER_CUTTING_CURRENT:
##### Cutting Current - Pressure
Your Water Lash may deal slashing damage instead of bludgeoning damage.
If the target is Soaked, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. Against unattended mundane ropes, cloth, paper, ash, salt, mud, clay, or soft stone, this damage counts as Scouring Erosion.
TAL_WATER_DRINKING_THE_RAIN:
##### Drinking the Rain - Cleansing
When you finish a short rest while you have access to rain, mist, clean water, or one of your Cleansing Basins, choose up to six creatures who rested with you.
Each chosen creature may remove one level of Exhaustion caused by heat, dehydration, thirst, smoke, forced march, or similar environmental strain. A creature can benefit from this talent once per long rest.
TAL_WATER_DROWN_THE_FLAME:
##### Drown the Flame - Cleansing / Pressure
When you create or move a Basin or Current, you may attempt to quench fire in the area.
Ordinary flames are extinguished. Magical flames and Fire sphere effects require a Water check against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC or an opposed Cultivation Check if the effect is especially strong.
If you succeed against a Fire effect, you may make one creature in the area Soaked or end one Burning-like ongoing fire effect on a creature.
TAL_WATER_ERODE_THE_MOUNTAIN_S_NAME:
##### Erode the Mountain’s Name - Pressure / Spring
Choose one object, wall, Barrier, formation anchor, or terrain feature you can affect with Water damage. Spend 10 minutes and 5 CP directing a continuous current against it.
Make a Water check against a DC set by the GM or against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC. On a success, the target gains an Erosion Mark for 24 hours.
While marked, Water damage against the target ignores ordinary Resistance and deals double damage if the target is mundane and erodible. If the target is a magical Barrier or formation anchor, the next successful Water check made to disrupt it before the mark ends has Advantage.
A single target can bear only one Erosion Mark from you at a time.
TAL_WATER_FLOOD_THE_BATTLEFIELD:
##### Flood the Battlefield - Tide / Domain
While your Court of the Endless Tide is active, you may spend 3 CP as an action to flood it.
Until the start of your next turn, the Domain becomes waist-deep spiritual floodwater for creatures of your choice. Hostile creatures without Swim Speed treat the area as Difficult Terrain and have Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks made to resist your Water effects.
When you activate the flood, choose up to a number of hostile creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature is knocked Prone, moved 30 feet into a legal space, and suffers Drowning Pressure until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is moved 10 feet and becomes Soaked.
TAL_WATER_FLOWING_STEP:
##### Flowing Step - Current
When you use Return the Flow, you may target yourself instead of an ally even if you are not adjacent to the Water effect. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures that are Soaked or standing in one of your Currents or Basins.
If you start your turn in rain, mist, wet ground, or a Basin you created, you may stand from Prone without spending movement once per turn.
TAL_WATER_HEAVEN_FALLING_TSUNAMI:
##### Heaven-Falling Tsunami - Tide
Action Type: Action
Area: 120-foot line, 30 feet wide, or 60-foot cone
Cost: 5 CP Uses: Once per long rest
A vertical sea descends or a horizontal tide breaks across the field.
Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 8d8 bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 60 feet, falls Prone, becomes Soaked, and suffers Drowning Pressure until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage, is pushed 15 feet, and becomes Soaked.
Objects and unattended structures in the area take the damage and may suffer Scouring Erosion.
TAL_WATER_LIVING_CURRENT:
##### Living Current - Realm Evolution
At Foundation, your created water develops spiritual continuity.
Gain the following benefits:
Water Lash can originate from any Basin or Current you created within 60 feet instead of from your body.
Return the Flow can move one of your Basins or Currents up to 20 feet instead of 10 feet.
Your Water Control Limit increases by one Created Water Basin.
When a talent asks whether a creature is adjacent to your Water effect, a creature inside the effect also counts.
TAL_WATER_MIST_VEIL:
##### Mist Veil - Mist
When you create a Mist Basin, you may make the area a 15-foot-radius sphere instead of a 10-foot square.
The area is Lightly Obscured. By spending 1 additional CP when you create it, you may make the area Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn; after that, it becomes Lightly Obscured for the remaining duration.
A creature does not become Hidden automatically. It must still use Hide or another feature.
TAL_WATER_PRESSURE_LANCE:
##### Pressure Lance - Pressure
When you use Water Lash, you may spend 1 CP to make it a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide.
Make one attack roll and compare it to the AC of each creature in the line. On a hit, a target takes Water Lash damage and becomes Soaked. If a target was already Soaked, add one Water Lash die to the damage.
Objects in the line take damage normally. Against unattended barriers, this can count as Scouring Erosion.
TAL_WATER_PULL_OF_THE_RIVER:
##### Pull of the River - Current
When your Water Lash hits a Soaked target, you may pull the target 10 feet instead of moving it 5 feet. If the target is Large or smaller and ends this movement adjacent to a Basin or Current you created, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall Prone.
TAL_WATER_RESTORATIVE_WATERS:
##### Restorative Waters - Cleansing / Return
When you use Return the Flow, you may spend 1 CP to restore Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your Water key ability modifier to one ally in or adjacent to the Water effect.
At CL 11, the healing becomes 2d8 + your modifier. At CL 17, it becomes 3d8 + your modifier.
A creature can benefit from Restorative Waters once per short rest unless you spend 2 CP instead of 1 CP.
This is supportive restoration, not full Life-sphere regeneration.
TAL_WATER_RIVER_CUTS_THE_GATE:
##### River Cuts the Gate - Pressure / Erosion
When your Water Lash, Pressure Lance, Tidal Wave, or Whirlpool Prison damages an object, Barrier, gate, wall, formation anchor, or unattended structure, you may spend 1 CP to apply Scouring Erosion.
