For 1 minute, repeated Water damage against that target ignores ordinary Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources and deals double damage to mundane objects if the GM agrees the material can be eroded.
Against magical Barriers, use a Water check against the Barrier’s DC or the creator’s Cultivation Save DC. On a success, the next Water damage against the Barrier before the end of your next turn gains the same benefit.
TAL_WATER_RIVER_PASSAGE:
##### River Passage - Tide
You can use Return the Flow to carry yourself or a willing creature through connected water.
If you begin adjacent to a Water Source, Basin, Current, river, canal, pond, cistern, rain curtain, or similar water path, you may teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space adjacent to the same connected water system or one of your Basins.
At CL 11, the range becomes 300 feet. At CL 15, it becomes 1 mile if both ends are connected to a significant Water Source.
TAL_WATER_RIVER_PATH_TO_THE_SEA:
##### River Path to the Sea - Tide / Travel
You can expand River Passage into a travel rite.
By spending 10 minutes and 5 CP at a significant Water Source, you may transport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to another significant Water Source you have personally visited or marked with a Water project. The destination must be within 10 miles per CL unless the journey follows a major river, coastline, sacred canal, or sea route approved by the GM.
This is a travel technique, not a combat teleport. Hostile wards, sealed Barriers, drought curses, or contested water deities may block or complicate the passage.
TAL_WATER_STILL_SURFACE_METHOD:
##### Still Surface Method - Mist
When a creature inside your Mist Basin is targeted by an attack from outside the Basin, you may use your Reaction to ripple the mist.
The attacker has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll unless it can see through obscurement or the attack does not rely on sight.
You may use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest, or by spending 1 CP.
TAL_WATER_TEN_THOUSAND_RETURNING_STREAMS:
##### Ten Thousand Returning Streams - Return / Tide
When you use Return the Flow inside your Court of the Endless Tide, you may choose up to three Water effects you created instead of one.
For each chosen effect, move it up to 20 feet, end it, or apply one minor Return effect. A creature can be moved by this talent only once per turn.
If at least two chosen effects end, you may restore Hit Points equal to your Water key ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus to one ally inside the Domain.
TAL_WATER_TIDAL_WAVE:
##### Tidal Wave - Tide / Current
When you use Shape Current, you may spend 2 additional CP to create a wave.
Choose a line up to 90 feet long and 15 feet wide, or a 30-foot cone. Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage, is pushed 20 feet, falls Prone, and becomes Soaked. On a successful save, it takes half damage and becomes Soaked.
If used inside your Court of the Endless Tide, you may curve the wave once around a corner or obstacle you can perceive.
TAL_WATER_WATER_BREATHING:
##### Water Breathing - Cleansing / Tide
You can use Shape Current to create a Breath Basin instead of one of its normal forms.
The Basin occupies a 10-foot-radius area and lasts for 1 hour without Concentration. Creatures of your choice in the Basin can breathe underwater, speak normally through water, and ignore the ordinary penalties of wet lungs, smoke inhalation, or choking dust while they remain in the area.
At CL 5, you may instead target up to a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. They gain this benefit for 1 hour while within 1 mile of a Water Source you have touched during the last minute.
TAL_WATER_WATER_CLONE:
##### Water Clone - Basin / Mist
When you create a Mist Basin or Cleansing Basin, you may spend 2 CP to form a Water Clone in it.
The clone occupies one space inside the Basin and lasts for the Basin’s duration. It cannot attack independently. When a creature you can perceive attacks you or an ally within 30 feet of the clone, you may use your Reaction to have the clone interpose.
Roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the attack targets the clone instead. The clone has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and Hit Points equal to twice your CL. If reduced to 0 Hit Points, it bursts and makes each hostile creature within 5 feet Soaked.
TAL_WATER_WATER_SHIELD:
##### Water Shield - Current / Cleansing
Trigger: You or a creature within 30 feet that you can perceive takes damage from an attack or area effect.
Action Type: Reaction
Cost: 1 CP
A current rises to absorb and redirect harm. Reduce the triggering damage by 1d10 + your Water key ability modifier.
If the protected creature is Soaked or inside one of your Basins or Currents, also move it 10 feet into a legal space without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
At CL 11, reduce the damage by 2d10 + your modifier. At CL 17, reduce it by 3d10 + your modifier.
TAL_WATER_WATER_WHIP:
##### Water Whip - Current / Pressure
When Water Lash hits, you may spend 1 CP to wrap the target in a whip-current.
The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Grappled by the water until the end of your next turn. While Grappled this way, it is also Soaked.
A target can escape early by using an action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
TAL_WATER_WAVE_BURST:
##### Wave Burst - Current
When you create a Flowing Current with Shape Current, you may make it burst outward from a point instead of flowing in a line or square.
The area becomes a 10-foot-radius burst. Each creature of your choice in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the center and become Soaked.
On a successful save, a creature is only Soaked.
TAL_WATER_WHEN_THE_SEA_FORGETS_THE_SHORE:
##### When the Sea Forgets the Shore
Secret Water Inheritance
Prerequisite: Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden oceanic scripture, sea-heart initiation, or equivalent revelation
Action Type: Action
Range: 1 mile, centered on a significant Water Source or on yourself during Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation
Area: Up to a 300-foot-radius region chosen by the GM and player according to terrain
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP Uses: Once per week
You declare that the battlefield was only temporarily dry.
For the duration, the area becomes a sovereign tide region. It may manifest as floodwater, descending rain-sea, rivers rising from stone, a phantom ocean overlapping reality, or every drop in the area remembering its original sea.
Choose three laws when the inheritance manifests:
No Shore. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. Allies of your choice ignore this terrain and gain Swim Speed equal to their Speed.
Every Path Returns. Once per round, when a hostile creature moves, teleports, flies, or is forced to move inside the area, you may move it up to 30 feet into a legal space after that movement resolves.
All Fire Drowns. Ordinary flames are extinguished. Fire effects that begin in the area or enter it must succeed on an opposed Cultivation Check or be suppressed until the start of the creator’s next turn.
Pressure Has No Surface. Up to three hostile creatures of your choice each round suffer Drowning Pressure until the start of your next turn.
The River Takes the Weapon. Once per round, when a hostile creature hits with a weapon attack inside the area, reduce the damage by 4d10 and move the attacker or target 30 feet into a legal space.
The Sea Gives Back. Once per round, an ally of your choice inside the area regains Hit Points equal to 4d8 + your Water key ability modifier when it starts its turn Soaked or inside a Water effect.
Mountains Become Silt. Objects, walls, gates, and unattended structures in the area suffer Scouring Erosion. Water damage against them is doubled if mundane and erodible.
When the inheritance ends, choose one final Return:
all allies of your choice in the area move up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
one hostile creature that failed a saving throw against your Water effect during the inheritance is Restrained until the end of your next turn;
one Barrier, gate, or terrain feature damaged by the inheritance gains an Erosion Mark for 24 hours;
one Sacred Spring forms at the center for 24 hours.
This inheritance cannot permanently flood a nation, create an endless sea, override a superior divine or sect formation without contest, or solve regional drought by itself. Those outcomes require campaign-scale projects.
TAL_WATER_WHIRLPOOL_PRISON:
##### Whirlpool Prison - Pressure / Basin
When you create a Pressure Basin, you may spend 2 additional CP to make it a whirlpool.
The area becomes a 20-foot-radius Basin. A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Strength saving throw.
On a failure, it is Restrained until the start of its next turn and suffers Drowning Pressure. On a success, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
A creature Restrained this way can use its action to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
TAL_WAX_ADHESIVE_POOL:
#### Adhesive Pool - Mold Talent
When you create Soft Spread, you may make it adhesive. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area, starts its turn there, or is knocked Prone there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn.
A creature affected by Adhesive Pool is impressed by the wax.
TAL_WAX_BASE_SPHERE_ABILITIES:
### Base Sphere Abilities
When you first gain the Sphere of Wax, you gain Mold Wax, Press Seal, and Kindle Wax.
You also learn one Wax talent of your choice.
#### Mold Wax
Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 1 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You create or awaken cultivated wax in an unoccupied space, on a surface, or over an unattended object within range. Choose one form.
Soft Spread. You create a 10-foot square of Soft Wax on a surface. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become impressed by the wax until the end of your next turn.
Set Shape. You create a Set Wax panel, ramp, handhold, brace, small bridge, shield plate, low wall, or similar structure that fits within two contiguous 5-foot cubes. It must be supported by a surface unless a talent says otherwise. It can provide cover, block a narrow passage, support weight, or create a short ramp or platform.
Fine Work. Outside initiative, you can shape wax into seals, molds, masks, tablets, candle forms, practice tools, ritual counters, labels, evidence casts, and small sculptures. Fine Work cannot create valuable trade goods, magical items, living organs, or permanent infrastructure unless the GM says otherwise.
At CL 5, your Soft Spread can cover a 15-foot square, or your Set Shape can fit within four contiguous 5-foot cubes.
At CL 10, your Soft Spread can cover a 20-foot square, or your Set Shape can fit within six contiguous 5-foot cubes.
At CL 15, your Soft Spread can cover a 25-foot square, or your Set Shape can fit within eight contiguous 5-foot cubes.
#### Press Seal
Action. Range 30 feet. Cost 1 CP. Duration 1 minute.
You press or throw a cultivated Wax Seal onto one creature, object, surface, or 5-foot space within range. A willing creature, unattended object, or surface is sealed automatically. An unwilling creature or attended object makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the seal attaches. On a success, the seal fails.
When you place the seal, choose one base seal.
Clinging Seal. The sealed creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet while the seal remains. If placed on an object, the object adheres to the surface it touches and requires an Action and a successful Strength check against your Cultivation Save DC to remove.
Witness Seal. The seal records the next creature other than you that touches, opens, damages, moves, or passes through the sealed target. You know that the seal was triggered if you are within 1 mile, and you can later inspect the seal to see the outline, handprint, footprint, tool mark, weapon shape, or other physical Impression left behind.
Closing Seal. The seal holds a door, lid, drawer, container, wound wrapping, sheath, scroll case, coffin, or similar closure shut. Opening it requires an Action and a successful Strength check or Dexterity check with appropriate tools against your Cultivation Save DC. A creature can also destroy the seal normally.
Preserving Seal. The sealed object, corpse, medicine, food, blood sample, written page, track, footprint, wound dressing, or physical clue resists decay, contamination, smearing, and ordinary weather while the seal remains.
#### Kindle Wax
Bonus Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 0 CP.
You burn one Wax form, Wax Seal, candle, or wax object you created within range. The chosen wax is consumed. Choose one base release.
Candleflare. One creature within 5 feet of the kindled wax makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes fire damage equal to 1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus. On a success, it takes half damage.
Smoke Puff. The wax releases thick smoke in a 5-foot radius until the start of your next turn. The area is Lightly Obscured. This smoke is ordinary smoke once released and can be dispersed by strong wind.
Release Seal. If the kindled wax was a Wax Seal on an ally, the ally gains temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If it was a Wax Seal on an enemy, that enemy takes fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Mark the Wick. You learn whether the wax had been touched, moved, damaged, or disturbed since you created it. If it held an Impression, you preserve a brief sensory image of the Impression before the wax burns.
TAL_WAX_BORROWED_COUNTENANCE:
#### Borrowed Countenance - Effigy Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5, Wax Mask.
When you create a Wax Mask from a true Impression of a creature’s face, hand, or identifying mark, the wearer may also imitate one physical sign of that creature: a handprint, a facial profile, a scar pattern, a lip shape, a bite pattern, or similar visible evidence.
The mask still does not alter voice, aura, cultivation pressure, memories, scent, or actual identity. Magical scrutiny, close social interaction, or careful inspection can expose the deception.
Using this talent for impersonation may be illegal, dishonorable, or forbidden in many sects.
TAL_WAX_CANDLE_PROCESSION:
#### Candle Procession - Wick Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action. Cost 1 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
You create up to six small cultivated candles in spaces you can see within 60 feet. The candles may float inches above the ground, cling to walls, or rest on surfaces. They shed dim light in a 10-foot radius.
As a Bonus Action, you may move each candle up to 20 feet. A candle cannot attack, carry objects, provide flanking, or occupy a creature’s space.
Allies who begin their turn within 5 feet of one of your procession candles may ignore the first 5 feet of Difficult Terrain they enter that turn.
TAL_WAX_CANDLE_PROCESSION_ACROSS_THE_NIG:
#### Candle Procession Across the Night - Wick Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15, Candle Procession.
Your Candle Procession can carry allies along prepared candle routes.
Rite. 10 minutes. Cost 4 CP. Duration 1 hour.
You arrange a line of candles between two points you have physically visited within the last 24 hours, no farther apart than 1 mile per Proficiency Bonus. During the duration, you and up to six willing creatures may travel between those points as part of a quiet procession. The journey takes 10 minutes regardless of normal travel difficulty, provided the route is physically passable by some path.
This is not teleportation. It is a supernatural procession that finds the safe candle-lit way through streets, halls, forests, ruins, grave roads, or sect grounds. Barriers, sealed gates, warded borders, hostile patrols, or impossible terrain can still interrupt it.
TAL_WAX_CANDLE_THAT_REMEMBERS_EVERY_FOOT:
#### Candle That Remembers Every Footstep - Rite Talent
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Rite. 10 minutes. Cost 4 CP. Duration 24 hours.
You prepare a sovereign tracking candle from an Impression. While the candle burns, it remembers the path of the creature or object that left the Impression.
You can ask the candle one of the following questions each hour.
Did the subject pass within 1 mile of this location in the last 24 hours?
Which direction did the subject most recently travel from here?
Did the subject cross a threshold, gate, river, road, wall, or formation nearby?
Is the subject currently protected by a strong anti-divination, anti-tracking, or identity-concealing effect?
The candle answers by flame direction, scent, smoke pattern, wax flow, or script emerging in melted wax. It does not reveal exact location unless the GM decides the Impression is unusually strong and the subject is nearby.
TAL_WAX_CLINGING_SEAL:
#### Clinging Seal - Seal Augment
When a creature fails its saving throw against Press Seal, you may spend 1 additional CP to strengthen the seal. Until the seal ends, the target cannot benefit from the Dash action unless it first uses its Action to attempt to remove the seal.
TAL_WAX_COURT_OF_TEN_THOUSAND_CANDLES:
#### Court of Ten Thousand Candles - Wax Domain
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action. Cost 4 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You establish a candle court in a 30-foot radius centered on a point you can see within 60 feet. The court fills with wax seals, thin candlelight, slow-falling droplets, and soft places waiting to harden.
Allies in the court gain the following benefits.
They ignore Difficult Terrain created by your Wax talents.
The first time each round an ally would be moved against their will, they may reduce that movement by 10 feet.
An ally who starts their turn adjacent to one of your Wax forms or candles gains temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Enemies in the court suffer the following effects.
The area is Difficult Terrain for them.
The first time each round an enemy fails a saving throw against one of your Wax talents, you may place a Wax Seal on that enemy without spending additional CP.
An enemy that damages one of your Wax forms is impressed by the court until the end of its next turn.
The court is visible and material. Fire, wind, dispelling, and object destruction can weaken parts of it, but do not end the entire Domain unless the central candle seal is destroyed or your concentration ends.
TAL_WAX_EFFIGY_OF_THE_ABSENT:
#### Effigy of the Absent - Effigy Rite
Prerequisite: CL 10, Wax Effigy.
Rite. 1 hour. Cost 4 CP. Duration 7 days.
You create an advanced effigy of a missing creature, forgotten oath, lost object, dead witness, or sealed event.
Choose one vessel.
Message Vessel. If the subject willingly gave you an Impression, name-seal, or token, the effigy can carry a message that reaches them in a dream, candle reflection, or moment of stillness if they are on the same plane and not protected against such contact.
Recognition Vessel. You may compare a creature, corpse, object, handwriting sample, wound, footprint, key, or aura trace against the effigy. The GM may grant advantage on checks to determine whether it matches the subject.
Funeral Vessel. If used in a respectful funeral rite, the effigy helps preserve a departing trace, name, or final memory long enough for Spirit, Fate, Dream, or ancestral rites to interact with it.
Effigy of the Absent cannot compel the subject to answer, appear, suffer harm, or reveal secrets by itself.
TAL_WAX_FLOWING_WAX_STEP:
#### Flowing Wax Step - Unique Wax Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Bonus Action. Cost 1 CP.
You soften wax under your own feet and ride its yielding surface. Until the end of your turn, you ignore Difficult Terrain created by wax, mud, snow, shallow water, slick stone, or similar yielding surfaces. If you move through your own Soft Wax this turn, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures standing in that wax.
TAL_WAX_FUNERAL_CANDLE_SHELTER:
#### Funeral Candle Shelter - Wick Rite
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Reaction.
Trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet would die, have its corpse destroyed, or have its departing trace scattered. Cost 5 CP.
You ignite a funeral candle and wrap the target in white wax light. Choose one effect.
Shelter the Dying. If the creature would die from damage, it instead falls to 0 hit points and becomes stable, provided the damage did not destroy the body outright. The candle ends.
Shelter the Departing Trace. If the creature dies, you preserve a respectful departing trace, final breath, name, or memory for 1 hour. This does not trap the soul or prevent resurrection. It gives allies time to perform Spirit, Fate, Dream, Medicine, funeral, or ancestral rites.
A creature can benefit from Funeral Candle Shelter only once per long rest.
TAL_WAX_GREATER_MOLD:
#### Greater Mold - Mold Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Your Mold Wax improves.
When you create Soft Spread, increase one side of the area by 10 feet.
When you create Set Shape, you may create two separate Set Wax structures within range, each no larger than half your normal Set Shape limit.
You may also create stairs, handrails, short bridges, wax curtains, false walls, ramps, seals across multiple panels, or simple furniture appropriate to the available volume.
TAL_WAX_GUIDING_CANDLE:
#### Guiding Candle - Wick Talent
You can create a small cultivated candle as part of Mold Wax or Press Seal. The candle burns for 1 hour, sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for another 10 feet, and is visible only as ordinary candlelight unless examined with supernatural senses.
As a Bonus Action, you may cause one Guiding Candle within 60 feet to flare. Until the start of your next turn, allies who can see the candle ignore nonmagical Difficult Terrain in a 10-foot radius around it.
TAL_WAX_HUNDRED_SEAL_CONFLAGRATION:
#### Hundred-Seal Conflagration - Wick Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 3 CP.
You ignite any number of your Wax Seals within range. Choose up to three creatures bearing those seals or adjacent to those seals. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 4d8 fire damage and is pushed 10 feet away from the nearest ignited seal. On a success, it takes half damage and is not pushed.
All ignited seals are consumed.
TAL_WAX_LINGERING_SEAL:
#### Lingering Seal - Seal Augment
When a Wax Seal would end because its duration expires, you may spend 1 CP to extend it for 10 minutes if it is on a surface, object, willing creature, corpse, or unattended item. This cannot extend a hostile creature’s combat seal unless a higher-Realm talent says otherwise.
TAL_WAX_LIVING_WAX_FORM:
#### Living Wax Form - Unique Wax Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Bonus Action. Cost 2 CP. Duration 1 minute.
You cultivate your own body as wax without losing your living nature. Choose one form when you activate this talent.
Soft Body. You can move through spaces as narrow as 1 inch wide if you are not carrying rigid equipment that cannot pass. You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws made to escape Grappled or Restrained. You have disadvantage on saving throws against effects that would push, pull, or knock you Prone.
Set Body. You gain temporary hit points equal to twice your Cultivation Level. While these temporary hit points remain, you reduce forced movement by 10 feet and have advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone.
Wick Body. The first time each round a creature hits you with a melee attack, you may use your Reaction to deal fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and shed bright candlelight in a 10-foot radius until the start of your next turn.
You may change forms as a Bonus Action by spending 1 CP.
TAL_WAX_MEDICINAL_WAX:
#### Medicinal Wax - Unique Wax Talent
When you use Seal Wound or Waxen Shell, choose one of the following medicinal preparations.
Cooling Wax. The target has advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn against fire, poison, or disease.
Stimulating Wax. The target’s Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
Numbing Wax. The first time before the end of your next turn that the target takes damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_WAX_MELTING_REBUKE:
#### Melting Rebuke - Wick Talent
Reaction.
Trigger: A creature within 5 feet of one of your Wax forms damages it with a melee attack or starts to tear away one of your Wax Seals.
You kindle that wax. The triggering creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes fire damage equal to 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus and is impressed by the wax until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and is not impressed.
TAL_WAX_MOLD_WAX:
#### Mold Wax
Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 1 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You create or awaken cultivated wax in an unoccupied space, on a surface, or over an unattended object within range. Choose one form.
Soft Spread. You create a 10-foot square of Soft Wax on a surface. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become impressed by the wax until the end of your next turn.
Set Shape. You create a Set Wax panel, ramp, handhold, brace, small bridge, shield plate, low wall, or similar structure that fits within two contiguous 5-foot cubes. It must be supported by a surface unless a talent says otherwise. It can provide cover, block a narrow passage, support weight, or create a short ramp or platform.
Fine Work. Outside initiative, you can shape wax into seals, molds, masks, tablets, candle forms, practice tools, ritual counters, labels, evidence casts, and small sculptures. Fine Work cannot create valuable trade goods, magical items, living organs, or permanent infrastructure unless the GM says otherwise.
At CL 5, your Soft Spread can cover a 15-foot square, or your Set Shape can fit within four contiguous 5-foot cubes.
At CL 10, your Soft Spread can cover a 20-foot square, or your Set Shape can fit within six contiguous 5-foot cubes.
At CL 15, your Soft Spread can cover a 25-foot square, or your Set Shape can fit within eight contiguous 5-foot cubes.
TAL_WAX_MOLTEN_SNARE:
#### Molten Snare - Mold Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
When a creature fails a saving throw against Adhesive Pool or Wax Cage, you may spend 1 CP to make the wax molten and dragging. Until the start of your next turn, the creature takes fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus whenever it moves willingly or is moved through the wax.
This is heated wax, not broad fire control.
TAL_WAX_PALACE_RAISED_FROM_ONE_DRIP:
#### Palace Raised From One Drip - Mold Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10, Greater Mold.
When you use Mold Wax, you may create more elaborate connected structures: multiple walls, a low maze, a stairwell, a short bridge, a sealed booth, a temporary clinic bay, a wax gatehouse, or a layered rampart.
The total volume cannot exceed your Mold Wax limits, but you may divide the wax into any number of connected sections. The structure must remain physically plausible: it needs support, cannot hover freely, and cannot create machinery with complex moving parts unless another talent permits it.
TAL_WAX_PRESERVING_SHROUD:
#### Preserving Shroud - Seal Rite
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Rite. 10 minutes. Range Touch. Cost 2 CP. Duration 24 hours.
You wrap a willing creature, corpse, medicine, rare specimen, document, spiritual trace, or physical clue in preserving wax and cloth. For the duration, the target resists ordinary decay, contamination, rot, weathering, insects, drying, smearing, and casual handling.
If used on a living creature, the target gains advantage on saving throws against disease and poison for the duration, but its Speed is reduced by 10 feet while fully shrouded.
If used on a corpse or trace, the shroud preserves evidence. It does not prevent resurrection limits, command souls, or halt supernatural decay unless the GM allows it.
TAL_WAX_PRESS_SEAL:
#### Press Seal
Action. Range 30 feet. Cost 1 CP. Duration 1 minute.
You press or throw a cultivated Wax Seal onto one creature, object, surface, or 5-foot space within range. A willing creature, unattended object, or surface is sealed automatically. An unwilling creature or attended object makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the seal attaches. On a success, the seal fails.
When you place the seal, choose one base seal.
Clinging Seal. The sealed creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet while the seal remains. If placed on an object, the object adheres to the surface it touches and requires an Action and a successful Strength check against your Cultivation Save DC to remove.
Witness Seal. The seal records the next creature other than you that touches, opens, damages, moves, or passes through the sealed target. You know that the seal was triggered if you are within 1 mile, and you can later inspect the seal to see the outline, handprint, footprint, tool mark, weapon shape, or other physical Impression left behind.
Closing Seal. The seal holds a door, lid, drawer, container, wound wrapping, sheath, scroll case, coffin, or similar closure shut. Opening it requires an Action and a successful Strength check or Dexterity check with appropriate tools against your Cultivation Save DC. A creature can also destroy the seal normally.
Preserving Seal. The sealed object, corpse, medicine, food, blood sample, written page, track, footprint, wound dressing, or physical clue resists decay, contamination, smearing, and ordinary weather while the seal remains.
TAL_WAX_PROCESSION_OF_WAX_ATTENDANTS:
#### Procession of Wax Attendants - Effigy Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action. Cost 3 CP. Duration 1 hour.
You shape up to three Small wax attendants. They are fragile ritual helpers, not combat summons. Each attendant has AC 10, 1 hit point, Speed 20 feet, and can carry a light object, hold a candle, bear a seal, deliver a message to a visible creature within 300 feet, open an unlocked door, pour medicine, hold a bandage, or perform another simple task.
In combat, an attendant acts on your turn and can take only the Dash, Disengage, Help, Hide, Search, or Use an Object action. It cannot attack. If it takes damage, it is destroyed.
TAL_WAX_QUIET_SEAL:
#### Quiet Seal - Seal Talent
You can place a Wax Seal without obvious light, heat, scent, or sound. A creature observing the target can still notice the seal with a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
You have advantage on checks made to hide Wax Seals among legal seals, candle drippings, wax repairs, cosmetics, medicine, funeral wrappings, or household objects.
TAL_WAX_RETURNING_WAX:
#### Returning Wax - Temper Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
When one of your Wax forms is destroyed by damage, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to have part of it flow back to you. You regain temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus, or you may immediately create a 5-foot square of Soft Wax in an unoccupied space within 30 feet of the destroyed form.
TAL_WAX_SCULPTED_IMPLEMENTS:
#### Sculpted Implements - Mold Talent
You may use Fine Work to create temporary wax tools, keys, wedges, handles, medical splints, practice weapons, stamps, labels, ritual counters, lock impressions, and evidence casts.
These implements are not metal and cannot replace specialized high-quality tools for every purpose. They can, however, grant advantage on checks to preserve evidence, copy an impression, mark a sealed object, splint an injury, create a temporary handle, or test whether a key shape fits a lock.
TAL_WAX_SEALED_ARCHIVE:
#### Sealed Archive - Rite Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Rite. 1 hour. Cost 4 CP. Duration 30 days.
You create a wax-sealed archive for evidence, memories, letters, maps, relics, ingredients, court records, medical notes, or corpse-tags. The archive may be a chest, wall, rack, candle hall, ledger, or sealed cabinet.
While the archive remains undamaged, its contents resist ordinary decay, tampering, weather, vermin, and casual theft. A creature that opens the archive without your permission must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or become marked by a Witness Seal for 24 hours.
This creates a temporary protected archive, not a permanent sect vault. Permanent archives require GM-approved sect-scale work.
TAL_WAX_SEAL_OF_PRESERVATION:
#### Seal of Preservation - Seal Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
When you place a Preserving Seal on a living willing creature, choose one condition or danger: poison, disease, bleeding, exhaustion from exposure, suffocation from smoke, or ordinary environmental contamination.
For the seal’s duration, the target gains advantage on saving throws against that danger. If the target is already suffering from the chosen danger, it may immediately make one new saving throw or ability check to resist or stabilize it if the GM judges the effect permits repeated attempts.
TAL_WAX_SEAL_WOUND:
#### Seal Wound - Unique Wax Talent
Action. Touch. Cost 1 CP.
You seal a wound with medicinal wax, pressure, and qi. The target gains temporary hit points equal to 1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus. If the target is bleeding, suffering from a mundane open wound, or taking ongoing damage from a wound effect that can be physically sealed, the GM may allow the target to make a new saving throw or ability check to end that effect.
This is not general healing. It is emergency closure, preservation, and stabilization.
TAL_WAX_SEARING_SEAL:
#### Searing Seal - Wick Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
When you kindle a Wax Seal on a hostile creature, you may spend 1 CP to make it sear. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it takes 2d8 fire damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and suffers no Reaction loss.
A creature cannot lose Reactions from your Searing Seal more than once per round.
TAL_WAX_SMOKE_WICK:
#### Smoke Wick - Wick Talent
When you use Smoke Puff, the smoke fills a 10-foot radius instead of a 5-foot radius. The area is Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn, then becomes Lightly Obscured until the end of your next turn.
Creatures that do not need to breathe can still have their sight blocked by the smoke.
TAL_WAX_SOVEREIGN_SEAL_OF_THE_CHOSEN_SHA:
#### Sovereign Seal of the Chosen Shape - Seal Talent
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 4 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You place a sovereign Wax Seal on one creature or object. An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, choose one chosen shape.
Shape of Stillness. The target’s Speed becomes 0, and it cannot teleport unless it first succeeds on a Charisma saving throw at the end of its turn.
Shape of Truth. The target cannot benefit from mundane disguise, physical masks, or shapechanging to conceal its basic body outline. Illusions are not dispelled, but creatures have advantage on checks to notice that something is being hidden.
Shape of Preservation. The target cannot be reduced below 1 hit point by damage from a source you can see, once during the duration. When this protection triggers, the seal ends and you gain one level of exhaustion or lose CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus, your choice.
Shape of Closure. One object, portal, container, wound, door, or threshold becomes sealed. Opening or crossing it requires a successful check or saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC, as appropriate to the situation.
A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the seal on a success.
TAL_WAX_TEMPERED_SEALANT:
#### Tempered Sealant - Temper Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Your Set Wax and Wax Seals no longer have vulnerability to fire damage unless the fire comes from a creature whose Cultivation Level, Challenge Rating, or spell level is higher than your Cultivation Level or the GM decides the heat is overwhelming.
Your wax also resists ordinary rain, desert heat, cold rooms, household flame, and casual attempts to melt it.
TAL_WAX_THE_LAST_CANDLE_REFUSES_TO_FORGE:
#### The Last Candle Refuses to Forget the Departed
Prerequisite: CL 17 or higher, GM permission.
Forbidden Rite. 1 minute. Cost 8 CP.
You light the last candle for a creature, place, oath, family, sect, battlefield, or vanished event that should have been forgotten. The candle burns with wax made from memory, evidence, grief, and refusal.
Choose one miracle.
Name Preserved. A creature whose name has been erased, denied, or ritually suppressed can be spoken again by those present. This does not defeat all curses, but it creates a true foothold for later Spirit, Fate, Dream, Blood, or ancestral restoration.
Trace Sheltered. A departing soul-trace, ancestral echo, final memory, or oath-fragment is preserved for 24 hours even if ordinary rites would fail. This does not imprison the dead. It prevents immediate scattering.
Evidence Refuses Fire. One physical record, body, trace, wound pattern, seal, footprint, weapon mark, or corpse-tag destroyed within the last day reappears as a wax Impression clear enough to be examined.
Door Remembered. A sealed, hidden, burned, moved, or forgotten threshold briefly appears as a wax outline. For 1 minute, creatures present can see where the passage was, what opened it, and what kind of seal closed it.
After using this inheritance, the candle leaves a permanent mark on your cultivation base. Until you complete a significant funeral, justice, remembrance, or reconciliation deed, you cannot use this inheritance again.
TAL_WAX_THOUSAND_FACED_WAX_SOVEREIGN:
#### Thousand-Faced Wax Sovereign - Effigy Talent
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action. Cost 4 CP. Duration 1 hour.
You surround yourself with many refined masks, hand impressions, name plaques, and wax figures. For the duration, you gain the following benefits.
You have advantage on checks made to create, detect, or analyze physical disguises, false bodies, forged handprints, seals, and masks.
When a creature hits you with an attack, you may use your Reaction to cause one wax false-face to break. The attack still hits, but the attacker becomes impressed by your Wax until the end of your next turn.
You may create a Wax Mask as an Action without the normal Rite time.
Once during the duration, when you would fail a Charisma check based on appearance, etiquette, legal identity, or ceremonial presence, you may reroll the check.
This does not alter your soul, aura, memories, voice, cultivation signature, or true identity.
TAL_WAX_WAXEN_BULWARK:
#### Waxen Bulwark - Mold Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
When you create a Wax Rampart, you may spend 1 additional CP to make it a bulwark. Allies adjacent to the bulwark when it appears gain temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Until the bulwark is destroyed or the effect ends, the first ally each round who starts their turn adjacent to it may choose to gain half cover until the start of their next turn, even if the bulwark would normally provide only partial protection.
TAL_WAX_WAXEN_CITY_OF_ONE_BREATH:
#### Waxen City of One Breath - Sovereign Mold Technique
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action. Cost 5 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 10 minutes.
You exhale a sovereign quantity of cultivated wax, shaping a battlefield district in a 60-foot radius centered on a point you can see within 120 feet. Choose up to four features when you create it.
Soft avenues that are Difficult Terrain for enemies.
Set Wax ramparts providing half cover.
Candle roads that allow allies to ignore your wax terrain.
Sealed doors, walls, or booths that require checks to open.
Raised platforms, bridges, stairs, or channels.
Preserving alcoves where allies gain temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus when they first enter.
Witness seals that mark the first enemy each round to damage a wax structure.
The city is temporary, visible, and material. It is not a real settlement and cannot create valuable goods. It can, however, transform a battlefield into a wax-sealed court, clinic, maze, barricade, or funeral avenue.
TAL_WAX_WAXEN_SHELL:
#### Waxen Shell - Unique Wax Talent
Action. Range Touch. Cost 1 CP. Duration 1 minute.
You coat a willing creature in a flexible wax shell. The target gains temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. While any of these temporary hit points remain, the target has advantage on saving throws against being moved by wind, water, ordinary slippery terrain, or minor forced movement caused by unstable footing.
The shell is visible and may impose disadvantage on checks requiring delicate touch if the GM judges the wax would interfere.
TAL_WAX_WAXEN_TRAIL:
#### Waxen Trail - Seal Talent
When a sealed creature moves, you may choose to have the seal leave a faint wax thread, scent, footprint line, or candle-colored trace. For the duration, you have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to track that creature through ordinary terrain.
If the creature teleports, turns invisible, or changes shape while sealed, the seal snaps and leaves an obvious wax mark at the point of departure.
TAL_WAX_WAX_CAGE:
#### Wax Cage - Mold Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 2 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You create bars, sheets, cords, or lattices of Set Wax around one Large or smaller creature within range. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is Restrained by the wax. On a success, it moves to the nearest unoccupied space of its choice outside the cage and is not restrained.
A restrained creature can use its Action to attempt a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the restraint on a success. The cage can also be destroyed.
Wax Cage is visibly material. It can be cut, burned, broken, or bypassed by teleportation unless another talent prevents that.
TAL_WAX_WAX_EFFIGY:
#### Wax Effigy - Effigy Rite
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Rite. 10 minutes. Range Touch. Cost 2 CP. Duration 24 hours.
You sculpt a small wax effigy of a creature, place, object, wound, oath, or event. The effigy must be based on a true Impression, eyewitness description, personal token, name-seal, or significant physical sample.
Choose one function.
Memory Vessel. A creature who studies the effigy has advantage on one Intelligence check made to recall, recognize, reconstruct, or explain the subject represented by the effigy.
Message Vessel. You may record a short spoken message, image, gesture, or emotional impression into the effigy. The first creature you designate who touches the effigy receives the message.
Ritual Focus. The effigy can serve as a focus for a later Wax, Spirit, Fate, Blood, Divination, or Formation ritual if the GM agrees the link is appropriate.
Wax Effigy does not harm or control the subject by itself.
TAL_WAX_WAX_MASK:
#### Wax Mask - Effigy Rite
Rite. 10 minutes. Range Touch. Cost 1 CP.
You sculpt a physical wax mask, prosthetic feature, false scar, false handprint, or ceremonial face. A creature wearing the mask gains advantage on one Charisma (Deception), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or disguise kit check made to pass a casual visual inspection.
The mask does not change voice, body shape, scent, gait, aura, cultivation pressure, or behavior. Close inspection can reveal it as a physical disguise.
If made from a true Impression of a creature’s face, hand, or identifying feature, the mask is more convincing but may be considered suspicious, illegal, or forbidden in many sects.
TAL_WAX_WAX_RAMPART:
#### Wax Rampart - Mold Talent
When you create Set Shape, you may create a sturdier rampart. The Set Wax gains additional hit points equal to your Cultivation Level, and creatures behind it may use it as half cover if its position would reasonably protect them.
At CL 5, a rampart can instead provide three-quarters cover to a creature directly behind it, but each 5-foot section used this way counts as two sections of your Set Shape.
TAL_WAX_WAX_TOMB:
#### Wax Tomb - Seal Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action. Range 60 feet. Cost 3 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
You attempt to seal one Large or smaller creature inside a wax sarcophagus, cocoon, pillar, or coffin. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it is Restrained and Blinded while sealed. On a success, it is not sealed, but the space it occupies becomes Soft Wax until the end of your next turn.
A sealed creature can use its Action to attempt a Strength saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC, breaking free on a success. The tomb can also be destroyed as a Set Wax object. A creature reduced to 0 hit points inside the tomb is stabilized rather than killed unless you choose to kindle the tomb with a Wick talent.
Wax Tomb is a containment technique. It does not suffocate a creature unless the GM rules the creature remains sealed long enough for that to matter.
TAL_WAX_WHITE_WAX_EDICT_OF_STILLNESS:
#### White Wax Edict of Stillness - Seal Talent
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action. Cost 5 CP. Duration Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Choose a 30-foot radius area within 120 feet. White wax seals spread across the ground, walls, weapons, and thresholds. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. The first time each round a hostile creature attempts to teleport, become invisible, change shape, or pass through a sealed threshold inside the area, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or the attempt fails and the creature becomes impressed by the wax until the end of its next turn.
On a successful save, the attempt works, but the creature still leaves a visible wax Impression at the point of departure.
TAL_WEAPONS_ARMAMENT_CONDUIT_INITIATE:
#### Armament Conduit Initiate - Conduit
Prerequisite: Weapons sphere and Qi Conduit Method
Choose one weapon with which you are proficient. It becomes your Conduit Weapon. You learn to circulate your cultivation through it, but you do not yet replace its attack and damage ability modifier.
TAL_WEAPONS_CASTING_HAND_WEAPON_METHOD:
#### Casting-Hand Weapon Method - Conduit
Prerequisite: Armament Conduit Initiate
When you attack with your Conduit Weapon, you may use your cultivation/casting modifier for attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity. Body Refiners use Constitution, Qi Cultivators use Intelligence or Charisma as appropriate, and Spirit Awakeners use Wisdom. A campaign spellcasting modifier may be used only if the GM allows it.
This does not grant additional proficiency, does not bypass ammunition or Loading, does not remove hand requirements, and does not make the weapon autonomous.
TAL_WEAPONS_PROFILE_LESSON:
#### Profile Lesson
When you gain a Foundation weapon specialty talent from this addendum, choose the listed legal weapon profile for that talent. The talent functions only with that profile unless the GM approves a near-identical weapon.
TAL_WEAPONS_PROFILE_SPECIALIST:
#### Profile Specialist - Profile
Prerequisite: Weapons sphere
Choose one legal weapon profile specialty talent from this addendum. Only one weapon specialty talent can modify a single attack, reaction, or damage packet.
TAL_WEATHER_BAROMETRIC_DISCIPLE:
#### Barometric Disciple
Prerequisite: Weather sphere
Your Read the Sky improves.
When you use Immediate Reading, you also learn the direction of the strongest weather change within 1 mile and whether a creature you can see is currently sustaining a weather, elemental, cloud, smoke, mist, fog, or storm effect by Concentration.
You have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival), Intelligence (Nature), or cultivation lore checks made to navigate, predict, or interpret weather.
TAL_WEATHER_BLIZZARD_SUN_FURNACE_MANDATE:
#### Blizzard-Sun Furnace Mandate
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Cold Sign or Heat Sign, Nascent Weather Mandate
When you create Cold severity 4 or Heat severity 4, you may give it a decisive mandate.
Blizzard Mandate: The area is heavily obscured by supernatural cold. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 cold damage and their Speed becomes 0 until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage and their Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of their next turn.
Sun Furnace Mandate: The area shimmers with supernatural heat. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 fire damage and cannot regain hit points until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage.
Damage from this talent cannot be healed until the creature leaves the severity 4 area or the severity drops below 4.
TAL_WEATHER_CLIMATE_SCRIPTURE:
#### Climate Scripture
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Foundation Weather Field
You can work slowly enough for weather to become travel, siege, harvest, or sect-territory pressure.
When you use Gather Weather with a 10-minute casting time, you may extend its duration to Concentration, up to 8 hours.
The radius becomes 1 mile if you spend 5 additional CP.
This long-duration weather obeys local climate, shelter, terrain, and GM adjudication. It can create environmental hazards, travel conditions, and social consequences, but it should not be used as a no-save city-killing button. Important NPCs, formations, sect arrays, and rival cultivators may resist, contest, shelter, or disperse it.
TAL_WEATHER_CORE_WEATHER_FIELD:
#### Core Weather Field
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Foundation Weather Field
Your Gather Weather improves again.
The radius becomes 60 feet.
When you gather a Weather Sign, you may create severity 3 weather if you spend 4 additional CP.
You may maintain up to two gathered Weather Signs in the same field if they are not opposed. For example, you may maintain Wind and Rain, Wind and Dry, Cold and Wind, Heat and Dry, or Rain and Cold. You cannot maintain Cold and Heat together or Rain and Dry together unless a specific talent says otherwise.
When two compatible signs share a field, your Shrouds of either sign count as being inside matching gathered weather.
TAL_WEATHER_COURT_OF_CHANGING_SKIES:
#### Court of Changing Skies
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Gather Weather
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
You establish a Weather Domain in which Heaven’s condition follows your breath.
When you create the Court, choose one Weather Sign you know. The area counts as gathered severity 2 weather of that sign.
At the start of each of your turns, choose one of the following:
change the Court to another Weather Sign you know;
increase the current sign by one severity, maximum severity 3;
reduce one opposed natural or magical weather category in the Court by one severity;
place a Sky Mantle on one willing creature in the Court without spending CP;
place a Cloud Shroud on one creature in the Court by spending 1 CP.
The Court follows Domain safeguards. It does not automatically override stronger Domains, sealed formations, divine weather, or Secret Inheritances.
TAL_WEATHER_DECREE_OF_CLEAR_HEAVEN:
#### Decree of Clear Heaven
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Mantle of Clear Skies
As an Action, spend 10 CP and choose a point within 300 feet.
In a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on that point, reduce one weather category by up to three severity steps. If this removes the support for a storm, the storm drops accordingly.
If the weather is sustained by another creature, that creature makes a saving throw using its relevant Sphere Save DC or other printed save DC. On a successful save, reduce the weather by only one severity step and you cannot use this talent against the same effect again until the end of your next turn.
Decree of Clear Heaven does not erase curses, disasters, divine punishments, tribulation weather, Secret Inheritance weather, or Realm-scale formations automatically. It contests them.
TAL_WEATHER_FOUNDATION_WEATHER_FIELD:
#### Foundation Weather Field
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Gather Weather
Your Gather Weather improves.
The radius becomes 30 feet.
When you gather a Weather Sign, you may create severity 2 weather if you spend 2 additional CP. Severity 2 weather follows the normal environmental meaning of that category, but combat damage, exhaustion, suffocation, and other severe hazards occur only when a talent says so or when the GM rules that prolonged exposure matters.
At the start of each of your turns while concentrating on Gather Weather, you may move the center of the field up to 20 feet to a point you can see.
TAL_WEATHER_FOUR_SEASON_REVERSAL:
#### Four-Season Reversal
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Twin-Season Conjunction
Once per long rest, when you would take damage or suffer a condition from a weather, elemental, climate, cloud, smoke, mist, storm, or environmental effect, use your Reaction to reverse your body’s season.
Choose one opposing pair.
Cold becomes Heat.
Heat becomes Cold.
Rain becomes Dry.
Dry becomes Rain.
Wind becomes Stillness.
Thunder becomes Silence.
You gain immunity to the triggering damage and condition until the end of the current turn. Then choose one creature within 60 feet. It makes a saving throw appropriate to the reversed sign.
On a failed save, it suffers the Shroud effect of the reversed sign as if you had placed Cloud Shroud on it without spending CP.
TAL_WEATHER_HEAVENLY_ROAD_THROUGH_RAIN_A:
#### Heavenly Road Through Rain and Wind
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Weather Road
While you maintain gathered Wind, Rain, Cold, Heat, or Dry, allies with your matching Sky Mantle gain one additional benefit while inside the field.
Wind: flying creatures do not need checks to fly through your wind unless the field is severity 4.
Rain: allies ignore light and heavy obscurity created by your rain, fog, or cloud.
Cold: allies do not slip, fall, or suffer Speed reduction from your ice or snow.
Heat: allies ignore mirage distortion and heat shimmer created by your weather.
Dry: allies ignore dust-based light obscurity and do not suffer dehydration from your weather.
Thunder: allies have Advantage on saving throws against lightning and thunder effects created by your storm.
TAL_WEATHER_HEAVEN_BREAKS_THE_BANNER:
#### Heaven Breaks the Banner
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Stormlord’s Finger
When you use Stormlord’s Finger inside a storm of severity 3 or higher, you may spend 6 additional CP to call a heaven-breaking bolt.
Choose a point inside the storm that you can see. Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point make a Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 lightning damage and is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not Stunned.
Objects, siege engines, ordinary buildings, and unattended metal structures take double damage. Formations, barriers, magic items, sect treasures, and Secret Inheritances use their normal defenses.
Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest.
TAL_WEATHER_LIGHTNING_CHOOSES_THE_ROD:
#### Lightning Chooses the Rod
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Thunder Sign
When a creature under your Thunder Shroud takes lightning or thunder damage from any source, you may move your Thunder Shroud to another creature within 30 feet of the original target without using an action.
The new target immediately makes the Shroud’s saving throw.
You may do this once per round.
TAL_WEATHER_LINGERING_MANTLE:
#### Lingering Mantle
Prerequisite: Sky Mantle
When you place Sky Mantle, you may spend 2 additional CP to make it last for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may have only one Lingering Mantle active at a time at Mortal Realm. If you create another, the previous one ends.
TAL_WEATHER_MANTLE_OF_CLEAR_SKIES:
#### Mantle of Clear Skies
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Sky Mantle
When you place Sky Mantle, you may choose Clear Skies instead of a Weather Sign.
The mantled creature treats nonmagical weather as one severity lower for the purpose of movement, visibility, environmental saving throws, and minor hazards.
At Core Formation, it treats weather as two severities lower.
This does not weaken the true weather for purposes of your Weather talents. A creature can be protected from the weather while you still use that weather as a sign.
TAL_WEATHER_NASCENT_WEATHER_MANDATE:
#### Nascent Weather Mandate
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Core Weather Field
Your Gather Weather reaches calamity scale under strict limits.
The radius becomes 120 feet for combat use.
When you gather weather, you may create severity 4 weather by spending 8 additional CP. Severity 4 weather requires Concentration, and you cannot make it persistent without a specific Secret Inheritance or GM-approved technique.
When you create severity 4 weather, choose creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus to be sheltered by your mandate. Sheltered creatures treat that weather as two severities lower for movement and environmental hazard purposes, but not for your Weather talents.
You may create severity 4 weather this way once per long rest. After doing so, you cannot create severity 4 weather again until you complete a long rest, even if you still have CP.
TAL_WEATHER_PERSISTENT_SHROUD:
#### Persistent Shroud
Prerequisite: Cloud Shroud
When you place Cloud Shroud, you may spend 2 additional CP to make it last for its remaining duration without Concentration.
A persistent Shroud ends after the target succeeds on three saving throws against it.
You may have only one Persistent Shroud active at a time at Mortal Realm. If you create another, the previous one ends.
TAL_WEATHER_PRESSURE_CRACKING_SHROUD:
#### Pressure-Cracking Shroud
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Severe Shroud
When a creature fails a saving throw against your Cloud Shroud while inside gathered weather of the same sign, you may spend 2 CP to crack its resistance to that weather.
Until the end of your next turn, the creature loses Resistance to the Shroud’s damage type. If it has immunity, this talent does not remove immunity, but the creature does not gain Advantage on saving throws from adaptation to ordinary weather of that sign.
TAL_WEATHER_QUICK_MANTLE:
#### Quick Mantle
Prerequisite: Weather sphere
When you place Sky Mantle as an Action by spending CP, you may instead place it as a Bonus Action.
Once per short rest, you may place a combat Sky Mantle without paying its base 1 CP cost. You must still pay any additional cost to force a sign that is not active.
TAL_WEATHER_RAIN_FOLLOWS_MANTLE_METHOD:
#### Rain-Follows-Mantle Method
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Rain Sign or Wind Sign
When a creature with your Sky Mantle moves at least 20 feet during its turn, you may use your Reaction to leave a 10-foot-wide trail of mist, drizzle, dust, heat shimmer, snow-flurry, or wind behind it until the start of your next turn.
Choose one Weather Sign active on the mantled creature. The trail counts as gathered severity 1 weather of that sign for Mantles and Shrouds, but it does not impose environmental hazards.
TAL_WEATHER_SCENT_OF_COMING_RAIN:
#### Scent of Coming Rain
Prerequisite: Read the Sky
You cannot be surprised by natural weather shifts, ordinary storms, fog banks, sudden rain, heat waves, cold fronts, or dust storms unless they are deliberately concealed by cultivation.
When initiative is rolled outdoors or in a space connected to open air, you may immediately use Battle Reading without an action.
TAL_WEATHER_SEVERE_SHROUD:
#### Severe Shroud
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Cloud Shroud
When you place a Cloud Shroud on a creature standing inside gathered weather of the same sign, the first saving throw it makes against that Shroud has Disadvantage.
If the target fails that saving throw, you may also apply one of the following until the start of your next turn.
Wind: the target is pushed 10 feet.
Rain: the target is doused and cannot take Reactions.
Cold: the target’s Speed becomes 0.
Heat: the target cannot regain hit points.
Dry: the target cannot benefit from temporary hit points.
Thunder: the target is Deafened and cannot take Reactions.
TAL_WEATHER_SHARED_WEATHER_FAVOR:
#### Shared Weather Favor
Prerequisite: Sky Mantle
When you place Sky Mantle, you may spend 1 additional CP to target one additional willing creature within 30 feet.
At Foundation Realm, you may spend 2 additional CP to target up to three additional willing creatures within 30 feet.
All targets must receive the same Weather Sign.
TAL_WEATHER_SHELTER_PIERCING_DRAFT:
#### Shelter-Piercing Draft
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Gather Weather
Your gathered weather can enter partially sheltered spaces such as open doorways, windowed rooms, broken ruins, tents, courtyards, caves with open mouths, and covered streets if air can move freely between the field and the space.
This does not bypass sealed rooms, airtight barriers, closed formations, or Total Cover.
TAL_WEATHER_SKY_BOUND_RANGE:
#### Sky-Bound Range
Prerequisite: Cloud Shroud or Gather Weather
Increase the range of Cloud Shroud and Gather Weather by 30 feet.
At Foundation Realm, increase the range by 60 feet instead.
At Core Formation, increase the range by 120 feet instead.
TAL_WEATHER_STORMLORD_S_FINGER:
#### Stormlord’s Finger
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Storm Birth
When a storm you gathered would create lightning, thunder, flying debris, or another random storm discharge, you choose the affected point instead of the GM choosing randomly.
As an Action while you maintain a storm field of severity 2 or higher, spend 3 CP and choose a point inside the storm that you can see.
Creatures within 5 feet of that point make a Dexterity saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature takes 6d10 lightning damage at storm severity 2, or 8d10 lightning damage at storm severity 3.
On a successful save, a creature takes half damage.
Once you use this Action, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn.
TAL_WEATHER_STORM_BIRTH:
#### Storm Birth
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Thunder Sign and Wind Sign; Rain Sign or Dry Sign
When your gathered Wind and gathered Rain or Dry overlap, they create a storm field. The storm severity equals the lower severity among Wind and Rain or Dry.
At storm severity 1, the area is charged. The first time each round a creature of your choice inside the area fails a saving throw against one of your Weather effects, it takes thunder damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
At storm severity 2 or higher, lightning and thunder may become dangerous if another talent releases them.
TAL_WEATHER_SUDDEN_SHIFT:
#### Sudden Shift
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Gather Weather
When you maintain Gather Weather, you may use a Bonus Action and spend 1 CP to change the gathered sign to another Weather Sign you know.
If the new sign opposes the old sign, reduce the old sign first as normal. This talent does not instantly turn supernatural heat into supernatural cold; it begins the shift and then obeys the severity rules.
TAL_WEATHER_TWIN_SEASON_CONJUNCTION:
#### Twin-Season Conjunction
Prerequisite: CL 10+, at least two Weather Sign talents
When you place a Sky Mantle or Cloud Shroud, you may spend 2 additional CP to bind two compatible Weather Signs into the same effect.
The target gains or suffers both signs.
Compatible pairs include Wind plus Rain, Wind plus Dry, Wind plus Cold, Wind plus Heat, Rain plus Cold, Rain plus Thunder, Dry plus Heat, Dry plus Thunder, and Wind plus Thunder.
Incompatible pairs include Cold plus Heat and Rain plus Dry unless another feature allows contradiction.
A creature can still have only one of your Mantles and one of your Shrouds. This talent changes what that single effect contains.
TAL_WEATHER_TYPHOON_HABOOB_GATE:
#### Typhoon-Haboob Gate
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Storm Birth, Core Weather Field
When you maintain Wind severity 4 and either Rain severity 4 or Dry severity 4 in the same area, you may open a typhoon or haboob gate.
Typhoon: Requires Wind and Rain. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 bludgeoning damage, are pushed 20 feet in a direction you choose, and fall Prone. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not pushed or knocked Prone.
Haboob: Requires Wind and Dry. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 3d8 slashing damage and are Poisoned until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not Poisoned.
Cover can protect against either effect at the GM’s discretion. Total Cover protects normally.
TAL_WEATHER_WEATHERPROOF_MANTLE:
#### Weatherproof Mantle
Prerequisite: Sky Mantle and any Weather Sign talent
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know. The Mantle effect of that sign also grants Resistance to one damage type while the sign is active.
Wind grants Resistance to nonmagical ranged weapon damage.
Rain grants Resistance to fire damage.
Cold grants Resistance to cold damage.
Heat grants Resistance to fire damage and Advantage on saves against cold weather hazards.
Dry grants Resistance to necrotic damage from desiccation and Advantage on saves against dehydration.
Thunder grants Resistance to lightning or thunder damage, chosen when the Mantle is placed.
You may take this talent more than once, choosing a different Weather Sign each time.
TAL_WEATHER_WEATHER_BACKLASH:
#### Weather Backlash
Prerequisite: Sky Mantle and any Weather Sign talent
When a creature with your Sky Mantle is hit by a melee attack while the Mantle’s sign is active, the attacker takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
The damage type depends on the Mantle.
Wind deals slashing or piercing damage.
Rain deals bludgeoning damage and douses the attacker until the start of its next turn.
Cold deals cold damage.
Heat deals fire damage.
Dry deals necrotic damage from desiccation.
Thunder deals lightning or thunder damage.
This damage can trigger only once per round per mantled creature.
TAL_WEATHER_WEATHER_BORROWING_MANTLE:
#### Weather-Borrowing Mantle
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Sky Mantle
When you place Sky Mantle, you may borrow one natural weather category at severity 1 or higher within 1 mile, even if it is outside your immediate battlefield.
The Mantle counts that sign as active for its duration.
If the borrowed weather is created or sustained by another cultivator, they may contest this with their own save DC or relevant cultivation check. On a successful contest, your Mantle still functions, but the borrowed sign ends at the end of your next turn unless you force it with CP.
TAL_WEATHER_WEATHER_CUT:
#### Weather Cut
Prerequisite: Any Weather Sign talent
Once per turn when you deal damage with a Weather Shroud, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of that Shroud.
If the target is standing inside gathered weather of the same sign, add twice your Proficiency Bonus instead.
TAL_WEATHER_WEATHER_EATS_CONCENTRATION:
#### Weather Eats Concentration
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Gather Weather
When a creature concentrating on a spell, sphere effect, technique, or similar ability starts its turn inside your gathered weather of severity 2 or higher, it must make a Constitution saving throw against your Weather Save DC if the weather plausibly disrupts it.
On a failed save, it loses Concentration.
The GM may rule that certain effects are not meaningfully disrupted by a given weather sign. For example, a stone-rooted earth technique may not care about mist, but a paper talisman formation may care greatly about rain and wind.
TAL_WEATHER_WEATHER_ROAD:
#### Weather Road
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Wind Sign, Rain Sign, Cold Sign, Heat Sign, or Dry Sign
While you maintain Gather Weather, allies with one of your Sky Mantles can move through your gathered weather without suffering difficult terrain, light obscurity, or disadvantage from that weather.
If the Mantle sign matches the gathered weather, the ally also gains +10 feet Speed while inside the field.
TAL_WRESTLING_BODY_LOCK:
#### Body Lock - Hold
Prerequisite: CL 5+
While moving a creature Grappled by you, ignore the additional movement cost from the Grappled condition when one of the following is true:
the target is smaller than you;
you hold Martial Focus;
you move no more than half your Speed during the turn.
Body Lock does not allow movement through illegal spaces or ignore terrain.
TAL_WRESTLING_CAPTURE_SPECIALIST:
#### Capture Specialist - Capture
Prerequisite: Pin, CL 7+
When binding one creature Restrained through Pin:
use the required Utilize action as a Bonus Action instead;
gain Advantage on the item’s binding check;
draw or ready the Rope, Chain, Manacles, or similar restraint as part of the same Bonus Action.
Capture Specialist does not replace the item’s normal size restrictions or escape rules.
TAL_WRESTLING_CHOKE_HOLD:
#### Choke Hold - Slam
The target cannot breathe or speak.
It cannot supply Verbal components.
If you apply Choke Hold to the same creature on consecutive rounds, the target is choking.
At the end of each of its turns while choking, it gains one Exhaustion level from suffocation.
When the target can breathe again, it removes all Exhaustion levels gained solely from this Choke Hold.
Creatures that do not need to breathe are immune.
TAL_WRESTLING_CLINCH_REVERSAL:
#### Clinch Reversal - Focus, Hold
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack or fails an attempt to Grapple or Shove you
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Attempt to Grapple the triggering creature.
The target makes its saving throw normally.
TAL_WRESTLING_EARTH_SHATTERING_SLAM:
#### Earth-Shattering Slam - Throw
Prerequisite: Berserker sphere Shatter Earth, Living Weapon, CL 5+
When using a creature as a Living Weapon, strike the ground through Shatter Earth.
The creature used as your Living Weapon makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save:
the grapple ends;
the creature becomes Restrained in the broken ground.
Successful Save:
the grapple ends;
the creature falls Prone in one legal adjacent space.
A Restrained creature may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, choosing which, against your Wrestling Save DC.
Successful Check: End the Restrained condition.
TAL_WRESTLING_GRANDSTANDING_SLAM:
#### Grandstanding Slam - Focus
Whenever you apply a Slam talent, expend Martial Focus.
Each hostile creature other than the Slammed creature that can see you makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Become Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Become immune to your Grandstanding Slam until you complete a short or long rest.
TAL_WRESTLING_GROUND_GAME:
#### Ground Game - Hold
When you begin your turn grappling one creature, use a Bonus Action to force that creature to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which.
Failed Save: Become Prone.
Successful Save: Remain standing.
When one creature successfully grapples you, use your Reaction to force it to make the same saving throw.
TAL_WRESTLING_HAMMERLOCK:
#### Hammerlock - Slam, Hold
Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on checks made to escape your grapple.
TAL_WRESTLING_HARD_WHIP:
#### Hard Whip - Slam, Throw
End the grapple.
Move the target up to 10 feet in one legal direction other than directly upward.
This forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
TAL_WRESTLING_HEAVEN_LIFTING_THROW:
#### Heaven-Lifting Throw - Throw
Prerequisite: Mountain-Crashing Suplex, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Target: One creature Grappled by you
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
End the grapple and throw the target up to 60 feet in one legal direction.
Ignore ordinary size limits.
The target and creatures within 10 feet of its landing space make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 8d10 Bludgeoning or Force damage and become Prone.
Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing.
The thrown target automatically fails if it collides with a solid surface before landing.
Heaven-Lifting Throw does not automatically move:
artifacts;
Formation cores;
Domains;
creatures protected by a stronger immovability effect.
Those may require a contested Cultivation Check.
TAL_WRESTLING_HEEL_TACTICS:
#### Heel Tactics - Slam
Expend Martial Focus.
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Become Blinded until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
TAL_WRESTLING_LAST_CHANCE_GRAPPLE:
#### Last Chance Grapple - Focus
When one creature succeeds on its saving throw against your Unarmed Strike Grapple option, expend Martial Focus.
Use a Bonus Action before the end of your turn to attempt to Grapple the same creature again.
TAL_WRESTLING_LIVING_WEAPON:
#### Living Weapon - Slam, Throw
You may use a creature Grappled by you as an improvised melee weapon until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends.
The creature must be no larger than you, including effects that increase your effective size for grappling.
You are proficient with the wielded creature.
Use Strength for its attack and damage rolls.
##### Hand Requirements
| Relative Size of Grappled Creature | Hand Requirement | Weapon Property |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At least two sizes smaller than you | One hand | Light |
| One size smaller than you | One hand | None |
| Same size as you | Two hands | Two-Handed |
You must continue using the body part maintaining the grapple and satisfy any additional hand requirement.
If you cannot satisfy the requirement, you cannot attack with the creature as a Living Weapon.
##### Living Weapon Damage
| Grappled Creature Size | Damage Die |
| --- | --- |
| Tiny | 1d4 |
| Small | 1d6 |
| Medium | 1d8 |
| Large | 1d10 |
| Huge | 2d6 |
| Gargantuan | 3d6 |
On a hit:
roll the listed damage die plus your Strength modifier;
the attacked creature takes that Bludgeoning damage;
the creature used as your Living Weapon takes the same Bludgeoning damage;
apply Resistance, Immunity, and other damage modifiers separately to each creature.
