TAL_YANG_APPLYING_A_RISING_MARK:
#### Applying a Rising Mark
You can apply a Rising Mark in three basic ways.
Kindle the Rising. As a Bonus Action, choose yourself or one willing creature, unattended object, or ongoing effect you created within 60 feet that you can perceive. The target gains one Kindled Mark.
Force the Rising. As a Reaction when a creature, object, or effect within 60 feet that you can perceive hits with an attack, forces a saving throw, regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, spends CP, uses a spell slot, uses a limited feature, teleports, becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or moves at least 10 feet during its turn, you may apply one Overkindled Mark to the source after the triggering event resolves.
Rising Thread. As an Action, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against one creature or object within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes Fire, Radiant, or Force damage, chosen when you make the attack, and gains one Overkindled Mark.
| Cultivation Level | Rising Thread Damage |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 1d6 |
| CL 5-10 | 2d6 |
| CL 11-16 | 3d6 |
| CL 17-20 | 4d6 |
The damage is not the sphere’s identity. It is the visible symptom of qi becoming too bright, too hot, or too forceful to remain unfinished.
TAL_YANG_BASE_SPHERE_ABILITIES:
### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES
The Yang sphere uses Rising Marks. A Rising Mark is not a condition. Immunity to a condition does not grant immunity to Rising Marks unless a feature says otherwise.
A Rising Mark represents a motion, wound, breath, oath, technique, or intention that has begun to swell toward completion.
#### Mark Limit
You can maintain a number of Rising Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature, object, or ongoing effect can have only one Rising Mark from you at a time unless a feature says otherwise.
A Rising Mark lasts until the end of your next turn, until you spend it, or until the marked subject is no longer on the same plane of existence as you.
#### Kindled and Overkindled Marks
A Rising Mark has one of two expressions.
Kindled Mark. A Rising Mark on you, a willing creature, an unattended object, or an effect you created is a Kindled Mark. You spend Kindled Marks to help an action complete.
Overkindled Mark. A Rising Mark on an unwilling creature, hostile object, enemy effect, or creature that rejects your assistance is an Overkindled Mark. You spend Overkindled Marks to make hostile exertion overcomplete, exposing or straining the source.
A willing creature may end your Rising Mark on itself at any time, no Action required.
#### Applying a Rising Mark
You can apply a Rising Mark in three basic ways.
Kindle the Rising. As a Bonus Action, choose yourself or one willing creature, unattended object, or ongoing effect you created within 60 feet that you can perceive. The target gains one Kindled Mark.
Force the Rising. As a Reaction when a creature, object, or effect within 60 feet that you can perceive hits with an attack, forces a saving throw, regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, spends CP, uses a spell slot, uses a limited feature, teleports, becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or moves at least 10 feet during its turn, you may apply one Overkindled Mark to the source after the triggering event resolves.
Rising Thread. As an Action, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against one creature or object within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes Fire, Radiant, or Force damage, chosen when you make the attack, and gains one Overkindled Mark.
| Cultivation Level | Rising Thread Damage |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 1d6 |
| CL 5-10 | 2d6 |
| CL 11-16 | 3d6 |
| CL 17-20 | 4d6 |
The damage is not the sphere’s identity. It is the visible symptom of qi becoming too bright, too hot, or too forceful to remain unfinished.
#### Spending a Rising Mark
Once per round, when a marked subject you can perceive performs a triggering act, you may spend its Rising Mark without using an Action. Choose one Completing Response appropriate to the mark.
#### Kindled Responses
You may use these responses when you spend a Kindled Mark.
Complete Force.
Trigger: the marked subject deals damage. Add 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier to one damage roll. This bonus increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
Complete Aim.
Trigger: the marked subject makes an attack roll or forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw. Add 1d4 to the attack roll, or choose one target making the saving throw and subtract 1d4 from that saving throw. At CL 11, the die becomes 1d6.
Complete Step.
Trigger: the marked subject begins movement during its turn. Increase one of the subject’s Speeds by 10 feet until the end of the current turn, or allow it to stand from Prone without spending movement. At CL 11, the Speed increase becomes 20 feet.
Complete Breath.
Trigger: the marked subject regains Hit Points or gains Temporary HP. Increase the amount gained by your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier.
Complete Resolve.
Trigger: the marked subject makes a saving throw against an effect that would reduce its Speed, prevent it from taking Reactions, impose Frightened, Paralyzed, Restrained, Stunned, or Unconscious, or suppress its ability to act. Add 1d4 to the saving throw. At CL 11, the die becomes 1d6.
Complete Revelation.
Trigger: the marked subject makes an attack roll, Wisdom (Perception) check, or Intelligence (Investigation) check against a creature or effect that is Hidden, Invisible, heavily obscured, disguised by illusion, or concealed by a Yin-like technique. The marked subject ignores Disadvantage from not seeing the target for that roll, provided it can still identify the target’s space or general location.
#### Overkindled Responses
You may use these responses when you spend an Overkindled Mark.
Overheat Force.
Trigger: the marked subject deals damage, makes an attack roll, or forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw. After the triggering act resolves, the subject takes Fire or Radiant damage equal to 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier. This damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
Overexpose.
Trigger: the marked subject becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or benefits from a feature that prevents others from perceiving it. Until the start of your next turn, the subject cannot benefit from being Hidden or Invisible against you, and allies you choose within 60 feet know the subject’s current space if they can perceive the area.
Overcommit Step.
Trigger: the marked subject moves at least 10 feet, teleports, or uses special movement. After the movement resolves, the subject cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. If the movement was teleportation and the destination is within 120 feet of you, you know the destination space.
Overgrown Recovery.
Trigger: the marked subject regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, restores CP, or benefits from regeneration. Until the start of your next turn, the first damage roll against that subject gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Overstrain Technique.
Trigger: the marked subject spends CP, uses a spell slot, activates a limited feature, or uses a named cultivation technique. If the subject uses the same named spell, sphere talent, forged technique, monster action, or cultivation ability again before the end of its next turn, it gains a Rising Mark immediately after the repeated ability resolves.
#### Yang Saves
Some Yang features require a saving throw. Unless a feature says otherwise, your Cultivation Save DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
TAL_YANG_COMPLETING_FLAME_MANTLE:
#### Completing Flame Mantle
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
You wrap yourself in rising heat, bright breath, and surplus meridian force. For the duration:
when you use Kindle the Rising on yourself, you may also apply a Kindled Mark to one willing creature within 10 feet;
once per turn when you spend a Kindled Mark with Complete Force, the bonus damage may be Fire, Radiant, or Force damage;
a creature that starts its turn Grappling you takes Fire or Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier;
you emit bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet.
Completing Flame Mantle does not count as sunlight.
TAL_YANG_DAWN_COMMANDS_THE_FALLEN_BREATH:
#### Dawn Commands the Fallen Breath
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet would die
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
The target drops to 1 Hit Point instead of dying and gains a Kindled Mark that lasts for 1 minute. It may immediately stand if Prone.
Until the end of the target’s next turn:
its Speed increases by 20 feet;
Opportunity Attacks against it are made with Disadvantage;
the first time it hits with an attack or forces a creature to fail a saving throw, it may spend its Kindled Mark with Complete Force or Complete Aim without counting against your once-per-round limit.
This cannot protect a creature whose soul is destroyed, whose body is completely annihilated, or whose death is caused by an effect that explicitly prevents death prevention or revival.

#### Dawn Refuses Restraint
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Kindled Mark with Complete Resolve
Cost: None
If the marked creature succeeds on the triggering saving throw, it may also end one effect currently reducing one of its Speeds or preventing it from taking Reactions, provided that effect is not from a higher Realm, Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation, curse, or narrative seal.
If no such effect can end, the marked creature gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
TAL_YANG_FORCE_COMPLETION:
#### Force Completion
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Kindled Mark with Complete Force
Cost: 2 CP
After the triggering damage resolves, choose one target damaged by the attack or effect. Push that target up to 10 feet directly away from the source of the damage.
If the target is more than one size larger than the source, it makes a Strength saving throw. On a successful save, it is not pushed.
TAL_YANG_FURNACE_BACKLASH:
#### Furnace Backlash
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend an Overkindled Mark with Overheat Force
Cost: 1 CP
The marked creature must make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
On a successful save, it takes no additional effect beyond Overheat Force.

Cost: 4 CP

Range: Self
Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

When an enemy in the area becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or benefits from magical darkness, you may apply an Overkindled Mark to that enemy without using your Reaction. You can do this once per round.

#### No Shelter for Stagnation

Trigger: You apply an Overkindled Mark to a creature that has not willingly moved since the end of its last turn
Cost: None

the damage from Overheat Force increases by your Proficiency Bonus;
Overcommit Step reduces the creature’s Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn after the triggering movement resolves;

Trigger: You spend an Overkindled Mark with Overexpose or Overcommit Step
Cost: None

Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend an Overkindled Mark

TAL_YANG_SEAL_BREAKING_WARMTH:

Trigger: You spend a Kindled Mark with Complete Resolve or Complete Step
Cost: 2 CP
The marked creature may immediately repeat one saving throw against an effect currently reducing its Speed, preventing it from taking Reactions, making it Restrained, making it Paralyzed, making it Stunned, or preventing it from willingly moving.

#### Solar Pursuit
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend an Overkindled Mark with Overexpose
Cost: 2 CP
Until the end of your next turn, you know the marked creature’s direction while it remains within 300 feet of you, even if it later becomes Hidden or Invisible.
This does not reveal the creature through planar boundaries, sealed Barriers, lead-lined vaults, anti-divination effects, or superior concealment.
TAL_YANG_SOVEREIGN_YANG_INCARNATION:
#### Sovereign Yang Incarnation
“I do not chase dawn. I am the command that makes the horizon answer.”
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Not required
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
You become a sovereign vessel of assertive completion. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:
Your Mark Limit doubles.
Once on each of your turns, you may use Kindle the Rising without using a Bonus Action.
You may spend Rising Marks twice per round instead of once per round.
When you spend a Kindled Mark, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + Key Ability modifier; move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; or emit bright light in a 20-foot radius until the start of your next turn.
When you spend an Overkindled Mark, the marked creature cannot benefit from being Hidden or Invisible against you until the start of its next turn.

Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: 24 hours

Cost: None

Trigger: You spend a Kindled Mark with Complete Aim
Cost: None

TAL_YANG_SURPLUS_STEP:

TAL_YANG_TEN_THOUSAND_MOTIONS_BECOME_NOO:

Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
You create an area where all hidden momentum is pulled toward expression. While in the area:

enemies that start their turn Hidden, Invisible, heavily obscured, or under an illusion gain one Overkindled Mark;

#### Twofold Rising

Cost: 2 CP

Area: 10-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You place a Kindled Mark on an area containing soil, roots, seeds, moss, fertile mud, living wood, or another suitable natural medium. The area swells with summer pressure and impatient growth.
Choose one mode when you use the talent.
Grasping Bloom. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. When a hostile creature starts its turn in the area, it gains an Overkindled Mark.
Nourishing Bloom. Allies that start their turns in the area gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature can gain these Temporary HP only once per turn.
Unfinished Bloom does not create permanent plant structures or replace the Wood sphere.
TAL_YANG_YANG_SAVES:
#### Yang Saves
Some Yang features require a saving throw. Unless a feature says otherwise, your Cultivation Save DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
TAL_YIN_BASE_SPHERE_ABILITIES:
### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES
The Yin sphere uses Waning Marks. A Waning Mark is not a condition. Immunity to a condition does not grant immunity to Waning Marks unless a feature says otherwise.
A Waning Mark represents a motion, technique, wound, breath, or intention that has begun to decline before it finishes expressing itself.
#### Mark Limit
You can maintain a number of Waning Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature can have only one Waning Mark from you at a time unless a feature says otherwise.
A Waning Mark lasts until the end of your next turn, until you spend it, or until the marked creature is no longer on the same plane of existence as you.
#### Marking a Creature
You can apply a Waning Mark in three basic ways.
Mark the Waning. As a Bonus Action, choose one creature within 60 feet that you can see, hear, or otherwise perceive clearly. The target gains one Waning Mark.
Receive Overextension. As a Reaction when a creature within 60 feet that you can perceive hits with an attack, forces a saving throw, regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, spends CP, uses a spell slot, teleports, or moves at least 10 feet during its turn, you may apply one Waning Mark to that creature after the triggering event resolves.
Withdrawing Thread. As an Action, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against one creature or object within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes Cold or Necrotic damage, chosen when you make the attack, and gains one Waning Mark.
| Cultivation Level | Withdrawing Thread Damage |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 1d6 |
| CL 5-10 | 2d6 |
| CL 11-16 | 3d6 |
| CL 17-20 | 4d6 |
The damage is not the sphere’s identity. It is the visible symptom of qi cooling as the target’s action begins to wane.
#### Spending a Waning Mark
Once per round, when a marked creature you can perceive performs a triggering act, you may spend its Waning Mark without using an Action. Choose one Diminishing Response appropriate to the trigger.
**Diminish Force**
Trigger: the marked creature deals damage. Reduce one damage roll by 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier. This reduction increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
**Diminish Aim**
Trigger: the marked creature makes an attack roll. Subtract 1d4 from the attack roll. At CL 11, subtract 1d6 instead.
**Diminish Power**
Trigger: the marked creature forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw. Choose one creature making that saving throw. The chosen creature adds 1d4 to the saving throw. At CL 11, the bonus becomes 1d6.
**Diminish Step**
Trigger: the marked creature begins movement, including teleportation. Reduce one of the creature’s Speeds by 10 feet until the end of the current turn, or reduce the distance of one teleportation effect by 10 feet. At CL 11, the reduction becomes 20 feet.
**Diminish Recovery**
Trigger: the marked creature regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, restores CP, or benefits from regeneration. Reduce the amount gained or restored by your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier, to a minimum of 0.
**Diminish Readiness**
Trigger: the marked creature takes a Reaction or would gain Advantage on a roll. The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, or the triggering Advantage is canceled for that roll.
#### Yin Saves
Some Yin features require a saving throw. Unless a feature says otherwise, your Cultivation Save DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
#### Marked Allies
You may place a Waning Mark on a willing ally. When you do, the mark represents preservation rather than harm. You may spend that mark only for Diminish Force, Diminish Power, Diminish Step, or Diminish Recovery if doing so benefits the ally.
A willing creature may end your Waning Mark on itself at any time, no Action required.
TAL_YIN_BORROWED_CONSEQUENCE:
#### Borrowed Consequence
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You reduce damage with Diminish Force
Cost: None
You gain Temporary HP equal to half the damage reduced, rounded down. These Temporary HP vanish at the start of your next turn.
If the triggering damage was Fire, Radiant, Thunder, or Yang-aspected, add your Proficiency Bonus to the Temporary HP gained.
TAL_YIN_GRAVE_QUIET_ARCHIVIST:
#### Grave-Quiet Archivist
Action Type: Passive
Cost: None
When you use Moonlit Preservation on a corpse, record, herb, beast core, alchemical ingredient, spiritual remnant, weapon, talisman, or scene of violence, you may also preserve one clear trace connected to it. Examples include the last scent on a cloak, the final wound pattern on a corpse, the color of qi in a broken talisman, or the taste of poison in a cup.
A creature examining the preserved subject has Advantage on one Investigation, Medicine, Nature, Arcana, Survival, or appropriate skill check related to that preserved evidence.
TAL_YIN_INCOMPLETE_DEPARTURE:
#### Incomplete Departure
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A marked creature within 90 feet teleports, enters another plane, becomes incorporeal, or uses a feature that would move it without crossing the intervening distance
Cost: 6 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
Spend the creature’s Waning Mark. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the movement is diminished. The target completes only half the distance, rounded down to the nearest 5 feet, and must appear in the nearest unoccupied legal space along the intended path or at the nearest legal partial destination. If no legal partial destination exists, the movement fails.
On a successful save, the movement succeeds, but the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
This feature cannot interrupt a Secret Inheritance, divine intervention, artifact effect, or higher-Realm spatial technique unless the GM rules your Yin cultivation is an appropriate counter.

TAL_YIN_MOONLIT_PRESERVATION:
#### Moonlit Preservation
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 2 CP
You preserve one corpse, herb bundle, beast core, food supply, alchemical ingredient, fragile object, document, wound pattern, footprint, bloodstain, scent trace, or Small room. The subject does not rot, decay, spoil, dry out, mold, fade, or lose ordinary potency for the duration.
At CL 10, the duration becomes 7 days. At CL 15, the duration becomes 30 days.
Moonlit Preservation does not restore life, repair destroyed objects, halt a soul’s departure, or prevent magical corruption unless another feature says so.
TAL_YIN_MOON_DRAWN_STEP:
#### Moon-Drawn Step
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark with Diminish Step
Cost: None
After the Diminish Step effect resolves, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
If you end this movement in Dim Light, Darkness, behind cover, or in an area of concealment created by a Yin feature, you may immediately take the Hide action as part of the same movement.
TAL_YIN_MOON_ENDING_MERIDIAN_SEAL:
#### Moon-Ending Meridian Seal
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
Choose one creature within range that currently has one of your Waning Marks. Choose one trait you know the target possesses: a damage Resistance, condition Resistance, movement mode, sense, regeneration trait, healing trait, or CP recovery trait.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, apply one appropriate suppression effect:
| Known Trait | Suppression Effect |
| --- | --- |
| Damage Resistance | The target loses that Resistance. |
| Condition Resistance | The target loses that condition Resistance. |
| Movement mode | The chosen movement mode is reduced by 20 feet, minimum 0. |
| Sense | The chosen sense’s range is reduced by 20 feet, minimum 0. |
| Regeneration or healing trait | The target cannot use that trait to regain Hit Points. |
| CP recovery trait | The target reduces CP recovered from that trait by your Proficiency Bonus + Key Ability modifier. |
At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
A creature can be affected by only one Moon-Ending Meridian Seal from you at a time.
This talent cannot remove Immunity unless the target is lower Realm than you or a Secret Inheritance, artifact, or GM-approved countermeasure allows it.
TAL_YIN_NO_DAWN_IN_THE_WOUND:
#### No Dawn in the Wound
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Saving Throw: Constitution
Choose one creature that currently has one of your Waning Marks. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, the Waning Mark becomes a Dormant Wound for the duration. The first time each round that the target regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, restores CP, or benefits from regeneration, reduce the amount by your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier.
At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
On a successful initial save, the Waning Mark remains, but the effect ends.
TAL_YIN_NO_DAWN_REPEATS_ITSELF:
#### No Dawn Repeats Itself
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: A creature inside your Yin Domain or affected by one of your Waning Marks uses the same named spell, sphere talent, forged technique, monster action, or cultivation ability on consecutive turns
Cost: 8 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the repeated ability fails to activate, but the target does not spend CP, spell slots, charges, or limited uses for the failed attempt. The action used to attempt it is still spent.
On a successful save, the ability functions normally, but the target gains a Waning Mark after it resolves and cannot benefit from Advantage until the start of its next turn.
This is a high-Realm anti-repetition technique. It does not prevent basic weapon attacks unless the attack is part of a named technique or special action.
TAL_YIN_PATIENT_MOON_METHOD:
#### Patient Moon Method
Action Type: Passive
Cost: None
When you apply a Waning Mark to a creature and do not spend it before the end of your next turn, you may either move the mark to another creature within 30 feet of the original target or extend the mark’s duration until the end of your following turn.
You can use this talent once per round.
TAL_YIN_PRESERVE_THE_UNFINISHED_STATE:
#### Preserve the Unfinished State
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature, object, corpse, wound, spell residue, Formation trace, or spiritual imprint within 60 feet would decay, vanish, close, disperse, or become impossible to examine
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 5 CP
You preserve the subject in its current unfinished state. The subject does not heal, rot, fade, disperse, close, or become further corrupted for the duration.
This can preserve evidence, hold open a wound for later diagnosis, maintain a fading magical aura long enough to study it, or delay the collapse of a spiritual imprint.
This does not keep a living creature alive, prevent damage, restrain a target, or stop a hostile effect from functioning unless another feature says so.
At CL 15, you may spend 10 CP to extend the duration to 24 hours.
TAL_YIN_PRESERVING_YIN:
#### Preserving Yin
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A willing creature within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright
Cost: 2 CP
You place a Waning Mark on the triggering creature and suspend the final collapse of its breath. The creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead of 0. Until the start of your next turn, it cannot regain Hit Points, but damage it takes is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Once a creature benefits from Preserving Yin, it cannot benefit from your Preserving Yin again until it finishes a Long Rest.
TAL_YIN_QUIET_RECEPTION:
#### Quiet Reception
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet that you can perceive misses you or an ally with an attack roll
Cost: None
You receive the failed motion and mark its decline. The triggering creature gains one Waning Mark.
If the attack missed because of Disadvantage, concealment, cover, or a penalty imposed by one of your Yin features, the mark lasts for 1 minute instead of until the end of your next turn.
TAL_YIN_RETURN_THE_OVEREXTENSION:
#### Return the Overextension
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You reduce damage with Diminish Force
Cost: 2 CP
The creature whose damage you reduced takes Psychic, Cold, or Necrotic damage equal to the amount reduced, to a maximum of 3 x your CL.
This damage represents the creature’s excess force returning inward through its own meridians.
TAL_YIN_SEAL_THE_REPETITION:
#### Seal the Repetition
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark from a creature that used a named spell, sphere talent, forged technique, monster action, or cultivation ability
Cost: 3 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target cannot use the same named spell, sphere talent, forged technique, monster action, or cultivation ability again until the end of its next turn.
On a successful save, the target can repeat the ability, but if it does so before the end of its next turn, it gains a Waning Mark immediately after the repeated ability resolves.
TAL_YIN_SILENCE_RECEIVES_THE_NAME:
#### Silence Receives the Name
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You use The Quiet After Speech
Cost: 2 CP
The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, until the start of its next turn, it cannot use verbal components or activate techniques that require a spoken command, chant, kiai, mantra, or audible oath.
On a successful save, the target can still speak and use verbal requirements, but its voice cannot be heard more than 10 feet away until the start of its next turn.
This feature does not create an area of silence.
TAL_YIN_SOVEREIGN_YIN_INCARNATION:
#### Sovereign Yin Incarnation
“I do not chase the world. The world tires, and returns to me.”
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Not required
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
You become a sovereign vessel of receptive stillness. For the duration, you gain the following benefits:
Your Mark Limit doubles.
Once on each of your turns, you may use Mark the Waning without using a Bonus Action.
You may spend Waning Marks twice per round instead of once per round.
When you spend a Waning Mark, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + Key Ability modifier; move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; or become Lightly Obscured until the start of your next turn.
A creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of you while marked by you must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot take Reactions and its Speed is reduced by 20 feet until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Sovereign Yin Incarnation does not create darkness or silence by itself. It is the pressure of motion returning to stillness.

TAL_YIN_STILLNESS_HAS_TEETH:
#### Stillness Has Teeth
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark
Cost: 1 CP
The marked creature takes Cold or Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier.
This damage is a consequence of the mark collapsing. It is deliberately modest: the talent rewards repeated diminishing without turning Yin into a primary damage sphere.
TAL_YIN_STILL_THE_BRIGHT_STRIKE:
#### Still the Bright Strike
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark with Diminish Force or Diminish Aim
Cost: None
A pale chill gathers around the target’s attacking limb, weapon, spell focus, breath, or qi channel. The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
This cannot reduce Speed below 0.
TAL_YIN_THE_QUIET_AFTER_SPEECH:
#### The Quiet After Speech
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark from a creature that spoke, shouted, used a verbal spell component, issued a command, or activated a sound-based technique during the current turn
Cost: 1 CP
The target’s voice trails into stillness. Until the start of its next turn, it has Disadvantage on Charisma checks relying on speech, and creatures more than 30 feet away cannot hear its voice unless it uses magical amplification or a cultivation technique with a higher CL than yours.
This does not prevent verbal components by itself. At Foundation Realm, you may take Silence Receives the Name to make this effect stronger.
TAL_YIN_THE_STILL_CORPSE_REMEMBERS:
#### The Still Corpse Remembers
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: Until your next Long Rest
Cost: 10 CP
Touch a corpse, severed limb, destroyed construct, broken talisman, shattered weapon, spent Formation node, or collapsed spiritual remnant. You preserve its final state and draw one answer from the stillness.
Ask the GM one question about the subject’s final hour, final injury, final technique, final owner, final command, final emotion, final destination, or final visible enemy. The answer must be brief but truthful from the subject’s available traces.
This does not speak with the dead, summon a soul, compel a spirit, or reveal information the subject left no trace of knowing.
TAL_YIN_THE_WORLD_RECEIVES_THE_BLOW:
#### The World Receives the Blow
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 120 feet deals damage to two or more creatures with the same effect
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per Long Rest
You spread the consequence of the attack into the receptive world. Choose a number of damaged creatures up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1. Reduce the damage each chosen creature takes by 4d10 + your CL.
The damaging creature gains a Waning Mark. If the effect dealt Fire, Radiant, Thunder, or Yang-aspected damage, the mark lasts for 1 minute.
TAL_YIN_TWOFOLD_WANING:
#### Twofold Waning
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: 2 CP
Use Mark the Waning against two different creatures within range instead of one.
Until the end of your next turn, the first time you spend a Waning Mark from either target, you may immediately move the other mark to a creature within 30 feet of the second marked target.
TAL_YIN_VEIL_OF_WANING_BREATH:
#### Veil of Waning Breath
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You create an area of inward-turning breath, cold haze, and spiritual quiet. The area is Lightly Obscured.
When a creature inside the area gains a Waning Mark, you may choose for the area to become Heavily Obscured for that creature until the start of your next turn. This heavier concealment represents the world withdrawing from the marked creature’s attention; it does not automatically make any creature Hidden.
A creature with Blindsight, Truesight, or an appropriate revealing technique may ignore this concealment within that sense or technique’s range.
TAL_YIN_WOUND_THAT_REFUSES_DAWN:
#### Wound That Refuses Dawn
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You spend a Waning Mark with Diminish Recovery
Cost: None
The target’s recovery continues to wane. Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target would regain Hit Points or gain Temporary HP, reduce that amount by your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 11, the reduction applies to each instance of healing or Temporary HP the target receives before the start of your next turn.
TAL_YIN_YIN_DOMAIN_COURT_OF_WANING_RETUR:
#### Yin Domain: Court of Waning Return
“Within my court, every bright act must bow before its ending.”
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
You establish a Domain where actions begin to return to stillness before they fully complete.
While inside the Domain, you gain the following benefits:
Your Mark Limit increases by your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1.
Once per round, when an enemy inside the Domain hits with an attack, forces a saving throw, regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, spends CP, uses a spell slot, teleports, or moves at least 10 feet during its turn, you may apply a Waning Mark to that enemy without using your Reaction.
When you spend a Waning Mark from an enemy inside the Domain, the enemy takes Cold or Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Enemies inside the Domain suffer the following effects:
they cannot benefit from Advantage against you while they have one of your Waning Marks;
the first time each round they repeat the same named spell, sphere talent, forged technique, monster action, or cultivation ability they used on their previous turn, they gain one Waning Mark after the repeated ability resolves;
if they begin their turn with a Waning Mark, their Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of their next turn.
The Domain is not darkness or silence. It may appear as moonless stillness, pale frost, a muffled court, or ink-black breath, but its mechanics are the waning of repeated force.
TAL_YIN_YIN_SAVES:
#### Yin Saves
Some Yin features require a saving throw. Unless a feature says otherwise, your Cultivation Save DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
TAL_YIN_YIN_SINKING_STEP:
#### Yin Sinking Step
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: Until the end of the current turn
Cost: 2 CP
Until the end of your turn, you can move through spaces occupied by marked creatures, and marked creatures cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you.
If you spend a Waning Mark during this movement, you may move through one solid object or barrier no more than 5 feet thick. This movement is not teleportation. If you end your turn inside an object, you are shunted to the nearest unoccupied space and take 2d10 Force damage.
This feature cannot pass through a ward, Formation, Barrier, or sealed boundary designed to block incorporeal or spiritual movement unless your CL exceeds the effect’s CL or the GM rules otherwise.
THREAD_BASE_DRAW_THE_LINE:
#### Base Ability - Draw the Line
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or replace one attack when you take the Attack action
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_DRAW_THE_LINE->action, ATTACK_REPLACEMENT_DRAW_THE_LINE->action
Range: Mundane 20 feet, Qi Thread 30 feet.
Cost: None for mundane thread if you have thread stock; 1 CP for Qi Thread or to ignore mundane stock.
Target: One creature, object, weapon, surface, or unattended item within range.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack. On a hit, you create a Thread Line between yourself or an anchor you control and the target. The line lasts until the end of your next turn. Choose one basic effect.
Pull: Move the target 5 feet toward you or toward the anchor if it is your size or smaller. Larger creatures are not moved unless they fail a Strength saving throw.
Snare: The target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Guide: The next attack roll you make against the target before the end of your next turn ignores half cover.
Trip: The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. This option requires the target to be no more than one size larger than you.
Disarm: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one held object of your choice in its space. This option requires a mundane line, Qi Thread, or needle to reach the object.
Damage: Draw the Line does not deal damage unless you choose Cutting Thread or another talent modifies it.
THREAD_BASE_LISTEN_THROUGH_TENSION:
#### Base Ability - Listen Through Tension
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: One active Thread Line you maintain.
Cost: None.
Effect: You read vibration, breath, resistance, and movement through a Thread Line. Until the end of your next turn, choose one benefit against the connected target or object.
You know whether the target is moving closer, farther, or staying still.
You know whether the target is holding the line, cutting the line, or ignoring it.
You have advantage on one Wisdom (Insight), Wisdom (Perception), or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check involving the line.
If the target is Invisible but physically connected by a mundane or Qi Thread, you know its space until the line ends, though this does not by itself let you see the target.
THREAD_BASE_SPOOL_AND_STRAND:
#### Base Ability - Spool and Strand
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: No action for ordinary handling; part of the action for Thread talents
Range: Self.
Cost: None for mundane thread; 1 CP to create or reinforce Qi Thread for combat use.
Effect: You can prepare, draw, control, and conceal combat-ready strands. You may use mundane thread, silk, wire, cord, needles, and hooks as thread tools. If you spend 1 CP, you can create Qi Thread from your fingertips, breath, weapon, sleeve, hair, blood, or dantian pressure for 1 minute.
Ordinary Uses: You can sew, bind, stitch, tie knots, mend cloth, mark a path with thread, set a simple cord, prepare a hidden sleeve spool, or handle fine threadwork without a check unless the situation is difficult.
Combat Use: Spool and Strand enables your Thread talents. It does not by itself restrain creatures, deal damage, or create traps.
THREAD_BASE_THREADED_STRIKE:
#### Base Ability - Threaded Strike
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ON_HIT_THREADED_STRIKE->passive
Timing Detail: Part of a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike
Range: The attack’s normal reach.
Cost: None.
Effect: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, you may wrap, hook, guide, or tension a thread as part of the hit. Until the start of your next turn, you gain one of the following benefits against that target.
Follow the Sleeve: You may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that target.
Tighten the Wrist: The target has disadvantage on the next Opportunity Attack it makes before the start of your next turn.
Draw the Guard: Your next Thread Attack against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage.
Weighted Knot: Add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage of the triggering attack. You can use Weighted Knot only once per round.
Threaded Strike is the common martial face of this sphere. Many Body Refiners learn Thread this way before ever projecting visible Qi Thread.
TRAP_BASE_DART_MECHANISM:

When triggered, choose one space occupied by the trap as the point of origin. The dart flies in a straight line up to 90 feet in a direction chosen when you set the trap.
The projectile stops at the first solid surface or creature in its path.
If the first creature in the path would be struck, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against that creature.
Hit: Deal Piercing damage.
Dart damage:
CL 1–4: 1d6
CL 5–10: 2d6
CL 11–16: 3d6
CL 17–20: 4d6
TRAP_BASE_TRIPWIRE:
### Tripwire — Snare Pattern
Stretch wire, rope, thread, or a comparable low obstruction through the trap’s spaces.
When a creature enters one of those spaces for the first time on a turn, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature has the Prone condition.
Successful Save: The creature avoids the effect and becomes aware of the trap.
Tripwire is not destroyed when triggered.
A creature aware of the Tripwire has Advantage on its saving throw against it.
A creature that already has the Prone condition does not trigger Tripwire.
WARLEADER_BASE_COMMAND_RESPONSES:
### Command Responses
A Command Response spends Momentum to turn battlefield order into immediate action.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
spending a Momentum Mark is not an Action;
you may use only one Command Response per round;
the target must be within Command Range and able to perceive your command;
a Command Response is not magical unless the talent says otherwise.
You know the following Command Responses.
#### Step on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see starts its turn, ends its turn, or is missed by an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see.
This movement cannot move the ally through an occupied space or through terrain it could not normally enter.
#### Brace the Line
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see is hit by an attack roll or fails a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw against an effect that deals damage.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally reduces the triggering damage by:
Proficiency Bonus + Warleader key ability modifier
If the triggering attack roll would miss after adding +2 to the ally’s AC, the attack misses instead of dealing reduced damage.
#### Strike on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see hits with an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally adds your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll from the triggering attack.
WARLEADER_BASE_FIERCE_SHOUT:
### Fierce Shout
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Affected allies add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll of the first attack they hit with before the start of your next turn.
A creature can benefit from only one Fierce Shout at a time.
WARLEADER_BASE_PRESS_THE_OPENING_STANDAR:
### Press the Opening Standard
When two Commanded allies have the same hostile creature within reach, each of those allies gains a +2 bonus to the first attack roll it makes against that creature on its turn.
This bonus applies only once per creature per turn.
WARLEADER_BASE_SET_THE_STANDARD:
### Set the Standard
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Command Range
Target: You and Commanded allies
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Choose one Standard you know.
Until the start of your next turn, you and Commanded allies may benefit from that Standard.
You know the Press the Opening Standard when you first learn Warleader.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
you can maintain only one Standard at a time;
setting a new Standard ends your previous Standard;
a Standard is not magical unless a talent says otherwise;
a Standard is not a Formation;
a Standard does not force an ally to act.
WATER_BASE_SHAPE_CURRENT:
##### Shape Current
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot square or a 10-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You gather water into a simple Current or Basin. Choose one form when you use this ability.
Flowing Current. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. When you create the Current, choose one creature in the area. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed or pulled 10 feet along the Current into a legal space.
Mist Basin. The area becomes Lightly Obscured. A creature inside it can attempt to Hide normally if it has appropriate cover or concealment.
Cleansing Basin. The first time each round you or an ally enters the area or starts its turn there, it may end the Soaked state on itself, extinguish ordinary flames on itself, or gain Advantage on the next saving throw before the start of its next turn against Poisoned, a disease, smoke, heat, or mundane contamination.
Pressure Basin. The area presses down and around. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
You may move a Basin or Current up to 10 feet as a Bonus Action on your turn.
WATER_BASE_WATER_INITIATION:
##### Water Initiation
When you first gain the Water sphere, you gain Water Lash, Shape Current, and one Mortal Realm Water talent.
You also learn to sense obvious Water Sources within 60 feet, including open water, rain, mist, wet ground, damp cloth, and recently spilled liquid.
WATER_BASE_WATER_LASH:
##### Water Lash
Action Type: Action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or object
Cost: 0 CP
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action, or use an action if you do not have attacks to replace.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 + your Path key ability modifier bludgeoning damage and becomes Soaked until the end of your next turn.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
If the target is already Soaked, you may move it 5 feet into a legal unoccupied space after the hit. This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
WEATHER_BASE_CLOUD_SHROUD:
### BASE ABILITY 3: CLOUD SHROUD
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You hang a private weather around a target: frost around the joints, rain inside the breath, dust in the eyes, heat against the skin, wind around the limbs, or thunder over the heart.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know and apply its Shroud effect.
A creature can be under only one of your Cloud Shrouds at a time. Placing a second Cloud Shroud from you on the same creature ends the first.
Unless a sign says otherwise, a creature makes the listed saving throw when the Shroud is placed and again at the end of each of its turns. A Shroud’s damage or condition applies on a failed save. A successful save prevents that round’s damage or condition but does not end the Shroud unless the Shroud says otherwise.
##### Three-Success Escape
If a Shroud no longer requires your Concentration because of a talent or feature, it ends once the target has succeeded on three saving throws against it.
##### Objects
A Shroud can target an unattended object. The GM decides whether the object is vulnerable to that weather. For example, rain may douse flame, heat may warp wax, cold may freeze water, aridity may dry ink, and wind may scatter papers.
WEATHER_BASE_GATHER_WEATHER:
### BASE ABILITY 4: GATHER WEATHER
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You gather a Weather Sign you know into a local field.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know other than Thunder Sign, unless Thunder Sign is being gathered through Storm rules. The area becomes severity 1 of that sign’s weather category.
Gathered weather counts as active weather for Sky Mantle and other Weather talents.
At Mortal Realm, Gather Weather creates atmosphere and combat-scale conditions, but it does not usually inflict long-duration travel hazards such as dehydration checks, hypothermia checks, or heat-exhaustion checks unless a talent specifically says so.
##### Shelter and Barriers
Gather Weather does not pass through sealed walls, closed rooms, airtight barriers, sealed formations, or spaces physically isolated from the area unless a feature says otherwise.
##### Opposing Weather
If you gather Cold into Heat, Heat is reduced first. If you gather Heat into Cold, Cold is reduced first. If you gather Aridity into Precipitation, Precipitation is reduced first. If you gather Precipitation into Aridity, Aridity is reduced first.
##### Storm Formation
A full storm requires Wind and either Precipitation or Aridity. If both supporting categories are severity 1 or higher, Thunder Sign and storm talents can treat the area as Storm severity equal to the lower supporting severity.
WEATHER_BASE_READ_THE_SKY:
### BASE ABILITY 1: READ THE SKY
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes for a careful reading
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=IMMEDIATE_READING_ACTION, CAREFUL_READING_TEN_MINUTES, BATTLE_READING_NO_ACTION
Range: Self
Cost: 0 CP
Duration: Instantaneous
You study pressure, humidity, temperature, scent, cloud motion, insects, skin-prickle, spiritual pressure, and the shape of Heaven’s breath.
Choose one of the following readings.
##### Immediate Reading
As an Action, learn all current weather categories and their severity within 1 mile, assuming you are outdoors or in contact with air that leads outdoors.
You also learn whether the weather within 300 feet is natural, supernatural, cultivation-made, or being sustained by Concentration.
##### Careful Reading
After 10 minutes, predict natural weather within 5 miles for the next 48 hours, unless stronger cultivation, sealed terrain, divine concealment, or narrative conditions interfere.
##### Battle Reading
When you cast a Weather sphere effect, you may also identify one active Weather Sign in the scene without using an action.
A sign is active if its category is severity 1 or higher, if you have placed it through a Mantle or Shroud, or if you have gathered it with Gather Weather.
WEATHER_BASE_SKY_MANTLE:
### BASE ABILITY 2: SKY MANTLE
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes as a ritual
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_SKY_MANTLE->action, BONUS_ACTION_REFRESH_MANTLE->bonus_action; procedures=TEN_MINUTE_SKY_MANTLE_RITUAL
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute if cast as an Action; up to 1 hour if cast as a 10-minute ritual
Cost: 1 CP if cast as an Action; 0 CP if cast as a 10-minute ritual
You wrap a creature in a weather sign so that Heaven favors its movement, breath, skin, weapon, or spirit.
When you place a Sky Mantle, choose one Weather Sign talent you know. The target gains that sign’s Mantle effect if at least one of the following is true:
the surrounding area currently has that weather category at severity 1 or higher;
you have gathered that sign with Gather Weather and the target is inside the area;
you spend 1 additional CP to force that sign through your own cultivation.
A creature can benefit from only one of your Sky Mantles at a time. Placing a new Sky Mantle from you ends the old one.
##### Refreshing the Mantle
On your turn, you may spend 1 CP and use a Bonus Action to change the Mantle to another Weather Sign talent you know, provided the new sign is active or you force it with CP.
##### Defensive Weather
When a creature with your Sky Mantle makes a saving throw against a Weather sphere effect, it has Advantage if the Mantle’s sign matches or opposes the effect’s sign.
WRESTLING_BASE_APPLYING_A_SLAM:
#### Applying a Slam
When you learn Wrestling, choose one Slam talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
You may apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you in any of the following ways:
##### Establish the Hold
When one creature gains the Grappled condition from your Unarmed Strike Grapple option or one of your Wrestling talents, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to that creature.
##### Work the Hold
When you begin your turn grappling one or more creatures, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you.
##### Punish the Escape Attempt
When a creature fails an Action check to escape one of your grapples, use your Reaction to apply one Slam talent to it.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
one use applies one Slam talent;
the target must still be Grappled by you when the Slam resolves;
the Slam lasts until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends, whichever happens first;
a Slam requiring a saving throw uses your Wrestling Save DC.
WRESTLING_BASE_SPECIAL_ATTACKS:
#### Special Attacks
When a Wrestling talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when taking the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type.
WRESTLING_BASE_WRESTLING_SAVE_DC_AND_ESC:
#### Wrestling Save DC and Escape DC
Your default Wrestling Save DC and grapple escape DC are:
8 + Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus
A Path synergy, Insight, or other feature may explicitly replace Strength for Wrestling talents or grapples created through this sphere.
foundation.FOUNDATION_03_EMPTY_BOWL_SOUL:
#### Anchor Answers Need — Ally

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** Willing creature within 30 ft fails a Fixed Empty Bowl Scope check or saving throw.
**Cost:** 1 Empty Bowl Mark
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** One willing creature within 30 feet that you can perceive
**Attack or Save:** Failed qualifying check or save
**Effect:** Use your Reaction and spend 1 pre-existing Empty Bowl Mark to add your proficiency bonus to the target's failed Fixed Empty Bowl Scope check or saving throw. This may turn the failure into a success. This ally-facing correction requires your Reaction.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** One Reaction; requires a pre-existing Empty Bowl Mark; cannot stack with Anchor Answers Need — Self, Famine Saint Intercession, or Domain Shelter Intercession on the same roll.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Out of range, unwilling target, hidden target, non-scope roll, reaction denial, or post-roll correction immunity prevents use.

#### Anchor Answers Need — Self

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** You fail a Fixed Empty Bowl Scope check or saving throw.
**Cost:** 1 Empty Bowl Mark
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Attack or Save:** Failed qualifying check or save
**Effect:** Spend 1 pre-existing Empty Bowl Mark to add your proficiency bonus to your own failed Fixed Empty Bowl Scope check or saving throw. This may turn the failure into a success. The Mark cannot be the one generated by the same event.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires a pre-existing Empty Bowl Mark; cannot stack with another Empty Bowl post-roll correction on the same roll.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** The roll must be within Fixed Empty Bowl Scope; effects that block post-roll correction or sever the soul anchor prevent use.

#### Domain Shelter Intercession

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** Protected creature in active Empty Bowl Domain fails a qualifying roll.
**Cost:** 1 Empty Bowl Mark
**Range:** 30-foot Emanation
**Target:** One protected creature in Empty Bowl Domain
**Attack or Save:** Failed qualifying check or save
**Effect:** Perfected Domain exception. Once per round while Empty Bowl Domain is active, spend 1 pre-existing Empty Bowl Mark to add your proficiency bonus + your cultivation ability modifier to one protected creature's failed qualifying check or save against hunger, deprivation, fear of scarcity, despair created by need, famine aura, devouring, or spiritual consumption. This is a printed Perfected Domain rider, not a generic reaction bypass; it cannot stack with Anchor Answers Need or Famine Saint Intercession on the same roll.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Perfected Domain only; once per round; cannot stack with Anchor Answers Need or Famine Saint Intercession on the same roll.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Outside the domain, non-protected targets, non-scope effects, same-event Mark generation, or anti-domain effects prevent use.

#### Empty Bowl Domain

**Type:** Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Cost:** 1 Empty Bowl Mark + 2 CP
**Range:** Self
**Target:** 30-foot Emanation centered on you
**Effect:** Perfected only. Spend 1 Empty Bowl Mark and 2 CP to manifest Empty Bowl Domain for 1 minute. Allies of your choice in the Emanation have advantage on saving throws against hunger, deprivation, fear of scarcity, despair created by need, famine aura, devouring, and spiritual consumption. Non-forbidden nourishment inside the domain grants temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus once per round to one protected creature.
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Limit:** Perfected only; once per combat or major scene; requires 1 Empty Bowl Mark and 2 CP.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Forbidden consumption, using need as control, suppressing the soul anchor, or leaving the domain ends or strains the effect at GM discretion.

#### Empty Bowl Reserve

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your maximum CP increases by your proficiency bonus. If the Foundation reaches Integrated, your maximum CP increases by an additional proficiency bonus; this stacks with the base increase. CP means Stamina, Qi, or Resonance according to Path.
**Duration:** Permanent while Foundation is stable
**Limit:** Always active while Foundation is stable; suppressed only by printed Strain/Hidden Injury rules.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Foundation suppression, Hollow Anchor Strain, or story-level severance can suspend the benefit; do not recalculate mid-damage packet.

#### Famine Saint Intercession

**Type:** Reaction
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** Self or willing creature within 30 ft fails a scoped saving throw.
**Cost:** 1 Empty Bowl Mark
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one willing creature within 30 feet
**Attack or Save:** Failed saving throw
**Effect:** Refined or higher. Use your Reaction and spend 1 Empty Bowl Mark to let the target reroll a failed saving throw against fear, despair, exhaustion, magical hunger, thirst, famine aura, deprivation, devouring, or spiritual consumption. The target uses the new result. If it succeeds, it gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus + your cultivation ability modifier.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Refined+ only; one Reaction; cannot stack with Anchor Answers Need or Domain Shelter Intercession on the same roll.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Non-scope saves, reaction denial, unwilling target, or effects that bar rerolls prevent use.

#### Forbidden Use Ends the Bowl

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Forbidden/incompatible Empty Bowl use.
**Range:** Self / Domain
**Target:** Self and active Empty Bowl effects
**Effect:** If you use Empty Bowl Soul Anchor to justify helpless consumption, famine hoarding, false charity for power, or feeding as control, any active Empty Bowl Domain ends, Hollow Anchor Strain may increase, and Hunger Deviation may progress as determined by the GM.
**Duration:** Instant; consequence persists by Burden/Deviation rules
**Limit:** Triggered by meaningful violation; not a player-selected benefit.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Avoiding the violation, accepting correction, or completing repair scenes prevents or later repairs the consequence.

#### Gather Empty Bowl Mark

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Qualifying need-answering event or qualifying resistance succeeds.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Once per round after you resolve a Fixed Empty Bowl Scope technique/effect that feeds, heals, stabilizes, protects, comforts, or answers real need, or after you succeed on a check/save against hunger, deprivation, fear of scarcity, despair created by need, exhaustion from deprivation, famine aura, devouring, or spiritual consumption, gain 1 Empty Bowl Mark. Maximum 1. Refreshes instead of stacking. You cannot spend this Mark on the same event that generated it.
**Duration:** Until the end of your next turn
**Limit:** Once per round; maximum 1 Empty Bowl Mark; expires at the end of your next turn.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Trivial scenes, artificial hunger farming, exploitative feeding, forbidden consumption, false charity, or no-risk resource cycling do not generate a Mark.

#### Resist the Shortcut

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Hunger Deviation temptation or progress event.
**Cost:** Optional: 1 Empty Bowl Mark
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Attack or Save:** Cultivation Check or Wisdom save against Hunger Deviation
**Effect:** When Hunger Deviation tempts you, you may add your proficiency bonus to the resistance check/save once per short rest. If you also spend 1 Empty Bowl Mark and refuse the offered shortcut, reduce Hunger Deviation progress by 1 instead of gaining its offered benefit.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Once per short rest for the bonus; Mark spend only if a real temptation is refused.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Accepting the shortcut, false refusal, or lack of meaningful temptation prevents progress reduction.

#### Share the Bowl

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Cost:** 1 Empty Bowl Mark
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one willing creature within 30 feet
**Effect:** Spend 1 Empty Bowl Mark. The target gains temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus + your cultivation ability modifier. If the scene involves real hunger, deprivation, fear of scarcity, despair created by need, famine aura, devouring, or spiritual consumption, the target also gains advantage on its next check or save against that same pressure before the end of its next turn.
**Duration:** Until the end of the target's next turn
**Limit:** One target; requires Empty Bowl Mark; temporary HP follows normal non-stacking rules.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** No real need, artificial farming, exploitative feeding, or forbidden consumption prevents the secondary advantage rider.
foundation.ancient_desolate_sacred_body_:
#### Generate Golden Sea Pulse

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After a real hostile pressure event resolves while you remain conscious: you take hostile damage; you make an eligible Saint-Body Frame resistance roll; you win a hostile physical contest; or you hit a hostile creature within 5 feet with a body-bound/martial Saint-Body expression after that creature damaged, moved, restrained, suppressed, cursed, possessed, poisoned, grappled, or seriously threatened you since the start of your last turn.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** After the listed hostile pressure event fully resolves, if you are conscious and do not already have Golden Sea Pulse, gain Golden Sea Pulse 1/1. You can generate Golden Sea Pulse no more than once per round. Golden Sea Pulse expires at the end of your next turn. A Pulse generated by an event cannot be spent on that same event.
**Limit:** Maximum 1; generation once per round; generated after trigger resolves; expires end of next turn.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Deny real hostile pressure, attack from outside the sacred-body range, avoid body-seizing contests, use effects outside Strength/Constitution body pressure, or wait for the Pulse to expire.

#### Golden Sea Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** You take hostile damage while conscious and have Golden Sea Pulse available from an earlier event.
**Cost:** 1 Golden Sea Pulse
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Spend 1 Golden Sea Pulse from an earlier event. Reduce the triggering hostile damage by twice your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. If the damage or rider comes from body suppression, curse-pressure, possession-pressure, poison-pressure, demonic pressure, necrotic corruption, hostile forced movement impact, or a similar effect trying to seize or corrupt the body, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus. This does not reduce self-inflicted overchannel costs, voluntary sacrifice costs, breakthrough backlash, or hidden-injury costs unless the GM explicitly treats them as hostile external pressure.
**Limit:** Requires Reaction and 1 Golden Sea Pulse from a prior event. Does not permit same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Does not reduce self-inflicted costs, voluntary overchannel damage, hidden injuries, breakthrough backlash, or the same damage event that generated the Pulse.

#### Perfected: Sacred Body Wake

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** On your turn while this Foundation is Perfected and you have Golden Sea Pulse from an earlier event.
**Cost:** 1 Golden Sea Pulse; once per short or long rest
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Spend 1 Golden Sea Pulse from an earlier event. For 1 minute or until you are Incapacitated, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Cultivation Level + your Constitution modifier, have Advantage on eligible Strength and Constitution ability checks and saving throws against forced movement, Prone, Grappled, Restrained, body suppression, curse-pressure, possession-pressure, poison-pressure, demonic pressure, and similar body/meridian seizure, and the first qualifying close-range or body-bound Saint-Body hit you make on each of your turns deals additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This does not create extra attacks, extra reactions, or same-event spending.
**Limit:** Once per long rest; requires Bonus Action and 1 Golden Sea Pulse from a prior event.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Does not make the cultivator immune, does not stack multiple free damage riders, and cannot be activated from a Pulse generated by the same triggering event.

#### Refined: Golden Blood Root

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** This rider applies when this Foundation is Refined.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** This modifies Saint-Body Frame and Golden Sea Guard. It does not require an additional Reaction, does not require an additional resource spend, and does not permit same-event spending. Saint-Body Frame’s maximum Hit Point increase becomes three times your Proficiency Bonus. When Golden Sea Guard reduces damage from poison, necrotic damage, curse-pressure, possession-pressure, demonic pressure, hostile body suppression, or a comparable corruptive/suppressive source, you have Advantage on the next eligible saving throw against that same source before the start of your next turn.
**Limit:** Rider only; modifies existing rows. No extra Reaction or resource spend.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** No extra Reaction or extra resource. Does not grant blanket immunity or cleanse major conditions.

#### Refined: Pressure Becomes Method

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** This rider applies when this Foundation is Refined and you generate Golden Sea Pulse from succeeding on an eligible Saint-Body Frame resistance roll.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** When you generate Golden Sea Pulse from making an eligible Saint-Body Frame resistance roll or winning a hostile physical contest, you may move up to 10 feet, stand from Prone, or end one minor speed penalty from the same source if you can do so without passing through barriers or ignoring a condition that still prevents movement. This modifies the generation event. It does not require an additional Reaction, does not require an additional resource spend, and does not permit spending the generated Pulse on the same event.
**Limit:** Rider only; applies when the stated generation trigger occurs. No same-event spend.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Cannot escape Grappled/Restrained/immobilizing conditions unless the triggering success already ends or avoids them.

#### Refuse Heaven-Lock

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** You would fail a Strength or Constitution saving throw or ability check against forced movement, being knocked Prone, being Grappled, being Restrained, hostile body suppression, curse-pressure, possession-pressure, poison-pressure, or a similar effect that tries to seize or collapse your body.
**Cost:** 1 Golden Sea Pulse
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Attack or Save:** Strength or Constitution roll already made
**Effect:** Spend 1 Golden Sea Pulse from an earlier event when you would fail an eligible Strength or Constitution ability check or saving throw against forced movement, being knocked Prone, being Grappled, being Restrained, hostile body suppression, curse-pressure, possession-pressure, poison-pressure, exhaustion-pressure, or a similar effect that tries to seize or collapse your body. Add your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier to the roll. If this changes the failure into a success, you may also end one minor body-seizing rider from the same source, such as a brief speed reduction, imposed Prone rider, or minor suppression mark. This cannot end major curses, diseases, hidden injuries, deviations, Incapacitated, Stunned, Paralyzed, Petrified, or possession unless another rule allows it.
**Limit:** Requires Reaction and 1 Golden Sea Pulse from a prior event; eligible Strength/Constitution body pressure only.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Cannot end Stunned, Paralyzed, Incapacitated, Petrified, major possession, major curse, hidden injury, or higher-Realm binding unless another rule permits it.

#### Saint-Body Frame

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Always active while the Foundation is available.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your maximum Hit Points increase by twice your Proficiency Bonus. Once per round, when you make a Strength or Constitution ability check or saving throw against forced movement, being knocked Prone, being Grappled, being Restrained, hostile body suppression, curse-pressure, possession-pressure, poison-pressure, exhaustion-pressure, or a similar effect that tries to seize, collapse, contaminate, or command your body or meridians, add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll as a Foundation bonus. This can apply even if you are already proficient; it is not expertise and does not change your proficiency state.
**Limit:** HP increase is always active. Resistance-roll bonus is once per round and only for eligible body/meridian pressure.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Does not grant immunity, does not stack Proficiency twice, and does not apply to purely mental influence that does not seize the body.

#### Saint-Body Rebuke

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After you hit a hostile creature within 5 feet with an unarmed strike, natural weapon, melee weapon, Body Refining technique, Iron Fist method, Brute method, Athletics method, or other body-bound Saint-Body expression.
**Cost:** 1 Golden Sea Pulse
**Range:** Melee / 5 ft
**Target:** One hostile creature you hit
**Effect:** Spend 1 Golden Sea Pulse after you hit with a qualifying close-range or body-bound Saint-Body expression. Add damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Constitution modifier. Then choose one rider: push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger than you; the target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn; or you gain Advantage on the next eligible Saint-Body Frame resistance roll you make against that target before the start of your next turn. This is not a second attack and does not create a new action.
**Limit:** Once per triggering hit; requires 1 Golden Sea Pulse from a prior event; no same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Does not work on purely distant attacks unless the method is explicitly body-bound. Forced movement rider is not immunity.
foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.a:
#### Ash-Remnant Strike

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After you damage a hostile creature with a later Foundation-aligned Ash-Born hit or effect while you have Remnant Cinder.
**Cost:** 1 Remnant Cinder
**Range:** Effect range
**Target:** One damaged hostile creature
**Attack or Save:** Uses triggering attack/save
**Effect:** After you damage a hostile creature with a Foundation-aligned Ash, Death, Fire, Karma, Fate, Dark, Radiance, Protection, Dreams, Ink, Hunger, Alchemy, funeral, survivor, remnant, or aftermath technique, spend 1 Remnant Cinder to add fire, necrotic, radiant, psychic, or force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. This is not a separate attack and cannot spend Cinder generated by that same hit or effect.
**Limit:** Costs 1 Remnant Cinder; not a separate attack; no same-event spend.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Deny if the technique is generic fire/death/Hunger with no aftermath/remnant/consequence expression.
foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.g:
#### Generate Remnant Cinder

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After a real qualifying Ash-Born event resolves.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** After the qualifying event fully resolves, gain 1 Remnant Cinder if you are conscious and do not already have Remnant Cinder. Qualifying events are: you spend CP on a Fixed Ash-Born Scope technique/effect; a nontrivial hostile creature, construct, ward, summoned creature, remnant, or significant object is destroyed within 60 feet during a meaningful scene; you succeed on an eligible save against remnant possession, ruin-terror, grief-control, despair, battlefield horror, ash contamination, death pressure, or fire-aftermath backlash; or you preserve, stabilize, release, or protect a survivor/remnant through a qualifying funeral, protection, cleansing, or aftermath method. Friendly, staged, self-inflicted, harmless, training, trivial-object, repeated non-threatening, innocent-harming, or farmed destruction cannot generate Remnant Cinder.
**Limit:** Maximum 1; once per round; expires end of next turn; no same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Deny generation from staged destruction, friendly sacrifices, trivial objects, farmed summons, harmless training, or innocent/protected-remnant harm.
foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.l:
#### Last Cinder Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** You or an ally within 30 feet takes hostile damage while you have Remnant Cinder.
**Cost:** 1 Remnant Cinder
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one ally
**Effect:** Spend 1 Remnant Cinder as a Reaction when you or an ally within 30 feet takes hostile damage. Reduce the triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. If the triggering source is fire aftermath, necrotic damage, ash, death pressure, grief-control, remnant possession, battlefield hazard, ruin-fed corruption, or funeral-defiling pressure, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus. This does not cleanse major curses, hidden injuries, deviations, or sacred-remnant debts.
**Limit:** Costs 1 Remnant Cinder; cannot use Cinder generated by same event.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use direct damage, present-tense threats, non-remnant control, or attack after Cinder expires.
foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.p:

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** You activate the Perfected Foundation state.
**Cost:** 3 CP
**Range:** 30-foot Emanation
**Target:** Self and chosen allies in area
**Effect:** Once per long rest, spend 3 CP as a Bonus Action to manifest a 30-foot Emanation of ash, smoke, dim cinders, ghostly embers, or pale funeral light for 1 minute. Chosen allies in the area have Advantage on saving throws against fear, despair, remnant possession, battlefield horror, grief-based control, ash contamination, and ruin-fed corruption. Once on each of your turns while the state lasts, when you damage a hostile creature or grant temporary Hit Points with a qualifying Foundation-aligned aftermath, remnant, funeral, survivor, Ash, Death, Fire, Karma, Fate, Dark, Radiance, Protection, Dreams, Ink, Hunger, or Alchemy technique, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or temporary HP value. Remnant Cinder maximum remains 1. If you deliberately destroy an innocent, ally, protected remnant, or sacred memory to feed this state, the state ends and Ruin-Seeking Deviation advances.
