**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Break line of effect, leave emanation, use non-scoped threats, bait Ruin-Seeking violation, or wait out 1 minute.
foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.r:
#### Refined — Ash Memory

**Type:** Foundation Scene / Utility
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** You touch meaningful ashes, ruins, remains, battlefield soil, burned scripture, or a remnant-marked object.
**Cost:** Scene requirements
**Range:** Touch
**Target:** One meaningful remnant object/site
**Attack or Save:** Cultivation Check if required
**Effect:** Touch a meaningful remnant and make a Cultivation Check if the GM requires one. On success, learn one meaningful consequence attached to the ruin: who died, what was lost, what caused the destruction, what debt remains, what remnant lingers, or what must be released. This does not reveal a full plot, all enemies, or a complete technique list.
**Limit:** Requires meaningful remnant; no resource generated by this row.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** False remnants, sealed memories, deliberate misinformation, or higher authority can resist or distort the reading.

#### Refined — Last Cinder Refusal

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** You spend Remnant Cinder on Last Cinder Guard and the guarded damage would still reduce you to 0 HP.
**Cost:** 1 CP
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** When you spend Remnant Cinder on Last Cinder Guard for yourself and the guarded damage would still reduce you to 0 HP, you may spend 1 CP to drop to 1 HP instead. Once per combat or major scene. This is not a second Reaction and cannot be used if you were already at 0 HP before the damage.
**Limit:** Requires legal Last Cinder Guard on self; once per combat/major scene.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use effects that bypass damage, unconsciousness before damage, or multiple threats after this rider is spent.

#### Refined — Smothering Remnant

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** You spend Remnant Cinder on Ash-Remnant Strike.
**Cost:** Included in Ash-Remnant Strike
**Range:** Effect range
**Target:** The same damaged target
**Effect:** When you spend Remnant Cinder on Ash-Remnant Strike, the damaged target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. If the target is a remnant, undead, regeneration effect, ruin-fed creature, or creature currently feeding from destruction, also reduce one recovery, regeneration, or CP recovery event before then by your Proficiency Bonus. This is a rider, not a second action or second Cinder spend.
**Limit:** Only applies when Ash-Remnant Strike is legally spent.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use non-healing defense, remove the attacker, or wait until the brief lock expires.

#### Remnant Core Reserve

**Type:** Passive
**Trigger:** Always active while this Foundation is installed.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your maximum CP increases by your Proficiency Bonus. Your legal Ash, Death, Fire, Karma, Fate, Dark, Radiance, Protection, Dreams, Ink, Hunger, and Alchemy techniques may count as Foundation-aligned only when they clearly express ash, fire aftermath, death consequence, remnant memory, funeral authority, survivor protection, burned scripture, ruined lineage, or transformation after loss. You have Advantage on Wisdom saving throws against remnant possession, ruin-terror, grief-based control, despair pressure, battlefield horror, and hostile effects that try to make you seek destruction as proof of truth. This grants no sphere access, no automatic immunity, and no passive once-per-round damage reduction.
**Limit:** Always active; no resource generated by this row.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use ordinary force, present-tense threats, renewal, living obligations, or effects outside ash/remnant/grief scope.
foundation.ash_born_remnant_core_v0_2B.s:

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.beast:

**Effect:** Perfected state. Spend 1 Pack Echo and 2 CP to enter Beast-Echo Marrow State for 1 minute, once per combat or major scene. Choose yourself and one bonded companion or ally within 60 ft. foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.compa:

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.gener:

foundation.beast_echo_marrow_v0_2A.marro:

foundation.divine_king_body_v0_2B.divine:

foundation.divine_king_body_v0_2B.moon_d:

foundation.dragon_wind_vessel_v0_2E.sove:

**Limit:** Once per round. Requires Perfected or higher. No second Momentum cost. Each chosen conversion must have a legal trigger.

foundation.dream_mirror_soul_anchor_v0_2:
#### Dream-Mirror Domain

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** On your turn while holding Mirror Trace.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace + 2 Path resource
**Range:** Self, 30-foot Emanation
**Target:** Self, 30-foot Emanation
**Effect:** Perfected evolution. Spend 1 Mirror Trace and 2 Path resource to create a 30-foot Emanation for 1 minute. While active, your Mirror Trace trigger can come from hostile misses or failed Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope saves against you or an ally in the domain, and once per round when you spend Mirror Trace, increase the numeric benefit by PB. If you willingly deny your true identity to exploit the domain, the domain ends and you gain False Face Strain Severity 1.
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Limit:** Perfected only; once per combat or major scene. Requires 1 pre-existing Mirror Trace and 2 Path resource. Domain amplification applies once per round to one numeric Mirror Trace conversion.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Break concentration-like domain control by Incapacitating the anchor, forcing them out of the scene, overpowering the domain with superior domain authority, exploiting the true-identity clause, or fighting outside Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope.

#### Dream-Reflection Counter

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you spend Mirror Trace on Reflection Cut against a creature affected by your Dreams, Illusion, Shadow, Beauty, The Hidden Eye, Water-memory, or Spirit-facing technique.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Stacks with Reflection Cut: the target also takes a -PB penalty to the next Insight, Perception, or attack roll it makes against you before the end of its next turn.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Dream-Reflection Counter as a Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** The penalty ends after one qualifying roll or at the end of the target’s next turn. Creatures immune to perception/identity disruption may ignore the penalty.

#### False-Image Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** When you take damage from a creature you can perceive, after damage is rolled and before it is applied.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace + Reaction
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace and your Reaction to reduce that damage by PB + cultivation ability modifier. The reflection takes the first part of the blow, then tears away.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires 1 Mirror Trace and your Reaction.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Cannot be used while you cannot perceive the damaging source. Effects that bypass reactions or suppress Foundation resources prevent this conversion.

#### Generate Mirror Trace

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** Once per round, after a hostile creature misses you with an attack or fails a saving throw against your Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope technique/effect.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** After the triggering miss or failed save resolves, gain 1 Mirror Trace, maximum 1. It fades at the end of your next turn. If already held, refresh expiration instead of stacking. Cannot be spent on the same event that generated it.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Once per round; maximum 1 Mirror Trace.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Avoid targeting the anchor directly, use effects outside the Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope, attack allies instead, or suppress Mirror Trace generation through Mirror Split or False Face Strain.

#### Mirror-Root Reserve

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Common Expression or higher
**Trigger:** Always active while the Foundation is available.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Base: maximum Path resource increases by PB. Integrated: maximum Path resource increases by another PB, stacking with the base passive. This resource increase is not recalculated or removed mid-scene unless the Foundation is fully severed by explicit story effect.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Passive Foundation benefit.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress or damage the Foundation through Mirror Split, Torn Reflection, False Face Strain, or sever/replace projects; ordinary dispels do not remove this passive.

#### Mirror-Step Reflex

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you spend Mirror Trace on False-Image Guard.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Stacks with False-Image Guard: after the damage reduction resolves, move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the damaging creature. If this movement puts you behind cover or outside the source’s reach before a continuing multi-hit sequence, later hits must still have a legal target.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Mirror-Step Reflex as a Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Does not cancel the triggering damage after it has been applied. Movement must be physically possible and cannot pass through sealed barriers.

#### Reflection Cut

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After you hit a creature or it fails a save against your later Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope attack/technique/effect.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace
**Range:** One target of triggering hit/effect
**Target:** One target of triggering hit/effect
**Effect:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace to add PB psychic or force damage to that later hit or damaging effect. Choose the damage type when you spend the resource.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires 1 Mirror Trace; cannot be used on the same event that generated the Trace.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** No benefit if the later effect does not deal damage or is outside the Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope. Resistance/immunity to the chosen damage type applies normally.

#### Stable True Name

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you spend Mirror Trace on True-Name Witness during treatment, repair, Foundation Challenge, or Method-correction for Mirror Split, Torn Reflection, False Face Strain, or False Self.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Stacks with True-Name Witness: add another PB to the same roll. On success, remove 1 False Self progress or count the scene as one stabilization toward Dream-Mirror integration.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Stable True Name as a Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Cannot remove Severity by itself; it supports the normal recovery or integration route.

#### True-Name Witness

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After you roll a Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope check or saving throw and before the outcome is known.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Attack or Save:** Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope check/save
**Effect:** Spend 1 Mirror Trace to add PB to the roll. This represents remembering which self is allowed to answer.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires 1 Mirror Trace.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** No benefit outside the Fixed Dream-Mirror Scope. Effects that block Foundation resources or sever true-name stability prevent this conversion.

#### Truth Behind the Mask

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you spend Mirror Trace on True-Name Witness against illusion, dream, disguise, memory, charm, possession, or identity manipulation.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Stacks with True-Name Witness: add another PB to the same roll. On success, learn one symbolic truth about the source, such as fear, method, false layer, emotional hook, or whether it is external, self-made, or spirit-borne.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Truth Behind the Mask as a Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** The truth is symbolic, not complete stat revelation. Stronger secrecy, Void, or domain authority may require a Foundation Challenge or opposed check.

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** You take hostile damage, or you are subjected to hostile drain, origin theft, possession pressure, anti-healing corruption, or source-corruption pressure.

**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Spend 1 Devoured Origin Spark as a Reaction. Reduce the triggering hostile damage, drain value, origin-theft pressure, or anti-healing/source-corruption pressure by your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. If the source is a wounded hostile creature or a direct drain/origin-theft effect, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus. This cannot reduce self-inflicted costs, voluntary overdraw, hidden injury consequences, or breakthrough backlash unless the GM explicitly treats the event as hostile.
**Limit:** Reaction; spend 1 Spark; no same-event spending unless Spark was already available.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use non-drain damage, force multiple threats, deny Spark generation, or apply non-reducible breakthrough/hidden-injury consequences.

#### Devouring Womb Frame

**Type:** Passive
**Trigger:** Always active while this Foundation is installed.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your hit point maximum increases by your Proficiency Bonus. Your legal Hunger, Blood, Death, Void, Unmaking, Daemonic Cultivation, Life self-rebuilding, and Qiweaving stabilization techniques may count as Foundation-aligned when they directly devour, shed, rebuild, or resist hostile essence pressure. You have Advantage on saving throws against hostile essence-drain, origin-theft, possession-pressure, and effects that would prevent you from regaining Hit Points by corrupting your source. This does not grant sphere access or automatic healing.
**Limit:** Always active; no resource generated by this row.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use enemies without essence, anti-drain wards, non-origin damage, distance, or purification pressure.

#### Generate Devoured Origin Spark

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After a meaningful hostile creature loses Hit Points from your legal devouring, drain, Hunger, Blood, Death, Void, Unmaking, Daemonic Cultivation, Life self-rebuilding, or Qiweaving stabilization technique; or after you resist a hostile drain, origin theft, possession, or source-corruption effect.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self

It expires at the end of your next turn. A Spark generated by an event cannot be spent on that same event. Friendly effects, self-inflicted harm, staged danger, training scenes, harmless creatures, and repeated non-threats never generate this resource.

**Target:** Triggering hostile creature

**Available At:** Perfected

**Cost:** Once per long rest
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** As a Bonus Action once per long rest, awaken the Imperishable Heaven Womb for 1 minute. Gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Cultivation Level + your Path key ability modifier. For the duration, your qualifying Foundation-aligned devouring, shedding, self-rebuilding, or source-corrupting hits deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you have Advantage on saving throws and ability checks against drain, poison, necrotic source-corruption, possession pressure, and body/source suppression. foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.declare_:
#### Declare Protected Subject

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** At initiative, or when a protected duty clearly appears in a scene.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Name one meaningful protected subject: one ally, one object, one doorway, one warded place, one helpless creature, or one duty. Iron Oath features require you to be actually defending that subject; artificial declarations do not qualify.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** One active protected subject at a time unless a Perfected boundary says otherwise.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Enemies may separate you from the subject, force movement, obscure lines, bait oath conflict, or attack other priorities. The GM may reject artificial declarations.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.generate:
#### Generate Guarding Iron

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** Once per round, after a hostile attack or technique damages you while you are defending a declared protected subject and you remain conscious.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** After the triggering damage resolves, gain 1 Guarding Iron, maximum 1. It fades at the end of your next turn. If already held, refresh expiration instead of stacking. Cannot be spent on the same event that generated it.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Once per round; maximum 1 Guarding Iron.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Avoid attacking the oath bearer in protected context, separate them from the subject, suppress Guarding Iron through Broken Guard, or exploit oath conflict.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.iron_int:
#### Iron Interposition

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you spend Guarding Iron on Iron Oath Guard for an adjacent ally.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Stacks with Iron Oath Guard: increase the damage reduction by PB. If the protected subject is the ally named by your declared oath, you may also move 5 feet toward that ally before the reduction, if that movement is possible.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Iron Interposition as a Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Separate the oath bearer from the ally, prevent movement, exhaust their Reaction, or suppress Guarding Iron.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.iron_oat:
#### Iron Oath Boundary

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** On your turn while defending a declared protected subject and able to name a boundary subject.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron + 2 Path resource
**Range:** Self, 15-ft Emanation
**Target:** Self, 15-ft Emanation
**Effect:** Perfected state. Spend 1 Guarding Iron and 2 Path resource to create a 15-ft Emanation for 1 minute, once per combat or major scene. Name one protected subject inside or adjacent to the boundary. While you defend that subject: Iron Oath Guard and Stand-Fast Witness each gain another +PB when used inside the boundary, chosen allies gain PB temporary HP when the boundary appears, and once per round an enemy attack/check/save to force, frighten, charm, dominate, disarm, or bypass you toward the protected subject is rolled with disadvantage or your saving throw is rolled with advantage. If you willingly abandon the named subject, the boundary ends and Broken Guard Strain Severity 1 applies.
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Limit:** Perfected; once per combat or major scene; requires 1 Guarding Iron and 2 Path resource.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Force abandonment, split protected duties, suppress Guarding Iron, pull the subject out of the boundary, use teleportation or non-hostile routes, or impose Broken Guard Strain.

#### Iron Oath Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** When you or an ally within 5 feet of you takes damage while you are defending a declared protected subject.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron
**Range:** Self or ally within 5 ft
**Target:** Self or ally within 5 ft
**Effect:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron to reduce the triggering damage by PB + cultivation ability modifier. This cannot be used on the same damage event that generated the Guarding Iron.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires 1 Guarding Iron; one Reaction.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Force the oath bearer to spend their Reaction, attack outside 5 feet, suppress Guarding Iron, or create conflicting protected subjects.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.oath_mar:
#### Oath-Mark Strike

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After you hit a creature with a weapon attack or compatible technique, or after a creature fails a save against your Fixed Iron Oath Scope technique.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron
**Range:** One qualifying target
**Target:** One qualifying target
**Effect:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron to add PB damage to the hit or damaging effect. The added damage matches the attack/effect, or is force if the technique needs oath-pressure expression. The target must have damaged, moved toward, threatened, or attempted to bypass your protected subject this combat.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires 1 Guarding Iron; cannot apply to the same event that generated the Guarding Iron.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Avoid threatening the protected subject, suppress Guarding Iron, or use immunity/resistance against the underlying attack. The GM may deny artificial target qualification.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.oath_ski:
#### Oath-Skin Frame

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Common Expression or higher
**Trigger:** Always active while the Foundation is available.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Base: maximum HP increases by PB. Integrated: maximum HP increases by another PB, stacking with the base passive. This HP increase is not recalculated or removed mid-scene unless the Foundation is fully severed by explicit story effect.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Passive Foundation benefit.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress or damage the Foundation through Oath-Bound Rigidity, Broken Guard, Iron Scar Constriction, or sever/replace projects; ordinary dispels do not remove this passive.

#### Oath-Skin Mantle

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you generate Guarding Iron while defending a declared protected subject.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Gain temporary HP equal to PB. This is in addition to the Guarding Iron gained; it does not spend Guarding Iron. Temporary HP follows normal non-stacking rules.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Oath-Skin Mantle as a Refined expression; once per round through the Guarding Iron trigger.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Prevent Guarding Iron generation, attack another priority, or use effects that bypass temporary HP through explicit rules.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.scar_led:
#### Scar-Ledger Defense

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you spend Guarding Iron on Stand-Fast Witness against fear, charm, domination, forced movement, disarm, or bypass pressure.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Stacks with Stand-Fast Witness: add another PB to the same roll. If the roll succeeds, the source cannot willingly move through your space until the end of its current turn unless it teleports or is at least two sizes larger than you.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Scar-Ledger Defense as a Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use non-movement routes, teleportation, size advantage, or effects outside Fixed Iron Oath Scope.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.shield_b:
#### Shield-Body Forging

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined; selected expression
**Trigger:** When you make a Technique Forging or Foundation Challenge roll for Guardian, Protection, Shield, Metal, Iron Fist, Karma, Chains, or Warleader that includes a declared protected-subject limitation.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Refined evolution. Reduce the DC by 2. This is a cultivation/project rider, not a combat action, and it does not grant any sphere or technique by itself.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires selecting Shield-Body Forging as a Refined expression; project/challenge scenes only.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** The technique must actually include a duty, ward, oath, protected-subject limitation, or defensive drawback.
foundation.iron_oath_skin_v0_2B.stand_fa:
#### Stand-Fast Witness

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After you roll a Fixed Iron Oath Scope check or saving throw.
**Cost:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Spend 1 Guarding Iron to add PB to the roll. This most often applies against forced movement, fear, charm, domination, disarm, being bypassed, oath interpretation, Iron Oath repair, or Foundation Challenge pressure.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Requires 1 Guarding Iron; one qualifying roll.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use effects outside Fixed Iron Oath Scope, suppress Guarding Iron, or pressure a protected subject through routes the oath bearer cannot witness or contest.
foundation.jade_furnace_meridian_v0_2B.b:
#### Banked Furnace Expenditure

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Before you pay CP for a Foundation-aligned technique, refinement, talisman, formation, medicine, purification, or body-as-cauldron method.
**Cost:** 1 Furnace Heat
**Range:** Self
**Target:** One qualifying CP expenditure
**Effect:** Spend 1 Furnace Heat before paying CP. Reduce the CP cost of the triggering Foundation-aligned technique or method by 1, to a minimum final cost of 1. This cannot reduce a cost to 0 unless another feature explicitly says so. If another feature reduces the final cost to 0, that technique cannot generate Furnace Heat.
**Limit:** Minimum final CP cost 1 from this spend; no same-event generation; does not apply to non-CP costs.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Increase costs, use anti-efficiency pressure, force non-CP problems, or bait Heat into a low-value spend.
foundation.jade_furnace_meridian_v0_2B.f:
#### Furnace Vent Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** When you take hostile fire, poison, acid, miasma, contaminated qi, furnace backlash, or technique-residue damage, or when such pressure would force a Constitution save.
**Cost:** 1 Furnace Heat
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Spend 1 Furnace Heat as a Reaction. Reduce the triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. If the source is poison, miasma, contaminated qi, furnace backlash, or technique residue, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus. If the trigger is an eligible Constitution save rather than damage, add PB + key ability modifier to that save instead.
**Limit:** Reaction spend; applies only to listed damage/backlash/residue/CON-save pressure.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use unrelated damage, trigger after Heat is gone, bait the Reaction, or attack the furnace with sealing effects.
foundation.jade_furnace_meridian_v0_2B.g:
#### Generate Furnace Heat

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After you pay CP for a Foundation-aligned technique, refinement, talisman, formation, medicine, purification, or body-as-cauldron method with final CP cost 1 or higher, and that event resolves.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self resource
**Effect:** After the qualifying CP expenditure fully resolves, if you are conscious and do not already have Furnace Heat, gain Furnace Heat 1/1. You can generate Furnace Heat no more than once per round. Furnace Heat expires at the end of your next turn. Furnace Heat generated by a technique cannot be spent on that same technique. Techniques with final CP cost 0, free techniques, staged expenditures, friendly loops, and effects created only to feed the Foundation do not generate Furnace Heat.
**Limit:** Maximum 1; once per round; after trigger resolves; expires end next turn; final-cost-0/free techniques do not generate.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Force the cultivator to stop spending CP, bait wasteful spending, suppress the furnace, or let Heat expire.
foundation.jade_furnace_meridian_v0_2B.j:
#### Jade Furnace Meridian Frame

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Always active while the Foundation is available.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your maximum Hit Points increase by your Proficiency Bonus. Alchemy, Fire, Qiweaving, Talismans, Formations, Radiance, Protection, Poison, Life, Blacksmith, and body-as-cauldron methods that spend CP to refine, purify, ignite, seal, heal, stabilize, or transform may count as Foundation-aligned. You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws against hostile poison, contaminated qi, furnace backlash, miasma, and technique-residue sickness. This passive creates no cost reduction by itself and requires no per-round tracking.
**Limit:** Passive only; no automatic CP reduction; no sphere access granted.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Poison or clog the furnace, force hesitation, deny proper fuel/materials, or exploit contaminated residue.

#### Jade Furnace Release

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After a Foundation-aligned CP technique you use deals damage, restores HP, grants temp HP, reduces damage, purifies, or stabilizes a target.
**Cost:** 1 Furnace Heat
**Range:** Technique range
**Target:** One affected target or value
**Effect:** Spend 1 Furnace Heat after the triggering technique resolves. Add your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier to one damage, healing, temporary Hit Point, damage reduction, purification, or stabilization value from that technique. The technique must have had a final CP cost of 1 or higher.
**Limit:** No-action spend after qualifying final-cost-1+ CP technique; cannot spend on same event that generated Heat.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Force low-value targets, use resistance/immunity, deny CP expenditure, or let Heat expire before a strong technique.
foundation.jade_furnace_meridian_v0_2B.p:
#### Perfected: Jade Furnace Meridian Cycle

**Type:** Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** On your turn after the Foundation is Perfected.
**Cost:** Once per long rest
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Once per long rest, as an Action, establish a Jade Furnace Meridian Cycle for 1 minute. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Cultivation Level + your Path key ability modifier. While the cycle lasts, the first Foundation-aligned technique or method you pay CP for on each of your turns costs 1 less CP, to a minimum final cost of 1. This discount does not require Furnace Heat and does not by itself generate Furnace Heat. Furnace Heat maximum remains 1, generation remains once per round after trigger resolution, and same-event spend lockout remains unchanged.
**Limit:** Perfected only; once per long rest; 1 minute; first qualifying CP payment on your turn only; minimum cost 1.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Interrupt the cycle, force non-CP actions, use anti-furnace pressure, or bait the discount on a low-value technique.
foundation.jade_furnace_meridian_v0_2B.r:
#### Refined: Clean Residue Circulation

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** When you spend Furnace Heat on any base spend.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** This modifies Furnace Heat spends. It does not require an additional action, Reaction, or Furnace Heat spend. After you spend Furnace Heat, you have Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw you make before the end of your next turn against poison, miasma, furnace backlash, contaminated qi, or technique-residue sickness.
**Limit:** Refined rider only; one next-save Advantage; no extra action/resource.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use unrelated saves, wait until the Advantage expires, or attack with non-residue pressure.

#### Refined: Jade Furnace Core

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** Always active after the Foundation is Refined.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** This modifies Jade Furnace Meridian Frame and Banked Furnace Expenditure. It does not require an additional action, Reaction, or Furnace Heat spend, and it does not permit same-event spending. Your maximum Hit Point increase from this Foundation becomes 2×your Proficiency Bonus. When you spend Furnace Heat on Banked Furnace Expenditure, reduce the qualifying CP cost by 2 instead of 1, still to a minimum final cost of 1.
**Limit:** Refined only; minimum final cost 1 remains; no free-technique loop.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Raise costs, apply anti-efficiency pressure, or use effects that punish CP expenditure after the discount.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.generat:
#### Generate Karmic Due

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After Trigger Resolves
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Once per round, after you hit a creature or it fails a saving throw against your technique, if that creature damaged you or an ally since the end of your last turn, gain 1 Karmic Due, maximum 1. It fades at the end of your next turn. If already held, refresh expiration instead of stacking. Cannot be spent on the same hit or failed save that generated it.
**Duration:** See effect
**Limit:** Once per round; max 1 Karmic Due; expires end of next turn.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Avoid creating debts through damage, attack from outside the cultivator's sight/answering range, suppress Karmic Due with Unpaid Debt/Tangled Knot, or prevent the answering hit/save failure.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.karmic_:
#### Karmic Root Reserve

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Common Expression or higher
**Trigger:** Always Active
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Base: your maximum Path resource increases by PB. Use Stamina, Qi, or Resonance according to your Path. Integrated: increase it by another PB, stacking with the base passive. This increase is not recalculated or removed mid-scene unless the Foundation is fully severed by explicit story effect.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Passive Foundation benefit.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress or damage the Foundation through Unpaid Debt, Karmic Snarl, Tangled Knot, or sever/replace projects; ordinary dispels do not remove this passive.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.knot_ju:
#### Knot Judgment

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After You Hit or a Creature Fails Your Damaging Technique Save
**Cost:** 1 Karmic Due
**Range:** Self
**Target:** One hit or damaging technique
**Effect:** Spend 1 Karmic Due to add PB damage to one hit or one damaging technique effect after it resolves. The damage follows the triggering attack or technique. Refined and Perfected evolutions can stack onto this conversion.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Spend 1 Karmic Due; cannot spend on the same event that generated it.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Block the hit/save failure, suppress Karmic Due, remove the cultivator's ability to answer the debt, or use resistance/immunity against the damage type.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.ledger_:
#### Ledger Witness

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** After Rolling Before Outcome
**Cost:** 1 Karmic Due
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Attack or Save:** Check or save in Fixed Karma Knot Scope
**Effect:** Spend 1 Karmic Due after rolling but before the outcome to add PB to a Fixed Karma Knot Scope check or saving throw. Refined and Perfected evolutions can stack onto this conversion.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Spend 1 Karmic Due; roll must be inside Fixed Karma Knot Scope.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Keep the roll outside the Foundation's fixed scope, suppress Karmic Due, or resolve the outcome before the player declares the spend.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.perfect:
#### Perfected: Court of Consequence

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** When You Spend Karmic Due
**Range:** Self
**Target:** One legal Karmic Due conversion
**Effect:** Once per round, when you spend Karmic Due, increase one numeric benefit from that conversion by PB. This stacks with the base conversion and any chosen Refined evolution.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Once per round; passive rider; requires Perfected stage.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress the Foundation, suppress Karmic Due, prevent the base conversion, or deny a numeric benefit to increase.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.red_cor:
#### Red Cord Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Available At:** Awakened or higher
**Trigger:** When You or an Ally Within 30 Feet Takes Damage
**Cost:** 1 Karmic Due + Reaction
**Range:** 30 ft
**Target:** Self or one ally within 30 ft
**Effect:** Spend 1 Karmic Due and your Reaction to reduce the triggering damage by PB + your cultivation ability modifier. Refined and Perfected evolutions can stack onto this conversion.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Spend 1 Karmic Due and Reaction.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Bait or exhaust the Reaction, suppress Karmic Due, attack from beyond 30 ft of eligible allies, or use damage that cannot be reduced by Foundation features.
foundation.karma_knot_root_v0_2B.refined:
#### Refined: Debt-Answer Judgment

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined or higher
**Trigger:** When Knot Judgment Is Used
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Knot Judgment
**Effect:** If chosen as the Refined expression, Knot Judgment adds another PB damage. This stacks with the base Knot Judgment damage.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Passive rider; requires chosen Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress the Foundation, suppress Karmic Due, or prevent the base Knot Judgment conversion.

#### Refined: Guardian Knot

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined or higher
**Trigger:** When Red Cord Guard Is Used
**Range:** 30 ft
**Target:** Red Cord Guard
**Effect:** If chosen as the Refined expression, Red Cord Guard reduces damage by another PB. This stacks with the base Red Cord Guard reduction.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Passive rider; requires chosen Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress the Foundation, suppress Karmic Due, or prevent the base Red Cord Guard conversion.

#### Refined: True Ledger Witness

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined or higher
**Trigger:** When Ledger Witness Is Used
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Ledger Witness
**Effect:** If chosen as the Refined expression, Ledger Witness adds another PB to the same Fixed Karma Knot Scope roll. This stacks with the base Ledger Witness bonus.
**Duration:** Instant
**Limit:** Passive rider; requires chosen Refined expression.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Suppress the Foundation, suppress Karmic Due, or keep the roll outside Fixed Karma Knot Scope.
foundation.moon_mirror_still_water_v0_2B:
#### Generate Mirror Stillness

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After a hostile attack against you or an ally within 30 feet misses, after you or an ally within 30 feet succeeds on a saving throw against a hostile effect you can perceive, or after you correctly identify the true hostile source behind a decoy, illusion, dream, or curse under real pressure.
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Gain 1 Mirror Stillness after the qualifying trigger resolves. Maximum 1. Once per round. It expires at the end of your next turn. You cannot spend Mirror Stillness on the same event that generated it. You cannot generate it from friendly, staged, training, harmless, repeated non-threat, or purely passive waiting events.
**Limit:** Maximum 1; once per round; expires end of next turn; no same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Stop making visible attacks, use area pressure, split threats, or force the cultivator to act first.

#### Moon-Mirror Soul Vessel

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** Always active while the Foundation is available.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your maximum Hit Points increase by your Proficiency Bonus. Water, Yin, Illusion, Dreams, Fate, Protection, The Hidden Eye, Qiweaving, Karma, and Spirit Companions methods that reflect danger, discern hostile intent, protect an ally, stabilize a mind, or answer a curse may count as Foundation-aligned. You have Advantage on Wisdom checks and saving throws against hostile illusion, dream pressure, false images, charm, fear, curse-bait, and decoy-source effects. This passive requires no per-round tracking.
**Limit:** Passive only; grants no automatic reaction, no invisibility, and no sphere access.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use unseen sources, area pressure, false timing, overwhelming direct force, or make passivity costly.

#### Perfected: Moon-Mirror Lake

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** On your turn while conscious and the Foundation is Perfected.
**Cost:** Once per long rest
**Range:** Self
**Target:** 30-foot emanation
**Effect:** Activate Moon-Mirror Lake for 1 minute. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Cultivation Level + your Path key ability modifier. Chosen allies in the 30-foot emanation have Advantage on saving throws against fear, charm, illusion, dream, curse, and forced spiritual movement. Once per round, when a hostile attack misses a chosen ally in the lake or a chosen ally succeeds on a listed saving throw, you may generate Mirror Stillness after the trigger resolves, obeying the normal maximum, expiry, and same-event lockout. Mirror Stillness maximum remains 1.
**Limit:** Once per long rest; 1 minute; resource cap remains 1; no same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Leave the emanation, attack with mundane pressure, force many simultaneous threats, or break the cultivator’s calm.

#### Refined: Clear Moon Surface

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** Applies while the Foundation is Refined.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** This modifies Moon-Mirror Soul Vessel and Still-Water Reflection. Your maximum Hit Point bonus from this Foundation becomes twice your Proficiency Bonus. Still-Water Reflection may target an ally within 60 feet if you can see the ally and the triggering hostile pressure. This rider costs no extra Reaction, no extra resource, and does not permit same-event spending.
**Limit:** Rider only; no extra Reaction/resource; no same-event spend permission.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Break line of sight, attack outside range, or create multiple simultaneous threats.

#### Refined: Truth Beneath Reflection

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** When you spend Mirror Stillness on Still-Water Reflection or Reflected Opening.
**Range:** Varies by modified spend
**Target:** Target of modified spend
**Effect:** This modifies Still-Water Reflection or Reflected Opening. When you spend Mirror Stillness on either action, add your Proficiency Bonus to one numeric value produced by that spend. This rider does not require an additional action, Reaction, or resource spend, and does not permit same-event spending.
**Limit:** Rider only; affects one numeric value; no extra resource/reaction.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Bait the spend or use pressures outside the Foundation scope.

#### Reflected Opening

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After you hit a hostile creature with a Foundation-aligned attack or technique.
**Cost:** 1 Mirror Stillness
**Range:** Varies by triggering attack
**Target:** One hostile creature hit by the triggering attack
**Effect:** Spend 1 Mirror Stillness after the hit resolves. Add your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier as psychic, cold, or force damage. Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on the next check it makes to hide its true position, disguise its hostile intent, or maintain an illusion or decoy against you.
**Limit:** No extra action; must follow a real Foundation-aligned hit; no same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Avoid giving the cultivator Stillness, use non-illusion defenses, or force them to spend defensively.

#### Still Lake Breath

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Trigger:** On your turn while you have Mirror Stillness.
**Cost:** 1 Mirror Stillness
**Range:** Self or one ally within 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one ally
**Effect:** Spend 1 Mirror Stillness as a Bonus Action. The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. Before the start of your next turn, the target has Advantage on the next saving throw against fear, charm, illusion, dream, curse, or forced spiritual movement.
**Limit:** One target; temporary HP does not stack with itself; no same-event spending.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Pressure multiple creatures, use mundane damage, or wait out the short window.

#### Still-Water Reflection

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** You or an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack or fails a saving throw against a hostile effect you can perceive.
**Cost:** 1 Mirror Stillness
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one ally
**Effect:** Spend 1 Mirror Stillness as a Reaction. Add your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier to the protected creature’s AC against the triggering attack or to the failed saving throw. If this changes the outcome, the attack misses or the saving throw succeeds. If it does not change the outcome and the trigger deals damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus. This does not require an additional resource spend and does not permit same-event spending.
**Limit:** Requires Reaction; one target; cannot spend on the same event that generated Mirror Stillness.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Bait the Reaction, use multiple attacks, attack outside range, or use effects the cultivator cannot perceive.
foundation.mud_lotus_dantian_v0_2A.gener:
#### Generate Lotus Dew

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** You are conscious, have no Lotus Dew, and a real qualifying recovery, treatment, living-water, or contamination-resistance event resolves.
**Range:** Self or 30 feet
**Target:** Self, one ally, or qualifying scene event
**Effect:** Once per round, generate 1 Lotus Dew if you are conscious, have none, and one of these real events resolves: you or an ally within 30 feet regains HP through treatment or a Foundation-aligned method; you or an ally gains temporary HP from a Foundation-aligned recovery method; you or an ally succeeds on an eligible save against poison, disease, rot, polluted water, sickness-exhaustion, or terrain contamination; you spend CP on a Fixed Mud Lotus Scope technique; or you complete a meaningful treatment action in a dangerous scene. Friendly, staged, self-inflicted, harmless, training, repeated non-threatening, farmed, or corruption-preserving events cannot generate Lotus Dew.
**Limit:** Once per round; max 1; expires end of your next turn; cannot be spent on same event.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Deny staged/farmed healing loops, harmless contamination, fake treatment, or preservation of rot.
foundation.mud_lotus_dantian_v0_2A.humbl:
#### Humble Medicine Witness

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** You make a Fixed Mud Lotus Scope Medicine, Survival, herbalism, Water, Life, Flowers, Alchemy, Protection, Disease-treatment, Poison-treatment, or Cultivation Check/save.
**Cost:** 1 Lotus Dew
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self

foundation.mud_lotus_dantian_v0_2A.lotus:

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Trigger:** You spend Lotus Dew to support a willing creature through living-water, medicine, or humble recovery.
**Cost:** 1 Lotus Dew
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one willing creature
**Effect:** As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Lotus Dew and choose yourself or one willing creature within 30 feet. If the source is poison, disease, rot, polluted water, living terrain contamination, or failed medicine backlash, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus. This does not cleanse major curses, diseases, hidden injuries, or deviations by itself.
**Limit:** Costs 1 Lotus Dew; cannot spend Dew generated by same event.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use direct weapon damage, dry fire, sterile light, pride pressure, or non-scoped damage.

**Trigger:** Always active while this Foundation is installed.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** Your maximum CP increases by your Proficiency Bonus. foundation.verdant_returning_spring_v0_2:
#### Generate Spring Dew

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** After you restore Hit Points to a creature other than yourself, grant temporary Hit Points to a creature other than yourself, reduce damage for a creature other than yourself, or succeed on a meaningful treatment/stabilization against hostile poison, disease, rot, withering, anti-healing, or spiritual depletion.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** After the qualifying outward-support trigger resolves, if you are conscious and do not already have Spring Dew, gain Spring Dew 1/1. Spring Dew cannot be generated by its own spending, by self-only healing, by staged harmless conditions, by friendly training scenes, or by repeated non-threatening treatment loops.
**Limit:** Maximum 1; once per round; generated after trigger resolves; expires end of your next turn; cannot be spent on the event that generated it.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Prevent outward support, isolate targets, use anti-healing, or force the cultivator into self-only survival.

#### Perfected: Returning-Spring Grove

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Available At:** Perfected
**Trigger:** You activate the Perfected Foundation expression.
**Cost:** Once per long rest
**Range:** Self; 30-foot emanation
**Target:** Self and chosen allies in the emanation
**Effect:** Once per long rest as a Bonus Action, you open a 30-foot Returning-Spring Grove for 1 minute. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Cultivation Level + your Path key ability modifier. Chosen allies in the emanation have Advantage on saving throws against poison, disease, rot, withering, anti-healing pressure, and spiritual depletion. When you spend Spring Dew on a creature in the grove, that creature also gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Spring Dew maximum remains 1.
**Limit:** Does not heal each round, cure major afflictions, or increase Spring Dew maximum.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Leave the emanation, separate allies, use pressure outside the listed categories, or exhaust Dew timing.

#### Refined: Dew Returns Outward

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** You spend Spring Dew on a Foundation action while Refined.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** When you spend Spring Dew on Returning-Spring Guard, Verdant Mercy Bloom, or Spring Renewal Pulse, add your Proficiency Bonus to one numeric value produced by that spend. This modifies the base spend. It does not require an additional action, Reaction, or resource spend.
**Limit:** Applies once to the spend and does not increase resource maximum.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Force the cultivator to spend Dew inefficiently or attack after Dew is gone.

#### Refined: Moonspring Root

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Available At:** Refined
**Trigger:** This rider is active while the Foundation is Refined.
**Range:** Self
**Target:** Self
**Effect:** When Refined, the Hit Point increase from Verdant Spring Vessel becomes twice your Proficiency Bonus. Returning-Spring Guard may target an ally you can see within 60 feet instead of 30 feet.
**Limit:** Does not increase Spring Dew maximum and does not let the guard protect targets through total cover.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Break line of sight, outrange the support line, or force multiple simultaneous injuries.

#### Returning-Spring Guard

**Type:** Reaction
**Trigger:** You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage from a hostile source.
**Cost:** 1 Spring Dew
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one ally taking the triggering damage
**Effect:** Spend 1 Spring Dew to reduce the triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. If the source is poison, disease, necrotic damage, rot, withering, hostile plant corruption, anti-healing pressure, or spiritual depletion, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus.
**Limit:** Does not restore HP and cannot generate Spring Dew from its own prevention.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Use burst damage outside 30 feet, anti-healing effects, or pressure the cultivator before Dew is available.

#### Spring Renewal Pulse

**Type:** Bonus Action
**Trigger:** You take a Bonus Action on your turn while Spring Dew is available.
**Cost:** 1 Spring Dew
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** Self or one willing creature within 30 feet
**Effect:** Spend 1 Spring Dew. The target gains temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier. Before the start of your next turn, the target has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes against poison, disease, rot, withering, anti-healing pressure, or spiritual depletion.
**Limit:** Does not cure the condition by itself and does not stack with itself on the same target.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Attack through other pressure types, wait out the short window, or force multiple saves.

#### Verdant Mercy Bloom

**Type:** No Action / Triggered
**Trigger:** You restore Hit Points, grant temporary Hit Points, or reduce damage for a creature other than yourself with a qualifying Foundation-aligned method.
**Cost:** 1 Spring Dew
**Range:** Range of the triggering effect
**Target:** One creature affected by the triggering support
**Effect:** Spend 1 Spring Dew to add your Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier to one healing, temporary Hit Point, or damage reduction value affecting a creature other than yourself. If the target is at 0 Hit Points, it is also stabilized if the effect leaves it alive and the source is not a forbidden anti-life wound.
**Limit:** Cannot target self-only support and cannot make the same support event generate and spend Dew.
**Counterplay and Boundaries:** Force self-only survival, block line of effect, or apply effects that prevent stabilization.

#### Cloud-Step Crane Vessel

**Trigger:** After you move at least 10 feet on your turn and hit a hostile creature with a Foundation-aligned melee, thrown, Air, spear, sword, or body-bound attack.

**Target:** Self
**Effect:** If you do not already have Crane Breath, gain Crane Breath 1/1 after the qualifying event resolves. It expires at the end of your next turn and cannot be spent on the event that generated it.

**Target:** Self

**Available At:** Perfected

**Target:** Self
**Effect:** For 1 minute, gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Cultivation Level + your Path key ability modifier. **Target:** Self
