### CL10 — Gate of the Inner Sea

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 25-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 5 Qi

Open a gate through which your inner sea floods the battlefield.

The field is Heavily Obscured to hostile creatures beyond 10 feet unless they can see through supernatural water or darkness.

Hostile creatures treat the field as difficult terrain.

A hostile creature makes a Strength saving throw when it:

- Enters the field for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn inside the field.

**Failed Save:**

- `4d8` Cold or Force damage.
- Pull it 15 feet toward the center.
- Gain one Depth Mark.

**Successful Save:**

- Half damage.
- Pull it 5 feet.

#### Sea Without Surface

Inside the field:

- Creatures without a Swim Speed move as though swimming.
- You and chosen allies gain a Swim Speed equal to walking Speed.
- You and chosen allies breathe normally.
- Fire-tagged persistent effects of lower Source CL are suppressed.
- Teleportation by a creature bearing at least three Depth Marks requires a successful Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.

#### Inner-Sea Passage

At the start of your turn, teleport from one point inside the field to another legal point inside it.

This costs 1 Inner-Sea Depth and does not require an action.

---

### CL3 — Inner Sea Awakening

Gain:

- Resistance to Cold damage.
- Swim Speed equal to walking Speed.
- Ability to breathe air and water.
- Immunity to ordinary deep-water pressure.
- Darkvision 60 feet while submerged or inside an Abyssal field.

#### Pressure of Recognition

Once per turn after one of your Qi-powered features damages, pulls, pushes, Grapples, Restrains, or slows a hostile creature, place one Depth Mark on it.

#### Spend Depth — Crushing Water

**Trigger:** One of your Qi-powered features affects a creature bearing a Depth Mark.  
**Cost:** 1 Inner-Sea Depth  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Choose one:

- Deal `2d8` Cold or Force damage.
- Pull it 10 feet.
- Reduce its Speed by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.
- Prevent it from taking Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.

At CL17, damage becomes `4d8`.

### CL14 — Leviathan Swallows the Moon

#### Abyssal Swallow

**Action**  
**Range:** 30 feet from you or your Domain Armament  
**Target:** One creature bearing at least three Depth Marks  
**Cost:** 5 Qi and remove three Depth Marks  
**Saving Throw:** Strength

**Failed Save:** The target is swallowed into your Inner Sea for up to 1 minute.

While swallowed:

- It occupies a separate bounded abyssal space.
- It has Total Cover from the outside world.
- It cannot affect or be affected by outside creatures except through features explicitly entering or reaching the Inner Sea.
- It takes `3d8` Cold or Force damage at the start of each turn.
- Its Speed is halved.
- It cannot willingly teleport or shift planes unless its effect has higher Source CL and succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
- It can breathe if it normally breathes water. Otherwise, it holds its breath under the normal suffocation procedure.

At the end of each turn, it may make a Strength or Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the swallow on a success.

A creature at least 6 CL lower than you receives no automatic end-of-turn attempt. It may still use an Action to attempt the check or activate an appropriate escape feature.

**Successful Save:**

- It is pulled 10 feet toward the origin.
- Its Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.

Abyssal Swallow ends when:

- You become Unconscious.
- The duration ends.
- You willingly release the creature.
- The creature escapes.
- A higher-authority effect breaches the Inner Sea.

When released, the creature appears in the nearest legal space to you or your Domain Armament.

You may hold one swallowed creature.

#### Inner-Sea Prisoner

While a creature is swallowed:

- Gain 1 Inner-Sea Depth at the start of each of your turns.
- You know its current Hit Points, Cultivation Point total, and active movement modes.
- It cannot conceal its broad cultivation category from your Qi Sensing.

This feature does not automatically steal memories or techniques.

---

### CL18 — World Beneath the Black Sea

**Bonus Action**  
**Area:** 50-foot-radius, 60-foot-high cylinder centered on you or your Domain Armament  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Overlay the battlefield with the primordial Black Sea.

For the duration:

- Gain Immunity to Cold damage.
- Gain Resistance to all damage except Force, Psychic, Radiant, and Void.
- Gain a Swim and Fly Speed of 60 feet and Hover.
- Gate of the Inner Sea is active throughout the field without separate Concentration.
- Gain 1 Inner-Sea Depth at the start of each turn.
- Crushing Water costs 0 Depth once per turn.
- Abyssal Maw costs 0 Qi once per turn.
- You may hold up to your Proficiency Bonus in swallowed creatures.
- A swallowed creature takes `5d8` Cold or Force damage instead of `3d8`.

#### Sinking Law

At the start of each hostile creature’s turn in the field, it makes a Strength saving throw.

Its Depth Marks modify the result:

- Subtract 1 from the save per Depth Mark.

**Failed Save:**

- Pulled 15 feet toward the field’s center or downward, your choice.
- Speed reduced by 15 feet.
- Cannot take Reactions.

**Successful Save:**

- Pulled 5 feet.

#### Abyssal Authority

A creature bearing four or more Depth Marks:

- Cannot regain Cultivation Points.
- Cannot willingly teleport without succeeding on a Charisma saving throw.
- Has Disadvantage on checks to escape your Grapples, Restrained effects, or Inner Sea.

A creature bearing six or more Depth Marks may be targeted by Abyssal Swallow without removing Marks and without paying Qi once per turn.

#### Leviathan Emergence

Once during the activation, use an Action to manifest a colossal leviathan through the field.

Choose any number of hostile creatures inside.

Each makes a Strength saving throw.

**Failed Save:**

- `10d10` Cold or Force damage.
- Gain two Depth Marks.
- Pulled up to 30 feet.
- If it reaches six Depth Marks, you may immediately swallow it if you have capacity.

**Successful Save:**

- Half damage.
- Gain one Depth Mark.

#### Drown the Cultivation

Once per round, choose one creature swallowed in your Inner Sea.

It makes a Constitution saving throw.

**Failed Save:** Until the start of your next turn:

- It cannot spend or regain Cultivation Points.
- Its Domain Armament is suppressed.
- It cannot begin a new Path, Subpath, Sphere, Method, Foundation-active, Recorded Art, Forged Technique, or Immortal Art activation.

**Successful Save:**

- Its next Cultivation Point cost before the start of your next turn increases by 2.

A creature at least 6 CL lower than you receives no initial save against Drown the Cultivation while swallowed. A higher-authority escape or protection can still oppose it.

### CL6 — Banner Guards the Host

At the end of your turn, designate one creature within 5 feet of the Banner. It is protected until the start of your next turn.

The protected creature gains:

- `+2 AC` against ranged attack rolls.
- Advantage on saving throws against Frightened.
- The ability to use the Banner as Half Cover against one ranged attack per round when the line of attack crosses the Banner’s space.

The protection ends if:

- The creature moves more than 5 feet from the Banner.
- The Banner is dispersed or suppressed.
- The Banner moves more than 5 feet from the creature.

#### Dread Interception

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** The protected creature takes ranged damage or fails a saving throw against Frightened.  
**Cost:** 1 Dread  
**Limit:** Once per round

Choose one:

- Reduce the ranged damage by `2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier`.
- Add PB to the failed Frightened save, potentially turning it into a success.

At CL11, damage reduction becomes `3d8 + modifier`. At CL17, `4d8 + modifier`.

#### Intercept through Domain Armament

If the Banner is your Domain Armament, Dread Interception functions while it is in either Assault or Guard Mode. In Assault Mode, the passive `+2 AC` does not apply, but the Reaction remains available.

---

### CL10 — Calamity Court Field

You raise the Banner as the center of a mobile daemonic court.

**Action**  
**Cost:** 5 Qi  
**Area:** 20-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder centered on the Banner  
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute

The field moves with the Banner.

A hostile creature that enters for the first time during a turn or starts its turn there makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:**

- Take `3d8` Psychic or Necrotic damage.
- Become Demon-Marked until the end of your next turn.
- Become Frightened until the start of its next turn.

**Successful Save:**

- Take half damage.
- Become Demon-Marked until the end of your next turn.
- Not Frightened by this activation.

A creature is affected by the entry/start trigger once per turn.

#### Court Favor

Choose a number of allies up to your Qi key ability modifier when the field begins. A chosen ally inside the field gains:

- `+1` to attack rolls against Demon-Marked creatures.
- Temporary Hit Points equal to PB at the start of its turn.
- Advantage on checks made to resist forced movement by a Demon-Marked creature.

Temporary Hit Points do not stack with themselves.

#### Field Disruption

If the Banner is dispersed, the field ends.

An equal- or higher-Source-CL consecrated field can contest the Calamity Court at the beginning of each of your turns. Make a Cultivation Check against the opposing field’s save DC.

**Success:** Your field functions normally.  
**Failure:** Its radius is reduced to 10 feet until the start of your next turn and Court Favor grants no Temporary Hit Points during that time.

---

### CL14 — Edict of the Calamity Court

You issue a court order through the mark.

**Bonus Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet from you or the Banner  
**Target:** One Demon-Marked creature  
**Cost:** 2 Dread  
**Limit:** Once per turn  
**Saving Throw:** Wisdom

Choose one Edict.

#### Kneel

**Failure:** The target falls Prone and its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn.  
**Success:** Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.

#### Flee

**Failure:** It must use its Reaction, if available, to move up to half its Speed away from the Banner by the safest legal route.  
**Success:** It cannot willingly move closer to the Banner until the start of its next turn.

#### Silence

**Failure:** It cannot use Audible or Resonant techniques and cannot provide verbal commands until the start of its next turn.  
**Success:** It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

#### Pay Tribute

**Failure:** The next Cultivation Point cost it pays before the end of its next turn increases by 2. If it cannot pay, the activation fails and no cost is spent.  
**Success:** The next cost increases by 1.

#### Break Formation

**Failure:** Until the start of its next turn, it cannot provide or receive bonuses from a Formation, coordinated stance, command aura, linked defense, or shared reaction.  
**Success:** One such bonus of your choice is suppressed until the end of the current turn.

A successful save against any Edict also prevents the target from taking Reactions until the start of its next turn unless the selected success result is already stronger.

#### Lower-Realm Judgment

A target whose Source CL is 6 or more lower and which failed its save cannot repeat or negate the Edict through an ordinary lower-authority feature during its duration.

A target whose Source CL is 3 or more higher gains Advantage on the save unless it currently has at least 3 separate Daemonic marks, conditions, or active effects from you.

---

**Limit:** Once per scene

For the duration:

- Gain 1 Corruption.
- Take `4d10` Psychic damage.

#### End of Court

At normal duration end, if you spent at least 5 Dread during the Procession, choose one:

You can preserve and reproduce the pattern of one devoured disaster.

Record one Pattern until your next long rest:

### CL3 — Devour the Blow

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You or a creature within 15 feet is affected by a qualifying harmful technique, hazard, forced movement, condition, or damage packet.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per round

Choose one component of the event:

- One forced movement.
- One condition.

- Gain one Devoured Calamity of the appropriate type.
- Record one associated rider such as Prone, reaction denial, Fire, teleport suppression, pressure, fear, or Cultivation Point loss.

#### Consume the Price

Once per turn, spend one Devoured Calamity when activating a Qi-powered feature to choose two different benefits:

- Add `1d8` associated damage.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Increase forced movement by 10 feet.
- Move your Domain Armament 20 feet.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to a Cultivation Check.
- Apply the recorded minor rider to one damaged target until the start of your next turn.

A minor rider cannot impose Stunned, complete cultivation suppression, instant death, or a permanent effect at this level.

A willing or self-created calamity can be consumed when:

- The normal cost is paid.
- Damage and consequences are real.
- The event can defeat, injure, scar, or meaningfully set you back.
- The resulting Calamity cannot fully refund the event through a closed loop.

---

**Reaction**

**Cost:** 5 Qi and one Devoured Calamity

Choose one target, area, Anchor, or active effect component.

Choose one:

- Remove one condition or rider from all targets.

- Prevent Cultivation Point loss.

Choose one:

#### Success against Higher Source CL

- Reduce damage by `5d10 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier`.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to one target’s saving throw.

The original effect resolves.

You still take `3d10` Force or Lightning damage as the decree burns through your furnace.

- A sect-protecting weather catastrophe.
- A curse sentence.

- A Formation collapse.

**Cost:** 3 Qi

**Cost:** 10 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

For the duration:

- Gain two Overflow Calamities at the start of each turn. They disappear at the end of that turn.

- You have suffered it during the scene.

**Trigger:** You are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright.  
**Cost:** 5 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Instead of falling Unconscious normally, collapse into a stationary cloud of ash in your space.

Until the start of your next turn:

- You remain at 0 Hit Points.
- You are Incapacitated, Stable, and have Speed 0.
- You do not make death saving throws.
- Ordinary damage cannot affect you.
- You cannot be healed or activate features.

Force, Radiant, and Void damage can affect the ash. If the ash takes any of those types, Ashen Rebirth ends, you become Unconscious at 0 Hit Points, and suffer one failed death saving throw.

At the start of your next turn if the feature remains active:

1. Reform in your space or an unoccupied space within 10 feet.
2. Regain Hit Points equal to `5 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
3. Stand without spending movement.
4. Create a 10-foot-radius ash cloud until the start of your following turn. It is Lightly Obscured to hostile creatures; you and chosen allies see normally through it.

Ashen Rebirth does not restore a destroyed body, reverse decapitation, prevent disintegration, or overcome an effect explicitly preventing resurrection or soul return.

### CL18 — Cinder Sovereign’s Wrath

**Bonus Action**  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

For the duration:

- Gain Immunity to Fire damage.
- Gain Resistance to Cold and Necrotic damage.
- Shed Bright Light 30 feet and Dim Light another 30 feet.
- Cinder Touch deals an additional `3d8` Fire damage instead of PB.
- Heart of the Forge may trigger from a hostile Fire effect even if it deals 0 damage.

#### Sovereign Heat

A hostile creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when it enters within 10 feet for the first time during a turn or starts there.

- **Failed Save:** `4d8` Fire damage and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.

After you move at least 10 feet during your turn, create one burning 5-foot space you passed through. You may maintain a number of burning spaces equal to your Proficiency Bonus; creating another removes the oldest.

---

Gain Resistance to Fire damage.

Once per turn, when one of your Qi-powered techniques deals damage, one creature damaged by the activation takes additional Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

#### Revealing Ember

After applying Cinder Touch, mark the damaged creature with a visible ember until the start of your next turn. While marked:

- **Refine the Spark:** Gain Advantage on your next Cultivation Attack before the end of your next turn.

**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** Touch

Choose one eligible item and one Gift. You may maintain one Promethean Gift. Creating another ends the previous Gift.

Choose one weapon. While wielded by a proficient creature:

The first time during each turn a creature knowingly states a factual claim it believes to be false, it makes a Charisma saving throw. On failure, the flame turns black until the statement ends. Your body becomes living cloud.

For the duration:

**Trigger:** Your Cremation Fire damages a creature.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn  
**Saving Throw:** Constitution

Mark the target with an Ash Sentence for 1 minute.

#### Failed Save

The target is **Cremation-Sealed**.

While Cremation-Sealed:

- When it spends Cultivation Points, it takes Cremation Fire damage equal to the number spent.

#### Successful Save

Until the start of your next turn:

- Healing it receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
- It cannot gain Temporary Hit Points.

A creature can bear one Ash Sentence from you. Reapplying it refreshes the duration.

#### Funeral Flame

When a creature bearing your Ash Sentence is reduced to 0 Hit Points:

- Gain one Ash Charge, subject to your normal limit.
- Its body and spirit trace begin to cremate.
- Until the end of your next turn, an effect attempting to heal it from 0 Hit Points, revive it, capture its soul, possess its body, or convert it into an undead or asset must succeed on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

On failure, the attempt is wasted only if its cost is ordinary and recoverable. Permanent sacrifices, irreplaceable materials, and story-limited charges are not spent on a failed pre-resolution check unless their Source Rule says otherwise.

---

### CL10 — Burn the Scripture

You learn to cremate an active cultivation structure rather than merely damage its bearer.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 5 Qi  
**Saving Throw:** Constitution

Choose one active, perceived effect on the target:

- A Path, Subpath, Sphere, Method, Foundation, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, item, Formation, or cultivated state effect with a remaining duration.
- One maintained transformation.
- One active aura, field, stance, mark, or summoned projection.
- One named technique currently affecting the target.

#### Failed Save

Make a Cultivation Check against the selected effect’s save DC. If it has none, use:

`8 + source Proficiency Bonus + source key ability modifier`

On a successful check:

- End the effect if its Source CL is lower than yours.
- Suppress it for 1 minute if its Source CL equals yours.
- Suppress it until the end of your next turn if its Source CL is higher.

The target repeats the feature’s Constitution save at the end of each turn when the effect is suppressed for 1 minute, ending the suppression on a success.

On a failed Cultivation Check:

- The effect remains active.
- You learn its Source CL and whether its authority is Path, Sphere, Method, Foundation, item, Formation, spirit, bloodline, or another recorded category.

#### Successful Save

The selected effect is not ended or suppressed.

The target takes `3d8` Cremation Fire damage.

#### Ash of the Burned Law

When Burn the Scripture ends or suppresses an effect, gain one Ash Charge.

You may store the resulting **Scripture Ash** until the scene ends. Once before then, consume it when activating a Qi-powered feature to choose one:

- Add `3d8` damage of a type used by the burned effect.
- Gain Resistance to one damage type used by it until the start of your next turn.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to one saving throw against the same named effect.
- Reduce the Qi cost of one feature sharing a tag with the burned effect by 2, minimum 1.

You can hold one Scripture Ash at a time.

Burn the Scripture cannot permanently erase a Path, Foundation, Method, Secret Law, or artifact at this level.

---

### CL18 — Cremate Heaven and Earth

**Action**  
**Range:** 120 feet  
**Area:** 40-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 10 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

A sovereign cremation furnace encloses the field.

For the duration:

- Gain Immunity to Fire damage.
- Gain Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage.
- Cremation Touch deals `4d8` additional damage instead of damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Spend Ash can spend up to two Charges during each turn, choosing different benefits.
- Burn the Scripture costs 3 Qi instead of 5 and can be used as a Bonus Action once per turn.
- Cremation Prison’s restrictions function throughout this field without a separate activation.

#### World-Ash Judgment

A hostile creature makes a Constitution saving throw when it enters or starts its turn inside.

##### Failed Save

- `8d8` Cremation Fire damage.
- Cremation-Sealed until the end of its next turn.
- One active cultivation system is scorched until the end of its next turn. Choose one system you can perceive: weapon-delivered techniques, one Sphere, Domain Armament, Golden Core Form, Nascent Soul continuity, Method active features, Foundation active features, Subpath features, flight, teleportation, or item activations.

The selected system is suppressed during that period.

##### Successful Save

- Half damage.
- Cremation-Sealed until the start of its next turn.

#### Final Cremation

Once during the activation, target one creature inside bearing your Ash Sentence.

It makes a Constitution saving throw with Advantage if its Source CL is higher than yours and with Disadvantage if it is at least 6 CL lower.

On failure:

- Suppress all Cultivation Point expenditure until the end of its next turn.
- If reduced to 0 Hit Points by this damage, its body, active spirit shell, and current cultivation projections are reduced to sovereign ash.
- Until the end of the scene, resurrection, reincarnation, soul capture, possession, reanimation, or restoration of that creature requires a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

If its Source CL is lower than yours, a failed restoration check cannot be retried until the scene ends or the restorer obtains a new higher-authority method, artifact, or Anchor.

On success:

- Half damage.
- It retains Cultivation Point expenditure.

Final Cremation does not permanently erase a true soul, Samsara identity, Secret Law, or artifact-protected existence unless another Source Rule explicitly grants that authority.

### CL3 — Cremation-Furnace Core

Gain Resistance to Fire damage.

Your Cinder Touch is replaced by **Cremation Touch**.

#### Cremation Touch

Once per turn, when one of your Qi-powered features deals damage, choose one creature damaged by it.

It takes additional Cremation Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

Choose Fire or Necrotic damage each time.

#### Spend Ash

Once per turn, when you activate a Qi-powered feature, spend one Ash Charge to choose one:

- Add `1d8` Cremation Fire damage to one damage roll.
- Reduce the feature’s Qi cost by 1, minimum 1.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Move your Domain Armament 20 feet.
- Cause one target damaged by the feature to shed visible ash until the start of your next turn, preventing Invisible and ordinary concealment from hiding it from you.

A single activation can spend one Ash Charge through this feature.

#### Corpse and Residue Rite

**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** Touch

Cremate one corpse, spirit shell, destroyed summon, or significant cultivation residue.

Choose one result:

- Prevent ordinary reanimation of the remains.
- Purify mundane disease and ordinary corpse contamination.
- Determine whether the remains carry a curse, possession, poison, corruption, soul fragment, or active cultivation imprint.
- Gain one Ash Charge if the remains are meaningful and have not already generated one for you during the scene.

This rite does not defeat a resurrection, reincarnation, soul-return, or ancestor-restoration effect whose Source CL exceeds yours without a later feature.

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 6 Qi

A black-red cremation furnace manifests around the area.

A hostile creature makes a Constitution saving throw when it:

- Enters the Prison for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn inside.

A creature is affected once per turn.

#### Failed Save

The creature:

The creature:

#### Burn the Escape

When a hostile creature inside activates a teleportation, Incorporeal movement, possession, spirit projection, or bodily transformation feature, it must make a Charisma saving throw.

On failure:

The Prison has one central Furnace Anchor:

- **Hit Points:** `5 × your Qi Cultivation CL`
- **Resistance:** Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Fire, Necrotic

- **Source CL:** Your CL

### CL18 — Banquet of Ten Thousand Tables

**Ritual Time:** 1 hour  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Ingredients:** At least ten complete Meal Portions and any rare ingredients required by chosen Courses  
**Targets:** Up to `100 × your CL` willing creatures that attend and consume a portion  
**Duration:** 24 hours  
**Limit:** Once per Cultivation Session

You establish a strategic-scale cultivated banquet, war commissary, sect feast, relief kitchen, shipboard provision rite, or ancestral table.

Each target gains:

- Two Meal Courses of its choice.
- One Body-Forging Course of its choice.
- Immunity to ordinary hunger, thirst, food spoilage, and environmental sickness for the duration.
- Advantage against Exhaustion from travel, forced marching, carrying loads, exposure, and physical overexertion.
- One **Heavenly Ration** carried within the body as cultivated nourishment.

#### Heavenly Ration

A creature may consume its Heavenly Ration without using an action when one of the following occurs:

- It is reduced to 0 Hit Points without being killed outright.
- It fails a Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or death saving throw.
- It gains a level of Exhaustion from physical exertion, exposure, hunger, thirst, poison, or disease.
- It begins its turn with fewer than half its Hit Points.

Choose one result:

- Become Stable, regain `4d8 + your key ability modifier` Hit Points, and stand if physically able.
- Turn the failed saving throw into a success when the opposing Source CL is no higher than yours; against higher authority, reroll with Advantage.
- Prevent the triggering level of Exhaustion.
- Regain `4d8 + your key ability modifier` Hit Points and Temporary Hit Points equal to `3 × PB`.

A Heavenly Ration disappears when used or when the Banquet duration ends. It is not a separate item and cannot be stolen or transferred after the feast.

#### No Army Starves

For 30 days after the Banquet, its Camp Kitchen Anchor can produce enough ordinary preserved food and clean water for `100 × your CL` creatures each day, provided at least one Supply Unit, seed stock, hunted game, harvested crop, or other genuine food source is supplied each day.

This multiplies and preserves logistics; it does not create unlimited matter from nothing.

#### Feast Before Battle

Once before the 24-hour duration ends, a target may use a Bonus Action to awaken the Banquet’s martial nourishment for 1 minute:

- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `5 × PB`.
- Ignore difficult terrain caused by rubble, mud, snow, vegetation, or bodies.
- Gain Advantage on Strength and Constitution checks and saving throws.
- The first time each turn it hits with a weapon attack or bodily cultivation technique, add `1d8` damage.

A creature can awaken Feast Before Battle once per Banquet.

Banquet of Ten Thousand Tables does not diagnose hidden conditions, reveal lies, conduct precision purification, or provide reaction-based correction. Those are Tea-Sage authorities.

---

### CL3 — Body-Tempering Meal

Learn three **Meal Courses** from the list below. Learn one additional Course at CL6 and all Courses at CL14.

#### Prepare Body-Tempering Meal

**Ritual Time:** 1 hour  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Ingredients:** One day of ordinary food per target  
**Targets:** Yourself and up to `2 × PB` willing creatures  
**Duration:** Until the end of the target’s next long rest

Each target consumes one Meal Portion and gains one Course. A creature may benefit from one Culinary Course at a time; another replaces it.

#### Iron-Bone Stew

Hit Point maximum increases by `2 × PB`, and current Hit Points increase by the same amount. Both decrease when the Course ends, never reducing current Hit Points below 1.

#### Long-March Rice

Speed increases by 5 feet. The creature has Advantage against Exhaustion caused by travel, forced marching, hunger, thirst, ordinary exposure, or carrying loads.

#### Bitter-Herb Broth

Advantage on saving throws against poison, disease, contaminated food or water, parasites, and ordinary environmental sickness.

#### Furnace-Spice Skewers

When Initiative is rolled, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × PB`. Once before the Course ends, add PB to a Strength or Constitution check after rolling.

#### Clear-Fish Soup

Gain +2 to Perception, Survival, and Medicine checks involving food, water, tracks, bodily condition, or environmental hazards. Passive scores increase equally where relevant.

#### Festival Dumplings

Advantage on the first saving throw during each scene against Charmed or Frightened. After succeeding, gain Temporary Hit Points equal to PB.

#### Preserve Provisions

During the same ritual, you may spend ingredients to create a number of Supply Units equal to your Proficiency Bonus. They remain fresh for 7 days, are protected from ordinary vermin and spoilage, and weigh half as much as equivalent untreated provisions.

---

### CL10 — Cultivated Camp Kitchen

**Setup Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** 30 feet  
**Area:** 30-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 24 hours  
**Cost:** 4 Qi  
**Anchor:** A real or projected stove, cauldron, oven, galley, wagon kitchen, or Culinary Domain Armament

Create a fixed Culinary Formation. You may maintain one.

Inside the Kitchen:

- Ordinary food cooks safely and does not spoil.
- Ordinary drinking water is purified of mundane contamination.
- Smoke, scent, sparks, and cooking noise can be contained within the boundary when you choose.
- Ordinary insects, vermin, and weather cannot contaminate stored provisions.
- Environmental heat and cold do not interfere with food preparation.
- With sufficient ingredients, ten minutes of work prepares ordinary meals for `10 × your CL` creatures.
- One hour of work preserves a number of Supply Units equal to `2 × PB` for 30 days.

#### Camp Discipline

Allies who spend at least 1 hour resting, eating, repairing equipment, or preparing supplies inside gain:

- Advantage against Exhaustion from travel, hunger, thirst, exposure, and forced marching until the end of the next travel segment.
- Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw made before the end of the next scene.
- Immunity to ordinary food poisoning and contaminated water from provisions prepared in the Kitchen.

#### Kitchen Recovery

A creature completing a short rest inside may spend one Supply Unit or one day of ingredients and choose one:

- Regain additional Hit Points equal to `2 × PB`.
- Regain one additional spent Hit Die, up to its normal maximum.
- Suppress one level of Exhaustion caused by travel, hunger, thirst, exposure, ordinary illness, or physical overexertion until the end of its next long rest.
- Repeat one save against an ordinary poison or disease with Advantage.

A creature can receive Kitchen Recovery once per long rest. Suppressed Exhaustion returns unless removed normally.

#### Mobile Commissary

A wagon, ship galley, carried cauldron, or appropriately sized Culinary Domain Armament may serve as the Anchor. The Kitchen can move with that vehicle or Asset, but it cannot move faster than a normal travel pace without ending. It does not function as a combat aura.

Destroying or removing the Anchor ends the Kitchen under the shared Anchor rules.

---

### CL6 — Sealed Field Rations

You learn one additional Meal Course.

Whenever you Prepare a Body-Tempering Meal, create a number of **Sealed Field Rations** equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Choose the type of each ration when it is made.

A creature carrying a ration may consume it as a Bonus Action. Another creature may administer it to an adjacent willing or Unconscious creature as an Action.

A ration remains potent for 24 hours and then becomes ordinary food. It is a physical preparation and can be stolen, destroyed, distributed, or rationed.

#### Restorative Ration

Regain `2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier` Hit Points.

#### Fortifying Ration

Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2d8 + your key ability modifier`.

#### Bitter Ration

Repeat one saving throw against Poisoned, disease, contaminated food or water, or a bodily toxin. Gain Advantage when the Source CL is no higher than yours.

#### Courage Ration

Repeat one saving throw against Frightened or a morale-breaking effect. Gain Advantage when the Source CL is no higher than yours.

#### Marching Ration

Move up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks and ignore difficult terrain until the end of the current turn.

#### Bracing Ration

Gain Advantage on the next Strength, Constitution, or death saving throw before the end of the next turn.

A creature can consume one Sealed Field Ration per turn. Creating additional rations outside meal preparation requires 10 minutes, actual ingredients, and 2 Qi for up to PB rations. Culinary Cultivators therefore prepare and distribute resources rather than producing unlimited emergency servings on demand.

---

### CL14 — Thousand-Person Commissary

You learn all Meal Courses.

#### Double Course

A creature may benefit from two different Meal Courses simultaneously. Receiving a third replaces one of its choice.

#### Marching Stores

Supply Units you preserve:

- Remain fresh for one year.
- Weigh one quarter as much as untreated provisions.
- Resist ordinary fire, water, rot, vermin, and spoilage.
- Can be recognized and opened only by creatures you authorize unless a thief succeeds on a Dexterity check using suitable tools or a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

During one hour in your Camp Kitchen, you may prepare ordinary food for `100 × your CL` creatures or create `10 × PB` Supply Units when sufficient ingredients exist.

#### Deploy the Rations

**Action**  
**Area:** 20-foot-radius sphere centered on you, your Culinary Domain Armament, or your Camp Kitchen Anchor  
**Cost:** One Sealed Field Ration or one Supply Unit per affected creature  
**Targets:** Any number of willing creatures inside

Each target consumes a ration and chooses one:

- Regain `3d8 + your key ability modifier` Hit Points.
- Gain the same amount as Temporary Hit Points.
- End lower- or equal-Source-CL Poisoned or Frightened.
- Repeat a higher-Source-CL save against poison, disease, fear, or physical exhaustion with Advantage.
- Move up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Gain Advantage on its next Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw before the end of its next turn.

A creature can benefit from Deploy the Rations once per scene. The physical supply cost is paid even if the target later wastes the benefit.

#### Body-Forging Course

When you Prepare a Body-Tempering Meal, spend 3 additional Qi and rare ingredients appropriate to the campaign. Each target chooses one bodily reinforcement until the end of its next long rest:

- +1 AC while wearing armor or wielding a shield it is proficient with.
- Resistance to one of Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison damage.
- Carrying capacity and push, drag, and lift limits double.
- Speed increases by another 10 feet.
- Advantage on death saving throws and checks made to resist bodily transformation.

A creature can benefit from one Body-Forging Course at a time.

---

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 3 Qi  
**Saving Throw:** Dexterity

#### Failed Save

The target is Restrained by direct cultivated chains.

- It cannot become Incorporeal.
- It cannot use supernatural movement that ignores intervening space.

Until the start of your next turn:

- Speed is reduced by 10 feet.
- It cannot take Reactions.
- It cannot willingly teleport.

---

### CL18 — Heaven-Sealing Edict

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

Choose one visible creature. Three immense **Seal Pillars** appear in legal unoccupied spaces within 30 feet of it. Each Pillar is an Anchor and bears one named binding:

1. **Outer Heaven Pillar** — movement, teleportation, flight, phasing, possession, and remote origins.
2. **Meridian Pillar** — Cultivation Point expenditure and recovery, Sphere techniques, weapon-delivered cultivation, and Domain Armament functions.
3. **Core Pillar** — Path, Subpath, Method, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Foundation active systems, cultivated-item activations, Recorded Arts, Forged Techniques, and Immortal Arts.

#### Seal Pillar Profile

- **Size:** Medium object
- **AC:** Your Cultivation Save DC
- **Hit Points:** `6 × your CL` each
- **Resistance:** Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from noncultivated attacks
- **Immunity:** Poison and Psychic damage
- **Source CL:** Your CL
- **Movement:** None

A Pillar must be placed on a legal surface or in a legal Formation position. If no legal space exists for all three, the activation fails before Qi is spent.

#### Initial Resistance

The target makes one Charisma saving throw.

##### Successful Save

Only the Outer Heaven Pillar binds the target until the start of your next turn. The other two Pillars still appear but do not bind unless the target fails a later Edict save.

##### Failed Save

The target is bound by a number of Pillars based on authority and preparation:

- **Within 2 CL or higher:** Outer Heaven and Meridian Pillars.
- **3–5 CL lower:** All three Pillars.
- **At least 6 CL lower, Completely Subdued, or already bearing your Core Seal:** All three Pillars, and Core Pillar imposes Complete Cultivation Suppression.

At the end of each of its turns, a target within 2 CL of you or higher repeats the Charisma save. On success, suppress one active Pillar of its choice until the end of its next turn.

A target 3–5 CL lower repeats the save at the end of every second turn. A target at least 6 CL lower receives no automatic repeat save.

#### Binding Effects

For each active Pillar:

- **Outer Heaven:** Speed is 0; the target cannot willingly teleport, fly, phase, become Incorporeal, possess, or use a remote technique origin outside its space.
- **Meridian:** The target cannot spend or regain Cultivation Points, use Sphere techniques, weapon-delivered techniques, or Domain Armament functions.
- **Core:** The target cannot activate Path, Subpath, Method, Foundation active, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, cultivated-item, Recorded Art, Forged Technique, Immortal Art, or transformation features.

When all three are active, the target suffers Complete Cultivation Suppression under the shared rule.

#### Break a Pillar

A Pillar ends when reduced to 0 Hit Points, lawfully displaced outside 60 feet of the target, or overcome by an equal- or higher-authority seal-breaking effect.

A creature adjacent to a Pillar may use an Action to attempt a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. On success, deal Force damage to the Pillar equal to `5 × that creature’s PB`, ignoring resistance.

The bound target may use Break the Seal against one active Pillar. On success, suppress that Pillar until the end of its next turn. A second consecutive success destroys the binding between that Pillar and the target, though the physical Pillar remains until the Edict ends.

#### Direct Binding, Not a Puzzle

Knowing the Pillars’ names, observing their order, or guessing their inscription does not remove them. There is no Master Key or cognitive solution. The Edict ends through destroyed Anchors, failed Concentration, seal-breaking authority, a printed release clause, or superior Source CL.

#### Sealed Passage

A creature or effect cannot teleport, phase, summon, or project through the triangle defined by the three Pillars when its Source CL is lower than yours. Equal or higher authority requires a Cultivation Check against your save DC.

### CL3 — Minor Seal

**Action**  
**Range:** 30 feet  
**Duration:** 8 hours  
**Cost:** 1 Qi

Place a Minor Seal on one unattended object no larger than a 5-foot cube.

Choose one function:

#### Lock Seal

The object cannot be opened, unlocked, unfolded, unsheathed, or disassembled through ordinary interaction.

#### Still Seal

The object cannot be willingly moved from its space. A structure or vehicle already moving before the Seal is placed cannot be targeted.

#### Dormancy Seal

One named non-Secret activated property of the object cannot be used. Passive properties continue unless they expressly depend on activation.

#### Closed-Voice Seal

The object cannot produce audible sound through an active property. Ordinary impacts may still make noise.

#### Bound-Hand Seal

Choose one ordinary mode of handling, such as drawing, wielding, drinking, wearing, reading, or activating. An unauthorized creature cannot use that mode while the Seal remains.

### CL14 — Prison of Law

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 6 Qi  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

Choose one creature and one **Prison Clause**:

- Teleportation and planar movement.
- Incorporeal movement and possession.
- One named Sphere.
- Domain and Cultivation Asset manifestation.
- One named Cultivation Point resource.
- Weapon-delivered cultivation techniques.
- One named transformation or body-changing system.

#### Failed Save

A visible cage of seals forms around the target.

While imprisoned:

- Speed becomes 0.
- It cannot willingly teleport, phase, or become Incorporeal.
- It cannot leave its space through supernatural movement.
- It cannot target a creature outside the Prison with a harmful direct-target feature.
- A creature outside cannot target it with an attack roll or harmful direct-target feature.
- Areas crossing both sides resolve normally when line of effect exists.
- The selected Prison Clause is suppressed.

Targets of equal or higher CL repeat the save at the end of each turn. Targets 3–5 CL lower repeat every second turn. Targets at least 6 CL lower receive no automatic repeat save.

#### Successful Save

The target is not imprisoned, but until the start of your next turn:

- Speed is halved.
- It cannot willingly teleport or become Incorporeal.
- The selected Clause is suppressed.

### CL10 — Sealing Mark

**Action**  
**Range:** Touch  
**Target:** One creature  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

Choose one Seal Grade before paying its cost.

A willing creature may accept the Mark without a saving throw.

A creature is **Completely Subdued** for this feature when at least one of the following is true:

- It willingly accepts the Seal.
- It is Unconscious or Incapacitated.
- It is at 0 Hit Points and Stable.
- It is at 0 Cultivation Points.
- It is Restrained by your Chains of Qi.
- It is imprisoned by your Prison of Law.
- A campaign procedure has established complete defeat and lawful or coercive sealing.

Being Completely Subdued does not remove the saving throw unless the target willingly accepts. It permits stronger Grades and durations.

#### Functional Seal

**Cost:** 5 Qi

Choose one exact category:

- Teleportation.
- Flight.
- Becoming Incorporeal.
- Shapechanging.
- Creating new summoned creatures or Cultivation Assets.
- Activating Audible techniques.
- Manifesting a Spirit Awakening Domain.
- One named Sphere.
- One named Path feature.
- One named Subpath feature.
- One named item property.
- Weapon-delivered cultivation techniques.
- Domain Armament attacks, movement, or Remote Technique Origin.

**Failed Save:** Suppressed for 1 minute.  
**Successful Save:** Suppressed until the start of your next turn.

A resisting target repeats the save at the end of each turn when its CL is within 2 of yours or higher. A target 3–5 CL lower repeats every second turn. A target at least 6 CL lower receives no automatic repeated save.

#### Meridian Seal

**Cost:** 7 Qi  
**Requirement:** The target is Prepared for Sealing, or you identified its circulation during the current scene.

Choose one:

- One named Sphere and all techniques sourced from it.
- One Cultivation Point resource’s recovery.
- Voluntary expenditure above your Proficiency Bonus during one turn.
- One elemental or conceptual Qi channel recorded on the target.
- All weapon-delivered cultivation techniques.
- Domain Armament manifestation, attacks, movement, and remote origins.
- One complete category of summons, transformations, or Formation commands.

**Failed Save:** Suppressed for 1 minute.  
**Successful Save:** Suppressed until the start of your next turn.

A Completely Subdued target that fails is sealed for 1 hour and receives no automatic repeated saves.

#### Core Seal

**Cost:** 10 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene  
**Requirement:** The target is Completely Subdued or imprisoned by your Prison of Law.

Choose one major cultivation structure:

- One complete Path’s active features and Cultivation Point expenditure.
- One Subpath and all features granted by it.
- One Method and all benefits granted by it.
- One Golden Core Form or equivalent Core engine.
- Nascent Soul or an equivalent autonomous cultivation structure.
- One Foundation’s active, triggered, and resource-spending benefits.
- All Spheres known by the target.
- All cultivated-item activations and Domain Armament functions.

Passive mundane statistics, Hit Points, Hit Dice, ordinary movement, ordinary senses, and basic bodily functions remain unless the selected structure explicitly produces them.

**Failed Save:** Suppressed for 1 hour.  
**Successful Save:** Suppressed until the start of your next turn.

A target at least 6 CL lower that is Completely Subdued automatically fails unless protected by explicit anti-sealing authority.

A target at least 3 CL higher downgrades Core Seal to Meridian Seal unless you also succeed on a Cultivation Check against its Cultivation Save DC or the save DC of the protecting effect.

#### Sealing Mark Anchor

Every Sealing Mark creates a visible or Qi-visible Anchor on the target.

- **AC:** 17
- **Hit Points:** `4 × your Qi Cultivation CL`
- **Resistance:** Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
- **Immunity:** Poison and Psychic damage
- **Source CL:** Your CL

A creature adjacent to the target may use an Action to attack the Anchor, attempt a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC, or use explicit seal-breaking, purification, meridian-opening, or authority-overriding features.

Destroying or lawfully breaking the Anchor ends the Mark. A creature may bear one Sealing Mark from you; a new Mark replaces the previous one.

#### Break the Seal

A sealed target may use its Action and choose one price:

- Spend Cultivation Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Take `4d10` Force damage that cannot be reduced by the sealed structure.
- Accept one level of Exhaustion.

It then repeats the Charisma save with Advantage.

- On success, end a Functional or Meridian Seal.
- Against Core Seal, reduce it to Meridian Seal until the start of the target’s next turn; a second successful Break the Seal ends it.

The target cannot choose a price it cannot actually pay.

### CL18 — Demon King Behind the Seal

You open the prison and wear the demon nature without releasing its command.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Limit:** Once per scene

For the duration:

- Open all three Chains without additional Qi.
- Gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet and Hover.
- Gain Resistance to all damage except Radiant, Psychic, and Void.
- Your once-per-turn Demon Nature bonus becomes `4d8`.
- Use Demon Projection once during each turn without spending Qi or a Bonus Action.
- Turn the Prison Outward costs 3 Qi.
- Creatures imprisoned by you have Disadvantage on saves against your Daemonic features.
- Lower-Source-CL possession and involuntary transformation automatically fail against you.
- Your Domain Armament range increases by 30 feet and can carry the Demon Nature rider once during each turn.

#### King’s Prison

You may maintain one Turn the Prison Outward effect without Concentration while Demon King Behind the Seal lasts.

- You must still concentrate on any second prison.
- If the form ends, the non-Concentration prison ends at the end of your current turn.
- Destroying its Anchor ends it normally.

#### Higher-Authority Contest

A higher-Source-CL exorcism, banishment, or demon-command effect can attempt to force the form closed.

After its normal save, if any, make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC.

**Success:** The form remains, but close one Chain until the start of your next turn.  
**Failure:** The form ends and the demon prison becomes Unstable.

#### End Strain

When the form ends, check your current Corruption.

- **0–5:** No additional consequence.
- **6–8:** Take `4d10` Psychic damage.
- **9:** Take `4d10` Psychic damage and cannot open the Third Chain until completing a Long Rest and stabilization session.
- **10:** Take `4d10` Psychic damage, gain 1 Exhaustion, and the prison becomes Unstable until purified or resealed by an equal- or higher-Source-CL procedure.

While Unstable, opening the Third Chain automatically causes a Broken Chain consequence.

### CL3 — First Chain: Borrowed Nature

While at least one Chain is open:

- Gain the First-Chain Defense from your Demon Nature.
- You may convert the damage of one Qi feature per turn to one damage type from your Demon Nature.
- Once per turn when you deal damage with a Qi feature or Domain Armament, add damage equal to PB of your Demon Nature’s type.

#### Nature Infusion

When you convert damage:

- The activation gains the Daemonic tag.
- The conversion applies to one damage packet unless the feature deals only one type throughout.
- It does not change physical weapon damage unless the weapon-delivery feature expressly permits technique-damage conversion.
- It cannot convert an artifact, Secret, or absolute damage type whose rule forbids alteration.

#### Consecrated Suppression

A consecrated effect whose Source CL is lower than yours cannot remove the First-Chain Defense, but can suppress the bonus damage until the start of your next turn.

An equal- or higher-Source-CL anti-daemonic effect may force a Charisma saving throw against its DC.

**Failure:** Close one Chain.  
**Success:** Remain open.

---

### CL6 — Second Chain: Demon Projection

While at least two Chains are open, you may project the demon nature outward.

**Bonus Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Attack:** Ranged Cultivation Attack

On a hit, deal:

- `2d8 + key ability modifier` at CL6.
- `3d8 + key ability modifier` at CL11.
- `4d8 + key ability modifier` at CL17.

Use one damage type from your Demon Nature, then apply its Projection Rider.

If the rider requires a save, use your Cultivation Save DC.

#### Domain Armament Projection

At CL9, instead of making a separate Demon Projection attack, you may express it through one Domain Armament Attack.

- Make the Domain Armament Attack normally.
- On a hit, add the Demon Projection dice once.
- Apply the rider once.
- This does not create an additional attack.

A projected or real bound Armament can take on the appearance of the Demon Nature.

#### Projection through Wards

A consecrated ward between the origin and target blocks Demon Projection when its Source CL equals or exceeds yours.

If its Source CL is within 2, you may make a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On success, the projection crosses but deals half damage.

---

### CL10 — Third Chain: Demon Core Prison

While all three Chains are open:

- The First-Chain once-per-turn bonus becomes `2d8` instead of PB.
- Demon Projection ignores ordinary Resistance to its damage.
- You have Advantage on saves against possession, involuntary transformation, and forced soul displacement.
- Your Domain Armament gains the Projection Rider once per turn when it hits.
- Your Qi Sensing can distinguish possession, demon influence, corruption, and ordinary emotional disturbance.

#### Guard-Mode Nature

When your Domain Armament uses Guard Mode, the protected creature gains one benefit according to your nature against the first qualifying packet each round:

- Ash: Fire Resistance.
- Frost: Cold Resistance.
- Storm: Lightning Resistance.
- Shadow: Necrotic Resistance.
- Venom: Poison Resistance.
- Stone: Reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage by PB.

This benefit applies to one packet and then expires until the start of your next turn.

#### Prisoned Possession

When a lower-Source-CL possession or involuntary transformation would affect you while all three Chains are open, you may redirect it into the internal prison.

- The effect fails against you.
- Close one Chain.
- You cannot reopen that Chain until the end of your next turn.

Against an effect within 2 Source CL, make a Charisma saving throw against its save DC. On success, redirect it. Against a higher authority, use the printed contest.

The redirected effect is suppressed, not captured for later use.

---

### CL14 — Turn the Prison Outward

You project the demon prison around another creature.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 5 Qi  
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

On a failed save, chains and prison seals bind the target.

- It is Restrained.
- It cannot teleport, become incorporeal, possess another creature, or voluntarily transform.
- Its Cultivation Point costs increase by 1.
- It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns.

On a successful initial save:

- Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet.
- It cannot teleport until the start of its next turn.
- No Anchor is created.

A creature with the Daemonic, Spirit, Possession, or Shapechanger tag has Disadvantage on its first save against this feature.

#### Prison Seal Anchor

On a failed initial save, create a Prison Seal Anchor in one unoccupied space within 10 feet of the target.

- **Size:** Medium Anchor.
- **AC:** Your Cultivation Save DC.
- **Hit Points:** `4 × your Qi Cultivation level`.
- **Immunities:** Poison and Psychic damage; Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, Prone.
- **Resistance:** Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing from noncultivated attacks.
- **Source CL:** Your Qi Cultivation level.
- **Movement:** None.

Destroying or suppressing the Anchor ends the prison.

The target can attack the Anchor while Restrained if it has a legal attack or technique capable of reaching it.

#### Source CL Outcomes

- **Target 6 or more CL lower:** On a failed initial save, it does not repeat saves automatically. It can escape only by destroying the Anchor, receiving outside aid, or using an explicit prison-breaking effect.
- **Target 3–5 CL lower:** It repeats the save at the end of every second turn.
- **Target within 2 CL:** It repeats at the end of each turn.
- **Target 3 or more CL higher:** On a failed save, it is Restrained only until the end of its next turn unless you succeed on a Cultivation Check against its save DC. On success, the normal prison remains.

Artifact, Secret, Immortal, and explicit absolute movement uses its printed interaction.

#### Feeding the Prison

Once per round when the imprisoned creature spends Cultivation Points, choose one:

- The Anchor regains Hit Points equal to twice the points spent, up to its maximum.
- Your next Demon Projection against that creature before the end of your next turn has Advantage.
- Reduce its Speed by an additional 10 feet until the end of its next turn.

### CL18 — Demon Emperor’s Second Engine

You fully open the second furnace and circulate it as an imperial engine.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Limit:** Once per scene

For the duration:

- Your Devil Qi maximum increases by 3.
- Gain 1 Devil Qi at the start of each of your turns.
- Gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet and Hover.
- Gain Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage.
- Use Devil-Qi Augment once during each turn without spending Devil Qi.
- Heart-Devil Counterflow costs 1 Devil Qi.
- Temporary Hit Points gained from this Subpath equal twice PB.
- Your Domain Armament range increases by 30 feet and its movement increases by 20 feet.

#### Emperor’s Overdraw

Once per round when activating a feature costing at least 1 Qi, you may gain 2 Corruption to reduce the cost by twice PB, possibly to 0, subject to the same minimum-cost restrictions as Demon Seed Overdraw.

Emperor’s Overdraw and Demon Seed Overdraw cannot apply to the same activation.

At 10 Corruption, Emperor’s Overdraw requires a Furnace Breach.

#### Emperor’s Furnace Authority

While this form lasts, a lower-Source-CL effect cannot completely suppress both your ordinary Qi system and second furnace with one ordinary activation unless it explicitly targets multiple cultivation systems.

An equal-Source-CL effect must identify which furnace it suppresses. A feature expressly imposing complete cultivation suppression can still suppress both.

#### End of the Engine

When the form ends, count the Corruption gained from this Subpath during its duration.

- **0–1:** No additional consequence.
- **2–3:** Take `4d10` Psychic or Necrotic damage that ignores Resistance.
- **4 or more:** Take `4d10` damage and gain 1 Exhaustion.
- **Any Furnace Breach occurred:** The second furnace becomes Dormant until you complete a Long Rest and a 1-hour stabilization session. While Dormant, you cannot gain or spend Devil Qi.

An equal- or higher-Source-CL physician, exorcist, seal master, or Daemonic specialist can perform the stabilization session for you.

### CL3 — Demon Seed Overdraw

You can force the second furnace to pay part of an ordinary Qi cost.

**Trigger:** You activate a Qi feature whose total cost is at least 1 Qi.  
**Limit:** Once per turn  
**Price:** Gain 1 Corruption

Reduce the total Qi cost by your Proficiency Bonus, possibly to 0.

The following costs remain at least 1 Qi unless their own rule explicitly says otherwise:

- Legendary or artifact activations.
- Secret-Law effects.
- Immortal Arts.
- Permanent or indefinite transformations.
- Strategic travel or world-scale effects.
- Effects requiring expensive materials.
- Features whose printed cost represents a sacrifice rather than expenditure.

Demon Seed Overdraw cannot reduce:

- Lifespan costs.
- Maximum-resource reductions.
- Corruption costs.
- Material components.
- Another creature’s expenditure.
- Costs already reduced by another feature that says they cannot be further reduced.

After resolving the activation, gain 1 Devil Qi.

#### Seed-Fed Reinforcement

When Demon Seed Overdraw gives you Devil Qi, choose one:

- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to PB.
- Move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Move your Domain Armament up to 10 feet.
- Gain Advantage on one Intimidation or Cultivation Check made before the end of your next turn.

#### Anti-Daemonic Interruption

If an equal- or higher-Source-CL anti-daemonic effect suppresses your second furnace while the activation is being resolved:

- The original feature remains activated if you can pay its unreduced cost immediately.
- If you cannot pay, the activation fails.
- Any Qi already paid remains spent.
- You do not gain Devil Qi or Corruption from the failed Overdraw.

---

### CL6 — Devil-Qi Augment

You can feed Devil Qi into a damaging expression.

**Trigger:** You deal damage with a Qi Path feature, Subpath feature, Sphere talent, Recorded Art, Forged Technique, or weapon-delivered cultivation technique.  
**Cost:** 1 Devil Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Choose Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage.

Add:

- `2d8` at CL6.
- `3d8` at CL11.
- `4d8` at CL17.

Then choose one Augment rider:

- Reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to PB.

Devil-Qi Augment applies once to the entire activation.

- A Barrage, volley, chain, area, or multiattack sequence gains the extra damage once, not once per projectile or attack.
- When used with a weapon-delivered technique, apply it to either the weapon-damage packet or the technique-damage packet, not both.
- The rider applies only to a creature that actually took the added damage.

#### Consecrated Resistance

If the damaged creature is protected by an equal- or higher-Source-CL consecrated effect, it may make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.

**Success:** Take half of the Augment dice and ignore the rider.  
**Failure:** Resolve normally.

This save does not reduce the original activation’s damage.

### CL14 — Heart-Devil Counterflow

The second furnace can reverse a failed internal response.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You fail a saving throw.  
**Cost:** 2 Devil Qi  
**Limit:** Once per round

Reroll the saving throw and add PB to the new roll. You must use the new result.

Heart-Devil Counterflow cannot reroll:

- A death saving throw.
- A breakthrough or training check.
- A roll that has already been rerolled.
- A consequence explicitly described as irresistible.
- A permanent price you voluntarily accepted.
- A Source-CL contest where the feature explicitly forbids rerolls.

#### Counterflow Backlash

If the reroll succeeds and the source is a creature you can perceive within 120 feet:

- It takes `3d8` Psychic or Necrotic damage.
- It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

If the source is an Anchor, Asset, Formation, or item rather than a creature, deal the damage to that source when it is a legal target. Otherwise, no backlash damage occurs.

#### Higher-Authority Saves

Against an effect whose Source CL is 3 or more higher than yours:

- You can still reroll.
- You do not add PB unless you first spend 1 additional Devil Qi.
- The backlash damage does not occur unless the reroll exceeds the DC by 5 or more.

Against an artifact, Secret, Immortal, or explicit absolute authority, use its printed restrictions.

---

### CL10 — Second Furnace Core

Your second furnace becomes a stable auxiliary reservoir.

#### Devil Qi Expenditure

Devil Qi can pay the Qi cost of an ordinary:

- Qi Path feature.
- Qi Subpath feature.
- Sphere talent.
- Recorded Art.
- Forged Technique.
- Domain Armament activation.
- Cultivated item activation that expressly accepts the user’s Qi.

Devil Qi cannot pay:

- Permanent sacrifice.
- Lifespan loss.
- Maximum-resource reduction.
- Expensive materials.
- Another creature’s cost.
- Artifact charges unless the artifact expressly accepts Devil Qi.
- Secret-Law or Immortal-Art costs unless that source explicitly permits it.

If a cost uses both ordinary Qi and Devil Qi, choose the split when paying.

#### Furnace Motion

After you spend at least 1 Devil Qi, choose one. You can gain each benefit no more than once per turn.

- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to PB.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Move your Domain Armament up to 20 feet.
- Add PB to the next Cultivation Check you make before the end of your next turn.
- Stand from Prone without spending movement.

#### Second-Furnace Continuity

When an effect would suppress or drain your ordinary Qi system:

- If its Source CL is lower than yours, you may still spend Devil Qi on features that do not require the suppressed organ, Method, Sphere, or pathway.
- If its Source CL is within 2, make a Constitution saving throw against the effect’s save DC. On success, the second furnace remains usable until the end of your next turn.
- If its Source CL is 3 or more higher, the second furnace is suppressed unless the effect’s fiction leaves it outside the affected structure.

This does not allow the second furnace to activate a feature whose required cultivation structure has been destroyed or conceptually severed.

#### Domain Armament Furnace Link

Your Domain Armament can display the second furnace as a black pulse, eye, ember, jaw, or rotating seal.

Once per turn when you spend Devil Qi:

- The Armament may move 10 feet.
- It can pass through the space of a lower-Source-CL consecrated creature or ward, but not end there.
- An equal- or higher-Source-CL ward blocks this passage unless you succeed on a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

### CL10 — Fate’s Thread

**Bonus Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Cost:** 4 Qi  
**Target:** One creature or active Cultivation Asset you can perceive

Establish a visible or invisible thread of predictive analysis.

When the feature begins, learn:

- Current Hit Points.
- Hit Point maximum.
- AC.
- Current Cultivation Points and maximum Cultivation Points, if it has them.
- Highest saving-throw modifier.
- Lowest saving-throw modifier.
- Whether it is Concentrating.
- Whether it is Bloodied or below half Hit Points.
- Every visible condition affecting it.
- One Resistance or Immunity of your choice from a damage type you name.

If the named Resistance or Immunity is absent, learn **Neither**.

#### Thread Advantage

For the duration:

- Gain Advantage on the first attack roll you make against the target during each of your turns.
- Gain Advantage on the first Cultivation Check you make each round to analyze, counter, dispel, suppress, or identify one of its active effects.
- The target cannot Hide from you through ordinary concealment alone.
- You know its direction and distance while it remains within 300 feet and on the same plane.

#### Ask the Thread

Once during each of your turns, ask one question from this list and receive an exact answer:

- Which saving throw modifier is currently highest?
- Is its current AC higher, lower, or equal to yours?
- Is it currently benefiting from Resistance to a named damage type?
- Is it currently immune to a named condition?
- Is it currently under an effect that will end at the start or end of its next turn?
- Is it currently capable of taking Reactions?
- Is one visible active effect on it using Concentration?
- What is the Source CL of one visible active effect on it?

**Trigger:** You declare an attack against a legal target.  
**Cost:** 5 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Do not roll the attack.

The attack hits.

Inevitable Strike:

- Is not a natural 20.
- Does not automatically score a critical hit.
- Does not trigger a feature requiring an actually rolled natural 20.
- Does not waive range, line of sight, line of effect, weapon, ammunition, origin, or target requirements.
- Does not bypass Resistance, Immunity, an invalid damage type, or a defense that applies after a hit.
- Can strike a target whose AC would otherwise make the attack impossible.

#### Fate Resistance

Before the hit resolves, make a Cultivation Check when the target is protected by:

- A Secret Law.
- An artifact fate-lock.
- A conceptual immunity to prediction or fate alteration.
- An explicit fate defense whose Source CL is higher than yours.

Learn the next Attunement in the productive cycle, giving you three consecutive known elements.

Once per turn, after you activate and completely resolve a Qi-powered technique matching your active Attunement:

1. Shift to the next known Attunement in the productive cycle.
2. The new Attunement becomes active immediately.

If the next element in the full cycle is not known, continue through the cycle until reaching the next known element. The shift requires no action, does not retroactively change the triggering technique, and does not occur after an invalid or refunded activation.

### CL3 — Fivefold Attunement

Choose one element as your **Starting Element**. You learn the Attunements of your Starting Element and the next element in the productive cycle.

At the start of each of your turns, choose one known Attunement to become active. It remains active until the start of your next turn. Choosing an Attunement requires no action.

#### Wood Attunement

Once per turn, when a Qi-powered technique restores Hit Points or grants Temporary Hit Points, increase that amount by your Proficiency Bonus for one target.

#### Fire Attunement

Once per turn, when a Qi-powered technique deals damage, one target damaged by the activation takes additional Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

#### Earth Attunement

You have Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone and against forced movement. Reduce the first forced movement affecting you each round by 5 feet.

#### Metal Attunement

While wearing light armor or no armor, gain +1 AC. This is not a shield bonus and functions while using a shield if you later gain shield training.

#### Water Attunement

Once per turn, immediately after activating a Qi-powered technique, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

### CL10 — Grand Fusion

**Trigger:** You activate a Qi-powered technique matching your active Attunement.  
**Cost:** 2 additional Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Fuse the triggering element with the next element in the productive cycle. Grand Fusion resolves as part of the triggering activation.

#### Wood Feeds Fire

Choose one creature damaged by the technique. It takes an additional `3d8` Fire damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

#### Fire Creates Earth

Create a 10-foot-radius area of scorched and upheaved ground centered on one point affected by the technique. The area lasts until the start of your next turn, is difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and deals Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to a hostile creature the first time it enters during a turn. A creature can take this damage once per turn.

#### Earth Bears Metal

Choose yourself or one willing creature affected by or within 10 feet of the technique’s origin. It gains +2 AC and Advantage against being Disarmed until the start of your next turn.

#### Metal Gathers Water

Choose yourself or one willing creature within 30 feet of the technique’s origin. Move it up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The movement requires a legal destination, cannot cross a solid barrier, and is not teleportation.

#### Water Nourishes Wood

Choose one creature affected by the technique or within 10 feet of its origin. It either regains `3d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier` Hit Points or gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the same roll.

After Grand Fusion resolves, Cycle of Rebirth shifts your Attunement normally.

You learn all five Attunements.

When Cycle of Rebirth shifts your active Attunement, gain the new element’s arrival benefit. An arrival benefit can occur once per turn.

- **Arrive at Wood:** Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- **Arrive at Fire:** The next damaging Qi-powered technique you activate before the end of your next turn deals an additional `1d8` Fire damage to one target.
- **Arrive at Earth:** Until the start of your next turn, reduce forced movement affecting you by 10 feet and you cannot be knocked Prone by a creature whose CL is lower than yours.
- **Arrive at Metal:** Gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. This stacks with Metal Attunement but not another Metal arrival bonus.
- **Arrive at Water:** Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 40-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Choose the field’s starting element. At the start of each of your turns, it advances to the next element in the productive cycle without using an action.

A hostile creature makes the current element’s saving throw when it enters the field for the first time during a turn or starts its turn inside. A creature is affected once per turn.

#### Wood Cycle

**Saving Throw:** Strength

Allies in the field increase the first healing or Temporary Hit Points they receive each turn by twice your Proficiency Bonus.

#### Fire Cycle

**Saving Throw:** Dexterity

- **Failed Save:** `5d8` Fire damage and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.

The first time each ally in the field deals damage during its turn, it deals additional Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

#### Earth Cycle

**Saving Throw:** Dexterity

- **Failed Save:** `4d8` Bludgeoning damage and Prone.

Allies in the field have Advantage against forced movement and being knocked Prone.

#### Metal Cycle

**Saving Throw:** Dexterity

- **Failed Save:** `5d8` Slashing damage and no Reactions until the end of its next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Half damage and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.

#### Water Cycle

**Saving Throw:** Strength
