- Your Soul Treasure cannot lose Integrity from an effect whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- Enter the Treasure and Manifest from the Treasure require no action.
- Treasure Recall costs 0 Qi and can cross ordinary planar boundaries when you know the item’s destination plane, but not sealed, artifact, Secret, or higher-authority boundaries.
- Maintain Treasure Aspect without its normal Qi cost.
- Create Soul Satellites without Concentration and move each 60 feet per turn.
- Use one Satellite as a Remote Technique Origin during each turn without surcharge.
- A floating shield Soul Treasure may protect two creatures in Guard Mode.
- A floating weapon Soul Treasure may make one additional Domain Armament Attack as part of the same Bonus Action; this additional attack does not add your ability modifier and cannot repeat once-per-turn riders.

#### Treasure Incarnation

Once during each of your turns, choose one state:

##### Wielded Incarnation

The Soul Treasure appears in your hand or worn position.

- Gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn if it is a shield or armor.
- Gain Advantage on the first attack made through it before the start of your next turn if it is a weapon or offensive implement.

##### Floating Incarnation

The Soul Treasure floats at one Satellite or legal point within 120 feet.

- Move it up to 60 feet.
- It can originate techniques and use its printed passive properties normally.

##### Inner Incarnation

Enter the Treasure.

- Gain Total Cover from effects that cannot affect the item or souls within it.
- The item remains targetable.

#### Reforge the Vessel

If your physical body is destroyed during Immortal Treasure Body but the Soul Treasure survives with at least 1 Integrity:

- You do not immediately die.
- You remain conscious inside the Soul Treasure at 1 Hit Point.
- Immortal Treasure Body ends.
- You cannot leave the item until you complete a reconstruction rite.

##### Reconstruction Rite

**Time:** 8 hours  
**Cost:** All current Qi, one permanent Hit Die, and appropriate cultivation materials

Create a replacement body adjacent to the Soul Treasure.

The replacement:

- Is recognizably yours.
- Retains your character statistics.
- May display permanent artifact traits.
- Restores you to half your Hit Point maximum.
- Does not restore spent resources or lost Integrity.

The permanent Hit Die loss can be restored only by a breakthrough, a Foundation or Method explicitly capable of restoring cultivation structure, or a higher-authority reconstruction effect.

#### Sever the Immortal Bond

A hostile creature may attempt to permanently sever the bond only when:

- The Soul Treasure is restrained, suppressed, or reduced to 0 Integrity.
- You are Incapacitated or inside it.
- The effect explicitly targets souls, bonds, names, or artifact ownership.

The severing source makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.

On success:

- The Soul Treasure ceases to be your resurrection vessel.
- You take `10d10` Psychic and Force damage.
- You cannot bind another Soul Treasure until completing a long rest and a major repair rite.

On failure:

- The bond remains.
- The source cannot retry until it changes the circumstances, obtains new authority, or a new scene begins.

### CL14 — Split Soul Treasury

Your Soul Treasure can support multiple linked manifestations without becoming multiple items.

#### Soul Satellites

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 5 Qi  
**Duration:** 1 minute

Create up to three projected Soul Satellites in unoccupied points within 60 feet.

Each Satellite:

- Is a projection of the Soul Treasure, not a copy of the item.
- Occupies no space.
- Has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC.
- Has Hit Points equal to `2 × your Qi Cultivation CL`.
- Is immune to Poison and Psychic damage.
- Can move 30 feet once during each of your turns.
- Can serve as a technique origin.
- Cannot activate item charges, automatic on-hit properties, attunement properties, or limited-use powers.
- Cannot be sold, wielded, stored, or bound.

You may originate a Qi-powered technique from one Satellite once per turn without surcharge.

Destroying a Satellite deals `2d8` Psychic damage to you and does not damage the real item.

#### Soul Transfer

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while the Soul Treasure or a Soul Satellite is within 120 feet.  
**Cost:** 2 Integrity  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Instead:

- Your body dissolves.
- You enter the Soul Treasure or one surviving Satellite.
- You remain at 1 Hit Point.
- The chosen Satellite becomes the Soul Treasure’s active embodiment until the end of your next turn.

At the end of your next turn:

- If using a Satellite, you must transfer into the real Soul Treasure or manifest adjacent to the Satellite.
- If neither is possible, you manifest in the nearest legal space at 0 Hit Points and Stable.

Soul Transfer cannot prevent instant death, complete soul erasure, or destruction by a higher-authority effect explicitly severing the bond.

---
tianxia.subpath.qi.soul_collateral_contr:
### CL6 — Foreclose Minor Collateral

**Bonus Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet, or same plane when the Contract says foreclosure is remote  
**Cost:** 1 Claim  
**Target:** One party in breach

Choose collateral actually pledged by that Contract.

#### Qi Foreclosure

Remove current Cultivation Points up to your Proficiency Bonus and regain Qi equal to half the amount removed, rounded up.

#### Blood Foreclosure

Deal `3d8` Necrotic or Psychic damage. You or one named beneficiary gains Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt.

#### Item Foreclosure

The named nonartifact item cannot be activated, dismissed, called, transferred, or willingly moved until the start of your next turn. If your Source CL exceeds the item’s controlling authority, it moves by a legal route to a space within 5 feet of you or the named beneficiary.

#### Movement Foreclosure

The breacher’s Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn, or it is pulled up to 15 feet toward a named boundary, creditor, prison, or delivery point.

#### Voice Foreclosure

The breacher cannot speak, use audible techniques, or communicate the named secret until the start of its next turn.

#### Service Foreclosure

The breacher must use its Reaction, if available, to perform one ordinary movement, drop an item, open a door, deliver an object, or take another non-self-destructive action explicitly pledged as collateral. A resisting target makes a Charisma save; on success, it loses Reactions instead.

#### Claim Transfer

**Action**  
**Cost:** 2 Qi

Transfer one unspent Claim and its attached foreclosure right to a willing party named as an authorized assignee in the Contract. The Contract remains the same; you do not create a new obligation.

---

### CL10 — Major Soul Covenant

#### Create Major Contract

**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** Touch  
**Cost:** 6 Qi  
**Duration:** Up to 30 days, or until fulfilled or released

A Major Contract may govern long service, apprenticeship, office, military duty, secrecy, passage, debt repayment, custody, bodyguard work, inheritance, sect membership, or another substantial obligation.

#### Binding an Unwilling Target

An unwilling creature can be bound only when it is Completely Subdued, has formally surrendered, accepted release under stated terms, inherited a valid Contract through an explicit Source Rule, or is subject to recognized conquered or legal authority.

It makes a Charisma saving throw.

- **Failed Save:** The Contract is established.
- **Successful Save:** It is not bound and cannot be targeted by this feature again until the end of the scene.
- **Target 3+ CL higher:** You must also win a Cultivation Check against its save DC.
- **Target 6+ CL lower and Completely Subdued:** It automatically fails unless protected by explicit anti-contract authority.

#### Major Collateral

Choose up to two:

- Current and maximum Cultivation Points up to `2 × PB`.
- One named Sphere or technique family.
- One Domain Armament bond or cultivated item power set.
- One movement mode or transformation.
- One memory category connected to the Contract.
- Up to one year of lifespan.
- One office, title, authority, inheritance right, or legal possession recognized by a Source Rule.
- One physical item or Cultivation Asset named in the Contract.

The Contract does not seize collateral until breach and foreclosure.

#### Major Breach

A meaningful breach creates two Claims. A severe breach defined by the Contract creates three.

#### Contract Anchor

A Major Contract creates a visible or Qi-visible Anchor on each party.

- **AC:** Your Cultivation Save DC
- **Hit Points:** `5 × your CL`
- **Resistance:** Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing
- **Immunity:** Poison and Psychic damage
- **Source CL:** Your CL

A party or adjacent ally may attack the Anchor, use a compatible Cultivation Check, fulfill a release term, or invoke equal/higher Contract, Oath, Karma, Fate, Void, Name, Soul, or Conceptual authority.

Destroying an Anchor releases that party but does not automatically restore collateral already lawfully foreclosed. Restoration follows the collateral’s own recovery rules.

---

### CL3 — Sign in Living Qi

#### Create Minor Soul Contract

**Ritual Time:** 1 minute  
**Range:** Touch, or all parties within 10 feet  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Duration:** Up to 8 hours

Create a **Minor Contract** governing a temporary service, payment, secrecy term, nonviolence clause, boundary, delivery, loan, escort, or exchange.

At this level, every party must knowingly sign through blood, Qi, spirit imprint, written name, spoken assent, or another unambiguous method. A party may sign under social or material pressure, but you cannot bind an unwilling resisting target through this feature.

#### Minor Collateral

Choose one item of collateral per party:

- Current Qi up to PB.
- Hit Points up to `2 × PB`.
- One held or carried nonartifact item named in the Contract.
- The ability to cross one named boundary.
- The ability to speak one named secret.
- One temporary service or action possible within the duration.

Collateral is not removed when pledged. It becomes vulnerable to foreclosure after breach.

#### Minor Breach

When a party knowingly breaches:

- The Contract gains one Claim.
- You know the direction of the breacher within 1 mile on the same plane.
- The breacher cannot conceal the Contract or its breach from your Contract Sight through a lower-Source-CL effect.

#### Contract Sight

Your Qi Sensing can perceive active Soul Contracts and their Anchors within normal range.

As an Action, analyze one and learn:

- Parties.
- Grade.
- Whether it is breached.
- Category of collateral.
- Source CL.
- Whether the Contract was voluntary, coerced, conquered, inherited, or imposed.

You do not automatically learn hidden text protected by superior authority.

---

### CL14 — Soul Foreclosure

You may enforce breached Major Contracts across the same plane when the Contract permits remote foreclosure.

#### Call the Contracted Party

**Action**  
**Range:** Same plane  
**Cost:** 5 Qi and 1 Claim  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

Choose one party in breach.

- **Failed Save:** It travels by a legal route to the nearest legal space within 10 feet of you, the named beneficiary, prison, worksite, court, or delivery location specified by the Contract.
- **Successful Save:** Its Speed is 0 and it cannot willingly teleport until the end of its next turn.

Sealed boundaries, planar barriers, and higher Source CL can block or delay the route. The feature does not create a legal destination where none exists.

#### Foreclose Cultivation

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet, or same plane through an authorized Contract Anchor  
**Cost:** 3 Claims  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

Choose one pledged cultivation collateral.

- **Failed Save:** Suppress it for 1 hour.
- **Successful Save:** Suppress it until the start of the target’s next turn.
- **Target 3–5 CL lower:** No automatic repeat save during the hour.
- **Target 6+ CL lower:** Suppression persists until the Contract is fulfilled, released, broken, or the collateral is restored by equal/higher authority.
- **Target 3+ CL higher:** The effect lasts only until the start of its next turn unless you also win a Cultivation Check.

If all active cultivation systems were explicitly pledged as collateral and lawfully foreclosed, the target suffers Complete Cultivation Suppression under the shared rule.

#### Seize the Payment

**Action**  
**Cost:** 1 or more Claims

Collect one pledged payment, item, Qi amount, memory category, lifespan portion, office, or authority whose transfer procedure is defined by the Contract.

- A real item travels through a legal route and is never duplicated.
- A memory is sealed or copied only as the Contract states.
- Lifespan and permanent cultivation collateral create long-term harm at the Contract’s Source CL.
- A title or office transfers only if the setting recognizes cultivated contract authority over it.

Unpledged property cannot be seized merely because the debtor has breached.

---

### CL18 — Sovereign Soul Contract

#### Create Sovereign Contract

**Ritual Time:** 1 hour  
**Range:** All parties and required Anchors present  
**Cost:** 10 Qi  
**Duration:** Indefinite until fulfilled, released, broken, or destroyed

A Sovereign Contract may govern sect succession, dynastic marriage, national tribute, immortal service, possession of a Saint-class treasure, prison of a great cultivator, transfer of a bloodline, protection of a world gate, or another major obligation.

It requires a physical or cultivated **Sovereign Contract Anchor** such as a tablet, throne seal, ancestral book, blood altar, spirit brand, weapon, city Formation, or world-gate inscription.

#### Sovereign Contract Anchor

- **AC:** Your Cultivation Save DC + 2
- **Hit Points:** `12 × your CL`
- **Resistance:** All damage from lower-Source-CL attacks
- **Immunity:** Poison and Psychic damage
- **Source CL:** Your CL
- **Repair:** Equal/higher Contract, Soul, Oath, Formation, or artifact procedure

#### Sovereign Terms

A Sovereign Contract may pledge:

- An entire Cultivation Point resource.
- One Path, Subpath, Method, Foundation active system, Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Domain Armament network, or Sphere family.
- A soul fragment or reincarnation right.
- Up to ten years of lifespan.
- A bloodline transmission.
- A Saint-class or lower real item.
- A city, sect, office, Formation, route, or treasury recognized by the setting.
- A named future service that remains possible.

A Secret Law, Immortal authority, artifact soul, entire true identity, or world principle can be pledged only when its own Source Rule permits it or the Contract’s authority is equal or higher.

#### Sovereign Breach

A Sovereign breach creates Claims equal to your Proficiency Bonus and activates one printed **Sovereign Penalty**:

- Suppress pledged cultivation collateral.
- Seal the breacher’s movement to a named territory.
- Transfer a pledged office, item, resource, or authority.
- Inflict Tier III or Tier IV cultivation harm matching the collateral.
- Call the breacher before the Contract Anchor.
- Place the soul fragment or reincarnation right in escrow within the Anchor.

#### Contract Court

**Action**  
**Area:** 40-foot-radius field centered on the Sovereign Anchor  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Inside the Court:

- Contract terms, Claims, pledged collateral, breach status, and authorized assignees become visible.
- A party cannot conceal a breach through a lower-Source-CL effect.
- Foreclosure costs one fewer Claim, minimum 1.
- Call the Contracted Party and Foreclose Cultivation may target any party in the field without range limits.
- A Contract challenge can be heard and resolved.

#### Final Foreclosure

Once during the Court, choose one party in Sovereign breach with at least four Claims. It makes a Charisma saving throw.

##### Failed Save

Choose one pledged result:

- **Collect All Qi:** Remove all current points from one pledged resource and prevent recovery for 1 hour.
- **Close the Cultivation Collateral:** Suppress all explicitly pledged cultivation systems; if every active system was pledged, impose Complete Cultivation Suppression.
- **Seize Soul Escrow:** Remove the pledged soul fragment, reincarnation right, or spirit collateral into the Anchor.
- **Collect the Named Price:** Transfer the exact pledged item, office, lifespan, memory, bloodline, service, or authority.
- **Compel Performance:** Move the party by a legal route to the named site and prevent voluntary departure for 1 hour when the Contract lawfully pledged that service.

##### Successful Save

One pledged system is suppressed until the end of the target’s next turn, it loses current Cultivation Points equal to `2 × PB`, and one Claim remains unspent.

#### Breaking a Sovereign Contract

A Sovereign Contract can be broken through:

- Fulfillment or mutual release.
- Destruction or lawful alteration of the Sovereign Anchor.
- Equal/higher Contract, Oath, Karma, Fate, Soul, Void, Name, Samsara, or Conceptual authority.
- A successful challenge proving that a required party, term, collateral, or acceptance state was supernaturally falsified.
- A campaign-scale revolution, succession, conquest, artifact intervention, or heavenly judgment recognized by the setting.

Breaking the Contract ends future foreclosure. It does not automatically restore collateral already consumed, transferred, aged, severed, or destroyed; that requires the shared reconstruction procedure.

#### Contract Is Not Karma

The Contract Court asks whether a valid term was breached and whether named collateral may be foreclosed. It does not decide whether the Contract was just, whether the breacher deserved punishment, or whether unrelated deeds created Karmic Merit or Burden.
tianxia.subpath.qi.sound_cultivator.feat:
### CL6 — Healing Melody

**Action**  
**Range:** 30 feet  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Target:** One creature capable of hearing the melody

The target regains `2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier` Hit Points. Healing becomes `3d8 + modifier` at CL14 and `4d8 + modifier` at CL18.

After healing, choose one:

- End Frightened when the effect’s Source CL is no higher than yours.
- End Deafened when the effect’s Source CL is no higher than yours.
- Allow an immediate saving throw against Charmed with Advantage.
- Allow the target to move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

A target incapable of hearing may benefit when touching the same connected solid or liquid medium carrying the performance. A feature explicitly blocking vibration prevents this alternate delivery.

### CL3 — Instrument of Qi

Gain proficiency with one musical instrument. If already proficient, gain a +2 bonus to ability checks using that instrument. You may use your Qi Cultivation key ability instead of Charisma for those checks.

The chosen instrument may serve as a cultivation focus, be bound as a Domain Armament, and act as the origin of this Subpath’s features through Domain Armament Link.

#### Resonant Note

**Bonus Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Target:** One creature capable of hearing the note  
**Saving Throw:** Wisdom

Choose Psychic or Thunder damage.

- **Failed Save:** `1d6` damage and subtract `1d4` from the target’s next attack roll before the start of your next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Half damage and no attack penalty.

Damage becomes `2d6` at CL11 and `3d6` at CL17.

Resonant Note can originate from you, your chosen instrument, or a bound instrumental Domain Armament.

### CL18 — Requiem of the Heavens

**Action**  
**Origin:** You or your instrumental Domain Armament  
**Area:** 60-foot-radius sphere  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene  
**Saving Throw:** Charisma

Choose Psychic or Thunder damage. A creature is eligible when it can hear the performance or is touching a solid or liquid medium carrying it. Blocking both sound and vibration makes the creature ineligible.

Choose any number of eligible creatures.

- **Failed Save:** `10d8` damage, Stunned until the end of your next turn, cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn, and has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws until then.
- **Successful Save:** Half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

When dealing Thunder damage, unattended objects, temporary barriers, vehicles, structures, and Formation Anchors take double damage.

---

### CL10 — Shattering Note

**Action**  
**Origin:** You or your instrumental Domain Armament  
**Area:** 30-foot cone  
**Cost:** 4 Qi  
**Saving Throw:** Constitution

- **Failed Save:** `6d6` Thunder damage, Deafened until the end of your next turn, and Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws caused by this damage.
- **Successful Save:** Half damage and Deafened until the start of your next turn.

Shattering Note does not require targets to hear you. It travels through air, liquid, or a connected solid surface and is blocked by effects explicitly suppressing vibration. It deals double damage to unattended objects, temporary barriers, vehicles, structures, and Formation Anchors.

At CL17, damage becomes `8d6`.

### CL14 — Song of Fear

**Action**  
**Origin:** You or your instrumental Domain Armament  
**Area:** 30-foot-radius sphere  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 5 Qi

A hostile creature capable of hearing the performance makes a Wisdom saving throw when it enters the area for the first time during a turn or starts its turn inside. A creature is affected once per turn.

- **Failed Save:** Frightened of the performance’s origin, cannot willingly move closer, and repeats the save at the end of each turn.
- **Successful Save:** Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

When a creature leaves the area while Frightened, the condition ends at the end of its current turn.
tianxia.subpath.qi.spear_meridian_cultiv:
### CL14 — Heaven-Piercing Spear Road

**Action**  
**Origin:** You or your Spear Domain Armament  
**Area:** 90-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line  
**Cost:** 6 Qi  
**Saving Throw:** Dexterity

A white spear-road tears through creatures, barriers, defensive Qi, and battlefield formations.

**Failed Save:**

- `10d8` Piercing or Force damage.
- Open two Meridian Gates.
- Push the creature up to 20 feet along the line.
- It cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn.

**Successful Save:**

- Half damage.
- Open one Meridian Gate.
- Push it 5 feet.
- It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

#### Piercing Authority

Heaven-Piercing Spear Road:

- Ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
- Passes through creatures.
- Deals double damage to objects, vehicles, temporary barriers, structures, Formation Anchors, and Cultivation Assets.
- Ignores ordinary Resistance possessed by a barrier or asset whose Source CL is lower than yours.
- Treats the Damage Threshold of a lower-CL barrier or asset as 0.
- Creates a visible 10-foot-wide passage through any destroyed section.

Against a barrier, ward, or spatial boundary whose Source CL equals or exceeds yours, make a Cultivation Check against its save DC.

**Success:** The Spear Road can damage and potentially pass through it.  
**Failure:** The Spear Road stops at that boundary after resolving against it.

#### Ride the Spear Road

After the line resolves, move yourself or one willing creature adjacent to the origin up to 60 feet along the line.

This movement:

- Does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
- May cross open air.
- Cannot continue beyond a surviving barrier.
- Must end in a legal unoccupied space touching or adjacent to the line.
- Is not teleportation.

---

### CL6 — Long Dragon Thrust

Your spear Qi extends beyond the physical weapon.

During your turn, a spear-family weapon you wield gains 5 feet of additional reach for:

- Your attacks.
- Opportunity Attacks.
- Spear Conduction.
- Features from this Subpath.

This additional reach is projected Qi. It does not enlarge the physical weapon and does not allow ordinary object manipulation at the extended distance.

#### Dragon Through the Ranks

**Action**  
**Area:** 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line originating from you, your wielded spear, or your Spear Domain Armament  
**Cost:** 3 Qi  
**Saving Throw:** Dexterity

Choose Piercing or Force damage.

**Failed Save:**

- `4d8` damage.
- Push the creature 10 feet along the line or pull it 10 feet toward the origin.
- Open one Meridian Gate.

**Successful Save:**

- Half damage.
- No forced movement.
- No Gate opens.

Damage becomes:

- `6d8` at CL11.
- `8d8` at CL17.

Dragon Through the Ranks:

- Passes through creatures.
- Ignores Half Cover.
- Stops at a solid barrier it cannot penetrate.
- Deals double damage to temporary barriers, Formation Anchors, and Cultivation Assets whose structure is pierced by the line.
- Can be delivered through a real or projected Spear Domain Armament.

A creature can gain one Gate from each activation.

---

### CL18 — Nail the Dragon Vein

You can drive a spear through the target’s circulation and leave it there as a suppressive cultivation Anchor.

**Action**  
**Range:** Reach of a wielded spear or within 5 feet of your floating Spear Domain Armament  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Requirement:** The target bears at least three of your Open Meridian Gates  
**Limit:** Once per scene

Make one qualifying spear attack.

**Miss:**

- The feature fails.
- The Qi remains spent.
- No Gate is consumed.

**Hit:**

- Deal the attack’s normal damage.
- Deal an additional `10d10` Piercing or Force damage.
- The target makes a Constitution saving throw.

#### Failed Save — Cultivation Nailed

Consume all of your Open Meridian Gates on the target.

Your spear, projected spear, or a manifested spear-shaped Qi nail becomes embedded as a **Dragon-Vein Nail**.

While the Nail remains:

- The target’s Speed is 0.
- It cannot willingly teleport, phase, become Incorporeal, or move between planes.
- It cannot recover Cultivation Points.
- It cannot activate a feature costing more than 1 Cultivation Point.
- Its Golden Core, Nascent Soul continuity, Domain Armament, and maintained Subpath engines are suppressed.
- It cannot activate a weapon-delivered cultivation technique.
- Active cultivation fields, transformations, and summoned assets it controls are suppressed unless their Source Rule allows them to persist independently.

If the target’s CL is at least 6 lower than yours, choose **Complete Meridian Imprisonment** instead:

- The target cannot spend Cultivation Points.
- It cannot activate Path, Subpath, Sphere, Recorded Art, Forged Technique, Immortal Art, Method, Foundation-active, cultivation-item, or Domain Armament powers.
- Its passive mundane statistics and ordinary equipment remain.
- The imprisonment lasts until the Nail is removed, destroyed, or overcome through treatment.

#### Successful Save — Partial Nail

Consume three of your Gates.

Until the end of your next turn:

- The target’s Speed is 0.
- It cannot recover Cultivation Points.
- It cannot activate features costing more than 2 Cultivation Points.
- It cannot willingly teleport.

No persistent Nail remains.

### CL10 — Nine-Gate Exploitation

You learn to exploit the openings your spear created.

#### Gate Pressure

Your effects against a creature bearing your Open Meridian Gates improve according to the number of Gates it bears.

| Open Gates | Effect against that creature |
|---:|---|
| **1** | It cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you after you hit it until the start of its next turn. |
| **2** | Its first Cultivation Point expenditure during each turn costs 1 additional point. If it cannot pay, the activation fails and no cost is spent. |
| **3** | Subtract `1d4` from its first saving throw during each turn against one of your spear attacks, Spear-Meridian features, or spear-delivered techniques. |
| **4** | It cannot recover Cultivation Points while it can perceive you and remains within 60 feet of you. |
| **5** | Your spear attacks and spear-delivered techniques ignore ordinary Resistance to their damage. They do not ignore Immunity unless another rule says so. |

Gate Pressure is cumulative.

#### Exploit the Open Gate

**Trigger:** You hit a creature bearing at least one of your Open Meridian Gates with a qualifying spear attack or spear-delivered technique.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Choose one Exploitation for which the target has enough Gates.

##### One Gate — Break the Rhythm

Deal an additional `2d8` Piercing or Force damage.

The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

##### Two Gates — Cripple the Step

Deal an additional `2d8` damage.

Until the start of your next turn:

- Its Speed is halved.
- It cannot Dash.
- It cannot gain a new Fly Speed.

##### Three Gates — Choke the Meridian

Deal an additional `3d8` damage.

Until the start of your next turn:

- It cannot recover Cultivation Points.
- The first cultivation feature it activates costs 2 additional Cultivation Points.

##### Four Gates — Interrupt the Core

Deal an additional `4d8` damage.

Choose one active system you can identify through Qi Sensing:

- Golden Core Form.
- Domain Armament.
- Maintained Subpath stance or current.
- Active Method benefit.
- One active Sphere talent.
- One active cultivation-item property.

The chosen system is suppressed until the start of your next turn.

##### Five Gates — Spear Through the Dantian

Deal an additional `5d8` damage.

The target makes a Constitution saving throw.

**Failed Save:** Choose one:

- Its current Cultivation Points become no higher than its Proficiency Bonus.
- Suppress its Cultivation Point recovery until the end of your next turn.
- Suppress one Golden Core, Nascent Soul, Method, Foundation active system, Subpath engine, or Path resource feature until the end of your next turn.
- It cannot activate features costing more than 2 Cultivation Points until the end of your next turn.

**Successful Save:**

- It cannot recover Cultivation Points until the start of its next turn.

Exploit the Open Gate does not consume Gates unless a feature expressly says so.

---

### CL3 — Spear Conduction

You can use a spear-family weapon as the delivery path for a targeted Qi technique.

#### Conduct Through the Spear

When you activate a Qi-powered technique, you may deliver it through a spear-family weapon you are wielding when all of the following are true:

- You are proficient with the weapon.
- The technique targets one creature or one object.
- The technique has a range of Touch, 5 feet, or 30 feet or less.
- The technique has an instantaneous effect or a duration applied directly to the struck target.
- The technique does not create an area, summon a creature, establish a field, create a separate asset, or require a location rather than a target.

**Additional Cost:** 1 Qi

Make one attack with the spear-family weapon as part of the technique’s activation.

**Miss:**

- The technique is not delivered.
- Its complete cost remains spent.
- No saving throw from the technique occurs.

**Hit:**

1. Deal the weapon’s normal damage.
2. Apply the delivered technique to the struck target.
3. Resolve any saving throw required by the technique.
4. Apply all once-per-activation limits.

Spear Conduction applies only to the first qualifying attack unless another Source Rule expressly expands it.

The weapon may be:

- Wielded normally.
- Thrown when its weapon profile permits it.
- Floating as your bound Domain Armament after CL9.

When a thrown spear delivers the technique, use the spear’s normal range unless the authorizing technique provides a longer legal range.

#### Piercing the Circulation

**Trigger:** You hit a creature with one of the following:

- A spear-family weapon attack.
- A weapon-delivered cultivation technique delivered through a spear-family weapon.
- A Spear Domain Armament Attack.
- A Qi-powered technique expressly shaped as a spear, lance, needle, or linear thrust.

**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn  
**Saving Throw:** Constitution

**Failed Save:**

- Open one Meridian Gate in the target.

### CL3 — Precision Infusions

Learn three **Tea Formulas** from the list below. Learn one additional Formula at CL6 and all Formulas at CL14.

#### Prepare Infusion Cups

**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Implements:** Tea implements and ordinary potable water  
**Yield:** A number of Infusion Cups equal to your Proficiency Bonus  
**Duration:** 8 hours

For each cup, choose one Formula you know. A cup may be physical tea, condensed steam, a sealed leaf packet, or another culturally appropriate serving. It is a temporary cultivated preparation, not a potion or permanent item.

A willing creature may consume a cup as a Bonus Action. An Unconscious creature is willing when an adjacent creature uses an Action to administer it. A creature can benefit from only one noninstantaneous Tea Formula at a time; receiving another ends the previous one.

Unused cups lose cultivation potency when the duration ends. They cannot be sold as permanent magic items, multiplied through ordinary copying, or harvested to generate Qi.

#### Cleansing Bitterleaf

The drinker immediately repeats one saving throw against Poisoned, disease, inhaled smoke, gas, dust, contaminated air, or another bodily contaminant.

- If the effect’s Source CL is no higher than yours, the repeat save has Advantage.
- If the effect has no save, suppress its symptoms until the end of the drinker’s next turn.
- If the drinker is not currently affected, it gains Advantage on the next saving throw against one of those hazards before the end of the scene.

This Formula does not remove a permanent poison, curse, infestation, or cultivation injury unless the effect’s own recovery procedure permits a successful save to do so.

#### Still-Mind Jasmine

Choose one:

- End Charmed or Frightened when the effect’s Source CL is no higher than yours.
- Immediately repeat a save against a higher-Source-CL Charmed, Frightened, possession, Dream, or supernatural emotional effect with Advantage.
- If no such effect is present, gain Advantage on the next Wisdom or Charisma saving throw before the end of the scene.

#### Spearpoint Red Tea

For 1 minute, the first time during each of the drinker’s turns that it makes an attack roll or forces a creature to make a saving throw through a cultivated technique, it gains one benefit:

- Add +1 to the attack roll; or
- Add `1d4` to one damage roll against one target after the target fails its save.

Choose after the roll but before the result is declared. This Formula cannot apply to every projectile or target of a Barrage.

#### Cloud-Step Green Tea

The drinker may immediately move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. For 1 minute:

- Speed increases by 10 feet.
- Standing from Prone costs 5 feet of movement.
- The first 10 feet of forced movement suffered during each round is ignored.

#### Clear-Eye Oolong

For 10 minutes, the drinker gains Advantage on checks to detect:

- Poisoned food or drink.
- Ordinary disguises and concealed weapons.
- Illusions whose Source CL is no higher than yours.
- Deliberately concealed emotional distress.
- A dream, possession, charm, or altered-memory effect already suspected through other evidence.

This Formula does not automatically reveal a creature’s thoughts, secrets, alignment, or guilt.

#### Bone-Warming Black Tea

The drinker gains Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus` and, for 1 hour, has Advantage against environmental cold, heat shock, altitude sickness, and Exhaustion caused by exposure.

### CL10 — Sword Array Field

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Area:** 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 5 Qi

A network of sword paths fills the Qi field.

A hostile creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when it enters for the first time during a turn or starts there.

- **Failed Save:** `3d8` Slashing or Force damage and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Half damage.

Damage becomes `4d8` at CL17.

#### Sword Control Inside the Field

While your Seed Sword or Sword Domain Armament is inside:

- Control range becomes 60 feet.
- Movement becomes 40 feet.
- Once during each turn, move it to any visible legal point inside without using an action.
- A projected sword may disappear and reappear along sword paths.
- A real bound sword travels through legal open space and cannot pass solid barriers, Total Cover, sealed Formations, spatial locks, or a physical restraint.

#### Sword-Qi Origin

A Qi-powered sword technique not requiring a physical weapon hit may originate from you, Seed Sword, Sword Domain Armament, or one visible sword-path point. A technique requiring a real weapon attack must use an actual sword. A projected sword-path point cannot copy properties of a bound artifact sword.

#### Array Pursuit

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A hostile creature willingly leaves the field or teleports from inside to outside.  
**Limit:** Once per round

Make one Sword Domain Armament Attack before it leaves. If no floating Sword Armament exists, make a Cultivation Attack from a sword-path point within 5 feet of it, dealing normal Domain Armament damage on hit. Array Pursuit does not trigger Sword Intent without paying its cost.

### CL6 — Sword Intent

**Trigger:** You hit a creature with a Seed-Sword Attack, Sword Domain Armament Attack, weapon attack using your bound Seed Sword, Qi-powered sword technique, or weapon-delivered technique delivered through a qualifying sword.  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn  
**Saving Throw:** Wisdom

Choose one Intent. The visible mark lasts until the start of your next turn.

#### Dread Intent

- **Failed Save:** Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

A creature immune to Frightened automatically succeeds.

#### Severing Intent

- **Failed Save:** No Reactions and Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of its next turn.
- **Successful Save:** No Reactions until the start of its next turn.

#### Arresting Intent

- **Failed Save:** Speed reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Speed reduced by 5 feet.

#### Displacing Intent

- **Failed Save:** Push or pull up to 10 feet.
- **Successful Save:** Push or pull 5 feet.

#### Exposing Intent

- **Failed Save:** Cannot benefit from Invisible or ordinary visual concealment against you, and the next sword attack against it before your next turn gains Advantage.
- **Successful Save:** Cannot benefit from Invisible against you until your next turn.

A creature can bear one Sword Intent from you. Applying another replaces it.

### CL3 — Sword Seed

You cultivate one **Seed Sword**. It may be a projected sword of condensed Qi or one specific real sword bound to your Sword Seed.

#### Cultivate Sword Seed

**Ritual Time:** 10 minutes  
**Range:** Touch when binding a real sword  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Duration:** Until replaced or willingly ended

You may maintain one Seed Sword. Binding another ends the previous bond.

A real sword must be owned by you or used with the owner’s permission, satisfy all attunement and cultivation prerequisites, not already be bound as another creature’s Domain Armament, and receive the consent of a sentient sword. Binding does not grant proficiency.

A projected Seed Sword is not a physical item, cannot be sold, stored, or transferred, cannot copy a real sword’s properties, disappears while suppressed, and reappears when suppression ends if the bond remains.

#### Release the Seed Sword

**Bonus Action**

Release the Seed Sword into an unoccupied point within 30 feet. It floats and occupies no space. Once during each of your turns, move it up to 20 feet without using an action. It must remain within 30 feet.

If forced beyond range, a projected sword appears at the nearest legal point in range; a real sword falls in its space and ceases floating until recovered or controlled again.

#### Call the Seed Sword

Call a floating real Seed Sword to a legal free hand as a Bonus Action, at the beginning or end of your Attack action, or as part of activating a sword-delivered technique through it. It travels through open space rather than teleporting. A solid barrier, sealed Formation, spatial lock, or item restraint can prevent the call.

#### Seed-Sword Attack

**Bonus Action**

Move the floating Seed Sword up to 20 feet, then make a Cultivation Attack against one creature within 5 feet of it.

- **Projected Sword Hit:** `1d6 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier` Slashing or Force damage.
- **Bound Real Sword Hit:** Use the greater of the sword’s normal damage dice or `1d6`, then add your key modifier, printed enhancement bonus, and automatic item property whose trigger is legally satisfied while floating.

A property requiring physical grip, the Attack action, a separate action, a charge, stance, or other cost functions only when that requirement is satisfied.

#### Wielded Sword

When physically wielding the Seed Sword, use its normal weapon rules and an ability authorized by its Source Rules. Sword Seed does not automatically allow your Qi Cultivation key ability for ordinary weapon attacks. It may serve as a focus or deliver an authorized cultivation technique.

#### Domain Armament Integration

At CL9, Sword Seed merges with Domain Armament and gains normal Domain range, movement, Assault Mode, Bound Armament Mode, Remote Technique Origin at CL13, and normal Domain Armament damage scaling.

A bound Saint-class, Legendary, named, or ancestral sword remains the actual item when floating or wielded.

### CL18 — Ten Thousand Swords Return to Origin

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 30-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

The field fills with sword projections, reflections, trajectories, and ancestral blade images. These manifestations are not independent weapons, cannot be collected or copy item properties, and make attacks only through this feature.

Center it on a visible point, your Sword Domain Armament, or an active Sword Array Field. If centered on the Array, the fields merge, use the larger area and this duration, and require only one Concentration effect.

#### Returning Swordstorm

When the field appears, choose any number of creatures inside. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw.

- **Failed Save:** `10d8` Slashing or Force damage and no Reactions until the end of its next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Half damage and no Reactions until the start of its next turn.

#### Perfected Sword Array

For the duration:

- Sword Array entry/start damage functions throughout.
- Both Sword Armaments may move to any legal point once per turn.
- Projected swords teleport along sword paths; real swords travel through legal open paths.
- Twin-Sword Command’s second attack adds your key ability modifier.
- Sword Intent costs 0 Qi once per turn.
- A successful save against Sword Intent still suffers the successful-save result.
- Array Pursuit does not expend your Reaction once per round, though it remains once per round.

#### Return to the Hand

Once during each turn, call one real bound sword in the field directly to a legal free hand without using an action. An artifact restraint, sealed Formation, spatial lock, or higher-authority control can prevent the call. The sword is never duplicated.

---

### CL14 — Twin Sword Refinement

You may maintain two Sword Domain Armaments simultaneously. Each may be projected or bound to a different real sword and may be wielded or floating. The same physical sword cannot be bound twice.

#### Manifest Twin Swords

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Duration:** 1 hour

Manifest or release both Armaments, choosing forms and damage types independently.

Once during each turn, move each floating sword up to its normal movement, switch either between floating and wielded states with a legal free hand, and switch either between permitted modes.

#### Twin-Sword Command

**Bonus Action**

Make one Domain Armament Attack with each floating Sword Armament and resolve separately.

The first deals normal Domain Armament damage and eligible item properties.

The second deals `2d8` damage at CL14 or `3d8` at CL17. It does not add your ability modifier, does add a bound sword’s enhancement bonus, does not automatically apply a limited-use or once-per-turn item rider, cannot trigger another attack, and cannot generate another Domain Armament Attack.

Once-per-turn features, including Sword Intent and Qi Technique Potency, apply to only one attack. A weapon-delivered cultivation technique applies only to the first qualifying attack unless it expressly permits multiple attacks.

#### Twin Guard

When one Sword Armament is left uncommanded in Assault Mode or placed in a legal Guard configuration by another feature, gain +1 AC against melee attack rolls until the start of your next turn. This does not stack with itself.

### CL14 — Calamity Furnace

Your maximum Calamity Charges increases by 3.

#### Furnace Response

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You fail a saving throw, take damage, become Grappled, Prone, or Restrained, or would be forcibly moved.  
**Cost:** 2 Calamity Charges  
**Limit:** Once per round

Choose the appropriate response:

#### Reverse the Save

Add your Proficiency Bonus to the failed saving throw, potentially turning it into a success.

This is not saving-throw proficiency.

#### Consume the Damage

Reduce the triggering damage by:

`4d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier`

#### Root Against Heaven

Reduce forced movement to 0 and prevent being knocked Prone by the triggering effect.

#### Burn the Binding

Immediately repeat a saving throw or escape check against Grappled or Restrained with Advantage.

If no escape roll normally exists, make a Strength, Dexterity, or Cultivation Check, your choice, against the effect’s save DC.

On success, the condition ends.

#### Scar of Authority

When Furnace Response successfully turns a failed save into a success, reduces damage to 0, prevents forced movement, or ends a condition, gain one **Tribulation Scar**.

You may maintain one Tribulation Scar.

It records the triggering effect’s Calamity Type and Source CL.

Before your next long rest, consume the Scar to choose one:

- Treat one Calamity Charge as the recorded type.
- Add the recorded Source CL difference, maximum +5, to one Cultivation Check made to resist or overcome a similar effect.
- Allow Tribulation Release to ignore ordinary Resistance to the recorded damage type.
- Recognize the same named technique automatically when you perceive it again.

A formal breakthrough tribulation may create a persistent named Scar through the breakthrough rules rather than this temporary one.

---

### CL6 — Calamity Tempering

Each typed Charge gains an additional benefit when spent.

You receive both the normal Spend Calamity benefit and one typed benefit.

#### Flame

- Add `1d8` Fire damage to one damaged target; or
- Gain Resistance to Fire until the start of your next turn.

#### Frost

- Reduce one damaged target’s Speed by 15 feet until the start of your next turn; or
- Gain Resistance to Cold until the start of your next turn.

#### Lightning

- The damaged target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; or
- Move 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

#### Storm

- Push or pull one affected creature 15 feet; or
- Gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet until the end of the current turn.

#### Force

- Gain +2 AC until the start of your next turn; or
- Ignore Resistance to Force for one damage roll.

#### Gravity

- Prevent yourself from being moved or knocked Prone until the start of your next turn; or
- Increase one forced movement by an additional 15 feet.

#### Blood

- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `3 × your Proficiency Bonus`; or
- The first healing received by one damaged target before the start of your next turn is reduced by twice your Proficiency Bonus.

#### Shadow

- Become Lightly Obscured until the start of your next turn; or
- Invisible does not conceal one damaged target from you until the start of your next turn.

#### Spirit

- Gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and soul displacement until the start of your next turn; or
- One damaged target has Disadvantage on its next Concentration save before then.

#### General

Choose one:

- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Add `1d8` Force damage.
- Add 10 feet to forced movement.

#### Tempered Body, External Engine

Calamity Tempering is Qi reinforcement and scar cultivation. It does not make the Tribulation Vessel a Body Refiner or grant Body Refining chassis features.

---

### CL3 — Gather Calamity

After a Qualifying Calamity resolves, gain one Calamity Charge of the appropriate type.

#### Spend Calamity

Once per turn, when you activate a Qi-powered feature or make a Cultivation Attack, spend one Charge to choose one benefit:

- Add `1d8` damage of a type associated with the Charge to one damage roll.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
- Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Increase one push, pull, lift, or forced movement by 10 feet.
- Move your Domain Armament 20 feet.
- Add your Proficiency Bonus to one Cultivation Check made as part of the activation.

The Charge is spent even if the attack misses or the target succeeds unless the feature never legally activates.

#### Calamity Sense

When you perceive an active hazard, hostile field, tribulation residue, damaged Formation, unstable artifact, or environmental catastrophe within 60 feet, you learn:

- Its broad Calamity Type.
- Whether it is stable, growing, collapsing, or about to discharge.
- Its Source CL.
- Whether surviving it could create a Calamity Charge.

Calamity Sense does not reveal exact damage or hidden triggers unless another feature permits it.

---

### CL10 — Tribulation Release

**Action**  
**Origin:** You or your Domain Armament  
**Area:** 30-foot-radius sphere  
**Cost:** 3 Qi and one or more Calamity Charges  
**Saving Throw:** Dexterity or Constitution, chosen when activated

Spend up to your Proficiency Bonus in Charges.

Choose one damage type represented by the spent Charges. If multiple types are represented, you may divide the damage between two represented types.

Each creature you choose in the area makes the saving throw.

#### Damage

Tribulation Release deals:

`2d8 + 2d8 per Charge spent`

**Failed Save:** Full damage.  
**Successful Save:** Half damage.

#### Calamity Riders

For each distinct Calamity Type among the spent Charges, choose one associated rider:

- **Flame:** The creature cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
- **Frost:** Its Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.
- **Lightning:** It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- **Storm:** Push or pull it 15 feet.
- **Force:** Knock it Prone.
- **Gravity:** Its Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
- **Blood:** Reduce the next healing it receives before the start of your next turn by `3 × your Proficiency Bonus`.
- **Shadow:** It cannot benefit from Invisible or ordinary concealment until the start of your next turn.
- **Spirit:** It has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn.
- **General:** Choose push 10 feet, pull 10 feet, Prone, or no Reactions.

On a successful save, the creature suffers a maximum of one rider of your choice.

On a failed save, it suffers every selected rider.

#### Release Without Limit Counter

Tribulation Release has no per-rest use limit. Its limit is the need to survive and spend genuine Calamity Charges.

---

### CL18 — Walking Tribulation

**Bonus Action**  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

You become a mobile convergence of preserved calamities.

When activated, gain three overflow Calamity Charges. These Charges:

- May exceed your normal maximum.
- May be any types you choose from calamities you have previously survived.
- Disappear when the transformation ends.

For the duration:

- Gain Resistance to Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, and Thunder damage.
- Gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from environmental hazards and cultivation techniques.
- You may gain Calamity Charges twice per round when they come from different triggering events.
- Spending one Charge grants two different normal or typed benefits.
- Furnace Response costs 1 Charge instead of 2 once per round.
- Tribulation Release costs 0 Qi once per turn.
- Tribulation Release may originate from any point within 30 feet of you.

#### Calamity Aura

A hostile creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when it:

- Enters a space within 15 feet of you for the first time during a turn.
- Starts its turn within 15 feet of you.

A creature is affected once per turn.

Choose one damage type represented by a Charge you currently possess.

**Failed Save:**

- `3d8` selected damage.
- Apply one associated Calamity rider from Tribulation Release.

**Successful Save:**

- Half damage.
- No rider.

#### Heaven Strikes Twice

Once during the activation, when a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your Tribulation Release, force it to repeat the saving throw.

It must use the new result.

This is not a reroll granted by luck. It is a second descending wave of the stored tribulation.

#### Vessel Breaks Before the Calamity

If Walking Tribulation ends while you have four or more unspent overflow or normal Charges:

- Take `1d8` Force damage per unspent Charge beyond three.
- This damage cannot be reduced by Tribulation Vessel features.

All overflow Charges then disappear.

Normal Charges remain, up to your normal maximum.

### CL14 — Endless Shoreline

Your Tide Flow maximum increases by 2.

#### Continuous Alternation

You may gain Tide Flow twice per turn, but each gain must come from a different qualifying hit and the saber must alternate each time.

#### Two-Wave Delivery

When you activate a weapon-delivered cultivation technique through one saber, you may extend it to the next qualifying attack made by the other saber during the same turn.

**Additional Cost:** The technique’s original Qi cost again, minimum 2 Qi.

The second delivery:

- Requires a separate hit.
- Uses the same targets and parameters permitted by the original technique.
- Pays no separate non-Qi material unless the material is consumed per target or per attack.
- Cannot create a second persistent field, summoned asset, permanent effect, or strategic-scale effect.
- Cannot be extended to a third attack.
- Counts as part of the same activation for once-per-activation riders.

If the original technique has a once-per-activation rider, choose which hit carries it.

#### Shoreline Reversal

After Returning Edge reduces damage to 0 or after a creature misses the protected creature of Receiving Mode, spend 1 Tide Flow to choose one:

- Make one saber attack against the attacker.
- Move the protected creature 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Push or pull the attacker 10 feet if it is no more than one size larger than you.
- Suppress the attacker’s Reactions until the start of its next turn.

A counterattack from Shoreline Reversal cannot generate another counterattack.

---

### CL6 — Flowing Pair

#### Returning Edge

**Reaction**

**Trigger:** A creature you can perceive hits you or an ally within 5 feet of your Falling Saber with an attack roll.  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per round

Make a saber attack roll using the Falling Saber and compare it to the triggering attack roll.

- If your result equals or exceeds the triggering roll, reduce the triggering damage by `2d8 + your Qi Cultivation key ability modifier`.
- If your result exceeds it by 5 or more, reduce the damage to 0 unless the attack’s Source CL is higher than yours.
- Against a higher Source CL, reducing the damage to 0 also requires a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC.

After the reduction resolves, you may reverse Rising and Falling roles.

#### Tide Follows Tide

Once per turn after the Rising Saber hits, spend 1 Qi to make one attack with the Falling Saber against the same target or a different creature within its reach.

This additional attack:

- Does not add your ability modifier to damage unless another rule normally permits it.
- Cannot generate another additional attack.
- Can generate Tide Flow if it satisfies the alternating requirement.
- Does not repeat a weapon-delivered technique.

#### Crossed Current

When both sabers are within 5 feet of the same creature, that creature has Disadvantage on checks and saving throws made to Disarm either saber or forcibly move one away from it.

---

### CL3 — Rising Tide, Falling Tide

At the start of each of your turns, choose which controlled saber is the **Rising Saber** and which is the **Falling Saber**.

You may reverse their roles once during the turn without using an action after either saber hits or misses.

#### Rising Saber

The first time during your turn that the Rising Saber hits:

- Deal additional Slashing or Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.

#### Falling Saber

While you control the Falling Saber, gain +1 AC against the first melee attack made against you each round.

After that attack resolves, this bonus ends until the start of your next turn.

#### Tide Sequence

You track **Tide Flow**.

- Maximum Tide Flow equals your Proficiency Bonus.
- Begin each scene with 0.
- Tide Flow disappears when the scene ends.
- Gain 1 Tide Flow once per turn when a different saber hits from the saber that made your previous qualifying hit.
- The first qualifying hit of a scene establishes the sequence but grants no Flow.

Spend 1 Tide Flow after a saber hit to choose one:

- Deal `1d8` additional Slashing or Force damage.
- Move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
- Move one controlled saber 10 feet.
- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Reduce the target’s Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.

The additional damage becomes `2d8` at CL11 and `3d8` at CL17.

#### Paired Technique Focus

Either controlled saber may serve as the focus or delivering weapon of an authorized weapon-delivered cultivation technique.

The technique applies only to the first qualifying attack unless another feature expressly expands it.

---

### CL10 — Twin-Tide Domain

At CL10, you may maintain two Saber Domain Armaments simultaneously even if one or both are real bound sabers.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 2 Qi  
**Duration:** 1 hour

Manifest, release, or call both sabers as part of the activation.

Each saber may be:

- Wielded.
- Floating in Assault Mode.
- Floating in **Receiving Mode**.

#### Receiving Mode

A saber in Receiving Mode cannot make a Domain Armament Attack.

Choose yourself or one willing creature within 5 feet of it as the protected creature.

The protected creature gains:

- +1 AC against melee attack rolls.
- Advantage on saving throws against being Disarmed.
- Reduction to forced movement equal to 5 feet.

A creature can benefit from one Receiving Mode saber at a time.

#### Twin-Tide Command

**Bonus Action**

Choose one command:

##### Rising and Falling

Make one Domain Armament Attack with the Rising Saber and place the Falling Saber in Receiving Mode.

##### Crossing Waves

Make one attack with each floating saber.

The second attack deals its normal damage dice but does not add your ability modifier. It cannot repeat a weapon-delivered technique or a once-per-turn item rider.

##### Return to Shore

Call either or both real bound sabers to legal free hands, or release either or both to floating positions.

#### Tidal Origin

A non-Self Qi-powered technique may originate from either saber through Domain Armament Link. A single activation uses one origin unless it expressly permits multiple origins.

---

### CL18 — Two Seas Become One

**Bonus Action**  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

For the duration:

- Both sabers simultaneously count as Rising and Falling.
- Gain the first-hit benefits of Rising Saber from each saber once per turn.
- Receiving Mode grants +2 AC against melee attacks instead of +1.
- Begin each turn with at least 2 Tide Flow. If you have less, increase it to 2.
- Tide Follows Tide costs 0 Qi once per turn.
- Returning Edge costs 0 Qi once per round.
- You may move each floating saber up to 30 feet once during each of your turns without using an action.
- A hostile effect whose Source CL is lower than yours cannot Disarm, seize, or suppress only one of the paired sabers; it must affect both or neither.

#### Tidal Procession

Once during each of your turns, move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and make up to four saber attacks distributed among creatures whose spaces you pass within reach.

Requirements:

- Attacks must alternate sabers.
- No creature may be attacked more than twice by this procession.
- Resolve each attack at the relevant point of movement.
- This replaces your Action.

Tidal Procession is one activation. Qi Technique Potency applies once.

#### Four-Wave Delivery

When you use Tidal Procession, you may deliver one eligible weapon-delivered cultivation technique through multiple hits.

- First qualifying hit: normal technique cost.
- Second qualifying hit: pay 2 additional Qi.
- Third qualifying hit: pay 3 additional Qi.
- Fourth qualifying hit: pay 4 additional Qi.

Declare the maximum number of intended deliveries before the first attack and pay the complete additional cost then.

A missed attack consumes its assigned delivery and does not transfer it to another attack.

The technique cannot be a permanent, resurrection, Secret, strategic-scale, or self-replicating effect. Persistent areas and summoned assets can be created only once.

#### Sea Without Opening

Once per round after you spend Tide Flow, choose one creature hit by both sabers during the current turn.

It makes a Dexterity or Wisdom saving throw, its choice.

**Failed Save:** Choose one:

- Restrained between the paired saber currents until the start of your next turn.
- Cannot take Reactions and its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
- Suppress one active weapon stance, Guard Mode, or Domain Armament mode until the start of your next turn.
- Increase its next Cultivation Point cost before the end of its next turn by 3.

**Successful Save:** It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

Against a target 6 or more CL lower than you, the failed-save result lasts until the end of your next turn.

### CL3 — Living Venom Dantian

Gain Immunity to Poison damage and Poisoned from effects whose Source CL is lower than yours.

Against equal or higher Source CL, gain Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws against Poisoned.

#### Seed Venom

**Trigger:** One of your Qi-powered features deals damage to a creature.  
**Cost:** 1 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per turn  
**Saving Throw:** Constitution

Choose one known Venom Strain.

On a failed save:

- The target gains one Venom Stage.
- It takes `1d8` damage of the Strain’s permitted type.

On a successful save:

- It takes half the additional damage.
- It gains no Stage.

At three Venom Stages, the target becomes **Deeply Envenomed**.

#### Strain Symptoms

While a creature has at least one Stage, apply the selected Strain’s symptom:

- **Furnace Venom:** The first time each turn it spends Cultivation Points, it takes damage equal to the number spent.
- **Frost Venom:** Speed is reduced by 5 feet per Stage, maximum 15 feet.
- **Blood Venom:** Healing received is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus per Stage.
- **Mind Venom:** Subtract 1 from Concentration saves per Stage.
- **Spirit Venom:** It cannot benefit from Invisible or Incorporeal concealment against you; at two or more Stages, possession and spirit projection costs increase by 1.

Create one antidote dose for one Venom Strain you know.

- One Subpath.
- One Method.
- One Golden Core Form.
- One Nascent Soul engine.
- Domain Armament.
- Foundation active features.
- All Cultivation Point recovery.

- The selected structure is suppressed until the start of its next turn.

Once per round, when a Deeply Envenomed creature inside the Plague damages another creature within 5 feet, the second creature makes a Constitution saving throw.

When a creature reaches two or more Venom Stages, choose one Meridian Affliction. The Affliction persists while it has at least two Stages.

Force or Void damage.

**Bonus Action**  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Cost:** 8 Qi  
**Limit:** Once per scene

You partially withdraw from reality and carry a moving absence around yourself.

For the duration:

- Gain Resistance to all damage except Force, Psychic, and Void.
- Move through creatures and nonartifact objects as difficult terrain.
- Pass through up to 10 feet of nonartifact, non-Secret solid material during one movement.

#### Return to Nothing

Once during the activation, choose one creature, Cultivation Asset, active manifestation, or object within 60 feet.

A nonliving nonartifact target whose Source CL is lower than yours is erased immediately.

Against an equal/higher, artifact, Immortal, or Secret target:

- On success, erase one manifestation or suppress one artifact/Secret function for 1 minute.
- On failure, suppress it until the start of your next turn.

Disappear through a momentary absence and reappear in one visible or precisely known unoccupied space within range.

Make the Alchemy Check with Disadvantage.
If the check succeeds, treat the result as though it succeeded by 10 or more.
If the check fails, the backlash damage increases by one rarity tier and the product is destroyed.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.pill_devouring:
### Pill Devouring - Refinement, Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Use Limit: Once per Short Rest.
Consume one ingredient worth at least 100 gp or one pill you created.
For 1 minute, gain:
5d8 Temporary HP;
+2 to saving throw DCs for Field Formulae you use;
+10 feet Speed.
When the effect ends, choose one:
gain 1 Pill Impurity;
take 2d6 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.
If you practice Demonic Cultivation or an equivalent corrupt method, the GM may allow you to take 1 Corruption instead of the listed cost.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.pill_spirit_creat:
### Pill Spirit Creation - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
When refining a Rare or higher recipe, you may spend +8 CP after a successful Alchemy Check to attempt to awaken a Pill Spirit.
Make a second Alchemy Check.
DC: 20 + the recipe’s rarity tier.
Success: The product awakens a minor Pill Spirit.
A minor Pill Spirit has AC 15, 1 HP, Fly Speed 30 feet, can speak in a faint voice, and understands its own recipe, ingredients, flaws, and intended effect. It can take the Help action. It can identify herbs, pills, poisons, and medicinal residue within 30 feet. It can sacrifice itself to grant Advantage on one Alchemy Check made within 30 feet.
A Pill Spirit is not a familiar, servant, combat creature, or permanent companion unless another feature says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.purification_form:
### Purification Formula - Recipe, Medicine
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You learn the Purification Formula.
Rarity: Rare.
Ingredient
Cost: 500 gp.
Refinement
Cost: 5 CP.
Consumption or Administration: Action.
Choose one effect affecting the target:
remove one major poison;
remove one disease;
remove 1d4 Pill Impurities;
end one alchemical side effect;
grant Advantage on the next saving throw against a curse, possession, Heart Demon, or spiritual injury before the target finishes a Long Rest.
The GM may require a higher-rarity version to treat Legendary, Secret, divine, or artifact-grade afflictions.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.realm_ascension_p:
### Realm Ascension Pill - Secret Recipe
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Heaven-Defying Pill, lost scripture, GM approval.
DC: 32 or higher.
Ingredient
Cost: 100,000 gp, three Heavenly Materials, one Realm-specific treasure, and one personal karmic price chosen by the GM.
Refinement
Time: 1 year.
Use Limit: Once per lifetime per alchemist and once per lifetime per consumer.
You refine a pill that condenses an entire Realm crossing into one dangerous miracle.
If the refinement succeeds and the consumer survives the administration, the consumer immediately advances to the first CL of the next Realm.
Then resolve:
a Heavenly Tribulation;
a foundation-stability check;
a Pill Impurity crisis;
any story consequences of forcing Heaven to answer.
Foundation-Stability Check: Constitution, Wisdom, or the consumer’s Path key ability, chosen by the GM based on the consumer’s method.
DC: 20 + the number of CLs effectively skipped.
Failure: The consumer advances but gains a severe lasting flaw, unstable foundation, damaged meridian, warped soul mark, corrupted body, or comparable defect.
Realm Ascension Pill cannot bypass a sealed destiny, destroyed soul, divine prohibition, Secret curse, campaign-specific cultivation lock, or GM-declared impossibility.
This Secret Inheritance should be legendary, feared, politically explosive, and rarely safe.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.resurrection_pill:
### Resurrection Pill - Recipe, Medicine, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Heaven-Defying Pill.
You learn the Resurrection Pill recipe.
DC: 30.
Ingredient
Cost: 25,000 gp, a Phoenix Feather or equivalent rebirth material, the heart or core of a CR 20+ creature or equivalent spirit beast, and preserved blood or soul-resonant remains.
Refinement
Time: 30 days.
Refinement
Cost: 25 CP paid across the refinement.
Use Limit: One successful Resurrection Pill per alchemist lifetime unless the campaign is intentionally mythic.
The pill must be administered within 1 minute of death.
The target returns to life with:
full HP;
half maximum CP;
no ordinary resurrection penalty.
The pill fails if the soul is destroyed, trapped, unwilling, reincarnated, or the body is completely unavailable.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.seven_flavor_furn:
### Seven-Flavor Furnace - Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
When you finish a Long Rest, choose up to three damage types from Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, and Thunder.
When an Alchemy technique lets you choose Acid, Fire, Poison, or Force damage, you may choose one of your selected damage types instead.
You must have ingredients, furnace fuel, or recipe logic that supports the selected damage types.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.spirit_gathering_:
### Spirit-Gathering Pill - Recipe
You learn the Spirit-Gathering Pill recipe.
Rarity: Common.
Consumption: During a 10-minute cultivation meditation.
Effect: Gain 50 CXP.
This is a Cultivation pill and counts against Pill Saturation.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.ten_thousand_dreg:
### Ten Thousand Dregs Field - Dregs, Volatile
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 20-foot-radius Sphere.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 3 CP and two Reagent Stock.
You scatter alchemical residue, ash, oil, wasted powder, and cauldron sludge over the area.
The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures.
The first time a hostile creature enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 3d6 Poison damage and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no Disadvantage.
At CL 17, the damage becomes 5d6.
tianxia.talent.alchemy.world_within_the_:
### World Within the Furnace - Furnace, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+.
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet.
Area: 30-foot-radius Sphere.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 8 CP and three Reagent Stock.
You unfold a temporary alchemical environment: layered medicinal smoke, rotating ash, bitter vapor, unstable dregs, and flickering pill seals. This is not a thrown cauldron or a physical wall. It is the battlefield behaving like the inside of a refinement chamber.
When you create the area, choose Acid, Fire, or Poison.
Hostile creatures of your choice that start their turns in the area make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 5d6 damage of the chosen type and suffers one of the following effects, chosen when you create the area:
Burn Away Dross: The creature cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn.
Numb the Meridians: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Clog the Breath: The creature cannot speak above a whisper or supply Verbal components until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage and no additional effect.
Allies of your choice that start their turns in the area gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Alchemy key ability modifier.
The area is not a wall and does not provide cover.
tianxia.talent.ash.ash_clone:
#### Ash Clone - Unique Ash Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Create one humanoid cinder figure.
##### Ash Clone
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | 13 + Proficiency Bonus |
| HP | 5 x CL |
| Speed | 30 feet; Fly 30 feet and Hover |
The clone acts immediately after your turn.
As a Bonus Action, command it to:
Attack;
Dash;
Disengage;
Dodge;
Help;
Hide.
Without a command, it Dodges.
##### Cinder Strike
Attack: Your Cultivation Attack Modifier
Damage: 2d8 + Path key ability modifier Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage
When destroyed, the clone creates a 10-foot-radius patch of Ash Terrain until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.ash.ash_ward:
#### Ash Ward - Unique Ash Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: 1 CP
A shell of compacted cinders absorbs part of the blow.
Reduce the triggering damage:
| Cultivation Level | Damage Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier |
If the protected creature stands inside Ash Terrain, Smoke, or a Fire effect, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction.
tianxia.talent.ash.ashen_trail:
#### Ashen Trail - Brand Augment
Cost: +1 CP
Duration: 8 hours
The Ashen Brand becomes a persistent tracking residue.
While the branded creature remains on the same plane and within 1 mile, you know:
its approximate direction;
whether it is alive;
whether it is conscious;
whether the brand has been suppressed or removed.
An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when Ashen Trail is applied.
Successful Save: The extended duration fails, but the ordinary Ashen Brand still applies.
You may maintain a number of Ashen Trails equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.ash.ashen_wasteland:
#### Ashen Wasteland - Ashfall Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Create an Ashfall area.
A hostile creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage and become Smothered until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 10-16 | 5d6 |
| 17-20 | 7d6 |
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.ash.ashes_of_the_forgotte:
#### Ashes of the Forgotten Age
“The city was gone long before the battle began. The cultivator merely reminded the battlefield.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of the Last Ember, hidden ash scripture
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
A forgotten ruin settles over the battlefield.
When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
##### Failed Save
Take 6d10 Fire damage and 6d10 Necrotic damage.
Become Smothered.
Cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn.
Cannot gain Temporary HP.
Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
##### Successful Save
Take half damage.
Healing received is halved until the start of its next turn.
Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
##### Inside the Area
Ordinary flames are smothered after burning briefly.
Ordinary structures visibly weaken.
Temporary Barriers take double damage.
Summoned Constructs cannot regenerate.
Tracking by ordinary sight or scent fails.
Corpses cannot be animated through ordinary effects until the talent ends.
Ashes of the Forgotten Age does not automatically destroy artifacts, Formation cores, Domains, or Realm-defining structures.
tianxia.talent.ash.funeral_ash:
#### Funeral Ash - Unique Ash Talent
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 2 CP
Prepare ash from incense, burned paper, cremation residue, or another ritual material.
Choose one purpose:
preserve one corpse against ordinary decay;
cause the ash to glow if a spirit approaches within 30 feet;
grant creatures resting nearby Advantage on saving throws against nightmares, possession, and ordinary undead fear;
cause the ash to glow if one named creature or creature family approaches within 30 feet.
tianxia.talent.ash.heaven_cremating_ashs:
#### Heaven-Cremating Ashstorm
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Area: 120-foot cone
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Release a continent-darkening surge of cinders.
Creatures inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 12d10 Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage and become Smothered until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
The area becomes Ash Terrain for 1 minute.
tianxia.talent.ash.remnant_harvest:
#### Remnant Harvest - Remnant Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Consume one Remnant you created.
Choose one:
reduce the CP cost of your next Ash talent before the end of your turn by 1, minimum 1;
move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks;
gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
extend one Ashen Brand you created until the start of your next turn.
A Remnant consumed this way disappears.
tianxia.talent.ash.rolling_ashfall:
#### Rolling Ashfall - Ashfall Augment
Cost: +1 CP
As a Bonus Action, move one of your Ashfall areas up to 20 feet.
If moving Ashfall causes a creature to leave the area, ongoing effects requiring that creature to remain inside end normally.
tianxia.talent.ash.world_after_the_fire:
#### World After the Fire
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Create an immense Ashfall area.
##### Allies
ignore Ash Terrain;
gain Resistance to Fire and Necrotic damage;
gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks;
may Hide while Lightly Obscured.
##### Enemies
treat the area as difficult terrain;
cannot Dash;
