cannot gain Temporary HP;
reduce healing received by your Proficiency Bonus;
have Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.
When an enemy enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 8d8 Fire, Necrotic, or Psychic damage and become Smothered until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.barrage.one_arrow_becomes:
#### One Arrow Becomes Ten Thousand “The master did not loose a volley. The master released the certainty that one projectile had ever been alone.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sovereign Arsenal Incarnation, hidden projectile scripture
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon range or 300 feet, whichever is greater
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
Make one ranged weapon attack against one creature, object, Barrier, or structure section.
On a hit, the single projectile becomes a perfect converging storm.
##### Creature
Deal:
12 weapon damage dice + twice your ability modifier
Then choose three:
push the target 20 feet;
knock it Prone;
reduce Speed to 0 until the end of your next turn;
prevent Reactions until the end of your next turn;
ignore ordinary Resistance to the weapon’s damage type;
strike up to three additional hostile creatures within 30 feet for half damage;
create a 20-foot-radius Sky-Net Suppression area centered on the target until the start of your next turn.
##### Object, Barrier, or Structure Deal:
16 weapon damage dice + twice your ability modifier
This damage ignores ordinary hardness.
##### Miss
On a miss, the projectile divides imperfectly.
Choose one hostile creature within 30 feet of the original target and make one additional ranged weapon attack against it.
One Arrow Becomes Ten Thousand does not reproduce artifacts, talismans, rare ammunition, or unique payloads.
tianxia.talent.barrage.ricochet_scriptur:
#### Ricochet Scripture - Blitz
Prerequisite: Redirection, CL 5+
When using Redirection, redirect the attack twice instead of once.
Each turn may bend the projectile by up to 90 degrees.
A physically plausible route is still required unless another sphere or Forged Technique changes that rule.
tianxia.talent.beastmastery.acrobatic_mo:
#### Acrobatic Mount - Rider
While mounted, substitute Wisdom (Animal Handling) for Athletics or Acrobatics checks made by your mount.
If you possess Athletics, apply your Motion talents during the mount’s movement where reasonable.
Use Wisdom (Animal Handling) in place of your Athletics or Acrobatics check.
tianxia.talent.beastmastery.lookout:
#### Lookout - Tamer
While within 30 feet of your Beast Allies, you and those allies use the highest Passive Perception score among the group.
tianxia.talent.beastmastery.mount_traini:
#### Mount Training - Tamer
Your Tame Creatures are considered trained mounts when their anatomy permits riding.
tianxia.talent.beastmastery.mounted_offe:
#### Mounted Offense - Rider
While mounted, gain Advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount.
tianxia.talent.beastmastery.pack_attack:
#### Pack Attack - Tamer, Pack
Your Tame Creatures gain Advantage on attacks against one creature when at least one allied Tame Creature is within 5 feet of the target and not Incapacitated.
A Beast Companion counts as a Tame Creature for this talent.
tianxia.talent.beastmastery.trainer:
#### Trainer
Gain Expertise in Wisdom (Animal Handling).
tianxia.talent.beauty.admiring_crowd_met:
### Admiring Crowd Method
When you use Catch the Eye outside combat before an audience, crowd, court, sect hall, market, banquet, performance, or public gathering, you may target a small group rather than one creature.
Choose a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each target must be able to perceive you and must not be actively hostile.
Each target makes its saving throw separately.
On a failed save, a target is Charmed by you for 1 minute or until you or your allies harm it.
This effect does not make the crowd obey commands. It makes them willing to listen, watch, admire, or give you social space.
tianxia.talent.beauty.aura_of_unapproach:
### Aura of Unapproachable Elegance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You surround yourself with an aura of refined distance.
For the duration, creatures bearing your Beauty Mark treat the area within 5 feet of you as difficult terrain.
In addition, when a marked creature enters a space within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it cannot willingly attack you until the start of its next turn.
This effect ends for a creature if you damage it.
tianxia.talent.beauty.awe_before_violenc:
### Awe Before Violence
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your presence makes violence against you feel ugly, improper, or spiritually difficult.
For the duration, the first time on each creature's turn that a creature that can perceive you targets you with an attack, it must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it must choose a different legal target or lose that attack.
On a successful save, it can attack you normally and is immune to this talent until the start of its next turn.
A creature that succeeds on three saving throws against this talent during the same scene becomes immune to your Awe Before Violence for 24 hours.
This effect ends early if you damage a creature or force a creature to make a saving throw that deals damage.
tianxia.talent.beauty.beautiful_warning:
### Beautiful Warning
When you roll Initiative, you may use Adorn the Moment as part of the same moment without spending a Bonus Action.
Once per long rest, when you do so, choose one enemy that can perceive you. It gains your Beauty Mark until the end of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.beauty.beauty_beyond_form:
### Beauty Beyond Form
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: Creatures of your choice up to twice your Proficiency Bonus that can perceive you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your beauty no longer depends on face, body, voice, clothing, youth, gender, species, or form. For one minute, you become a spiritual principle of awe, harmony, longing, terror, mercy, perfection, or impossible memory.
Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, a target is Charmed by you for 1 minute and gains your Beauty Mark.
While Charmed this way, the target cannot willingly attack you. The first time on each of its turns that it targets one of your allies with an attack or damaging effect, it must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, it loses that attack or damaging effect. On a success, it acts normally and the Charmed condition ends.
The effect ends early for a target if you damage it.
A creature that succeeds on its initial saving throw is immune to your Beauty Beyond Form for 24 hours.
tianxia.talent.beauty.beauty_in_motion:
### Beauty in Motion
When you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you may spend 1 CP to leave a trail of graceful motion until the start of your next turn.
During this time, the first creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the Opportunity Attack misses automatically.
On a successful save, the attack is made with Disadvantage.
tianxia.talent.beauty.beauty_that_ends_w:
### Beauty That Ends War
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can perceive you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Save: Wisdom
You reveal beauty so sincere, terrible, tragic, or sacred that violence feels like sacrilege.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it cannot willingly make attacks or force creatures to make damaging saving throws.
The effect ends early if the target takes damage, if one of its allies is killed, if you command it to suffer humiliation or betrayal, or if you or your allies resume obvious aggression after it stops fighting.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Once a creature succeeds on a saving throw against this talent, it is immune to your Beauty That Ends War for 24 hours.
tianxia.talent.beauty.beauty_that_judges:
### Beauty That Judges
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your beauty becomes a mirror of the target's own ugliness, cruelty, envy, or shame.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you and spiritually judged for 1 minute.
While judged, the first time on each of its turns that it damages a creature other than you, it takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
This effect ends early if you damage the target.
tianxia.talent.beauty.beloved_voice:
### Beloved Voice
You may use Catch the Eye, Red Lip Command, Tears Like Pearls, and Captive Audience through your voice instead of sight.
A target must be able to hear you clearly.
If the target can hear but not see you, it has Advantage on its saving throw unless your voice is especially appropriate to the scene, such as a song, public speech, whispered confession, formal challenge, or prayer.
tianxia.talent.beauty.captive_audience:
### Captive Audience
Action Type: Action
Range: 30-foot cone
Target: Creatures of your choice in the area that can perceive you
Duration: Until the end of your next turn
Cost: 2 CP
Save: Wisdom
You seize the attention of a room, battlefield line, court, or mob.
Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, a target is Captivated by you until the end of your next turn and gains your Beauty Mark for 1 minute.
On a successful save, it is not Captivated, but gains your Beauty Mark until the end of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.beauty.court_of_one:
### Court of One
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Save: Wisdom
You make the target feel as if the scene has narrowed to only the two of you.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for the duration. While Charmed this way, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
This effect ends early if you or your allies damage the target.
tianxia.talent.beauty.courtly_grace:
### Courtly Grace
When you use Adorn the Moment on yourself, you may choose two of the listed skill options instead of one. The first qualifying check using either skill gains the benefit.
In addition, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Performance, Persuasion, Insight, or Deception. If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, choose another from the list.
tianxia.talent.beauty.disarming_courtesy:
### Disarming Courtesy
When a creature bearing your Beauty Mark makes a hostile ability check against you in a social scene, such as Intimidation, Deception, or Insight, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction.
The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it has Disadvantage on the triggering check.
This talent does not prevent honest disagreement or justified suspicion.
tianxia.talent.beauty.domain_of_the_perf:
### Domain of the Perfect Moment
Action Type: Action
Range: 30-foot emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Save: Wisdom
You create a temporary domain where every gesture, breath, drop of blood, and falling leaf seems arranged around you.
When you activate this talent, choose any number of creatures in the area.
Each hostile target must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it is Charmed by you until the end of its next turn and gains your Beauty Mark for 1 minute.
For the duration, the first time a marked hostile creature starts its turn in the domain, it must repeat the saving throw.
On a failed save, it cannot willingly attack you until the start of its next turn.
This effect ends for a creature if you damage it.
tianxia.talent.beauty.envious_glance:
### Envious Glance
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Save: Wisdom
You twist admiration into envy.
On a failed save, the target is Captivated by you for the duration. While Captivated this way, it has Disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes against a creature other than you on each of its turns.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
The effect also ends if you or your allies damage the target.
tianxia.talent.beauty.face_that_halts_th:
### Face That Halts the Army
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: Creatures of your choice up to your Proficiency Bonus
Duration: Until the end of your next turn
Cost: 3 CP
Save: Wisdom
You reveal a level of presence that makes even trained killers hesitate.
Each target must be able to perceive you and must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, a target is Captivated and cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn.
On a successful save, it is only Captivated until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.beauty.fragrant_sleeve_di:
### Fragrant Sleeve Diversion
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Save: Wisdom
A gesture, scent, sleeve movement, smile, turn of the head, or ripple of presence pulls the target's attention.
On a failed save, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
On a successful save, it can still take Reactions, but not Opportunity Attacks against you until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.beauty.gentle_smile_metho:
### Gentle Smile Method
When you successfully place a Beauty Mark on a creature outside combat, you may ask the GM one of the following questions:
- What would make this creature willing to listen?
- What kind of beauty, status, kindness, or etiquette does this creature respect?
- What would offend this creature's dignity?
- Is this creature more moved by admiration, pity, pride, curiosity, or longing?
The answer may be symbolic or incomplete, but it should be useful.
tianxia.talent.beauty.grace_that_shames_:
### Grace That Shames the Cruel
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 60 feet
Trigger: A creature bearing your Beauty Mark damages a creature other than you
Duration: Until the end of the triggering creature's next turn
Cost: 2 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your presence makes the act feel crude, shameful, or spiritually dissonant.
The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it takes Psychic damage equal to 1d8 + your key ability modifier, and it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
At CL 11, the Psychic damage increases to 2d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 17, it increases to 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
tianxia.talent.beauty.heaven_cannot_look:
### Heaven Cannot Look Away
When you use Captive Audience, Face That Halts the Army, or Domain of the Perfect Moment, you may spend 2 additional CP.
Targets that fail their saving throws are also unable to become Hidden from you until the effect ends, as their own attention and spiritual presence remain caught in the exchange.
This does not reveal invisible creatures unless they failed the saving throw while you could perceive them.
tianxia.talent.beauty.imperial_face_meth:
### Imperial Face Method
When you enter a formal social scene where status, face, etiquette, reputation, or public dignity matters, you may spend 1 CP to establish an Imperial Face.
For 10 minutes, creatures that can perceive you understand that insulting, dismissing, or crudely interrupting you is socially dangerous unless they have higher status, overwhelming confidence, or a reason to ignore etiquette.
This does not force obedience. It changes the social stakes.
The GM may grant Advantage on one Charisma check that relies on dignity, poise, etiquette, or reputation during the scene.
tianxia.talent.beauty.jewel_mind_reflect:
### Jewel-Mind Reflection
When you succeed on a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, possession, social compulsion, or a Spirit Awakening effect that attempts to alter your emotions, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to reflect beauty through the attack.
The creature that forced the saving throw must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it gains your Beauty Mark for 1 minute and is Captivated by you until the end of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.beauty.lotus_court_aura:
### Lotus Court Aura
Action Type: Action
Range: 15-foot emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You create an aura of courtly beauty, solemn grace, ghostly elegance, or sacred refinement.
For the duration, when a hostile creature starts its turn in the aura and can perceive you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, it has Disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn unless that attack targets you.
On a successful save, it is immune to this aura until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.beauty.lotus_gaze_pacific:
### Lotus Gaze Pacification
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can perceive you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Save: Wisdom
You look at the target with unbearable compassion, beauty, sadness, or serenity.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it cannot willingly make attacks unless it or one of its allies was damaged since the end of its last turn.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
tianxia.talent.beauty.lovely_monster_bea:
### Lovely Monster Bearing
Your beauty may be unsettling, predatory, scarred, ghostly, demonic, corpse-pale, inhuman, or terrible.
When a Beauty talent would normally rely on elegance, softness, charm, refinement, or attractiveness, you may instead express it through awe, fearsome grace, tragic horror, alien symmetry, or overwhelming presence.
In addition, when you use Catch the Eye, you may choose whether the Beauty Mark feels like admiration, fear, reverence, pity, envy, curiosity, or fascination.
This talent does not make Beauty effects count as fear effects unless another talent says so.
tianxia.talent.beauty.name_written_in_si:
### Name Written in Silk
When a creature is Charmed by one of your Beauty talents for at least 1 minute, you may spend 2 CP to leave a lingering Beauty Mark.
The mark lasts for 24 hours.
While the mark remains, you have Advantage on the first social check you make against that creature during a peaceful interaction.
The mark ends immediately if you betray, humiliate, or harm the creature.
tianxia.talent.beauty.perfect_entrance:
### Perfect Entrance
When you enter a scene, audience chamber, duel ground, banquet, battlefield, or public space, you may spend 1 CP to make your arrival spiritually memorable.
Choose a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus that can perceive you.
Each target gains your Beauty Mark until the end of your next turn.
If no combat is occurring, the mark lasts 1 minute instead.
tianxia.talent.beauty.perfect_posture:
### Perfect Posture
When you make a saving throw against being knocked Prone, moved against your will, humiliated by a social technique, or forced to kneel, bow, grovel, or lose face, you may add 1d4 to the roll.
You may use this talent after seeing the d20 roll but before the result is declared.
You may use this talent a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.
tianxia.talent.beauty.radiant_rivalry:
### Radiant Rivalry
Choose one creature bearing your Beauty Mark.
Until the end of the scene, whenever that creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, you gain a Rivalry Mark against it.
You may hold only one Rivalry Mark at a time.
Before the end of the scene, you may spend the Rivalry Mark in one of the following ways:
- add your Proficiency Bonus to one Beauty-related attack roll or social check made against that creature;
- before the creature rolls a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, increase your Cultivation Save DC against that saving throw by 2.
The Rivalry Mark then ends.
tianxia.talent.beauty.shared_spotlight:
### Shared Spotlight
When you use Adorn the Moment, you may affect yourself and one willing ally within 30 feet.
The ally's benefit must be the same kind of presentation: graceful, radiant, tragic, terrifying, courtly, solemn, or another shared aesthetic.
tianxia.talent.beauty.softened_heart:
### Softened Heart
When you make a Charisma check to de-escalate hostility, ask for mercy, request a pause in violence, negotiate surrender, or prevent cruelty, you may spend 1 CP to add 1d4 to the roll.
You may use this talent after seeing the roll but before the result is declared.
tianxia.talent.beauty.tears_like_pearls:
### Tears Like Pearls
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can perceive you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your beauty becomes vulnerable, tragic, or painfully sincere.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it cannot willingly attack you unless you attack it, harm it, or command harm against it.
The target repeats the saving throw whenever one of its allies is harmed by you or your allies, ending the effect on a success.
A creature immune to Charmed is unaffected.
tianxia.talent.beauty.unapproachable_poi:
### Unapproachable Poise
When you use Turn the Blade Aside and the target fails its saving throw, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
At Foundation Realm, this movement increases to 15 feet.
tianxia.talent.beauty.unbearable_splendo:
### Unbearable Splendor
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Save: Wisdom
Your beauty overwhelms the target's ability to act naturally.
On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. Until the end of its next turn, it is also Overwhelmed by Splendor.
While Overwhelmed by Splendor, the target cannot take Reactions, and on its turn it may do only one of the following: move, take an Action, or take a Bonus Action.
After the Overwhelmed state ends, the target remains Charmed for the duration.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Charmed condition on a success.
This effect ends early if you or your allies damage the target.
tianxia.talent.beauty.unforgettable_face:
### Unforgettable Face
A creature that has failed a saving throw against your Beauty talent remembers you clearly for one year unless memory alteration, reincarnation, curse, or stronger magic interferes.
You may also choose to leave a gentler impression. In that case, the creature remembers not your exact face but the emotion your beauty left behind.
tianxia.talent.beauty.world_adorning_ges:
### World-Adorning Gesture
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You make a place beautiful: lanterns seem brighter, petals drift, dust turns gold, shadows become elegant, rain sings, ruined stone looks holy, or blood on the ground becomes tragically vivid.
The area becomes Adorned Terrain.
While in Adorned Terrain, creatures of your choice gain Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks, Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and Wisdom saving throws against Frightened.
Hostile creatures in the terrain that can perceive the beauty have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice creatures other than you.
The terrain is not difficult terrain unless another feature says so.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.borrowed_furna:
### Borrowed Furnace Method - Furnace, Projected
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening
You can project your furnace rhythm a short distance.
Your Blacksmith abilities can treat one unattended workpiece within 30 feet as a legal workpiece if you can see it and it is touching a solid surface.
You still need tools in hand or an active furnace focus.
You cannot use this talent on a hostile creature’s worn or carried equipment unless another talent allows it.
Body Refiners cannot learn this talent unless they have an explicit external projection breakthrough.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.dragon_bellows:
### Dragon-Bellows Method - Furnace
Prerequisite: CL 12+, Furnace Discipline
When you create controlled forge heat, choose one of the following furnace moods:
Clean Flame: Advantage on checks to remove impurity, rust, poison residue, or corruption from a workpiece.
Hungry Flame: reduce crafting time for mundane forging by half, but on a failed check the workpiece gains a flaw.
Quiet Flame: forge without obvious smoke, sparks, or sound beyond 10 feet.
Roaring Flame: your next Set Edge or Forge-Fitted Weapon temper adds 1d6 Fire damage to the first hit.
White Flame: the workpiece counts as magical for the next check, repair, or attack involving its Temporary Temper.
Dragon-Bellows Method does not grant broad Fire sphere control.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.edge_before_bl:
### Edge Before Blood - Temper
When you use Set Edge on a weapon, choose one damage type the weapon already deals.
Until the Temporary Temper ends, the first hit with that weapon also treats the target’s nonmagical resistance to that damage type as one step weaker:
immunity is unaffected;
resistance becomes normal damage;
normal damage is unchanged.
Edge Before Blood does not affect magical resistance unless the GM approves the workpiece and materials.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.field_repair:
### Field Repair - Forge
When a creature within reach has a weapon, shield, armor, tool, or object damaged by an attack, hazard, or failed check, use your Reaction to Set the Workpiece to that object and place 1 Forge Mark on it.
If you already had a current workpiece, choose whether to keep the old workpiece or change to the new one.
At CL 5+, you may also use Close the Crack as part of the same Reaction by spending 1 CP.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.furnace_court_:
### Furnace Court of the Thousandfold Temper - Domain
“Every strike in the court became a hammer blow. Every breath became bellows. Every flaw had nowhere left to hide.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Create a mobile furnace court around yourself.
For the duration:
you can maintain up to three current workpieces;
once at the start of each of your turns, place 1 Forge Mark on one current workpiece inside the area;
allies inside the area gain Advantage on checks made to repair, maintain, draw, stow, fit, or use prepared equipment;
the first time each round that an ally inside hits with a weapon bearing your Forge Mark, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll;
the first time each round that an ally inside is hit while wearing armor or carrying a shield bearing your Forge Mark, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus;
hostile unattended objects, barriers, traps, locks, and constructs inside the area reveal obvious flaws to you.
While the Domain lasts, you may use Hammer the Mark once per round without spending a Bonus Action.
Furnace Court does not create permanent equipment and does not replace a workshop for long-term crafting.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.furnace_discip:
### Furnace Discipline - Furnace
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your body and tools learn the rhythm of controlled heat.
You gain Resistance to Fire damage while holding a Blacksmith tool or while your current workpiece has at least 1 Forge Mark.
When you use Spark Without Furnace, you may spend 1 CP to create a controlled forge flame sufficient to work one Medium or smaller workpiece for 10 minutes without ordinary fuel.
This flame cannot be used as a direct attack unless another feature says so.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.hammer_rebuke:
### Hammer Rebuke - Flaw, Quench
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack using a weapon or natural weapon
Cost: Spend 1 Forge Mark on your held tool, weapon, armor, or shield
Strike the attacking weapon, limb, guard, or rhythm.
The attacker makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
it cannot make opportunity attacks until the start of its next turn;
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with the triggering weapon or limb before the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot make opportunity attacks against you until the start of its next turn.
Hammer Rebuke does not damage a magic item unless another feature allows it.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.honest_materia:
### Honest Material
When buying, selling, identifying, or inspecting raw materials, ore, fuel, tool stock, or crafting components, gain Advantage on checks made to determine quality, authenticity, contamination, or fair price.
If a creature knowingly sells you false or adulterated material and you inspect it for at least 1 minute, it makes a Charisma (Deception) check against your Blacksmith Save DC.
On a failure, you know the material is false, adulterated, cursed, substituted, or unfit, though not necessarily who caused the fraud.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.portable_forge:
### Portable Forge Kit - Tool
You carry the essential tools of the traveling smith.
You can perform ordinary Blacksmith sphere abilities without a full workshop if you have a hammer, tongs, file, whetstone, binding wire, charcoal or equivalent fuel, and a stable surface.
During a short rest, choose one weapon, shield, suit of armor, tool, or object owned by you or an ally.
That item gains one Forge Mark at the start of the next action scene that day.
You can prepare a number of items this way equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and an item can hold only one prepared mark from this talent.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.quench_in_brea:
### Quench in Breath - Quench, Body
When you spend a Forge Mark on a workpiece you hold, wear, or touch, reduce the next Fire, Cold, Lightning, or Acid damage you take before the start of your next turn by your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 5+, if the workpiece is armor, a shield, or a tool prepared for heat, you may grant this reduction to the wearer or holder instead.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.quench_the_arm:
### Quench the Army’s Edge
Prerequisite: Furnace Court of the Thousandfold Temper, CL 15+
When you use Furnace Court, choose one army-edge doctrine for the duration:
#### Thousand Spear Doctrine
The first time each round that each ally inside the Domain hits with a weapon attack using a weapon bearing your Forge Mark, add 1d6 damage of the weapon’s type.
#### Iron Shirt Doctrine
The first time each round that each ally inside the Domain takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage while wearing marked armor or carrying a marked shield, reduce that damage by 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier.
#### Bell-Hammer Doctrine
When an ally inside the Domain scores a critical hit or reduces a creature to 0 HP using a marked weapon, you may place 1 Forge Mark on another legal workpiece inside the Domain.
#### Clean Tool Doctrine
Allies inside the Domain gain Advantage on ability checks using tools you have marked, and failed checks do not damage those tools unless the failure is catastrophic.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.sect_armorer_s:
### Sect Armorer’s Ledger - Project
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You can maintain a small armory for a party, sect team, guard detail, caravan, or workshop.
At the end of a long rest, choose a number of weapons, shields, armor sets, tools, or adventuring items equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Intelligence modifier, minimum 1.
Until the next long rest:
each chosen item ignores the first mundane wear, rust, dulling, or minor damage it would suffer;
each chosen item grants Advantage on one check made to maintain, clean, pack, carry, or present it properly;
once before the next long rest, when a chosen item would be damaged, its bearer may reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
Sect Armorer’s Ledger does not repair major damage automatically.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.seven_hammer_r:
### Seven-Hammer Revision - Quench
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you or an ally within 30 feet rolls damage with a weapon, tool, object, or construct attack involving a workpiece bearing your Forge Mark, spend 1 Forge Mark to revise the strike.
Reroll a number of damage dice up to your Proficiency Bonus and use the new rolls.
If the workpiece is one you personally forged or prepared during the current day, also add your Intelligence modifier to the damage roll.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.spark_without_:
### Spark Without Furnace - Furnace
You can create forge heat without a full furnace.
When using Hammer the Mark or a Forge Response, you may produce enough heat to soften, temper, solder, or seal a hand-sized portion of a legal workpiece.
This heat is not a weapon by itself.
You can use it to ignite ordinary tinder, heat tools, boil a small amount of water, seal wax, solder soft metal, or warm a cold object.
At CL 5+, this heat can treat harder materials as long as you spend CP equal to the object’s quality or the GM’s required amount.
Spark Without Furnace does not replace Fire sphere techniques for battlefield flames.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.spirit_listeni:
### Spirit-Listening Tap - Flaw, Spirit
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Read the Flaw on a magic item, spiritually significant object, ancestral weapon, talismanic tool, sect token, or item with a history, you may ask one question from the list below on a success:
What emotion was strongest when this item was last used?
What kind of owner does this item accept?
What kind of use does this item resist?
What material or memory is missing from its current state?
Has this item harmed its bearer before?
Does this item contain the seed of an item spirit?
The answer comes as tone, heat, memory, pressure, dream, or intuition.
This does not reveal command words or secret powers automatically.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.steady_hammer_:
### Steady Hammer Breathing - Tool, Temper
When you make an ability check using Smith’s Tools, add your Proficiency Bonus twice if you are already proficient.
If another feature already grants Expertise with Smith’s Tools, instead gain Advantage on one Smith’s Tools check per short rest.
In addition, when you use Hammer the Mark, you may move 5 feet before or after the work without provoking opportunity attacks from one creature whose weapon, armor, shield, or carried object is your current workpiece.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.strike_the_hid:
### Strike the Hidden Flaw in Heaven’s Tool - Flaw
Prerequisite: Unmake by Knowing, CL 15+
When you can see a magical construct, artifact mechanism, formation component, summoned weapon, spiritual chain, divine seal, cursed tool, or similar crafted supernatural thing within 60 feet, you may attempt to identify its hidden flaw.
Action Type: Action
Cost: 5 CP
Make an Intelligence check using Smith’s Tools against the creator’s save DC, the effect’s DC, or a GM-set DC.
Successful Check: Choose one:
suppress one non-Secret function until the start of your next turn;
reduce the effect’s remaining duration by 1 round, minimum 1 round;
create an opening that gives the next attack or check against it Advantage;
allow one ally to ignore one movement, restraint, or equipment penalty caused by it until the start of your next turn.
Failed Check: You cannot target that same thing with this talent again until your next long rest.
This talent does not destroy artifacts or Secret Inheritances outright.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.tempering_sequ:
### Tempering Sequence - Forge
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a workpiece has at least 3 Forge Marks from you, you may spend all of them to perform a Tempering Sequence.
Choose one:
#### Hardening Sequence
The workpiece gains a Temporary Temper lasting 10 minutes.
If armor or shield, it grants +1 AC.
If weapon or tool, it gains +1 to attack rolls or relevant checks.
#### Softening Sequence
The workpiece becomes easier to reshape.
The next repair, crafting, modification, or disarm attempt involving it before the end of the scene has Advantage.
#### Purifying Sequence
Reduce one mundane impurity, rust, poison residue, rot, corrosion, instability, or crafting complication affecting the workpiece.
A magical curse or artifact flaw is only reduced if the GM allows it.
#### Awakening Sequence
The workpiece gains the first sign of an item spirit seed until the end of the next long rest.
During that time, once when used for its named purpose, it grants Advantage on one roll.
A true awakening requires a project.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.ten_thousand_t:
### Ten-Thousand Temper Armory - Project
Prerequisite: Sect Armorer’s Ledger, CL 15+
You can maintain a serious armory for a sect branch, expedition, guard corps, caravan fleet, or player faction.
During downtime, establish an armory with:
a secure workspace;
assistants or disciples;
inventory records;
materials;
repair protocols;
tools;
GM-approved upkeep.
While the armory is maintained, choose one armory doctrine:
#### Expedition Doctrine
Travel gear, weapons, and armor maintained by the armory ignore ordinary weather wear and reduce one travel equipment complication per journey.
#### Guard Doctrine
A number of guards or allies approved by the GM begin each prepared mission with one Temporary Temper on a weapon or armor piece.
#### Sect Duel Doctrine
A number of named duelists equal to your Proficiency Bonus may each prepare one named weapon or defensive item with Name the Purpose after a long rest.
#### Repair Doctrine
Downtime repair times for mundane equipment are reduced by half, and the armory can preserve damaged magic items until a proper repair project begins.
Ten-Thousand Temper Armory creates infrastructure, not free treasure.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.two_beat_tempe:
### Two-Beat Temper - Temper
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Hammer the Mark, you may place 2 Forge Marks instead of 1.
After doing so, you cannot place more Forge Marks on that workpiece until the start of your next turn.
If you are in a full workshop or at your Apprentice’s Anvil, you may use Two-Beat Temper once per round without cost.
If you are not, spend 1 CP each time after the first use in a scene.
tianxia.talent.blacksmith.workman_s_eye:
### Workman’s Eye - Flaw
When you use Read the Flaw, learn one additional fact on a success.
You may also use Read the Flaw on a construct, vehicle, siege engine, gate, lock, chain, bridge, armor stand, furnace, or trap you can touch.
If you identify a nonmagical object’s flaw, gain Advantage on the next check made to repair, disable, open, break, or improve it before the end of the scene.
tianxia.talent.blood.blood_hound:
#### Blood Hound - Rite Talent
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One Blood Sample
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 2 CP
Study one Blood Sample.
For the duration:
know the approximate direction of its source while the source remains on the same plane and within 100 miles;
gain Advantage on checks made to track the source;
recognize whether another sample came from the same creature. A protected, sealed, transformed, or magically disguised target may require a Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.blood.blood_mending:
#### Blood Mending - Unique Blood Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Cost: 3 CP
Restore:
3d8 + Path key ability modifier HP
You may also end one ordinary bleeding effect.
A creature benefiting from Blood Mending cannot benefit again until it completes a short rest.
Blood Mending repairs circulation and ordinary wounds.
It does not regrow missing limbs or automatically remove major injuries, curses, or Realm-level damage.
tianxia.talent.blood.blood_ward:
#### Blood Ward - Unique Blood Talent
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: 1 CP
A curtain of hardened blood absorbs part of the blow.
Reduce the triggering damage by the amount shown on the Blood Ward Reduction table.
Blood Ward Reduction:
• CL 1-4: 1d8 + your key ability modifier.
• CL 5-10: 2d8 + your key ability modifier.
• CL 11-16: 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
• CL 17-20: 4d8 + your key ability modifier.
If the protected creature is Bloodied or bears your Blood Thread, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction.
tianxia.talent.blood.bloodletting_strike:
#### Bloodletting Strike - Thread Augment
Trigger: You hit with a melee attack or Blood Thread.
Cost: 1 CP.
Add 1d6 Necrotic damage to the triggering hit or Blood Thread damage.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: At the start of its next turn, it takes additional Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Successful Save: No ongoing damage.
A creature can suffer only one Bloodletting Strike from you at a time.
tianxia.talent.blood.bloodline_reading:
#### Bloodline Reading - Bloodline Rite
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature or Blood Sample
Cost: 2 CP
Study one body’s inherited circulation.
Learn broad information:
whether a meaningful bloodline, ancestry, mutation, or inherited trait exists;
whether one trait appears dormant, active, damaged, or artificially altered;
whether the sample has been contaminated or refined;
whether two studied samples appear closely related. Bloodline Reading provides evidence, not a complete genealogy.
tianxia.talent.blood.crimson_court:
#### Crimson Court - Blood Domain
“Every heartbeat in this court belongs to itself. Every heartbeat is still audible to me.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Inside the Domain:
##### You and Allies
gain Advantage on death saving throws;
gain Resistance to Necrotic damage;
receive additional healing equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn;
know whether another allied creature inside becomes Bloodied.
##### Enemies
cannot benefit from ordinary invisibility against your Bloodsense after taking damage inside the Domain;
have Disadvantage on saving throws against your Blood talents while Bloodied. When a Bloodied enemy starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 2d8 Necrotic damage and cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.blood.crimson_feast:
#### Crimson Feast - Thread Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Trigger: You damage a Bloodied creature bearing your Blood Thread
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per turn
Deepen the predatory link.
Deal extra Necrotic damage based on your CL.
Crimson Feast Damage:
• CL 5-10: 2d6 Necrotic damage.
• CL 11-16: 3d6 Necrotic damage.
• CL 17-20: 4d6 Necrotic damage.
Regain HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Crimson Feast cannot heal you above half your maximum HP.
Crimson Feast is not automatically forbidden, but some sects treat predatory use against unwilling creatures as suspect.
tianxia.talent.blood.crimson_mark:
#### Crimson Mark - Thread Augment
Cost: +1 CP
Duration: 1 hour
When you apply Blood Thread, extend its duration to 1 hour.
While the Thread persists:
you know the target’s approximate direction while it remains on the same plane and within 10 miles x Proficiency Bonus;
the target cannot hide from your Bloodsense merely through ordinary invisibility;
sealed barriers, anti-divination techniques, and specialized concealment may still interfere. An unwilling creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Successful Save: The extended duration fails, but the ordinary Blood Thread still applies.
tianxia.talent.blood.crimson_wave:
#### Crimson Wave - Unique Blood Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot cone
Cost: 3 CP
Release a wave of blood, iron scent, and vital pressure.
Choose Necrotic or Piercing when you activate the talent. Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: A creature takes damage based on your CL.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage.
Crimson Wave Damage:
• CL 5-10: 4d6 Necrotic or Piercing damage.
• CL 11-16: 6d6 Necrotic or Piercing damage.
• CL 17-20: 8d6 Necrotic or Piercing damage.
tianxia.talent.blood.heart_seizing_grip:
#### Heart-Seizing Grip - Forbidden Thread Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Choose one living creature bearing your Blood Thread.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save:
Restrained by internal pain and pressure;
cannot take Reactions;
take 3d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each turn;
repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save:
take 3d8 Necrotic damage;
cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.blood.open_the_veins:
#### Open the Veins - Sacrifice Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the end of your turn
Cost: None
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Until the end of your turn:
Crimson Sacrifice may replace CP multiple times instead of only once;
reduce the HP cost of each replaced CP from 5 HP to 4 HP;
the maximum CP replaced across the turn remains 2 x Proficiency Bonus. At the end of your turn, make a Constitution saving throw against your own Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: Become Bloodied if you were not already Bloodied and gain one level of Exhaustion.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
Open the Veins cannot reduce you below 1 HP.
tianxia.talent.blood.rivers_run_red:
#### Rivers Run Red
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Create a storm of blood, iron scent, and spiritual pressure.
When a creature enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 8d8 Necrotic or Piercing damage and become Poisoned until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
A Bloodied creature inside also counts as bearing your Blood Thread until it leaves the area.
tianxia.talent.blood.shared_veins:
#### Shared Veins - Rite Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 3 CP
Bind yourself and up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures into a shared circulation pact.
While two bound creatures remain within 60 feet:
each knows whether another bound creature is Bloodied;
each knows the approximate direction of the others;
when one bound creature receives healing, another bound creature of your choice regains HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature gains this secondary healing only once per turn.
Shared Veins does not transfer conditions or damage automatically.
tianxia.talent.blood.vital_transfusion:
#### Vital Transfusion - Unique Blood Talent
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Cost: Special
You take self-damage up to the maximum shown on the Vital Transfusion Maximum table.
Vital Transfusion Maximum:
• CL 1-4: Up to 1d8 + your key ability modifier.
• CL 5-10: Up to 2d8 + your key ability modifier.
• CL 11-16: Up to 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
• CL 17-20: Up to 4d8 + your key ability modifier.
Roll the listed dice when you activate the talent, then choose how much self-damage to take, up to the rolled maximum.
This self-damage:
ignores Resistance and Immunity;
cannot be reduced;
cannot be transferred;
cannot be paid with Temporary HP;
cannot reduce you below 1 HP.
One living creature you touch regains HP equal to the self-damage taken.
Vital Transfusion does not restore missing limbs or remove major injuries by itself.
tianxia.talent.brute.alternative_maneuve:
#### Alternative Maneuvers
You do not suffer Disadvantage when using Shove Aside.
When making an Overrun attempt, apply Brutal Shove damage and one Manhandle talent as though it were a Brutal Shove.
tianxia.talent.chains.binding_chain:
### Binding Chain
Tags: Tether
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 2 CP
You use Set the Tether as a tighter binding.
Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target becomes Bound until the start of your next turn.
This talent is the basic hard-control expression of Chains.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_armor:
### Chain Armor
Tags: Anchor
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Chains coil around your body as armor, counterweight, and anchor.
For the duration, you gain:
+2 AC;
Advantage on saving throws against forced movement and Prone;
reduce forced movement affecting you by 10 feet;
when a creature Grappling you starts its turn, it takes Bludgeoning or Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you already have natural chain armor from Body Refining or a forged technique, the GM may allow the appearance to merge rather than stacking visual layers.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_clone:
### Chain Clone
Tags: Tether, Lash
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
You create one humanoid chain construct.
Chain Clone
AC: 14 + your Proficiency Bonus
HP: 6 x your CL
Speed: 30 feet
Size: Medium unless your technique says otherwise
Chain Strike: The clone makes a melee Cultivation Attack using your Cultivation Attack Modifier. On a hit, it deals 2d8 + your key ability modifier Bludgeoning or Slashing damage.
Hooking Links: When Chain Strike hits, the target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
The clone acts immediately after your turn.
As a Bonus Action, you command it to Attack, Dash, Dodge, Grapple, Help, Shove, or use Set the Tether with your Cultivation Save DC. Without a command, it Dodges.
Only one Chain Clone may exist at a time.
This talent does not replace Puppetry because the construct is a simple chain-body extension, not a full vessel or independent puppet.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_counter:
### Chain Counter
Tags: Anchor, Lash
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 30 feet
Trigger: A creature within range makes a melee attack, enters your reach, strikes a creature linked by your Tether, or moves into a space adjacent to one of your Chain Objects
Cost: 2 CP
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
reduce the triggering attack roll by your Proficiency Bonus;
pull the target 10 feet;
knock the target Prone;
reduce its Speed to 0 for the remainder of the turn;
prevent it from taking Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet or reduce its remaining movement by 5 feet.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_gang_method:
### Chain Gang Method
Tags: Tether, Prison
Prerequisite: Twin Tether
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Choose up to three creatures within range. Each unwilling creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Each creature that fails becomes part of a chain gang. Willing creatures may join without a save.
While part of the chain gang:
each creature is Bound;
no linked creature can willingly move more than 30 feet from every other linked creature;
when one linked creature is forcibly moved, you may choose one other linked creature to make a Strength saving throw; on a failure, it is pulled 10 feet in the same direction;
if a linked creature falls Prone, one other linked creature of your choice has its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
A linked creature may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the Tether on itself on a success.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_prison:
### Chain Prison
Tags: Tether, Prison
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
You trap one creature inside layered chains.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained and Anchored for the duration. While affected, it cannot take Reactions and cannot teleport unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the Strength saving throw, ending the Restrained portion of the effect on a success. If the target succeeds, it remains Bound until the start of its next turn.
Successful Initial Save: The target becomes Bound until the start of its next turn.
The prison is a Chain Object with AC 17 and Hit Points equal to 8 x your CL. Destroying the prison ends the effect.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_script_seal:
### Chain-Script Seal
Tags: Tether, Spirit
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You write a chain-shaped seal on a creature, object, spirit, corpse, talisman, or doorway.
An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target bears a Chain-Script Seal.
Successful Save: The seal fails to attach.
While sealed, the target counts as linked for your Link-Sense and Anchor the Link. In addition, the first time each round the target attempts to teleport, become Incorporeal, possess another creature, or leave its body, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC or the attempt fails.
Spirit Awakening cultivators often use this talent to hold ghosts, possessing entities, and fleeing souls in place long enough for another technique to resolve.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_the_door:
### Chain the Door
Tags: Anchor, Prison
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
You bind a door, gate, lid, hatch, chest, window, passage, or similar movable boundary with chain seals.
For the duration:
opening the bound object requires a Strength check against your Cultivation Save DC;
teleportation through the boundary requires a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC;
attempts to force, pick, or unseal the boundary create an audible chain-ringing you can hear within 300 feet;
the bound object gains Temporary HP equal to 5 x your CL for the duration.
This does not make a wall where no boundary exists, and it does not prevent a creature from breaking through nearby unprotected material.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_the_falling_:
### Chain the Falling Star
Tags: Anchor, Rescue
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 120 feet
Trigger: A willing ally, sect asset, flying vessel, platform, mount, or protected creature within range would fall, be hurled, be dropped from flight, be pulled into a hazard, or be displaced by a massive force
Cost: 8 CP
You cast sovereign rescue chains.
Choose up to five willing creatures or one vehicle/object of Huge size or smaller involved in the same event.
For each target, choose one:
prevent the fall;
reduce forced movement by 60 feet;
move the target to the nearest safe unoccupied space within 30 feet;
suspend the target in chains until the end of its next turn;
grant Resistance to the triggering damage;
allow the target to stand, land, or stabilize without spending movement.
This talent can save an airship from crashing for one round, hold a collapsing bridge long enough for creatures to flee, or keep a dragon-mounted ally from being thrown out of the sky.
It does not permanently repair the underlying disaster.
tianxia.talent.chains.chain_web:
### Chain Web
Tags: Tether, Prison
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
You fill the area with crossing chains.
The area is difficult terrain.
When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 3d8 Bludgeoning or Slashing damage and is Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and becomes Bound until the start of its next turn.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the damage becomes 4d8.
tianxia.talent.chains.drag_down_the_flyi:
### Drag Down the Flying Crane
Tags: Tether, Anchor
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 3 CP
You target one flying creature with Set the Tether.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target descends up to 30 feet and becomes Bound until the start of your next turn. If it reaches the ground or a stable surface, it also falls Prone.
Successful Save: The target descends 10 feet and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
If the target cannot descend because of solid obstacles, it takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus for every 10 feet of prevented descent, to a maximum equal to 5 x your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.chains.drag_the_mountain_:
### Drag the Mountain Gate
Tags: Lash, Anchor
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Cost: 6 CP
Choose one creature, object, vehicle, siege engine, gate, boulder, statue, or other large target you can see.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes 6d10 Bludgeoning or Slashing damage, is pulled up to 30 feet toward a point you choose, and falls Prone if it ends on a surface.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and is pulled 10 feet.
Against an unattended object or structure, this talent deals double damage and may move the target if physically plausible.
This is a battlefield and siege-chain technique, not general telekinesis.
tianxia.talent.chains.grappling_chain:
### Grappling Chain
Tags: Lash, Tether
Trigger: You hit a creature with Chain Lash or a melee attack
Cost: 2 CP
Your chain wraps around the target after the hit.
Add Bludgeoning or Slashing damage based on Realm:
Foundation: +2d6
Core Formation: +3d6
Nascent Soul: +4d6
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
pull the target 15 feet;
knock the target Prone;
the target becomes Bound until the start of your next turn;
the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn;
you may immediately attempt to Grapple the target if it is within your reach.
Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet.
tianxia.talent.chains.heavenly_anchor:
### Heavenly Anchor
Tags: Anchor, Prison, Spirit
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Choose one creature, object, or 10-foot-radius area.
An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target becomes Anchored for the duration. For the duration, it cannot:
teleport;
travel between planes;
become Incorporeal;
be moved involuntarily unless the moving effect overcomes your Cultivation Save DC;
be carried away by ordinary environmental forces.
At the end of each of its turns, an unwilling creature repeats the Charisma saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot teleport until the start of its next turn.
Heavenly Anchor does not prevent mental influence, possession already in progress, or effects that do not require the target to move unless another talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.chains.hooked_step:
### Hooked Step
Tags: Anchor, Lash
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 1 CP
You hook a chain to a surface, object, enemy, ally, or anchor and move along the line.
Move up to 15 feet toward a point you can see within range without provoking opportunity attacks from creatures other than the target of the hook.
If the hook is attached to an unwilling creature, the creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: You may move as described, and the target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: You may move only 5 feet.
This movement must end in an unoccupied space you can occupy.
tianxia.talent.chains.iron_link_guard:
### Iron Link Guard
Tags: Anchor, Rescue
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 30 feet
Trigger: A creature you can see is hit by a melee attack, ranged attack, or Chain Lash-like attack
Cost: 1 CP
You snap a chain across the blow.
Reduce the damage by 1d8 + your key ability modifier.
At Foundation Realm, reduce the damage by 2d8 + your key ability modifier.
At Core Formation Realm, reduce the damage by 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
At Nascent Soul Realm, reduce the damage by 4d8 + your key ability modifier.
If the damage is reduced to 0, you may attach a harmless Link to the attacker until the start of your next turn.
This talent protects by interception, not by general warding. It should not replace Protection sphere defensive scaling.
tianxia.talent.chains.link_sense:
### Link-Sense
Tags: Tether, SpiritPassive
You can feel tension through your own chains.
While a creature, object, or surface is attached to one of your Tethers, you know the direction of the linked target while it remains within 120 feet of you. You also know whether the Tether is taut, slack, cut, broken, or being deliberately manipulated.
Spirit Awakening cultivators may perceive this as a pressure in the soul rather than a physical sensation.
tianxia.talent.chains.lock_the_weapon_ha:
### Lock the Weapon Hand
Tags: Lash, Tether
Trigger: Chain Lash hits a creature holding a weapon, focus, shield, tool, talisman, or similar object
Cost: 2 CP
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one held object. Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls or ability checks made using that object, and cannot stow or drop it willingly.
Successful Save: The target cannot take Reactions involving that object until the start of its next turn.
This talent restrains the hand or object; it does not steal the object.
tianxia.talent.chains.manacle_method:
### Manacle Method
Tags: Tether
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You form manacles, cuffs, rope-links, pressure-point bands, or seal-shackles on one willing, incapacitated, Grappled, Restrained, or Prone creature.
If the target is unwilling and not incapacitated, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Bound for the duration.
Successful Save: The chains do not attach.
A Bound target may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the effect on a success.
If you use Manacle Method on a target already Restrained by one of your Chains effects, it has Disadvantage on the first escape check it makes against Manacle Method.
tianxia.talent.chains.meridian_chain_loc:
### Meridian Chain Lock
Tags: Tether, Spirit
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Prerequisite: The target is Bound, Grappled, Restrained, or attached to one of your Tethers
Cost: 4 CP
You tighten chain pressure around the target’s meridians, spell gestures, breath, or soul movement.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn:
the first time the target spends CP, it spends 2 additional CP;
the target cannot take Reactions;
the target has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.
Successful Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
This talent does not prevent a target from using abilities outright; it makes movement, breath, and power flow costly.
tianxia.talent.chains.oath_lock_chain:
### Oath-Lock Chain
Tags: Tether, Prison, Spirit
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 5 CP
You bind a willing oath, surrender, prisoner agreement, sect parole, duel condition, or safe-passage promise with visible chain script.
The target must be willing, defeated, restrained, or participating in a formal agreement. This talent cannot force a free creature to swear an oath.
Choose one simple condition, such as:
do not leave this room;
do not attack named prisoners;
do not speak the hidden route;
do not remove these shackles;
return to the sect gate by sunset;
remain within 30 feet of the escort.
If the target knowingly violates the condition, it takes Force damage equal to 3d8 + your key ability modifier and becomes Bound for 1 minute. The target may make a Charisma saving throw, halving the damage and preventing the Bound state on a success.
Oath-Lock Chain is a limited chain-oath. It does not replace Karma because it requires explicit chain sealing, a narrow condition, and a willing or already-contained context.
tianxia.talent.chains.prisoner_s_bell:
### Prisoner’s Bell
Tags: Prison, SpiritPassive
When a creature escapes one of your Chains talents, destroys one of your Chain Objects, teleports away from one of your Tethers, or crosses a boundary protected by Chain the Door, you may immediately learn the direction of its escape and whether it used physical movement, teleportation, spiritual escape, forced movement, or outside assistance.
If the creature is within 300 feet, you also hear a chain-bell sound that no one else hears unless you permit it.
Once per short rest, when Prisoner’s Bell triggers, you may use Restraining Hook against that creature without spending CP if it is within range.
tianxia.talent.chains.pulling_chain:
### Pulling Chain
Tags: Tether, Lash
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP
You use Set the Tether to drag a target or object.
Choose one creature or unattended object within range.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Pull the target up to 15 feet toward you or toward one anchored point you can see.
Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet.
If the target is an unattended object, you may pull an object weighing no more than 50 pounds x your CL up to 30 feet.
Pulling Chain cannot move a target into a solid object. If movement would place the target in an obviously lethal hazard, the GM may grant Advantage on the save.
tianxia.talent.chains.rescue_line:
### Rescue Line
Tags: Anchor, Rescue
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 60 feet
Trigger: A willing ally within range falls, is knocked Prone, is pushed, is pulled, would enter a hazard, or is moved against its will
Cost: 2 CP
Choose one:
pull the ally 15 feet toward you;
reduce forced movement by 20 feet;
prevent the ally from falling;
move the ally to the nearest safe unoccupied space within 10 feet of its original location;
allow the ally to stand without spending movement.
The ally must be willing.
At Core Formation Realm, the range increases to 90 feet.
tianxia.talent.chains.restraining_hook:
### Restraining Hook
Tags: Tether, Lash
Action Type: Reaction
Range: 30 feet
Trigger: A creature within range moves more than 10 feet during a turn, leaves your reach, or attempts to move away from a Tether you created
Cost: 1 CP
You hook the target’s ankle, wrist, sleeve, shadow, or spiritual pressure.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Reduce its remaining movement to 0.
Successful Save: Reduce its remaining movement by 10 feet.
Restraining Hook does not count as an opportunity attack.
tianxia.talent.chains.seal_the_crossing_:
### Seal the Crossing Gate
Tags: Anchor, Prison, Spirit
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 10 CP
You seal local escape routes with chained gates.
For the duration, enemies in the area cannot teleport, become Incorporeal, enter the Ethereal Plane, travel between planes, or exit through portal-like effects unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
A creature that succeeds can escape normally, but the chain-gates ring. You learn what kind of escape was used.
Allies you designate when creating the effect may ignore the seal.
This talent does not close permanent portals or planar rifts by itself; it prevents creatures inside the area from using them freely for the duration.
tianxia.talent.chains.shackling_chain:
### Shackling Chain
Tags: Tether, Prison
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
You upgrade Set the Tether into a sustained shackle.
Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained for the duration.
Successful Save: The target becomes Bound until the start of its next turn.
A Restrained target repeats the Strength saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. It may also use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the effect on a success.
The shackle is a Chain Object. Destroying it ends the effect.
tianxia.talent.chains.thousand_mile_pris:
### Thousand-Mile Prisoner Line
Tags: Tether, Prison, Spirit, Restricted
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: 7 days
Cost: 10 CP
You place a long-distance prisoner chain on a willing, defeated, unconscious, restrained, or legally condemned target.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw if unwilling.
Failed Save: The prisoner bears a Thousand-Mile Prisoner Line.
Successful Save: The rite fails.
While marked:
you know the direction and distance to the prisoner while on the same plane;
if the prisoner teleports, you learn the destination direction and approximate distance if still on the same plane;
if the prisoner crosses planes, you learn that a planar crossing occurred;
the prisoner has Disadvantage on checks made to remove mundane restraints;
the first time each day the prisoner attempts to escape an assigned boundary, it must make a Charisma saving throw or become Bound for 1 minute.
The prisoner may attempt to break the line during a long rest by making a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. On three successes, the line breaks. On three failures, the line remains until its duration ends.
This talent is restricted in orthodox sects. Its legal use usually requires office, warrant, battlefield authority, or sect law.
tianxia.talent.chains.weighted_links:
### Weighted Links
Tags: LashPassive
Your Chain Lash hits with heavier momentum.
Once per turn when Chain Lash hits, you may add your key ability modifier to the damage if it is not already included.
In addition, when Chain Lash pulls or pushes a target, increase the movement by 5 feet if the target is no more than one size larger than you.
tianxia.talent.chains.world_bound_in_cha:
### World Bound in Chains
Tags: Domain, Tether, Prison
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You fill the battlefield with enormous chains.
#### Allies
Allies inside the area:
gain Advantage on saves against forced movement and Prone;
reduce forced movement by 20 feet;
may move along chains as though they were solid ground;
gain Half Cover against ranged attacks while adjacent to a major chain.
#### Enemies
Enemies inside the area:
treat the area as difficult terrain;
cannot Dash;
cannot teleport unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw;
have Disadvantage on checks made to escape Grappled, Restrained, and Bound states caused by your Chains talents.
When an enemy enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes 4d8 Bludgeoning or Slashing damage and is Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and becomes Bound until the start of its next turn.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.daemonic_cultivation.blac:
#### Black Merit Smile - Tyrant, Parasite
You learn how to make corruption look like worthiness.
Gain Advantage on one Charisma check per Short Rest made to intimidate, impress, bargain with, or recruit a creature tempted by power.
When Demon Seed is active, you may spend 1 Devoured Essence to make one creature that can hear you roll a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It has Disadvantage on the next Insight check made against you before the end of the scene.
This does not force friendship, loyalty, or belief.
tianxia.talent.daemonic_cultivation.demo:
#### Demon Sovereign Aura - Domain, Tyrant
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP or 7 Devoured Essence
Manifest a small demon court: black banners, bone lamps, hungry scripture, trembling shadows, upside-down incense, or a throne of pressure.
While inside the aura:
Allies you choose gain:
Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns;
Advantage on saving throws against Frightened;
+1 to attack rolls against creatures bearing your Demon Mark.
Enemies you choose make a Wisdom saving throw the first time each turn they enter the aura or start their turn there.
Failed Save: Choose one:
Frightened until the start of their next turn;
Speed reduced by 15 feet until the start of their next turn;
cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn;
take Psychic or Necrotic damage equal to 2d8 + Proficiency Bonus;
gain your Demon Mark until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Their Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of their next turn.
When Demon Sovereign Aura ends, gain 1 Corruption if any creature was reduced to 0 HP inside the aura.
tianxia.talent.daemonic_cultivation.stea:
#### Steal the Enemy’s Heaven
Prerequisite: Devour the Scripture Fragment, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 120 feet uses a non-Secret, non-artifact, non-Domain technique with a visible effect.
Cost: 12 CP or 12 Devoured Essence
Make a contested Cultivation Check.
Success: The triggering technique still occurs, but you steal its heavenly momentum.
Choose two:
gain Resistance to all damage dealt by the triggering effect;
one target of the triggering effect gains Advantage on its saving throw;
your next Daemonic talent before the end of your next turn has Advantage on its attack roll or imposes Disadvantage on one saving throw;
regain CP or Stamina equal to Proficiency Bonus;
reproduce a corrupted echo of one minor part of the technique before the end of your next turn.
Success by 5 or more: Choose three instead.
Failure: The technique resolves normally and you gain 2 Corruption.
tianxia.talent.death.bone_general:
#### Bone General - Command
Prerequisite: Corpse Servant, CL 10+
Your corpse servants develop disciplined battlefield functions.
When you create a Corpse Servant, choose two improvements from the list below. You may choose the same improvement only if it says so.
+2 AC.
+3 x your CL HP.
Climb Speed equal to Speed.
Swim Speed equal to Speed.
Reach increases by 5 feet.
Large size, if the corpse can support it.
Grave Strike deals +1d8 Necrotic damage.
It can speak simple phrases in a grave-rasp.
It retains one skill proficiency the corpse had in life.
It gains the Deathless Guard reaction without needing the talent.
It gains Resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
You may change one chosen improvement whenever you animate a new Corpse Servant.
tianxia.talent.death.the_grave_emperor_o:
#### The Grave Emperor Opens the Ninth Gate
“When the gate opened, the dead did not rise screaming. They rose in order. That was worse.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Death-Sovereign Incarnation, Grave Formation, hidden grave-emperor scripture, GM approval
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 120-foot Emanation centered on you
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Not required
Cost: 20 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You open the Ninth Gate, establishing a temporary imperial court of death. The battlefield becomes a grave jurisdiction. Corpses turn their faces toward you. Ghosts hear their case called. Living enemies feel their names written in ash.
When you activate this inheritance, choose Orthodox Gate or Forbidden Gate.
tianxia.talent.destruction.ashen_denial:
### Ashen Denial
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Withering Break, Foundation Realm
A creature damaged by Withering Break cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn.
If the creature already has Temporary HP, remove those Temporary HP before applying damage.
tianxia.talent.destruction.breaching_pro:
### Breaching Proof
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Unadorned Ruin, Foundation Realm
Unadorned Ruin deals one additional Destruction Die against objects, structures, barriers, formation anchors, siege engines, cover sources, and similar constructed defenses.
If this destroys a meaningful barrier section, the GM should normally create a breach, weakened cover, exposed anchor, or other visible consequence.
tianxia.talent.destruction.break_the_for:
### Break the Formation Anchor
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Breaching Proof, Core Formation Realm
When your Destructive Blast damages a formation anchor, ward node, barrier focus, ritual object, siege engine, or similar constructed defense, you may spend 1 CP to make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC or a GM-set DC.
On a success, the target defense is disrupted until the start of your next turn. The GM determines the visible effect, such as lowering a barrier panel, exposing a weak point, halving cover, interrupting a ritual pulse, or making the next check against the defense with Advantage.
tianxia.talent.destruction.break_the_gua:
### Break the Guard
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Fracturing Break or Scouring Break, Foundation Realm
When a creature fails its saving throw against Fracturing Break or Scouring Break, choose one:
its AC is reduced by 1 until the start of your next turn;
the next attack roll against it before the start of your next turn gains Advantage;
it cannot benefit from half cover until the start of your next turn.
A creature can suffer only one option from Break the Guard at a time.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_chai:
### Calamity Chain Reaction
Blast Shape Talent
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
When your Destructive Blast destroys an object or reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points, you may spend 1 CP to cause fragments of ruin to burst outward.
Choose one creature or object within 10 feet of the destroyed target. That creature or object takes one Destruction Die of the selected Blast Type’s damage type.
If the original blast used an area Blast Shape, choose only one secondary target total.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_curt:
### Calamity Curtain
Blast Shape Talent
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Create one 5-foot-by-5-foot wall panel on a flat surface within range.
A creature passing through the panel suffers the damage and effects of the selected Destructive Blast.
A creature standing in the wall’s space when the panel appears makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful saving throw, that creature chooses which side of the wall it occupies. On a failed saving throw, you choose which side it occupies, provided the creature can fit in the selected space.
The Calamity Curtain does not normally block line of effect, sight, projectiles, or thrown objects.
A creature cannot take damage from the same Calamity Curtain more than once per turn.
The maximum number of contiguous panels increases with your Cultivation Level.
CL 1-4: 1 panel
CL 5-10: 2 panels
CL 11-16: 4 panels
CL 17+: 8 panels
Augment - 0 CP: Create a spherical or hemispherical dome instead of a linear wall. The dome’s radius cannot exceed the width or height of one panel.
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the maximum width and height of each panel.
CL 1-4: 10 feet x 10 feet
