CL 5-10: 15 feet x 15 feet
CL 11-16: 20 feet x 20 feet
CL 17+: 25 feet x 25 feet
Augment - 1 CP: Create twice as many panels.
Augment - 1 CP: The Calamity Curtain blocks sight. Moving through the wall requires an additional 5 feet of movement. At CL 11 or higher, nonmagical projectiles passing through the wall are destroyed.
Augment - 2 CP: The Calamity Curtain persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_form:
### Calamity Form
Blast Shape Talent
You shape your destructive cultivation into a deliberate area release.
Augment - 0 CP: Release your Destructive Blast in a 5-foot-radius area centered on a point within range. You may exclude yourself. Affected creatures make a Dexterity saving throw.
Augment - 1 CP: Instead release your Destructive Blast as one of the following:
a 30-foot cone;
a 120-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line.
The effect emanates from one point within range. Affected creatures make a Dexterity saving throw.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_mant:
### Calamity Mantle
Blast Shape Talent
Duration: 1 round
Your Destructive Blast becomes an aura of destructive cultivation extending 10 feet from you.
While the Calamity Mantle is active, you may spend a Bonus Action to affect every other creature within the aura with your Destructive Blast. Affected creatures make a Dexterity saving throw.
The Blast Type and all other parameters are selected when you activate the Calamity Mantle and cannot be changed while it remains active.
Augment - 1 CP: The duration becomes Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Augment - 2 CP: The Calamity Mantle persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_pear:
### Calamity Pearl
Blast Shape Talent
Your Destructive Blast affects one 5-foot cube within range. Creatures in that cube make a Dexterity saving throw.
#### Sealed Pearl
Augment - 0 CP: Instead of resolving immediately, the Destructive Blast forms as a cultivated pearl approximately the size of a sling stone.
You or another creature may throw the pearl with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, hurl it with a sling using the sling’s normal range, place it carefully on a surface, or deliberately shatter it.
The pearl releases the stored Destructive Blast when shattered. If placed without shattering, it releases after 1 minute.
A creature may shatter a pearl within reach as an Action, as a Bonus Action, or by spending 5 feet of movement while passing through its space. A creature unaware of the pearl that moves through its space has a 50 percent chance of shattering it.
You cannot maintain more Sealed Pearls at one time than your Proficiency Bonus.
For rules interacting with thrown alchemical items or traps, treat a Sealed Pearl as a throwable prepared formula.
Augment - 1 CP: The Sealed Pearl persists for 8 hours. If you are within your Destructive Blast range of the pearl, you may cause it to release as a Reaction. At the end of the duration, the pearl either releases or dissipates. Choose which outcome occurs when creating it.
Augment - 1 CP: The affected area becomes a sphere with a radius of up to 20 feet.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_sove:
### Calamity-Sovereign Incarnation
Transformation Talent
Requirement: Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
You become a temporary incarnation of destructive authority.
For the duration:
once on each of your turns, when you use Destructive Blast, reduce the CP cost of one Destruction augment by 1, to a minimum of 0 CP;
your Destructive Blast ignores half cover;
objects and structures damaged by your Destructive Blast take one additional Destruction Die;
when a creature within 30 feet damages you, you may use Returning Calamity without spending additional CP, but only once per round.
When the duration ends, you cannot use Calamity-Sovereign Incarnation again until you finish a long rest.
tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_with:
### Calamity Without Mercy
Blast Discipline Talent
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Destructive Blast effects with a final CP cost of 1 or more, you may still apply one minor breakage consequence from the selected Blast Type if the GM agrees the target is physically or spiritually vulnerable to it.
Examples include cracking a shield, scattering footing, dimming a temporary barrier, exposing a weak point, or interrupting a minor environmental object.
This talent cannot apply a rider condition, deny healing, remove Reactions, or force movement on a successful save unless another feature says so.

### Calamity Without Ornament
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Breaching Proof, Nascent Soul Realm
When another Destruction talent allows you to add Destruction Dice to Unadorned Ruin, increase the maximum permitted number of additional dice by one.
In addition, once per turn when Unadorned Ruin damages an object, structure, barrier, formation anchor, or constructed defense, you may ignore Resistance to Force damage from non-artifact sources.
tianxia.talent.destruction.catastrophe_e:
### Catastrophe Engine
Blast Discipline Talent
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
Once per turn when you spend CP on Deepen the Calamity, reduce the CP cost of one Blast Shape augment applied to that same Destructive Blast by 1, to a minimum of 0 CP.
You cannot reduce the cost of an augment that removes Concentration.
tianxia.talent.destruction.collapsing_af:
### Collapsing Aftermath
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
When your Destructive Blast destroys or drops a meaningful object, barrier, structure section, cover source, or construct to 0 Hit Points, choose one visible space adjacent to it.
That space becomes hazardous wreckage until the start of your next turn. The first creature other than you to enter that space or start its turn there takes one Destruction Die of damage of the blast’s damage type.
tianxia.talent.destruction.controlled_ru:
### Controlled Ruin
Blast Discipline Talent
You learn to keep your release from scattering wastefully.
When you release an unshaped Destructive Blast, increase its range to 60 feet.
When you use a Blast Shape that affects an area, you may exclude yourself from the area if you are inside it. This does not exclude allies unless another talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.destruction.crushing_brea:
### Crushing Break
Blast Type Talent
Destruction Die: d8
Damage Type: Bludgeoning
Your ruin manifests as direct crushing impact.
A creature damaged by Crushing Break makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, push the creature 10 feet away from the blast’s point of origin.
Forced movement from Crushing Break cannot move a creature through a solid barrier.
tianxia.talent.destruction.destructive_d:
### Destructive Domain: Court of the Last Impact
Domain Talent
Requirement: Destructive Domain: Field of Falling Forms, Nascent Soul Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 60-foot-radius aura
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
You manifest a domain where all forms remember the possibility of ending.
While the domain persists:
your Destructive Blast range increases by 60 feet inside the domain;
you may apply one Blast Type and one Blast Shape without counting Unadorned Ruin as your Blast Type when using Unadorned Ruin;
objects, barriers, structures, and formation anchors damaged by your Destructive Blast take two additional Destruction Dice;
the first time each round a creature fails a saving throw against your Destructive Blast inside the domain, choose one: it falls Prone, cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn, or cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
The domain does not automatically destroy terrain or buildings. The GM adjudicates environmental consequences from actual damage dealt.

### Destructive Domain: Field of Falling Forms
Domain Talent
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 20-foot-radius aura
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
You create a temporary field where structural integrity weakens.
While the domain persists:
your Destructive Blast range increases by 30 feet inside the domain;
objects, barriers, structures, and constructs inside the domain lose Resistance to the damage type of your selected Destructive Blast unless that Resistance comes from an artifact, major formation, or higher-Realm effect;
when you damage a creature inside the domain with Destructive Blast, the creature cannot benefit from half cover until the start of your next turn.
The domain does not damage creatures by itself.
tianxia.talent.destruction.fracturing_br:
### Fracturing Break
Blast Type Talent
Destruction Die: d8
Damage Type: Force
Your ruin finds stress lines and worsens them.
A creature damaged by Fracturing Break makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the next attack roll made against that creature before the start of your next turn gains Advantage.
Objects and structures damaged by Fracturing Break count as cracked until the start of your next turn. The next source of Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage against such a target deals one additional Destruction Die.
tianxia.talent.destruction.hammer_throug:
### Hammer Through the Line
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Crushing Break, Foundation Realm
When Crushing Break pushes a creature into a solid obstacle or another creature, the pushed creature takes one additional Destruction Die of Bludgeoning damage and falls Prone.
If the pushed creature collides with another creature, the second creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it also falls Prone.
tianxia.talent.destruction.heaven_pierci:
### Heaven-Piercing Ray
Blast Shape Talent
Release your Destructive Blast as a ray.
Make one ranged Cultivation Attack against one target within range. You may instead make a melee Cultivation Attack against a target within your natural reach.
Augment - 1 CP: Release multiple rays as part of the same Action.
CL 1-4: 2 rays
CL 5-10: 3 rays
CL 11-16: 4 rays
CL 17+: 5 rays
Make a separate Cultivation Attack for each ray. Each ray deals full damage and applies the ordinary rules of the selected Blast Type. No creature or object may be targeted by more than one ray from the same release.
tianxia.talent.destruction.leaping_ruin:
### Leaping Ruin
Blast Shape Talent
Your Destructive Blast arcs toward one creature or object of your choice within range.
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Augment - 1 CP: When the first target fails its saving throw, you may spend a Bonus Action to cause the release to leap to additional targets.
The blast may affect a total number of targets equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Each additional target must be:
within 30 feet of the previous target;
within your Destructive Blast range;
visible to you;
not previously affected by the same release.
Each additional target makes its own Dexterity saving throw. No creature or object may be affected more than once by the same Leaping Ruin.
tianxia.talent.destruction.returning_cal:
### Returning Calamity
Blast Shape Talent
Augment - 1 CP: You may release your Destructive Blast as a Reaction when you are damaged by a creature within range that you can see.
The creature that damaged you becomes the target of the blast. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
On a successful save, the target takes half damage and negates the selected Blast Type’s rider effect.
tianxia.talent.destruction.ruin_binding_:
### Ruin-Binding Tether
Blast Shape Talent
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Make one of the following attacks against a creature or object within 30 feet:
a melee Cultivation Attack if the target is within your natural reach;
a ranged Cultivation Attack otherwise.
On a hit, deal your selected Destructive Blast damage and tether the target to you.
The tethered target cannot willingly move farther away from you unless you allow it. While the tether persists, neither you nor the target can move more than 30 feet from the other.
Either creature may attempt to drag the other through a contested Strength check. If the moving creature wins, it may move up to half its Speed while dragging the other creature. A creature at least two size categories larger than the opposing creature cannot be dragged and may move freely at full Speed while dragging the smaller creature.
While the tether remains, you may spend a Bonus Action to deal the stored Destructive Blast damage to the tethered target again. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
The Blast Type and all other parameters are selected when the tether is created and cannot be changed while it remains active.
The tether has AC equal to 10 + your Proficiency Bonus, HP equal to 3 x your CL, immunity to Psychic damage, and immunity to the selected Blast Type’s damage type. The tether’s HP refreshes at the start of your turn.
Augment - 2 CP: The tether persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.
tianxia.talent.destruction.ruin_crossing:
### Ruin-Crossing Step
Blast Shape Talent
Your Destructive Blast becomes a 5-foot-wide, 10-foot-long line emanating from you.
After the release resolves, you appear in the final square of the line or the nearest legal unoccupied space.
Affected creatures make a Dexterity saving throw.
You do not count as moving through intermediate spaces. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the length of the line by any amount up to your Destructive Blast range.
Augment - 1 CP: You may appear in any legal unoccupied space along the line after the release resolves.
tianxia.talent.destruction.ruin_tempered:
### Ruin-Tempered Armament
Blast Shape Talent
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: action, bonus_action
Timing Detail: Action or Bonus Action, chosen when activated
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_IMBUE->action, BONUS_ACTION_IMBUE->bonus_action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Your Destructive Blast imbues weapons and ammunition.
Choose one of the following within range:
one melee weapon;
one natural weapon;
one unarmed strike;
up to 20 pieces of ammunition.
The selected weapon or ammunition deals the chosen Blast Type’s damage type instead of its ordinary damage type.
Attacks made with the imbued weapon or ammunition do not deal additional Destructive Blast damage and do not apply the Blast Type’s rider effect unless stated below.
After damaging a creature with an imbued weapon or piece of ammunition, the wielder may spend a Bonus Action to apply the selected Blast Type’s rider effect to that creature as though it had been damaged by the Destructive Blast.
Critical hits with an imbued weapon or piece of ammunition deal additional damage of the selected Blast Type. This damage is added after resolving the critical hit and is not doubled.
CL 1-4: +1d6 damage
CL 5-10: +2d6 damage
CL 11-16: +3d6 damage
CL 17+: +4d6 damage
Augment - 1 CP: Imbue a number of additional weapons, natural weapons, unarmed strikes, or sets of ammunition equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Augment - 2 CP: The imbuement persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.
tianxia.talent.destruction.ruin_that_rem:
### Ruin That Remembers
Blast Shape Talent
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
When you damage a creature with Destructive Blast, you may spend 2 CP to leave a Ruin Trace on it for 1 minute.
Once during that duration, when you damage the same creature again with Destructive Blast, consume the Ruin Trace to deal two additional Destruction Dice of the same damage type.
A creature can bear only one Ruin Trace from you at a time.
tianxia.talent.destruction.ruinous_inter:
### Ruinous Interruption
Blast Type Refinement
Requirement: Staggering Break, Foundation Realm
A creature that fails its saving throw against Staggering Break cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
If the creature is Concentrating, it also has Disadvantage on the Concentration saving throw caused by the blast’s damage.
tianxia.talent.destruction.scouring_brea:
### Scouring Break
Blast Type Talent
Destruction Die: d6
Damage Type: Slashing
Your ruin tears surfaces, armor gaps, and exposed defenses.
A creature damaged by Scouring Break makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Spaces meaningfully affected by an area Blast Shape may become littered with splinters, shards, torn stone, or cutting residue until the start of your next turn. Moving through such a space costs an additional 5 feet of movement.
tianxia.talent.destruction.staggering_br:
### Staggering Break
Blast Type Talent
Destruction Die: d6
Damage Type: Thunder
Your ruin hammers rhythm, breath, and balance.
A creature damaged by Staggering Break makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn.
A creature that cannot hear is still affected; the damage is destructive vibration, not ordinary sound.
tianxia.talent.destruction.the_mountain_:
### The Mountain Admits It Can Break
Siege Talent
Requirement: Nascent Soul Realm
When you spend at least 10 minutes using Destructive Blast against a stationary object, wall, gate, barrier, mountain face, ship hull, formation shell, or similar target, you may conduct a siege-breaking rite.
At the end of the rite, make a Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC based on the target’s scale, material, formation support, Realm, and narrative importance.
On a success, you create one meaningful breach, crack, route, collapse point, exposed anchor, or tactical opening.
On a failure, the target is damaged and visibly weakened, but remains functional. You cannot attempt this rite against the same target again until you change tactics, gain new leverage, obtain better information, or spend significant additional resources.
tianxia.talent.destruction.unmaking_pres:
### Unmaking Pressure
Blast Type Talent
Requirement: Core Formation Realm
Destruction Die: d6
Damage Type: Force
Your ruin presses against active protections until their shape fails.
A creature damaged by Unmaking Pressure makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, choose one visible temporary defensive benefit affecting it, such as a temporary AC bonus, temporary damage resistance, temporary barrier layer, temporary shield effect, or similar protection. That benefit is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
Unmaking Pressure cannot suppress core Path features, permanent item properties, entire spheres, plot protections, or effects the GM judges too deep to break with ordinary Destruction.
tianxia.talent.destruction.wandering_cal:
### Wandering Calamity
Blast Shape Talent
Duration: 1 round
Your Destructive Blast takes the form of a 5-foot-diameter sphere of cultivated calamity.
The sphere appears in one legal unoccupied space within range. A creature entering the sphere’s space is affected by the blast and makes a Dexterity saving throw. A creature cannot take damage from the same Wandering Calamity more than once per turn.
As a Bonus Action, move the sphere up to 30 feet. If you ram the sphere into a creature, that creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it negates the sphere’s damage and rider effects. After attempting to ram a creature, the sphere stops moving for the turn in the space immediately before that creature.
The sphere flies and is never at risk of falling.
Augment - 1 CP: The duration becomes Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Augment - 2 CP: The Wandering Calamity persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.
tianxia.talent.destruction.withering_bre:
### Withering Break
Blast Type Talent
Destruction Die: d6
Damage Type: Necrotic
Your ruin expresses as immediate structural exhaustion rather than grave authority.
A creature damaged by Withering Break cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
This is destructive depletion, not control over death, corpses, ghosts, or undead.
tianxia.talent.destruction.world_ending_:
### World-Ending Line
Blast Shape Talent
Requirement: Nascent Soul Realm
When you release Destructive Blast as a line, ray, or Ruin-Crossing Step, you may spend 3 additional CP to make it a World-Ending Line.
The line becomes 10 feet wide and may extend up to 300 feet. It damages objects and structures in its path as well as creatures.
A creature reduced to 0 Hit Points by this line leaves behind a visible scar of ruin, such as glassed stone, split earth, blackened air, silent vibration, or a pressure trench.
World-Ending Line cannot pass through a sealed artifact barrier, major formation, or plot-level defense unless the GM permits it.
tianxia.talent.disease.clean_carrier_met:
#### Clean Carrier Method
Tags: [Carrier], [Purge]
You can carry minor infections without spreading them accidentally.
You have Advantage on saving throws against ordinary disease.
When you succeed on a saving throw against a Disease effect, you may choose to gain one harmless Contagion Token instead of suffering no visible effect. This token cannot be spent by enemies and fades after 1 minute.
Once per round, when you voluntarily remove one of your own harmless Contagion Tokens, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Body Refiners often learn this talent before Plague-Bearing Body.
tianxia.talent.disease.contaminated_woun:
#### Contaminated Wound
Tags: [Seed], [Carrier]
Trigger: You damage a creature with Sow the Fever Seed or a weapon attack.
Cost: 1 CP
Use Limit: Once per turn
The attack deals additional 1d6 Necrotic or Poison damage.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target gains one Contagion Token, and healing it receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Healing it receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn.
The additional damage increases to 2d6 at Core Formation and 3d6 at Nascent Soul.
tianxia.talent.disease.coughing_breath:
#### Coughing Breath
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom]
Cost: 1 CP
When you hit a creature with Sow the Fever Seed, you may spend 1 CP to disturb its breath.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws.
Successful Save: The target has Disadvantage on the next concentration saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.disease.enlarged_quaranti:
#### Enlarged Quarantine Veil
Tags: [Veil]
Your Quarantine Veil radius increases to 15 feet.
At Core Formation, it increases to 20 feet.
At Nascent Soul, it increases to 30 feet.
tianxia.talent.disease.epidemic_surge:
#### Epidemic Surge
Tags: [Seed], [Carrier]
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 90 feet
Cost: 4 CP
Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures bearing your Contagion Tokens.
Spend one Contagion Token from each chosen creature. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 3d8 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and is not Sickened.
Epidemic Surge can damage each creature only once per use.
At Nascent Soul, this damage becomes 4d8.
tianxia.talent.disease.fever_symptom:
#### Fever Symptom
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom]
Cost: 1 CP
When you hit a creature with Sow the Fever Seed, you may spend 1 CP to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target’s next healing before the start of your next turn is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
At Core Formation, a failed save also deals additional Disease damage equal to your key ability modifier.
tianxia.talent.disease.hidden_carrier:
#### Hidden Carrier
Tags: [Diagnose], [Carrier], [Forbidden]
Your disease signs become difficult to identify.
When another creature uses a divination, Medicine check, Diagnose-like effect, or Disease talent to identify your Contagion Tokens or Infection Effects, it must make a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
On a failure, it knows that something is wrong but not that you caused it.
You may suppress visible symptoms caused by your Disease talents until the start of your next turn. Suppressed symptoms still function mechanically.
tianxia.talent.disease.infection_of_the_:
#### Infection of the Cultivation Breath
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom], [Forbidden]
When a creature bearing at least two of your Contagion Tokens spends CP, you may use your Reaction and spend one of those tokens.
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the creature cannot reduce CP costs below printed values, cannot regain CP, and has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws.
Successful Save: The creature cannot regain CP until the start of its next turn.
This talent does not permanently destroy cultivation advancement and cannot scatter a cultivation base by itself.
tianxia.talent.disease.living_plague:
#### Living Plague
Tags: [Seed], [Carrier], [Forbidden]
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
You create one crawling plague construct, parasite swarm, fever ghost, infected corpse-shell, or spiritual sickness body.
Only one Living Plague created by you may exist at a time.
Living Plague
AC: 13 + your Proficiency Bonus.
Hit Points: 5 x your Cultivation Level.
Speed: 30 feet, Climb 30 feet.
It acts immediately after your turn.
As a Bonus Action, command it to Attack, Dash, Dodge, Help, Hide, Climb, or interact with a contaminated object. Without a command, it Dodges.
Infected Strike: Use your Cultivation Attack Modifier. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + your key ability modifier Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and gains one Contagion Token.
Contagious Body: When the Living Plague is destroyed, creatures of your choice within 5 feet make Constitution saving throws. On a failed save, a creature gains one Contagion Token.
tianxia.talent.disease.malaise_symptom:
#### Malaise Symptom
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom]
Cost: 1 CP
When you hit a creature with Sow the Fever Seed, you may impose weakness rather than raw fever.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet, it cannot take Reactions, and it has Disadvantage on Strength checks.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.disease.merciful_quaranti:
#### Merciful Quarantine Physician
Tags: [Diagnose], [Purge], [Veil]
When you use Purging Breath on a creature inside your Quarantine Veil in Containment Mode, you may choose two Purging Breath benefits instead of one.
In addition, if Purging Breath allows an immediate repeat saving throw against an Infection Effect, the target has Advantage on that saving throw.
tianxia.talent.disease.narrow_quarantine:
#### Narrow Quarantine
Tags: [Veil]
When you Raise the Quarantine Veil in Containment Mode, you may reduce the radius to 5 feet.
If you do, the veil no longer requires Concentration, but it lasts only until the end of your next turn.
This is often used to isolate a patient, seal a corpse, protect a doorway, or stop one infected creature from spreading tokens for a round.
tianxia.talent.disease.parasite_seed:
#### Parasite Seed
Tags: [Seed], [Carrier]
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: A biological, fungal, spiritual, or dream parasite clings to the target. At the start of each of the target’s turns, it takes 2d6 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and gains one Contagion Token. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The target takes 2d6 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage once and does not gain the parasite.
The damage increases to 3d6 at Core Formation and 4d6 at Nascent Soul.
tianxia.talent.disease.physician_of_bad_:
#### Physician of Bad Signs
Tags: [Diagnose]
When you use Diagnose the Sickness, you may ask one additional practical question.
Examples include:
What kind of creature is most vulnerable to this infection?
Is the infection being sustained by a creature, item, terrain feature, corpse, or spiritual anchor?
Would Life, Alchemy, Disease, Radiance, Flesh, or Spirit Awakening be the most obvious treatment route?
Is the infection being hidden?
Has the target been recently treated?
The GM answers truthfully, but may answer in cultivation-world language rather than mechanical labels.
tianxia.talent.disease.plague_bearing_bo:
#### Plague-Bearing Body
Tags: [Carrier], [Purge]
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Cultivated disease circulates harmlessly inside your body.
For the duration, you gain:
Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage;
Advantage on saving throws against Disease;
immunity to ordinary disease;
immunity to Sickened;
the ability to hold your own Contagion Tokens harmlessly inside your body.
A creature Grappling you or touching your blood, sweat, bite, claws, breath, or open wound gains one Contagion Token at the start of its turn unless you suppress the effect.
Body Refiners treat this as a central access talent.
tianxia.talent.disease.plague_cloud:
#### Plague Cloud
Tags: [Veil], [Seed]
When you Raise the Quarantine Veil in Outbreak Mode, you may spend 2 additional CP.
The veil becomes a drifting cloud of spores, infected mist, spiritual fever, crawling parasites, or coughing smoke.
The area becomes lightly obscured, and enemies that fail their saving throw against the veil also gain one Contagion Token.
At Core Formation, enemies that fail also become unable to regain more than half the normal Hit Points from healing until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.disease.plague_eruption:
#### Plague Eruption
Tags: [Veil], [Seed]
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
You create a violent outbreak zone. This functions as Raise the Quarantine Veil in Outbreak Mode, but the area is 20 feet and the damage is 5d6.
When a creature with one or more of your Contagion Tokens fails its saving throw against this area, you may spend one of those tokens to deal an additional 2d6 damage.
At Nascent Soul, the base damage becomes 7d6 and the token damage becomes 3d6.
tianxia.talent.disease.plague_needle:
#### Plague Needle
Tags: [Seed], [Carrier]
You can deliver Disease through a precise martial strike.
When you hit with a weapon attack using a needle, dart, dagger, claw, fang, unarmed strike, or other small piercing method, you may spend 1 CP to use Sow the Fever Seed through that hit instead of making a ranged Cultivation Attack.
Use the weapon attack’s hit result. The Disease damage is added to the weapon’s damage.
Body Refiners may use this talent through unarmed strikes, pressure points, biting, claws, blood contact, or palm needles.
tianxia.talent.disease.quarantine_citade:
#### Quarantine Citadel
Tags: [Veil], [Purge], [Strategic Project]
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual project
Time: 30 days
Cost: 15 CP at the culmination, plus 25,000 gp in medicinal herbs, jade, alchemical materials, sealed chambers, talismans, spirit anchors, and quarantine infrastructure
You create a permanent quarantine site, plague hospital, containment fortress, disease-research compound, sealed cemetery, monster-hunter infirmary, or epidemic defense hall.
Choose three benefits:
Disease talents cost 1 fewer CP once per turn nearby, minimum 1.
Diagnose the Sickness and Purging Breath checks gain +2.
Ordinary disease cannot spread between sealed rooms.
Raise the Quarantine Veil can be made permanent in prepared chambers.
Life and Alchemy projects gain +2 when treating disease.
Residents gain Advantage on saving throws against ordinary disease.
Contaminated objects may be stored safely.
Intruders carrying Disease trigger visible warning marks.
Medicinal herbs worth 500 gp are produced each month.
One dangerous infection may be studied with reduced risk.
You may maintain a number of Quarantine Citadels equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.disease.quarantine_ward:
#### Quarantine Ward
Tags: [Veil], [Purge]
When you Raise the Quarantine Veil in Containment Mode, you may spend 2 additional CP.
The veil becomes a proper ward.
Choose any number of creatures inside the veil. They gain Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage caused by Disease talents while they remain inside the veil.
In addition, Contagion Tokens cannot spread out of the area unless you allow it.
If a creature inside the ward attempts to teleport out while bearing one or more Contagion Tokens, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or the teleport fails.
The ward does not physically trap creatures.
tianxia.talent.disease.soul_plague_metho:
#### Soul Plague Method
Tags: [Diagnose], [Seed], [Symptom]
Your Disease can infect spiritual command rather than flesh.
Your Disease talents can affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and soul-bound constructs if they have an animating spirit or spiritual identity.
Against such targets, your Disease talents may deal Psychic or Necrotic damage instead of Poison.
When you use Diagnose the Sickness on such a target, you may learn whether the sickness is tied to memory, possession, soul injury, curse, Heart Demon influence, or external spiritual contamination.
tianxia.talent.disease.spreading_infecti:
#### Spreading Infection
Tags: [Seed], [Carrier]
Trigger: A creature bearing one or more of your Contagion Tokens starts its turn within 10 feet of another creature.
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per round
Choose one nearby creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target gains one Contagion Token.
Successful Save: The target cannot gain Contagion Tokens from this talent until the start of its next turn.
You choose whether this talent can affect your allies.
This talent does not spread infection outside combat unless a ritual, downtime project, or GM scene allows it.
tianxia.talent.disease.symptom_cascade:
#### Symptom Cascade
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom]
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose two symptoms. The symptoms last for the duration. At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending both symptoms on itself on a success.
Successful Save: Choose one symptom. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
Symptoms:
Fever: Take 2d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each turn.
Tremors: Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Weakness: Disadvantage on Strength saving throws.
Coughing: Cannot take Reactions.
Fatigue: Speed reduced by 20 feet.
Rot: Healing received reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Confusion: Disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.
Pain: Disadvantage on concentration saving throws.
Parasite: Gain one Contagion Token at the start of each turn.
tianxia.talent.disease.thousand_symptom_:
#### Thousand-Symptom Plague
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom]
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You release a perfected outbreak of many symptoms at once.
Creatures of your choice inside the area make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: A creature takes 10d10 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and suffers two symptoms until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and suffers one symptom until the start of your next turn.
Symptoms:
Cannot take Reactions.
Speed becomes 0.
Healing received is halved.
Disadvantage on attack rolls.
Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws.
Gain two Contagion Tokens.
Become Poisoned.
Become Frightened.
tianxia.talent.disease.weakening_sicknes:
#### Weakening Sickness
Tags: [Seed], [Symptom]
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one symptom from the list below. The symptom lasts for the duration. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the symptom on itself on a success.
Successful Save: Choose one symptom. It lasts until the start of your next turn.
Symptoms:
Disadvantage on Strength saving throws.
Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.
Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws.
Speed reduced by 20 feet.
Healing received reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Cannot take Reactions.
Disadvantage on concentration saving throws.
Gain one Contagion Token at the start of each turn.
tianxia.talent.disease.world_of_pestilen:
#### World of Pestilence
Tags: [Veil], [Seed], [Purge]
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You create a battlefield-scale epidemic zone.
Allies you choose inside the area gain:
Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage;
Advantage on saving throws against Disease;
immunity to your Contagion Tokens;
immunity to your Disease terrain effects.
Enemies inside the area suffer the following effects:
they cannot regain more than half the normal Hit Points from healing;
they have Disadvantage on concentration saving throws;
they gain one Contagion Token when they enter for the first time on a turn;
when they enter for the first time on a turn or start their turn inside, they make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 8d8 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Sickened.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.dreams.dream_beast:
#### Dream Beast - Unique Dreams Talent
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Create one dream creature shaped from a chosen symbolic theme.
##### Dream Beast
The beast acts immediately after your turn.
As a Bonus Action, command it to:
Attack;
Dash;
Disengage;
Dodge;
Help;
Search. Without a command, it Dodges.
##### Nightmare Claw
Attack: Your Cultivation Attack Modifier
Damage: 2d8 + Path key ability modifier Psychic damage
On a hit, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.dreams.thousand_night_rep:
#### Thousand-Night Repose - Lucid Rite
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Target: Up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures
Duration: One long rest
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Guide the targets through a profound restorative sleep.
After completing the long rest, each target may choose two:
end one ordinary mental-stress effect;
end one ordinary nightmare;
repeat one saving throw against Charmed or Frightened;
gain Temporary HP equal to 3 x Proficiency Bonus;
reduce one level of ordinary exhaustion caused by lack of sleep, travel, or mental strain;
gain Advantage on its first Wisdom saving throw before its next long rest. Thousand-Night Repose does not remove curses, permanent injuries, Realm-level exhaustion, or Secret effects.
tianxia.talent.drunken_style.falling_upw:
### Falling Upward Scripture - Chaos-Step
Prerequisite: CL 15+
You may treat any fall as a Drunken Style movement opportunity.
When you fall at least 10 feet and are not Incapacitated, you may use your Reaction to move up to half your Speed horizontally or upward along a nearby surface, creature, object, branch, wall, banner, weapon, spiritual thread, or comparable support.
If this movement ends on a legal surface, reduce the fall distance by the distance moved. If the fall damage is reduced to 0, you may immediately use Reeling Step without spending a Bonus Action.
This talent does not create a surface where none exists and does not let you hover without Sovereign Chaos-Step Incarnation or another feature.
tianxia.talent.drunken_style.the_step_he:
### The Step Heaven Could Not Predict
Secret Drunken Style Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sovereign Chaos-Step Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden chaos-step scripture, impossible survival, or recognition by a master of broken rhythm
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: action, reaction
Timing Detail: Reaction or Action
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=REACTION_WRONG_BEAT->reaction, ACTION_OFF_RHYTHM_FIELD->action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
For one breath, the battlefield’s prediction fails.
Use this inheritance in one of two ways.
#### As a Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within range makes an attack roll, activates a technique that targets one or more creatures, begins a movement technique, or forces a saving throw.
Choose one:
Wrong
Target: The attack or single-target technique targets a different legal creature within range of the original effect.
Wrong Place: Move yourself and up to a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus up to 30 feet each to legal spaces you can perceive. If this makes the original effect illegal, it fails against those creatures.
Wrong Beat: The triggering creature becomes Off-Rhythm from you, loses its Reaction, and has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll or grants Advantage on the triggering saving throw.
Wrong Certainty: If the triggering effect would hit you or make you fail a saving throw, turn that hit into a miss or that failed save into a success.
#### As an Action
Choose up to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus within range. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Off-Rhythm from you for 1 minute. While Off-Rhythm this way, it suffers all of the following:
it cannot take Opportunity Attacks;
it cannot benefit from Advantage on attack rolls against you;
the first time each round it misses an attack roll, falls Prone or moves 15 feet in a legal direction you choose;
when it activates a technique that targets you, you may move 15 feet before the technique resolves.
A target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The target becomes Off-Rhythm from you until the end of your next turn and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This inheritance cannot automatically override artifacts, Secret Inheritances, divine mandates, Lair actions, Legendary actions, fate-sealed attacks, or campaign-scale calamities. Against such effects, it may grant an opposed Cultivation Check, create a partial escape, redirect a lesser portion of the effect, or become the seed of a Forged Technique or larger cultivation project.
tianxia.talent.equipment.ancestral_battl:
### Ancestral Battle Dress
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Spirit Awakening path or GM permission
Tags: Armor, Fitted
Choose one named suit of armor, armored robe, helmet, or battle dress. It becomes your Ancestral Battle Dress.
While wearing it as your Fitted Armor, once per long rest when you fail a saving throw, you may reroll the save. You must use the new result.

### Ancestral Battle Dress Scripture
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Ancestral Battle Dress; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Secret
Your named armor remembers its line of wearers.
When you use Ancestral Battle Dress to reroll a failed saving throw, you also gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Equipment key ability modifier, minimum 1.
These Temporary Hit Points appear after the reroll is resolved.
tianxia.talent.equipment.armor_answers_t:
### Armor Answers the Soul
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Instant Harness or Ancestral Battle Dress
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Mobility
As an Action, you may call your Fitted Armor from within 60 feet and don it.
The armor must be unattended, not locked away, not worn by another creature, and able to reach you along an open path. It cannot pass through total cover, sealed containers, dimensional barriers, antimagic restrictions, or effects that stop item movement.
This talent does not let the armor attack, scout, carry objects, act independently, or become a companion.
tianxia.talent.equipment.armor_ease:
### Armor Ease
Tags: Armor, Mobility
Choose light, medium, or heavy armor. You must be proficient with the chosen category.
While wearing armor of that category, you ignore Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks imposed by that armor.
You may take this talent more than once, choosing a different armor category each time.
tianxia.talent.equipment.armor_training:
### Armor Training
Tags: Armor
You gain proficiency with light armor. If you already have light armor proficiency, you instead gain medium armor proficiency. If you already have light and medium armor proficiency, you instead gain heavy armor proficiency.
You may take this talent more than once.
tianxia.talent.equipment.beast_hide_harn:
### Beast-Hide Harness Scripture
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Padded Layers; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Armor, Guard, Secret
Your padding, hide, and underlayers are trained to catch tearing impacts before they reach the flesh.
While wearing leather, hide, scale, lamellar, padded, or robe-style armor you are proficient with, your Padded Layers talent may trigger when you take slashing damage instead of bludgeoning damage.
You still use Padded Layers only once per round. This does not change the fall or collision benefit from Padded Layers.
tianxia.talent.equipment.black_armor_leg:
### Black Armor Legion Scripture
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Armor Training; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard, Secret
Your armor is trained for disciplined battle lines, guard rotations, and holding under pressure.
When you roll initiative while wearing your Fitted Armor and you are not surprised, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Equipment key ability modifier, minimum 1.
These Temporary Hit Points follow normal Temporary Hit Point rules.
tianxia.talent.equipment.breath_aligned_:
### Breath-Aligned Armor
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Armor Training
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Mobility
While wearing your Fitted Armor, you may stand from prone by spending only 5 feet of movement.
In addition, your Fitted Armor does not impose Disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
tianxia.talent.equipment.brigandine_robe:
### Brigandine Robe Scripture
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Hidden Plates
Tags: Armor, Concealed, Guard
While your armor is concealed by Hidden Plates, you may use your Reaction when you are hit by an attack.
Increase your AC against that attack by your Proficiency Bonus. If this causes the attack to miss, your armor is revealed to the attacker.
Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.
tianxia.talent.equipment.circuit_armor:
### Circuit Armor
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Qi-Conductive Lacing
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
As a Bonus Action while wearing your Fitted Armor, spend 2 CP to awaken its circuit for 1 minute.
While the circuit is active, once per round when you take damage, reduce the damage by your Equipment key ability modifier, minimum 1.
The circuit ends early if you remove the armor, become Incapacitated, or the armor is destroyed.
tianxia.talent.equipment.field_maintenan:
### Field Maintenance
Tags: Armor
You know how to keep armor usable without turning this sphere into a crafting system.
You have Advantage on checks made to clean, oil, relace, patch, seal, dry, or safely remove armor you are proficient with.
This talent does not create armor, improve armor, restore object hit points, or replace the Blacksmith sphere.
tianxia.talent.equipment.helmet_discipli:
### Helmet Discipline
Tags: Armor, Guard
While wearing a helmet, mask, armored hood, or equivalent head protection with armor you are proficient with, you may turn one critical hit against you into a normal hit.
You must use this feature before damage is rolled. Once you use it, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.
tianxia.talent.equipment.hidden_brigandi:
### Hidden Brigandine Assassin-Robe
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Hidden Plates; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Armor, Concealed, Mobility, Secret
Your hidden armor is cut for sudden violence, escape steps, and court ambushes.
When Brigandine Robe Scripture causes an attack to miss, you may move up to 10 feet as part of the same Reaction. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from the creature that made the triggering attack.
This talent does not make heavy armor easier to conceal unless Hidden Plates already allows that armor to be concealed.
tianxia.talent.equipment.hidden_plates:
### Hidden Plates
Tags: Armor, Concealed
While wearing light or medium armor you are proficient with, you may disguise it as ordinary clothing, travel robes, sect dress, court dress, or work garments.
A creature that searches you must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Equipment Save DC to notice the armor. A physical search made by touch has Advantage on this check.
This talent does not hide heavy armor unless a separate item, talent, armor profile, or explicit GM approval says that specific heavy armor can be concealed.
tianxia.talent.equipment.instant_harness:
### Instant Harness
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Quick Harness
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Mobility
As an Action, you may don or doff your Fitted Armor if it is within your reach, unrestrained, and not locked, sealed, worn by another creature, or trapped.
This talent moves straps, buckles, robes, plates, cords, and helmets into place. It does not teleport armor or call it from a distance.
tianxia.talent.equipment.iron_rain_readi:
### Iron Rain Readiness
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
When you are hit by a ranged attack, or when you fail a Dexterity saving throw against an area effect, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP.
Roll 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. Reduce the triggering damage by the result.
tianxia.talent.equipment.lamellar_flow:
### Lamellar Flow
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage while wearing your Fitted Armor, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to reduce the damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
At Core Formation Realm, this reduction becomes 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
At Nascent Soul Realm, this reduction becomes 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.equipment.mingguang_brigh:
### Mingguang Bright Armor Scripture
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Mirror-Bright Armor; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard, Secret
Your mirror-bright plates do not merely shine; they announce that the battlefield has a center.
When a creature fails its saving throw against Mirror-Bright Armor, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the creature succeeds on the saving throw, you gain no Temporary Hit Points.
tianxia.talent.equipment.mirror_bright_a:
### Mirror-Bright Armor
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
As a Bonus Action while wearing your Fitted Armor, spend 1 CP and choose one creature within 30 feet that can see you.
The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Equipment Save DC. On a failed save, the target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against a creature other than you before the start of your next turn.
This is a visual challenge, not mind control. A creature that cannot see your armor is unaffected.
tianxia.talent.equipment.mountain_patter:
### Mountain-Pattern Grand Shell
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Mountain-Pattern Shell; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard, Secret
Your interlocking plates settle into a stronger pattern after the first blow.
Once per round while wearing medium or heavy Fitted Armor, when you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
This reduction is passive and does not cost a Reaction. If another passive Equipment feature would also reduce the same damage, choose one passive Equipment reduction to apply. This talent does not apply while you are Incapacitated.

### Mountain-Pattern Shell
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
While wearing medium or heavy Fitted Armor, you gain a +1 bonus to AC.
You lose this bonus while Incapacitated or while using another Equipment talent that grants a persistent bonus to AC.
tianxia.talent.equipment.padded_layers:
### Padded Layers
Tags: Armor, Guard
While wearing armor you are proficient with, once per round when you take bludgeoning damage, you may reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
If the damage comes from falling or collision with an object or surface, reduce the damage by twice your Proficiency Bonus instead.
tianxia.talent.equipment.qi_conductive_l:
### Qi-Conductive Lacing
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Integration
Your Fitted Armor can carry a simple qi circuit without becoming a magic item.
Once per turn, when you spend CP on an Equipment talent while wearing your Fitted Armor, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.equipment.quick_harness:
### Quick Harness
Tags: Armor, Mobility
You don or doff armor you are proficient with in half the normal time.
If the armor is your Fitted Armor, you may instead don or doff it in one quarter of the normal time.
tianxia.talent.equipment.reinforced_robe:
### Reinforced Robes
Tags: Armor
While you are wearing no armor and not using a shield, your AC equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Equipment key ability modifier.
This is an armor discipline expressed through robes, wraps, bracers, belts, boots, and guarded movement. It does not improve unarmed strikes or weapon attacks.
tianxia.talent.equipment.shield_training:
### Shield Training
Tags: Armor
You gain shield proficiency.
This does not grant Shield sphere talents, shield active defense, shield attacks, or shield deflection techniques.
tianxia.talent.equipment.sleep_in_armor:
### Sleep in Armor
Tags: Armor, Mobility
You can complete a long rest while wearing light or medium armor you are proficient with.
If you are proficient with heavy armor, you can also complete a long rest while wearing heavy armor, but you must spend 10 minutes after waking to stretch, relace, and settle the suit before it counts as your Fitted Armor again.
tianxia.talent.equipment.soul_sealed_arm:
### Soul-Sealed Armor
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
While wearing your Fitted Armor, it cannot be removed from you against your will unless you are Incapacitated, dead, or the effect specifically removes worn equipment.
Once per long rest, when damage would reduce you to 0 HP but not kill you outright, you may instead drop to 1 HP. Your Fitted Armor becomes cracked, dimmed, spiritually strained, or visibly damaged until you finish a long rest.
tianxia.talent.equipment.sure_harness:
### Sure Harness
Tags: Armor, Mobility
While wearing armor you are proficient with, you ignore any Speed reduction caused by failing to meet that armor's Strength requirement.
tianxia.talent.equipment.underplate_chan:
### Underplate Channels
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm; Talismans sphere, Formations sphere, or GM permission
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Integration
Your Fitted Armor has safe channels for one legal talisman, formation marker, scripture strip, seal case, or similar small item.
You may secure or remove that item during a short or long rest. While secured, the item counts as worn and does not require a free hand merely to carry it.
This talent does not create the item, activate it for free, reduce its cost, grant extra charges, or make an illegal item legal.
tianxia.talent.equipment.walking_fortres:
### Walking Fortress Scripture
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Circuit Armor or Mountain-Pattern Shell
Tags: Armor, Fitted, Guard
As a Bonus Action while wearing your Fitted Armor, spend 4 CP to enter Walking Fortress stance for 1 minute.
While in this stance, your Speed is reduced by 10 feet and you have Resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
The stance ends early if you remove the armor, become Incapacitated, or choose to end it.
tianxia.talent.fire.banked_ember:
#### Banked Ember - Unique Fire Talent
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 1 CP
Place a dormant ember into one object, weapon, torch, campfire, brazier, or willing creature.
As a Bonus Action while within 60 feet, cause the ember to flare.
Choose one:
ignite an unattended flammable object;
cause the bearer’s next attack before the end of its turn to deal extra Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
create Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for another 20 feet for 1 minute;
apply Burn to one creature touching the ember-bearing object.
You may maintain a number of Banked Embers equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.fire.blazing_armor:
#### Blazing Armor - Unique Fire Talent
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Wrap yourself or one willing creature within touch in defensive flame.
For the duration:

tianxia.talent.formations.harmonized_pul:

tianxia.talent.formations.heaven_and_ear:
#### HEAVEN AND EARTH BECOME THE DIAGRAM
Secret Formation Inheritance
Prerequisites: Sovereign of the World-Diagram, Heavenly Grand Formation, CL 17+, lost scripture, celestial revelation, sect-defining inheritance, or world-array transmission
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or 1 minute if used as a prepared ritual
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=ONE_MINUTE_PREPARED_RITUAL
Range: Self
Area: 300-foot-radius sphere centered on you, or one prepared site up to a comparable scale
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 20 CP
Use Limit: Once per week. If used to overwrite a major existing Grand Formation, once per month.
You unfold the World-Array Scripture. For a short time, the surrounding world is treated as if it had always been built from your Nodes, Gates, and Flow Lines.
Choose five World Laws from the list below. The area becomes a World Array with those laws.
Law of the Eye: You always know the location of creatures inside the area unless hidden by a Secret technique or stronger effect. You do not learn their thoughts, statistics, or secrets.
Law of the Gate: Keyed allies may teleport up to 60 feet inside the area as a Bonus Action. Hostile creatures attempting to teleport inside, out of, or through the area must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or the teleport fails.
Law of the Locked Road: Hostile creatures treat the entire area as Difficult Terrain. Once per round when a hostile creature moves more than 10 feet, you may force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, its movement ends.
Law of the Hidden Road: Keyed allies have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and may Hide while Lightly Obscured inside the area. Hostile creatures have Disadvantage on checks made to find your Nodes, Eyes, hidden Gates, or concealed keyed allies.
Law of the Killing Line: Once during each of your turns, choose a line up to 120 feet long inside the area. Hostile creatures on that line make Dexterity saving throws. A creature takes 8d8 Force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
Law of the Returning Breath: Once per round when a keyed ally inside the area is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, it instead drops to 1 Hit Point and is moved up to 30 feet to a legal space inside the area. A creature can benefit from this law only once per use of the inheritance.
Law of the Suppressed Current: The first time each round a hostile creature spends CP inside the area, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the CP is spent and the effect fails. On a success, the effect works, but the creature cannot benefit from this law again until the start of its next turn.
Law of the Shattered Formation: Choose one non-Secret Formation, Barrier, Domain, or prepared magical battlefield effect inside the area. Make a Formation Check against its creator’s save DC. On a success, suppress it while this inheritance lasts. On a failure, suppress one of its minor benefits until the end of your next turn.
Law of the Nine Palaces: Divide the area into up to nine visible or invisible palaces. Once per turn, when a hostile creature crosses from one palace into another, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, choose whether it becomes lost, slowed, or exposed until the start of your next turn. A lost creature cannot willingly move closer to a chosen objective. A slowed creature’s Speed is halved. An exposed creature cannot benefit from Invisible or Half Cover.
Law of the World Anchor: Create nine Anchors. Each Anchor has AC 19, Hit Points equal to 15 × your Proficiency Bonus, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The World Array does not require Concentration while at least five Anchors remain. If fewer than five remain, you must Concentrate to maintain it. If fewer than three remain, it collapses.
While this inheritance lasts, you may Pulse one Pattern Layer or World Law once during each of your turns without using an action.
Limits: This inheritance does not permanently create territory, erase a kingdom, make you omnipotent, automatically kill creatures, rewrite the past, or suppress a stronger Secret Inheritance without a contested scene. It does, however, allow a Formation master to fight like a sect defending its ancestral mountain.

tianxia.talent.formations.layered_patter:
#### LAYERED PATTERN - PATTERN
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you set an array, you may add a second Pattern Layer you know.
Increase the CP cost by 2.
When you Pulse the array, choose one Pattern Layer to Pulse. You do not Pulse both unless another feature says so.
tianxia.talent.formations.line_array:
#### LINE ARRAY - NODE
When you set an array, you may shape it as a line instead of a circle.
A Combat Line Array is up to 30 feet long and 5 feet wide.
A Prepared Line Array is up to 60 feet long and 10 feet wide.
The Array Eye must be at one end, at the center, or in a visible anchor point along the line. Flow Line effects treat the entire line as one continuous route.
tianxia.talent.formations.linked_formati:
#### LINKED FORMATION NETWORK - PREPARED
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You may link two Prepared Arrays you control within 1 mile if both have stable Eyes and at least three intact Nodes.
A keyed creature standing inside one linked array may use an Action and spend 1 CP, or cause the array to spend 1 stored charge if it has one, to teleport to an unoccupied space inside the other linked array.
After a linked teleport is used, you must spend 3 CP before the end of your next turn or both arrays become dormant for 1 minute.
At CL 15, the maximum distance increases to 10 miles if both arrays are built on spiritual veins, sect territory, or long-prepared sites.
tianxia.talent.formations.mountain_seali:
#### MOUNTAIN-SEALING GREAT ARRAY - GATE
Prerequisite: Sealing Gate Pattern, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius circle
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 9 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Create a heavy sealing array with four visible Anchors.
Inside the array:
teleportation and planar travel fail unless the creature succeeds on a Charisma saving throw;
hostile creatures cannot willingly leave by ordinary movement unless they succeed on a Strength or Charisma saving throw, their choice;
ongoing non-Secret movement-enhancing effects are suppressed while their source remains inside;
summoning into or out of the array fails unless the summoner succeeds on a Formation Check against your Formation Save DC.
Destroying two Anchors collapses the array.
You are also affected by the sealing rules unless you are keyed to the array.
tianxia.talent.formations.nine_palaces_k:
#### NINE PALACES KILLING ARRAY - PATTERN
Prerequisite: Killing Line Pattern, CL 15+
When you create an array with the Killing Line Pattern, you may designate up to nine Nodes as killing palaces.
When you Pulse the Killing Line Pattern, choose up to three hostile creatures inside the array. Make one Formation Attack roll and compare it to each target’s AC.
Hit: A target takes 4d8 + your Formation key ability modifier damage.
If at least two targets are hit, one Flow Line between two Nodes becomes a killing line until the start of your next turn. A hostile creature that crosses that line takes damage equal to your CL.
tianxia.talent.formations.rapid_array:
#### RAPID ARRAY - NODE
When setting a Prepared Array, reduce the setup time from 10 minutes to 1 minute.
When setting a Combat Array, you may place its Eye in any unoccupied space within range rather than only at the center of the array. The array’s area remains centered on the Eye unless another talent changes its shape.
tianxia.talent.formations.reflecting_gat:
#### REFLECTING GATE - GATE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature outside one of your arrays targets a creature inside that array with a ranged attack or single-target supernatural effect that crosses the boundary
Cost: 2 CP
Make a Formation Check against the attacker’s attack roll or Cultivation Save DC, whichever is appropriate.
Success: Choose one:
the effect misses the protected target;
the attack or effect is redirected to another legal target inside or adjacent to the array;
the attack or effect rebounds toward the attacker if the attacker is a legal target.
This cannot redirect area effects, Secret Inheritances, Legendary Actions, Lair Actions, environmental disasters, or effects that originate inside the array.
tianxia.talent.formations.reinforced_nod:
#### REINFORCED NODES - NODE
Increase the Hit Points of your Nodes and Eyes by your CL.
When a Node or Eye you control within 120 feet would be destroyed, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to leave it at 1 Hit Point instead.
tianxia.talent.formations.sealing_gate_p:
#### SEALING GATE PATTERN - PATTERN
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You learn the Sealing Gate Pattern.
Passive: Teleportation into, out of, or through the array requires the teleporting creature to succeed on a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the teleport fails and any action, CP, or resource spent is wasted.
Pulse: Choose one hostile creature inside the array. It makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the creature cannot teleport, plane shift, enter the Ethereal Plane, possess another creature, or leave its body by spiritual projection.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on the next check or saving throw it makes to teleport, possess, or spiritually travel.
tianxia.talent.formations.self_sustainin:
#### SELF-SUSTAINING CIRCUIT - PREPARED
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you complete a Prepared Array, you may spend 2 additional CP to make it self-sustaining.
A self-sustaining array lasts 24 hours and does not require your attention to Pulse. When you create it, choose one of its Pattern Pulses and one trigger condition. The array automatically Pulses when that trigger occurs, no more than once per round.
A self-sustaining array cannot move, cannot change keyed creatures after completion unless you physically access its Eye, and cannot be dismissed from a distance unless you know a talent that allows it.
tianxia.talent.formations.shifting_gates:
#### SHIFTING GATES - GATE
Prerequisite: CL 5+
As a Bonus Action, choose one array you control within 120 feet. Until the start of your next turn, keyed creatures may enter or leave the array without spending extra movement, while hostile creatures crossing the boundary must make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature’s movement ends at the boundary.
Successful Save: It crosses normally, but its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.formations.sovereign_puls:
#### SOVEREIGN PULSE - PULSE
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you Pulse an array, you may spend 2 CP to Pulse two different Pattern Layers in that array.
A creature affected by both Pulses makes separate saving throws as normal. If both Pulses would impose movement penalties, use the stronger penalty rather than stacking them unless a feature says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.formations.spirit_lock_ar:
#### SPIRIT-LOCK ARRAY - PATTERN
Prerequisite: Sealing Gate Pattern, CL 10+
A creature that fails a saving throw against your Sealing Gate Pattern Pulse also cannot be willingly summoned, dismissed, banished, possessed, magically transported, or moved by a teleportation effect until the start of your next turn.
If the creature is possessing another body, projecting its spirit, or maintaining a remote spiritual avatar, it must make a second Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The possession, projection, or avatar is suppressed until the end of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.formations.turn_the_battl:
#### TURN THE BATTLEFIELD INSIDE OUT - GATE
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: One Formation Array you control
Cost: 7 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose any number of keyed allies inside the array and up to the same number of hostile creatures inside it. Each hostile creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
For each failed save, you may exchange that hostile creature’s position with one chosen keyed ally, provided both spaces are legal.
A creature that succeeds is not moved, but it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This is teleportation and fails against effects that block teleportation.
tianxia.talent.gravity.anchor_breaking_p:
#### Anchor-Breaking Palm
Tag: Weight Art.
When you hit a creature with Heavying Blow, you may choose to disrupt its footing rather than knock it Prone.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot benefit from features that prevent forced movement, reduce forced movement, or count it as larger for resisting forced movement, unless those features are Secret, Domain-level, or stronger than your current Realm.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.gravity.black_star_grip:
#### Black-Star Grip
Tag: Field Art, Anchor Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 6 CP or Stamina.
Choose one creature you can see. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Grappled by gravitational pressure. The escape DC is your Cultivation Save DC. While Grappled this way, the target takes Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of each of its turns and cannot move farther from you.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
This Grapple does not require a free hand and is not ended by moving away unless the target escapes or the effect ends.
tianxia.talent.gravity.event_horizon_pri:
#### Event Horizon Prison
Tag: Field Art, Anchor Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet.
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 12 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
Create a dense gravitational boundary. A creature attempting to leave the area must make a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its movement ends at the boundary.
Successful Save: It crosses normally.
When a creature starts its turn inside the prison, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 6d10 Force damage.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage.
Teleportation out of the prison requires a successful opposed Cultivation Check against you. If the teleportation fails, the action and resource are spent but the creature remains inside.
tianxia.talent.gravity.falling_line:
#### Falling Line
Tag: Field Art, Fall Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: 1 CP or Stamina.
Choose a 30-foot line you can see. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 1d8 Force damage and is pulled 10 feet along the line toward the direction you choose.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not pulled.
Damage increases to 2d8 at CL 5, 3d8 at CL 11, and 4d8 at CL 17.
tianxia.talent.gravity.falling_star_cala:
#### Falling Star Calamity
Tag: Field Art, Fall Art.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Ritual
Time: 1 minute.
Range: 1 mile.
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere.
Cost: 15 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per week.
Call down a meteor, compressed stone, celestial fragment, or formed mass of falling gravitic pressure. Creatures in the area make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: The creature takes 16d10 Bludgeoning damage plus 16d10 Fire damage.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage.
The impact creates a crater, difficult terrain, smoke, fire, structural collapse, and a detectable spiritual disturbance.
This technique is not subtle. It is a siege art, sect war art, or catastrophe technique, not a normal duel technique.
tianxia.talent.gravity.feather_body:
#### Feather Body
Tag: Weight Art.
Your Body Lightening improves.
Benefits while Body Lightening is active:
Your Speed increase becomes 15 feet.
You ignore the first 30 feet of falling when calculating falling damage.
You may stand from Prone by spending only 5 feet of movement.
You may move across fragile surfaces, loose snow, thin branches, rooftiles, and similar footing without breaking them, if the GM agrees the surface could plausibly support supernatural lightness.
At CL 5, you may run across liquid surfaces during your turn, but you sink if you end your turn unsupported.
tianxia.talent.gravity.gravitic_armor:
#### Gravitic Armor
Tag: Weight Art, Orbit Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 5 CP or Stamina.
Wrap yourself in layered pressure, orbiting dust, and body-centered weight control.
Benefits:
You gain +2 AC.
You gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
You have Advantage against being Grappled, knocked Prone, or moved against your will.
You are immune to ordinary falling damage.
While Gravitic Armor is active, your Weight Shift modes improve:
Body Lightening: Speed increases by an additional 10 feet.
Body Heavying: Weighted Strike damage dice increase by one step, from d6 to d8 or from d8 to d10.
tianxia.talent.gravity.gravitic_pull:
#### Gravitic Pull
Tag: Field Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: 1 CP or Stamina.
Choose one creature no larger than Large. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Pull the target up to 15 feet toward a point you can see.
Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet toward that point.
A willing creature may choose to fail the save.
At CL 5, you may target a Huge creature. At CL 11, you may target a Gargantuan creature, but the pull distance is halved unless the creature is willing or airborne.
tianxia.talent.gravity.gravitic_push:
#### Gravitic Push
Tag: Field Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: 1 CP or Stamina.
Choose one creature no larger than Large. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push the target up to 15 feet away from a point you can see.
Successful Save: Push the target 5 feet.
At CL 5, you may target a Huge creature. At CL 11, you may target a Gargantuan creature, but the push distance is halved unless the creature is willing or airborne.
tianxia.talent.gravity.gravity_domain:
#### Gravity Domain - Sovereign Weight
Tag: Domain Art, Field Art.
“Kneel. The world itself agrees with me.”
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 7 CP or Stamina.
Choose any number of creatures to exclude when you create the Domain.
Inside the Domain:
Hostile creatures treat the area as difficult terrain.
Hostile creatures cannot fly unless they can Hover.
Hostile creatures have Disadvantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
Forced movement caused by your Gravity talents increases by 10 feet.
When a hostile creature starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed becomes 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.gravity.heaven_s_weight:
### Secret Inheritance - Heaven’s Weight
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Gravity Domain, lost scripture, heavenly revelation, or mountain-star inheritance.
“The heavens have always pressed downward. I simply decide where they press hardest.”
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Cost: 15 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per week.
Choose one creature or object no larger than Gargantuan. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Initial Save: For 1 minute, the target suffers Heaven’s Weight.
A creature under Heaven’s Weight:
is Restrained;
cannot fly;
cannot teleport;
cannot be moved voluntarily;
has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws;
takes 4d10 Force damage at the start of each of its turns.
At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Initial Save: Until the start of the target’s next turn, its Speed becomes 0, it cannot fly, and it cannot take Reactions.
Objects and Structures: A structure failing the save begins collapsing under its own weight. The exact result depends on size, construction, and narrative scale.
Secret Limitation: Heaven’s Weight cannot be used casually. Each use creates a visible heavenly pressure mark: cracked clouds, bending starlight, a bell-like pressure in the bones, or a mountain-shadow falling where no mountain exists. Sects, spirits, and rival cultivators may recognize the inheritance.
tianxia.talent.gravity.heavy_weapon_body:
#### Heavy Weapon Body
Tag: Weight Art.
You learn to make a weapon heavy only at the moment of impact.
When you use Weighted Strike with Heavying Blow, you may change the extra damage dice from d6s to d8s if the attack is made with a melee weapon wielded in two hands or with an Unarmed Strike made while both feet are grounded.
If you miss, no extra strain is applied and the resource is not spent.
tianxia.talent.gravity.light_body_flurry:
#### Light-Body Flurry
Tag: Weight Art.
When Body Lightening is active and you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you may use Weighted Strike with Lightening Blow without spending a resource once per short rest.
At CL 5, regain the use of this talent when you roll initiative and have no uses remaining.
tianxia.talent.gravity.light_body_rush:
#### Light Body Rush
Tag: Weight Art.
Prerequisite: Feather Body.
When Body Lightening is active, you may spend 1 CP or Stamina as a Bonus Action to take the Dash or Disengage action.
