If you hit with a melee attack after moving at least 20 feet on the same turn, you may also use Lightening Blow without spending additional resources.
tianxia.talent.gravity.local_down:
#### Local Down
Tag: Field Art, Fall Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet.
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 6 CP or Stamina.
Choose a direction to become down inside the area. Creatures of your choice inside the area make Strength saving throws when the effect appears and whenever they start their turn inside.
Failed Save: The creature falls in the chosen direction until it strikes a surface, exits the area, or falls 60 feet.
Successful Save: The creature holds position but treats the area as difficult terrain until the start of its next turn.
A creature that can fly may use its Fly Speed to resist the fall if it succeeds on the saving throw.
tianxia.talent.gravity.meteoric_descent:
#### Meteoric Descent
Tag: Weight Art, Fall Art.
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: When you descend at least 20 feet onto a point below you during legal movement, falling movement, or a printed gravity/fall effect.
Cost: 5 CP or Stamina.
You leap, fall, or reverse gravity so that you descend at least 20 feet onto a point below you. Creatures within 15 feet of that point make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: The creature takes 6d8 Force damage and falls Prone.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and remains standing.
You take no falling damage from the descent.
For each additional 20 feet descended before impact, add 1d8 Force damage, to a maximum number of additional dice equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.gravity.moon_falling_coun:
#### Moon-Falling Counter
Tag: Weight Art, Fall Art.
Trigger: A creature misses you with a melee attack while Body Lightening is active.
Cost: Reaction and 1 CP or Stamina.
You rise, turn, or drop along an impossible angle. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then make one melee attack against it.
If the attack hits, you may use Lightening Blow without spending additional resources.
tianxia.talent.gravity.moon_weight_incar:
#### Moon-Weight Incarnation
Tag: Weight Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 10 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
You embody alternating moon-lightness and mountain-weight. While this talent is active, you may benefit from both Body Lightening and Body Heavying at the same time.
Benefits:
Your Speed is not reduced by Body Heavying.
Your Speed increases by 20 feet.
You count as two sizes larger for resisting forced movement and being knocked Prone.
You may use Weighted Strike once on each of your turns without spending resources.
Once per round when you use Weighted Strike, you may apply both Heavying Blow and Lightening Blow to the same hit.
You are immune to ordinary falling damage.
tianxia.talent.gravity.mountain_body:
#### Mountain Body
Tag: Weight Art.
Your Body Heavying improves.
Benefits while Body Heavying is active:
Your carrying, dragging, lifting, and pushing capacity becomes four times normal instead of double.
You may add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage of your first successful Grapple-related Slam, Shove, or Unarmed Strike each turn.
You gain Advantage on checks made to hold a door, brace a barrier, resist a charging creature, or remain standing on unstable terrain.
At CL 5, you count as two sizes larger rather than one size larger for resisting forced movement, but not for initiating Grapples or Shoves.
tianxia.talent.gravity.mountain_crushing:
#### Mountain-Crushing Step
Tag: Weight Art.
Prerequisite: Mountain Body.
When Body Heavying is active, you may spend 1 CP or Stamina before moving.
Until the end of your turn:
Your movement ignores ordinary difficult terrain caused by rubble, mud, snow, loose stone, bodies, or uneven ground.
The first creature you hit with a melee attack after moving at least 10 feet must make a Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, it falls Prone or is pushed 10 feet, chosen by you.
tianxia.talent.gravity.orbit_breaking_gu:
#### Orbit-Breaking Guard
Tag: Weight Art, Orbit Art.
Prerequisite: Orbiting Guard.
When Orbiting Guard is active and a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may use your Reaction to curve the failed force around you.
Choose one:
Move the attacker 10 feet to an unoccupied space adjacent to you.
Move yourself 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Cause the attacker to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it falls Prone.
If Gravitic Armor is active, you may use this talent without spending your Reaction once per round.
tianxia.talent.gravity.orbiting_guard:
#### Orbiting Guard
Tag: Weight Art, Orbit Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 1 CP or Stamina.
Create a close field of orbiting pressure, curved dust, small stones, sleeve weights, weapon tassels, or invisible directional pull around yourself.
While active:
You gain +1 AC.
Once per round when a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
At CL 5, the AC bonus becomes +2 while Body Lightening or Body Heavying is active.
tianxia.talent.gravity.shared_weight:
#### Shared Weight
Tag: Weight Art.
When you use Weight Shift, you may spend 1 CP or Stamina to apply the same mode to one willing creature you touch.
At CL 11, you may affect two willing creatures you touch.
A creature can benefit from only one Weight Shift at a time. If multiple Weight Shifts apply, the creature chooses which one remains.
tianxia.talent.gravity.singularity_seed:
#### Singularity Seed
Tag: Field Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet.
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Until the start of your next turn.
Cost: 6 CP or Stamina.
Create a brief point of extreme gravity. Creatures of your choice inside make Strength saving throws.
Failed Save: The creature is pulled to the center, takes 6d6 Force damage, and is Restrained until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature is pulled 10 feet toward the center and takes half damage.
Objects and unsecured terrain may also be pulled inward.
tianxia.talent.gravity.ten_thousand_weig:
#### Ten-Thousand-Weight Body
Tag: Weight Art.
Prerequisite: Mountain Body.
When Body Heavying is active, you may spend 5 CP or Stamina at the start of your turn to make your body impossibly dense until the start of your next turn.
Until then:
You cannot be moved against your will by effects of Core Formation or lower unless they are Secret or Domain techniques.
Creatures that hit you with melee attacks take Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Your melee attacks against objects and structures deal double damage.
Your Heavying Blow knocks a target Prone on a failed save and pushes or pulls it 10 feet, rather than choosing only one.
After the effect ends, your Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.gravity.weight_borrowing_:
#### Weight-Borrowing Throw
Tag: Weight Art.
When you successfully Shove or Grapple a creature while Body Heavying is active, you may spend 1 CP or Stamina to move the target 5 feet in any horizontal direction or knock it Prone.
If the target is already Grappled by you, increase the movement to 10 feet.
This movement is forced movement and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
tianxia.talent.gravity.world_crushing_pr:
#### World-Crushing Pressure
Tag: Field Art, Domain Art.
“A mountain is merely a stone that has remembered how heavy it is.”
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 12 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
Choose creatures to exclude. When another creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 8d8 Force damage, falls Prone, and is Restrained until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and has its Speed halved until the start of its next turn.
Structures and unattended objects inside the area take double damage from Gravity talents and from falling, collapse, or crushing hazards.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.guardian.assist_the_line:
### Assist the Line — Zone Talent
Allies inside your Patrol Zone gain:
+1 AC
A creature benefits from only one Assist the Line effect at a time.
tianxia.talent.guardian.clear_path:
### Clear Path — Zone Talent
Allies other than you do not provoke opportunity attacks from hostile creatures for moving through your Patrol Zone.
Clear Path does not protect movement outside the zone.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.batt:
### Battlefield Recovery Method - Cut, Route
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
After a battle involving magical beasts, cultivators, constructs, alchemical residue, weather phenomena, formations, or supernatural terrain, spend 10 minutes recovering useful materials.
Make a Gathering Check.
On success, recover one appropriate Common, Uncommon, or Rare Lot if the scene reasonably contains one.
On success by 5 or more, recover a Pure Lot or one additional lower-grade Lot.
You cannot harvest a living cultivator’s cultivation base with this talent, and remains of sapient beings may carry legal, moral, sect, or karmic consequences.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.beas:
### Beast-Core Dressing - Cut
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Simple Beast Dressing.
You may harvest a low-grade beast core, monster gall, spirit bone, blood crystal, venom pearl, or comparable concentrated organ from an eligible slain magical beast.
The creature must have such a material in the story. This talent does not create cores in creatures that lack them.
Make a Gathering Check. The DC is usually 15 for Uncommon materials, 18 for Rare materials, or higher for elite beasts.
On success, recover the material as a Harvest Lot or specific quest ingredient.
On failure by more than 5, the core cracks, vents, dissolves, or loses part of its value.
On a Natural 1, the core releases a backlash appropriate to the beast.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.bitt:
### Bitter-Spore Caution - Hazard
You have Advantage on saving throws against poison, disease, spores, bad air, irritating pollen, mundane parasites, and similar hazards triggered by harvesting.
When a Natural 1 on Clean Harvest would trigger a poison or spore hazard, you may spend 1 CP or 1 Stamina to reduce the hazard’s damage by your Proficiency Bonus + Gathering key ability modifier.
Mortal non-cultivators without CP may use this reduction once per Long Rest.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.camp:
### Camp Gatherer - Route
During a Long Rest in the wilderness, you may gather ordinary food, fuel, water, and simple medicinal plants for a number of creatures equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus + your Gathering key ability modifier, minimum 2.
If the terrain is barren, cursed, hostile, urban, or magically depleted, the GM may require a Gathering Check or declare the area unsuitable.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.clea:
### Clean Sickle Method - Cut
When you make a Clean Harvest check with proper tools, add +2 to the roll.
If you harvest a plant, fungus, resin, fruit, bark, or root and succeed by 5 or more, the source survives unless the material can only be harvested destructively.
This bonus does not stack with another item or talent bonus to the same check. Use the higher bonus.

### Cleansing at the Source - Cut, Seal
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
When you harvest a Lot that would be Bruised, poisoned, diseased, spiritually muddy, blood-tainted, curse-touched, or contaminated, spend 3 CP and make a Gathering Check.
On success, remove one contamination or treat the Lot as Normal quality.
On success by 5 or more, treat it as Pure quality.
On failure, the Lot remains contaminated.
This is not a replacement for Alchemy purification recipes, but it can make a material safe enough to bring home.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.comm:
### Common Herbcraft - Sign, Cut
You have Advantage on Gathering Checks to identify and harvest Common medicinal herbs, edible plants, fungi, roots, berries, and ordinary field materials.
When you succeed on Clean Harvest for a Common plant or fungus by 5 or more, you may create one additional Common Lot if the source contains enough material.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.comp:
### Companion Gatherers - Route, Steward
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can train mundane assistants, outer disciples, family workers, or hirelings to support safe gathering.
During downtime, a team under your supervision may gather mundane and Common materials without your direct presence.
The GM sets output by region, safety, skill, and investment.
Assistants cannot harvest Uncommon or higher spiritual materials without your direct oversight unless they have their own relevant training.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.dew_:
### Dew Jar Method - Seal
You learn how to collect dew, sap, resin, honey, rainwater, mineral seep, brine, and other delicate liquids without wasting their essence.
You may Clean Harvest liquids and delicate residues that ordinary harvesters would lose.
When you seal a liquid Lot, it remains stable for twice the normal duration.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.dryi:
### Drying Shed Method - Seal, Route
You can seal ordinary herbs, grains, mushrooms, flowers, roots, resins, meats, and hides without special equipment.
During a Short Rest, you may preserve up to twice your normal number of Common or mundane Lots.
During downtime, a storehouse, shed, drying rack, smokehouse, cellar, or clean room under your supervision spoils more slowly.
This talent does not preserve Rare or higher spiritual materials without proper containers.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.farm:
### Farmer’s Eye - Sign, Steward
You can judge ordinary crops, herbs, seed grain, soil moisture, rot, pests, mold, and harvest timing at a glance.
After 10 minutes inspecting a mundane field, garden, orchard, storehouse, or herb bed, make a Gathering Check.
DC 10: Learn whether the crop is healthy, threatened, ready, immature, or overripe.
DC 15: Identify one practical mundane intervention such as drying, pruning, sorting, pest removal, drainage, shade, harvest timing, or storage adjustment.
During downtime, if you supervise an ordinary farm or herb bed for at least 7 days during a season, reduce mundane spoilage, waste, or storage loss by a meaningful amount set by the GM.
This does not make plants grow faster and does not create spiritual herbs.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.fiel:
### Field Ledger - Sign, Route
You keep careful records of sites, seasons, buyers, tools, debts, taboos, harvest dates, and local names.
After you successfully Read the Sign for a Resource Site, you may record it in your Field Ledger.
When you return to a recorded site, gain Advantage on the first Read the Sign or Clean Harvest check you make there, provided the site has not dramatically changed.
You may maintain a number of active recorded sites equal to 3 + your Proficiency Bonus + Gathering key ability modifier.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.firs:
### First-Aid Poultice - Seal, Hazard
During a Short Rest, spend one Common medicinal Lot to prepare poultices for up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures.
A treated creature gains Advantage on the first saving throw it makes against poison, disease, or Exhaustion from travel before its next Long Rest.
A creature can benefit from your First-Aid Poultice once per Long Rest.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.fora:
### Forager’s Quiet Step - Approach
You gain proficiency in Stealth or Survival.
If already proficient, gain a flat +2 bonus to that skill.
When approaching a Resource Site guarded by ordinary animals, insects, or natural hazards, you may make a Gathering Check instead of Dexterity (Stealth) to avoid disturbing the site.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.form:
### Formation-Ward Harvest - Approach, Hazard
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You can harvest materials from sites protected by minor wards, garden arrays, spirit fences, preservation seals, or warning talismans without immediately ruining the source.
Make a Gathering Check against the ward’s DC.
On success, identify the safe harvesting boundary, required offering, keyed tool, seasonal timing, or forbidden contact.
On success by 5 or more, the first Clean Harvest check made at the site gains Advantage.
This talent does not disable enemy Formations by itself. It tells you how not to break the garden while gathering.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.haza:
### Hazardous Harvest - Hazard, Approach
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You may spend 1 CP or 1 Stamina to gain Resistance to one damage type or hazard associated with a Resource Site until the end of the current harvest attempt.
Examples include Poison from spores, Fire from flame fruit, Cold from frost lotus, Acid from corrosive slime, Lightning from thunderwood, or Necrotic from grave moss.
This protection applies only to the harvesting scene, not to unrelated combat unless the GM rules the hazard is inseparable from the fight.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.heav:
### Heaven-Sealed Vault - Seal, Route
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Spirit Vault Bundle.
You can seal Very Rare and Legendary materials against ordinary spoilage, aura loss, blood heat decay, spiritual evaporation, and common divination.
A Heaven-Sealed Lot remains stable indefinitely under normal conditions.
A creature attempting to locate, spoil, curse, or spiritually consume it through magic must contest your Gathering Save DC or the special DC set by the material.
The container remains a physical object and can still be stolen, broken, burned, drowned, or opened by force.

### Heavenly Material Recognition - Sign, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+.
You may attempt to identify Legendary and potential Secret materials: heavenly herbs, tribulation-struck wood, dragon blood jade, phoenix ash, star dew, sovereign beast cores, ancient corpse flowers, realm-bound ores, and impossible spirit fruits.
Read the Sign reveals not only what the material is, but what price Heaven, earth, guardian, karma, season, or oath may demand for taking it.
A failure may still reveal that the material is beyond your current authority.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.hidd:
### Hidden Herb Scent - Sign
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can smell, feel, or intuit the presence of spirit herbs and medicinal materials within 120 feet if they are not behind Total Cover, sealed by a stronger effect, or overwhelmed by a more powerful spiritual presence.
This sense reveals direction and general category, not exact identity, ownership, danger, or value.
When you spend 10 minutes surveying an area, the range becomes 1 mile for obvious Common and Uncommon Resource Sites.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.jade:
### Jade Knife Clean Cut - Cut
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
When harvesting a spiritual plant, fungus, beast organ, venom sac, mineral seam, dew bead, or comparable material, spend 1 CP before making the Gathering Check.
On success, create a Pure Lot instead of a Normal Lot.
On failure by 5 or less, create a Normal Lot instead of a Bruised Lot.
You must have a proper tool or a justified spiritual cutting method.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.livi:
### Living Ingredient Negotiation - Approach, Sign
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Living Source Courtesy.
You may bargain with awakened herbs, spirit fungi, ancient trees, mineral spirits, springs, hives, or comparable living Resource Sites if they can perceive intent.
Make a Gathering Check using Wisdom unless your key ability is already Wisdom.
On success, the source may allow a nonlethal harvest, name a price, reveal a ripening time, warn of a guardian, or offer a lesser Lot.
This does not compel obedience. The GM sets what a source wants.

### Living Source Courtesy - Approach, Steward
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
Some plants, fungi, spirit springs, hives, monster nests, and old trees respond to respectful conduct.
When you approach an Awakened or sensitive Resource Site without immediate violence, you may make a Gathering Check contested by the site’s relevant DC.
On success, the source permits one careful harvest, reveals a safer method, or withholds a hazard.
This is not mind control and does not command plants. A hostile guardian, oath-bound spirit, or starving beast may still refuse.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.mark:
### Market Bundle - Route
When you sell mundane produce, Common medicinal herbs, ordinary beast materials, or Common Harvest Lots, you may make a Gathering Check against DC 12.
On a success, you find the correct buyer, avoid obvious cheating, and sell at normal expected value.
On a success by 5 or more, improve the price, receive a useful rumor about a Resource Site, or gain minor sect credit.
This talent does not guarantee a buyer for illegal, cursed, stolen, Rare, or politically restricted materials.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.medi:
### Medicine Mountain Map - Sign, Route
Prerequisite: CL 5+, Field Ledger.
When you spend at least 1 day surveying a wilderness region, mountain valley, sect field, forest, marsh, or underground route, make a Gathering Check.
On success, create a Medicine Mountain Map.
While using the map, you and allies gain Advantage on checks to navigate toward recorded Resource Sites, avoid known hazards, and return with harvested materials intact.
A map becomes stale if war, fire, flood, spiritual eruption, sect conflict, or monster migration changes the area.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.name:
### Name-the-Harvest Mandate - Unique, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+.
Once per Long Rest, when you successfully Read the Sign for a Resource Site, you may name one material type that the site could plausibly contain.
For the next hour, you have Advantage on checks to find, approach, harvest, preserve, and transport that material from the site.
If the site does not contain that material, the use is wasted.
This is not divination strong enough to invent treasure. It is a Nascent Soul gatherer’s mandate aligning attention, luck, field memory, and practiced instinct toward the chosen harvest.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.pill:
### Pill-Hall Supply Chain - Route
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You can coordinate harvesters, carts, contracts, storage, guards, ledgers, pack beasts, river transport, and sect tribute for a pill hall or medicine market.
During downtime, a Pill Hall, Medicine Hall, or alchemical workshop supplied by you reduces waste, spoilage, and missing-ingredient delays.
If the Alchemy sphere’s Sect Pill Hall is present and you manage the supply chain, its Common and Uncommon production can continue with fewer interruptions, provided the GM agrees the region can support the ingredients.
This talent does not create ingredients and does not refine pills.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.quic:
### Quick Field Harvest - Cut
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can attempt Clean Harvest as an Action for Common materials or as 1 minute of work for Uncommon materials.
When harvesting this quickly, make the Gathering Check with Disadvantage unless you spend 1 CP or the source is already prepared, exposed, dead, or stabilized.
This talent is useful during raids, battlefield aftermath, collapsing ruins, or secret-realm time limits.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.rare:
### Rare Site Survey - Sign, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You may Read the Sign for Rare Resource Sites, including old spirit herbs, hidden mineral veins, dangerous mushrooms, spirit springs, weather-fed groves, ancient beast dens, and battlefield-remnant materials.
When you spend at least 1 hour surveying a region and succeed on a Gathering Check, the GM reveals one major Resource Site or confirms that none is reasonably present.
This does not reveal sites hidden by stronger Formations, Secret Inheritances, active guardians, divine concealment, or story locks unless your result exceeds the relevant DC.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.root:
### Root-Left-Alive Method - Cut, Steward
When you harvest a plant, fungus, coral, moss, spirit grass, or comparable living source, you may choose to reduce the number of Lots gained by 1, minimum 0.
If you do, the source survives and may recover naturally if the environment remains suitable.
At the GM’s discretion, a surviving source may remain useful as a future Resource Site.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.simp:
### Simple Beast Dressing - Cut
When you harvest meat, hide, horn, bone, sinew, venom, gall, feathers, scale, shell, or other ordinary beast materials from a slain creature, make one Gathering Check.
On a success, recover usable materials worth an amount set by the GM for the creature and scene.
On a success by 5 or more, choose one:
recover an additional minor Lot;
avoid tainting the material with blood, bile, or rot;
identify whether the creature carried poison, disease, spiritual residue, or useful organs.
This talent does not harvest true beast cores unless you later learn Beast-Core Dressing.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.sour:
### Source-Sparing Harvest - Cut, Steward
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Root-Left-Alive Method.
When you harvest a living source of Common, Uncommon, or Rare material, you may attempt to take a Lot without reducing the site’s future yield.
Increase the Harvest DC by 5.
On success, gain the Lot and preserve the source.
On success by 5 or more, also create a Pure Lot.
On failure, either gain no Lot or harm the source, your choice.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.sove:
### Sovereign Beast Dressing - Cut, Hazard
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Beast-Core Dressing.
You can harvest Very Rare beast cores, sovereign organs, dragon scales, phoenix ash, lightning antlers, demon gall, spirit marrow, or equivalent materials from eligible defeated creatures.
Make a Gathering Check against a DC appropriate to the creature, usually 22 or higher.
On success, recover the material.
On success by 5 or more, the material is Pure.
On Natural 1, the remnant will, poison, curse, blood heat, elemental discharge, or lingering resentment erupts as a hazard.
This talent never authorizes murder or corpse desecration as socially safe. Sect law, clan vengeance, beast oaths, and karma still matter.

### Sovereign Clean Cut - Cut, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Jade Knife Clean Cut.
When you harvest a Very Rare or Legendary material, spend 8 CP before rolling.
On success, create a Pure Lot.
On success by 5 or more, create a Perfect Lot.
On failure by 5 or less, create a Normal Lot instead of a Bruised Lot.
On failure by more than 5, you may choose to save the source and gain no Lot instead of ruining the material.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.spir:
### Spirit Vault Bundle - Seal, Route
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Spirit-Sealing Wax.
You can create sealed bundles, jade boxes, ice gourds, copper jars, blood-warm flasks, shadow wraps, or mineral cases suitable for Rare materials.
When you Seal the Essence of a Lot, you may also suppress obvious spiritual leakage, scent, blood heat, or elemental discharge.
A creature attempting to locate the sealed Lot by magical or spiritual sensing must succeed on a check against your Gathering Save DC.
This does not hide the Lot from mundane search if the container is found.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.ten_:
### Ten-Thousand Herb Catalogue - Sign
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You maintain a personal or sect-backed catalogue of herbs, beasts, minerals, fungi, poisons, spirit soils, dew phenomena, and regional names.
You have Advantage on checks to identify Common, Uncommon, and Rare ingredients.
Once per Long Rest, when you fail a Gathering Check to identify a material, reroll the check. You must use the new result.

### Ten-Thousand-Year Ripeness - Sign
Prerequisite: CL 15+.
You can distinguish true age, false age, accumulated spiritual density, and artificial ripening.
When you identify a material whose value depends on age or maturity, learn whether its apparent age is true, exaggerated, suppressed, artificially inflated, or spiritually misleading.
If you later use the material in Alchemy, the alchemist ignores one penalty caused by false age or misunderstood maturity.
tianxia.talent.harvesting_gathering.worl:
### World-Root Courtesy - Approach, Steward
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Living Ingredient Negotiation.
You can attempt respectful contact with ancient Resource Sites whose awareness is larger than one body: mountain roots, old forests, deep springs, medicinal valleys, spirit orchards, mineral dragons, ancestral hives, or sealed gardens.
This is a narrative technique requiring time, conduct, offerings, and GM approval.
On success, the site may grant one harvest, a seed-like clue, a guardian’s warning, a lesser substitute, or permission to return.
This does not grow plants and does not command the site.
tianxia.talent.hunger.appetite_seal:
### Appetite Seal - Taste, Meal
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
When you use Taste the Qi on a meal, corpse portion, or ingredient and identify Impurity, you may mark the impurity pattern for later correction.
The next time before your next long rest that you use Refine the Meal on that target, reduce the DC increase from Corrupted Portion by 1.
At Core Formation Realm, reduce the DC increase by 2 instead.
tianxia.talent.hunger.battle_ration:
### Battle Ration - Meal, Mantle
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
You may prepare one stored Satiety as a battle ration at the end of a short rest.
Until your next long rest, you may activate Digestive Mantle with that Satiety as part of the same Bonus Action used to consume it.
When you do, the Mantle's Temporary HP increases by your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.hunger.beast_bone_broth:
### Beast-Bone Broth - Meal, Beast-Course
When you Refine a spirit-beast or monster portion with bones, shell, horn, claw, scale, carapace, or hide, you may store it as Bone Satiety.
A Digestive Mantle using Bone Satiety may choose Thick Hide even if the original creature did not obviously have thick hide.
At Foundation Realm, Thick Hide from Bone Satiety reduces damage by twice your Proficiency Bonus instead.
tianxia.talent.hunger.bitter_medicine_be:
### Bitter Medicine Belly - Survival, Mantle
While Digestive Mantle is active, you have Advantage on saving throws against Poisoned.
If you succeed on a saving throw against Poisoned while Digestive Mantle is active, you may spend 1 CP to gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.hunger.cauldron_stomach:
### Cauldron Stomach - Meal
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Your maximum Satiety increases by 2.
When you complete a long rest, you may preserve one unused Satiety charge instead of losing it, provided it is not Forbidden Satiety.
You may preserve only one Satiety this way at a time.
tianxia.talent.hunger.clean_palate:
### Clean Palate - Taste
When you use Taste the Qi on food, medicine, water, poison, beast meat, a corpse, or a spiritual ingredient, you may also learn whether it is safe to eat by ordinary standards.
If you already know it is unsafe, you gain Advantage on the next saving throw you make against that specific poison, disease, or impurity before the end of your next long rest.
tianxia.talent.hunger.demon_beast_digest:
### Demon-Beast Digestion - Demon-Course, Meal
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
When you use Refine the Meal on a Corrupted Portion from a demon beast, you may accept 1 Impurity before rolling.
If you do, gain Advantage on the Hunger Check.
On a success, the Satiety created by this meal counts as Demon-Beast Satiety.
A Digestive Mantle using Demon-Beast Satiety may choose two basic Mantle benefits instead of one.
When that Mantle ends, make a Constitution saving throw against your Hunger Save DC.
Failed Save: gain 1 Impurity.
tianxia.talent.hunger.demon_meat_without:
### Demon Meat Without Madness - Demon-Course, Meal
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Demon-Beast Digestion
When you successfully use Refine the Meal on a demon-beast portion, reduce the Impurity gained from that meal or its next Digestive Mantle by 1, minimum 0.
If you succeed by 5 or more, you may also remove one visible cosmetic sign of demonic digestion from the resulting Mantle, such as beast pupils, horn-shadow, black veins, smoke breath, or predatory aura. This conceals appearance only. It does not hide Appetite Stain, Forbidden Hunger, or other spiritual crimes.
tianxia.talent.hunger.devour_the_venom_k:
### Devour the Venom, Keep the Fang - Mantle
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
When you activate Digestive Mantle using venomous, poisonous, acidic, diseased, or corrupted Satiety, choose Acid, Poison, or Necrotic, as appropriate to the meal.
You gain Resistance to the chosen damage type until the start of your next turn.
As a Reaction when you take that damage type, you may spend 1 CP to extend the Resistance to that triggering damage instance and gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.hunger.dragon_marrow_banq:
### Dragon-Marrow Banquet Scripture - Secret, Meal, Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, dragon, serpent, flood-beast, sky-beast, or imperial banquet inheritance
When you Refine the Meal using a Mighty Portion from a dragon, serpent, flood-beast, sky-beast, imperial guardian beast, or comparable creature, you may spend 5 CP.
On a success, create Dragon-Marrow Satiety.
When you activate Digestive Mantle using Dragon-Marrow Satiety, choose two basic Mantle benefits and one dragon-marrow sign:
- Flood Sign: gain Swim Speed equal to your Speed for the Mantle duration.
- Sky Sign: gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until the end of your next turn.
- Scale Sign: Thick Hide reduces damage by three times your Proficiency Bonus the first time it triggers.
- Breath Sign: once before the Mantle ends, when you deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, or Thunder damage from a Hunger talent or compatible sphere talent, add 2d8 damage of the same type.
- Majesty Sign: gain Advantage on the next Charisma (Intimidation) or Charisma (Persuasion) check made against a creature that respects dragon, imperial, or beast-sovereign authority before your next long rest.
If the source was corrupted, demonic, unwillingly sacrificed, or illegally obtained, gain 1 Impurity when the Mantle ends.
tianxia.talent.hunger.empty_bowl_guard:
### Empty-Bowl Guard - Mantle
When you activate Digestive Mantle while you have no ordinary food remaining in your supplies, increase the Temporary HP gained by your Proficiency Bonus.
This talent functions only once per long rest.
If you later gain access to abundant food before your next long rest, the talent does not activate again. Empty-Bowl Guard rewards real deprivation, not staged bookkeeping.
tianxia.talent.hunger.famine_enduring_bo:
### Famine-Enduring Bowl - Survival, Meal
When you successfully Refine the Meal using a Common Portion, you may choose not to gain Satiety. Instead, one willing creature who eats the meal ignores the effects of ordinary hunger and thirst for 24 hours.
This does not remove Exhaustion already gained from starvation or dehydration. It also does not protect against magical famine, cursed thirst, poison, or disease.
At Core Formation Realm, you may affect a number of willing creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.hunger.famine_surviving_s:
### Famine-Surviving Saint Method - Secret, Survival, Banquet
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, famine lineage, wandering saint, refugee kitchen, or sect disaster office inheritance
During a short rest, you may spend 3 CP and one Essence Portion to prepare a famine bowl for up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures.
Each participant ignores ordinary hunger, thirst, and forced-march penalties for 24 hours and gains Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw against Exhaustion before its next long rest.
If used to feed helpless refugees, starving commoners, disaster victims, or noncombatants in genuine need, you regain 1 CP after the rest and reduce Impurity by 1.
This talent cannot create food from nothing. It stretches meaningful nourishment through cultivation.
tianxia.talent.hunger.heaven_famine_bell:
### Heaven-Famine Belly - Survival, Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
When Digestive Mantle is active, you and willing allies within 30 feet have Advantage on saving throws against magical hunger, cursed thirst, famine aura, disease caused by starvation, and Exhaustion caused by hostile travel conditions.
As a Reaction when a willing creature within 30 feet fails one of those saving throws, you may spend 2 CP and end your Digestive Mantle to let that creature reroll the save. The creature must use the new result.
tianxia.talent.hunger.heavenly_gourmand_:
### Heavenly Gourmand's Thousand-Flavour Canon - Secret, Meal
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, secret gourmand canon
When you use Refine the Meal, you may name a flavor principle before rolling: bitter, sweet, sour, salty, spicy, fresh, smoky, metallic, cold, burning, earthy, bloody, floral, rotten, clean, or empty.
On a success, the Satiety gains that flavor principle.
When you later use that Satiety for Digestive Mantle, choose one additional minor benefit based on the flavor:
- Bitter: Advantage on the next saving throw against Poisoned before the Mantle ends.
- Sweet: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Sour: increase Speed by 5 feet until the end of your next turn.
- Salty: Advantage on the next Constitution check before the Mantle ends.
- Spicy: add +1 damage to the first damage roll you make before the end of your next turn.
- Fresh: reduce Impurity by 1 when the Mantle ends if the Satiety was not Corrupted.
- Smoky: gain Advantage on the next Dexterity (Stealth) check before the Mantle ends.
- Metallic: the first time Thick Hide triggers, reduce damage by 2 additional points.
- Cold: Cold Gut lasts until the end of your next turn instead of until the start of your next turn.
- Burning: Furnace Belly deals +1 additional damage.
- Earthy: Advantage on the next saving throw against being knocked Prone.
- Bloody: when you hit a Bloodied creature, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus once before the Mantle ends.
- Floral: Advantage on the next Charisma check made in a peaceful social scene before your next long rest.
- Rotten: Advantage on the next saving throw against Disease before your next long rest.
- Clean: ignore 1 Impurity that would be gained when the Mantle ends.
- Empty: if the Mantle ends while you have 0 Satiety, gain Advantage on your next Taste the Qi check.
The GM may reject a flavor principle that does not fit the ingredient.
tianxia.talent.hunger.hundred_flavour_ma:
### Hundred-Flavour Mantle - Mantle
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
When you activate Digestive Mantle, you may spend 1 additional Satiety.
If you do, choose one primary Mantle benefit and one secondary Mantle benefit.
The primary benefit lasts for the full Mantle duration. The secondary benefit lasts until the end of your next turn.
Only one of the benefits may add damage.
tianxia.talent.hunger.hunger_sense_merid:
### Hunger-Sense Meridian - Taste
When you use Taste the Qi on a creature, you may also learn whether it has eaten a meaningful spiritual meal, pill, beast core, demon-beast portion, or forbidden essence within the last 24 hours.
On a successful contested Hunger Check against a concealing target, you may learn whether the meal was beast-born, plant-born, pill-born, demon-born, undead, cultivator-born, or artificial.
tianxia.talent.hunger.hunter_s_victory_m:
### Hunter's Victory Meal - Meal, Beast-Course
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
When you help reduce a meaningful beast, spirit beast, monster, demon beast, monstrosity, dragon, or comparable creature to 0 HP, your first Refine the Meal check using one of its Essence Portions before your next long rest gains a +2 bonus.
If the creature was a major threat for your party or your cultivation stage, gain Advantage instead.
This talent does not apply if the creature was helpless, trapped only for farming, conjured, summoned, or not a meaningful opponent.
tianxia.talent.hunger.inner_banquet_furn:
### Inner Banquet Furnace - Banquet, Meal
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
During a short rest, you may spend 3 CP and use Refine the Meal with one Notable or Mighty Portion to prepare an internal banquet furnace.
On a success, choose up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures who share the meal. Each chosen creature gains Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus and Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before its next long rest.
If the meal uses Demon-Beast Satiety or a Corrupted Portion, each participant may choose to gain 1 Impurity. A participant who accepts this Impurity also gains +5 feet Speed for 1 hour.
tianxia.talent.hunger.marrow_furnace_pul:
### Marrow-Furnace Pulse - Mantle
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
While Digestive Mantle is active, once per turn when you spend CP on a Hunger talent, you may gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the active Mantle came from a demon beast, you may instead add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll that turn and gain 1 Impurity when the Mantle ends.
tianxia.talent.hunger.maw_of_ten_thousan:
### Maw of Ten Thousand Courses - Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
When you activate Digestive Mantle, you may spend up to 3 Satiety.
Choose one Mantle benefit for each Satiety spent.
Only one benefit may add damage.
Only one benefit may grant or renew Resistance.
When the Mantle ends, reduce your Impurity by 1 if none of the spent Satiety was Corrupted, Demon-Beast, or Forbidden.
tianxia.talent.hunger.monster_core_simme:
### Monster-Core Simmer - Meal
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
When you Refine the Meal using beast core residue, monster core fragments, demon core scrap, or a similar concentrated organ, you may spend 2 CP instead of 1 CP.
On a success, gain 1 Satiety and choose the exact basic Mantle benefit it will support when later used for Digestive Mantle.
On a success by 5 or more, that future Digestive Mantle also gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus when activated.
On a failure by 5 or more, gain 2 Impurity instead of 1.
tianxia.talent.hunger.nine_beast_soverei:
### Nine-Beast Sovereign Course - Beast-Course, Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
When you activate Digestive Mantle using at least two Satiety from different beast, monster, or demon-beast sources, choose one of the following sovereign adaptations:
- Winged Hunger: gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until the end of your next turn. You fall if you are airborne when this benefit ends unless another feature keeps you aloft.
- Burrowing Hunger: gain a Burrow Speed of 20 feet through earth, sand, loose stone, or snow until the end of your next turn. You cannot burrow through worked stone, metal, formations, or sealed barriers.
- Armored Hunger: when Thick Hide reduces damage, reduce it by three times your Proficiency Bonus instead of by your Proficiency Bonus.
- Venom Sovereign: the first time each turn that Venom Belly deals extra damage, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until the start of your next turn.
Once you choose a sovereign adaptation, you cannot choose another until you activate a new Digestive Mantle.
tianxia.talent.hunger.old_monster_kitche:
### Old Monster Kitchen Manual - Secret, Taste, Meal
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, ancient kitchen manual or monster-hunter teacher
When you use Taste the Qi on a monster, spirit beast, demon beast, or strange ingredient, you may ask the GM one additional question:
What part should not be eaten?
If you later use Refine the Meal on that creature or ingredient and avoid the named danger, gain a +2 bonus to the Hunger Check.
At Core Formation Realm, the bonus increases to +3.
At Nascent Soul Realm, if the meal succeeds by 5 or more, you may also create one additional Satiety, but the additional Satiety must be used before your next short rest or it spoils.
tianxia.talent.hunger.predator_king_dige:
### Predator-King Digestion - Mantle, Beast-Course
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
When you activate Digestive Mantle using Satiety from a predator or apex beast, your Predator Step improves.
While Predator Step is active, you gain Climb Speed equal to your Speed or Swim Speed equal to your Speed, chosen when you activate the Mantle and appropriate to the source creature.
In addition, once before the Mantle ends, when you hit a Bloodied creature with an attack, you may add damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die, weapon damage die, or a d8, whichever is most appropriate to your build and approved by the GM.
tianxia.talent.hunger.predator_s_course:
### Predator's Course - Mantle, Beast-Course
When you activate Digestive Mantle using a predator, hunter, stalking beast, flying beast, serpent, spider, tiger, wolf, hawk, or comparable source, you may choose Predator Step.
While Predator Step is active, your jump distance also increases by 10 feet, and you gain Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track Bloodied creatures.
tianxia.talent.hunger.scripture_of_the_e:
### Scripture of the Empty Bowl - Secret, Taste, Mantle
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, secret scripture or teacher
You learn to turn lack into focus.
If you begin combat with 0 Satiety, you may use Taste the Qi once without spending a Bonus Action during your first turn.
If that Taste the Qi identifies a meaningful source of nourishment, you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus and Advantage on your next Hunger Check before the end of the scene.
At Core Formation Realm, if you later gain Satiety from that identified source before the end of the scene, your next Digestive Mantle costs 0 CP.
tianxia.talent.hunger.second_stomach_met:
### Second Stomach Method - Meal
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Your maximum Satiety increases by 1.
In addition, when you finish a short rest, you may preserve one Satiety charge that would otherwise expire at your next long rest. Preserved Satiety lasts until the end of your next long rest.
You can preserve only one Satiety this way at a time.
Forbidden Satiety cannot be preserved by this talent.
tianxia.talent.hunger.soul_scent_appetit:
### Soul-Scent Appetite - Taste
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Your Taste the Qi can sense appetite at soul depth.
When you use Taste the Qi on a creature, you may ask one additional question:
- What does this creature spiritually crave right now?
- What kind of nourishment, fear, vow, vengeance, recognition, bloodline pressure, or breakthrough hunger is strongest in it?
- Has this creature recently used a forbidden consumption method?
- Is this creature carrying Appetite Stain, daemonic corruption, undead hunger, ghost famine, or comparable spiritual predation?
If the target is unwilling, make the normal contested Hunger Check.
This talent reveals symbolic hunger, not a complete plan or private memory.
tianxia.talent.hunger.the_empty_bowl_wat:
### The Empty Bowl Watches - Taste, Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
While Digestive Mantle is active, you can use Taste the Qi without spending a Bonus Action once on each of your turns.
When you do, the target must be within 60 feet.
If Taste the Qi reveals that the target is Bloodied, poisoned, starving, spiritually empty, Impure, or carrying Appetite Stain, you may gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You can gain Temporary HP this way only once per round.
tianxia.talent.hunger.the_last_meal_befo:
### The Last Meal Before Immortality - Secret, Banquet, Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, major story permission
When a willing creature shares a meal with you before a breakthrough, duel, exile, execution, tribulation, last stand, or other life-defining threshold, you may perform a 1-hour rite and spend 8 CP.
Choose one participant, which may be you.
Until that creature finishes its next long rest, it gains one Last Meal die, a d8.
Once during that duration, the creature may roll the Last Meal die and add it to one saving throw, Cultivation Check, death saving throw, or ability check made to endure fear, hunger, poison, disease, forced march, hostile weather, spiritual pressure, or a breakthrough consequence.
After the die is used, the creature gains a symbolic hunger chosen by the GM or player: return home, avenge someone, eat again, protect a disciple, finish a vow, see dawn, or take one more step.
A creature can benefit from only one Last Meal Before Immortality at a time.
tianxia.talent.hunger.three_course_battl:
### Three-Course Battle Body - Mantle
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
When Digestive Mantle is active, you may use a Bonus Action to consume 1 additional Satiety and replace your current basic Mantle benefit with a different basic Mantle benefit appropriate to the new Satiety.
When you do, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You can use this replacement a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest.
tianxia.talent.hunger.trail_stomach_scri:
### Trail-Stomach Scripture - Survival, Meal
You can use Refine the Meal during harsh travel without proper cooking tools, provided you have fire, water, salt, a knife, a heated stone, or a comparable survival method.
When you successfully Refine a Common or Notable Portion during travel, choose one creature who shares the meal. That creature gains Advantage on its next Constitution saving throw against forced march, starvation, thirst, mundane cold, mundane heat, or spoiled food before its next long rest.
tianxia.talent.hunger.wolfing_the_battle:
### Wolfing the Battlefield Scrap - Meal
You may use Refine the Meal as a 1-minute ritual instead of a 10-minute ritual if the Essence Portion came from a creature reduced to 0 HP within the last minute.
When you do, the DC increases by 2. On a failure by 5 or more, you gain 1 Impurity and cannot use Wolfing the Battlefield Scrap again until you finish a short rest.
tianxia.talent.ice.ice_bridge_scripture:
#### Ice Bridge Scripture
Action Type: No Action
Trigger: You use Crystallize Path
Cost: None
Your Lattice Spaces can form simple unsupported bridges, ramps, stairs, or narrow platforms instead of needing to coat an existing surface. Each unsupported Lattice Space must be connected to a solid surface or another Lattice Space that ultimately connects to a solid surface.
A creature can stand on these spaces. Each 5-foot unsupported Lattice Space can support up to one Large creature or four Medium or smaller creatures. If a supporting Lattice Space is destroyed, unsupported spaces depending on it collapse and end.
tianxia.talent.illusion.consensus_lie:
#### Consensus Lie
Prerequisite: Illusion Domain, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
Tags: Premise, Image, Phantasm
You create an illusion supported by social proof. Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, a creature gains the same False Premise from you. While at least two creatures affected by this talent can see or hear one another, they have Disadvantage on Study checks against that specific premise because each witness reinforces the others.
If one affected creature recognizes the illusion as false, each other affected creature may immediately repeat the saving throw.
tianxia.talent.illusion.greater_invisibi:
#### Greater Invisibility
Prerequisite: Obscuring Glamer, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 4 CPConcentration: Required
Tags: Glamer, Veil
One willing creature you touch becomes Invisible. The invisibility does not end when the target attacks, casts a spell, uses a sphere talent, or deals damage.
This does not automatically make the target Hidden. Tracks, sound, scent, spiritual pressure, displaced dust, and other signs may still reveal the target’s location.
tianxia.talent.illusion.illusory_army:
#### Illusory Army
Prerequisite: Complex Figments, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Tags: Figment, Decoy, Premise
You fill the area with false soldiers, beasts, weapons, banners, talismans, arrows, or spiritual avatars. The army does not deal physical damage and does not occupy spaces.
When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it gains a False Premise from you until the start of your next turn.
Once per round, when you trigger a Misdirection Response against a creature inside the area, choose one ally inside the area. That ally may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature.
tianxia.talent.illusion.impossible_premi:
#### Impossible Premise
Prerequisite: Potent Phantasm, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next turn
Cost: 7 CP
Saving Throw: Intelligence
Tags: Phantasm, Premise
You present a premise that cannot be true but briefly overwhelms interpretation: the target sees itself already struck, a bridge where none can exist, a dead teacher speaking its name, a door opening inside its own shadow, or a second moon rising behind your hand.
On a failed save, the target gains a False Premise. Until the effect ends, when you trigger a Misdirection Response against that target, choose two different responses instead of one.
On a successful save, the target is immune to your Impossible Premise until you finish a Long Rest.
tianxia.talent.illusion.intelligent_illu:
#### Intelligent Illusion
Prerequisite: Illusion, CL 10+
Tags: Sensory, Figment, Veil
Your complex illusions can respond to simple stimuli. When you augment a figment to include sight and sound, you may also grant it limited intelligence based on your Intelligence score.
An intelligent figment can carry out simple instructions without requiring your Action each turn, such as “argue with anyone who enters,” “pretend to guard this gate,” “walk this route,” or “answer questions as the innkeeper would.” You must still use an Action to give it a new order.
An intelligent figment can fool simple thought-reading, telepathy, and similar effects with surface impressions you define. A creature that probes deeply may make an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Cultivation Save DC to recognize that the thoughts are artificial.
When used with Illusory Disguise, this talent can provide false surface thoughts and apparent memories consistent with the disguise. It does not rewrite the target’s true mind.
tianxia.talent.illusion.mirage:
#### Mirage
Prerequisite: Illusionary Terrain, CL 10+
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Ritual or Action
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=MIRAGE_RITUAL
Range: 1 mile
Area: Up to one 1-mile cube
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 6 CPConcentration: Not required
Tags: Figment, Image, Sensory
You create a vast illusion over terrain. You can make roads appear elsewhere, hide a camp, make a valley appear flooded, cover ruins with false forest, make a fortress appear abandoned, or make an empty plain seem like a city.
The terrain is not physically changed. The illusion cannot create real shelter, bridges, food, water, hazards, or Cover. Creatures may Study the mirage normally, though the scale may make contradictions harder to find.
tianxia.talent.illusion.mirage_city:
#### Mirage City
Prerequisite: Mirage, CL 15+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Range: 1 mile
Area: Up to one settlement, fortress, battlefield, valley, sect compound, or comparable region
Duration: 7 days
Cost: 10 CP
Tags: Figment, Image, Sensory
You create a long-lasting large-scale mirage. The mirage may hide a settlement, make a ruin appear inhabited, make an army appear larger or smaller, cover a sect hall with a false district, or make one road appear as another.
The mirage is not physical. It does not create food, shelter, walls, guards, bridges, or traps. It can, however, misdirect travel, social response, scouting, and witness testimony.
A creature that spends 10 minutes examining the area may Study the mirage. Creatures with relevant maps, local knowledge, Truesight, Formation-sight, or superior spiritual perception may have Advantage.
tianxia.talent.illusion.permanent_illusi:
#### Permanent Illusion
Prerequisite: Illusion, CL 15+
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=MAKE_ILLUSION_PERMANENT->passive
Timing Detail: Part of creating a figment or glamer
Cost: 8 CP
Tags: Figment, Glamer
One figment or glamer you create lasts until dispelled, dismissed by you, or ended by a condition in its talent. The illusion does not require Concentration.
A permanent illusion must have a fixed boundary or clear target. The GM may require rare ink, jade dust, incense, moon-water, spirit lacquer, or another cultivation material for permanent illusions used as Formations, sect defenses, or inheritance trials.
tianxia.talent.illusion.phantom_prison:
#### Phantom Prison
Prerequisite: Potent Phantasm, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Saving Throw: Intelligence
Tags: Phantasm, Premise
The target perceives a prison that only it fully experiences: chains of light, enclosing walls, a collapsing room, a judgment hall, a predator’s jaws, or another impossible enclosure.
On a failed save, the target’s Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, and it gains a False Premise from you. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
The target may also use its Action to Study the prison, ending the effect on a success.
tianxia.talent.illusion.sovereign_illusi:
#### Sovereign Illusion Incarnation
Prerequisite: Illusion Domain, CL 15+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 6 CPConcentration: Not required
Tags: Glamer, Veil, Premise
You become the living center of your false premise.
For the duration:
you may trigger two Misdirection Responses per round instead of one;
your Minor Illusion, Create Figment, and Plant False Premise may be used as Bonus Actions;
when a creature misses you because of an Illusion talent, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature;
once per round, when a creature succeeds on a Study check against one of your illusions, you may force it to make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it recognizes that something is false but misidentifies which part is false until the end of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.illusion.substantial_phan:
#### Substantial Phantasm
Prerequisite: Greater Illusion, Potent Phantasm, CL 10+
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Timing Detail: Part of Create Figment
Cost: 3 CP
Tags: Figment, Phantasm
You give an illusion enough psychic weight to restrain a creature that accepts it.
Choose any number of creatures inside the figment’s area. Each chosen creature makes an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the creature is Grappled by the illusion until the start of your next turn or until it successfully Studies the illusion. A creature Grappled this way may make a free Study check at the end of each of its turns.
Augment 2 CP: A creature that fails the saving throw is Restrained instead of Grappled.
Substantial Phantasm is not true matter. It cannot carry objects, block doors, support weight, or restrain a creature that has recognized it as false.
tianxia.talent.illusion.the_one_false_pr:
### Secret Inheritance - The One False Premise Beneath Heaven
Prerequisite: Illusion, CL 17+, GM permission
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature, object, area, or event the target can perceive
Duration: 1 round
Cost: 12 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
Tags: Premise, Phantasm, Secret Inheritance
You establish one false premise so completely that the target’s immediate reality organizes around it.
Choose one premise that can be expressed in a single sentence, such as:
“The bridge is safe.”
“The assassin is behind you.”
“The gate is already open.”
“Your ally has betrayed you.”
“The wound came from elsewhere.”
“The elder’s command was spoken.”
“The treasure is in my hand.”
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target treats the premise as true for the purpose of one immediate choice. The premise cannot force self-destruction, make the target choose an illegal action, rewrite long-term loyalty, create physical matter, teleport a creature, or override direct divine, artifact, or Secret Inheritance-level protection.
When the target acts on the premise, choose up to two Misdirection Responses and apply them. The target then immediately recognizes that something impossible occurred, but may not know what part was false.
Successful Save: The target is not affected and is immune to this Secret Inheritance until you finish a Long Rest.
Overreach: If the premise contradicts something the target is currently touching, suffering, holding, or directly experiencing, the target has Advantage on the saving throw.
tianxia.talent.illusion.thousand_face_pr:
#### Thousand-Face Procession
Prerequisite: Illusory Disguise, Veiled Illusion, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: Up to twelve willing creatures
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 8 CP
Tags: Glamer, Veil
You disguise multiple creatures under a shared social premise: a funeral procession, envoy, patrol, merchant train, cult rite, noble retinue, sect delegation, troupe, or similar identity.
Creatures affected by the procession have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to maintain the shared cover. A creature that Studies one disguise and succeeds recognizes that creature’s disguise as false, but does not automatically reveal the entire procession.
tianxia.talent.illusion.unreliable_witne:
#### Unreliable Witness
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet succeeds on a Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Insight), or Intelligence (Investigation) check
Cost: 2 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
Tags: Phantasm, Premise
The target must repeat the triggering check. On a failed save, it uses the lower result and gains a False Premise from you until the start of your next turn.
This does not alter memory permanently. It makes the immediate interpretation unreliable.
tianxia.talent.illusion.world_of_false_p:
#### World of False Premises
Prerequisite: Illusion Domain, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 60-foot Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Tags: Premise, Image, Phantasm
Your Domain expands into a complete local interpretation of reality.
While the effect lasts, hostile creatures inside the area have Disadvantage on the first Study check they make each round against your Illusion talents. In addition, the first time each round that a hostile creature inside the area misses an attack, targets the wrong creature, wastes movement, or fails a Study check because of your Illusion talent, you regain 1 CP.
You cannot regain more CP from this talent than your Proficiency Bonus during one use.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.animate_minor_v:
#### Animate Minor Vessel - Awakening
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One unattended Tiny or Small object
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
You command motion into an object. The object becomes an animated vessel that obeys simple commands such as move, guard, carry, pull, open, close, strike, hide, or follow.
Use the following local statistics unless the GM provides better object stats:
Tiny Object: AC 18, HP 20, Speed 30 feet or Fly 30 feet (Hover) if it lacks legs, attack bonus = your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier, hit 1d4 + key ability modifier Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing depending on form.
Small Object: AC 16, HP 25, Speed 30 feet or Fly 30 feet (Hover), attack bonus = your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier, hit 1d8 + key ability modifier.
An animated object is a construct-like vessel with Intelligence 3, Wisdom 3, and Charisma 1. It understands your simple commands but is not a true creature with personality unless awakened by another feature.
Commanding one or more animated vessels uses your Bonus Action. If you issue no command, they Dodge, Disengage, Hide, or continue the last safe command.
At CL 11, you may animate a Medium object. At CL 17, you may animate a Large object.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.awaken_true_ves:
#### Awaken True Vessel Spirit - Awakening
Prerequisite: Awaken Vessel Spirit, CL 15+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 24-hour ritual
Range: Touch
Target: One tree, beast with Intelligence 3 or lower, magic item, crafted body, corpse prepared by legal rites, or long-used personal object
Cost: 10 CP and a major material or narrative cost determined by the GM
You attempt to awaken a true vessel spirit. Make an Imbuement Check. The DC is set by the GM based on the target’s nature, usually 20 for simple vessels, 25 for magic items or crafted bodies, and 30+ for ancient trees, sect treasures, corpses with unresolved karma, or complex vessel spirits.
Success: the target gains lasting sentience or awakens as a story creature, item spirit, awakened beast, or vessel-person. Its exact stat block, loyalty, and rights are determined by the GM. It is initially friendly if treated well, but not mindlessly enslaved.
Failure: the awakening fails and the GM chooses one backlash: a flawed spirit, hostile vessel, incomplete sentience, curse, possession opening, broken item spirit, or sect-level consequence.
This talent is intentionally a story procedure, not a routine combat buff.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.awaken_vessel_s:
#### Awaken Vessel Spirit - Awakening
Prerequisite: Speak to the Vessel, CL 12+
You can awaken a more durable temporary vessel spirit.
When you use Speak to the Vessel, you may spend 3 CP to give the Vessel a temporary spirit for 24 hours. It gains Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma 10, can speak one language you know, and can make simple judgments about its surroundings.
If the target is an animated object you control, it can continue following your last command without your Bonus Action, though commanding it to change tasks still requires your Bonus Action.
If the target is a magic item, tree, crafted body, or prepared vessel, the awakened spirit may develop preferences. It begins friendly but not enslaved unless a separate binding effect applies.
This is not permanent sentience. Permanent awakening is a strategic project, Secret Inheritance, or major story result.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.clarify_and_clo:
#### Clarify and Cloud - Mandate
You command attention and thought.
Imbue - Clarify. Place Mandate can target one willing creature. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The target has Advantage on ability checks using that ability. When the target makes one such ability check, it may treat a roll lower than 10 as a 10. Once this replacement is used, the Mandate ends unless you spend 1 CP to keep it active.
Fray - Cloud. Fray Mandate can target one creature. The target has Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability checks. If the target is Concentrating, it also has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.court_of_ten_th:
#### Court of Ten Thousand Mandates - Domain
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP; once per short or long rest
You establish a court where every vessel briefly answers to your authority.
When you create the Court, choose one Mandate family you know: Sharpen/Dull, Harden/Brittle, Lighten/Burden, Quicken/Slow, Quiet/Resound, Clarify/Cloud, Physique/Weakness, Fortify/Expose, or Suppress Function.
For the duration:
your Mandate Load increases by your Proficiency Bonus;
once on each of your turns, you may use Place Mandate or Fray Mandate from the chosen family without spending an Action, targeting a legal Vessel inside the Court;
objects inside the Court count as in range for your Read the Vessel;
when a hostile creature inside the Court succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Fray Mandates, you may spend 1 CP to make the Mandate linger until the start of your next turn in a lesser form chosen by the GM;
when a willing creature inside the Court receives one of your Imbue Mandates, it gains temporary hit points equal to your key ability modifier.
The Court does not override artifacts, permanent soul contracts, sect treasures, Secret Inheritances, or unwilling creatures without saving throws.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.elemental_mantl:
#### Elemental Mantle - Mandate
You command a weapon or vessel to carry a surface element.
Imbue. Place Mandate can target one weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or damaging tool. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Radiant, or Thunder. Once per turn, an attack with the Vessel deals an extra 1d6 damage of the chosen type.
At CL 5, the extra damage increases to 2d6. At CL 11, it increases to 3d6. At CL 17, it increases to 4d6.
A Vessel cannot benefit from more than one Elemental Mantle at a time. This talent does not create independent elemental terrain or replace elemental spheres.
Fray - Elemental Dimming. Fray Mandate can target one weapon or natural weapon currently dealing extra elemental damage from a spell, sphere, item, or technique. On a failed save, reduce one extra damage die from that effect by one step, to a minimum of no extra die, until the Mandate ends. Stronger effects may require Counter-Mandate.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.fortify_and_exp:
#### Fortify and Expose - Mandate
You command defensive readiness.
Imbue - Fortify. Place Mandate can target one willing creature. Choose one saving throw. The target gains Proficiency in that saving throw for the duration. If the target already has Proficiency, it gains a +1 bonus instead.
Fray - Expose. Fray Mandate can target one creature. Choose Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throws. The target has Disadvantage on the next saving throw of that type it makes before the start of your next turn.
Augment 2 CP. Expose lasts for the full duration, but each time the target fails a saving throw because of this Disadvantage, it may repeat the Wisdom saving throw against this Mandate, ending it on a success.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.guided_vessel:
#### Guided Vessel - Mandate
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You can command direction into a ranged weapon, thrown weapon, or ammunition.
Imbue - Pursuant Shot. Place Mandate can target one ranged or thrown weapon. Attacks made with it treat the target’s Cover as one degree lower. Total Cover becomes Three-Quarters Cover only if there is a gap, crack, murder-hole, arrow slit, window, or other path the ammunition could physically pass through.
Fray - Treacherous Shot. Fray Mandate can target one ranged or thrown weapon. Attacks made with it have Disadvantage. If an affected attack misses and one of the attacker’s allies is within 30 feet of the original target, the ammunition veers toward the nearest such ally. Compare the original attack roll to that ally’s AC; the GM may reroll if the line is impossible.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.harden_and_brit:
#### Harden and Brittle - Mandate
You command durability.
Imbue - Harden. Place Mandate can target one object, weapon, armor, shield, door, tool, or unattended structure section no larger than a 10-foot cube. It gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for the duration. If the target is armor or a shield, the wearer also gains temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of each of their turns while wearing or wielding it.
Fray - Brittle. Fray Mandate can target one object, weapon, armor, shield, door, tool, or unattended structure section no larger than a 10-foot cube. It loses Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. If it had no such Resistance, it gains Vulnerability to the next instance of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage it takes before the start of your next turn.
Augment 2 CP. You can apply Harden or Brittle to a creature. A creature affected by Harden gains Resistance to one of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, chosen when you place the Mandate. A creature affected by Brittle loses one such Resistance, or takes extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus the next time it takes damage of the chosen type before the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.heavy_light_fie:
#### Heavy-Light Field - Domain
Prerequisite: Lighten and Burden, CL 12+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius Sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You create an area where weight obeys your Mandate.
Choose Light Field or Heavy Field.
Light Field. Creatures and unsecured objects in the area are half-weight. Creatures have Advantage on jumping checks and Disadvantage on checks to resist being pushed or pulled. Falling creatures descend at half speed and take half falling damage.
Heavy Field. The area is Difficult Terrain. Creatures have Disadvantage on jumping checks, cannot take the Dash action unless they succeed on a Strength saving throw at the start of their turn, and unsecured objects weigh twice as much.
As a Bonus Action on later turns, you may switch the field between Light and Heavy.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.layered_mandate:
#### Layered Mandate - Layer
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Mandate Load increases by 1.
In addition, when you apply Place Mandate to a willing target, you may spend 1 CP to apply two different Imbue options you know with the same action. The options must affect different properties. Combine their CP costs.
For example, you could make a weapon both Tempered and Elementally Mantled, or a robe both Quiet and Hardened.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.lighten_and_bur:
#### Lighten and Burden - Mandate
You command weight.
Imbue - Lighten. Place Mandate can target one object or willing creature. The target’s weight is halved. If the target is a creature, it has Advantage on checks made to climb, jump, balance, or avoid falling, and its carrying capacity is doubled. If the target is an object, creatures have Advantage on checks to lift, drag, throw, or carry it.
At CL 5, you may make a Tiny object or Tiny willing creature weightless. At CL 11, Small. At CL 17, Medium. A weightless creature or object falls slowly and can be moved by pushing, wind, telekinesis, or physical contact.
Fray - Burden. Fray Mandate can target one creature or object. The target’s weight doubles. A creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it cannot take the Dash action. It also has Disadvantage on checks made to avoid being knocked Prone, shoved, dragged, or pulled.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.mass_mandate:
#### Mass Mandate - Layer
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you use Place Mandate or Fray Mandate, you may spend 2 CP to affect a number of legal targets within range up to your Proficiency Bonus. All targets receive the same Mandate option.
A Mass Mandate uses Mandate Load equal to half the number of affected targets, rounded up, unless used inside your Court of Ten Thousand Mandates.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.name_the_army_s:
#### Name the Army’s Gear - Domain
Prerequisite: Mass Mandate, CL 15+
When you use Mass Mandate on weapons, armor, shields, tools, talismans, or worn equipment, you may affect up to ten Vessels inside range. This Mass Mandate uses only 3 Mandate Load.
If the Mandate is beneficial, all Vessels must be carried by willing creatures. If hostile, each bearer saves separately.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.physique_and_we:
#### Physique and Weakness - Mandate
You command bodily function without permanently refining it.
Imbue - Physique. Place Mandate can target one willing creature. Choose Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. The target has Advantage on ability checks using that ability.
Fray - Weakness. Fray Mandate can target one creature. The target has Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution ability checks.
Physique does not grant permanent Body Refining, extra limbs, natural armor, or maximum HP.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.quicken_and_slo:
#### Quicken and Slow - Mandate
You command motion.
Imbue - Quicken. Place Mandate can target one willing creature or object capable of movement. A creature gains a +10-foot bonus to one movement speed it possesses. The bonus increases to +15 feet at CL 5, +20 feet at CL 11, and +25 feet at CL 17.
Fray - Slow. Fray Mandate can target one creature. Choose one movement speed it possesses. That speed is halved.
Augment 1 CP. When applying Slow, also prevent the target from taking the Disengage action while the Mandate lasts.
Augment 1 CP. When applying Slow, suppress one special movement mode, such as flying, climbing, swimming, or burrowing. If this suppresses natural flight, the target descends safely at 60 feet per round unless another effect causes falling.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.quiet_and_resou:
#### Quiet and Resound - Mandate
You command sound.
Imbue - Quiet. Place Mandate can target one creature or object. Sounds it creates are muffled. Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear it have Disadvantage, and the target has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on sound.
Fray - Resound. Fray Mandate can target one creature or object. Sounds it creates are amplified. Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear it have Advantage, and affected creatures or creatures carrying affected objects have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Quiet does not create magical silence and does not automatically prevent verbal components. Resound does not deal thunder damage unless another feature says so.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.rebel_vessel:
#### Rebel Vessel - Fray
Prerequisite: Animate Minor Vessel, CL 5+
You can Fray a held weapon, worn armor, clothing, or tool by commanding it to resist its bearer.
The bearer makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: choose one effect:
a held weapon or tool imposes Disadvantage on attacks or checks made with it;
armor or clothing Grapples the wearer until the wearer uses an Action to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against your DC, ending the effect on a success;
armor or clothing also Restrains the wearer until the start of your next turn if the save fails by 5 or more.
A soul-bound, artifact-grade, or strongly awakened item may require an opposed Cultivation Check before Rebel Vessel can affect it.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.referential_man:
#### Referential Mandate - Domain
Prerequisite: Court of Ten Thousand Mandates, CL 12+
When you create your Court, you may define one visible or audible criterion such as swords, red robes, unarmored creatures, enemies carrying banners, allies wearing your sect token, doors, chains, lamps, or talismans.
Your free Mandate from the Court can affect only Vessels matching that criterion, but it may affect up to three matching Vessels at once. This counts as one use of the free Court Mandate.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.reflex_edict:
#### Reflex Edict - Mandate
You command reaction timing.
Imbue - Ready Reflex. Place Mandate can target one willing creature. The target has Advantage on Initiative checks. Once per round, the target may make one Opportunity Attack without expending its Reaction. If this Mandate is applied after Initiative has been rolled, the target may reroll Initiative with Advantage and use the higher result if it would improve its turn order starting next round.
