Fray - Lagging Reflex. Fray Mandate can target one creature. The target has Disadvantage on Initiative checks and cannot make Opportunity Attacks. If this Mandate is applied after Initiative has been rolled, the target rerolls Initiative with Disadvantage and uses the lower result if it would worsen its turn order starting next round.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.reverse_the_wei:
#### Reverse the Weight of Heaven - Domain
Prerequisite: Heavy-Light Field, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: Up to ten contiguous 10-foot cubes
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP; once per long rest
You reverse or redirect gravity inside the area.
Choose one direction: up, down, north, south, east, west, or toward a visible anchor point. Unsecured objects and creatures in the area fall in that direction until they strike a surface, exit the area, or reach the boundary.
A creature that can grab a fixed object may make a Dexterity saving throw to secure itself and avoid falling. Creatures with a fly speed may use their movement to resist as normal. When the effect ends, normal gravity resumes.
This is a magical cultivation effect and can be countered by Qiweaving, Space, Earth, Force, or comparable superior gravity law.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.sharpen_and_dul:
#### Sharpen and Dull - Mandate
You command edge, impact, and killing profile.
Imbue - Sharpen. Place Mandate can target one weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or improvised weapon. Choose one:
attacks with the Vessel score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20;
once per turn, the Vessel deals extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
the Vessel counts as a chosen common material for overcoming Resistance or Immunity, such as silvered, cold iron, jade-edged, blessed bronze, or another material approved by the GM.
Fray - Dull. Fray Mandate can target one weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or improvised weapon. Attacks made with it cannot score critical hits, and once per turn when it deals damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.speak_to_the_ve:
#### Speak to the Vessel - Awakening
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Place Mandate can target one object, tree, corpse, construct, or creature with Intelligence 3 or lower. Spend 1 CP.
For the duration, the target gains Intelligence 10 and the ability to speak and understand one language you know. If the target is an object or tree, it gains ordinary human-like senses out to 30 feet.
It is friendly toward you, but it does not automatically obey dangerous commands unless another feature controls it. It does not gain memories from before it was awakened unless the GM rules that the vessel has an existing spirit, inscription, haunting, or record.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.suppress_functi:
#### Suppress Function - Mandate
You command a function to stop.
Fray - Still Tongue. Fray Mandate can target one creature. On a failed save, it cannot speak clearly and cannot provide verbal components or activate techniques requiring clear speech, mantra, roar, chant, or breath-command. If the creature uses telepathy, sign language, writing, or another non-speech communication method, you may instead suppress one such method.
Fray - Seal Sense. Fray Mandate can target one creature. On a failed save, choose Blinded, Deafened, or the loss of one special sense such as Blindsight, Tremorsense, Scent, or a sphere-specific sense. The effect ends if the creature succeeds on its repeat save.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.tempered_equipm:
#### Tempered Equipment - Mandate
You can command the quality of weapons, armor, shields, tools, and improvised objects.
Imbue - Temper. Place Mandate can target a weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, armor, shield, clothing treated as armor, or improvised weapon. The target counts as magical. A weapon or natural weapon gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down. Armor, clothing treated as armor, or a shield gains the same bonus to AC. This does not stack with an existing magical bonus of the same kind; use the higher value.
Fray - Suppress Temper. Fray Mandate can target a weapon, natural weapon, armor, shield, or similar object. Magical bonuses to attack, damage, or AC from that target are suppressed for the duration. Artifact-grade or soul-bound items may require an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.the_edict_that_:
#### The Edict That Names the World Again
Secret Imbuement Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sovereign of the True Name of Things, CL 17+, inheritance scripture or equivalent story breakthrough
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Area: 120-foot-radius Sphere or one colossal visible Vessel
Duration: Until the end of your next turn; some lesser effects last 1 minute
Cost: 10 CP; once per week
You speak an Edict that briefly renames one property of the battlefield.
Choose one Edict:
All Blades Remember Hunger. Willing allies’ weapons in the area count as magical, ignore Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and deal extra damage equal to your Cultivation Level once before the duration ends. Hostile weapons must save or become Dull.
All Armor Forgets Mercy. Willing allies’ armor and shields reduce incoming damage by your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier. Hostile armor and shields must save or lose magical AC bonuses until the end of your next turn.
All Weight Obeys My Palm. Choose up, down, inward, outward, or toward one visible point. Unsecured objects and creatures that fail a Strength saving throw fall or slide in that direction up to 60 feet, taking damage as appropriate if they collide.
All Voices Are Mine to Permit. Willing allies can speak, transmit commands, and use verbal techniques through noise, silence, or distance inside the area. Hostile creatures must save or be unable to speak clearly, use verbal components, or issue command words until the end of your next turn.
All Vessels Wake and Bow. Unattended objects up to Large size in the area animate until the end of your next turn and obey one simple command. Attended objects may save through their bearer. Magic items and artifacts may resist with opposed Cultivation Checks.
All Weakness Becomes Obvious. Until the end of your next turn, you and allies in the area know which of Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is lowest for each hostile creature you can perceive. The first saving throw each hostile creature makes against that ability before the duration ends has Disadvantage.
All False Nature Is Denied. Choose one ongoing enhancement, degradation, polymorph, item buff, weight change, speed alteration, false vigor, animated object, or similar property-changing effect on each hostile target in the area. Make one Imbuement Check against the highest relevant DC. On a success, suppress all chosen effects until the end of your next turn.
Failure or Resistance. A creature, artifact, sect treasure, Secret Inheritance, or superior Realm effect may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check. On a failed Edict against a superior effect, you take psychic or force damage equal to twice your Cultivation Level and cannot use this inheritance again until you complete a major cultivation session.
This inheritance does not permanently rewrite reality, create permanent sentience, forge artifacts, replace Talismans/Formations/Alchemy, or grant ownership of another cultivator’s soul-bound treasure. It is one impossible command, not a new world.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.touch_carried_m:
#### Touch-Carried Mandate - Vessel
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, unarmed strike, natural weapon, or spell attack, you may spend 1 CP to apply one Fray Mandate you know to the target as part of the same attack. The target makes any saving throw normally.
If the attack was made with a weapon, natural weapon, or unarmed strike currently bearing one of your Imbue Mandates, the target has Disadvantage on its first saving throw against the Fray Mandate.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.twin_fray:
#### Twin Fray - Layer
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Fray Mandate, you may spend 2 CP to apply two different Fray options you know to the same target. The target makes one Wisdom saving throw unless a Fray option calls for a different saving throw. On a success, both effects fail. On a failure, both apply.
The effects must target different properties.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.unmake_the_king:
#### Unmake the King’s Armor - Counter
Prerequisite: Suppress Item Spirit, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature wearing, wielding, or carrying imbued, magical, spiritual, or artifact-like equipment
Cost: 4 CP; once per long rest
Choose one item or equipment layer you can perceive. Make an Imbuement Check against the target’s Cultivation Save DC or the item’s DC, whichever is higher.
Success: suppress one equipment-based bonus, defensive property, weapon property, mobility property, or item activation until the end of your next turn. If the target is not artifact-grade or inheritance-grade, the suppression lasts 1 minute.
Failure: the item flares in resistance. You take force damage equal to your Cultivation Level and cannot target that item again until after a long rest.
tianxia.talent.imbuement.venom_retuning:
#### Venom Retuning - Mandate
Prerequisite: CL 5+
This talent is intentionally narrow. It supports poison-adjacent Imbuement but does not replace Alchemy or Poison spheres.
Imbue - Corrosive Venom. Place Mandate can target one dose of poison, natural weapon that deals Poison damage, or object coated with poison. The next time it would deal Poison damage, it deals Acid damage instead.
Imbue - Virulent Edge. Place Mandate can target one dose of poison or natural weapon that inflicts Poison damage or the Poisoned condition. The next creature that saves against that poison before the Mandate ends has Disadvantage on the save.
Fray - Stale Venom. Fray Mandate can target one dose of poison, poison effect, or natural weapon producing poison. Creatures have Advantage on saving throws against that poison effect.
tianxia.talent.ink.binding_script:
#### Binding Script
Talent Type: Mark.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Until the start of your next turn.
Cost: 2 CP.
Target: One creature you can see.
Effect: Characters coil around the target’s limbs. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Marked
Target: If the target already bears one of your Ink Marks, you may use Binding Script as a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
tianxia.talent.ink.black_seal_edict:
#### Black-Seal Edict
Talent Type: Seal.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 6 CP.
Target: One creature bearing one of your Ink Marks.
Effect: Choose one type of action or movement to forbid. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Options: Speak a command, teleport, become Invisible, change shape, open a marked passage, draw a marked weapon, cast through a marked focus, or move farther than 30 feet from the Mark’s current location.
Failed Save: The target cannot perform the forbidden act for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot perform the forbidden act until the start of your next turn.
Restriction: The forbidden act must be narrow and concrete. Black-Seal Edict cannot forbid all attacks, all movement, all magic, or all speech unless a later feature says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.ink.brushstroke_shield:
#### Brushstroke Shield
Talent Type: Reaction.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet is hit by an attack or takes damage from a visible effect.
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: Create a curved stroke of hardened ink. Reduce the damage by 1d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 11, reduce the damage by 2d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 17, reduce the damage by 3d8 + your key ability modifier.
Marked Ally: If the protected creature bears one of your Ink Marks, increase the reduction by your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.ink.concealing_script:
#### Concealing Script
Talent Type: Mark.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: 1 CP.
Target: One object, doorway, container, written page, weapon, tool, corpse, or 5-foot section of wall, floor, or ceiling.
Effect: Place a concealed Ink Mark. The marked subject becomes difficult to notice without becoming physically invisible.
Detection: A creature searching for the subject must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Cultivation Save DC. Magical detection can reveal that something has been concealed, but does not automatically reveal the subject’s full nature unless the detecting effect is appropriate.
Limits: Concealing Script cannot hide a creature unless a later talent allows it. It cannot erase sound, scent, tracks, or physical evidence unless those details are part of the marked subject.
tianxia.talent.ink.heaven_sealing_writ:
#### Heaven-Sealing Writ
Talent Type: Seal.
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 12 CP.
Target: One creature, portal, summoned creature, magic item, possessed body, or active sphere effect bearing one of your Ink Marks.
Effect: Write a heavy sealing character across the target. Make a Cultivation Check against the target’s save DC, effect DC, or a GM-set DC. If the target is a creature, it makes a Charisma saving throw instead.
Success or
Failed Save: Choose one function to suppress for the duration.
Teleportation.
Possession.
Invisibility.
Shapechanging.
Summoning link.
Opening a portal.
One marked item’s active magical function.
One ongoing written, runic, talismanic, or inscription-based effect.
Failure or
Successful Save: The target is disrupted until the start of your next turn, but the full suppression does not take hold.
Restriction: Heaven-Sealing Writ cannot erase a creature’s entire cultivation, remove a class, or permanently destroy an artifact without a separate narrative resolution.
tianxia.talent.ink.hooked_character:
#### Hooked Character
Talent Type: Stroke.
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: When Ink Lash hits
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: The stroke hooks the target. Choose one.
Pull the target up to 10 feet toward one of your Ink Marks within 30 feet of it.
Pull the target up to 10 feet toward you.
Move the target 5 feet to a side space you can see.
Save: If the target is Large or larger, it may make a Strength saving throw to resist the movement. On a success, it is not moved.
tianxia.talent.ink.immortal_scripture:
#### Immortal Scripture
Talent Type: Permanent Inscription.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 8 hours.
Cost: 12 CP.
Materials: Rare ink, jade dust, cinnabar, gold leaf, spirit paper, beast blood, or equivalent materials worth at least 5,000 gp.
Effect: Create one permanent inscription. Choose one purpose.
Hidden archive.
Sealed doorway.
Protected scripture vault.
Long-distance Ink River anchor.
Permanent Concealing Script.
Permanent Revealing Script.
Protective scripture surrounding one building.
Stable Painted Beast guardian.
Permanent warning mark.
Limits: The inscription has visible anchors or physical writing somewhere in the site. It can be studied, damaged, removed, corrupted, overpainted, or ritually contested. Complex inscriptions may require regular maintenance.
Capacity: You may maintain a number of Immortal Scriptures equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.ink.ink_cloud:
#### Ink Cloud
Talent Type: Stroke.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 10-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: Until the start of your next turn.
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: Ink bursts into mist, floating characters, or black rain. The area is lightly obscured. Creatures of your choice inside the area have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight.
Additional
Cost: Spend +1 CP to make the area heavily obscured until the start of your next turn. Wind, water, or strong dispersing effects may end the cloud early.
tianxia.talent.ink.ink_domain:
#### Ink Domain - Painted Battlefield
Talent Type: Domain.
Opening Line: “You entered my painting when you took your first step.”
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 7 CP.
Effect: The battlefield becomes flowing ink, half-finished scenery, floating characters, and painted terrain.
Allies: Allies of your choice ignore difficult terrain caused by this Domain, may Hide while lightly obscured inside it, and gain +2 to checks made to escape Grappled or Restrained.
Enemies: Enemies of your choice treat the area as difficult terrain, have Disadvantage on checks made to detect illusions, traps, and Ink Marks inside the Domain, and cannot benefit from being Invisible while bearing one of your Ink Marks.
Free Mark: Once on each of your turns, you may place one simple Ink Mark on a creature, object, or surface inside the Domain without spending CP or using an action. An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity saving throw as normal.
Boundary: This Domain does not create true illusions by itself. It makes the battlefield resemble a painting and supports Ink effects.
tianxia.talent.ink.ink_doppelganger:
#### Ink Doppelganger
Talent Type: Illustration.
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 4 CP.
Target: One creature you can see.
Effect: Create an ink copy of the target in an unoccupied space. The duplicate has AC 13, 1 HP, Speed 30 feet, and repeats simple gestures, posture, and brief phrases. It can use the Help action and can serve as the origin of your Ink Lash when you take that action.
Limits: The duplicate does not copy statistics, memories, special senses, class features, talents, items, or spells. It disappears when damaged.
Deception: A creature may identify the doppelganger as false with an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Insight) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
tianxia.talent.ink.ink_river_passage:
#### Ink River Passage
Talent Type: Passage.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: 5 CP.
Effect: Create a painted entrance on one surface. Choose another surface bearing one of your Ink Marks within 1 mile. The two surfaces become linked by an Ink River Passage.
Travel: A creature entering one painted doorway exits the other. The passage is two-way and allows one creature through per turn.
Limits: Ink River Passage cannot cross planes, cannot bypass Dimensional Lock, collapses if either Mark is removed, and cannot connect to a place you have not marked.
Space Boundary: Ink River Passage is prepared mark travel. It is not true teleportation, cannot target an unknown destination, and cannot replace Space sphere travel.
tianxia.talent.ink.ink_step:
#### Ink Step
Talent Type: Movement.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet.
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: Teleport between two valid ink-shadow points. Choose one of the following paths.
From your space to an unoccupied space adjacent to one of your visible Ink Marks within range.
From one of your visible Ink Marks within range to an unoccupied space adjacent to another of your visible Ink Marks within range.
From a shadow you occupy to an unoccupied space adjacent to one of your visible Ink Marks within range.
From one of your visible Ink Marks within range to an unoccupied shadow within range.
Limits: Ink Step requires line of effect unless a talent says otherwise. It cannot cross planes, bypass Dimensional Lock, or enter a space you could not physically occupy.
tianxia.talent.ink.living_illustration:
#### Living Illustration
Talent Type: Illustration.
Prerequisite: Painted Beast.
Effect: Improve Painted Beast. Each time you create a Painted Beast, choose one form benefit.
Tiger: Ink Fang damage becomes 3d6 + your key ability modifier.
Crane: The beast gains Fly Speed 50 feet and Hover.
Serpent: When Ink Fang hits, the target makes a Constitution saving throw or is Poisoned until the start of your next turn.
Spider: The beast gains Climb Speed 40 feet. When Ink Fang hits, the target makes a Strength saving throw or its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn.
Horse: The beast’s Speed becomes 60 feet and it may carry two Medium creatures or one Large creature.
Tortoise: The beast’s AC increases by 3 and its Speed becomes 20 feet.
Hound: The beast has Advantage on checks made to track creatures and detect hidden targets.
tianxia.talent.ink.living_seal_script:
#### Living Seal Script
Talent Type: Mark.
Prerequisite: Press Mark.
Effect: When you create an Ink Mark on a surface, object, or willing creature, you may cause the Mark to crawl up to 10 feet along a connected surface or across the marked creature’s body as part of the same action. This movement cannot cross an open gap unless the surfaces touch.
Combat Use: When an unwilling creature successfully saves against one of your Ink Marks, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction to move the failed mark onto one object the creature is carrying or one adjacent surface instead.
tianxia.talent.ink.marked_origin:
#### Marked Origin
Talent Type: Stroke.
Prerequisite: Ink Lash.
Effect: When you use Ink Lash, you may originate the attack from one of your visible Ink Marks within 60 feet instead of from your own space. The target must be within 60 feet of that Mark, and you must have line of effect to the Mark. The Ink Lash does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from your space.
Additional
Cost: Spend 1 CP to ignore cover between you and the target if the chosen Ink Mark has clear line of effect to the target.
tianxia.talent.ink.name_testing_brush:
#### Name-Testing Brush
Talent Type: Revelation.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 5 CP.
Target: One creature, object, or magical disguise you can see.
Effect: Write a testing character in the air. The target makes a Charisma saving throw if unwilling or magically disguised.
Failed Save: You learn whether the target is using a disguise, illusion, shapechanging effect, possession, false name, or projected image. You do not automatically learn the true name.
Successful Save: You sense only whether a supernatural concealment is present, not its type.
True Name Link: If you already know the target’s True Name, it has Disadvantage on this saving throw.
tianxia.talent.ink.painted_beast:
#### Painted Beast
Talent Type: Illustration.
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 4 CP.
Effect: Paint and animate one beastlike construct in an unoccupied space. Choose a hound, tiger, crane, serpent, spider, horse, tortoise, or another appropriate animal shape.
Painted Beast Statistics: The Painted Beast has AC 12 + your Proficiency Bonus, HP equal to 5 x your CL, Speed 40 feet, immunity to Poison damage, and immunity to the Charmed, Frightened, and Poisoned conditions.
Ink Fang: The beast uses your Cultivation Attack Modifier. On a hit, it deals 2d6 + your key ability modifier Slashing damage.
Command: The beast acts immediately after your turn. As a Bonus Action, command it to Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, or Search. Without a command, it Dodges.
Restriction: Only one Painted Beast may be active at a time unless a later talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.ink.painted_law_of_the_sc:
#### Painted Law of the Scene
Talent Type: Domain Rule.
Prerequisite: Ink Domain - Painted Battlefield.
Action Type: Special Trigger
Timing Detail: When you create Ink Domain
Cost: +3 CP.
Effect: Choose one narrow law of the painted scene. The law applies inside your Ink Domain.
Examples: “No one crosses the red bridge without leaving a Mark.” “Spoken lies appear as black characters.” “A creature that breaks a marked object is outlined until the end of its next turn.” “A door painted shut is difficult terrain to pass through.” “Blood spilled in the scene becomes readable as recent movement.”
Mechanical
Restriction: A painted law may impose difficult terrain, reveal a narrow behavior, place a simple Ink Mark, grant Advantage or Disadvantage on a narrow check, or trigger minor damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. It cannot duplicate Fate, rewrite choices, forbid broad actions, or create arbitrary win conditions.
tianxia.talent.ink.perfect_copy_scriptur:
#### Perfect Copy Scripture
Talent Type: Scripture.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Range: Touch.
Duration: Until your next long rest.
Cost: 2 CP.
Target: One nonmagical text, painting, map, diagram, seal, letter, or visible inscription no larger than one 5-foot square or one bound book.
Effect: Create an exact visual copy in Living Ink. The copy preserves visible text, brush pressure, diagrams, stains, tears, marginalia, and artistic detail.
Limits: Perfect Copy Scripture does not duplicate magical power, hidden enchantments, sealed techniques, true names, or active talismans. It may copy what a viewer can see, not what the original secretly contains.
Forgery: If used to deceive, checks made to detect the copy as a copy are contested by your calligrapher’s supplies, painter’s supplies, Intelligence (Investigation), or Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.ink.revealing_script:
#### Revealing Script
Talent Type: Mark.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: 1 CP.
Target: One creature, object, disguise, illusion-covered surface, hidden door, or suspicious mark.
Effect: Place an Ink Mark that reveals what clings to the target. Choose one benefit when you create the Mark.
Invisible creatures bearing the Mark remain visible to you.
Disguises do not conceal the Mark from you.
You know the Mark’s direction while it is within 1 mile.
Illusions covering the marked subject are easier to recognize; you have Advantage on checks to disbelieve or identify those illusions.
Hidden writing, seals, and altered inscriptions on the marked subject become visible to you.
Unwilling Creature: The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, the Mark fails.
tianxia.talent.ink.scripted_technique:
#### Scripted Technique
Talent Type: Scripture.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour.
Cost: 5 CP.
Target: One scroll, painting, robe panel, fan, stone inscription, jade slip, or similar prepared medium.
Effect: Record one Tier 1 sphere talent or one base Cultivation Attack you know into the medium. The stored technique uses your Cultivation Save DC and Cultivation Attack Modifier.
Activation: A creature holding or touching the medium may activate the stored technique as an action. The medium is destroyed or rendered spiritually blank after activation.
Limits: Scripted Technique cannot store a Reaction, Domain, Forged Technique, crafting talent, Secret Inheritance, Legendary effect, or talent with a minimum Realm above Mortal unless the GM allows an advanced version.
Capacity: You may maintain a number of Scripted Techniques equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Creating another beyond this limit causes the oldest to fade.
tianxia.talent.ink.scripture_prison:
#### Scripture Prison
Talent Type: Seal.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 6 CP.
Target: One creature you can see.
Effect: Characters wrap around the target. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. The target may also use its action to make a Strength check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet and it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Marked
Target: If the target bears one of your Ink Marks, it has Disadvantage on the first saving throw against Scripture Prison.
tianxia.talent.ink.scripture_wall:
#### Scripture Wall
Talent Type: Scripture.
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 4 CP.
Effect: Create a wall of hardened characters on a solid surface. The wall may be up to 20 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick. It may be straight, curved, or segmented as long as every segment touches another segment.
Statistics: The wall has AC 14, HP equal to 10 x your Proficiency Bonus, and immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
Shape: The wall may provide cover, block a passage, support weight like a temporary bridge, or form a barrier against movement. It cannot appear inside a creature’s space.
Marked Wall: You may place one simple Ink Mark on the Scripture Wall when you create it.
tianxia.talent.ink.seal_the_passage:
#### Seal the Passage
Talent Type: Seal.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: 3 CP.
Target: One doorway, window, gate, chest, box, scroll case, cave mouth, hatch, or similar opening.
Effect: Place a sealing Ink Mark. Opening, crossing, or forcing the sealed passage requires one of the following against your Cultivation Save DC.
Strength check to force it.
Dexterity check or thieves’ tools check to bypass it.
Cultivation Check to disrupt the seal.
Appropriate dispelling or anti-script effect.
Failure: A creature that fails cannot try again until the start of its next turn.
Alarm: You may spend +1 CP when creating the seal. If you do, you know when the seal is broken while you are within 1 mile.
tianxia.talent.ink.soul_staining_ink:
#### Soul-Staining Ink
Talent Type: Mark.
Prerequisite: Revealing Script.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 3 CP.
Target: One creature you can see.
Effect: The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: A stain appears on the target’s spiritual outline. For the duration, it cannot benefit from being Invisible against you, and it cannot Hide from you while within 60 feet unless it has total cover.
Successful Save: The target is outlined until the start of your next turn and cannot benefit from being Invisible against you during that time.
Spirit Use: Against ghosts, spirits, incorporeal creatures, and possessing entities, the target has Disadvantage on the saving throw if you have Soul Ink.
tianxia.talent.ink.ten_thousand_illustra:
#### Ten Thousand Illustrated Soldiers
Talent Type: Strategic Illustration.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour.
Duration: 24 hours.
Cost: 15 CP.
Use Limit: Once per week.
Effect: Paint an army of lesser constructs. The soldiers function as a strategic force for sieges, sect defense, battlefield control, intimidation, evacuation, or labor.
Encounter Representation: During an ordinary encounter, represent the army with up to two Painted Formations.
Painted Formation Statistics: AC 13 + your Proficiency Bonus, HP equal to 10 x your CL, Speed 30 feet.
Formation Assault: Uses your Cultivation Attack Modifier. On a hit, it deals 4d8 + your key ability modifier Slashing damage. Below half HP, this damage becomes 2d8 + your key ability modifier.
Limits: A Painted Formation occupies a large battlefield area and cannot fit into cramped spaces. It is not a normal summon and cannot solve precision tasks.
tianxia.talent.ink.thousand_brushstrokes:
#### Thousand Brushstrokes
Talent Type: Stroke.
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot cone.
Cost: 3 CP.
Effect: Creatures in the area make Dexterity saving throws as cutting characters fill the air.
Failed Save: A creature takes 4d6 Slashing damage.
Successful Save: A creature takes half damage.
Scaling: At CL 11, the damage becomes 6d6. At CL 17, the damage becomes 8d6.
Marked Ground: If the cone originates from one of your Ink Marks, increase the cone to 20 feet.
tianxia.talent.ink.true_name_calligraphy:
### Secret Inheritance - True Name Calligraphy
Opening Line: “Everything has a name. A thing written correctly cannot pretend to be anything else.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Immortal Scripture, and discovery of the target’s True Name.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 15 CP.
Use Limit: Once per week.
Effect: Write one creature’s True Name into the air. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For the duration, the target cannot become Invisible, cannot change shape, cannot teleport, cannot benefit from a disguise or illusion, has Disadvantage on saving throws against your Ink talents, and you always know its location while it remains on the same plane and within 1 mile. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot become Invisible or change shape until the start of its next turn.
True Name
Requirement: Discovering a True Name should require meaningful research, investigation, oath testimony, spirit interrogation, ancestral records, karmic proof, or narrative access. A nickname, public title, legal name, sect name, or assumed name is not enough unless the campaign defines it as true.
Boundary: True Name Calligraphy reveals and fixes identity. It does not by itself command fate, steal a soul, rewrite a life, or permanently erase a being.
tianxia.talent.ink.vermilion_correction:
#### Vermilion Correction
Talent Type: Word-like Script.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 30 feet that bears one of your Ink Marks makes an ability check.
Cost: 1 CP.
Effect: The mark flashes with a correcting stroke. Add or subtract 1d4 from the roll. You must choose before the GM announces whether the roll succeeds or fails.
Use Limit: A creature can be affected by Vermilion Correction only once per round.
Design Note: This is a narrow mark-based correction, not general Fate manipulation.
tianxia.talent.ink.wet_ink_warning:
#### Wet Ink Warning
Talent Type: Mark.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: 1 CP.
Target: One object, doorway, container, weapon, corpse, or 5-foot section of terrain.
Effect: Place an Ink Mark that warns you when disturbed. Until the duration ends, you mentally know when a creature touches, opens, crosses, damages, or moves the marked target while you are within 1 mile.
Hidden Warning: A concealed Wet Ink Warning can be found like a concealed Ink Mark. A creature that finds it may avoid triggering it with a successful Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), thieves’ tools, calligrapher’s supplies, or Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
tianxia.talent.ink.world_as_canvas:
#### World as Canvas
Talent Type: Domain-Scale Scripture.
Opening Line: “The mountain is unfinished. Allow me to add one stroke.”
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere.
Duration: 1 minute.
Concentration: Required.
Cost: 12 CP.
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
Effect: Reshape the battlefield through living calligraphy. Choose three effects when you create World as Canvas.
Create up to three Scripture Walls.
Cover the ground in difficult terrain for enemies of your choice.
Create obscuring painted mist in up to three 10-foot-radius areas.
Create a bridge, ramp, stair, screen, platform, or curtain of ink.
Open one Ink River Passage between two marked surfaces inside the area without the normal ritual time.
Summon two Painted Beasts.
Place Revealing Script on any number of creatures of your choice inside the area.
Create one 20-foot-radius zone of Binding Script.
Binding Zone: A creature entering a Binding Script zone for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is Restrained until the start of its next turn. On a success, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.iron_fist.the_fist_that_t:
##### The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch
“Heaven did not fall. It only stepped back. For one breath, that was enough.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sovereign Iron-Body Incarnation, hidden iron-body scripture
Action Type: Action
Range: Reach, or 60 feet through Breath-Extended Strike
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
Make one Unarmed Strike against one creature, object, temporary Barrier, or supernatural defensive effect.
Before rolling:
gain Advantage;
ignore Disadvantage;
treat the target as Opened;
your attack ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage;
if the attack targets an object or temporary Barrier, ignore ordinary object Damage Thresholds.
Hit: Add 12d10 Force or Thunder damage.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose three consequences.
The target is Stunned until the end of your next turn.
The target falls Prone and cannot stand until the start of your next turn.
The target cannot take Reactions for 1 minute.
The target’s Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
Suppress one non-Secret bodily, martial, or movement technique affecting the target for 1 minute.
Apply three seals from Meridian-Sealing Palm for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending one seal on a success.
Move the target up to 30 feet in one legal direction without triggering Brute Collision talents.
You immediately move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Successful Save: Choose one consequence other than Stunned.
If the target is an object, temporary Barrier, Formation Anchor, or defensive effect, deal double total damage and make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s rank or DC.
Successful Check: Breach, suppress, or shatter one defensive layer until the end of your next turn.
Failed Check: The target is damaged but not breached.
The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch does not automatically destroy:
artifacts;
permanent Formations;
Domains;
Secret Inheritances;
Realm-defining structures;
cosmic offices;
living worlds;
Heaven itself.
Those may still be meaningfully damaged, humiliated, interrupted, or turned into the subject of a campaign.
tianxia.talent.jester.a_fine_display:
### A Fine Display - Punchline
Compatible Proposition: Strike the Fool
Resolve after the attack roll.
If the triggering attack misses:
move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil;
the Foil becomes Flustered.
If the triggering attack hits, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.jester.after_you_honored_:
### After You, Honored Guest - Punchline, Pratfall
Compatible Proposition: Come Closer
Move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil.
Then the Foil makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Fall Prone.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
Your movement must end in a legal unoccupied space.
tianxia.talent.jester.applaud_the_master:
### Applaud the Master - Punchline
Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool
Choose the creature targeted by the triggering attack roll or harmful effect.
That creature gains:
+2 AC
against the triggering attack roll, or:
+2
to one saving throw against the triggering effect.
Apply the bonus only to the triggering roll.
If the attack misses or the saving throw succeeds, the Foil becomes Flustered.
tianxia.talent.jester.banquet_escape:
### Banquet Escape - Punchline, Pratfall
Prerequisite: CL 5+Compatible Proposition: Strike the Fool
Resolve after the triggering attack roll.
Move up to half your Speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil.
If this movement places you outside the triggering attack’s reach or range, the attack misses.
If the attack still hits, reduce its damage by:
2d6 + Charisma modifier
tianxia.talent.jester.court_of_words_wit:
### Court of Words Without Offense - Martial Domain
“Everyone heard the joke. Nobody agreed on who the fool had been.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
For the duration:
creatures inside can hear you clearly unless Deafened or prevented by a stronger effect;
use Set the Scene once at the start of each of your turns without spending a Bonus Action;
when one ally inside is missed by an attack roll, it moves 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the attacker;
when one Foil inside becomes Flustered, choose one ally inside to gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
once per round, deliver one Punchline without spending your Reaction.
You may still use your Reaction for a different Punchline when legal.
Court of Words Without Offense does not force creatures to laugh, understand your language, or become Charmed.
tianxia.talent.jester.dancing_fool:
### Dancing Fool - Pratfall
When you Disengage, move through allied spaces without treating them as difficult terrain until the end of the turn.
Once during that movement, pass through one hostile creature’s space if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Treat that hostile space as difficult terrain and do not end movement there.
tianxia.talent.jester.dongfang_shuo_s_co:
### Dongfang Shuo’s Court-Hermit Step - Pratfall, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature misses you with an attack, you succeed on a saving throw against a harmful effect, or one of your Punchlines resolves
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Move up to your Speed.
During this movement:
do not provoke opportunity attacks;
pass through hostile spaces as difficult terrain if the creature is no more than one size larger than you;
do not end movement in an occupied space;
Hide as part of this Reaction if you end Heavily Obscured or behind Total Cover and otherwise meet the 2024 Hide requirements.
tianxia.talent.jester.excellent_idea:
### Excellent Idea - Punchline, Mock-Praise
Compatible Proposition: Show Your Hand
The Foil makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It becomes Flustered and has Disadvantage on the first Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Excellent Idea does not cancel the triggering technique.
tianxia.talent.jester.false_opening:
### False Opening - Pratfall, Focus
At the start of your turn, choose to take:
-2 AC
until the start of your next turn.
The first time a creature misses you with an attack roll before the penalty ends:
regain Martial Focus if absent;
move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature.
tianxia.talent.jester.focused_applause:
### Focused Applause - Focus
When your Punchline causes an attack to miss, causes a saving throw to succeed, or makes a creature fall Prone, regain Martial Focus if absent.
tianxia.talent.jester.grand_entrance:
### Grand Entrance - Setup
When Initiative is rolled, use Set the Scene without spending a Bonus Action.
If you are Surprised, use Grand Entrance after your first turn begins instead.
tianxia.talent.jester.mock_praise_script:
### Mock-Praise Scripture - Setup, Mock-Praise
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When using Set the Scene, choose two different Propositions.
The first one fulfilled permits one compatible Punchline and ends Set the Scene normally.
tianxia.talent.jester.mocking_heaven_s_d:
### Mocking Heaven’s Decree
Prerequisite: Reductio ad Absurdum, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One creature you can see within 60 feet activates a Domain, Realm Evolution, or ordinary supernatural technique costing at least 5 CP or an equivalent resource
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
The creature chooses one:
abandon the triggering technique before paying its cost or expending its use;
resolve the technique normally and become Flustered until the end of your next turn;
resolve the technique normally and allow one ally you can see to move up to its Speed, take the Dodge action, or take the Help action immediately.
Mocking Heaven’s Decree does not cancel Secret Inheritances.
tianxia.talent.jester.painted_wall_no_sh:
### Painted Wall, No Shade - Punchline, Mock-Praise
Prerequisite: CL 10+Compatible Proposition: Come Closer or Show Your Hand
Choose one visible temporary Barrier, conjured wall, created area of Cover, or terrain-altering supernatural effect involved in the triggering movement or technique.
Make a Jester Cultivation Check:
d20 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus
against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC, named sphere Save DC, or spell save DC.
Successful Check: Suppress one 10-foot section or one 5-foot square until the start of your next turn.Failed Check: No effect.
Painted Wall, No Shade does not suppress Domains, Formation cores, artifacts, or Realm-defining structures.
tianxia.talent.jester.pratfall_exit:
### Pratfall Exit - Pratfall
When you fall Prone or deliberately drop Prone, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
Use Pratfall Exit once per round.
Standing from Prone still costs movement normally.
tianxia.talent.jester.reductio_ad_absurd:
### Reductio ad Absurdum - Punchline, Mock-Praise
Prerequisite: CL 10+Compatible Proposition: Show Your Hand
Before the Foil resolves the triggering supernatural technique, present the contradiction in its overcommitment.
The Foil chooses one:
abandon the triggering technique before paying its cost or expending its use;
resolve the technique normally, then become Flustered and take 4d8 Psychic damage.
A creature immune to Psychic damage may still choose either option and may still become Flustered.
Reductio ad Absurdum does not affect Domains, Secret Inheritances, or techniques whose activation cannot reasonably be abandoned once begun.
tianxia.talent.jester.ridiculous_weapon:
### Ridiculous Weapon
Gain proficiency with improvised weapons.
When you attack with an improvised weapon, use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack roll and damage roll if higher.
A harmless prop, folding fan, bowl, ladle, painted sign, bench, fruit, slipper, or similar object normally deals:
1d4 Bludgeoning damage
unless the GM determines that it closely resembles another weapon.
Once per turn when you hit with an improvised weapon, choose one:
apply Set the Scene to the target without spending a Bonus Action, choosing Strike the Fool;
move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target;
the target has Disadvantage on its next Opportunity Attack before the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.jester.ten_thousand_masks:
### Ten-Thousand Masks Procession
Prerequisite: Thousand Faces, One Mistake, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
A procession of roles, gestures, jokes, and impossible changes of posture fills the area.
#### Allies
gain +10 feet Speed;
gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened;
take the Help action as a Bonus Action once during the duration;
move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks when a hostile creature inside becomes Flustered, once per round.
#### Enemies
When one enemy enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
become Flustered;
reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
suffer Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of its next turn;
cannot take Bonus Actions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Ten-Thousand Masks Procession is a visible supernatural performance.
It does not automatically create convincing visual Illusions outside its explicit effects.
tianxia.talent.jester.the_audience_choos:
### The Audience Chooses the Hero - Punchline
Prerequisite: CL 10+Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool
Choose the ally targeted by the triggering attack or harmful effect.
Until the start of your next turn, the ally gains:
+2 AC;
Advantage on Dexterity saving throws;
Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus.
If the triggering effect misses or fails against the ally, the Foil becomes Flustered.
tianxia.talent.jester.the_whole_court_la:
### The Whole Court Laughs
Prerequisite: Court of Words Without Offense, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: Your Foil rolls a natural 1 on a d20 Test, misses an attack by 5 or more, or fails a saving throw against one of your Jester talents by 5 or more
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
The Foil makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn:
become Flustered;
Speed becomes 0;
cannot take Bonus Actions;
attack rolls against it have Advantage.
Successful Save: Become Flustered.
This technique targets self-possession and battle rhythm, not social identity.
tianxia.talent.jester.thrown_slipper_reb:
### Thrown Slipper Rebuke - Punchline
Prerequisite: Ridiculous Weapon, CL 5+Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool or Show Your Hand
Make one improvised-weapon ranged attack against the Foil with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet.
Hit: Deal normal improvised-weapon damage and choose one:
the Foil becomes Flustered;
reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
one ally targeted by the triggering effect moves 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil.
The thrown prop returns to your hand, lands in a legal space nearby, or is replaced with another appropriate prop as the fiction allows.
tianxia.talent.jester.too_proud_to_stop:
### Too Proud to Stop - Setup, Mock-Praise
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When your Foil fulfills a Proposition and you do not deliver a Punchline, preserve Set the Scene until the start of your next turn.
If the Foil fulfills one of your Propositions again before Set the Scene ends, use one compatible Punchline without spending your Reaction.
Use Too Proud to Stop once per round.
tianxia.talent.jester.words_without_offe:
### Words Without Offense
Gain Expertise in Charisma (Performance).
When you take the Influence action to amuse, criticize indirectly, or deliver unwelcome advice through humor, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10.
Words Without Offense does not allow a repugnant request to succeed automatically.
tianxia.talent.jester.you_meng_s_borrowe:
### You Meng’s Borrowed Robes - Borrowed-Role
Prerequisite: Borrowed Expression, CL 5+
After observing one creature for at least 10 minutes, create a studied role.
While performing that role:
gain Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks made to imitate the creature’s mannerisms;
gain Advantage on one Influence check made against a creature familiar with the imitated person;
once per short rest, when a creature familiar with the imitated person targets you with an attack or harmful effect, impose Disadvantage on one attack roll or gain Advantage on one saving throw against that effect.
This talent does not change your physical appearance, clothing, voice, memories, authority, or legal identity automatically.
A disguise, Illusion, or forged documents may improve the performance.
tianxia.talent.karma.break_the_crooked_o:
#### Break the Crooked Oath
Tags: Oath, Thread, Judgment
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 3 CP
Target: One oath, contract, bargain, or supernatural obligation you can perceive
Make a Karma Check against the effect’s DC. If the effect has no DC, use 10 + the creator’s Proficiency Bonus + the creator’s key ability modifier, or a GM-set DC for ancient or divine effects.
Success: You learn whether the oath was willingly accepted, coerced, forged, impossible, or corrupted. If it was coerced, forged, or impossible, suppress one penalty from the oath until the end of your next turn.
Success by 5 or More: Suppress the penalty for 1 minute instead.
Failure: You learn only that the oath resists you.
Break the Crooked Oath does not end a valid Great Oath or Secret bond by itself.
tianxia.talent.karma.burden_of_deeds:
#### Burden of Deeds
Tags: Debt, Judgment
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Requirement: Target carries at least one of your Debt Imprints
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For each Debt Imprint it carries, choose one burden:
Speed reduced by 5 feet;
-1 penalty to attack rolls;
-1 penalty to saving throws;
cannot take Reactions;
Disadvantage on the next ability check it makes before the end of its next turn.
You may choose the same burden more than once if it is mathematically meaningful, except cannot take Reactions.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Burden of Deeds does not consume Debt Imprints.
tianxia.talent.karma.chain_of_consequenc:
#### Chain of Consequence
Tags: Debt, Reflection, Judgment
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 5 CP and three Debt Imprints
Target: One creature carrying at least three of your Debt Imprints
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The next time the target deals damage before the end of your next turn, it takes the same amount of Psychic damage.
Maximum Psychic damage: 10 x your CL.
Successful Save: The target takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Chain of Consequence consumes three Debt Imprints.
tianxia.talent.karma.clean_hands:
#### Clean Hands
Tags: Ledger, Mercy
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You would place a Debt Imprint on a creature whose harmful act was accidental, coerced, mindless, or performed under domination
Cost: None
You may choose not to place the Debt Imprint. If you do, you may instead place one Debt Imprint on the creature, spirit, oath, curse, or controller responsible for the coercion, if you can identify it and it is within 120 feet.
If the responsible source is not valid or present, you learn only that the visible actor was not the true debtor.
tianxia.talent.karma.debt_follows_the_ha:
#### Debt Follows the Hand
Tags: Debt, Ledger
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can see commands, coerces, dominates, summons, or orders another creature to cause a harmful Cause
Cost: 1 CP
Place the Debt Imprint from Record the Deed on the commander instead of the visible actor. If both are responsible, you may place one Debt Imprint on each, but this counts as your use of Record the Deed for the round and costs 1 additional CP.
tianxia.talent.karma.debt_written_on_bon:
#### Debt Written on Bone
Tags: Debt, Judgment
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP and one Debt Imprint
Expend one Debt Imprint on a creature. The next time the creature deals damage before the duration ends, choose one:
it takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier;
it cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn;
it gains no benefit from Advantage on that attack roll or saving throw.
Debt Written on Bone ends after triggering.
tianxia.talent.karma.delayed_price:
#### Delayed Price
Tags: Debt, Mercy
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet would take damage from one of your Karma talents
Cost: 1 CP
Delay that damage until the end of the target’s next turn. Record the amount and type. If the target apologizes sincerely, repairs the immediate harm, or accepts a meaningful burden before the delayed damage occurs, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
Delayed Price cannot delay damage from Secret Inheritances or Legendary Karma effects unless they say so.
tianxia.talent.karma.fate_deferred:
#### Fate Deferred
Tags: Mercy, Thread
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet would take damage
Cost: 5 CP
Delay the damage until the end of the target’s next turn. Record the amount and damage type.
Before the damage arrives, other effects may reduce it, redirect it, absorb it, heal the target, move the target, make the target immune, or satisfy a condition that a Karma talent recognizes as repayment.
If the target leaves the plane before the damage arrives, the damage occurs immediately before it departs unless a Legendary or Secret effect prevents it.
Fate Deferred does not erase consequence. It gives the table one turn to answer it.
tianxia.talent.karma.grace_repaid:
#### Grace Repaid
Tags: Grace, Mercy
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature carrying one of your Grace Imprints takes damage within 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Grace Imprint
Reduce the damage by 1d8 + your key ability modifier.
At CL 5, reduction becomes 2d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 11, 3d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 17, 4d8 + your key ability modifier.
tianxia.talent.karma.grace_shelters_the_:
#### Grace Shelters the Innocent
Tags: Grace, Mercy
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature carrying one of your Grace Imprints fails a saving throw against a harmful effect
Cost: 2 CP and one Grace Imprint
Add 1d6 to the saving throw. If this turns failure into success, the creature also gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the effect would also harm a creature bound by your Red Thread of Fellowship, that bound creature gains the same Temporary HP.
tianxia.talent.karma.harm_returned:
#### Harm Returned
Tags: Debt, Reflection
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with at least two of your Debt Imprints deals damage to you or an ally within 60 feet
Cost: 3 CP and two Debt Imprints
The triggering creature takes Psychic damage equal to half the triggering damage, rounded down.
Maximum reflected damage: 5 x your CL.
Reflected damage cannot itself trigger Harm Returned, Return the Sting, or similar effects.
tianxia.talent.karma.heavenly_retributio:
#### Heavenly Retribution
Tags: Debt, Judgment
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Requirement: Target carries at least three of your Debt Imprints
Choose one creature. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 4d10 Psychic or Radiant damage per Debt Imprint consumed, to a maximum number of consumed Imprints equal to your Proficiency Bonus. The target is Stunned until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
All Debt Imprints on the target are consumed.
tianxia.talent.karma.judgment_writ:
#### Judgment Writ
Tags: Oath, Judgment, Debt
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 6 CP
Requirement: Target carries at least one of your Debt Imprints or has broken one of your Oath talents
You write a visible writ of grievance in the target’s aura. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For the duration, the first time each turn the target repeats the same type of harmful Cause that earned the Debt, it takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
Successful Save: The writ lasts until the end of your next turn instead.
The writ can be removed early if the target sincerely repairs the harm, accepts a comparable burden, or receives a superior cleansing effect.
Judgment Writ counts against Karmic Load.
tianxia.talent.karma.karma_sovereign_inc:
#### Karma-Sovereign Incarnation
Tags: Secret, Ledger, Judgment, MercyRealm: Nascent Soul
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You manifest as a living judge of consequence. Red and gold threads coil around your soul, and the air fills with silent tally marks.
For the duration:
your Record the Deed range becomes 300 feet;
you may record Causes you perceive through allied senses, oath marks, or Red Thread Network;
once per turn, when you spend a Debt Imprint, you may deal additional Psychic or Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
once per turn, when you spend a Grace Imprint, the protected or aided creature gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
you have Advantage on Karma Checks to read, suppress, or contest oaths, curses, possession bonds, and supernatural obligations.
When the Incarnation ends, you gain one Karmic Burden. Until you finish a long rest, the next time you break a meaningful promise or knowingly ignore a debt, you cannot regain CP until you make restitution or finish another long rest.
tianxia.talent.karma.karmic_exchange:
#### Karmic Exchange
Tags: Debt, Grace, Ledger
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet rolls an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw
Cost: 3 CP and one matching Imprint
After seeing the roll but before knowing the result, choose one:
expend one Debt Imprint on the creature to subtract 1d6 from the roll;
expend one Grace Imprint on the creature to add 1d6 to the roll.
A roll can be affected by only one Karmic Exchange.
At CL 17, the die becomes 1d8.
tianxia.talent.karma.karmic_mirror:
#### Karmic Mirror
Tags: Reflection, Debt, Grace
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or a creature bound to you by a Karma talent is targeted by a hostile single-target effect
Cost: 4 CP and one matching Imprint
If the attacker carries one of your Debt Imprints, expend it and force the attacker to make a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The attacker is also affected by the hostile effect if it is a legal target.
Successful Save: The attacker takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
If the defender carries one of your Grace Imprints, you may instead expend that Grace Imprint to give the defender Advantage on the saving throw or impose Disadvantage on the attack roll.
Karmic Mirror cannot reflect area effects, Secret effects, or effects with no meaningful source unless the GM permits it.
tianxia.talent.karma.karmic_sight:
#### Karmic Sight
Tags: Ledger, Thread
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
For the duration, you can see obvious karmic pressure as symbolic threads. You know when a creature you can see gains or spends one of your Karmic Imprints. You also have Advantage on Wisdom or Intelligence checks made to identify oaths, contracts, curses, possession bonds, supernatural guilt, or consequence-bearing locations.
Once during the duration, you may use Ledger Eye without spending an action.
tianxia.talent.karma.ledger_seal_scriptu:
#### Ledger Seal Scripture
Tags: Ledger, SecretRealm: Foundation
Your Ledger becomes a stable seal rather than a fleeting perception.
Benefits:
Your maximum Karmic Imprints per creature increases by 1.
Imprints on creatures bound by your Oath talents last until your next long rest plus one additional day.
Once per round, when you use Record the Deed, you may spend 1 CP to place the Imprint without using your Reaction.
Your Ledger Eye can identify whether a visible oath was willingly accepted, coerced, forged, or corrupted, though it does not reveal all terms automatically.
tianxia.talent.karma.mandate_of_heaven:
#### Mandate of Heaven
Tags: Oath, Domain, Judgment
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Duration: 30 days
Cost: 12 CP
Write a visible karmic law into one location no larger than a major building, courtyard, sect hall, shrine, gatehouse, or ship.
Choose one clearly stated condition. Examples include:
no weapon may be drawn here;
no creature may lie within this hall;
no creature may enter while concealing hostile intent;
no spirit may possess another creature here;
no teleportation may cross this threshold;
no disciple may spill sect blood in this room.
When a creature knowingly violates the law, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 6d10 Psychic or Radiant damage, gains the maximum number of Debt Imprints you can place on it, and is Frightened until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and gains one Debt Imprint.
Mandate of Heaven does not physically prevent violation. It punishes violation.
Only one Mandate of Heaven created by you may exist at a time.
tianxia.talent.karma.merit_becomes_armor:
#### Merit Becomes Armor
Tags: Grace, Mercy
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP and one Grace Imprint
Choose one creature carrying your Grace Imprint. Expend the Imprint. For the duration, the creature gains:
+1 AC;
Advantage on saving throws against Frightened;
the first time each round it prevents damage, restores HP, or protects another creature at personal risk, it gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.karma.no_lie_before_the_l:
#### No Lie Before the Ledger
Tags: Ledger, Oath, Judgment
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 8 CP
For the duration, creatures of your choice inside the aura feel the pressure of witnessed truth.
When an affected creature knowingly speaks a direct lie, breaks a promise made during the aura, or conceals a required answer after agreeing to speak, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 4d8 Psychic damage and gains one Debt Imprint.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and does not gain an Imprint.
This talent does not force a creature to speak. It punishes falsehood after the creature chooses to speak under the Ledger.
tianxia.talent.karma.oath_of_mutual_defe:
#### Oath of Mutual Defense
Tags: Oath, Grace, Mercy
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 3 CP
Bind up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures in an oath of shared defense.
Once per round, when a bound creature within 60 feet of another bound creature takes damage, another bound creature may use its Reaction to take half the damage, rounded down. The original target takes the remaining damage.
Damage transferred this way cannot be transferred again.
If a bound creature willingly takes damage for another through this oath, you may place one Grace Imprint on that creature without using your Reaction. This can occur only once per round.
Oath of Mutual Defense counts against Karmic Load.
tianxia.talent.karma.red_thread_network:
#### Red Thread Network
Tags: Thread, Grace, Ledger
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 6 CP
Create a network among up to twice your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures.
While two bound creatures are on the same plane, each knows the direction of the nearest other bound creature. While within 120 feet of one another, bound creatures also know when another bound creature is Bloodied, Unconscious, Dying, Charmed, Frightened, or possessed.
Once per round, when a bound creature creates a Grace Cause, you may place one Grace Imprint on a different bound creature who benefits from that Cause.
Red Thread Network counts against Karmic Load.
tianxia.talent.karma.red_thread_of_fello:
#### Red Thread of Fellowship
Tags: Thread, Grace
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 2 CP
Bind yourself and up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures with red threads of mutual recognition.
While bound creatures are within 60 feet of one another, each bound creature knows:
whether another bound creature is Bloodied, Unconscious, or Dying;
the direction of each other bound creature;
when another bound creature gains one of your Karmic Imprints.
Once during the duration, when a bound creature fails a saving throw, another bound creature may use its Reaction and expend one Grace Imprint it carries to add 1d4 to the failed save, potentially turning failure into success.
Red Thread of Fellowship counts against Karmic Load.
tianxia.talent.karma.return_the_sting:
#### Return the Sting
Tags: Debt, Reflection
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature with one of your Debt Imprints deals damage to you or an ally within 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Debt Imprint
The triggering creature takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
At CL 11, add 1d8 Psychic damage. At CL 17, add 2d8 Psychic damage.
This damage cannot trigger another Return the Sting.
tianxia.talent.karma.reversal_of_due_for:
#### Reversal of Due Fortune
Tags: Debt, Grace, Ledger
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet rolls a natural 1 or natural 20
Cost: 4 CP and one matching Imprint
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You do not change luck. You call due consequence at the most dramatic possible moment.
Choose one:
expend one Grace Imprint on the creature to turn a natural 1 into a natural 20;
expend one Debt Imprint on the creature to turn a natural 20 into a natural 1.
A Legendary or Secret effect may resist this technique with a Charisma saving throw or opposed check.
This is a Karma effect, not a Fate effect, because it requires a matching Imprint.
tianxia.talent.karma.shared_merit:
#### Shared Merit
Tags: Grace, Mercy
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Grace Imprint
Choose one creature carrying one of your Grace Imprints. Expend the Imprint and choose another willing creature within 30 feet of the target. Both creatures gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
If one of the creatures is bound to the other by Red Thread of Fellowship, increase the Temporary HP by your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.karma.ten_thousand_debts_:
#### Ten Thousand Debts Return to Source
Tags: Debt, Reflection, Judgment
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature you can perceive that has created at least one major Debt Cause in the last 24 hours and carries at least one of your Debt Imprints. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the first time the target damages another creature, inflicts a harmful condition, or commands another creature to do so, the consequence returns to it. It takes Psychic damage equal to the damage it caused, or 8d10 Psychic damage if the Cause did not deal damage.
Successful Save: The target takes 4d10 Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Ten Thousand Debts Return to Source cannot trigger from damage it deals to the target.
tianxia.talent.karma.thread_of_pursuit:
#### Thread of Pursuit
Tags: Thread, Ledger
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 1 CP
Touch one creature, object, corpse, bloodstain, oath-token, or location. You know the direction to the target while it remains on the same plane and within 10 miles x your Proficiency Bonus.
If used on an unwilling creature, the target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Successful Save: The technique fails.
A creature carrying one of your Debt Imprints makes this save with Disadvantage.
Thread of Pursuit counts against Karmic Load.
tianxia.talent.karma.trial_of_the_ledger:
#### Trial of the Ledger
Tags: Judgment, Debt, Grace
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Choose one creature carrying at least two of your Karmic Imprints. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature enters a spiritual trial. Until the effect ends, the first time each turn it creates a Debt Cause, it takes 2d8 Psychic damage. The first time each turn it creates a Grace Cause, it gains Temporary HP equal to 2d8.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target creates a Debt Cause, it takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier.
The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the trial on a success.
Trial of the Ledger does not force the target to act. It makes action reveal consequence.
tianxia.talent.karma.witness_seal:
#### Witness Seal
Tags: Ledger, Oath
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet makes a clear promise, confession, accusation, or bargain
Cost: 1 CP
Duration: 24 hours
You seal the words as witnessed testimony. For the duration, you know if the same creature knowingly contradicts the sealed statement within 60 feet of you.
If the statement was a promise and the creature breaks it during the duration, you may use Record the Deed on the oath-breaking even if you cannot see the creature, as long as it is on the same plane.
Witness Seal does not prove whether the original statement was true. It records the fact that the words were spoken.
tianxia.talent.life.break_enchantment:
#### Break Enchantment - Purification
You can use Purify the Pulse to suppress hostile cultivation effects, curses, and magical afflictions.
Augment - 1 CP: When you use Purify the Pulse, you may attempt to remove one ongoing magical, spiritual, or cultivation effect from the target.
Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC. If the effect has no listed save DC, the GM sets an appropriate DC.
Success: The effect ends on the target.
Failure: The effect is not removed, but Purify the Pulse still resolves normally against any disease or condition you chose.
Break Enchantment can suppress the effect of cursed equipment long enough for the item to be removed, but it does not destroy the curse inside the item unless the GM says otherwise.
Break Enchantment has no effect on instantaneous effects.
tianxia.talent.life.clear_physician_s_ey:
#### Clear Physician’s Eye - Diagnosis
When you use Read the Pulse as an Action, you may ask one additional practical question about the target’s condition.
Examples include:
Is this poison natural, alchemical, spiritual, or curse-like?
Is this disease contagious?
Is the target dying because of wounds, poison, suffocation, spiritual damage, or another obvious cause?
Is this condition being maintained by an ongoing effect?
Would Purify the Pulse suppress this condition?
The GM answers truthfully, but may answer in cultivation-world language rather than mechanical terminology.
tianxia.talent.life.contagion_reversal:
#### Contagion Reversal - Forbidden, Plague, Purification
When you remove a condition, disease, or poison with Purify the Pulse, you may cast the rejected affliction into another living creature.
Choose one living creature within the range of your Purify the Pulse. The target must make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target suffers one condition, disease symptom, or poison effect you just removed. The transferred effect lasts for 1 round unless the GM says the original affliction is weaker.
Successful Save: The target is unaffected.
The original creature is restored whether the new target succeeds or fails.
A creature’s immunities apply normally.
This talent is Forbidden in most orthodox sects unless used against plague-beasts, demons, undead vessels, battlefield monsters, or other sanctioned enemies.
tianxia.talent.life.deep_root_restoratio:
#### Deep Root Restoration - Purification
Your Purify the Pulse can treat complex harm as a single broken pattern.
Augment - 2 CP: When you use Purify the Pulse, you may remove any number of conditions affecting the target that Purify the Pulse or your Life talents could remove individually.
You do not remove curses, missing limbs, death, soul-binding, or instantaneous effects unless another talent allows it.
tianxia.talent.life.empathic_transfer:
#### Empathic Transfer - Sympathetic, Purification
You can restore another creature by taking its affliction into yourself.
When you use Purify the Pulse, you may reduce its CP cost by 1, to a minimum of 0 CP. If you do, you gain the condition or disease you removed as though you had been the original target.
You cannot transfer an affliction that would immediately kill you.
You cannot transfer an affliction if you are already affected by the same non-cumulative affliction.
If the original affliction allowed saving throws over time, you do not immediately gain a new saving throw when you take it. Your own immunities and resistances still apply.
tianxia.talent.life.esoteric_vitality:
#### Esoteric Vitality - Pulse
Your Life cultivation can recognize unnatural living patterns.
Mend the Pulse, Borrowed Breath, Read the Pulse, and Purify the Pulse can affect undead, constructs, animated objects, and artificial bodies that possess an animating pattern.
This does not make such creatures living for other purposes.
Esoteric Vitality cannot restore a destroyed construct unless another talent says otherwise. It cannot return an undead creature to true life unless a resurrection talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.life.fount_of_life:
#### Fount of Life - Mend, Storage
You can store healing inside yourself as a reserve of refined vitality.
When you use Mend the Pulse, you may choose to store the healing instead of applying it immediately. Roll the healing normally. The result becomes stored healing.
You can store a maximum amount of healing equal to 10 times your Cultivation Level.
Stored healing lasts until you finish a long rest.
As an Action, you may touch one creature and release any amount of stored healing into that creature, up to the amount remaining in your Fount of Life. The target regains that many Hit Points. The released amount is subtracted from your stored healing.
Healing stored with Fount of Life cannot be created from delayed healing or regeneration effects.
tianxia.talent.life.golden_marrow_regene:
#### Golden Marrow Regeneration - Regeneration
Prerequisite: Revitalizing Thread.
Your regeneration can reattach or restore severed body parts.
When a creature under your Revitalizing Thread has a severed body part held to the stump, you may spend 1 CP and use an object interaction to reattach it instantly.
If Revitalizing Thread persists for at least 2 minutes without interruption, you may spend 3 CP to restore missing fingers, toes, ears, tails, and similar minor body parts.
Restoring a missing hand, foot, arm, leg, eye, or organ requires 1 hour of uninterrupted treatment, 5 CP, and appropriate medical, alchemical, sect, or spiritual support as determined by the GM.
Golden Marrow Regeneration cannot restore a missing head unless a Nascent Soul talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.life.greater_invigorate:
#### Greater Invigorate - Breath
Your Borrowed Breath can exceed ordinary injury limits.
Augment - 1 CP: Borrowed Breath grants Temporary HP based on Realm.
Mortal: 5 Temporary HP.Foundation: 10 Temporary HP.Core Formation: 15 Temporary HP.Nascent Soul: 20 Temporary HP.
Borrowed Breath may be used on a creature at full Hit Points when you apply this augment.
The target’s current Hit Points plus Temporary HP may exceed its Hit Point maximum, following the ordinary rules for Temporary HP.
tianxia.talent.life.greater_mend:
#### Greater Mend - Mend
You can flood a living pattern with stronger medicinal qi.
Augment - 1 CP: When you use Mend the Pulse, the target regains Hit Points equal to 5 times your Cultivation Level + your key ability modifier instead of the normal healing roll.
This healing still cannot raise the target above its Hit Point maximum unless another feature says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.life.greater_purification:
#### Greater Purification - Purification
Your Purify the Pulse can remove deeper injuries.
Augment - 1 CP: Purify the Pulse may remove one of the following:
one level of Exhaustion;
one effect reducing one of the target’s ability scores;
one effect reducing the target’s Hit Point maximum.
A creature can benefit from Greater Purification only once per long rest unless the GM permits more intensive treatment during downtime, sect infirmary care, or a special medicinal ritual.
tianxia.talent.life.greater_resurrection:
#### Greater Resurrection - Soul-Return, Regeneration
Prerequisite: Resurrection and Golden Marrow Regeneration.
Your Resurrection can reach across years.
When you use Resurrection, you may spend 2 additional CP to target a creature that has been dead for less than 100 years.
You may restore missing body parts as part of the resurrection.
