If the creature has been dead for 1 year or longer, the act taxes you greatly. Until you finish a long rest, you cannot use Life sphere talents, and you have Disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws.
The soul must be willing and at liberty to return.
Greater Resurrection cannot return a creature whose soul has been destroyed, consumed, reincarnated beyond reach, sealed by a stronger authority, or forbidden from returning by the campaign’s cosmology.
tianxia.talent.life.hundred_medicine_cor:
#### Hundred-Medicine Core - Mend, Storage
Your Fount of Life becomes more efficient.
Increase your maximum stored healing from Fount of Life to 20 times your Cultivation Level.
When you finish a short rest and have no stored healing remaining, you may store healing equal to your Cultivation Level + your key ability modifier without spending CP.
Once you use this free storage, you cannot do so again until you finish a long rest.
tianxia.talent.life.latent_healing:
#### Latent Healing - Mend, Breath, Pulse
When you use Mend the Pulse or Borrowed Breath, you may delay the effect instead of resolving it immediately.
The target carries the delayed healing until it finishes a short or long rest.
When the target is injured, it may use its Reaction to trigger the delayed healing.
A creature can carry only one Latent Healing from you at a time.
You can use Latent Healing on an uninjured target, but the target cannot trigger it until it is injured.
tianxia.talent.life.life_domain_hall_of_:
#### Life Domain: Hall of Returning Breath - Domain, Field, Pulse
You manifest a temporary domain where the living pattern is remembered by the world itself.
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 60-foot-radius aura
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
When you create the Hall of Returning Breath, choose any number of willing creatures in the aura. Each chosen creature gains a Pulse Seal that does not count against your normal Pulse Seal limit for the duration.
While a chosen creature remains in the aura:
it has Advantage on death saving throws;
it has Advantage on saving throws against disease and poison;
the first time each round it regains Hit Points from one of your Life abilities, it regains additional Hit Points equal to your key ability modifier;
if it has 0 Hit Points and is stable, it may regain 1 Hit Point at the start of its turn.
Once during the duration, when a chosen creature in the aura would die, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to delay that death until the end of the creature’s next turn.
This delay does not save a creature destroyed by disintegration, decapitation, old age, soul destruction, or an effect that leaves no viable living pattern.
tianxia.talent.life.life_preserving_diag:
#### Life-Preserving Diagnosis - Diagnosis, Pulse
When a creature bearing your Pulse Seal would die from failed death saving throws, poison, disease, or a condition you are capable of treating, you immediately sense the crisis if the creature is on the same plane of existence.
You may use your Reaction to do one of the following:
use Read the Pulse on the creature;
trigger a Latent Healing on the creature if it carries one from you;
spend 1 CP to extend the creature’s death by 1 round, preventing it from dying until the end of its next turn.
Life-Preserving Diagnosis does not prevent death from massive damage, disintegration, decapitation, old age, or effects that state the creature dies without entering a dying state.
tianxia.talent.life.life_seal_reach:
#### Life-Seal Reach - Pulse
Your Pulse Seals can carry a short thread of restorative authority.
When you use Mend the Pulse, Borrowed Breath, or Purify the Pulse, you may target a creature bearing your Pulse Seal within 30 feet instead of touching it.
At Core Formation Realm, this range becomes 60 feet.
At Nascent Soul Realm, this range becomes 120 feet.
Body Refiners cannot use Life-Seal Reach unless they have a forged technique, subpath feature, variant scripture, or GM permission that explains how their bodily Life cultivation remains physically connected.
tianxia.talent.life.minute_gate_resuscit:
#### Minute-Gate Resuscitation - Soul-Return
Prerequisite: One-Breath Resuscitation.
You can call back a creature whose soul has only begun to cross the threshold.
One-Breath Resuscitation can target a creature that died within the last minute.
If the creature has been dead longer than 1 round, increase the cost to 4 CP.
The target returns with 1 Hit Point and gains 1 level of Exhaustion, to a maximum of 5. This Exhaustion cannot be reduced below 1 until the target finishes a long rest.
The body must still be mostly intact.
tianxia.talent.life.one_breath_resuscita:
#### One-Breath Resuscitation - Soul-Return
You can call a creature back if death has only just closed its hand.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature that died within the last round
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 3 CP
The target returns to life with 1 Hit Point.
The body must be mostly intact. This cannot return a creature that died of old age, cannot restore missing body parts, and cannot return a soul that is unwilling or not at liberty to return.
Coming back from death is an ordeal. The target gains 1 level of Exhaustion, to a maximum of 5. This Exhaustion cannot be reduced below 1 until the target finishes a long rest.
One-Breath Resuscitation cannot return undead to life.
tianxia.talent.life.pulse_array_treatmen:
#### Pulse Array Treatment - Field, Pulse
You can coordinate several Pulse Seals into a single treatment.
When you use Mend the Pulse, Borrowed Breath, or Purify the Pulse, you may spend 2 additional CP to affect any number of willing creatures bearing your Pulse Seals within 30 feet.
Each target receives the same base Life ability.
If the ability requires you to choose a condition, disease, or effect, choose separately for each target.
At Core Formation Realm, the range becomes 60 feet.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the range becomes 120 feet.
Body Refiners must still obey their Path restrictions unless a technique specifically permits this talent.
tianxia.talent.life.reopen_the_living_me:
#### Reopen the Living Meridian - Purification, Meridian
You can repair damage to the channels through which cultivation moves.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 2 CP
Choose one ongoing effect that blocks, suppresses, scrambles, seals, or damages the target’s ability to spend CP, use a sphere talent, maintain Concentration, speak, breathe, or move normally.
Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC.
Success: The effect is suppressed for 1 minute.
Failure: The effect is suppressed until the end of the target’s next turn.
This talent does not remove a permanent curse, cultivation deviation, scattered foundation, or crippled realm by itself, but it may allow the target to function long enough to survive the scene.
tianxia.talent.life.restorative_mend:
#### Restorative Mend - Mend, Purification
When you use Mend the Pulse or Borrowed Breath, you may also use Purify the Pulse on the same target as part of the same Action.
You must pay the CP cost of Purify the Pulse normally.
If a talent modifies Purify the Pulse, you may apply that talent as part of Restorative Mend if you can pay all costs.
tianxia.talent.life.resurrection:
#### Resurrection - Soul-Return
Prerequisite: Minute-Gate Resuscitation.
You can return the dead to life through a full soul-return rite.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Target: One dead creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 5 CP
You return a dead creature to life, provided it has been dead no longer than 10 days.
If the creature’s soul is willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point.
This neutralizes poisons and cures nonmagical diseases that affected the creature at the time it died.
This does not remove magical diseases, curses, soul bindings, cultivation deviations, or similar effects. If those effects are not removed before resurrection, they resume when the creature returns to life.
The body must possess the organs and structure necessary for survival. If the creature lacks a head or another body part essential to survival, Resurrection fails unless another talent restores the missing part first.
Coming back from death is an ordeal. The target suffers a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Each time the target finishes a long rest, this penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.
Resurrection cannot return undead to life unless the GM determines the undead creature’s original soul is willing, available, and not transformed beyond recovery.
tianxia.talent.life.revitalizing_thread:
#### Revitalizing Thread - Mend, Regeneration
When you use Mend the Pulse, you may choose to grant gradual natural healing instead of immediate healing.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
The target regains Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The amount healed each round depends on your Realm.
Mortal: 1 Hit Point.Foundation: 2 Hit Points.Core Formation: 3 Hit Points.Nascent Soul: 4 Hit Points.
A creature at 0 Hit Points is stabilized by Revitalizing Thread, but does not regain Hit Points from this talent until it is no longer at 0 Hit Points unless another feature says otherwise.
Augment - Sustained Thread, 2 CP: Revitalizing Thread persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after creating the effect on your turn without spending an action.
tianxia.talent.life.shared_infirmary_han:
#### Shared Infirmary Hand - Field
When you use Read the Pulse, Mend the Pulse, Borrowed Breath, or Purify the Pulse, you may spend 1 additional CP to affect one additional willing creature you can touch.
At Foundation Realm, you may affect up to two additional willing creatures you can touch.
At Core Formation Realm, you may affect a number of additional willing creatures you can touch equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
At Nascent Soul Realm, creatures bearing your Pulse Seals count as being touched for this talent if they are within 30 feet of you.
Body Refiners must still satisfy their Path’s body-contact restriction unless a forged technique or talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.life.soul_lamp_continuity:
#### Soul-Lamp Continuity - Soul-Return
Your own soul remembers the pattern of your body.
When you would die while you have at least 1 CP remaining, you may spend all remaining CP, minimum 1 CP, to preserve a Soul-Lamp.
The Soul-Lamp lasts for 1 minute.
While the Soul-Lamp persists, you are dead, but your soul has not fully departed. A creature can use One-Breath Resuscitation, Minute-Gate Resuscitation, Resurrection, or a comparable effect on you as though your body were still within the valid time limit.
If your body is mostly intact when the Soul-Lamp ends, you may make a Constitution saving throw against DC 20.
Success: You return to life with 1 Hit Point and 1 level of Exhaustion.
Failure: You die normally.
Soul-Lamp Continuity cannot function if your soul is destroyed, consumed, imprisoned, or if your body is destroyed beyond recognition.
tianxia.talent.life.vital_court_field:
#### Vital Court Field - Field, Pulse
You can create an infirmary field around yourself.
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 20-foot-radius aura
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Choose any number of willing creatures in the aura when you create it. Each chosen creature gains a Pulse Seal that does not count against your normal Pulse Seal limit for the duration.
Once per round, when a chosen creature in the aura regains Hit Points from one of your Life abilities, another chosen creature in the aura may gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
While in the aura, chosen creatures have Advantage on saving throws against disease and poison.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the aura radius increases to 30 feet.
tianxia.talent.life.world_womb_restorati:
#### World-Womb Restoration - Field
You can use Life cultivation as large-scale crisis medicine.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: Self
Area: 300-foot-radius field
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 6 CP
Choose any number of living creatures in the area.
Each target receives one of the following benefits:
regains Hit Points equal to 5 times your Cultivation Level + your key ability modifier;
ends one disease;
ends one poison;
becomes stable if dying;
gains Temporary HP from Greater Invigorate.
You may choose a different benefit for each target.
World-Womb Restoration cannot return the dead to life, regrow missing limbs, remove curses, or restore a scattered cultivation base.
This talent is usually treated as a sect-scale miracle, battlefield aftermath art, plague-response rite, or immortal physician inheritance rather than casual combat healing.
tianxia.talent.life.wound_closing_palm:
#### Wound-Closing Palm - Mend
When you use Mend the Pulse on a creature at 0 Hit Points, the target may immediately regain consciousness if the healing raises it above 0 Hit Points.
In addition, the target does not fall Prone from being unconscious if the GM judges that your touch reaches it before it collapses fully, such as during a readied action, reaction-based forged technique, or cinematic immediate treatment.
This talent does not prevent death.
tianxia.talent.life.wound_memory_suturin:
#### Wound Memory Suturing - Regeneration, Purification
You can close injuries that remain open because the body remembers the wound as its new truth.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 3 CP
Choose one ongoing effect that prevents healing, halves healing, prevents the target from gaining Temporary HP, causes a wound to reopen, or deals recurring damage because of a wound. Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC.
Success: The effect ends on the target.
Failure: The effect is suppressed until the end of the target’s next turn.
Wound Memory Suturing does not affect Mortality Seals, Domains, Secret Inheritances, artifact curses, divine decrees, or story-scale death laws unless the GM allows it.
tianxia.talent.life.yellow_spring_refusa:
#### Yellow-Spring Refusal Seal - Soul-Return, Pulse
You place a seal that forbids the threshold from closing too quickly.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One willing living creature bearing your Pulse Seal
Duration: Until the target finishes a long rest
Cost: 4 CP
The first time during the duration that the target would die and leave a mostly intact body, the seal triggers. The target remains dead, but its soul does not fully depart for 1 minute.
During that minute, any Life soul-return talent used on the target treats the death as having occurred in the last round.
Once the seal triggers, it ends. A creature can benefit from only one Yellow-Spring Refusal Seal at a time.
This seal cannot hold a soul destroyed, consumed, imprisoned, reincarnated beyond reach, claimed by stronger underworld authority, or forbidden from returning by the campaign’s cosmology.
tianxia.talent.lightning.when_potential_:
### When Potential Becomes Judgment
Secret Lightning Inheritance
Prerequisites: CL 17+, Lightning Sovereign Incarnation, Formation-Splitting Bolt, True Lightning-God Mantle, and access to a true lightning scripture, tribulation scar, heavenly thunder inheritance, or equivalent revelation
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on you
Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You command the instant when potential becomes judgment.
Choose up to three decrees:
The Circuit Was Always One. Choose any number of Charged creatures, objects, formation nodes, talismans, qi constructs, or spaces you can perceive in the area, up to three times your Proficiency Bonus. Each hostile creature chosen this way makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 8d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The Ward Forgets Its Shape. Choose one non-Secret ward, barrier, talisman array, qi construct, or formation segment in the area. Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s DC. On a success, suppress it until the end of your next turn. On a failure, reduce one of its major numerical effects by your Cultivation Level until the end of your next turn.
The Body Becomes Thunder. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a Fly Speed of 120 feet, Hover, Resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. The first time you hit each turn with a Lightning attack, it deals additional lightning damage equal to 4d8.
The Command Arrives Too Late. Hostile creatures of your choice in the area that are issuing commands, maintaining Concentration, controlling formations, directing summons, or sustaining technique-states make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they cannot take Reactions, issue audible commands, or grant allies Advantage until the end of their next turn. On a success, they cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn.
The Sky Writes the Shortest Path. You may move up to 1 mile to a location you can see, a Charged target you can perceive, or a Conductive path you have marked within the last minute. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. It cannot enter sealed spaces protected by superior authority without an opposed check.
The Thunder Speaks After. After all other decrees resolve, creatures of your choice within 120 feet of any target damaged by this inheritance make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is Deafened and Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is Deafened until the start of its next turn.
Limits: When Potential Becomes Judgment does not permanently change weather, erase mountains, shut down ancient city arrays by default, kill breathless creatures automatically, bypass immunity, or defeat stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.magma.sea_of_molten_heave:
#### Sea of Molten Heaven
“The mountain opened. The world beneath the world rose to answer.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Volcano-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-magma scripture
Action Type: Action
Range: 150 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Flood the area with impossible volcanic force.
The area becomes a sea of molten stone, furnace pressure, volcanic ash, and rising obsidian teeth.
When a creature enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 8d10 Fire and 8d10 Bludgeoning damage, falls Prone, becomes Burning for 3d10 Fire damage until the end of its next turn, and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage, cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, and suffers Heat Pressure until the start of its next turn.
A creature takes damage from Sea of Molten Heaven only once per turn.
Melting Pressure:
Structures, objects, vehicles, Barriers, and exposed Formation Anchors inside take triple damage from your Magma talents.
Your Magma talents ignore ordinary Fire Resistance, ordinary material hardness, and mundane heat shielding inside the area.
Volcanic Aftermath:
After the talent ends, the area becomes visibly altered and filled with difficult terrain, unstable volcanic debris, cooled lava, and Obsidian Terrain.
Sea of Molten Heaven does not automatically destroy:
• entire cities;
• divine structures;
• Secret Formations;
• world-scale terrain;
• legendary artifacts;
• Realm-defining geography.
It can, however, make those things bleed.
tianxia.talent.metal.bell_monastery_list:
### Bell-Monastery Listening Sutra - Secret, Bell, Resonance
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, bell monastery, resonance teacher, ancestral bell, formation-auditor office, or comparable inheritance
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: action, reaction
Timing Detail: Action or Reaction
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_LISTENING_SUTRA->action, REACTION_LISTENING_SUTRA->reaction
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature, object, barrier, construct, formation node, armor, weapon, gate, bell, chain, talisman frame, or metal-bearing technique you can perceive
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You strike a soundless bell in your Metal Qi and make the target confess its flaw.
If used as an Action, make a Metal Check against the target's AC, save DC, formation DC, creator's Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: Learn the target's most useful structural weakness, then choose one:
- the next attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage;
- reduce its AC by 2 until the start of your next turn;
- suppress one non-Secret metal, armor, ward, lock, talisman frame, construct joint, or formation-node benefit until the start of your next turn;
- cause a visible crack, ring, or flaw-sign that allows allies to ignore half cover from the target until the start of your next turn.
Success by 5 or More: Choose two effects instead of one.
If used as a Reaction, the trigger is a visible metal-bearing attack, ward, construct action, formation pulse, talisman frame, armor technique, or weapon technique within range. On a successful Metal Check, impose Disadvantage on the triggering roll, or reduce its damage, damage reduction, shield value, or movement by your Cultivation Level.
At Nascent Soul Realm, if the target is non-Secret and lower Realm than you, success by 5 or more may suppress it until the end of your next turn instead.
This Sutra is perception and resonance, not broad Sound sphere control.
tianxia.talent.metal.heavenly_needle_sut:
### Heavenly Needle Sutra - Secret, Needle
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, needle scripture, assassin-monk teacher, medical needle sect, hidden weapon lineage, or comparable inheritance
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Target: Up to a number of creatures or exposed technique-nodes you can see equal to your Proficiency Bonus
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You scatter visible or nearly invisible Metal Qi needles through meridian gaps, armor seams, robe folds, formation cracks, and weapon shadows. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes piercing damage equal to **3d8 + your Metal key ability modifier** and suffers one needle seal of your choice until the start of your next turn:
- cannot take Reactions;
- Speed is reduced by 15 feet;
- cannot regain CP;
- has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain a technique;
- drops one held non-artifact metal object if physically capable of dropping it.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and suffers no needle seal.
If a target is wearing metal armor, carrying a visible metal weapon, standing in ore-rich ground, or already affected by your Metal Appraisal, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw.
At Core Formation Realm, failed-save damage becomes **4d8 + your Metal key ability modifier**.
At Nascent Soul Realm, you may choose one target that failed the save; that target suffers two different needle seals instead of one.
This Sutra does not grant Poison, Disease, Blood, or Pressure Points sphere authority by itself. It uses Metal Qi as needles, pins, filings, and surgical killing lines.
tianxia.talent.metal.indestructible_iron:
### Indestructible Iron Marrow Sutra - Secret, Iron-Body
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Body Refining Path or Iron-Body Method, iron-marrow teacher, ancestral body scripture, or comparable inheritance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You turn bone, marrow, teeth, nails, blood-iron, and meridian walls into a single iron scripture.
For the duration:
- gain Temporary HP equal to **twice your Cultivation Level**;
- gain Resistance to non-Secret Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage;
- you cannot be moved against your will while conscious unless the moving effect wins an opposed check against your Metal Check;
- once per round when damage would reduce you to 0 HP, you may make a Constitution saving throw against your own Metal Save DC. On a success, you drop to 1 HP instead and the Sutra ends.
While the Sutra is active, your Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity checks that require subtle movement.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the first time the Sutra prevents you from dropping to 0 HP, metal thorns burst outward. Hostile creatures of your choice within 10 feet take piercing damage equal to **3d8 + your Constitution modifier**.
This Sutra is powerful, obvious, and body-changing. When it ends, your joints ring like cooling iron until you finish a short rest.
tianxia.talent.metal.loadstone_emperor_s:
### Loadstone Emperor Scripture - Secret, Loadstone
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, magnet mountain inheritance, imperial mine office, loadstone teacher, ore-heart jade slip, or comparable source
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Until the end of your next turn
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You declare a loadstone court. Metal-bearing objects, weapons, armor, coins, nails, chains, gates, ore veins, and exposed metal tools in the area answer your direction for one brutal moment.
Choose up to a number of creatures or objects in the area equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus. A chosen creature must be wearing metal, carrying metal, made partly of metal, standing in ore-rich ground, struck by your Metal Qi this turn, or otherwise metal-bearing.
Each chosen creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
- pull the creature up to 30 feet toward the center;
- push the creature up to 30 feet away from the center;
- knock the creature Prone if it is Large or smaller;
- force it to drop one non-artifact metal object it is holding;
- pin it against a metal object, ore-rich surface, gate, chain, armor rack, or comparable anchor, reducing its Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: You may move the creature 5 feet, but it suffers no other effect.
Unattended non-artifact metal objects in the area can be moved up to 60 feet, gathered into a pile, slammed into a surface, opened, shut, barred, or scattered. This cannot open sealed treasures, defeat superior formations, or steal worn items from a creature that succeeded on its save.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the area becomes a 60-foot-radius sphere, and one failed-save creature of your choice also takes bludgeoning or piercing damage equal to **4d8 + your Metal key ability modifier**.
tianxia.talent.metal.ten_thousand_metal_:
### Ten-Thousand-Metal Sovereign Edict - Secret, Metal Sovereign
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, at least three Metal Methods, and access to a sovereign metal scripture, White Tiger mandate, immortal mine-heart, ancestral bell, imperial armory seal, or comparable revelation
Action Type: Action
Range: Self
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on you
Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You declare that every piece of metal in the region remembers Heaven's command. The edict can act only through metal-bearing creatures, metal objects, weapons, armor, ore-rich terrain, mineralized structures, formation metal, ringing bells, battlefield armaments, or targets carrying your Metal Qi. This keeps the inheritance comparable in scale to heavenly lightning decrees while preserving Metal's boundary: it rules what bears metal, not everything under the sky.
Choose up to three decrees:
**All Weapons Bow.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the region that are holding metal weapons, wearing metal armor, carrying metal tools, made partly of metal, standing in ore-rich ground, or directly connected to battlefield metal make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature is pulled 30 feet, pushed 30 feet, knocked Prone, or forced to drop one non-artifact metal object, your choice. On a success, it is moved 5 feet or keeps its grip, your choice.
**The Edge Finds the Gap.** Choose up to twice your Proficiency Bonus metal-bearing creatures, armored creatures, weapon-bearing creatures, constructs, or creatures carrying your Metal Qi that you can perceive in the region. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes **8d8 slashing or piercing damage** and cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and can regain HP normally.
**The Bell Names the Flaw.** Choose one visible or spiritually perceived non-Secret ward, barrier, armor technique, formation node, talisman frame, construct, gate, chain, seal, armory defense, or metal-bearing technique in the region. Make a Metal Check against its DC. On a success, suppress it until the end of your next turn. On a failure, reduce one of its major numerical benefits by your Cultivation Level until the end of your next turn and learn one of its protection rules.
**The Ore Remembers the Mountain.** Choose a point on metal-bearing ground, stone with ore, a mine, a forge floor, a battlefield covered with weapons, an armory, a city gate, or comparable terrain. Until the end of your next turn, the ground in a 60-foot radius becomes difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and the first time each hostile creature moves more than 10 feet through it, it takes piercing damage equal to your Cultivation Level.
**The Tiger Passes Judgment.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the region that are Bloodied, Frightened, carrying your Metal Qi, holding a weapon, wearing armor, standing among battlefield metal, or maintaining a violent technique make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature cannot take Reactions, cannot benefit from Invisibility against you, and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. On a success, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
**The Body Becomes a Bell of Iron.** Until the end of your next turn, you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Lightning, and Thunder damage; cannot be forcibly moved unless the enemy wins an opposed check against your Metal Check; and your first Metal talent hit each turn deals additional damage equal to **4d8**.
Limits: Ten-Thousand-Metal Sovereign Edict does not permanently steal weapons, destroy artifacts, erase mountains, shut down ancient city arrays by default, bypass immunity, command nonmetal creatures without a metal-bearing condition, or defeat stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.music.battle_cadence:
#### Battle Cadence - Measure, Cadence
When you Keep the Measure through breath, footwork, chant, weapon impacts, drum, bell, or another approved martial method, you may enter Battle Cadence.
While Battle Cadence is active:
your Speed increases by 5 feet;
once per turn when you hit with an approved weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll;
one ally within 15 feet who can perceive your cadence gains +5 feet Speed until the start of your next turn.
Battle Cadence is usually a Body Refining or martial expression. Qi and Spirit cultivators may learn it, but it does not let them use Stamina unless another feature permits.
tianxia.talent.music.bell_of_warning:
#### Bell of Warning - Phrase, Support
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One creature within 60 feet that can hear you rolls Initiative or is targeted by an attack before it has acted in combat
Cost: 1 CP
Choose one willing creature that can hear you.
It gains one benefit:
add your Proficiency Bonus to Initiative;
gain +2 AC against the triggering attack;
move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Use Bell of Warning once per round.
tianxia.talent.music.captivating_melody:

Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Choose one creature that can hear or spiritually perceive you. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target becomes Distracted.
While Distracted:
Speed is reduced by 10 feet;
it cannot take Reactions;
it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.
At the end of each of its turns, the affected creature repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.music.concerto_of_broken_:
#### Concerto of Broken Breath - Dissonance
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot cone
Cost: 6 CP
Creatures in the area that can hear or spiritually perceive you make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take Thunder or Psychic damage and choose one:
cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn;
Speed is reduced to 0 until the start of your next turn;
has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw before the end of its next turn.

tianxia.talent.music.court_of_resonant_m:
#### Court of Resonant Measure - Domain, Chord
“Every heartbeat in this place follows my measure.”
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Choose one mode when activating the Domain.
##### Harmonious Court
Allies inside who can hear or spiritually perceive you gain:
Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened;
+1 AC;
+10 feet Speed;
telepathic emotional communication with you through rhythm.

difficult terrain;
Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws;
inability to take Reactions.

Failed Save: It has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
Court of Resonant Measure ends early if you become Incapacitated.
tianxia.talent.music.disruptive_harmony:
#### Disruptive Harmony - Dissonance
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet that you can hear or spiritually perceive spends CP, activates a supernatural technique, or begins Concentrating
Cost: 2 CP
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
it has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn;
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
one active performance, chant, command, or verbal technique it maintains becomes audible and recognizable to you if it was concealed by ordinary means.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
tianxia.talent.music.dissonant_note:
#### Dissonant Note - Dissonance
Action Type: Action

Cost: 2 CP
Choose one creature that can hear or spiritually perceive your note. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

tianxia.talent.music.harmonizing_breath:

Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Choose one willing creature that can hear or spiritually perceive your Measure.

one nonmagical Frightened effect;

tianxia.talent.music.healing_hymn:
#### Healing Hymn - Chord, Support
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

Begin a restorative performance.

A creature can receive this healing only once per short rest.
Music heals by restoring breath, calming the heart, and harmonizing disrupted meridians. It does not regrow limbs, cure disease, remove poison, or replace the Life sphere.
tianxia.talent.music.heartstring_severin:
#### Heartstring Severing Prelude - Soul-Sound, Dissonance
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature that can hear or spiritually perceive you.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, choose one:
suppress one Bardic, Music, War command, or morale aura affecting it;
prevent it from benefiting from one ally’s audible command;
prevent it from issuing commands that grant mechanical benefits;
prevent it from using one reaction-based support feature.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This does not erase memory, remove social rank, or break a true oath unless another feature says so.
tianxia.talent.music.immortal_funeral_be:
#### Immortal Funeral Bell - Chord, Soul-Sound
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
A solemn bell marks endings.
Enemies inside that can hear or spiritually perceive the bell suffer:

cannot regain HP more than once per round;
cannot benefit from effects that trigger when reduced to 0 HP unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw;
have Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws.

Resistance to Frightened;
when reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, may immediately move 5 feet or speak one sentence.

tianxia.talent.music.lullaby_of_settled_:
#### Lullaby of Settled Breath - Chord, Support
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures within range that can hear you.
Willing targets gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened, Charmed, and one effect causing Rage, Frenzy, panic, or uncontrolled aggression.
Unwilling targets make Wisdom saving throws.

tianxia.talent.music.march_of_the_immort:
#### March of the Immortal Host - Chord, Cadence
Prerequisite: Battle Cadence
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP, 6 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus
Begin a perfect battle cadence.

+10 feet Speed;
ignore nonmagical difficult terrain;
Advantage on checks and saving throws made to resist Grappled, Prone, and forced movement;
once per turn after hitting with a weapon attack, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
tianxia.talent.music.mocking_rhythm:
#### Mocking Rhythm - Dissonance

tianxia.talent.poison.serious_ingrained_:
#### Serious Ingrained Toxin Stages
A Serious Ingrained Toxin has stages. At the end of each long rest, the target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Success: The poison stage decreases by 1. If it would decrease below Stage 1, the poison ends.
Failure: The poison stage increases by 1, to a maximum of Stage 4.
A creature cannot suffer more than one Serious Ingrained Toxin at a time.
Stage 1 - Bitter Channels. The target has Disadvantage on the first Cultivation Check it makes each day, and cannot reduce CP costs below their printed values.
Stage 2 - Numb Meridian Flow. The target’s maximum CP is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus, and it has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. This maximum CP reduction ends when the poison ends.
Stage 3 - Foundation Corrosion. The target’s Hit Point maximum is reduced by your Cultivation Level, and the target regains only half as much CP from short-rest or scene-based recovery. This maximum Hit Point reduction ends when the poison ends.
Stage 4 - Life-Gate Closing. The target cannot regain CP above half its maximum CP, cannot gain Temporary HP, and has Disadvantage on death saving throws. If the target fails three daily saves while at Stage 4, it dies unless the GM decides the poison instead triggers a major cultivation injury, coma, sealed meridians, or story crisis.
tianxia.talent.poison.soul_venom_method:
#### Soul Venom Method
Your poison can attack the spirit’s command over the body.
When you use Deliver the Dose, Ingrain the Toxin, Lingering Meridian Venom, or Five-Venom Formula, you may choose to make the poison spiritual.
A spiritual poison may affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and creatures without ordinary biology if they have a soul, animating spirit, or spiritual pattern.
Against such targets, you may deal Psychic or Necrotic damage instead of Poison or Acid damage.
Spirit Awakening cultivators may use Wisdom for this talent.
Soul Venom Method does not automatically affect mindless constructs, soulless automata, or creatures protected by stronger spiritual authority.

Choose one object the target is holding.
Failed Save: The target drops the object. If the target has no held object, one hand, claw, tentacle, or similar appendage cannot be used to Grapple, hold, or manipulate objects until the effect ends.
Successful Save: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or ability check it makes with that object before the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.grip_seve:
#### Grip-Severing Point - Point
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Choose one object the target is holding.
Failed Save: The target drops the object.
Successful Save: The target keeps hold of the object, but has Disadvantage on the next attack roll, ability check, or activation using that object before the effect ends.
If the target holds the object with two or more hands, it has Advantage on this saving throw.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.intercept:
#### Intercepting Tap - Counterpoint
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within your reach hits you with a melee attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Make one Precision Contact attack against the triggering creature.
Hit: Reduce the triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus and apply one Point talent you know.
Miss: Reduce the triggering damage by 1.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.interrupt:
#### Interrupting Point - Counterpoint, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature bearing one of your Pressure Points within 30 feet activates a spell, technique, talent, stance, guard, or other ability
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The activation falters. The target’s action, Bonus Action, Reaction, and any CP or resource spent are not lost, but the ability does not resolve until immediately after the triggering creature’s current turn ends.
Successful Save: The ability resolves normally, but the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Interrupting Point delays timing; it does not counter the effect outright.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.joint_sea:
#### Joint Seal - Seal
Trigger: You close a Seal through Touch the Point
Save: Strength
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next turn
Choose one limb, wing, gripping appendage, leg, or analogous moving structure.
Failed Save: That part cannot be used effectively. A disabled leg reduces Speed by half. A disabled arm or gripping limb cannot hold a weapon, Shield, focus, or tool effectively. A disabled wing may prevent flight if the creature needs that wing to fly.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Creatures without meaningful body parts suffer the successful-save effect instead.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.life_gate:
#### Life Gate Touch - Diagnostic, Meridian
Prerequisite: Gentle Release, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Cost: 2 CP or expend Martial Focus
Touch the body’s life gate and force the breath to return.
Choose one:
the target immediately spends one Hit Die and adds your Pressure Points ability modifier to the HP regained;
end one Poisoned, Frightened, or ordinary Paralyzed condition affecting the target;
reduce the target’s Exhaustion by 1 if the Exhaustion was gained during the last hour;
restore one use of a non-Secret technique that recharges on a short rest, if that technique has been unavailable for at least 1 minute and the GM agrees it is bodily or breath-based.
A creature may benefit from your Life Gate Touch only once per long rest.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.locked_br:
#### Locked Breath Method - Seal, Meridian
Prerequisite: Breath Seal, CL 5+
Trigger: You close a Seal through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next turn
Failed Save: The target cannot activate abilities that require clear speech, a Verbal component, a kiai, a chant, a roar, or steady breathing. If the target is concentrating, it immediately makes a Concentration saving throw against your Pressure Points Save DC.
Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.meridian_:
#### Meridian Diagram Memory - Diagnostic
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you successfully use Pulse Diagnosis on a creature, you may create a mental meridian diagram of that creature for 24 hours.
While the diagram remains:
your first Precision Contact attack against that creature during each encounter has Advantage;
the creature’s first saving throw against one of your Seal talents during each encounter has Disadvantage;
you can recognize obvious disguises, shape changes, or possession attempts that fail to alter the creature’s underlying meridian rhythm.
You may maintain a number of meridian diagrams equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

#### Meridian Stillness Field - Domain, Meridian
Prerequisite: Chamber of Nine Gates, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP, or expend Martial Focus and 2 CP
Create a field of hovering meridian diagrams and suspended pressure lines.
Hostile creatures inside the field that bear one of your Pressure Points suffer the following effects:
Speed reduced by 10 feet;
cannot benefit from Advantage on Concentration saving throws;
cannot take Opportunity Attacks;
the first time each round they activate a non-Secret technique, they make a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The activation completes, but the creature takes Psychic or Force damage equal to 2d8 + your Pressure Points ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: No damage.
Meridian Stillness Field does not create a physical Barrier and does not stop teleportation unless the teleportation technique itself requires stable bodily or meridian flow and the GM calls for a contest.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.needle_me:
#### Needle Meets Blade - Counterpoint
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature bearing one of your Pressure Points hits you with a melee attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Reduce the damage by 1d8 + your Pressure Points ability modifier.
If this reduces the damage to 0, apply one Point talent you know to the attacker.
At CL 11, reduce the damage by 2d8 + your Pressure Points ability modifier.
At CL 17, reduce the damage by 3d8 + your Pressure Points ability modifier.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.nine_need:
#### Nine-Needle Cascade - Point, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: Dexterity
Choose one additional creature within 10 feet of the target and within your Meridian Flick range.
Failed Save: Apply Numbing Point to the second creature.
Successful Save: No effect.
If both creatures already bear your Pressure Points, you may expend Martial Focus to apply the same Seal talent to both creatures. Each creature saves separately.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.patient_h:
#### Patient Hand - Focus
When you take the Dodge, Search, or Study action and can perceive a hostile creature within 30 feet, regain Martial Focus.
If you regain Martial Focus this way, choose one creature you can perceive within 30 feet. Before the end of your next turn, you have Advantage on the next Wisdom (Medicine), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), or Cultivation Check you make to read or touch that creature’s pressure points.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.pulse_dia:
#### Pulse Diagnosis - Diagnostic
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One willing, Incapacitated, Restrained, Grappled by you, or unaware creatureCheck: Wisdom (Medicine) against a DC set by the GM
Typical DCs:
| Body Type | DC |
| --- | --- |
| Ordinary anatomy | 10 |
| Unusual anatomy | 15 |
| Alien, spiritual, heavily transformed, or concealed body | 20 |
Success: Learn two of the following:
whether the target is diseased or poisoned;
whether the target is under an obvious mind-affecting condition;
whether the target has a hidden injury affecting movement, speech, grip, sight, or breath;
which saving throw among Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution appears weakest;
whether the target’s breath, pulse, or meridian rhythm has been artificially altered;
one safe pressure point that can numb pain or release breath.
Failure: Learn one true but incomplete detail.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.qi_needle:
#### Qi-Needle Tap - Point, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Choose one ongoing body-enhancing, movement-enhancing, or breath-enhancing effect on the target that you can perceive.
Failed Save: Suppress that effect until the effect ends.
Successful Save: The effect remains, but the target cannot benefit from Advantage on the next Strength or Dexterity D20 Test it makes before the effect ends.
This talent cannot suppress a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, Path, Realm, or permanent transformation.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.retaliato:
#### Retaliatory Nerve - Counterpoint
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Make one Precision Contact attack against the triggering creature.
On a hit, deal the attack’s normal damage and apply one Point talent you know.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.return_th:
#### Return the Broken Pulse - Diagnostic, Meridian
Prerequisite: Life Gate Touch, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One creature that died within the last round
Cost: 6 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You strike, press, or needle the last unclosed point of life.
If the creature’s soul is free and willing, it returns to life with 1 HP.
This technique cannot restore a creature that died of old age, whose body has been destroyed beyond recognition, whose soul is trapped or unwilling, or whose death was caused by a superior soul-destroying effect unless a separate story, ritual, or contest resolves that obstacle.
Return the Broken Pulse is emergency resuscitation, not broad resurrection magic.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.reversing:
#### Reversing Pulse - Counterpoint, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature bearing one of your Pressure Points within 30 feet would regain HP, gain Temporary HP, or end a condition affecting itself
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Halve the HP or Temporary HP gained, or delay the condition removal until the end of the target’s next turn.
Successful Save: Reduce the HP or Temporary HP gained by your Proficiency Bonus, or no effect if the trigger was condition removal.
This talent cannot delay recovery caused by a Secret Inheritance, superior restoration, or explicit immunity-breaking cure unless the GM allows an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.sealed_gr:
#### Sealed Grip Scripture - Seal
Prerequisite: Grip Seal, CL 5+
Trigger: You close a Seal through Touch the Point
Save: Strength
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next turn
Choose one held object, weapon, tool, focus, or Shield.
Failed Save: The target cannot use that object. If the object is not secured, the target also drops it.
Successful Save: The target keeps hold of the object but has Disadvantage on attack rolls or ability checks made with it until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.shut_the_:
#### Shut the Heaven Gate - Seal, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Trigger: You close a Seal through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Failed Save: The target has the Stunned condition.
Successful Save: The target is Dazed until the effect ends. While Dazed this way, the target cannot take Reactions and may take either an Action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both.
A creature that cannot be Stunned but has a readable meridian, animating, or spiritual structure suffers the successful-save effect on a failed save instead.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.soft_para:
#### Soft Paralysis Tap - Seal, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Trigger: You close a Seal through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Failed Save: The target has the Restrained condition.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed becomes 0.
This is a meridian lock, not a Grapple. Forced movement can still move the target unless another effect prevents it.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.speech_kn:
#### Speech-Knot Point - Point
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
The target’s jaw, tongue, throat, breath, or vocal meridian stutters.
The next time the target speaks clearly, issues a command, uses an ability requiring clear speech, or provides a Verbal component before the effect ends, it makes the saving throw.
Failed Save: The speech falters. If the triggering ability requires clear speech or a Verbal component, the activation fails, but the action and resources are not spent unless the ability itself says otherwise.
Successful Save: The target speaks normally, and this Point ends.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.stance_br:
#### Stance-Breaking Point - Point
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: Strength or Dexterity, target’s choice
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
You touch the ankle, knee, hip, root, seam, or balance gate.
Failed Save: Choose one:
the target falls Prone;
the target is pushed 5 feet to a legal unoccupied space;
the target cannot take Reactions;
the target’s Speed becomes 0.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet.
This is a technical collapse, not a Brute collision.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.steal_the:
#### Steal the Breath Between Actions - Counterpoint, Meridian
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature bearing one of your Pressure Points within 60 feet takes a Bonus Action or Reaction
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The triggering Bonus Action or Reaction fails and is wasted.
Successful Save: The triggering act resolves, but the target cannot take another Bonus Action or Reaction until the end of its next turn.
This talent steals timing, not memory or permission to act permanently.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.stolen_pu:
#### Stolen Pulse Step - Point
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: None
Move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
If the target already bore one of your Pressure Points before the hit, you may instead move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target.
This movement represents stepping through the target’s collapsed rhythm, not teleportation.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.technique:
#### Technique-Closing Point - Seal, Meridian
Prerequisite: Interrupting Point, CL 10+
Trigger: You close a Seal through Touch the Point
Save: Constitution or Wisdom, target’s choice
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next turn
Choose one non-Secret active talent, spell, stance, guard, or technique you have seen the target use during this encounter.
Failed Save: The target cannot use that ability.
Successful Save: The target can use the ability normally, but if it does so before the start of your next turn, it has Disadvantage on the first attack roll or saving throw involved in that activation.
This talent does not remove known abilities permanently and cannot suppress a Path, Realm, Domain, Legendary Action, Lair Action, artifact, or Secret Inheritance.
tianxia.talent.pressure_points.weak_puls:
#### Weak Pulse Point - Point
Trigger: You apply a Pressure Point through Touch the Point
Save: None
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
The target’s circulation, animating rhythm, or inner breath briefly weakens.
The first time before the effect ends that the target regains HP or gains Temporary HP, reduce the amount gained by your Proficiency Bonus.
This is not a Blood talent and does not create a Blood Thread.
tianxia.talent.protection.bulwark:
#### Bulwark - Succor
Trigger: A protected ally is targeted by an attack roll
Sacrifice one Persistent Aegis on that ally.
The ally gains Resistance to all damage dealt by the triggering attack.
tianxia.talent.protection.buttress:
#### Buttress
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet
Target: One Barrier Ward you created
Cost: 1 CP
Restore HP to the Barrier equal to:
5 x CL
You cannot restore a Barrier above its maximum HP.
##### Swift Buttress
Augment - 1 CP: Use Buttress as a Bonus Action.
##### Emergency Buttress
Augment - 2 CP: Use Buttress as a Reaction when an attack would destroy the Barrier.
Add the restored HP before resolving the triggering damage.
tianxia.talent.protection.citadel_of_one:
#### Citadel of One Breath - Ward
Prerequisite: Barrier Ward, Greater Barrier, Buttress, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A Barrier Ward you created would be destroyed
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
The Barrier remains at 1 HP instead of being destroyed.
Until the start of your next turn:
it cannot lose HP;
it cannot be shoved or overrun;
teleportation crossing its boundary requires a successful Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC;
creatures inside gain Half Cover against attacks originating outside. At the start of your next turn, the Barrier resumes functioning normally.
tianxia.talent.protection.clarity:
#### Clarity - Ward
Attempts to conceal, disguise, or obfuscate creatures inside the Ward are hindered.
When the Ward appears, make one Cultivation Check against each:
illusion;
concealment effect;
magical disguise;
magical item creating those effects. Successful Check: Suppress that effect while it remains inside the Ward.
Failed Check: The effect continues normally.
A creature attempting to activate an illusion, concealment effect, or disguise inside the Ward must succeed on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
A creature inside also makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot activate ordinary abilities that disguise or conceal itself while it remains inside.
Successful Save: It may use nonmagical concealment normally, but supernatural concealment still faces the Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.protection.community:
#### Community
Whenever a creature benefiting from one of your Aegises takes damage, you may transfer up to half of that damage to another willing creature benefiting from one of your Aegises.
No action is required.
Transferred damage:
keeps its original damage type;
cannot be transferred again;
cannot be redirected by another effect.
tianxia.talent.protection.continuous_bar:
#### Continuous Barrier - Barrier
When creating Barrier Ward, you may shape it into:
a hemispherical dome;
a sealed sphere. The Barrier is fully sealed.
If it passes through an ordinary object, it cuts harmlessly through the material without damaging it, but the object cannot be moved through the Barrier.
Creatures and animated objects are shunted normally.
Burrowing, Ethereal travel, and unusual movement cannot bypass the sealed Barrier.
tianxia.talent.protection.greater_barrie:
#### Greater Barrier - Barrier
When creating Barrier Ward, you may form a flat vertical plane.
The wall:
must be contiguous;
must include one point adjacent to you;
may extend up to 30 feet away;
contains a maximum number of 10-foot x 10-foot panels equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus.
##### Reinforced Barrier Augment - 1 CP: Increase the Barrier’s maximum HP to 10 x CL.
Increase the DC to shove or overrun the Barrier by 5.
A Reinforced Barrier does not renew HP automatically, even while maintained through Concentration.
##### Expanded Panels
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the maximum number of panels to four times your Proficiency Bonus.
##### Grand Panels
Augment - 2 CP: Increase panel size to 20-foot x 20-foot.
tianxia.talent.protection.heaven_shelter:
#### Heaven-Sheltering Aegis
Prerequisite: Armored Aegis, Bulwark, Luck, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Grant one willing creature an exalted Aegis.
For the duration:
its base AC becomes your Cultivation Save DC + 2;
it gains Advantage on all saving throws;
it gains Resistance to all damage;
once during the duration, when it would drop to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead and the Aegis ends. Heaven-Sheltering Aegis cannot be made Persistent.
tianxia.talent.protection.impedance:
#### Impedance - Aegis, Ward
##### Aegis
A creature attempting to enter a space within 5 feet of the bearer makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot enter that space until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: It may move normally.
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the protected distance to 10 feet.
##### Ward
A creature makes a Wisdom saving throw when it attempts to enter the Ward or move closer to the Ward’s center for the first time on a turn.
Failed Save: It cannot enter or move closer to the center until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: It may move normally.
Impedance affects movement only. It does not stop attacks.
tianxia.talent.protection.luck:
#### Luck - Succor
Trigger: A protected creature makes a saving throw
Sacrifice one Persistent Aegis on that creature.
The creature rerolls the saving throw and must use the new result.
tianxia.talent.protection.peacebound:
#### Peacebound - Aegis, Ward
##### Aegis
A creature attempting a violent action or offensive supernatural effect against the bearer makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The action fails. Any CP or limited-use resource spent is lost.
Successful Save: The Peacebound Aegis ends immediately.
If the bearer takes an offensive action, the Aegis ends immediately.
##### Ward
A creature attempting a violent action or offensive supernatural effect while inside the Ward makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The action fails. Any CP or limited-use resource spent is lost.
Successful Save: The Peacebound Ward ends for all creatures.
When a creature breaks your Peacebound Ward in this way, creatures inside become immune to your Peacebound Ward until the next dawn.
tianxia.talent.protection.protected_heal:
#### Protected Health - Aegis, Ward
##### Aegis
The bearer gains:
Resistance to Poison damage;
Advantage on saving throws against poison;
Advantage on saving throws against disease.
##### Ward Creatures inside gain those benefits while they remain inside.
tianxia.talent.protection.punishment:
#### Punishment - Aegis, Succor
##### Aegis
A creature that hits the bearer with an attack takes Psychic damage based on your CL.
Punishment Damage:
• CL 1-4: Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
• CL 5-10: 1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus Psychic damage.
• CL 11-16: 2d6 + your Proficiency Bonus Psychic damage.
• CL 17-20: 3d6 + your Proficiency Bonus Psychic damage.
##### Succor
Trigger: A protected ally takes damage from an attack
Sacrifice one Persistent Aegis on that ally.
The attacker takes Psychic damage based on your CL, using the Punishment Damage table.
Punishment Succor stacks with Punishment Aegis.
tianxia.talent.protection.shielded:
#### Shielded - Aegis
Create a weightless translucent shield.
The shield functions as an ordinary shield.
It does not interfere with material or somatic components.
If the bearer uses the shield-hand to hold another object, the shield is suppressed until the start of the next turn in which that hand is free.
Augment - 1 CP: The bearer is treated as proficient with the shield.
tianxia.talent.protection.spell_ward:
#### Spell Ward - Aegis
Cost: 1 CP
The bearer gains Advantage on saving throws against supernatural effects.
tianxia.talent.protection.spell_ward.fou:
#### Spell Ward - Ward
Cost: 3 CP
When the Ward appears, make one Cultivation Check against each supernatural effect, magic item, or summoned creature inside.
Successful Check: Suppress that effect, item, or summoned creature while it remains inside.
Failed Check: It functions normally.
A cultivator attempting to activate a supernatural effect inside the Ward, target a creature inside from outside, or send a summoned creature across the Ward’s threshold makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Successful Check: The effect functions normally.
Failed Check: The effect is suppressed or the summoned creature cannot cross.
Time spent suppressed still counts against the effect’s duration.
tianxia.talent.protection.status:
#### Status
You always know:
the direction and distance to creatures benefiting from one of your Aegises;
whether they are unharmed, wounded, disabled, frightened, unconscious, dying, poisoned, diseased, stunned, or similarly afflicted. This awareness ends if a target dies or leaves the plane.
tianxia.talent.protection.the_wall_that_:
#### The Wall That Remains After Heaven Breaks
“When the formation shattered, the mountain burned, and every oath failed, the wall remained because one cultivator had not yet agreed to let the people behind it die.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Barrier Ward, Buttress, Bulwark, hidden guardian inheritance
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One of the following:
you or an ally benefiting from your Aegis would drop to 0 HP;
a Barrier Ward you created would be destroyed;
a creature inside one of your Wards would fail a saving throw against an effect that would incapacitate it.
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one:
The protected creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.
The Barrier remains at 1 HP and negates overflow damage from the triggering effect.
The protected creature succeeds on the triggering saving throw.
Sacrifice one Aegis on the protected creature without requiring it to be Persistent and activate one Succor talent you know.
Immediately create Barrier Ward centered on the protected creature without spending an Action or CP. Until the end of your next turn:
your Barrier Wards cannot be shoved or overrun;
Buttress restores maximum possible HP;
creatures benefiting from your Aegises gain Resistance to all damage;
your Wards cannot be made permanent or converted into Formation infrastructure through this effect.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.enemy_string_hoo:
### Enemy String Hook - Tension, Projected
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you hit a creature with Puppet Strike or Needle Rain Marionette, spend 2 CP to deepen the Tension Mark into a String Hook.
Until the end of your next turn, the marked creature cannot willingly move farther from your active puppet vessel unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw.
On a failed save, its movement stops.
A creature can use its Action to tear out the hook, ending the mark.
A Body Refiner may learn this talent only with Projected Puppetry permission unless the puppet vessel is physically attached to the target.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.false_body_on_th:
### False Body on the Stage - Substitute
When you take the Dodge action, your active puppet vessel also gains the benefits of Dodge until the start of your next turn.
If an enemy misses the puppet vessel with an attack during that time, apply a Tension Mark to that enemy.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.forbidden_corpse:
### Forbidden Corpse-Puppet Method - Forbidden, Vessel
Prerequisite: GM permission, CL 15+
You may use a humanoid corpse or similar corpse as a puppet vessel.
The corpse is not undead unless another feature makes it undead.
It does not regain life, memory, class features, or spellcasting.
When you raise a corpse-puppet vessel, choose one body memory from the following list:
Soldier’s Arm: Puppet Strike damage die increases by one step.
Runner’s Feet: +15 feet vessel Speed.
Guard’s Spine: the vessel can provide Half Cover to one adjacent creature.
Laborer’s Grip: the vessel has Advantage on saves made to maintain a Grapple created by Grasping Marionette.
Speaker’s Jaw: you may use Voice Through the Doll through it with Advantage on Performance checks meant to unsettle or warn.
Using this talent is spiritually taboo in most orthodox sects.
It may attract Karma, ghost resentment, family vengeance, sect discipline, corpse-law investigation, or burial rite consequences.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.grasping_marione:
### Grasping Marionette - Vessel, Tension
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your puppet vessel can attempt to Grapple.
As an Action, choose one creature within 5 feet of the vessel.
The creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, its choice.
Failed Save: The creature is Grappled by the puppet vessel until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature is not Grappled, but gains a Tension Mark.
The Grapple ends early if the puppet vessel is moved more than 5 feet away from the target, is reduced to 0 Hit Points, or leaves your control range.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.heaven_s_spare_b:
### Heaven’s Spare Body - Substitute
Prerequisite: Marionette Substitution Body, CL 15+
When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while you have an active puppet vessel within control range, spend 8 CP and destroy that vessel.
You are reduced to 1 Hit Point instead.
Then move to the destroyed vessel’s space or move the destroyed vessel’s remains to your space.
Use Heaven’s Spare Body once per long rest.
This talent cannot prevent death from effects that kill without reducing Hit Points unless the GM allows a specific interaction.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.hidden_thread:
### Hidden Thread - Thread
Your control threads are difficult to notice.
A creature must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Perception), or appropriate cultivation check against your Cultivation Save DC to identify the thread without special senses.
A creature that can see invisible objects, spiritual residue, Qi currents, or the thread’s physical material still gains Advantage on the check.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.iron_coffin_pupp:
### Iron-Coffin Puppet Shell - Vessel
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Your active puppet vessel can carry one willing Medium or smaller creature.
While carried this way, the creature has Three-Quarters Cover, but is Restrained by the cramped shell unless the shell is built specifically for them during a long rest.
As a Bonus Action, you may open or close the shell if the vessel is within control range.
If the vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points while carrying a creature, the carried creature falls Prone in the vessel’s space and takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.ironwood_practic:
### Ironwood Practice Body - Vessel
Your basic puppet vessel gains one of the following constructions when you designate it after a long rest:
Guard Body: +2 AC.
Running Body: +10 feet Speed.
Needle Body: Puppet Strike may deal Piercing damage and its range from the vessel increases to 10 feet.
Heavy Body: advantage on saving throws against forced movement, but Speed decreases by 5 feet.
Tool Body: the vessel can hold and use one mundane tool as part of Thread the Object.
You may choose a different construction after a long rest.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.joint_catching_n:
### Joint-Catching Needle - Tension
When you hit with Puppet Strike, choose one of the target’s obvious modes of movement: walking, climbing, flying, swimming, or burrowing.
Until the end of your next turn, the first time the target uses that movement mode, you may spend the Tension Mark to reduce that movement by 10 feet.
At CL 5+, reduce it by 20 feet instead.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.knot_the_knee:
### Knot the Knee - Tension
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a creature with your Tension Mark willingly moves at least 10 feet, spend the mark as a Reaction.
The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone after moving 5 feet.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.little_servant_s:
### Little Servant’s Errand - Thread
Your Thread the Object can manipulate unattended objects weighing up to 10 x your Proficiency Bonus pounds.
You may also perform simple tool-adjacent tasks such as sweeping dust, carrying a message scroll, pulling a curtain, pouring tea, moving a tray, turning a crank, or retrieving a visible object.
This talent does not replace a tool proficiency check when skill matters.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.long_silk_thread:
### Long Silk Thread - Thread, Projected
Increase your control range by 30 feet.
At CL 5, increase it by 60 feet instead.
At CL 11, increase it by 120 feet instead.
A Body Refiner may learn this talent only if they have Projected Puppetry permission.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.marionette_subst:
### Marionette Substitution Body - Substitute
Prerequisite: Substitute Harm Body, CL 10+
When a creature you can see targets you with an attack or harmful effect, use your Reaction and spend 3 CP to switch positions with one active puppet vessel within 60 feet.
You teleport or are pulled along the thread to the vessel’s space, and the vessel moves to your former space.
Resolve the triggering attack or effect against the new legal target if the target remains legal.
If the puppet vessel is not a legal target, you gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw or the attack roll against you has Disadvantage.
This movement is supernatural.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.needle_rain_mari:
### Needle Rain Marionette - Vessel, Tension
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you use Puppet Strike, choose to make the vessel release needles, splinters, paper blades, wire hooks, or bone pins.
The attack can target one creature within 30 feet of the puppet vessel.
On a hit, the damage type is Piercing, and the target gains a Tension Mark.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.paper_soldier_ba:
### Paper Soldier Battalion - Vessel
Prerequisite: CL 7+
You may designate a swarm of Tiny paper, straw, cloth, wooden, or bone puppets as one puppet vessel.
It occupies a 10-foot square and can move through openings at least 1 inch wide.
It cannot carry objects heavier than 5 pounds.
Puppet Strike from the battalion may target one creature in its space or within 5 feet of its space.
When a creature starts its turn inside the battalion’s space, apply a Tension Mark to that creature if it does not already have one from you.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.puppet_drinks_th:
### Puppet Drinks the Blow - Substitute
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When a creature within 5 feet of your puppet vessel takes damage, spend a Tension Mark from the attacker or from the damaged creature.
Reduce the damage by:
3d8 + your Puppetry key ability modifier
The puppet vessel takes damage equal to half the amount reduced.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.puppet_hand_fein:
### Puppet-Hand Feint - Tension
When your puppet vessel takes the Help action using False Hand, the helped ally may choose to apply the help to its next attack roll or Dexterity ability check before the start of your next turn.
If the helped roll succeeds, the target of the roll gains a Tension Mark if legal.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.puppet_screen:
### Puppet Screen - Substitute
When a creature within 5 feet of your active puppet vessel is targeted by a ranged attack, use your Reaction to move the puppet vessel into the line of attack.
The target gains Half Cover against the triggering attack.
If the attack misses because of the cover bonus, the puppet vessel takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.puppet_theater_d:
### Puppet Theater Domain - Court of Hanging Threads
“The battlefield became a stage. Every sleeve, weapon, corpse, doll, and shadow waited for the hand that knew its cue.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You establish a Puppet Theater Domain.
For the duration:
your control range applies anywhere inside the Domain;
you may maintain up to three active puppet vessels inside the Domain;
when a hostile creature starts its turn within 5 feet of one of your active puppet vessels, it gains a Tension Mark if it does not already have one from you;
once on each of your turns, use a basic Tension Response without spending your normal once-per-turn Tension Response limit;
your puppet vessels gain Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus when the Domain appears;
when one of your puppet vessels is reduced to 0 Hit Points, choose one hostile creature within 5 feet of it to make a Dexterity saving throw or become Restrained until the end of its next turn by snapping threads and collapsing limbs.
The Domain does not create permanent puppets or raw materials.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.self_marionette_:
### Self-Marionette Method - Vessel, Body Refining
You may treat your own body, armor, clothing, or a held object as your active puppet vessel for Puppetry features.
When you do, Raise the Vessel does not create a separate object.
Instead, until the effect ends:
your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one creature you have marked with Tension during the current turn;
once per turn, after you spend a Tension Mark, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the marked creature;
you may use Puppet Strike through an unarmed strike, armor cord, sleeve, weapon tassel, or held object.
Self-Marionette Method does not grant extra limbs or extra Actions.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.sever_the_sleeve:
### Sever the Sleeve, Not the Arm - Tension
When you spend a Tension Mark with Cross the Limb, choose one held nonmagical object the marked creature is holding.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It drops the object in its space.
Successful Save: It keeps the object, but has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with that object before the end of its next turn.
This talent cannot disarm shields that are strapped on, cursed items, natural weapons, or body parts.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.sleeve_pulling_r:
### Sleeve-Pulling Rebuke - Tension
Trigger: A creature with your Tension Mark makes an Opportunity Attack.
Spend the mark.
The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The Opportunity Attack misses.
Successful Save: The attack roll has Disadvantage.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.soul_thread_warn:
### Soul-Thread Warning - Thread, Spirit
Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening or GM permission, CL 15+
When a creature within your control range is about to take an Action that would directly harm you or one of your active puppet vessels, you sense the thread of intent.
Use your Reaction to move one active puppet vessel up to half its Speed before the triggering Action resolves.
If this movement places the vessel adjacent to the acting creature, the creature gains a Tension Mark before the Action resolves.
Soul-Thread Warning reads immediate hostile intent, not private thoughts.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.substitute_harm_:
### Substitute Harm Body - Substitute
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you take damage from an attack or effect while your active puppet vessel is within 30 feet, use your Reaction and spend 1 CP.
Reduce the damage by:
2d8 + your Puppetry key ability modifier
Your puppet vessel takes the same amount of damage that was reduced.
At CL 11+, increase the reduction to 3d8 + your ability modifier.
At CL 17+, increase it to 4d8 + your ability modifier.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.ten_thousand_fin:
### Ten Thousand Fingers Scripture - Thread
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you use Thread the Object, affect a number of unattended objects up to your Proficiency Bonus within a 20-foot cube.
Each object must be no heavier than 10 pounds unless another talent increases the limit.
