You may arrange tools, pull pins, move props, open latches, scatter caltrops, throw curtains, or perform a similar coordinated manipulation.
This talent cannot make attacks unless another talent explicitly allows it.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.the_body_that_he:
### The Body That Heaven Forgot Was Mine
“Cut the hands. Burn the doll. Break the stage. The thread was never between the puppet and the master. It was between motion and the world.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Thousand-Puppet Incarnation, hidden marionette scripture, GM approval
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or one active puppet vessel within 120 feet is targeted by an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, or Secret Inheritance
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Before the triggering effect resolves, designate one of the following as the True Body until the end of the current turn:
yourself;
one active puppet vessel;
one prepared puppet vessel within 120 feet;
one valid vessel destroyed since the end of your last turn.
The triggering effect treats the True Body as the primary target if it is a legal target.
If it is not a legal target, choose one:
the triggering attack has Disadvantage, or you gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw;
reduce the triggering damage by 10d10;
move yourself and up to three active puppet vessels to legal spaces within 30 feet of their current positions;
apply Tension Marks to up to five hostile creatures you can see within 120 feet.
After the triggering effect resolves, every active puppet vessel you control may immediately move up to its Speed and make one Puppet Strike, dividing attacks among legal targets as you choose.
Then all Tension Marks you control end.
If the GM determines the inheritance was used to deny a karmic, oathbound, or tribulation consequence without paying any substitute price, the inheritance may create a new debt instead of erasing the old one.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.thousand_puppet_:
### Thousand-Puppet Incarnation
“The master lifted one finger. Every discarded doll in the hall remembered it had once been shaped like a body.”
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
For the duration:
maintain up to five active puppet vessels;
when you use your Bonus Action to move puppet vessels, move any number of your active vessels up to their Speed;
once on each of your turns, make one Puppet Strike without spending your Action;
use two Tension Responses per turn instead of one;
when a puppet vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it explodes into thread, splinters, silk, bone, paper, or metal shards; each hostile creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity saving throw or gains a Tension Mark and takes 3d8 Piercing or Force damage.
This incarnation does not create permanent puppet vessels.
You must have sufficient suitable objects, prepared dolls, debris, or material in the scene, or the GM may limit the number of vessels.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.thread_the_weapo:
### Thread the Weapon - Thread, Tension
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When a creature with your Tension Mark makes a melee weapon attack, spend the mark as a Reaction.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
reduce the attack roll by your Proficiency Bonus;
the attack’s target gains +2 AC against the attack;
if the attack misses, move the attacker 5 feet to a legal space.
Successful Save: The attack roll is reduced by 1.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.threaded_step_fo:
### Threaded Step Formation - Thread
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you move your active puppet vessel, choose one willing ally within 5 feet of it.
That ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature that has your Tension Mark.
Use Threaded Step Formation once per turn.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.two_body_control:
### Two-Body Control - Vessel
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may maintain two active puppet vessels at once.
When you use a Bonus Action to move one vessel, you may move both vessels, but the total movement between them cannot exceed the highest Speed among them.
You may use Puppet Strike from either vessel, not both, unless another talent says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.puppetry.voice_through_th:
### Voice Through the Doll - Thread
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Speak through your active puppet vessel.
Your voice may sound like your own, like the puppet’s carved voice, or like a simple theatrical mask.
This does not imitate a specific person convincingly unless you have the appropriate disguise, Illusion, Jester, or Deception support.
When you use the Influence action through the puppet, you may use your Puppetry key ability in place of Charisma if the request is delivered through performance, warning, messenger-work, or ritual theater.
tianxia.talent.radiance.consecrated_boun:
##### Consecrated Boundary - Aura, Purification
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Create an area of quiet dawnlight.
Inside the area:
allies gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption;
Unclean creatures treat the area as difficult terrain;
an Unclean creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Wisdom saving throw;
ordinary spiritual contamination is suppressed.
Failed Save: The Unclean creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn and takes Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Radiance ability modifier.
Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Consecrated Boundary is not a physical Barrier and does not block movement by ordinary creatures.
tianxia.talent.radiance.consecrated_reco:
##### Consecrated Recovery
Prerequisite: CL 10+
When you use a Radiance talent to end, suppress, or grant a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, possession, corruption, disease, or curse, choose one affected willing creature.
That creature gains Temporary HP equal to:
2 × your Proficiency Bonus
A creature can gain this Temporary HP from you only once per short rest.
tianxia.talent.radiance.dawn_gate_ward:
##### Dawn Gate Ward - Aura, Ward
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Create a gate of vertical dawnlight.
Choose one creature type, force, or condition when creating the Ward, such as undead, demons, possession entities, creatures bearing a specific corruption, or creatures currently maintaining magical Darkness.
A creature matching the chosen category that attempts to enter or leave the area must make a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Its movement fails for that attempt, and it becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: It may move normally, but it cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible or visual concealment until the start of your next turn.
Dawn Gate Ward is not a complete prison. It does not block teleportation, planar travel, ethereal movement, or superior movement techniques unless a Forged Technique or higher-Realm feature says otherwise.
tianxia.talent.radiance.dawn_step:
##### Dawn Step - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Step through a line of dawnlight to an unoccupied space you can see.
The origin or destination must be in Bright Light, bear your Glow, or be adjacent to a creature or object bearing your Dawnmark.
This movement:
does not provoke Opportunity Attacks;
does not pass through solid objects;
cannot cross a sealed Barrier or Dimensional Lock;
leaves a visible streak of radiance until the start of your next turn.
Dawn Step is short spiritual movement, not the high-speed optical movement of the Light sphere.
tianxia.talent.radiance.dawn_ward:
##### Dawn Ward - Ward
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or one ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: 1 CP
A flash of dawnlight catches the harm before it settles.
Reduce the triggering damage by the amount shown below.
Cultivation Level: 1-10; Damage Reduction: 1d8 + Radiance ability modifier
Cultivation Level: 11-16; Damage Reduction: 2d8 + Radiance ability modifier
Cultivation Level: 17-20; Damage Reduction: 3d8 + Radiance ability modifier
If the triggering damage is Necrotic, Radiant, Psychic from fear or possession, or damage dealt by an Unclean creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction.
tianxia.talent.radiance.daybreak_seal:
##### Daybreak Seal - Mark, Purification
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you damage a creature bearing your Dawnmark, you may pay 2 CP.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot regain HP and cannot gain Temporary HP.
Successful Save: The target cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn.
If the target is Unclean, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw.
tianxia.talent.radiance.gentle_dawn:
##### Gentle Dawn - Purification, Ward
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Cost: 1 CP
You place a soft dawn glow over the target’s brow, heart, or meridians.
Choose one:
the target may immediately repeat a saving throw against Charmed or Frightened;
the target may immediately repeat a saving throw against Poisoned;
suppress one ordinary fear, despair, nausea, or spiritual chill effect on the target until the start of your next turn;
grant Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Radiance ability modifier.
A creature may gain Temporary HP from your Gentle Dawn only once per short rest.
tianxia.talent.radiance.halo_of_the_merc:
##### Halo of the Merciful Sovereign - Ward
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One willing creature
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Place a stable halo over the target.
For the duration:
the target sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius;
the target has Resistance to Necrotic damage;
the target has Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption;
when the target takes damage from an Unclean creature, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus;
when the target succeeds on a save against Charmed, Frightened, possession, or corruption, one hostile creature within 10 feet of the target becomes Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn.
This Halo does not require Concentration, but you may maintain only one Halo of the Merciful Sovereign at a time.
tianxia.talent.radiance.heavenly_radianc:
##### Heavenly Radiance - The Undying Dawn
“The night did not end. It was simply made too honest to continue.”
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Solar Radiance Form
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute Concentration: Not required
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Transform into an incarnation of sovereign dawn.
For the duration:
gain Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover;
gain Immunity to Radiant damage;
gain Resistance to Necrotic, Fire, and Psychic damage;
shed Bright Light in a 120-foot radius and Dim Light for another 120 feet;
suppress non-Legendary magical Darkness, ordinary illusion concealment, ordinary invisibility, and ordinary fear auras inside your Bright Light;
Radiance Strike deals 8d10 Radiant damage instead of its normal damage;
once per turn when Radiance Strike hits an Unclean target, suppress one visible corruption-derived temporary benefit until the start of your next turn.
###### Solar Aura
When a hostile creature starts its turn within 20 feet of you, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 4d10 Radiant damage and become Blinded until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
A creature is affected by Solar Aura only once per turn.
###### Dawn Wave
While Heavenly Radiance is active, when you use Radiance Strike, you may instead release one of the following:
a single-target beam with a range of 120 feet;
a 60-foot line, 10 feet wide;
a 30-foot cone.
The line and cone require Dexterity saving throws for half damage instead of attack rolls. Creatures that fail are Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn.
When the transformation ends, gain 1 level of Exhaustion unless you ended the encounter with at least half your maximum CP remaining.
tianxia.talent.radiance.mercy_of_morning:
##### Mercy of Morning - Ward
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature bearing your Glow or Dawnmark
Cost: 1 CP
Choose one:
end one ordinary frightened response that is not a full condition;
grant the target Advantage on its next saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, or possession before the end of your next turn;
allow the target to stand from Prone without spending movement;
allow the target to move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Mercy of Morning is a stabilizing blessing, not a major healing effect.
tianxia.talent.radiance.mirror_of_clean_:
##### Mirror of Clean Dawn - Revelation, Ward
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 60 feet makes a saving throw against an illusion, disguise, possession, fear, charm, or corruption effect
Cost: 2 CP
A dawn mirror appears behind the target, showing the true outline of the threat.
The target gains a bonus to the triggering saving throw equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the saving throw succeeds, the creature that created the triggering effect becomes Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn if it is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover.
tianxia.talent.radiance.purifying_radian:
##### Purifying Radiance - Purification
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Cost: 3 CP
Touch one willing creature and choose one:
end Poisoned;
remove one ordinary disease;
end Charmed or Frightened;
suppress one curse for 1 hour;
cleanse ordinary spiritual contamination;
allow the target to immediately repeat a saving throw against possession or corruption with Advantage.
A stronger curse, disease, possession, or spiritual contamination may require a Cultivation Check against the creator’s Save DC or an appropriate DC set by the GM.
###### Burning Purification
Instead of cleansing a willing creature, make a melee Cultivation Attack against one Unclean creature within reach.
Hit: Deal 4d8 Radiant damage. The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
At CL 11, increase the damage to 6d8.
At CL 17, increase the damage to 8d8.
tianxia.talent.radiance.radiant_aegis_of:
##### Radiant Aegis of the Heart - Ward
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Wrap the target’s heart, soul, or core in gentle radiance.
For the duration, the target gains:
Resistance to Necrotic damage;
Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened;
Advantage on saving throws against possession attempts;
when the target succeeds on a save against Charmed, Frightened, or possession, it may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
A creature may benefit from only one Radiant Aegis of the Heart you created at a time.
tianxia.talent.radiance.radiant_exorcism:
##### Radiant Exorcism Palm - Purification
Prerequisite: Purifying Radiance, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Cost: 4 CP
Touch one creature affected by possession, spiritual contamination, curse pressure, or an attached unclean entity.
Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM.
Success: Suppress one visible possession, corruption, or curse-derived temporary benefit until the end of your next turn. If the effect is ordinary for the target’s Realm, also grant the host Advantage on its next saving throw to resist or end that effect.
Failure: The target becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn, but the effect is not suppressed.
Radiant Exorcism Palm does not automatically end a major possession, remove a bloodline curse, or destroy a bound spirit.
tianxia.talent.radiance.resurrection_of_:
##### Resurrection of the Morning Breath - Ward, Purification
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A willing creature within 60 feet would drop to 0 HP due to damage from an Unclean creature, Necrotic damage, a curse, possession, or corruption
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
A dawn breath catches the creature at the edge of collapse.
The creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.
Then choose one:
end Frightened or Charmed on the creature;
suppress one possession or corruption effect on the creature until the start of your next turn;
move the creature up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
deal 4d8 Radiant damage to the triggering creature if it is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover.
Resurrection of the Morning Breath is not full resurrection and cannot restore a dead creature.
tianxia.talent.radiance.sever_the_posses:
##### Sever the Possessing Shadow - Purification
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature you can see that is possessed, spiritually contaminated, or serving as an anchor for an Unclean force.
Make a Cultivation Check against the possessing or corrupting effect’s Save DC. If the effect has no Save DC, use the responsible creature’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM.
Success: Suppress the possession or corruption until the end of your next turn. During that time, the host may immediately repeat one saving throw or contested check to end or weaken the effect with Advantage. If the effect is ordinary for its Realm, it ends instead.
Failure: The effect is not suppressed, but the host gains Advantage on its next saving throw against it before the end of your next turn.
If the possessing or corrupting entity is present within 60 feet, it becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn and takes 6d8 Radiant damage.
Sever the Possessing Shadow does not automatically destroy a soul, kill a host, erase a campaign-defining curse, or override a Secret Inheritance.
tianxia.talent.radiance.solar_flare:
##### Solar Flare - Aura
Prerequisite: Blinding Flash
When you use Blinding Flash, pay +2 CP.
The flash also deals Radiant damage.
Cultivation Level: 1-10;
Damage: 2d6
Cultivation Level: 11-16;
Damage: 4d6
Cultivation Level: 17-20;
Damage: 6d6
A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half damage and is not Blinded.
tianxia.talent.radiance.solar_radiance_f:
##### Solar Radiance Form - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Manifest a perfected halo, dawn mantle, or solar crown of Radiance.
For the duration:
you shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for another 30 feet;
you gain Resistance to Radiant and Necrotic damage;
Radiance Strike deals +1d8 Radiant damage;
a creature that hits you with a melee attack while within 10 feet takes 2d6 Radiant damage;
once per turn when Radiance Strike hits a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Blinded until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Unclean creatures have Disadvantage on the saving throw.
tianxia.talent.retribution.thousand_tell:
### Thousand-Tell Awareness - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Read the Tell, CL 12+
You are difficult to deceive once a creature commits its body to violence.
Gain:
Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made during combat;
Advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause you to attack an ally or misidentify a creature you can currently perceive;
the ability to recognize whether a visible creature within 30 feet is deliberately attempting to draw out your Counterstrike through a feint.
Thousand-Tell Awareness does not automatically reveal Invisible creatures, thoughts, exact actions, or hidden creatures behind Total Cover.
tianxia.talent.sabers.army_line_chopping:
### Army-Line Chopping Field - Battleline
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Area: 15-foot cone
Cost: 4 CP
Creatures in the cone make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage only.
Until the start of your next turn, allies who move through the cone’s area do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures that failed the save.
tianxia.talent.sabers.banner_cleaving_ad:
### Banner-Cleaving Advance - Battleline
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: 1 CP
Until the end of your turn, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain caused by crowds, rubble, brush, mud, shallow water, loose weapons, or ordinary battlefield debris costs you no extra movement.
If you hit with a saber after using this talent, gain 1 Edge Momentum.
tianxia.talent.sabers.battlefield_behead:
### Battlefield Beheading Line - Execution, Battleline
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 8 CP
Choose one creature you can see within range. A saber line crosses the battlefield.
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes 10d8 slashing damage, becomes Guard Pressured until the end of its next turn, and loses one ordinary guard, stance, or defensive posture until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and loses no posture.
This cannot remove Secret inheritances, domain-scale protections, artifacts, or stronger authority without an opposed check.
tianxia.talent.sabers.battleline_shove_c:
### Battleline Shove-Cut - Battleline
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a Sabers talent after moving at least 10 feet, you may spend 1 CP.
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Push it 10 feet or knock it Prone.
Successful Save: Push it 5 feet.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
tianxia.talent.sabers.beheading_feint:
### Beheading Feint - Execution
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere
Bonus Action; 2 CP.
Choose one creature within saber reach or within 30 feet if using projected saber qi.
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It is Guard Pressured, and your next Sabers attack against it before the end of your turn has Advantage.
Successful Save: It is not Guard Pressured, but it cannot take Reactions against your movement until the end of your turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.bloodless_butcher_:
### Bloodless Butcher’s Lesson - Cruel
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
You know where cuts matter without cultivating blood.
When you apply a Saber Wound, choose one:
- the target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the wound ends;
- the target has Disadvantage on the next Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check it makes before the wound ends;
- if the target receives magical healing before the wound ends, reduce that healing by your Proficiency Bonus once.
This talent does not stack with itself on the same wound.
tianxia.talent.sabers.circle_cleaving_sa:
### Circle-Cleaving Saber - Cleave
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach
Cost: 2 CP
Make saber attacks against up to a number of creatures within reach equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You cannot attack the same creature more than once with this talent.
After resolving all attacks, choose one creature you hit. It becomes Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.counter_slope_dao:
### Counter-Slope Dao - Parry
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may spend 1 CP to step into the slope of its guard.
Move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. If you end adjacent to it, it becomes Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.crescent_through_t:
### Crescent Through the Shield Wall - Cleave
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere
When your Sabers talent damages two or more creatures in one turn, choose one damaged creature carrying a shield, guard state, or temporary AC bonus.
That creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: One non-Secret guard, parry, shield bonus, or defensive stance of your choice is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No suppression, but the target is Guard Pressured.
tianxia.talent.sabers.cruel_draw_cut:
### Cruel Draw Cut - Cruel
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Bonus Action
Trigger: You hit with a saber attack
Cost: 1 CP
Deal extra slashing damage equal to one roll of your saber weapon die.
If you practice Cruel Edge Method, apply one Saber Wound.
If the target already has two Saber Wounds from you, instead add your Proficiency Bonus to the extra damage.
tianxia.talent.sabers.domain_of_the_unan:
### Domain of the Unanswered Cut - Execution
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Execution Platform Presence
Action Type: Bonus Action
Area: 30-foot emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Once per long rest, you create a domain of saber pressure.
Hostile creatures of your choice that start their turn in the domain while Guard Pressured, Bloodied, or carrying a Saber Wound must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before then.
Successful Save: The creature is immune to this talent’s Wisdom save until the start of its next turn.
The domain ends early if you are Incapacitated.
This is a saber-pressure domain, not a mile-scale sovereign edict.
tianxia.talent.sabers.execution_platform:
### Execution Platform Presence - Execution
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
For the duration, once per turn when you hit a Guard Pressured, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a saber, add 1d8 slashing damage.
When you reduce a creature to 0 HP during the duration, you may end one Frightened effect on yourself or one willing ally within 30 feet.
tianxia.talent.sabers.forward_cut:
### Forward Cut - Entry
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach
Cost: None
Make one saber attack against one target in reach.
Hit: Deal normal weapon damage. If you moved at least 10 feet toward the target this turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll.
If the target is Guard Pressured, you may also move 5 feet after the hit without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that target.
tianxia.talent.sabers.guard_cutting_parr:
### Guard-Cutting Parry - Parry
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature hits you with a melee weapon attack
Cost: None
Reduce the incoming weapon damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
If this reduces the damage to 0, or if the triggering attack misses because another defense increased your AC before damage, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
At Foundation Realm, you may spend 1 CP or 1 Stamina to make the attacker Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.hard_draw_cut:
### Hard Draw Cut - Entry, Cruel
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
Action Type: Bonus Action
Trigger: You draw a saber or begin your turn with a sheathed saber
Cost: None
Until the end of your turn, the next saber hit you make deals additional slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you practice Cruel Edge Method, you may apply one Saber Wound on that hit.
tianxia.talent.sabers.hewing_entry:
### Hewing Entry - Entry
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Range: Weapon reach
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina if delivered as Body Refining melee saber expression
Make one saber attack.
Hit: Deal normal damage and force a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is knocked Prone or Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn, your choice.
Successful Save: The target is Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.horse_cutting_arc:
### Horse-Cutting Arc - Cleave, Battleline
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot line, 5 feet wide
Cost: 4 CP
Creatures in the line make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: A creature takes 5d8 slashing damage and is pushed 5 feet or knocked Prone if Large or smaller, your choice.
Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and is not moved.
A creature carrying your Saber Wound has Disadvantage on the save.
tianxia.talent.sabers.kingfisher_beheads:
### Kingfisher Beheads the Retreat - Pursuit, Execution
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Red Trail Pursuit
When a creature within 120 feet that you damaged with a Sabers talent since the start of your last turn moves away from you, uses a teleport-like movement, or attempts to leave a battleline, you may spend 4 CP and your Reaction.
Make one Sabers Cultivation Attack against that creature. On hit, it takes 6d8 slashing damage and its movement is reduced by 20 feet until the end of the turn.
If the movement was teleport-like, this does not prevent the movement unless the target fails a Wisdom saving throw against your Sabers Save DC.
tianxia.talent.sabers.red_trail_pursuit:
### Red Trail Pursuit - Pursuit
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature you hit with a saber attack this round moves away from you
Cost: None
Move up to half your Speed toward the triggering creature. If you end within saber reach, make one saber attack against it.
If the creature has a Saber Wound from you, this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
tianxia.talent.sabers.rider_s_passing_cu:
### Rider’s Passing Cut - Pursuit
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere
When you move at least 20 feet on your turn and hit with a saber, you may spend 1 CP to continue your movement up to 10 feet after the hit without provoking from the target.
If you are mounted, this follow-through movement can be taken by your mount instead.
This does not grant mount control, mount actions, or Horse-Soul benefits.
tianxia.talent.sabers.saber_scare:
### Saber Scare - Execution
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Sabers talent or score a critical hit with a saber, choose one hostile creature within 30 feet that can see you.
That creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: No effect.
tianxia.talent.sabers.secret_saber_manua:
## Secret Saber Manuals
Secret Saber Manuals are rare battlefield lineages, executioner records, cavalry scriptures, frontier army inheritances, bandit-king scars, or named-blade teachings. They are powerful, but Sabers is not intended to have Lightning-style regional sovereignty by default.
### Manual of the Red Gate Charge - Secret, Battleline
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere, battlefield dao inheritance or military teacher
Action Type: Action
Cost: 3 CP
Move up to your Speed in a straight or gently curving line. During this movement, you may pass through spaces occupied by hostile creatures, but you cannot end there.
Choose up to three creatures whose spaces you passed through or moved adjacent to. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and knocked Prone if Large or smaller.
Successful Save: Half damage and not Prone.
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest.
At Core Formation Realm, the damage increases to 6d8 and you may affect up to five creatures.
### Execution Platform Sutra - Secret, Execution
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Execution Saber Method or executioner inheritance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
For the duration, the first time each turn you hit a Guard Pressured, Restrained, Prone, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a Sabers talent, choose one:
- add 3d8 slashing damage;
- suppress one non-Secret reaction, parry, guard, or defensive stance until the end of the target’s next turn;
- force a Constitution saving throw; on failure, the target cannot regain HP or CP until the start of your next turn.
This sutra does not kill helpless targets automatically. It makes execution mechanically possible under combat rules.
### Black Banner Cavalry Dao - Secret, Pursuit, Battleline
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Cavalry Crescent Method or cavalry/frontier inheritance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
For the duration, when you move at least 20 feet on your turn, your next Sabers hit before the end of that turn deals +2d8 slashing damage and pushes the target 10 feet on a failed Strength save.
Once during the duration, when a creature you damaged attempts to move farther away from you, you may use Red Trail Pursuit without spending your Reaction.
If you are mounted, your mount also ignores nonmagical difficult terrain created by crowds, mud, grass, shallow water, snow, or loose battlefield debris for the duration.
This manual does not grant Horse-Soul, mount intelligence, or warband command.
### Tiger-Butcher Short Saber Manual - Secret, Cruel
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Duan Dao Close-Cut Method or butcher/assassin/sect-police short-saber teacher
When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a short saber, duan dao, or butterfly saber, you may spend 2 CP.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes 3d8 slashing damage and suffers one Saber Wound.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and no Saber Wound.
If the target is larger than you, Guard Pressured, or grappled by you or an ally, it has Disadvantage on the save.
Use Limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest.
tianxia.talent.sabers.shield_hacking_rhy:
### Shield-Hacking Rhythm - Entry
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
When you hit a creature carrying a shield, using a guard stance, or benefiting from a temporary AC bonus, you may spend 1 Edge Momentum.
If you do, the target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target loses the next shield, parry, guard, or temporary AC bonus it would apply before the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: No extra effect.
This does not destroy shields or permanent armor.
tianxia.talent.sabers.short_saber_infigh:
### Short Saber Infighting - Entry
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a duan dao, butterfly saber, short saber, or similar close saber, you may make a shove attempt against that creature as part of the same Action.
If the shove succeeds, the creature is Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.ten_step_pursuit_d:
### Ten-Step Pursuit Doctrine - Pursuit
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Red Trail Pursuit
Your Red Trail Pursuit reaction can trigger when a creature you hit with a saber since the start of your last turn moves away from you, even if the hit was not this round.
When you hit with the pursuit attack, you may spend 2 CP to reduce the target’s Speed by 10 feet until the end of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.sabers.thousand_saber_inf:
### Thousand-Saber Infantry Road - Battleline
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Sabers sphere
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot line, 10 feet wide
Cost: 8 CP
Creatures of your choice in the line make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 8d8 slashing damage and cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the end of their next turn.
Successful Save: Half damage.
Allies of your choice can move through the line’s area until the start of your next turn without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures that failed the save.
tianxia.talent.sabers.wrap_the_head_retu:
### Wrap the Head, Return the Edge - Parry
Prerequisite: Sabers sphere
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A melee attack misses you, or you reduce melee damage with Guard-Cutting Parry
Cost: 1 Edge Momentum
Make one saber attack against the triggering creature.
Hit: Deal normal damage and make the target Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.scoundrel.grifter_s_hands:
#### GRIFTER’S HANDS
Gain Expertise in Dexterity (Sleight of Hand).
tianxia.talent.scoundrel.heaven_s_treasu:
#### HEAVEN’S TREASURY WAS NEVER LOCKED
“The sovereign checked their sword. Their sword remained. They checked their cultivation. Their cultivation remained. Only when they tried to act did they discover the thief had stolen the reason any of it mattered.”
Prerequisite: Sovereign of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves, CL 17+, hidden heaven-robbery scripture
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one creature you can perceive.
Make a Scoundrel Check against its Cultivation Save DC. A superior defense may replace this with an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.sect_stewardship.common_s:
### Common Scripture Notes - Pavilion
You know how to take practical notes from public instruction.
After attending a public lesson, outer gate lecture, village teaching, senior disciple demonstration, or basic scripture reading for at least 1 hour, choose one skill, tool, or sphere topic discussed in the lesson.
Before your next Long Rest, you or one ally who studies your notes may add one Merit Die to one non-combat ability check related to that topic.
This cannot grant a sphere, talent, spell, technique, language, proficiency, or permanent bonus by itself.
tianxia.talent.sect_stewardship.inner_ga:
### Inner Gate Pass - Pavilion, Etiquette
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
Your records and manners are good enough to enter places that outer disciples only hear about.
When you Petition the Hall for access to a restricted but non-secret area, such as an inner archive desk, medicine hall waiting room, furnace schedule, inner lecture balcony, guest courtyard, refined tool room, or supervised scripture shelf, roll your Merit Die twice and use the higher result.
The GM may require Inner Standing, a sponsor, a completed mission, or a written pass for sensitive areas.
This talent does not open forbidden vaults, Secret Inheritances, private residences, sealed formations, treasury rooms, or ancestor halls.
tianxia.talent.sect_stewardship.public_d:
### Public Dao Lecture - Pavilion, Lineage
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can turn a lesson into usable cultivation structure.
When you attend or organize a public lecture for at least 1 hour, choose a topic: a Path, sphere, Realm principle, sect law, ethical rule, cultivation hazard, historical example, or practical duty.
A number of willing listeners up to your Proficiency Bonus + Sect Stewardship key ability modifier may benefit.
Before each listener’s next Long Rest, they may add one Merit Die to one of the following:
a Daily Cultivation Meditation check related to the topic;
a Study check to understand the topic;
an Insight check to apply the topic socially;
a check to avoid a known cultivation mistake described in the lecture.
A creature can benefit from only one Public Dao Lecture per Long Rest.
This does not grant automatic CXP. It helps the listener make better use of ordinary cultivation and study.
tianxia.talent.shadow.clinging_silhouett:
### Clinging Silhouette
Cost: +1 CP
You may create a Shadow Anchor attached to a creature or object.
The anchor moves with its bearer.
An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The anchor is applied.
Successful Save: No effect.
An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the anchor on a success.
tianxia.talent.shadow.grasping_silhouett:
### Grasping Silhouette
Cost: +1 CP
When you apply Shadow Mark to a creature through Second Silhouette, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature becomes Restrained until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.shadow.lingering_trace:
### Lingering Trace
Cost: +1 CP
A Shadow Mark you apply lasts for 8 hours.
While the marked creature remains within 1 mile, you know:
its approximate direction;
whether it is alive;
whether it is conscious;
whether the mark has been suppressed or removed.
You may track a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you exceed this limit, choose one older mark to end.
Lingering Trace does not reveal an exact square.
tianxia.talent.shadow.long_shadow:
### Long Shadow
Cost: +1 CP
Increase Shadow Step range from half your Speed to your full Speed.
tianxia.talent.shadow.shadow_fang:
### Shadow Fang
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
On a hit, deal your choice of Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage equal to the dice below + your Path key ability modifier:
| CL | Damage |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 1d8 |
| 5-10 | 2d8 |
| 11-16 | 3d8 |
| 17-20 | 4d8 |
On a hit, you may apply your Shadow Mark until the start of your next turn.
Shadow Fang gives a combat-focused cultivator a faster way to establish Second Silhouette pressure without making ranged damage the identity of the entire sphere.
tianxia.talent.shadow.shadow_lurk:
### Shadow Lurk
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
Detach the target’s Cast Shadow as a loyal scout.
The target does not cast an ordinary shadow while the lurk exists.
#### Shadow Lurk
AC: 10 + your Proficiency BonusHP: Equal to your CLSpeed: 30 feet
The lurk:
appears as a shaded imitation of its source;
acts immediately after its source;
may move, Dodge, Hide, Help, manipulate objects, and use ordinary skill proficiencies possessed by its source;
cannot attack;
cannot activate Path features, sphere talents, Forged Techniques, limited-use abilities, or items;
must remain within 300 feet of its source.
Either the target or the lurk may retract it as a Bonus Action.
If the lurk is reduced to 0 HP or moves beyond its maximum range, it vanishes and the target becomes Stunned until the end of its next turn.
When it returns, the target immediately remembers everything the lurk perceived.
tianxia.talent.shadow.shadow_ward:
### Shadow Ward
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: 1 CP
A protective silhouette rises between danger and its target.
Reduce the triggering damage:
| CL | Damage Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier |
If the protected creature occupies one of your Shadowed Spaces, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction.
tianxia.talent.shadow.silhouette_veil:
### Silhouette Veil
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Wrap yourself in overlapping silhouettes.
For the duration:
Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in Dim Light or Darkness.
The first opportunity attack made against you each round has Disadvantage.
Creatures more than 30 feet away have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to identify your exact position while you are Lightly Obscured.
Silhouette Veil does not make you Invisible.
tianxia.talent.shield.sacrificial_shield:
#### SACRIFICIAL SHIELD - DEFLECT
When the triggering attack hits and is a Critical Hit, break your Shield.
The Critical Hit becomes a normal hit.
Resolve the attack normally after removing the additional effects caused solely by the Critical Hit.
tianxia.talent.shield.smashing_counter:
#### SMASHING COUNTER - DEFLECT, COUNTER
When the triggering attack misses and the attacker is adjacent to you, immediately attempt the ordinary 2024 Shove option of an Unarmed Strike against that creature.
The Shield may deliver the shove as a rim strike, shoulder check, rising bash, or body-weighted impact.
tianxia.talent.shield.thousand_ricochet_:
#### THOUSAND-RICOCHET SCRIPTURE - DEFLECT, COUNTER
Prerequisite: Redirecting Shield, CL 12+
When you use Redirecting Shield, you may expend Martial Focus to redirect the attack through up to three different legal targets.
Resolve the original attack roll against each target’s AC in sequence.
The attack stops after the first hit.
Each redirection must follow a plausible legal route between Shield Faces, surfaces, weapons, or terrain.
A projectile or attack that cannot continue along a legal route ends harmlessly.
tianxia.talent.smoke.scent_eating_smoke:
### Scent-Eating Smoke - Veil, Witness
Your Smoke Veil interferes with scent.
Creatures inside your Smoke Veil have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures relying primarily on smell.
A creature with a Smoke Trace from you loses this benefit against you.
tianxia.talent.smoke.the_last_breath_hid:
### The Last Breath Hides the Empire
“The palace burned for three days. No one agreed where the emperor went. The smoke remembered, but it did not testify.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Hidden Witnesses, hidden smoke scripture
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: One creature you can see or hear within 120 feet declares an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, Secret Inheritance, escape technique, or public accusation
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
A sovereign smoke court answers the declaration before the world finishes witnessing it.
Choose up to three 20-foot cubes within 120 feet. They become Dense Smoke Veils for 1 minute. These veils do not require Concentration.
The triggering creature gains a Smoke Trace that lasts for the full duration.
Then choose one inheritance effect:
#### Hide the Witness
Choose up to five willing creatures inside the smoke.
Each becomes Invisible until it leaves the smoke, attacks, deals damage, or the inheritance ends.
This invisibility is smoke-concealment, not an illusion.
#### Carry the Evidence
One object, corpse, written message, Formation key, or unattended item inside the smoke is carried to another smoke cube you created with this inheritance.
The object must fit inside a 5-foot cube and cannot be worn or carried by an unwilling creature.
#### Smother the Declaration
The triggering creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The triggering action resolves with Disadvantage on all attack rolls it makes, and targets have Advantage on saving throws against it. If it required speech, breath, command, roar, song, or verbal scripture, it also cannot be repeated until the end of the creature’s next turn.
Successful Save: Targets have Advantage on saving throws against the triggering action, or the triggering attack rolls have Disadvantage if it uses attack rolls.
#### Reveal the Ashen Path
Every creature of your choice inside the smoke learns the direction to the triggering creature, even if it teleports or becomes Invisible before the end of its next turn.
The Last Breath Hides the Empire does not erase memory. It controls what can still be seen, carried, followed, or cleanly spoken while the smoke court exists.
tianxia.talent.sniper.the_arrow_that_arr:
#### The Arrow That Arrived Before the Bowstring
Secret Sniper Inheritance Prerequisites: Heaven-Hunting Eye, Phasic Shot, CL 17+, a hidden scripture of impossible trajectory
Action Type: Action
Range: 1 mile, or farther by story/project/formation at GM discretion
Target: One creature, object, formation anchor, vehicle weak point, siege engine, exposed spirit channel, or battlefield command focus whose exact location you know
Cost: Expend Martial Focus and spend 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You lower your breath until the world forgets you are about to act.
Then the shot arrives.
Make one ranged weapon attack or single-target ranged spell attack. This attack has the following properties:
it ignores normal and long range;
it has Advantage;
Deadly Aim applies;
it ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover;
it ignores Total Cover unless the target is inside a sealed Barrier, sealed vault, demiplane, divine refuge, artifact enclosure, or equivalent absolute protection;
it can pass through one non-absolute obstruction as though using Phasic Shot;
it can apply up to three Snipe talents you know;
it counts as magical, cultivation-enhanced, and spiritually significant.
On a hit, the attack deals normal damage plus 10d10 damage. Then choose three different Decisive Line effects:
Line Through the Heart: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it drops to 0 Hit Points if its remaining Hit Points are equal to or less than half its maximum Hit Points.
Line Through the Hand: The target drops one held item, command implement, weapon, talisman, seal, or focus. If the item is protected, win an opposed Cultivation Check.
Line Through the Foot: The target’s Speed becomes 0 and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn.
Line Through the Breath: The target cannot speak, chant, roar, provide verbal components, or use breath-keyed techniques until the end of its next turn.
Line Through the Eye: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn, and invisibility or ordinary concealment does not protect it from you for 1 minute.
Line Through the Formation: Suppress one exposed formation anchor, ward node, barrier segment, domain focus, siege engine component, or command device until the end of your next turn.
Line Through the Technique: End one non-Secret ongoing effect on the target if its Pattern Rank or equivalent is not higher than your Proficiency Bonus; otherwise make an opposed Cultivation Check.
Line Through the Command: One order, command aura, battlefield signal, prepared reaction, or commanded servant sequence from the target fails or is delayed until the end of its next turn.
Line Through the Escape: If the target would move, teleport, or be carried away before the end of its next turn, you may use your Reaction to force it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the movement fails.
On a miss, the shot still finds a lesser line. Choose one Decisive Line effect other than Line Through the Heart, and apply it if the target fails the relevant saving throw or opposed check.
Limits: This inheritance cannot automatically kill a major villain, destroy an artifact, invalidate a whole fortress, erase a divine refuge, or ignore a superior Secret Inheritance. Against such targets, success may instead create the one opening needed for the party, project, sect, army, or next scene to exploit.
tianxia.talent.sound.the_first_sound_bef:
#### The First Sound Before Heaven
“Before Heaven named itself, something rang. The cultivator who hears it does not speak loudly. They remind the world what it once answered to.”
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sound-Sovereign Incarnation, World-Ringing Note, hidden primordial-tone scripture
Action Type: Action
Range: 300 feet, or one connected resonant structure within sight
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere, 300-foot line, or one named resonant target
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Release a primordial tone, absolute silence, or impossible vibration.
Choose one mode.
Heaven-Ringing Mode:
Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 16d10 Thunder or Psychic damage, become Deafened for 1 minute, and become Stunned until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and become Deafened until the end of your next turn.
Structure-Shattering Mode:
Choose one object, barrier, structure, Formation Anchor, gate, instrument array, or terrain feature.
Make a Sound Cultivation Attack or Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC.
Success: Deal 20d10 Thunder damage to the target, ignoring ordinary Resistance and hardness. If the target survives, choose one ordinary function to suppress until the end of your next turn.
Silence-Before-Sound Mode:
Create a 60-foot-radius field until the end of your next turn.
Inside the field:
hostile verbal components fail;
hostile Voice talents fail;
ordinary sound cannot exist;
Thunder damage from hostile sources becomes 0;
creatures of your choice can still hear your command, bell, or soul-tone.
The First Sound Before Heaven does not automatically destroy artifacts, Domains, immortal formations, permanent karmic bonds, or Realm-defining structures. It may crack, suppress, reveal, or contest them according to GM adjudication.
tianxia.talent.source.buried_light_eye_s:
### Buried-Light Eye Scripture
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Buried Light Lantern; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Reading, Stone, Secret
Your sight catches the buried shine before the stone is opened.
As a Bonus Action, spend 1 CP. For 1 minute, you have Advantage on Source Reading checks made to examine spiritually active stone, ore, jade, crystal, or source materials within 60 feet that you can see.
This talent does not see through total cover.
tianxia.talent.source.buried_light_lante:
### Buried Light Lantern
Tags: Reading, Stone
As an Action, spend 1 CP and choose a point on a mineral surface within 30 feet.
Until the end of your next turn, spiritually active stone, ore, jade, source crystals, inscriptions, seals, or source-contaminated cracks within 10 feet of that point shed dim light visible to ordinary sight.
This does not reveal Invisible creatures, read writing, disable traps, or identify the effect.
tianxia.talent.source.closing_the_forbid:
### Closing the Forbidden Door
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sealstone Reader or Seal-Tapping Hand
Tags: Guard, Seal, Stone
When a trap, source hazard, cursed stone, sealed container, coffin-stone, a sealed mineral object the GM has established contains or restrains a creature, or a visible seal on a mineral object or mineral surface you can see within 30 feet opens, breaks, discharges, or activates, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP.
Choose one creature you can see that is about to make a saving throw against the triggering effect. That creature has Advantage on that saving throw.
This talent does not cancel the effect, close the seal, or protect against effects that do not require or allow a saving throw.
tianxia.talent.source.dragon_pin:
### Dragon Pin
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Earth-Line Snare
Tags: Vein, Pulse, Projected
As an Action, spend 2 CP and choose a 10-foot-radius area of mineral surface within 60 feet.
For 1 minute or until your Concentration ends, that area is difficult terrain for creatures you choose. The first time each chosen creature enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Source Save DC. On a failed save, it takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage. On a successful save, it takes no damage. A creature makes this saving throw at most once per turn.
This is a short source pin, not a Formation. It requires Concentration, leaves no structure behind, and ends early if you are Incapacitated.
tianxia.talent.source.dragon_seeking_com:
### Dragon-Seeking Compass Method
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Dragon-Vein Glimpse; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Reading, Vein, Travel, Secret
Your steps keep returning to the vein, even when the road lies.
When Dragon-Vein Glimpse gives you a rough direction or clue, you also have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made during the next 8 hours to travel toward that clue without losing the general direction.
This does not reveal a safe path or bypass guardians.
tianxia.talent.source.dragon_vein_glimps:
### Dragon-Vein Glimpse
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Reading, Vein
When you spend 10 minutes using Source Reading outdoors, underground, in a mine, or in a stone ruin, you may ask whether a significant source vein, spiritual mineral deposit, sealed stone, or strong earth-pulse exists within 1 mile.
If the answer is yes, the GM gives you a rough direction or a useful clue. This does not give an exact map, ownership, safe route, quantity, or guarantee of access.
tianxia.talent.source.dragon_vein_mantle:
### Dragon-Vein Mantle
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Source Circuit
Tags: Vein, Pulse, Guard
As a Bonus Action while touching a mineral surface, spend 4 CP to mantle yourself in dragon-vein pressure for 1 minute.
While the mantle lasts, you gain Tremorsense out to 30 feet, and once per turn when you hit with Source Pulse, you may add 1d8 radiant damage to the damage roll.
The mantle ends early if you are Incapacitated or no longer touching a mineral surface.
tianxia.talent.source.earth_line_snare:
### Earth-Line Snare
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Vein, Pulse, Projected
As an Action, spend 1 CP and choose one creature you can see within 60 feet that is touching a mineral surface.
The target must make a Strength saving throw against your Source Save DC. On a failed save, its Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
This talent does not Restrain the target, knock it Prone, or prevent teleportation.
tianxia.talent.source.earth_remembers_th:
### Earth Remembers the Cut
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Dragon-Vein Glimpse
Tags: Reading, Vein, Stone
By spending 10 minutes using Source Reading in a mine, cave, mountain, stone ruin, battlefield, tomb, or source-rich place, you may ask the GM up to three questions about mineral memory in the examined area.
Valid questions include recent excavation, strongest source direction, obvious sealed chambers, major collapses, unnatural stone movement, whether something living was sealed in stone, or whether there are visible signs of ritual damage to the place.
The GM answers with brief truthful impressions if the earth, stone, or source can carry that memory. This talent does not reveal names, passwords, full maps, hidden thoughts, or future events.
tianxia.talent.source.false_stone_cautio:
### False Stone Caution
Tags: Reading, Guard, Seal
You have Advantage on checks made to notice whether a stone, ore, jade piece, spirit-stone, source crystal, or mineral container is cursed, poisoned, trapped, sealed, unstable, or spiritually contaminated before you willingly open, cut, break, carry, or absorb it.
If you knowingly ignore the warning, this talent gives no protection against the consequence.
tianxia.talent.source.fault_finding_puls:
### Fault-Finding Pulse
Tags: Pulse, Reading
Your pulse does not only strike. It shows where the target is badly set against the ground.
Once per turn, when you hit a creature with Source Pulse, choose yourself or one ally who can see the target. The next damage roll the chosen creature makes against that target before the start of your next turn gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
This bonus applies only once. A creature cannot benefit from more than one use of Fault-Finding Pulse on the same damage roll.
tianxia.talent.source.grounded_guard:
### Grounded Guard
Tags: Guard, Vein
When you take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage while you are touching a mineral surface, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP.
Reduce the damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
At Core Formation Realm, this reduction becomes 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At Nascent Soul Realm, it becomes 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.source.heaven_sealing_sou:
### Heaven-Sealing Source Pin
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Dragon Pin
Tags: Vein, Seal, Projected
As an Action, spend 4 CP and choose a 10-foot-radius area of mineral surface within 60 feet.
For 1 minute or until your Concentration ends, the area is nailed by source pressure. A creature of your choice that starts in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw against your Source Save DC before teleporting out of the area. On a failed save, that teleport fails and the use of the teleport effect is spent. On a successful save, the creature teleports normally. A creature makes this saving throw at most once per turn.
This talent does not reduce Speed, Restrain creatures, block walking or flying movement, create a wall, or affect creatures that are not touching the mineral surface. It requires Concentration and ends early if you are Incapacitated.
tianxia.talent.source.mine_shelter_refle:
### Mine-Shelter Reflex
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Grounded Guard or Safe Cut
Tags: Guard, Stone
When you take damage from a trap, collapse, falling stone, burst crystal, mining hazard, or source-stone discharge while touching a mineral surface, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP.
You have Resistance to the triggering damage.
This talent applies only to the triggering damage.
tianxia.talent.source.northern_stone_gam:
### Northern Stone-Gambler Hand
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Source Appraiser or Safe Cut; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Reading, Stone, Secret
Your fingers know when a stone is hollow, baited, fat with source, or waiting to punish greed.
Once per short or long rest, when you make a Source check to appraise, cut, open, or safely handle an existing mineral object, you may treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
This talent does not create better contents.
tianxia.talent.source.old_mine_shelter_s:
### Old Mine Shelter Scripture
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Mine-Shelter Reflex; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Guard, Stone, Secret
Your school was born in collapsing mines and learned to breathe under falling stone.
When you use Mine-Shelter Reflex, you may choose one willing creature within 5 feet of you. That creature also gains Resistance to the same triggering damage.
The creature must also be touching the same connected stone, earth, or mineral surface, as determined by the GM.
tianxia.talent.source.prospector_s_eye:
### Prospector's Eye
Tags: Reading, Stone
You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Survival) checks made to notice source signs, mineral seams, unstable stone, recent digging, worked stone, quarry marks, hidden mine supports, or spiritually active ore.
This talent does not reveal a hidden object automatically.
tianxia.talent.source.pulse_through_the_:
### Pulse Through the Seam
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Pulse, Vein, Projected
When you use Source Pulse, you may choose a mineral surface point within 30 feet that you can see. The pulse originates from that point instead of from you.
You still make the attack and use your range. The chosen point must have a clear path to the target; if the target has total cover from the chosen point, Source Pulse cannot target it.
tianxia.talent.source.quarry_walker:
### Quarry Walker
Tags: Travel, Stone
You ignore nonmagical difficult terrain caused by loose stone, scree, rubble, gravel, broken tile, mine spoil, or uneven worked stone.
This talent does not let you ignore magical difficult terrain, plant growth, mud, ice, water, crowding, or restraints.
tianxia.talent.source.root_cutting_pulse:
### Root-Cutting Pulse
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Tags: Pulse, Vein, Projected
When you hit a creature with Source Pulse, you may spend 2 CP.
The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Source Save DC. On a failed save, the target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.
This talent does not reduce current Hit Points beyond the Source Pulse damage.
tianxia.talent.source.safe_cut:
### Safe Cut
Tags: Reading, Stone, Guard
When you make a check to cut, open, harvest, or remove an existing stone, ore, jade, source crystal, or similar mineral material, failure by 5 or less does not ruin the material unless the GM rules the material was already too unstable.
This talent does not give you crafting ability and does not produce extra material.
tianxia.talent.source.seal_burying_palm:
### Seal-Burying Palm
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Earth-Line Snare
Tags: Vein, Seal, Pulse
When a creature fails its saving throw against your Earth-Line Snare, it also cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This does not Restrain, Paralyze, Silence, Stun, or prevent teleportation.
tianxia.talent.source.seal_holding_breat:
### Seal-Holding Breath
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Seal Patch or Seal-Tapping Hand
Tags: Guard, Seal
When a source hazard, cursed stone, sealed mineral object, or visible seal on a mineral object or mineral surface you can see within 30 feet would force you to make a saving throw, you may spend 1 CP before rolling.
Add your Proficiency Bonus to that saving throw.
This talent applies only to the triggering saving throw. It does not protect against effects with no saving throw.
tianxia.talent.source.seal_patch:
### Seal Patch
Tags: Guard, Seal, Stone
When you use Source Seal on a target that is unstable, cracked, or about to discharge, choose the Stillness Seal option. The seal may affect the next such roll before the end of the seal, rather than only the next roll.
This does not repair the target, prevent all discharge, or protect creatures from an effect that has already resolved.
tianxia.talent.source.seal_reclosing_han:
### Seal-Reclosing Hand
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Source Lock or Closing the Forbidden Door
Tags: Guard, Seal, Stone
When a source seal, coffin-stone, sealed mineral container, closed stone or metal door, or mundane lock or latch attached to such an object you can touch would open or break, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP.
Make a Source check. The DC is the opening creature's ability check result, the triggering effect's save DC, or another DC set by the GM. On a success, delay the opening or break until the end of the current turn.
This talent does not permanently close the seal, cancel the triggering effect, or affect artifacts, Domains, active Formations, or Secret techniques unless the GM explicitly permits an opposed Cultivation Check for a specific scene.
tianxia.talent.source.seal_tapping_hand:
### Seal-Tapping Hand
Tags: Reading, Seal, Stone
You know how to tap the edge of a seal without pretending to own it.
When you make a Source check to examine a visible magical seal, ward, binding mark, trap mark, or suppression mark on a mineral object or mineral surface, you have Advantage on the check.
On a success, the GM may tell you what the seal appears to affect, what kind of danger it poses, what might trigger it, whether it is damaged or unstable, and whether it is much older or stronger than expected.
This talent does not open, dispel, bypass, copy, suppress, or take control of the seal.
tianxia.talent.source.sealstone_reader:
### Sealstone Reader
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Reading, Seal, Stone
You have Advantage on checks made to identify whether a stone, wall, source crystal, jade object, coffin-stone, monument, or mineral container bears a seal, inscription, formation mark, talisman mark, prison mark, or preservation mark.
This talent identifies the presence and general purpose of such marks. It does not dispel them, bypass them, or teach their full rules.
tianxia.talent.source.source_appraiser:
### Source Appraiser
Tags: Reading, Stone
When you spend at least 1 minute examining an unattended stone, gem, ore sample, jade piece, source crystal, spirit-stone, or similar mineral object, you may make a Source check against a DC set by the GM.
On a success, the GM tells you one of the following facts: whether it carries active qi, whether it is ordinary or unusual for its kind, whether it is obviously unstable, whether it has been tampered with, or whether it is safe to handle normally.
This talent does not set market price and does not create valuable materials.
tianxia.talent.source.source_circuit:
### Source Circuit
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm
Tags: Pulse, Vein
As a Bonus Action while touching a mineral surface, spend 2 CP to awaken a source circuit for 1 minute.
While the circuit is active, once per turn when you hit with Source Pulse, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll. In addition, the Speed reduction from that Source Pulse becomes 20 feet instead of 10 feet.
The increased Speed reduction does not stack with itself. The circuit ends early if you are Incapacitated or no longer touching a mineral surface.
tianxia.talent.source.source_heaven_scri:
### Source-Heaven Scripture
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Dragon-Vein Glimpse; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Reading, Vein, Secret
Your lineage teaches that the land has veins because Heaven once bled into it.
Once per long rest, when you fail a Source check made as part of Source Reading, you may reroll the check. You must use the new result.
If the rerolled check succeeds, you may learn one additional useful fact from the same Source Reading.
tianxia.talent.source.source_heaven_seal:
### Source-Heaven Sealing Scripture
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Source Lock; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Seal, Stone, Secret
Your scripture teaches that a true source master first learns how not to open the wrong thing.
When you use Source Lock on a mineral object, sealed container, stone door, coffin-stone, or 5-foot section of mineral surface, you may spend 1 additional CP. If you do, the duration becomes 10 minutes.
This extended seal still follows all restrictions of Source Lock and still does not affect creatures, worn or carried items, magical locks, active Formations, talisman seals, soul seals, oath seals, or structures larger than the allowed target.
tianxia.talent.source.source_lock:
### Source Lock
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Source Seal
Tags: Seal, Stone
As an Action, spend 1 CP and touch one unattended mineral object, closed stone door, closed metal door, mineral container, coffin-stone, or 5-foot section of mineral surface.
For 1 minute, the target is held by a simple source seal. A creature can force the target open, break the seal's hold, or move through the sealed section only by succeeding on a Strength (Athletics) check against your Source Save DC. The seal ends early if the target is destroyed.
This talent does not affect creatures, worn or carried items, magical locks, active formations, talisman seals, soul seals, oath seals, or structures larger than a 5-foot section unless the GM approves the target as simple enough for this talent.
tianxia.talent.source.source_seal_pulse:
### Source-Seal Pulse
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Source Pulse
Tags: Pulse, Seal, Projected
When you hit a creature with Source Pulse while that creature is touching a mineral surface, you may spend 2 CP.
The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Source Save DC. On a failed save, the target cannot teleport until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, nothing extra happens.
This talent does not reduce Speed, Restrain the target, prevent planar travel that is not teleportation, or stop movement granted by another creature.
tianxia.talent.source.source_skin:
### Source Skin
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Guard, Stone
You have Advantage on saving throws against being Petrified.
In addition, when you take damage from a stone, crystal, sand, earth, or mineral environmental hazard, you may use your Reaction to reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.source.source_womb_script:
### Source Womb Scripture
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Stone Womb Preservation; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Guard, Stone, Seal, Secret
Your source shell preserves a life without pretending to heal it.
When Stone Womb Preservation ends, the target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Source key ability modifier, minimum 1.
These Temporary Hit Points appear after the shell ends and follow normal Temporary Hit Point rules.
tianxia.talent.source.stone_bone_source_:
### Stone-Bone Source Scripture
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Stone-Bone Source Body; Secret Inheritance
Tags: Guard, Pulse, Stone, Secret
Your body has been tempered until source pressure travels through bone without tearing the marrow.
When you use Source Pulse through a melee attack, unarmed strike, held weapon, armor plate, or touched mineral surface, you may spend 1 Stamina. On a hit, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll.
You can use this benefit only once per turn.
tianxia.talent.source.stone_cover_pulse:
### Stone-Cover Pulse
Tags: Pulse, Stone
Your Source Pulse ignores half cover if that cover is made of nonmagical earth, stone, brick, tile, crystal, ore, or similar mineral material.
This talent does not ignore three-quarters cover, total cover, magical cover, shields, armor, or cover made from wood, flesh, plants, water, or force.
tianxia.talent.source.stone_ear:
### Stone Ear
Tags: Reading, Stone
As an Action, you may touch a mineral surface and listen through it.
Until the end of your current turn, you know whether there is an obvious hollow space, flowing water, active machinery, recent excavation, or moving creature in contact with the same connected stone, earth, or mineral surface within 30 feet, as determined by the GM.
This does not give exact location, creature identity, or a map.
tianxia.talent.source.stone_within_stone:
### Stone-Within-Stone
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Source Appraiser or Sealstone Reader
Tags: Reading, Seal, Stone
When you spend 10 minutes using Source Reading on a stone, crystal, jade object, source deposit, coffin-stone, sealed ore, or similar mineral object, you may ask whether it contains one of the following: a living creature, corpse, curse, disease, preserved spirit, sealed weapon, unstable source pressure, or obvious prison mark.
The GM answers truthfully if the condition is present and detectable by Source. This talent does not open the object or identify everything inside it.
tianxia.talent.source.stone_womb_preserv:
### Stone Womb Preservation
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Tags: Guard, Stone, Seal
As an Action, spend 4 CP and touch a willing creature at 0 Hit Points or a willing Incapacitated creature.
The target is encased in a thin shell of source-stone until the start of your next turn. While encased, the target has Resistance to all damage, is stable if it was dying, and cannot move or take actions.
The shell ends early if the target regains Hit Points, if you dismiss it, or if the shell is broken by damage equal to 10 + your Source key ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.
This talent does not restore Hit Points.
tianxia.talent.source.vein_draw:
### Vein Draw
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
Tags: Guard, Vein
As a Bonus Action while touching a mineral surface, spend 1 CP to draw a small guard from the ground.
You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Source key ability modifier, minimum 1.
These Temporary Hit Points follow normal Temporary Hit Point rules.
tianxia.talent.source.vein_step_footwork:
### Vein-Step Footwork
Tags: Travel, Pulse
When your Source Pulse hits a creature, you may move up to 10 feet after the attack resolves.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the creature hit by Source Pulse.
tianxia.talent.source.world_nail_source_:
### World-Nail Source Seal
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Source Lock or Seal-Reclosing Hand
Tags: Seal, Stone, Projected
As an Action, spend 4 CP and choose one unattended mineral object, stone door, mineral container, coffin-stone, visible seal on a mineral object or mineral surface, or 5-foot section of mineral surface within 30 feet.
For 1 minute, the target is held by a source seal. A creature attempting to open, move through, or break the sealed target must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) check against your Source Save DC. If the target is a visible non-Secret seal on a mineral object or mineral surface, or a source hazard the GM considers appropriate for your Realm and CL, the GM may let this talent delay the target's next discharge until the end of your next turn instead of applying the normal forced-opening check.
This talent still does not affect creatures, worn or carried items, artifacts, Domains, active Formations, talisman seals, oath seals, or soul seals unless the GM explicitly permits an opposed Cultivation Check for a specific scene.
tianxia.talent.space.anchor_gate:
#### Anchor Gate
Tag: Gate Art, Anchor Art.
Prerequisite: Anchor Seal, CL 15.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Duration: 10 minutes.
Cost: 8 CP.
Open a stable two-way gate between two Spatial Anchors you created on the same plane.
Maximum distance:
CL 15: 3 miles.
CL 20: 5 miles.
Immortal or epic inheritances may exceed this limit, but ordinary CL 1-20 Anchor Gate does not cross provinces, nations, planes, or unknown destinations.
The gate is large enough for a Large creature.
Both anchors must still exist and must not be inside a hostile dimensional seal.
The gate is visible, contestable, and vulnerable to seal-breaking or formation disruption.
Anchor Gate is not True Teleport. It requires prepared anchors, ritual time, a visible gate, and a limited regional distance.
tianxia.talent.space.anchor_seal:
#### Anchor Seal
Tag: Anchor Art, Seal Art.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Range: Touch.
Duration: 24 hours.
Cost: 2 CP.
Create a Spatial Anchor on a doorway, stone, talisman, mirror, threshold, room, tree, gatepost, statue, road marker, or other fixed object.
You may maintain a number of Spatial Anchors equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
A Spatial Anchor may be used by your Space talents if they require an anchor. It may also be detected by Spatial Awareness, Divination, Formations, Stars, or a suitable Cultivation Check.
Destroying or defacing the anchor ends it.
At CL 10, anchors last 7 days. At CL 15, anchors last until you dismiss them, they are destroyed, or you exceed your maximum.
tianxia.talent.space.blink_guard:
#### Blink Guard
Tag: Fold Art.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You are hit by an attack, fail a Dexterity saving throw, or are included in an area effect you can perceive.
Cost: 2 CP.
Teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.
If the triggering attack or effect would no longer reach you from your new position, one of the following happens:
the attack misses you;
you take no damage from an area effect that no longer includes your space;
a movement-based hazard fails to include you.
Blink Guard cannot undo consequences that have already resolved. If the attack, saving throw, or damage has already been applied, it is too late.
At CL 15, Blink Guard range becomes 30 feet.
tianxia.talent.space.close_gate:
#### Close Gate
Tag: Gate Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 3 CP.
Create two linked openings on surfaces or in open spaces you can see within range. Each opening is up to 5 feet in diameter.
A creature entering one opening exits the other.
Rules:
A creature can pass through the gate only once on each of its turns.
A creature must have enough movement to enter the gate.
The gate does not pull creatures by itself.
A hostile creature forced toward a gate may make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it stops at the boundary. On a failure, it passes through.
A creature may not end its turn halfway inside the gate.
At CL 11, each opening may be up to 10 feet in diameter by spending 1 additional CP.
At CL 15, the range becomes 240 feet, but both openings must still be visible or anchored by a talent that explicitly allows otherwise.
Close Gate is battlefield portal work, not long-distance teleportation.
tianxia.talent.space.cut_the_road_behind:
#### Cut the Road Behind You
Tag: Seal Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: 4 CP.
After you teleport, use a gate, exit a pocket space, or pass through a spatial boundary, you may seal the route behind you.
Until the start of your next turn, creatures cannot follow through the same teleport trace, gate residue, pocket entrance, or boundary seam unless they succeed on a Cultivation Check against your CSDC.
At CL 20, the seal lasts until the end of your next turn.
This talent is commonly used by escaping masters, thieves, scouts, and sect messengers.
tianxia.talent.space.dimensional_seal:
#### Dimensional Seal
Tag: Seal Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 2 CP.
