Choose one creature, object, doorway, portal, or 10-foot cube you can see within range.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature cannot teleport, enter portals, open extradimensional storage, willingly enter a pocket space, or benefit from a spatial displacement effect. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The creature cannot teleport until the start of its next turn.
If the target is an object, doorway, portal, or area, teleportation and portals through that target are blocked unless the opposing effect succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your CSDC.
tianxia.talent.space.door_that_is_not_th:
#### Door That Is Not There
Tag: Gate Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 1 CP.
Touch a closed door, wall panel, curtain, gate, hatch, or similar boundary no more than 10 feet wide. For the duration, you create a false opening through the boundary.
Creatures you allow may pass through as if the boundary were open.
The opening does not damage the structure and closes behind each allowed creature.
Limits:
The boundary must be no more than 1 foot thick unless the GM allows a thinner spiritual interpretation.
The talent cannot pass through a Dimensional Lock.
The talent cannot bypass a higher-Realm formation seal without a Cultivation Check.
The talent does not unlock treasure chests or disable traps by itself.
tianxia.talent.space.exile_beyond_the_ho:
#### Exile Beyond the Horizon
Tag: Pocket Art, Seal Art, Forbidden Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 12 CP.
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
Choose one creature you can see. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is banished into a sealed pocket horizon for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, returning on a success.
Successful Initial Save: The target disappears until the start of its next turn.
While exiled:
the target cannot affect the outside world;
the outside world cannot affect the target;
the target experiences a vast empty road, horizon, sea, sky, corridor, or starless threshold;
the target appears in the nearest unoccupied space when it returns.
Exile Beyond the Horizon is not planar travel and does not permanently remove the target.
tianxia.talent.space.extended_fold:
#### Extended Fold
Tag: Fold Art.
Prerequisite: Fold Step.
Increase your Fold Step range by 15 feet.
You may learn this talent twice. Its benefits stack. A cultivator with Fold Step and two instances of Extended Fold has a normal Fold Step range of 50 feet.
This talent increases battlefield freedom but still does not create long-range travel.
tianxia.talent.space.fold_prison:
#### Fold Prison
Tag: Pocket Art, Seal Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 6 CP.
Choose one creature you can see. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is trapped in a small folded loop until the end of its next turn. While trapped, it is Incapacitated, has total cover from the outside world, and cannot affect creatures outside the loop.
At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw. On a success, it returns to the nearest unoccupied space to where it vanished and the effect ends.
Successful Initial Save: The target vanishes until the start of its next turn, then returns immediately. It is not Incapacitated after it returns.
Fold Prison requires concentration. If your concentration ends, the target returns immediately.
Fold Prison is not permanent banishment.
tianxia.talent.space.folded_path:
#### Folded Path
Tag: Gate Art.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Range: Touch.
Duration: 1 hour.
Cost: 3 CP.
Choose two points along a path you have physically traveled, carefully mapped, or observed from a high vantage point. The two points must be within 1 mile of each other.
For the duration, creatures traveling normally between the points may complete the journey in 10 minutes if the route is not blocked by sealed terrain, hostile formations, or complete destruction.
At CL 10, maximum distance becomes 2 miles.
At CL 15, maximum distance becomes 3 miles.
At CL 20, maximum distance becomes 5 miles.
Folded Path shortens a journey. It is not instant teleportation. Creatures still travel along the folded route and may encounter guards, wards, weather, ambushes, or sealed checkpoints.
tianxia.talent.space.folded_reach:
#### Folded Reach
Tag: Fold Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the end of your current turn.
Cost: 1 CP.
Your next melee weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, touch talent, or harmless touch effect made before the end of your turn may originate from a point you can see within 10 feet of you.
At CL 10, this distance becomes 15 feet. At CL 15, it becomes 20 feet.
The attack or effect still uses its normal range from the folded point. This talent does not allow you to attack through total cover, sealed barriers, or Dimensional Lock.
tianxia.talent.space.folded_weapon_line:
#### Folded Weapon Line
Tag: Fold Art, Edge Art.
Prerequisite: Folded Reach.
When you use Folded Reach with a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, you may spend 1 additional CP to increase the folded distance by 10 feet.
If the attack hits, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
If the attack misses, the target still knows the direction from which the attack came.
tianxia.talent.space.hidden_pocket:
#### Hidden Pocket
Tag: Pocket Art.
Prerequisite: Spatial Storage.
Your Spatial Storage is harder to detect and seize.
Benefits:
You gain Advantage on checks made to conceal the storage opening.
A creature attempting to identify the storage must succeed on an opposed Cultivation Check or an appropriate Search/Study check.
If a creature attempts to steal an item from the storage opening while it is open, you may close the opening as a Reaction.
Hidden Pocket does not make stored contraband legal, undetectable to all magic, or immune to sect inspection.
tianxia.talent.space.line_of_sight_gate:
#### Line-of-Sight Gate
Tag: Gate Art.
Prerequisite: Close Gate.
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Duration: Until the end of your next turn.
Cost: 5 CP.
Create two linked openings at points you can see within range. Each opening is up to 10 feet in diameter.
Unlike Close Gate, this gate may be suspended in open air and may be placed vertically, horizontally, or at an angle.
The gate lasts only until the end of your next turn.
A creature may pass through this gate only once per round.
Line-of-Sight Gate cannot connect to a point you cannot see and cannot become true teleportation.
tianxia.talent.space.phase_step:
#### Phase Step
Tag: Fold Art, Forbidden Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the end of your current turn.
Cost: 3 CP.
You partially step outside ordinary space.
Until the end of your turn:
you may move through creatures and objects as Difficult Terrain;
you ignore Opportunity Attacks;
you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage;
you cannot be Grappled or Restrained by ordinary physical means.
If you end your turn inside an object, you are moved to the nearest open space and take 4d10 Force damage.
Phase Step cannot pass through a Dimensional Lock or a sealed boundary of equal or higher Realm.
tianxia.talent.space.return_from_elsewhe:
#### Return From Elsewhere
Tag: Seal Art, Anchor Art.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet is teleported, banished, shifted into a pocket space, or moved between planes against their will.
Cost: 5 CP.
The affected creature makes its saving throw or contest against the triggering effect with Advantage.
If the creature still fails and the effect moves it, you may mark the departure point with a return anchor until the end of your next turn.
Before the mark ends, you may use your Action to return the creature to the marked space if the creature is on the same plane or in a pocket space connected to the triggering effect.
Return From Elsewhere cannot retrieve a creature from death, reincarnation, sealed immortal prisons, or a completed True Teleport beyond your Realm.
tianxia.talent.space.safe_return_mark:
#### Safe Return Mark
Tag: Anchor Art.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: Self.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 1 CP.
Mark your current space as a return point.
Once before the mark ends, when you use Fold Step, Blink Guard, Short Swap, or another Fold Art, you may instead teleport to the marked space if it is within 120 feet and unoccupied.
If the marked space becomes occupied, sealed, or invalid, the mark ends.
tianxia.talent.space.sect_gate_network:
#### Sect Gate Network
Tag: Gate Art, Anchor Art.
Prerequisite: Anchor Gate.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 8 hours.
Cost: Special.
Create a stable sect-scale gate network between prepared Spatial Anchors within a single territory.
This is not a normal combat talent. It is a strategic project requiring money, materials, permission, and security.
Requirements:
at least two permanent Spatial Anchors;
rare spatial jade, mirror-stone, threshold ink, void-thread, or equivalent materials;
a secure formation foundation;
a successful Cultivation Check;
GM approval for political and logistical consequences.
Default Limits:
A sect network connects a known compound, mountain, city, valley, or protected region.
It does not cross nations casually.
It does not cross planes.
It does not function through imperial dimensional interdiction.
It can be attacked, taxed, regulated, sealed, infiltrated, or sabotaged.
This talent exists because Space should be able to build gates, but gate infrastructure is not the same as personal True Teleport.
tianxia.talent.space.short_swap:
#### Short Swap
Tag: Fold Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet.
Cost: 1 CP.
Choose one willing creature you can see within range. You and the target teleport, swapping spaces.
Both spaces must be unoccupied by other creatures and large enough to safely hold the arriving creature.
At CL 10, you may use Short Swap as a Bonus Action by spending 2 CP instead.
Short Swap cannot force an unwilling creature to move.
tianxia.talent.space.sleeve_of_a_hundred:
#### Sleeve of a Hundred Steps
Tag: Pocket Art.
Prerequisite: Spatial Storage.
Your Spatial Storage can briefly hold movement as well as objects.
Once per short rest, when you or a willing creature within 5 feet would fall, be pushed, be pulled, or be moved by a non-damaging forced movement effect, you may use your Reaction to store up to 20 feet of that movement.
Until the end of your next turn, the protected creature may release the stored movement as part of its movement, moving the stored distance in a direction it chooses.
If not released, the stored movement fades harmlessly.
This talent cannot store teleportation, damage, a creature’s whole body, or a fall from more than 100 feet.
tianxia.talent.space.space_between_blade:
#### Space Between Blades
Tag: Fold Art.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature misses you with a melee attack.
Cost: 1 CP.
Teleport 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. Then choose one:
You may move 5 additional feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
The attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you until the start of your next turn.
The next melee attack you make against the attacker before the end of your next turn deals additional Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
This talent represents tiny combat-space corrections, not a full escape.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_barrier:
#### Spatial Barrier
Tag: Seal Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 3 CP.
Create a distorted barrier up to 20 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 foot thick.
Ranged attacks passing through the barrier have Disadvantage.
A creature attempting to cross the barrier must make a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Its movement ends at the boundary.
Successful Save: It crosses normally.
A creature attempts this save only once per turn.
The barrier is not a wall of force. It does not provide total cover unless a talent improves it.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_displacemen:
#### Spatial Displacement
Tag: Fold Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: 3 CP.
Choose one creature you can see within range. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Teleport the target to an unoccupied space you can see within 20 feet of its starting space.
Successful Save: Move the target 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Limits:
You cannot teleport a target into hazards that would deal immediate damage unless the GM allows it and the target fails the save by 5 or more.
You cannot teleport a target into the air unless another talent permits vertical displacement.
You cannot teleport a target into restraints, cages, or solid objects.
At CL 15, the failed-save distance becomes 30 feet.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_domain:
#### Spatial Domain - Folded Battlefield
Tag: Domain Art.
“No one is near. No one is far. They are only where the formation permits them to be.”
Action Type: Action
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 7 CP.
While the Domain is active, local distance becomes unreliable.
Your Movement: Once per turn, you may teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see inside the Domain without spending CP or using an action.
Allies: Allies inside the Domain may move through the spaces of other allies and do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from movement that begins and ends inside the Domain.
Enemies: The first time on each enemy’s turn that it moves more than 10 feet while inside the Domain, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
Teleportation: An enemy attempting to teleport out of, into, or within the Domain must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the teleport fails and the action is wasted, but CP or limited uses are not spent unless the enemy willingly forced the attempt against an obvious seal.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_domain.nasc:
#### Spatial Domain - Thousand-Door Palace
Tag: Domain Art.
Prerequisite: Spatial Domain - Folded Battlefield.
Action Type: Action
Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 10 CP.
Your Domain becomes a palace of unseen thresholds.
Benefits:
Your free teleport inside the Domain increases to 30 feet.
Once per round, when an ally inside the Domain is hit by an attack, you may move that ally 10 feet to an unoccupied space inside the Domain without using your Reaction.
Enemies treat all movement inside the Domain as Difficult Terrain.
Enemy teleportation inside the Domain requires a Charisma saving throw even if the teleport would not leave the Domain.
If an enemy fails a teleportation save inside the Domain, you may choose the nearest unoccupied valid space where the enemy appears instead of simply causing the teleport to fail.
This Domain is powerful control, but still local to the battlefield.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_maze:
#### Spatial Maze
Tag: Pocket Art, Domain Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 30-foot cube.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 9 CP.
Fold an area into a repeating local maze.
Creatures of your choice treat the area normally.
Other creatures experience the following:
The area is Difficult Terrain for them.
The first time each turn they move more than 10 feet inside the area, they make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, they emerge in a different unoccupied space in the area chosen by you.
On a successful save, they avoid being repositioned until the end of that turn, but the area remains Difficult Terrain.
Ranged attacks through the area have Disadvantage unless the attacker is one of your chosen creatures.
Spatial Maze is real folding, not an illusion. Truesight does not automatically defeat it, though spatial senses and Formations may help.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_severance:
#### Spatial Severance
Tag: Edge Art.
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet.
Cost: 5 CP.
Choose one creature or object you can see. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The target takes 6d8 Force damage and cannot teleport until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage and cannot teleport until the start of your next turn.
At CL 17, damage becomes 8d8.
Spatial Severance cuts the local relationship between the target and its escape routes. It does not sever limbs unless the GM is using a severe-injury module.
tianxia.talent.space.spatial_storage:
#### Spatial Storage
Tag: Pocket Art.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Cost: 2 CP.
Create a personal folded storage space linked to a sleeve, ring, pouch, bracelet, tattoo, scabbard, book, gourd, mirror, or ripple in the air.
Capacity:
Weight capacity equals 50 pounds times your CL.
Maximum volume equals 5 cubic feet times your Proficiency Bonus.
You may open or close the storage as an Action.
The storage:
cannot contain living creatures;
preserves ordinary objects;
does not preserve unstable explosives or volatile formulae unless the GM allows it;
cannot bypass attunement, curse restrictions, ownership seals, or soul-bound items;
collapses harmlessly if you die, placing contents beside your body or in the nearest available space.
At CL 10, you may maintain two separate storage spaces. At CL 15, you may maintain three.
tianxia.talent.space.step_behind_the_sle:
#### Step Behind the Sleeve
Tag: Fold Art.
Prerequisite: Space sphere.
When you use Fold Step, you may appear behind loose cover, hanging cloth, a doorway edge, a pillar, a screen, an ally’s space, or another visible partial obstruction within range.
If this gives you cover against a creature, you gain that cover immediately after the teleport.
Once per turn, if you Fold Step into a space adjacent to a creature that could not see your destination before the teleport, you gain Advantage on the next Dexterity (Stealth) check or melee attack roll you make against that creature before the end of the turn.
This talent does not make you Invisible.
tianxia.talent.space.void_between_worlds:
### Secret Inheritance - Void Between Worlds
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Spatial Domain, hidden inheritance.
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Split Candidate Buckets: action, reaction
Timing Detail: Reaction or Action
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=REACTION_VANISH_BETWEEN_WORLDS->reaction, ACTION_OPEN_VOID_BETWEEN_WORLDS->action
Cost: 15 CP.
Use Limit: Once per week.
“There are places between places. Most minds were not shaped to survive them.”
Choose one use.
Vanish Between Worlds: As a Reaction when you would take damage, fail a saving throw, be trapped, or be forcibly teleported, you disappear into the void between places until the start of your next turn.
While absent:
you cannot be targeted;
you take no damage from the triggering effect;
you cannot act;
you cannot perceive ordinary space clearly;
you return to your previous space or the nearest open space.
Cast Beyond the Threshold: As an Action, choose one creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target disappears until the end of your next turn. When it returns, it takes 8d10 Psychic damage and cannot teleport for 1 minute.
Successful Save: The target takes 4d10 Psychic damage and cannot teleport until the start of its next turn.
Void Between Worlds does not permanently erase a creature and does not allow True Teleport.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.battle_:
### Battle Manifestation
Your companion spirit can maintain a more stable combat body.
When you command a bonded spirit to manifest, it may remain physically or spiritually manifest for up to 1 hour, until dismissed, until reduced to 0 Hit Points, or until the bond is suppressed.
While manifest, it may use movement and basic actions according to its companion role.
If the manifestation is destroyed, the spirit is not necessarily dead, but it retreats and gains Bond Strain 1. It cannot manifest again until you finish a short rest or make an appropriate Offering unless you spend 2 CP to call it back sooner.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.bind_th:
### Bind the Violent Ghost
When placing a Binding Seal on a spirit that has attacked you or your allies during the current scene, you have Advantage on the Binding check or the spirit has Disadvantage on its saving throw, whichever rule the GM uses.
This advantage does not apply if you provoked the spirit through betrayal, taboo violation, or unjustified aggression.
Orthodox sects often permit this talent for exorcists, battlefield sealers, plague-spirit hunters, and shrine protectors.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.break_t:
### Break the Cruel Seal
You can weaken another cultivator's Binding Seal.
As an Action, target one spirit, vessel, host, or seal within 30 feet that you can perceive.
Make a Cultivation Check against the binder's Cultivation Save DC.
On a success, reduce the target Binding Seal's control for 1 minute. During that time, the bound spirit has Advantage on saving throws to resist commands, possession, forced manifestation, or punishment through the seal.
If the bound spirit is willing to be freed and the original seal is not stronger than your Realm, you may instead suppress the Binding Seal until the end of your next turn.
This talent does not automatically make the spirit friendly.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.call_th:
### Call the Little Shrine
You can create a small temporary dwelling for a willing spirit.
As part of a short rest, you may prepare a minor shrine, token, charm, cup, ribbon, carved bone, blood mark, flower garland, incense bowl, blade knot, or similar object.
A willing spirit bound to you may shelter in that object.
While sheltered, the spirit is not physically manifest, cannot be targeted by ordinary attacks, and cannot use most Nature Expressions. It can communicate with you in impressions while you carry the shrine.
If the shrine is destroyed, the spirit is forced to manifest or retreat, increasing Bond Strain by 1.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.externa:
### External Spirit Source
Your bonded spirit can serve as the origin point of its Nature Expression.
When you command a manifested spirit to use a Nature Expression, the effect may originate from the spirit's space rather than yours, provided the expression is part of the spirit's Nature.
This talent is especially important for Body Refiners.
A Body Refiner with this talent still does not personally project external qi. The spirit is the source.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.first_n:
### First Nature Expression
Choose one Major Spirit Bond you maintain.
The spirit learns one additional simple Nature Expression from one of its Nature Spheres.
The expression must be appropriate to Mortal Realm.
You may take this talent more than once. Each time, choose one additional simple expression for a bonded spirit.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.gentle_:
### Gentle Offering Method
When you give a spirit an appropriate Offering during a short rest or scene of quiet interaction, reduce Bond Strain by 1.
Once per long rest, if the Offering is especially meaningful, you may reduce Bond Strain by 2 instead.
This talent cannot reduce Bond Strain caused by ongoing coercion unless the spirit accepts the Offering as genuine.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.great_n:
### Great Nature Expression
Choose one bonded spirit and one active Nature Sphere.
The spirit may learn one Foundation talent from that Nature Sphere as a Spirit Nature Expression.
You do not learn that talent.
The spirit must meet any Realm, Nature, and story requirements. You must pay any CP cost unless the spirit has its own CP pool.
You may take this talent more than once.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.guardia:
### Guardian Spirit Posture
When your bonded spirit is within 10 feet of you or a protected ally, you may command it as a Bonus Action to Guard.
Until the start of your next turn, the first attack against the protected creature has Disadvantage, or the protected creature gains a bonus to AC equal to your Proficiency Bonus against that attack. Choose when the posture is activated.
If the spirit's Nature is Guardian, Ancestor, Shield, Mountain, Shrine, Beast, or similar, the protected creature also gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.iron_co:
### Iron Courtesy
You know how to speak to spirits without immediately offending them.
When you first encounter a spirit, you may make a Wisdom or Charisma check against a DC set by the GM.
On a success, you avoid accidental violation of its most obvious Taboo for the first scene.
This does not protect you from deliberate insult, coercion, or ignorance after the spirit's nature is revealed.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.name_bi:
### Name-Binding
Forbidden or Restricted
You learn to bind a spirit through a deeper portion of its Name.
When you successfully apply a Binding Seal to a spirit whose true or partial Name you know, the spirit has Disadvantage on its first attempt to break the seal.
In addition, you may issue one standing command that the spirit must obey unless it directly violates its core Nature.
Every time the standing command forces unwilling service, increase Bond Strain by 1.
Using Name-Binding on a sentient spirit without just cause is considered a grave spiritual crime in many traditions.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.nature_:
### Nature Talent Investment
Choose one bonded spirit and one of its active Nature Spheres.
The spirit learns one Mortal talent from that sphere as a Spirit Nature Expression.
You do not learn that talent.
The expression uses the spirit as source and follows all ordinary Realm limits, costs, and targeting rules unless modified by the bond.
You may take this talent more than once. Each time, choose a new Nature talent for a bonded spirit.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.oath_wr:
### Oath Written in Incense
When you form a Covenant Bond, you may define one formal Oath between yourself and the spirit.
Examples:
- I will not abandon your shrine.
- I will feed you with victory.
- I will return your bones home.
- I will never command you to harm children.
- I will avenge your grove.
- I will let you taste the blood of my enemies.
- I will carry your name until it is remembered.
While you uphold the Oath, reduce Bond Strain by 1 after each long rest, minimum 0.
If you knowingly break the Oath, Bond Strain immediately becomes 3.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.painful:
### Painful Binding Seal
Restricted
You can create a Binding Seal on a defeated, trapped, or restrained unwilling spirit.
Use the Binding Seal rules under Forge the Bond.
A spirit bound this way gains Bond Strain 1 immediately.
When you command the spirit to act against its desire, increase Bond Strain by 1 unless the command aligns with its Nature or the spirit fears a greater consequence.
A spirit held by Painful Binding Seal may attempt to weaken the bond whenever Bond Strain reaches 3, when you are reduced to 0 Hit Points, when you violate the terms of the seal, or when an appropriate exorcist, shrine, or hostile spirit interferes.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.possess:
### Possession Contest
You can fight for control when a spirit tries to host an unwilling creature.
When a spirit attempts to possess, host, ride, or control a creature within 30 feet, you may use your Reaction to interfere.
Make a Cultivation Check against the spirit's DC.
On a success, the target gains Advantage on its saving throw or the spirit has Disadvantage on its check.
If the spirit is one of your bonded spirits, you may instead help it, imposing Disadvantage on the target's resistance. Helping an unwilling possession is Forbidden in most orthodox settings.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.punishi:
### Punishing Seal
Restricted
When a spirit bound by your Binding Seal disobeys a command that the seal can lawfully enforce, you may use your Reaction to punish it.
The spirit takes Psychic or Force damage equal to one roll of your sphere die plus your key ability modifier, or it loses access to one Nature Expression until the end of its next turn.
Using this talent increases Bond Strain by 1.
Repeated use may mark you as a cruel binder in societies that recognize spirit ethics.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.rebirth:
### Rebirth of the Broken Spirit
You can restore a bonded spirit whose manifestation, vessel, or shrine was destroyed.
As an 8-hour rite, spend 5 CP and provide an offering meaningful to the spirit.
If the spirit's core has not been devoured, erased, reincarnated beyond reach, or claimed by a stronger authority, it returns to a new vessel, shrine, body, dream, or hosted mark.
The spirit returns with Bond Strain 2 unless the offering directly addresses the cause of destruction.
This talent can also purify some corruption from a spirit, but cannot rewrite its Nature without a major story.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.second_:
### Second Major Bond
You may maintain one additional Major Spirit Bond.
This talent cannot be taken before Core Formation Realm.
You may take this talent again at Nascent Soul Realm.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.shared_:
### Shared Senses
As an Action, you may share senses with a bonded spirit within 1 mile.
Until the start of your next turn, you perceive through the spirit's senses and are Blinded and Deafened to your own surroundings unless you choose to end the link early.
At Foundation Realm, you may maintain this for Concentration, up to 1 minute.
At Core Formation Realm, sharing senses no longer Blinds or Deafens you unless the spirit is in a radically alien environment.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.soverei:
### Sovereign Nature Expression
Choose one bonded spirit and one active Nature Sphere.
The spirit may learn one Core Formation talent from that Nature Sphere as a Spirit Nature Expression.
At the GM's discretion, a Nascent Soul spirit or Great Spirit avatar may learn a Nascent Soul expression, but this should usually require a Secret Inheritance, major covenant, or story breakthrough.
You do not learn that talent.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.spirit_:
### Spirit Intercession
When a creature you can see targets your bonded spirit, hosted vessel, or spirit shrine with an attack, you may use your Reaction to impose Disadvantage on the attack if you are within 30 feet of the spirit or vessel.
Describe how the bond flares, the spirit blurs, a warding charm sparks, or your own aura pulls the blow aside.
If the attack still hits, increase Bond Strain by 1 unless you spend 1 CP.

### Spirit Pact Technique
You can forge techniques that belong to both you and the spirit.
When you create a forged technique involving this sphere and one of the spirit's Nature Spheres, the technique may be assigned to the bond rather than to you alone.
A bond technique can only be used while the spirit is bonded, hosted, or manifested.
If the bond breaks, the technique becomes unusable until repaired, inherited, reinterpreted, or reforged.
This talent is a formal gateway for techniques such as a blood dryad's flower field, a weapon spirit's impossible strike, or an ancestor's protective command.

### Spirit Recall
As a Bonus Action, call a bonded spirit within 60 feet back to its vessel, shrine, hosted body, or your side.
If the spirit is willing and not restrained, banished, sealed, or incapacitated, it immediately moves to the chosen legal location.
This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks because the spirit folds through the bond rather than crossing space normally.
At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 120 feet.
At Core Formation Realm, the spirit may be recalled from up to 1 mile if it is not in combat.

### Spirit Speech
You can communicate with spirits through impressions, images, emotions, and symbolic language even if you do not share a spoken language.
This does not force honesty or cooperation.
When speaking to a spirit whose Nature you have Read during the current scene, you may use your key ability modifier instead of Charisma for one social check toward that spirit.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.sympath:
### Sympathetic Vessel
When a hosted spirit would suffer damage, banishment, forced suppression, or a hostile Binding attempt, the host or vessel may absorb part of the pressure.
If you are the host, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction to grant the spirit Advantage on its saving throw or impose Disadvantage on the hostile check.
If the spirit still fails, you take damage equal to your Cultivation Level or gain 1 Bond Strain.
If the host is an item, the item takes the damage or suffers visible cracking, tarnish, wilting, bleeding, or other stress.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.vessel_:
### Vessel Mark
You can mark an object, weapon, charm, corpse, statue, mask, shrine, or piece of armor as a spirit vessel.
Creating a Vessel Mark takes 10 minutes and costs 1 CP.
A vessel can safely hold one willing minor spirit, one Covenant spirit that chooses to shelter, or one bound spirit whose seal is already established.
A spirit in a vessel is easier to carry, hide, protect, bargain with, or imprison.
A vessel has AC and HP appropriate to the object. If destroyed, the spirit is expelled and Bond Strain increases by 1.
tianxia.talent.spirit_companions.warding:
### Warding Name
You learn a partial Name of a bonded spirit, not enough to enslave it but enough to call it home.
When the spirit would be banished, forcibly dismissed, compelled away from you, or trapped beyond a boundary, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to call its Warding Name.
The spirit makes a new saving throw with Advantage, or you make a Cultivation Check against the effect's DC.
On a success, the spirit remains with you or returns to its vessel.
tianxia.talent.stars.astral_bearings:
#### Astral Bearings
Tags: Survey, Astral
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 2 CP
You read the high sky for planar strain and astral orientation. For the duration, you gain Advantage on checks made to:
identify portals, planar thinness, astral disturbances, or teleportation scars;
determine whether a space has been folded, sealed, or displaced;
recognize whether a Star Anchor has been tampered with;
navigate through strange realms where normal geography is unreliable.
This does not reveal a portal’s destination unless you have another valid clue.
tianxia.talent.stars.astral_body_beyond_:
#### Astral Body Beyond the Sky
Tags: Astral, Survey
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Project an astral star-body along your Star Anchor Network. Your physical body becomes Incapacitated but not Unconscious. Your astral body appears as a faint constellation at one active Star Anchor within 100 miles on the same plane.
While projected:
you can see and hear from the astral body;
you may speak in a quiet starlit voice;
you may use Survey, Relay, Mark, and Ward Stars talents from the astral body’s position;
you cannot use Attack talents unless a specific feature permits it;
if the astral body takes damage equal to your CL, the projection ends;
if your physical body takes damage, you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration.
Astral Body Beyond the Sky cannot cross planar boundaries by default and does not allow possession.
tianxia.talent.stars.celestial_bearings:
#### Celestial Bearings
Tags: Survey
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 1 CP
Choose yourself and up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures. For the duration, each chosen creature gains:
Advantage on checks made to navigate outdoors;
the ability to know true north;
the ability to estimate time until sunrise, sunset, moonrise, or local nightfall if such cycles exist;
Advantage on checks made to notice ordinary celestial-navigation errors;
the ability to know the direction of the nearest active Star Anchor you created within 1 mile.
Aligned Benefit: Beneath Open Sky or within 30 feet of a Star Anchor, the creatures may also estimate approximate latitude, identify major known landmarks by direction, and notice whether the sky is supernaturally distorted.
tianxia.talent.stars.celestial_relay:
#### Celestial Relay
Tags: Relay, Anchor
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Special
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
Send a brief message to one willing creature within 30 feet of one of your active Star Anchors on the same plane. The message may appear as:
a constellation;
a spoken whisper;
written light;
a star-map pulse;
a brief dreamlike image.
The target may reply with one brief message if willing.
Celestial Relay cannot cross planes unless reinforced through a Forged Technique, Secret effect, or special observatory.
tianxia.talent.stars.cold_star_mantle:
#### Cold Star Mantle
Tags: Ward
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CPConcentration: Required
Cold starlight settles over your body or one willing creature within 30 feet. For the duration, the target gains:
resistance to Cold damage;
Advantage on saving throws against being lost, disoriented, or magically misdirected;
once per turn, when the target deals Radiant, Force, or Cold damage, it may add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll.
tianxia.talent.stars.constellation_guard:
#### Constellation Guard
Tags: Ward
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CPConcentration: Required
Seven faint stars orbit you. For the duration, you gain:
+2 AC;
resistance to Radiant and Force damage;
Advantage on saving throws against being lost, teleported involuntarily, displaced between planes, or moved by a spatial effect.
One visible star extinguishes whenever you take damage from a hostile creature. When the final star extinguishes, the AC bonus ends, but the other benefits remain until the talent ends.
At the start of each of your turns, restore one extinguished star if you are Aligned.
tianxia.talent.stars.constellation_priso:
#### Constellation Prison
Tags: Mark, Line, Ward
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 6 CPConcentration: Required
Saving Throw: Charisma
Choose one creature you can target. A constellation locks around the creature. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For the duration, the target is Restrained, cannot teleport, cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible, and cannot take Reactions. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot teleport until the start of your next turn.
A restrained target may also use its Action to make a Strength or Charisma check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the prison on a success.
tianxia.talent.stars.constellation_road:
#### Constellation Road
Tags: Anchor, Line, Survey
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 8 CP
Connect at least two active Star Anchors within 20 miles on the same plane. Willing travelers designated by you who follow the route gain:
travel at three times ordinary overland Speed;
Advantage on checks made to avoid becoming lost;
Advantage on checks made to avoid ordinary ambushes along the route;
knowledge of the direction of the next anchor;
a faint starlight trail visible only to designated creatures.
Constellation Road cannot cross planes, cannot cross a Dimensional Lock, requires at least two active Star Anchors, and remains detectable through Stars, Divination, or Formations.
tianxia.talent.stars.guiding_star:
#### Guiding Star
Tags: Mark, Survey
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 90 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Choose one ally, enemy, object, or visible location. A harmless guiding star appears above or near it.
If the target is willing, carried by you, or unattended, no save is required. An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target bears your Stellar Mark until the start of your next turn.
For the duration, one ally who can see the guiding star may add 1d4 to one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw made to reach, strike, protect, or avoid the marked target. A creature can benefit from only one Guiding Star die per round.
tianxia.talent.stars.heaven_mirror_star_:
#### Heaven-Mirror Star Map
Tags: Survey, Anchor
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 hour
Duration: Until your next long rest
Cost: 6 CP
Create an advanced Star Map tied to one Star Anchor Network. While holding the map or meditating within 30 feet of it, you may ask one of the following questions once per hour:
Which of my Star Anchors has been disturbed most recently?
Which anchor is nearest to a celestial disturbance?
Which anchor has the clearest sky reference?
Is the route between two anchors spatially distorted?
Is one named location within the mapped region under false sky, starless ward, or major concealment?
The answer appears as shifting starlight and may be approximate. The map cannot reveal secrets outside the mapped region or defeat stronger concealment automatically.
tianxia.talent.stars.night_sight_meridia:
#### Night-Sight Meridian
Tags: Survey
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 1 CP
Starlight opens a quiet meridian behind your eyes. For the duration:
Dim Light does not impose Disadvantage on your Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight;
you can see normally through nonmagical darkness out to 60 feet;
you have Advantage on checks made to identify constellations, celestial distortions, Star Anchors, or astral signs.
This does not see through magical darkness unless the darkness is weaker than your Stars effect and you succeed on a Stars Check against its DC.
tianxia.talent.stars.seven_star_step:
#### Seven-Star Step
Tags: Line, Movement
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 3 CP
Move along up to three short star steps. Choose up to three unoccupied spaces you can see within range. You may move through them in any order, ending in the final chosen space.
This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks and may move vertically, but cannot pass through solid barriers.
If you pass within 5 feet of a creature bearing your Stellar Mark, you may end its Reactions until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw.
tianxia.talent.stars.stable_stellar_mark:
#### Stable Stellar Mark
Tags: Mark
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 120 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Saving Throw: Charisma
Choose one creature you can target. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target bears your Stellar Mark for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the mark on a success.
Successful Save: The target bears your Stellar Mark until the start of your next turn.
While marked:
it cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible against you;
you know its direction within 1 mile;
your Stars ranged attacks ignore Half Cover against it;
Starpath Step may end in a valid unoccupied space within 10 feet of it.
tianxia.talent.stars.star_anchor:
#### Star Anchor
Tags: Anchor, Survey, Relay
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 2 CP
Create one Star Anchor. Choose one attunement:
Wayfinding Anchor. Creatures you designate within 1 mile know its direction.
Warning Anchor. You know when a creature crosses within 30 feet of it if you are within 10 miles and on the same plane.
Observation Anchor. While within 1 mile, you may use an action to perceive its immediate surroundings as a dim starlit image until the end of your next turn.
Technique Anchor. Once per turn, one Stars talent used within 30 feet of the anchor costs 1 fewer CP, minimum 1.
You may maintain a number of Star Anchors equal to your Proficiency Bonus unless another feature increases the limit.
tianxia.talent.stars.star_drawn_projecti:
#### Star-Drawn Projectile
Tags: Attack, Mark, Line
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the end of your turn
Cost: 2 CP
The next ranged weapon attack, thrown weapon attack, Starbolt, Comet Spear, or similar line attack you make this turn is drawn along a constellation path.
Choose one benefit:
ignore Half Cover;
increase range by 60 feet;
if the target bears your Stellar Mark and the attack hits, push it 10 feet;
if the attack misses a marked target, you may reroll the attack once, but must use the new result.
tianxia.talent.stars.star_name_seal:
#### Star Name Seal
Tags: Mark, Astral, Ward
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 10 CPConcentration: Required
Saving Throw: Charisma
Choose one creature bearing your Stellar Mark. You speak the star-name assigned to its current position. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For the duration, the target cannot teleport, cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible, cannot willingly enter another plane, and cannot move farther than 120 feet from the point where the seal was placed. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot teleport until the start of your next turn.
If the target is a Legendary creature, a sect treasure bearer, or protected by a stronger spatial or fate effect, the GM may require an opposed Cultivation Check before the failed-save effect applies.
tianxia.talent.stars.star_needle_aim:
#### Star-Needle Aim
Tags: Attack, Mark
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: Until the end of your turn
Cost: 1 CP
Your next Starbolt or ranged weapon attack this turn follows a needle-thin constellation line.
If the target bears your Stellar Mark, the attack ignores Half Cover. If the target does not bear your Stellar Mark, the attack gains +1 to hit.
This talent does not ignore Total Cover.
tianxia.talent.stars.star_shadow:
#### Star Shadow
Tags: Astral, Mark, Attack
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CPConcentration: Required
Create one humanoid constellation shadow in an unoccupied space you can see.
Star Shadow Statistics. AC 13 + your Proficiency Bonus. Hit Points equal to 5 x your CL. Speed 30 feet, Fly 30 feet, Hover.
Star Strike. The shadow makes a Cultivation Attack using your modifier. On a hit, it deals 2d8 + your key ability modifier Radiant, Force, or Cold damage.
Guiding Light. When the shadow hits a creature, apply Stellar Mark until the start of your next turn.
The Star Shadow acts immediately after your turn. As a Bonus Action, you command it to Attack, Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, or Search. Without a command, it Dodges.
Only one Star Shadow may exist at a time.
tianxia.talent.stars.star_soul_guidance:
#### Star-Soul Guidance
Tags: Ward, Astral
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within 30 feet fails a saving throw against being Charmed, Frightened, possessed, displaced, lost, teleported against its will, or spiritually misdirected
Cost: 3 CP
A constellation flashes inside the creature’s aura. The creature rerolls the saving throw and must use the new result.
If the creature is Aligned, it gains a bonus to the reroll equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
A creature can benefit from Star-Soul Guidance only once per short rest.
tianxia.talent.stars.starlight_ward:
#### Starlight Ward
Tags: Ward
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage
Cost: 1 CP
A small constellation flashes between the harm and the target. Reduce the triggering damage by:
CL 1-10: 1d8 + key ability modifier;
CL 11-16: 2d8 + key ability modifier;
CL 17-20: 3d8 + key ability modifier.
Aligned Benefit: Add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction.
tianxia.talent.stars.warning_star:
#### Warning Star
Tags: Ward, Anchor, Relay
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 1 minute
Range: Touch
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 1 CP
Place a faint warning star on a doorway, campsite, wagon, ship, or small area no larger than a 20-foot-radius sphere.
When a creature you did not designate enters the area, you receive a brief warning if you are within 1 mile and on the same plane. The warning tells you the direction of the star and whether the intruder is Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, or larger. It does not identify the creature.
A creature using Stealth may avoid triggering the warning by succeeding on a Dexterity (Stealth) check against your Cultivation Save DC.
tianxia.talent.talismans.advanced_talism:
#### Advanced Talisman Crafting - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may craft Uncommon and Rare talismans.
You may reverse engineer a Common or Uncommon talisman formula after 8 hours of study and a successful Talisman Crafting Check against the formula DC + 2.
A failed reverse engineering attempt does not destroy the talisman unless you fail by 5 or more.
tianxia.talent.talismans.battle_stroke_s:
#### Battle Stroke Scripture - Script
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
For the duration, you may use Emergency Stroke as a Bonus Action instead of an Action.
A talisman drawn this way must be Common unless another talent permits a higher-rank emergency formula.
tianxia.talent.talismans.binding_talisma:
#### Binding Talisman - Formula, Seal
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You learn the Binding Talisman formula.
Rank: Uncommon
Family: Binding
Activation: Action
Range: 30 feet, or thrown 20/60 feet
Target: one creature
Consumed: yes
The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Restrained for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.talismans.demon_subduing_:
#### Demon-Subduing Tag - Formula, Seal
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You learn the Demon-Subduing Tag formula.
Rank: Rare
Family: Binding, Purification, Sealing
Activation: Action or Triggered
Range: 30 feet, or applied to a surface
Consumed: yes
Choose one fiend, demon, corrupted spirit, possessing entity, undead, or comparable unclean creature. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: It is Restrained and cannot teleport, possess a new host, turn invisible, or willingly enter another plane until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
If the talisman is part of a prepared site seal, the failed-save duration becomes 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each of the target’s turns.
tianxia.talent.talismans.elemental_talis:
#### Elemental Talisman
Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder when you craft a compatible Attack formula.
The formula deals that damage type instead of its normal elemental damage.
When you spend at least 1 CP while crafting the talisman, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll the talisman makes.
You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different damage type each time.
tianxia.talent.talismans.ember_talisman:
#### Ember Talisman - Formula
You learn the Ember Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Attack
Activation: Action
Range: 60 feet
Target: one creature or object
Consumed: yes
Make a Talisman Attack. On a hit, the target takes Fire damage.
Damage is 1d10 at CL 1, 2d10 at CL 5, 3d10 at CL 11, and 4d10 at CL 17.
tianxia.talent.talismans.featherfall_tal:
#### Featherfall Talisman - Formula
You learn the Featherfall Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Movement
Activation: Reaction, triggered when the bearer or a creature within 30 feet begins falling
Range: 30 feet
Consumed: yes
The affected creature descends safely and takes no falling damage from the triggering fall.
tianxia.talent.talismans.formula_copyist:
#### Formula Copyist
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When copying a formula into a formula book, jade archive, sect manual, or personal talisman scripture, reduce the time required by half.
You have Advantage on checks to determine whether a copied formula is incomplete, forged, mistranslated, trapped, or deliberately corrupted.
tianxia.talent.talismans.ghost_warding_t:
#### Ghost-Warding Talisman - Formula, Seal
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You learn the Ghost-Warding Talisman formula.
Rank: Uncommon
Family: Purification, Sealing
Activation: Action or Triggered
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 hour
Consumed: yes
Attach the talisman to a door, coffin, corpse, shrine, weapon, room threshold, or willing creature.
For the duration, incorporeal undead, ghostly projections, possessing spirits, and similar entities have Disadvantage on the first attack roll or ability check they make each turn against the warded target or across the warded threshold.
A stronger spirit may force an opposed Cultivation Check to push through.
tianxia.talent.talismans.healing_talisma:
#### Healing Talisman - Formula
You learn the Healing Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Restoration
Activation: Bonus Action
Range: Touch
Target: one creature
Consumed: yes
The target regains 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier hit points.
At CL 5, healing increases to 2d8 + Intelligence modifier. At CL 11, 3d8 + Intelligence modifier. At CL 17, 4d8 + Intelligence modifier.
tianxia.talent.talismans.hidden_sleeve_p:
#### Hidden Sleeve Preparation
Increase your Prepared Talisman Limit by 2.
In addition, once per turn you may draw or stow a prepared talisman without using your object interaction.
tianxia.talent.talismans.legendary_talis:
#### Legendary Talisman Crafting - Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: CL 15+
You may craft Very Rare and Legendary talismans.
When you fail a Talisman Crafting Check, you may spend 5 CP to reroll the check. You must use the new result.
You can attempt to stabilize a Cracked Talisman during a long rest. Make a Talisman Crafting Check against the original DC. On a success, it becomes stable. On a failure, it remains cracked. On a failure by 5 or more, it is destroyed.
tianxia.talent.talismans.message_talisma:
#### Message Talisman - Formula
You learn the Message Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Communication
Activation: Action
Range: 1 mile
Consumed: yes
Send a short written or whispered message of no more than 25 words to a creature carrying a paired talisman you crafted.
The recipient receives the message as ink appearing, a whispered voice, warmth in the sleeve, or another chosen sign.
tianxia.talent.talismans.purifying_talis:
#### Purifying Talisman - Formula
You learn the Purifying Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Purification
Activation: Action
Range: Touch
Consumed: yes
Choose one creature or object. End one minor poison, spoiled food/water impurity, common miasma stain, minor corpse odor, or similar low-grade contamination.
At CL 5+, this formula can also grant Advantage on the target’s next saving throw against Poisoned or diseased before the end of your next turn.
tianxia.talent.talismans.qi_storage_tali:
#### Qi Storage Talisman - Formula
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You learn the Qi Storage Talisman formula.
Rank: Uncommon
Family: Sealing, Restoration
Activation: Bonus Action
Range: Touch
Consumed: yes
When crafted, you may store CP in the talisman, up to your Proficiency Bonus.
A creature holding the talisman may activate it to regain CP equal to the amount stored, up to its normal maximum.
Stored CP fades when you finish a long rest unless the talisman is jade, bone, or metal.
tianxia.talent.talismans.rapid_talisman:
#### Rapid Talisman
When crafting Common or Uncommon talismans, reduce the required time by half.
If you rush a talisman this way during danger, increase the crafting DC by 2.
tianxia.talent.talismans.remote_activati:
#### Remote Activation
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may activate a prepared talisman you crafted within 60 feet as if you were holding it, provided you can perceive it or clearly sense its resonance.
If the talisman is worn or held by an unwilling creature, that creature may make a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, your remote activation fails but the talisman is not consumed.
tianxia.talent.talismans.reusable_talism:
#### Reusable Talisman - Medium
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You may craft reusable jade talismans storing Common or Uncommon formulae.
A reusable talisman has one charge and regains one charge at dawn or after the bearer completes a full cultivation session, as the formula states.
Creating a reusable talisman increases material cost by x50 and adds +5 CP to the crafting cost.
Reusable talismans count against your Reusable Jade Limit.
tianxia.talent.talismans.revealing_talis:
#### Revealing Talisman - Formula
You learn the Revealing Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Detection
Activation: Action
Range: Self
Duration: 10 minutes
Consumed: yes
For the duration, you have Advantage on checks to notice visible talismans, written seals, hidden ink, obvious spiritual inscriptions, and attached ward tags within 30 feet.
This does not reveal invisible creatures, secret identities, or hidden memories unless another feature says so.
tianxia.talent.talismans.seal_breaker_s_:
#### Seal Breaker’s Eye
You gain Advantage on Read the Script checks against Common and Uncommon talismans.
If you identify a talisman’s trigger, you also learn one safe method of avoiding that trigger, if such a method exists.
tianxia.talent.talismans.secret_formula:
### Secret Formula
#### Dao-Sealing Talisman - Secret Formula
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Legendary Talisman Crafting, lost scripture or sect inheritance
Crafting
Cost: 10,000 gp and 15 CPCrafting
Time: 30 days
Activation: Melee Talisman Attack or applied as part of a successful compatible technique
Target: one creature
Consumed: yes
On a hit, the target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening. For 1 minute, the target cannot spend that Path’s resource or activate talents that require that Path. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot spend CP until the start of your next turn.
The Dao-Sealing Talisman may be removed or ended by:
a successful Cultivation Check as an Action against your Talisman Save DC;
a Legendary purification or seal-breaking technique;
destruction of the physical talisman;
a superior Secret technique;
a campaign-scale counterseal.
The Dao-Sealing Talisman cannot permanently remove a Path, Realm, cultivation base, class feature, or character identity unless the campaign explicitly makes that the story’s central consequence.
tianxia.talent.talismans.shield_talisman:
#### Shield Talisman - Formula
You learn the Shield Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Shielding
Activation: Reaction, triggered when the bearer is hit by an attack
Range: Self or bearer
Consumed: yes
The bearer gains +3 AC against the triggering attack, possibly turning the hit into a miss.
tianxia.talent.talismans.talisman_bomb:
#### Talisman Bomb - Array
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Preparation
Time: 10 minutes
Activation: Action
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 6 CP plus consumed talismans
Bundle up to your Proficiency Bonus compatible talismans.
Choose one mode.
Focused Bomb: All talismans must share one family. Resolve one primary effect and improve it once per additional talisman.
Layered Bomb: Use up to three different compatible effects. Resolve each once. The GM may reject combinations that do not make sense together.
All talismans in the bomb are consumed.
tianxia.talent.talismans.talisman_recall:
#### Talisman Recall - Script
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Choose one talisman you crafted and can perceive, or whose resonance you can clearly sense.
If unattended, it flies to your hand or a legal space within your reach.
If held or worn by another creature, that creature makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the talisman returns to you. On a success, it remains where it is.
Artifacts, soul-bound talismans, and talismans integrated into a Formation may require an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.talismans.talisman_reflec:
#### Talisman Reflection - Seal
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Trigger: You are targeted by a single-target supernatural effect
Action Type: Reaction
Cost: 5 CP and one compatible prepared talisman
Make a Talisman Crafting Check against DC 10 + the attacker’s Proficiency Bonus + the attacker’s relevant ability modifier.
On a success, redirect the effect toward its source or another legal target within the effect’s original range.
On a failure, the talisman is consumed and the effect resolves normally.
This cannot redirect area effects, Domains, Secret techniques, Legendary actions, or effects without a meaningful target line unless the GM permits an opposed Cultivation Check.
tianxia.talent.talismans.talisman_wall:
#### Talisman Wall - Seal
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP per talisman used
Arrange prepared talismans into a wall of written Qi.
The wall may be up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 inch thick. It must be contiguous and placed on a surface or suspended between legal anchor points.
For each talisman consumed, the wall gains 10 hit points. The wall has AC 15 and provides Total Cover while intact.
The wall does not block teleportation, possession, planar travel, or effects that do not physically cross the wall unless a formula says so.
tianxia.talent.talismans.ten_thousand_ta:
#### Ten Thousand Tags Obey
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Talisman Array
When you build a Talisman Array, you may include up to twice your Proficiency Bonus talismans.
In addition, once per long rest, when a Talisman Array would consume one Common or Uncommon talisman, you may prevent that talisman from being consumed.
tianxia.talent.talismans.triggered_talis:
#### Triggered Talisman
When crafting a talisman, you may give it one legal visible trigger instead of requiring direct activation.
The trigger must be simple, observable, and written into the formula.
A triggered talisman remains prepared until activated, removed, disabled, destroyed, or until the formula’s maximum storage duration expires.
tianxia.talent.talismans.warding_talisma:
#### Warding Talisman - Formula
You learn the Warding Talisman formula.
Rank: Common
Family: Shielding
Activation: Action
Range: Touch
Duration: 1 hour
Consumed: yes
Choose Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The bearer gains +1 to saving throws using that ability for the duration.
A creature can benefit from only one Warding Talisman at a time.
tianxia.talent.the_hidden_eye.biological:
##### Biological Insight - Approach
You may use Intelligence (Nature) when attempting to Analyze a creature.
When you successfully Analyze a creature using Nature, learning its creature type does not count against the number of Analyzable Characteristics you learn from that attempt.
tianxia.talent.the_hidden_eye.detect_sur:
##### Detect Surface Thoughts - Research, Realm Evolution
Prerequisite: Proficiency in Wisdom (Insight)
Action Type: Action
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Target: One creature Analyzed by you
Listen to the target’s surface thoughts.
Until the talent ends, you have Advantage on ability checks and saving throws made against that target.
Detect Surface Thoughts reveals immediate emotional impressions, active concerns, and the thoughts naturally passing through the target’s mind. It does not automatically reveal hidden memories, compel answers, or allow you to search the target’s mind for a chosen fact.
A creature with no readable mind is immune.
Detect Surface Thoughts is a magical cultivation effect.
tianxia.talent.the_hidden_eye.discern_te:
##### Discern Tells - Research
You have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made against creatures Analyzed by you.
A creature Analyzed by you cannot have Advantage on attack rolls made against you.
Discern Tells does not impose Disadvantage on those attacks. If the creature has both Advantage and Disadvantage, resolve the roll using the normal rules.
tianxia.talent.the_hidden_eye.meridian_s:
##### Meridian-Seeking Ledger - Research, Realm Evolution
When you successfully Analyze a creature, you may record one learned characteristic in a spiritual ledger, memorized combat schema, carved jade slip, or equivalent cultivation method.
Until you finish a Long Rest, the first ally you advise about that target gains one of the following benefits of your choice:
Advantage on its next attack roll against the target;
Advantage on its next saving throw against an effect created by the target;
a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus on its next Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Insight), or Wisdom (Survival) check made to detect, follow, or understand the target.
Advising the ally requires 1 minute of explanation or a Bonus Action if the ally is within 30 feet and can perceive you.
You may maintain a number of ledgers equal to your Path key ability modifier, minimum 1.
tianxia.talent.the_hidden_eye.stealth_su:
##### Stealth Surge - Research, Stalker
While you are hidden, creatures Analyzed by you have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to find you.
tianxia.talent.thread.binding_knot:
#### Binding Knot
Talent Type: Knot.
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or replace one attack when you take the Attack action
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_BINDING_KNOT->action, ATTACK_REPLACEMENT_BINDING_KNOT->action
Range: Thread range.
Cost: 1 CP or expend Martial Focus.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack against a creature. On a hit, the target is Grappled by your Thread Line until the end of your next turn. The target may use an action to attempt Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Acrobatics), or an appropriate Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC to escape.
Maintenance: You may use a Bonus Action on later turns to maintain the grapple if the line remains intact.
Mundane
Restriction: If this is done with ordinary thread, the target may also escape by cutting the line.
tianxia.talent.thread.borrowed_limb_scri:
#### Borrowed Limb Scripture
Talent Type: Forbidden Control.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: 5 CP.
Target: One creature connected by at least two of your Thread Lines.
Effect: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you force one immediate simple movement: drop one held object, take one step of up to 5 feet, make one weapon attack against a target you choose within its reach, fall Prone, or waste its Reaction until the start of its next turn.
On
Success: The target is immune to your Borrowed Limb Scripture until the end of the encounter.
Forbidden Note: This is the edge where Thread approaches Puppetry. Repeated public use is likely to draw sect attention, moral suspicion, and counter-scripture development.
tianxia.talent.thread.cutting_thread:
#### Cutting Thread
Talent Type: Strike.
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=CUTTING_THREAD_RIDER->passive
Timing Detail: Part of Draw the Line or Threaded Strike
Cost: None, or 1 CP for Qi Thread damage.
Effect: Your thread can cut. When you hit with Draw the Line or a melee attack modified by Threaded Strike, you may deal Slashing damage equal to 1d6 + your key ability modifier.
Scaling: The damage becomes 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
Qi Edge: If you spend 1 CP, the damage is magical and can be Force instead of Slashing.
tianxia.talent.thread.dao_spinning_cocoo:
#### Dao-Spinning Cocoon
Talent Type: Defense and Transformation.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Range: Self or touch.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 5 CP.
Effect: You wrap yourself or a willing creature in a cocoon of silk and qi. The target is Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects that cannot penetrate the cocoon. The cocoon has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and hit points equal to 10 times your CL. It is resistant to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Refinement: At the start of each of the target’s turns while inside, choose one benefit.
The target regains hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier.
The target ends one Poisoned or Bleeding effect.
The target gains advantage on one saving throw before the start of its next turn.
The target may spend one Hit Die and regain additional hit points.
Emergence: When the cocoon ends, the target may stand, move 10 feet, and end one Grappled or Restrained effect currently affecting it.
tianxia.talent.thread.garrote_thread:
#### Garrote Thread
Talent Type: Strike.
Action Type: Action
Range: 5 feet, or 10 feet if you have an active Thread Line to the target.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus or spend 1 CP.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack against one creature that breathes or has a vulnerable neck, throat, mask line, breathing vent, spiritual speech point, or similar exposed channel. On a hit, the target takes Bludgeoning or Slashing damage equal to your Thread sphere damage and cannot speak clearly until the start of your next turn.
Save: The target may make a Strength saving throw. On a success, the speech restriction does not apply.
Limits: Garrote Thread does not automatically prevent spellcasting or cultivation techniques unless they require clear speech, chanting, or breath. Creatures without a relevant anatomy may be immune.
tianxia.talent.thread.heaven_net_casting:
#### Heaven-Net Casting
Talent Type: Loom.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Area: 30-foot radius.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 6 CP.
Effect: You cast a net of qi threads over the area. Flying creatures in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have their flying speed reduced to 0 until the start of their next turn. Creatures without Hover fall if their flying speed becomes 0. Grounded hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain and have disadvantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks to escape grapples, restraints, or thread effects.
Partial Effect: On a successful save, a flying creature’s flying speed is reduced by 20 feet until the start of its next turn.
tianxia.talent.thread.hidden_fiber:
#### Hidden Fiber
Talent Type: Utility.
Action Type: Action
Range: Touch or thread range.
Cost: None, or 1 CP for Qi concealment.
Effect: You conceal a mundane Thread Line, anchor, knot, suture, or trip line. A creature must succeed on a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check against your Cultivation Save DC to notice it.
Qi Concealment: If you spend 1 CP, you can conceal a Qi Thread from ordinary sight, though spiritual senses and magical detection may still detect it.
tianxia.talent.thread.hundred_line_weavi:
#### Hundred-Line Weaving
Talent Type: Core Expansion.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Effect: Your Thread Line limit increases by 2. When you use Draw the Line, you may spend 1 additional CP to target one additional creature or object within range. Make a separate Thread Attack for each target.
Tension Mastery: Once per round when a Thread Line you maintain would end at the end of your turn, you may maintain it until the end of your next turn without spending an action.
tianxia.talent.thread.life_line_stitch:
#### Life-Line Stitch
Talent Type: Emergency Restoration.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature within Thread range is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright.
Cost: 6 CP.
Effect: You stitch the creature’s life-line to its body. The target instead drops to 1 hit point, falls Prone, and becomes Restrained by your thread until the end of its next turn. While restrained this way, it cannot take reactions, and its speed is 0.
Cost of Survival: The target gains one level of Exhaustion after the immediate danger passes. A creature can benefit from Life-Line Stitch once per Long Rest.
Limits: Life-Line Stitch cannot reverse instant death, old age, soul destruction, scattered cultivation base, or a death explicitly claimed by Fate, Heaven, or a stronger narrative power unless the GM allows it.
tianxia.talent.thread.loom_of_the_narrow:
#### Loom of the Narrow Gate
Talent Type: Battlefield Control.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Action
Range: 90 feet.
Area: Up to six connected 5-foot squares, arranged as lines or arcs.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 4 CP.
Effect: You create a narrow battlefield loom. Hostile creatures treat the affected squares as Difficult Terrain. When a hostile creature leaves one affected square for another or exits the area, you may use your Reaction to make a Thread Attack. On a hit, choose Pull, Snare, Trip, or Disarm from Draw the Line, and the target takes your Cutting Thread damage if you know that talent.
Persistent Lines: The loom counts as two active Thread Lines for your limit.
tianxia.talent.thread.meridian_lock:
#### Meridian Lock
Talent Type: Control.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Action
Range: Qi Thread range.
Cost: 3 CP.
Effect: Choose a creature connected by one of your Qi Threads. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is Restrained until the end of your next turn and cannot spend CP to use movement, teleportation, forced movement, or escape techniques. On a success, its speed is halved until the end of your next turn.
Maintenance: You may spend 1 CP at the start of your turn to extend the effect on a failed target until the end of your next turn. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
tianxia.talent.thread.needle_guide:
#### Needle Guide
Talent Type: Strike.
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=NEEDLE_GUIDE_RIDER->passive
Timing Detail: Part of an attack with a needle, dart, throwing knife, light blade, acupuncture needle, or similar small piercing weapon
Cost: None.
Effect: You may attach a thread to the weapon. On a hit, you may immediately create a Thread Line to the target without using Draw the Line. On a miss, you may pull the weapon back to your hand unless it is lodged, destroyed, or caught.
Follow-Up: If the target is connected by this line, your next Thread Attack against it before the end of your next turn gains a +2 bonus.
tianxia.talent.thread.puppet_line_correc:
#### Puppet-Line Correction
Talent Type: Support and Control.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Reaction
Trigger: A creature connected to your Thread Line makes an attack roll, Strength check, Dexterity check, or Dexterity saving throw.
Cost: 2 CP.
Effect: If the creature is willing, it adds your Proficiency Bonus to the roll. If the creature is unwilling, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, subtract your Proficiency Bonus from the roll. On a success, the roll is unaffected.
Limits: This is momentary line correction. It is not full puppeteering, mind control, or forced action.
tianxia.talent.thread.qi_thread_scriptur:
#### Qi Thread Scripture
Talent Type: Core Expansion.
Prerequisite: CL 5.
Effect: Your Qi Threads become more stable and more common. When you spend 1 CP to create Qi Thread, it lasts for 10 minutes instead of 1 minute. While active, your Thread Lines may be Qi Threads by default instead of requiring separate CP for each line.
Extra Lines: Your Thread Line limit increases by 1.
Martial Use: You may use Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, or Wisdom for Thread Attacks with Qi Thread, chosen when you gain this talent.
tianxia.talent.thread.red_thread_of_debt:
#### Red Thread of Debt
Talent Type: Spirit and Social.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Timing Detail: 1 minute
Range: Touch.
Duration: 24 hours.
Cost: 3 CP.
Target: One willing creature with whom you share a promise, debt, oath, rescue, rivalry, or meaningful relationship.
Effect: You tie a symbolic red thread between yourself and the target. While on the same plane and within 1 mile, each of you knows the rough direction of the other if the other is conscious and willing to be found. Once during the duration, either creature may tug the thread as a Bonus Action, allowing the other to sense urgency, danger, grief, or summons.
Limits: This is not Fate. It does not guarantee reunion, enforce romance, compel obedience, or change destiny. A creature may willingly break the thread as an action.
tianxia.talent.thread.sever_the_battle_l:
#### Sever the Battle Line
Talent Type: Battlefield Control.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Range: 120 feet.
Cost: 5 CP.
Effect: Choose two creatures, two objects, or one creature and one object that you can see. You cut the line of cooperation, pursuit, or reinforcement between them. Each unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, until the end of your next turn the two targets cannot willingly move closer to each other, cannot provide Help to each other, and cannot use reactions to protect, counter for, or benefit each other.
On
Success: The affected target can act normally, but the next time it tries to move closer to the other named target before the end of your next turn, its speed is reduced by 10 feet.
Limits: This does not break emotional bonds, Fate threads, command structures, telepathy, or allied status. It temporarily cuts the tactical line between two points.
tianxia.talent.thread.severing_silk:
#### Severing Silk
Talent Type: Strike.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Timing Detail: Action, or replace one attack
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_SEVERING_SILK->action, ATTACK_REPLACEMENT_SEVERING_SILK->action
Range: Qi Thread range.
Cost: 3 CP.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack. On a hit, the target takes Force or Slashing damage equal to your Thread sphere damage, and you may attempt to sever one active magical effect, Thread Line, tether, mark, charm, curse, or maintained technique on the target.
Check: Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s DC, the creator’s Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC. On a success, the effect ends or is suppressed until the end of your next turn.
Limits: Severing Silk cannot sever artifacts, core cultivation bases, major oaths, Fate ledgers, or permanent story bonds without GM approval.
tianxia.talent.thread.silk_step:
#### Silk Step
Talent Type: Movement.
Action Type: Bonus Action
Cost: None, or 1 CP for Qi Thread.
Effect: You use thread tension to assist footwork. Until the end of your turn, your walking speed increases by 10 feet, and you may move through the space of a creature connected to one of your Thread Lines as if it were Difficult Terrain rather than blocking your movement.
Wall Hook: If you have a thread anchored to a wall, ceiling, beam, tree, roof, or similar support, you may climb or swing up to 10 feet as part of this movement without making an ability check unless the surface or situation is especially dangerous.
tianxia.talent.thread.snaring_crossing:
#### Snaring Crossing
Talent Type: Reaction.
Trigger: A creature you can see moves across a space containing one of your Thread Lines or moves out of a space adjacent to an anchor you control.
Cost: Expend Martial Focus or spend 1 CP.
Effect: The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, its speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn. On a success, its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
