**Successful Save:** The target is not marked, but you learn whether its Source CL is lower than, equal to, or higher than yours and whether a stronger effect is concealing its soul-flame.

If the target is Bloodied, has failed an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw since the end of your last turn, has lost Concentration, or has had a supernatural defense suppressed during the scene, it makes this save with Disadvantage.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.choir_of_the_un:
### CL14 — All Eyes Open

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 6 Resonance  
**Duration:** The scene

Manifest a **Choir of Unopened Eyes**, a Spirit Awakening field extending 30 feet from you. Invisible spiritual eyes, reflected faces, harmonized whispers, or rings of unreadable script fill the field.

While the field lasts:

- You cannot be surprised by a spiritually perceptible creature in the field unless protected by higher authority.
- Ordinary invisibility, ordinary illusion, mundane disguise, and ordinary voice mimicry cannot grant Advantage against you.
- Hostile creatures of your choice have Disadvantage on Deception checks made in the field and on saves made to maintain ordinary disguises or illusions against your observation.
- A creature bearing your Witness Note cannot teleport, cross a planar boundary, or spiritually project out of the field without leaving a visible departure chord that identifies the direction and broad method used.
- Once per round when a hostile creature in the field becomes Resonance Marked or contradicts a witnessed statement, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on it.

#### Chorus Assets

When the field manifests, create three **Unopened Eyes**. They are stationary Cultivation Assets placed in unoccupied spaces you can see in the field.

Each Eye has:

- **Type and Size:** Tiny stationary Spirit Cultivation Asset
- **AC:** Your Cultivation Save DC
- **Hit Points:** `3 × Proficiency Bonus`
- **Speed:** 0 feet
- **Source CL:** Your effective Spirit Awakening CL
- **Damage Immunities:** Poison and Psychic
- **Condition Immunities:** Charmed, Frightened, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
- **Perception:** Shares your Spiritual Sense within 15 feet of itself
- **At 0 Hit Points:** It is destroyed, deals the printed Psychic damage to you, and leaves no creature or corpse.

An Eye does not take a turn. Once on each of your turns, choose one surviving Eye as the origin of Spiritual Sense, Soul Gaze, Hymn of Stillness, Forced Confession, or a technique that expressly permits a spiritual Asset as its origin.

Destroying all three Eyes ends the field. If an Eye is destroyed, you take Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Soul Splitting cannot duplicate these Eyes or grant them independent actions.

#### Closed Testimony

As a Bonus Action, spend 2 Resonance and choose two surviving Eyes. Until the start of your next turn, the straight line between them becomes a witness barrier. A lower-Source-CL creature bearing your Witness Note cannot cross that line unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, its movement stops before the line and it suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.

### CL18 — Edict of Perfect Witness

You can make the Choir’s shared observation temporarily more authoritative than the target’s preferred self-presentation.

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Requirement:** The target bears both your Witness Note and Resonance Mark, or is inside All Eyes Open and has failed against one of your features this scene

Choose one creature that can hear you. It makes a Charisma saving throw.

**Failed Save:** For up to 1 minute, subject to repeated saves, the target is under **Perfect Witness**.

While under Perfect Witness, it cannot willingly:

- speak a deliberate lie;
- benefit from ordinary invisibility, disguise, or illusion against creatures you designate;
- teleport, plane shift, project its soul, or cross a sealed threshold without first using its Action to declare the broad method and intended destination;
- target a creature other than you with an attack or hostile technique while you are a legal target, unless it first uses its Action to state one emotionally true reason it refuses your witness;
- conceal whether it is possessed, oath-bound, coerced, disguised, carrying a hidden spiritual Asset, or acting under a direct command, though exact details may remain protected.

At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save. Each success removes one bullet of its choice. Three successes end Perfect Witness. A failed repeat save imposes one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.

**Successful Initial Save:** Until the end of its next turn, it cannot willingly lie, cannot benefit from ordinary invisibility against you, and suffers two different ordinary Spiritual Pressure effects as one exceptional pressure package.

#### Equal and Higher Authority

A Secret Law, divine silence, artifact mask, identity-defining transformation, or equal- or higher-Source-CL concealment can contest individual expressions of the Edict. A successful contest suppresses only the disputed bullet, not the entire feature.

Perfect Witness does not compel revelation of facts the target does not know, force self-incrimination in exact legal terms, or grant you control of the target’s full turn. It is terrifying because it narrows evasion, not because it creates omniscience.

#### Witness Aftermath

When Perfect Witness ends, every creature that directly observed the Edict retains a clear memory that extraordinary spiritual coercion occurred. Ordinary memory alteration cannot erase that fact from a lower-Source-CL witness, though it may blur details. This social and spiritual evidence is one reason the method remains Forbidden.

#### Soul Splitting Expression — Second Witness

While Soul Splitting is active, use **Second Witness** as your Subpath Expression. Move your Soul Fragment up to 20 feet and choose one subject within 30 feet of it that bears your Witness Note. Until the start of your next turn, the fragment counts as a second witness position for determining whether that subject is within range of Face, Voice, Wound, or Confession Echo notation. This does not place a new Note, duplicate an activation, or permit a statement or event hidden from both positions to be witnessed.

### CL10 — Forced Confession

You can force an observed contradiction to surface as an emotionally true statement.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 5 Resonance  
**Requirement:** The target can hear you and bears your Witness Note or Resonance Mark

Choose one question from the following list and speak it aloud:

- What do you fear will happen next?
- What are you trying to protect?
- Whom or what do you presently serve?
- What guilt or shame is influencing this decision?
- What immediate action do you intend?
- What desire are you refusing to name?

The target makes a Charisma saving throw.

**Failed Save:** It must speak one emotionally true sentence that directly concerns the chosen question. It may use metaphor if literal speech is impossible, but it cannot knowingly answer with a falsehood.

**Successful Save:** You learn which broad motive currently dominates it: fear, duty, hunger, love, pride, grief, hatred, survival, obedience, or concealment.

#### Protected Information

Forced Confession does not automatically reveal:

- protected names;
- passwords or exact tactical plans;
- a Secret Law’s hidden procedure;
- a sealed memory;
- divine or artifact-confined knowledge;
- facts the target genuinely does not know;
- an identity whose exposure would itself require higher authority.

If the answer would cross such protection, the target instead speaks a true sentence describing the pressure surrounding the secret. A Cultivation Check against the protecting effect can reveal one additional useful category, but not necessarily the exact secret.

#### Confession Echo

If the target fails, you may place a new Witness Note on the spoken statement without counting against the once-per-turn limits of another feature. For the scene, you know when the target knowingly acts in direct contradiction to that statement while within 300 feet on the same plane.

### CL6 — Hymn of Stillness

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 3 Resonance  
**Target:** One creature that can hear you or bears your Witness Note

The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** It takes `3d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic damage and is caught in synchronized observation until the start of your next turn. During that time:

- it cannot take Reactions;
- its Speed is reduced by 10 feet;
- it cannot willingly benefit from ordinary invisibility or an ordinary disguise against you;
- if Resonance Marked by you, choose one additional ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect for it.

**Successful Save:** It takes half damage. Choose either to reduce its Speed by 10 feet or prevent Reactions until the start of your next turn.

#### Sustained Refrain

At the start of your next turn, you may spend 1 Resonance to force a target that failed to repeat the save.

- On a failure, the Stillness continues until the start of your following turn.
- On a success, it ends.
- You can sustain only one Hymn of Stillness at a time.
- Damage from the Hymn is dealt only on the initial use.

A creature with lower Source CL that fails by 5 or more cannot speak a deliberate lie while the Hymn persists, though it can remain silent.

### CL3 — Witness Note

When you use Spiritual Sense, Soul Gaze, or another legal diagnostic procedure on a creature or effect, you may spend 1 Resonance to place a Witness Note on one observed subject.

Choose one **Notation**:

#### Face Notation

Ordinary invisibility, mundane disguise, and ordinary illusion cannot prevent you from identifying the subject as the same spiritual presence while it remains within 60 feet. This does not reveal a new body behind total cover or defeat higher-authority transformation automatically.

#### Voice Notation

While the subject is within 60 feet and you can hear it, you know when it knowingly contradicts a statement it made while bearing the Note. You do not automatically learn which statement was false or the complete truth.

#### Wound Notation

You know when the subject gains or loses Hit Points, Temporary Hit Points, a possession effect, a spiritual contamination, or a Resonance Mark while within 60 feet.

#### Threshold Notation

Place the Note on a doorway, boundary, object, corpse, shrine, or 5-foot space. You know when a spiritually perceptible creature crosses, possesses, activates, removes, or meaningfully alters the subject while you are within 300 feet on the same plane.

#### Chorus Recognition

Once per turn when a hostile creature bearing your Witness Note becomes Resonance Marked by you, you may impose Revealed Disturbance as its ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect without additional cost.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.compass_breakin:
### CL10 — Break the Four Directions

You collapse completed movement into one decisive martial line.

**Action**  
**Range:** Your reach after the movement below  
**Cost:** 5 Resonance  
**Requirement:** Your Pole is a meaningful hostile creature or hostile Cultivation Asset you can perceive within 60 feet

Spend one, two, or three different Bearing tokens. For each token spent, you may first move up to 10 feet by spiritual step. Each segment must complete the corresponding movement category relative to the Pole's position when the activation began. These segments:

- do not provoke opportunity attacks from the Pole;
- cannot cross a wall, sealed boundary, or illegal space;
- do not end Grappled or Restrained unless you first win the required contest;
- are one movement created by this activation, not separate movement activations.

After the movement, make one cultivation attack against the Pole through an unarmed strike or a weapon you are proficient with. Use your Cultivation Attack Modifier instead of the normal attack modifier for this attack.

**Hit:** The attack deals its normal damage plus `2d8 + 1d8 for each Bearing spent` Psychic or Force damage. Apply each matching rider:

- **Approach:** Move the Pole up to 10 feet toward you and Resonance Mark it until the end of your next turn. A creature at least two size categories larger than you or a creature protected by equal-or-higher bodily, gravity, Space, or anchoring authority can make a Strength saving throw to prevent the movement.
- **Orbit:** The Pole cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.
- **Depart:** Move the Pole up to 15 feet away from you on a failed Strength or Wisdom saving throw. You may then move 10 feet away from it without provoking opportunity attacks from it.

**Miss:** You may move 5 feet in the category of one Bearing spent. No damage or hostile rider occurs.

Break the Four Directions is one attack and one Spirit Awakening technique. It cannot become an Attack action, deliver a full multi-packet Forged Technique, or activate a second movement-granting attack feature.

### CL18 — Heaven Has No Fixed North

You manifest a battlefield in which orientation follows cultivated intent rather than passive geography.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Area:** 40-foot-radius aura centered on you  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required

The aura is your **Compass Domain** and moves with you.

#### Chosen Bearings

At the start of each chosen ally's turn in the Domain, it may declare Approach, Orbit, or Depart relative to you. If it completes that movement category during the turn, it gains the matching benefit until the start of its next turn:

- **Approach:** Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × Proficiency Bonus`.
- **Orbit:** `+2 AC` against opportunity attacks and attacks made as Reactions.
- **Depart:** 10 feet of additional movement that must be used before the turn ends.

A creature can gain one Chosen Bearing benefit per turn. These benefits do not create your Bearing tokens.

#### False North

At the start of each of your turns, choose one hostile creature in the Domain as your False North until the start of your next turn. It counts as your Pole without ending your underlying Pole.

You gain one temporary token of each Bearing relative to the False North. These temporary tokens expire at the start of your next turn and cannot be carried outside the Domain.

#### Turn the Whole Field

**Bonus Action**  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Choose one Resonance Marked hostile creature in the Domain. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Choose Approach, Orbit, or Depart relative to you.

- **Failed Save:** Move it up to 15 feet in the chosen category, and it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- **Successful Save:** Move it 5 feet in the chosen category if a legal space exists. It retains its Reactions.

For Orbit, the final space must be within 5 feet of the creature's original distance from you. A creature protected by higher-Source-CL anchoring, Space, Formation, Boundary, or bodily authority can force a Cultivation Check.

#### Compass-Breaking Procession

Once on each of your turns, you may use Break the Four Directions against your False North without paying its Resonance cost. You may spend no more than two temporary Bearing tokens on this free use, and its added damage is `2d8 + 1d8 per token spent`. You cannot also use a paid Break the Four Directions during the same turn.

#### No Direction of Escape

Once during the activation, when a Resonance Marked hostile creature in the Domain teleports, uses conceptual movement, enters a route, or crosses the Domain's boundary, you may use your Reaction to contest that movement.

Make a Cultivation Check against the movement's Source Rule.

- **Success:** Choose one result:
  - If the movement has a traversed path, it ends at the last legal space no farther than half the declared distance from its origin.
  - If it is teleportation or another pathless relocation, it arrives in a legal space you choose within 10 feet of the geometric halfway point between origin and declared destination; if no such space exists, it arrives in the nearest legal space to that midpoint that the movement's own Source Rule could reach.
  - It arrives in the nearest legal space still inside the Domain.
  - It completes the movement, and you move to a legal space within 10 feet of its destination.
- **Failure:** The movement resolves normally, but you learn its destination direction and whether it crossed Space, Boundary, Time, Formation, Void, or another route authority.

No Direction of Escape cannot follow a creature across planes or into an unknown sealed location unless the opposing Source Rule already permits that relation.

#### Domain Collision and Ending

A conflicting Domain that fixes direction, seals movement, controls gravity, establishes absolute geometry, or denies conceptual relation contests by Source CL and then Cultivation Check if necessary. Losing the contest suppresses only the contradictory Compass expression.

When the Domain ends, temporary Bearings and False North end. Creatures are not moved merely because ordinary orientation returns.

### CL14 — No Fixed Compass

Your soul can continue a direction even when the body is constrained by ordinary geometry.

#### Direction Without Footing

Your Speed increases by 10 feet.

While completing a declared Bearing, you may move across liquid, narrow surfaces, unstable terrain, vertical surfaces, and open gaps as though they were stable ground. You fall at the end of the turn unless you reach a supporting space or another rule keeps you aloft. This is a spiritual step, not flight.

Nonmagical difficult terrain does not cost you extra movement while completing a Bearing.

#### Break the Restraining Direction

Once on each of your turns when a Grappled, Restrained, pinned, tethered, or similar effect prevents movement required by your declared Bearing, you may spend 2 Resonance and make a Cultivation Check against the effect's escape DC or Source Rule.

- **Success:** End one ordinary Grappled or Restrained effect on yourself, or suppress one equal-authority movement restriction until the end of the turn. You may then continue moving.
- **Failure:** The restriction remains. You do not spend movement that the restriction made illegal, but you cannot attempt this procedure against the same effect again during the turn.
- **Higher authority:** On success, suppress only the expression preventing the current movement unless the effect's own rules permit complete escape.

#### Bearing Without Name

Once per turn when you spend a Bearing token, you may treat it as either of the other two Bearings for one printed rider. The movement you already performed is not rewritten; only the rider changes.

#### Soul Splitting — Counter-Needle

While your Soul Fragment is within 60 feet of your Pole:

- you may originate Turn the Compass or Break the Four Directions from yourself or the fragment, chosen when activated;
- range, line of effect, and movement are measured from the chosen origin;
- you remain the only attacker and mover unless the feature expressly moves the fragment;
- after you spend a Bearing token, the fragment may move 10 feet without an action at the end of the activation.

Once per turn after that movement, if the fragment ends within 10 feet of your Resonance Marked Pole, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on the Pole until the start of your next turn.

The fragment cannot generate Bearing tokens, complete Bearings for you, or use Break the Four Directions independently.

### CL3 — Three-Bearing Footwork

You gain the Pole and Bearing rules above.

#### Compass Strike

Once on each of your turns when you complete your declared Bearing, apply the matching expression below. If you already damaged your Pole with a Martial Strike during the turn, resolve the expression immediately. Otherwise, it applies to the next Martial Strike that damages the Pole before the end of the turn.

- **Approach — Enter the Line:** Deal an additional `1d8` Psychic or Force damage. The Pole cannot take opportunity attacks against you until the start of your next turn.
- **Orbit — Step Beyond the Angle:** Move 5 feet to a legal space. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from the Pole. You gain `+2 AC` against attacks made by the Pole until the start of your next turn.
- **Depart — Leave the Needle Behind:** Move up to 10 feet farther from the Pole without provoking opportunity attacks from it. If the Pole is Resonance Marked by you, you may instead require it to make a Strength or Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, move it 5 feet away from you.

Compass Strike is one once-per-turn rider. Extra Attack, echoes, Soul Splitting, reactions, and additional damage packets cannot apply it more than once during the turn.

#### No Blind Side to the Soul

When a creature that is your Pole becomes Hidden from you but remains Resonance Marked and within 60 feet, it does not gain Advantage on its first attack against you solely from being unseen. Total cover, perfect spiritual concealment, invisibility's other effects, and effects that prevent you from perceiving the attack still apply.

### CL6 — Turn the Compass

You can spend a stored Bearing to reorient an attack before it arrives.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** Your Pole within 60 feet targets you or a willing creature you can perceive within 15 feet of you with an attack, Grapple, or single-target hostile technique  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance and one matching Bearing token

Choose the expression associated with the token spent.

#### Approach — Intercept the Line

Move up to 10 feet toward the Pole or the protected creature without provoking opportunity attacks from the Pole.

If you end adjacent to the protected creature or within the triggering attack's legal reach or range, you may become the target instead. Use the original attack roll, saving throw procedure, damage, and riders against you. You gain `+2 AC` against an attack roll redirected this way or Advantage on the first saving throw required by the triggering technique.

If you cannot legally become the target, the protected creature instead gains `+2 AC` or Advantage on its saving throw against the trigger.

#### Orbit — Leave the Attack Facing Empty Air

Move the protected willing creature up to 10 feet to a legal space that is no more than 5 feet closer to or farther from the Pole than its original space. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from the Pole.

The triggering attack has Disadvantage. The protected creature has Advantage on a saving throw against the triggering Grapple or technique instead.

#### Depart — Put Distance Inside the Blow

Move the protected willing creature up to 10 feet farther from the Pole without provoking opportunity attacks from it.

Recheck reach, range, line of effect, and legal target after the movement:

- If the trigger no longer has a legal target, it fails against that creature. A resource committed solely to the failed attack or technique is spent unless its Source Rule says otherwise.
- If the trigger remains legal, the protected creature gains `+2 AC` or Advantage on its saving throw.

Turn the Compass does not move an unwilling protected creature and does not escape an existing Grapple, Restrained effect, sealed area, or carried state unless the movement remains legal under that effect.

#### Read Their Bearing

Once per round when your Pole voluntarily completes Approach, Orbit, or Depart relative to the space you occupied at the start of its turn, you gain the corresponding Bearing token. The Pole must be a meaningful hostile creature and must have moved at least 10 feet. Its forced movement does not qualify.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.dream_eater.fea:
### CL18 — Dream Eater Ascension

You enter the vulnerable inner dream and consume something the target uses to remain psychologically whole.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance and up to 3 Dream Morsels  
**Target requirement:** Sleeping, helpless, in Cursed Sleep, or bearing both your Resonance Mark and Nightmare Scar  
**Duration:** Instantaneous injury; stolen effects persist as described

The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. It has Disadvantage if you spent at least 2 Dream Morsels and it is asleep or helpless.

#### Failed Save

The target takes `10d10` Psychic damage. Choose one **Consumption**:

- **Recent Memory:** Remove one significant memory formed within the last 30 days. The target knows a gap exists but cannot access the content.
- **Restful Dream:** The target cannot receive recovery benefits from a Long Rest until it completes one successful **Devoured-Dream Recovery**. It can still sleep, avoid ordinary sleep-deprivation consequences, and complete a Full Cultivation Session if another rule permits; only the Long Rest benefits are withheld.
- **Practiced Confidence:** Suppress one skill proficiency, tool proficiency, or language linked to a memory you have identified. This cannot suppress a Path, Sphere, talent, Method, Foundation, Insight, or entire ability score.
- **Defining Hope:** Suppress one stated aspiration, source of courage, or positive bond. While suppressed, the target has Disadvantage on saves against Frightened and cannot use that hope as a Soul Anchor invocation. This does not sever or replace the Soul Anchor itself.
- **Prepared Dream:** Suppress one dream-based, memory-based, or emotional technique the target has used or revealed during the scene. The suppression lasts until recovery and cannot affect a feature of higher minimum CL than your Source CL.

You retain the consumed content as a **Devoured Dream**. You can hold only one Devoured Dream at a time. While holding it:

- Gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half the Psychic damage dealt.
- Gain one relevant language, skill proficiency, or narrow emotional insight if the consumed content supports it.
- You can reproduce the consumed memory or dream as an illusion or symbolic vision.

Holding a Devoured Dream does not give you the victim’s Path, Sphere, technique, statistics, true identity, or Soul Anchor.

#### Successful Save

The target takes half damage, suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect, and you may steal one ordinary Dream Fragment under Stolen Dreams without additional cost.

#### Recovery

The target can recover the consumed content through one of these routes:

- Spiritual Exorcism followed by a Full Cultivation Session and a successful Wisdom or Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
- A Dreams, Spirit, Medicine, Memory, Samsara, Karma, or appropriate Secret-Law procedure that explicitly restores lost memory or identity content.
- Destroying or forcing you to release the Devoured Dream, followed by a Long Rest or Full Cultivation Session.
- Completing the **Witnessed Reconstruction procedure** in the Procedure Addendum using witnesses, journals, Soul Anchor relationships, dream records, or lived repetition.

An equal- or-higher-Source-CL Consumption requires the printed Source CL contest or a restoration Source Rule of equal or higher authority. Secret, divine, artifact, tribulation, or conceptual protection uses its own explicit counterprocedure; this feature does not create an undefined quest requirement. A Devoured Dream cannot be permanently destroyed merely because you die; it is released as recoverable spiritual residue unless another explicit effect consumes it.

#### Hunger’s Reflection

While holding a Devoured Dream, Soul Gaze and spiritual diagnosis can perceive that you contain another creature’s dream-content. If you retain it through a Full Cultivation Session, make a Wisdom saving throw against your own Cultivation Save DC. On failure, roll or choose one **Dream Intrusion** from the Procedure Addendum. It persists until you release the dream or complete Spiritual Exorcism on yourself. This is a spiritual consequence, not the mechanical Daemonic tag.

#### Soul Splitting Expression — Mouth Behind Sleep

While Soul Splitting is active, your Soul Fragment may enter the outer threshold of a dream through Dream Walker and may serve as the origin for Nightmare Touch or Sleeping Curse. You still activate the feature once, pay one cost, and cannot affect a target through total cover unless the dream connection already exists.

### CL3 — Dream Walker

You can approach the edge of another creature’s dream without immediately harming it.

**Ritual or Action**  
**Range:** 1 mile during the ritual; 60 feet during action use  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance  
**Duration:** Up to 10 minutes during the ritual; until the end of your next turn during action use

Choose one sleeping creature whose broad location you know, or one sleeping or Resonance Marked creature you can perceive.

A willing creature admits you automatically. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.

#### Failed Save

You enter the dream’s outer threshold. Your body remains where it is, and this is not Astral Projection. You may:

- Speak to the dreamer in symbolic or ordinary language.
- Present one image, sensation, warning, or memory you willingly disclose.
- Learn the dream’s dominant emotional tone.
- Determine whether another dream intruder, nightmare parasite, memory seal, or obvious dream curse is present.
- Create a Resonance Mark on the dreamer that lasts until it wakes or until the normal mark duration expires after waking, whichever is later.

You cannot deal damage, compel behavior, steal information, rewrite memory, or move beyond the outer dream through Dream Walker alone.

#### Successful Save

You perceive that the dream is closed, warded, lucidly defended, absent, or beyond your current authority. You do not learn its content.

#### Defended Dreams

A ward, Spirit technique, Dreams technique, trained lucid dreamer, Soul Anchor, spirit companion, equal- or higher-Source-CL soul, or creature that does not truly dream can block entry or require a Cultivation Check. On failure, you cannot attempt Dream Walker against that creature again until its dream changes or the next scene begins.

#### Wakeful Taste

When a creature Resonance Marked by you within 60 feet becomes Frightened or fails a save against Mind Spike, choose one of these categories and learn its result:

- A symbolic image associated with its present fear.
- Whether it slept normally during its last long rest.
- Whether a nightmare, dream parasite, or dream-derived memory currently influences it.

This does not reveal a hidden fact merely because the target fears discovery.

### CL6 — Nightmare Touch

You can bite into the spiritual residue of sleep, helplessness, or a marked fear.

**Action**  
**Range:** Touch, or 30 feet against a sleeping creature or a creature bearing your Resonance Mark  
**Cost:** 3 Resonance

The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** It takes `4d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic damage, gains a Nightmare Scar, and cannot regain Hit Points from sleep or rest until the start of your next turn. If it is asleep, it wakes after the damage unless you spend 1 Dream Morsel to keep it asleep until the end of its next turn or until it takes damage from another source.

**Successful Save:** It takes half damage and does not gain a Scar.

If the target was sleeping, helpless, Frightened, or already scarred and is meaningful and hostile, gain 1 Dream Morsel subject to the normal limit.

#### Feed on Resistance

When a meaningful hostile creature succeeds on its saving throw against Nightmare Touch while already scarred, you may spend 1 Dream Morsel to impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect and prevent the Scar’s first-save Disadvantage from being expended by that successful save.

#### Predatory Trace

A creature damaged by Nightmare Touch can identify that its sleep or fear was spiritually attacked, even if it cannot identify you. Soul Gaze, Read the Spirit, and appropriate dream diagnosis can identify your spiritual signature unless you defeat the diagnosis with a Cultivation Check.

### CL14 — Sleeping Curse

You can drag an exhausted or spiritually opened soul into predatory sleep even during battle.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 6 Resonance  
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute

Choose one creature that is Bloodied, Frightened, Resonance Marked by you, or bearing your Nightmare Scar. It makes a Wisdom saving throw.

#### Failed Save

The creature falls into **Cursed Sleep**. It is Unconscious, falls Prone if able, and cannot be awakened by ordinary noise or an ally’s simple action.

At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. It also immediately repeats the save with Advantage when it takes damage.

While it sleeps, you may use one of these options once on each of your turns:

- **Feed:** Spend 1 Dream Morsel. The sleeper takes `3d10` Psychic damage and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage dealt. This damage grants the normal immediate repeat save with Advantage.
- **Question:** Ask one question about a fear, dream, or recent emotionally important event. The sleeper’s dream answers symbolically. Protected information can require a Cultivation Check.
- **Deepen the Scar:** The target’s Nightmare Scar cannot be removed by an ordinary long-rest save until after the next scene.
- **Maintain Stillness:** The target does not repeat the save at the end of this turn, but you cannot choose this option on consecutive turns.

#### Successful Initial Save

The target becomes Drowsy until the end of its next turn: its Speed is halved, it cannot take Reactions, and it suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.

#### Intervention

An ally adjacent to the sleeper may use an Action to perform one intervention:

- Inflict damage, granting the repeat save with Advantage.
- Invoke the sleeper’s Soul Anchor, true name, or meaningful bond, granting an immediate repeat save.
- Use Spiritual Exorcism, a Dreams or Spirit technique, or a suitable stimulant or ritual.
- Contest your Source CL with a Cultivation Check to break the curse’s dream connection.

#### Lower-Realm Dominance

A substantially lower-Source-CL ordinary creature that fails the initial save cannot wake through ordinary immunity to magical sleep unless the immunity explicitly protects the soul or dreams. It retains the printed repeat saves and intervention procedures.

### CL10 — Stolen Dreams

You can take usable fragments of fear, longing, and recent dream-memory.

**Trigger:** A creature bearing your Nightmare Scar fails its save against Mind Spike, Nightmare Touch, Domain Pressure, or another Dream Eater feature.  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance or 1 Dream Morsel  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Choose one **Dream Fragment** to steal:

- A recent dream image.
- A surface fear relevant to the current scene.
- A person, place, or object presently associated with safety or danger.
- One ordinary emotional vulnerability.
- One language fragment, face, route, or sensory memory encountered during the last 24 hours.

Protected memories, sealed secrets, Soul Anchor material, training secrets, plot-critical knowledge, and memories hidden by equal or higher authority require a Cultivation Check. On failure, you learn the category of protection rather than the memory.

You can retain a number of Stolen Dreams equal to your Wisdom modifier, minimum 1. A Stolen Dream lasts until your next Full Cultivation Session unless preserved through a legal item, Sphere, ritual, or Insight. When you exceed the limit, release one existing fragment.

#### Spend a Stolen Dream

As a Bonus Action, release one retained fragment for one benefit:

- Gain Advantage on one Insight, Investigation, Perception, Persuasion, Deception, or Survival check directly related to the fragment.
- Give the original creature Disadvantage on one attack roll or saving throw it makes against you before the end of your next turn by confronting it with the fragment.
- Reproduce one harmless sensory image, voice, scent, or dream-symbol for up to 1 minute.
- Find the direction of a person, place, or object shown in the fragment if it is within 1 mile and not hidden by stronger authority.

Releasing the fragment removes it from you but does not erase it from the original creature.

#### Memory Theft Boundary

Stolen Dreams reads or copies a fragment; it does not remove a proficiency, delete an entire relationship, replace identity, or grant the full knowledge required to use another creature’s feature, Sphere, manual, password system, or Secret.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.dreamweaver.fea:
### CL3 — Dream Stitch

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A creature you can perceive within 60 feet makes an attack roll.  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance

Stitch a moment of dream hesitation into the attacker’s intent. Impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll.

If the attack misses, choose one:

- The attacker becomes Resonance Marked by you.
- Create a Dream Thread on the attacker.

If the attack already had Disadvantage, Dream Stitch does not add a third die. Instead, subtract your Proficiency Bonus from the attack roll after the roll is made but before the result is announced.

Dream Stitch cannot alter an attack you cannot spiritually perceive, an environmental collapse with no attacking creature, or an effect that expressly cannot be altered by Reactions. It can affect a blind, invisible, or incorporeal attacker if Spiritual Sense or another legal sense perceives that attacker.

#### Threaded Reverie

When you use Soul Gaze on a creature bearing your Dream Thread, you may learn one additional item:

- The strongest emotion presently shaping its next intended action.
- Whether it is asleep, dreaming, affected by a dream intrusion, or maintaining an illusion.
- The symbolic image through which its current fear or desire would appear in a dream.

This is diagnostic information. It does not reveal private memories, hidden mechanics, or an exact future action.

### CL14 — Eternal Dream Refuge

You cultivate a hidden dream-body that catches you when the waking body collapses.

**Trigger:** You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while conscious and your soul is not sealed, possessed, or prevented from dreaming.  
**Cost:** 6 Resonance  
**Limit:** Once per scene

You fall Unconscious at 0 Hit Points but do not immediately begin making death saving throws. Create a **Dream Refuge** in a 20-foot Emanation centered on your body. The Refuge lasts for up to 3 rounds. It is a **Dream Field** anchored to your body, not a separate targetable Asset. Your body is its sole Anchor and retains its normal AC, Hit Points, size, and conditions. An effect that can directly suppress dreams, Fields, souls, or spiritual Anchors may contest the Refuge under the Source CL rules without first destroying a separate object.

While the Refuge exists:

- You are stable.
- Your body has Resistance to all damage except Psychic, Force, and damage from an effect that can strike dreams or souls.
- Enemies that first enter the Refuge on a turn or start their turn there make a Wisdom saving throw.
- On a failed save, a creature falls into **Dream Sleep** until the end of its next turn, until it takes damage, or until another creature uses an action to wake it.
- On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet and it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- An ally in the Refuge can use an Action to complete one **Refuge Recall**: speak your name and at least one specific shared event in a sentence of no more than 25 words; invoke one recorded Soul Anchor relationship or principle; spend and resolve a legal healing feature on you; or succeed on a Wisdom (Medicine), Wisdom (Insight), or Charisma (Performance or Persuasion) check against your Cultivation Save DC while physically touching your body. A successful Recall restores you to consciousness with Hit Points equal to `2 × Proficiency Bonus`, and the Refuge ends. A creature can attempt only one Recall during the same Refuge unless it uses a different listed method.

At the end of the third round, if no ally wakes you and you remain alive, you awaken with 1 Hit Point, gain 1 level of Exhaustion, and the Refuge ends.

If the Dream Refuge is broken by an equal- or higher-Source-CL anti-dream effect, you become stable but lose its other protections and begin death saving throws normally at the start of your next turn if still at 0 Hit Points.

#### Soul Splitting Expression — Dream Double

While Soul Splitting is active, you may use **Dream Double** as your Subpath Expression. Move your Soul Fragment up to 20 feet without provoking reactions from spirit-affecting creatures. One creature bearing your Dream Thread within 30 feet of the fragment has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of your next turn.

### CL6 — Unreality Bites Back

Your dream-work resists being dismissed as “only an illusion.”

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A creature within 60 feet succeeds on a check or saving throw made specifically to disbelieve, pierce, escape, suppress, or end one of your dream, illusion, emotional unreality, or Dreamweaver effects.  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance

The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** It takes `3d10` Psychic damage, becomes Resonance Marked by you, and suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect. You may also create or refresh a Dream Thread on it.

**Successful Save:** It takes half damage and you may create a Dream Thread on it, but it still succeeds against the original effect.

Unreality Bites Back never reverses the triggering success by itself. It punishes spiritual certainty and creates later access.

#### Dream-Thread Passage

As a Bonus Action, spend 1 Resonance and choose one creature bearing your Dream Thread within 60 feet. Until the end of your turn, you may perceive that creature through ordinary darkness, invisibility, and non-total visual concealment. This does not cross total cover or defeat equal- or higher-Source-CL spiritual concealment without a Cultivation Check.

### CL10 — Waking Dream Revision

You can revise a moment by forcing the soul to rehearse a different dream-version of it. This is not Fate alteration; the revision must pass through one of your Dream Threads.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You, an ally you can perceive, or a creature bearing your Dream Thread within 60 feet completes a d20 Test.  
**Cost:** 3 Resonance  
**Limit:** Once per round

Choose one of the following:

- **Rehearse Success:** If the Test was made by you or an ally, reroll it. The new roll must be used.
- **Rehearse Failure:** If the Test was made by a hostile creature bearing your Dream Thread, force it to reroll. The new roll must be used.
- **Change the Symbol:** Do not reroll. Instead, move your Dream Thread from the creature involved in the Test to another creature you can perceive within 30 feet of it. The new creature makes a Wisdom saving throw, receiving the Thread on a failure.

You must use Waking Dream Revision before the Test’s consequences produce a new independent roll, damage packet, movement, or another completed activation. It cannot reroll a natural 20 where an explicit rule makes that result unalterable, and it cannot modify breakthrough, training, forging, or tribulation resolution unless a Source Rule explicitly permits dream intervention.

#### Lucid Resistance

You have Advantage on saving throws against sleep, dream intrusion, nightmare effects, and memory alterations that occur through dreams. When you succeed on such a save, you may spend 1 Resonance to identify the effect’s direction, dream-symbol, or spiritual signature if its Source CL does not exceed yours. Equal or higher authority can require a Cultivation Check.

### CL18 — World of One

You isolate one soul inside a personal dream-world whose symbols obey your cultivated authority.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Duration:** The scene  
**Concentration:** Yes

Choose one creature you can perceive. A creature bearing your Dream Thread makes the initial saving throw with Disadvantage. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

#### Failed Save

The target’s consciousness is drawn into a **World of One**. Its body becomes Incapacitated, falls Prone if able, and cannot perceive or affect the ordinary battlefield. The body remains present and can be moved or damaged.

At the end of each of its turns, the target takes `6d10` Psychic damage and may attempt to escape by choosing one procedure:

- Repeat the Wisdom saving throw.
- Make an Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Insight), or Charisma (Performance or Persuasion) check against your Cultivation Save DC to identify, accept, reinterpret, or break the governing dream-symbol.
- Destroy a dream Anchor that you manifest inside the World. The Anchor has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC, Hit Points equal to `5 × your Proficiency Bonus`, and can be damaged only by the target’s spiritual, cultivated, magical, or symbolic actions.

A successful procedure ends the effect. The target chooses one procedure each turn; it does not attempt all three.

#### Successful Initial Save

The target takes half of `6d10` Psychic damage, suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect, and you may create a Dream Thread on it.

#### Authority and Realm

- A creature whose Source CL is at least 5 lower than yours and that fails the initial save cannot use an ordinary legendary resistance or mundane immunity to ignore the dream unless that protection explicitly applies to dream entry, soul isolation, or conceptual imprisonment.
- An equal- or higher-Source-CL target retains every printed escape procedure and may contest a contradictory dream law with a Cultivation Check.
- A mindless entity, a being that truly cannot dream, or a creature with no coherent soul is immune unless another Source Rule gives you an appropriate dream-symbol or consciousness route.
- Damage dealt to the target’s body grants it Advantage on its next escape attempt but does not automatically end World of One.
- If your Concentration ends, the target returns immediately and knows it was attacked through a dream.

#### Domain Integration

While Domain Manifestation is active, you may originate World of One from yourself or your Soul Fragment. A target inside your Domain that bears both your Resonance Mark and Dream Thread cannot benefit from ordinary sleep immunity on the initial save; equal- or higher-authority immunity remains valid.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_scribe.fea:
### CL3 — Ink Remembers

You can recover the strongest recent echo left on a meaningful object or mark.

**Action**  
**Range:** Touch  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance

Touch a written document, carved inscription, blood mark, footprint, broken weapon, garment, corpse, shrine object, damaged treasure, or another object meaningfully involved in an event.

You receive one sensory echo connected to its strongest recent use or emotion. Choose one category:

- sight or visual arrangement;
- sound or spoken emotional tone;
- touch, force, injury, or direction of movement;
- fear, grief, loyalty, anger, desire, or intent;
- spiritual pressure, possession, curse, dream influence, death, or another supernatural disturbance.

The echo usually concerns the most significant event within the previous seven days. Older echoes may remain on treasured, blood-soaked, haunted, consecrated, artifact, or story-significant objects.

You may record the echo as an Echo Entry.

Ink Remembers does not provide complete history, exact statistics, secret mechanics, secure identity, or facts the object did not meaningfully witness. Cleansing, forgery, counter-inscription, stronger concealment, or destruction can distort the echo. A successful Cultivation Check against that Source Rule reveals one true fragment and the fact that the record was altered.

#### Record the Disturbance

When you place a Resonance Mark on a creature, you may also record one immediately observable spiritual category as an Echo Entry: Charmed, Frightened, possessed, dream-haunted, grief-strained, oath-bound, transformed, disguised, dying, or spiritually contaminated.

This does not reveal the source unless you identify it through another procedure.

### CL14 — Marginal Correction

You revise a spiritual event while its ink is still wet.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You or an ally within 60 feet fails an ability check or saving throw involving memory, knowledge, illusion, charm, fear, possession, dreams, identity, emotional deception, spiritual concealment, or an event represented by one of your relevant Echo Entries  
**Cost:** 6 Resonance

Choose one Correction:

#### Reroute the Line

The target rerolls the check or saving throw with Advantage and must use the new result.

If the reroll succeeds, you learn the triggering effect’s broad authority category: ordinary, Open, Restricted, Rare, Forbidden, Secret, divine, artifact, tribulation, Foundation, Method, bloodline, or universal cultivation authority.

#### Restore the Missing Word

If the failure resulted from ordinary memory loss, silence, confusion, illusion, emotional distortion, or a hidden but previously recorded fact, consume one relevant Echo Entry. The target instead treats the roll as a success, but only for the discrete question, perception, or immediate effect represented by that Entry.

This cannot restore an erased lifetime, return a destroyed soul fragment, create knowledge never recorded, or overrule higher authority without a Cultivation Check.

#### Annotate the Wound

If the failure would inflict possession, identity alteration, major memory loss, a Heart Demon escalation, or a lasting spiritual wound, create an **Annotation** on the target. The immediate failure still occurs, but one named expression is suppressed until the end of the target’s next turn, creating time for exorcism, escape, healing, or another intervention.

A creature can benefit from only one Marginal Correction on the same roll. Corrections cannot recursively correct one another.

### CL10 — Name on the Page

You write a creature into your ledger strongly enough that ordinary concealment can no longer make it spiritually anonymous to you.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 5 Resonance  
**Duration:** The scene

Write, trace, sign, or speak one of the following concerning a creature you can perceive:

- its chosen name;
- a title it meaningfully bears;
- a kinship or office it recognizes;
- a descriptive epithet that is currently and demonstrably true, such as “the wounded gatekeeper,” “the spirit within the magistrate,” or “the killer holding the red spear.”

The target makes a Charisma saving throw.

**Failed Save:** It becomes Resonance Marked for the scene, and you create a **Name Entry**. While the Entry remains:

- ordinary invisibility, disguise, mimicry, voice alteration, illusion, and crowd concealment cannot hide the fact that the recorded subject is present within 120 feet;
- you know when the recorded subject knowingly acts in direct contradiction to the recorded name, title, office, or epithet;
- the first time each round it contradicts that recorded identity while within 60 feet, it takes Psychic damage equal to `2 × Proficiency Bonus` or suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect, your choice.

**Successful Save:** It is Resonance Marked until the end of your next turn, and the Name Entry records only the subject’s current appearance and spiritual pressure category.

#### Correcting the Name

A creature can spend an Action to challenge an inaccurate or obsolete Name Entry. If the title, office, epithet, or relationship is no longer true, the Entry ends automatically. If contested, the creature makes a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. On a success, the Entry is reduced to an ordinary Echo Entry and loses its mechanical effects.

A chosen name or title is not a true name unless another Source Rule expressly says so. Name on the Page cannot seize ownership, compel obedience, or permanently rewrite identity.

### CL6 — Written Rebuke

You write against a hostile word before its echo settles into reality.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A Resonance Marked creature within 60 feet knowingly speaks a direct lie, uses a verbal or spiritual command, activates an audible or named technique, or targets you or an ally with a mental, emotional, memory, dream, or possession effect  
**Cost:** 3 Resonance

The triggering creature makes a Charisma saving throw.

**Failed Save:** It takes `4d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic damage. Choose one Rebuke:

- **Strike the Phrase:** The triggering attack roll is made with Disadvantage or the triggering effect’s first target makes its saving throw with Advantage.
- **Break the Command:** If the effect requires the target to hear, understand, obey, recognize a name, or receive a spiritual command, its effect is suppressed until the start of the triggering creature’s next turn.
- **Record the Lie:** Create an Echo Entry containing the exact direct lie or false command. Until the end of the scene, the creature has Disadvantage on the first Charisma saving throw it makes against you when that Entry is relevant.

**Successful Save:** It takes half damage. You may still create an Echo Entry recording the triggering phrase or effect category.

Written Rebuke does not automatically counter silent techniques, purely physical attacks, accidental falsehoods, mistaken beliefs, or speech protected by superior true-name, divine, Secret, or artifact authority. Against such effects, a Cultivation Check may be required to apply Strike the Phrase or Break the Command.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.echo_step_disci:
### CL3 — Afterimage Edge

#### Record the Killing Step

Once on each of your turns when you move at least 10 feet, record one space you occupied during that movement as an Echo Position.

#### Strike From the Echo

Once on each of your turns when you use Mind Spike, make an unarmed strike, or make a weapon attack with a weapon you are proficient with, you may treat one Echo Position within 20 feet as the attack’s origin for range, reach, cover, and line of effect.

- You still occupy your actual space.
- The target must be legal from the Echo Position.
- The attack cannot originate from both spaces.
- A melee attack can use an Echo Position adjacent to the target even if you are not adjacent.
- Using an Echo Position this way consumes it after the attack resolves.

If the target is Resonance Marked by you, add your Wisdom modifier to one damage roll of the attack or Mind Spike. This bonus applies once per turn and does not stack with another feature adding the same ability modifier to that damage roll.

#### Step Through the Opening

After Strike From the Echo resolves, you may spend 1 Resonance to move to the consumed Echo Position by spiritual step. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

### CL6 — Echo Counter

You leave the threatened body behind and let the attacker strike the decision you already abandoned.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A creature you can perceive targets you with an attack or enters your reach  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance

Record your current space as an Echo Position, then move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

If the triggering attack can no longer reach or target you, it misses. Otherwise, you gain `+2 AC` against it.

If the attack misses, choose one:

- the attacker takes `2d8 + Wisdom modifier` Psychic damage;
- use Mind Spike against it, reducing Mind Spike’s damage by one die;
- move to another Echo Position within 20 feet;
- remove its Reactions until the start of its next turn if it is Resonance Marked by you.

#### Cross the Blade-Hum

When a hostile creature moves through or ends movement in one of your Echo Positions, you may consume that Echo Position without using a Reaction. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** Its Speed becomes 0 for the rest of the turn and it becomes Resonance Marked until the end of your next turn.

**Successful Save:** Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet for the rest of the turn.

A creature can trigger this once per turn.

### CL18 — Hundred Echoes Kill One Moment

You manifest every combat-ready version of your position across a single decisive interval.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required

You enter the **Hundred-Echo State**.

#### Echo Field

At the start and end of each of your turns, record your current space as an Echo Position without counting against your normal limit. These State-created positions last until the State ends.

You can move through hostile creatures’ spaces, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain, and do not provoke opportunity attacks. You cannot end movement in an occupied space.

#### One Soul, Many Edges

Once on each of your turns when you use Mind Spike, make a weapon attack with a weapon you are proficient with, or activate a single-target Spirit Awakening technique, choose up to three Echo Positions within 60 feet.

After the triggering effect resolves, choose one creature legal from each selected position. Each chosen creature takes `2d8` Psychic or Force damage. A creature chosen multiple times takes damage only once, but if it is your Pursuit Mark target, it takes `4d8` instead.

This is secondary echo damage, not additional attacks and not additional technique activations.

#### Moment of the Final Edge

Once during the State, use an Action to choose one creature within 120 feet that you can perceive or that bears your Pursuit Mark. Select up to six Echo Positions that form a legal sequence ending adjacent to or within 30 feet of the target, depending on your chosen final attack.

Move through the sequence by spiritual step, then choose one:

- make one weapon attack with a weapon you are proficient with;
- use Mind Spike with maximum damage on its damage dice on a failed save;
- make one Cultivation Attack dealing `10d10` Psychic, Force, Slashing, or Necrotic damage on a hit.

On a hit or failed save, the target also makes a Charisma saving throw.

**Failed Save:** Choose two: no Reactions until the end of your next turn; Speed 0 until the start of its next turn; cannot regain Hit Points until the start of its next turn; one active lower-Source-CL movement or concealment effect ends; it is knocked Prone; it is moved 20 feet to a legal space along your echo sequence.

**Successful Save:** Choose one of those effects until the start of its next turn.

If the target’s Source CL is at least 5 lower than yours and it bears your Pursuit Mark, ordinary non-Secret escape, invisibility, and movement defenses cannot prevent the final approach. Equal or higher authority contests normally.

#### After the Last Echo

When the State ends, remove every Echo Position and Pursuit Mark you created. You cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn as your body and soul agree on which position survived.

---

### CL14 — Pursuit Without Distance

Once your soul has learned a target’s combat rhythm, escape becomes another recorded position.

#### Pursuit Mark

When you damage a Resonance Marked meaningful hostile creature, you may spend 2 Resonance to convert your Resonance Mark on it into a **Pursuit Mark** lasting for the scene.

- A Pursuit Mark is a special Resonance Mark.
- You can maintain one Pursuit Mark at a time.
- You know the marked creature’s direction and approximate distance while it remains within 1 mile and is not behind stronger concealment.
- The target can remove the mark by spending an Action and succeeding on a Charisma saving throw, receiving Spiritual Exorcism, or crossing a higher-Source-CL boundary that severs pursuit.

#### Follow the Vanishing Point

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** The creature bearing your Pursuit Mark moves at least 15 feet, teleports, enters invisibility, changes form, crosses a portal, or leaves your current line of sight  
**Cost:** 4 Resonance

Choose one:

- move up to your Speed by spiritual step toward a legal space within 10 feet of its destination;
- move to an Echo Position within 60 feet and use Mind Spike against the target if it is legal from that position;
- if the target teleported or crossed a route, make a Cultivation Check against the movement’s Source Rule. On a success, arrive in a legal space within 10 feet of the destination. On a failure, move up to half your Speed toward the last legal point and learn the route’s authority category.

After arriving, record your space as an Echo Position.

#### Cut the Retreat

Once per round when the pursued creature leaves one of your Echo Positions or attempts to move away from you, you may consume that Echo Position. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** Its movement ends after 5 feet and it takes `3d8` Psychic damage.

**Successful Save:** Its movement distance is reduced by 10 feet.

#### Soul Splitting — Second Stance

Your soul fragment can maintain one Echo Position of its own. You may use that position as an origin for Strike From the Echo or Three-Step Soul Execution, but doing so destroys the fragment after the technique resolves. Destruction this way does not cause the core Soul Splitting backlash damage.

### CL10 — Three-Step Soul Execution

You resolve three prepared killing positions as one continuous Spirit Awakening technique.

**Action**  
**Cost:** 5 Resonance

Choose up to three legal origins among your space and your Echo Positions. Each origin must be within 30 feet of the next origin in the sequence.

For each chosen origin, choose one creature legal from that origin. You may choose the same creature more than once. Make a Cultivation Attack for each origin.

**Hit:** `3d8` Psychic, Force, Slashing, or Necrotic damage.

After each attack, you may move to that origin by spiritual step. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. Consume every Echo Position used as an origin.

A creature hit more than once takes full damage from the first hit and `2d8` from each later hit. Apply on-hit riders, poison, weapon-delivered effects, and once-per-turn bonuses only to the first hit unless another rule expressly permits multiple delivery.

If all three attacks hit the same Resonance Marked target, it makes a Charisma saving throw after the final hit.

**Failed Save:** It cannot take Reactions, its Speed is halved, and it has Disadvantage on its next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw before the end of your next turn.

**Successful Save:** It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

Three-Step Soul Execution is a Spirit Awakening technique, not the Attack action and not three weapon attacks.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.equal_measure_s:
### CL18 — Court of Equal Heaven

You manifest a spiritual court in which hostile consequence cannot remain one-sided.

**Action**  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Area:** 40-foot-radius aura centered on you  
**Duration:** 1 minute  
**Concentration:** Required

The aura is your **Court of Equal Heaven Domain** and moves with you.

#### Debts of the Aggressor

A hostile creature in the Domain gains one **Debt** of the corresponding kind the first time each round one of its activations causes a chosen ally in the Domain to receive:

- qualifying damage for Impact;
- qualifying movement or restraint for Motion;
- a qualifying spiritual or mental consequence for Intent.

A creature can hold one Debt of each kind. One activation creates only one Debt, chosen by you if several qualify. Debts are visible to Spiritual Sense and end when the creature leaves the Domain or the Domain ends.

#### Any Hand May Answer

Once on each turn when a chosen ally damages a creature with at least one Debt, that ally may discharge one Debt and apply its matching answer:

- **Impact:** Deal an additional `3d8` Psychic or Force damage.
- **Motion:** Move up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the indebted creature, or require it to make a Strength or Wisdom saving throw and move it up to 15 feet on a failure or 5 feet on a success.
- **Intent:** Impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect and grant the ally Advantage on its next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw before the start of its next turn.

A creature can benefit from Any Hand May Answer only once per turn. The added damage and movement cannot generate Measures or new Debts.

#### Nothing Without Answer

Once per round, you may use Exact Counterweight without spending a stored Measure if the hostile source holds the matching Debt. Discharge that Debt instead. You still spend Resonance and your Reaction.

#### Perfect Recompense

Once during the activation, use Threefold Recompense without paying its Resonance cost against a creature in the Domain. You may discharge its Debts as though they were Measures you held.

If all three Debts are discharged and the Martial Strike hits or Mind Spike fails its save, the target also:

- cannot take Reactions;
- has Speed 0;
- has Disadvantage on its next Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw;

until the start of your next turn. This is one exceptional judgment package, not three conditions.

#### Equal Court Is Not Moral Judgment

The Domain records hostile consequence, not justice, innocence, ownership, lawful punishment, karmic merit, or consent. It cannot force restitution, transfer permanent wounds, revive the dead, or determine who deserved an action.

#### Domain Collision and Ending

Karma, Oath, Contract, Sovereignty, Fate, divine judgment, artifact law, or higher-Source-CL reciprocity can contest a Debt or answer that directly contradicts its authority. Losing the contest suppresses only that Debt or answer.

When the Domain ends, all Debts end. Your personal Measures remain until the scene ends.

### CL6 — Exact Counterweight

You can spend a stored Measure to reduce a matching consequence before it is finalized.

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You or a willing creature bearing your Resonance Mark within 30 feet is affected by a hostile activation matching a Measure you hold  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance and the matching Measure

Choose the corresponding procedure.

#### Impact Counterweight

Reduce one instance of triggering damage by `3d8 + Wisdom modifier` after Resistance and before Temporary Hit Points.

If this reduces the damage to 0, the source takes Psychic damage equal to your Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus and becomes Resonance Marked until the end of your next turn, provided it is a creature within 60 feet that you can perceive or spiritually locate through your mark.

Impact Counterweight does not reduce Hit Point costs, self-inflicted sacrifice, maximum-Hit-Point reduction, Exhaustion, cultivation harm, or damage that expressly cannot be reduced unless you win the relevant authority contest.

#### Motion Counterweight

Choose one:

- reduce forced movement by up to 20 feet;
- prevent the target from being knocked Prone;
- grant Advantage on the triggering check or save against becoming Grappled or Restrained;
- if the effect imposed Grappled or Restrained without a check or save, make a Cultivation Check against its Source Rule. On a success, suppress that condition until the start of the protected creature's next turn.

If all forced movement is prevented or the protected creature avoids the condition, it may move 5 feet to a legal space without provoking opportunity attacks from the source.

#### Intent Counterweight

If the trigger allows an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma saving throw, add `1d6` to the roll after seeing the d20 but before the outcome is finalized.

If the trigger imposed an ordinary lower-Source-CL effect without a save, make a Cultivation Check against its Source Rule. On a success, suppress one mental, emotional, spiritual, possession, command, or identity expression until the start of the protected creature's next turn.

If the added die changes a failure into a success or the suppression succeeds, impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on the source until the start of your next turn if it is within 60 feet and can be affected by spiritual authority.

#### No Borrowing from the Same Blow

A Measure gained from a hostile activation becomes available only after that activation and every linked damage packet, movement, condition, and rider have resolved. It cannot pay for Exact Counterweight against the activation that created it.

### CL3 — Receive and Return

You gain the Measure rules above.

#### Measured Return

Once on each of your turns, when a Martial Strike damages a meaningful hostile creature, you may spend one Measure and apply its expression.

If you use Mind Spike, the expression occurs on a failed save. On a successful save, only Mind Spike's normal result occurs and the Measure is not spent.

- **Impact — Weight for Weight:** Deal an additional `1d8` Psychic or Force damage. You gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier + Proficiency Bonus.
- **Motion — Step for Step:** Move yourself up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target, or require the target to make a Strength or Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, move it up to 10 feet. On a success, move it 5 feet if a legal space exists.
- **Intent — Will for Will:** Resonance Mark the target until the end of your next turn and impose one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on it.

Measured Return cannot spend more than one Measure on the same Martial Strike.

#### Know the Weight

When Soul Gaze examines a creature, effect, Asset, or Anchor that caused you to receive a Measure during the scene, you also learn:

- which of Impact, Motion, or Intent was its primary expression;
- whether the Source CL was lower than, equal to, or higher than yours;
- whether the effect depended on a weapon, body, spirit, Asset, Anchor, Domain, Formation, possession, or another continuing link.

You do not automatically learn exact statistics, hidden techniques, or protected names.

### CL14 — The Scales Do Not Tremble

#### Convert the Measure

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance  
**Limit:** Once per turn

Convert one Measure you hold into either of the other two kinds. You cannot use this to hold more than one Measure of the same kind.

#### Counterweight Becomes Counterstrike

Once per round, if Exact Counterweight causes one of the following results, you may make one Martial Strike against the hostile source as part of the same Reaction:

- Impact Counterweight reduces the damage to 0;
- Motion Counterweight prevents all forced movement or avoids the condition;
- Intent Counterweight changes a failed save to a success or successfully suppresses the effect.

The source must be within the normal range of the chosen Martial Strike. A weapon or unarmed strike uses its normal attack. Mind Spike reduces its damage by one die, minimum one die. This strike cannot use Measured Return or Threefold Recompense and cannot grant another Reaction.

#### Bear the Unequal Burden

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** A willing Resonance Marked creature within 30 feet would receive an Impact, Motion, or Intent consequence and you do not hold the matching Measure  
**Cost:** 3 Resonance

Transfer one discrete matching consequence to yourself before it resolves:

- one instance of damage;
- one forced movement, Prone, Grappled, or Restrained result;
- one ordinary mental, emotional, spiritual, possession, command, or identity effect.

You become the target for that consequence and resolve it using your defenses, actual position, and legal immunities. If it cannot legally affect you, it is not erased; the original creature remains the target.

After the transferred consequence resolves, gain the matching Measure. Bear the Unequal Burden cannot transfer death, permanent transformation, maximum-Hit-Point reduction, cultivation-system destruction, Soul Anchor severance, or higher-authority effects without a successful Cultivation Check.

You cannot use Bear the Unequal Burden and Exact Counterweight on the same trigger because both require your Reaction.

#### Soul Splitting — Second Pan

Your Soul Fragment can hold one Measure transferred from you at the end of your turn. Transfer requires no action and does not create a duplicate Measure.

While the fragment holds a Measure:

- you may originate Exact Counterweight from the fragment, protecting a creature within 30 feet of it;
- the fragment spends the Measure when the feature is used;
- if the fragment is destroyed, the held Measure is lost before Soul Splitting's destruction effects resolve.

Once per turn after you spend a Measure through the fragment, it may move 15 feet and grant one willing creature within 10 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

### CL10 — Threefold Recompense

You return one or more completed Measures through a single martial judgment.

**Action**  
**Range:** Martial Strike range  
**Cost:** 5 Resonance  
**Target:** One meaningful hostile creature bearing your Resonance Mark

Spend one, two, or three different Measures, then make one Martial Strike against the target.

- If you use a weapon or unarmed strike, resolve its normal attack roll.
- If you use Mind Spike, resolve its normal Wisdom saving throw.

**Hit or Failed Save:** The Martial Strike deals its normal damage plus `2d8 + 1d8 for each Measure spent` Psychic or Force damage. Apply every matching rider below.

**Miss:** No added damage or riders occur. Measures are spent.

**Successful Mind Spike Save:** The target takes Mind Spike's normal half damage plus half of the added dice. It suffers no Measure rider. Measures are spent.

#### Impact Recompense

The target cannot reduce the added damage with Temporary Hit Points, though Temporary Hit Points still absorb its normal Martial Strike damage. This does not bypass Resistance or Immunity.

#### Motion Recompense

Move yourself to a legal space adjacent to the target before damage is applied, or move the target up to 15 feet after damage on a failed Strength or Wisdom saving throw. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from the target.

#### Intent Recompense

Impose an exceptional pressure package consisting of two different ordinary Spiritual Pressure effects until the start of your next turn.

Threefold Recompense is one activation and cannot generate a new Measure from its own damage, movement, or Pressure.
tianxia.tradition.spirit.exorcist.featur:
### CL6 — Banishment Strike

You turn a successful soul wound into a door of departure.

**Trigger:** An Intruder, Restless Dead, fiend, demon, hostile spirit, or possessed creature fails its saving throw against your Mind Spike.  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance

Choose the spirit being struck. If the target is a possessed creature, choose either the Host or the designated Intruder; ordinary Mind Spike damage still applies to the original target. The chosen spiritual target makes a Charisma saving throw.

#### Failed Save

Apply the result appropriate to the target:

- **Possessing Intruder:** It is forced out of the Host into the nearest legal unoccupied space within 10 feet. It is visible to Spiritual Sense and cannot repossess that Host until the end of the scene. If it has no legal independent manifestation, it is sealed in a temporary spiritual outline adjacent to the Host until the end of your next turn and is Incapacitated during that time.
- **Extraplanar Spirit, Fiend, or Demon:** It is banished from the current battlefield until the end of its next turn, then returns to the nearest legal space to where it departed. If its Source CL is at least 5 lower than yours and it is not anchored to the plane, it is instead expelled to its home plane for the scene.
- **Native Ghost, Undead Soul, or Restless Dead:** It is Frightened of you and cannot willingly move closer to its Host, corpse, grave, or sustaining Anchor for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each turn.
- **Cursed or Contaminated Host:** Suppress one ordinary possession, curse, or spiritual contamination affecting it until the end of your next turn. The Host may immediately repeat one save the effect normally permits, with Advantage.

#### Successful Save

The chosen target suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect and cannot become hidden from your Ghost Sight until the start of your next turn.

#### Banishment Limits

Banishment Strike does not permanently destroy a soul, erase a Spirit Companion bond, override divine custody, dismiss a willingly hosted ancestor, or send an equal- or higher-Source-CL entity across planar boundaries without its printed Anchor or escape procedure.

### CL3 — Ghost Sight and Name the Intruder

#### Ghost Sight

Your Spiritual Sense extends to 60 feet for the limited purpose of perceiving:

- Invisible spirits, ghosts, incorporeal undead, projected souls, possessing entities, and spirit parasites.
- The broad outline of a possession link between a Host and Intruder.
- Ordinary curses, spiritual contamination, corpse animation, and funerary disturbance.

Ghost Sight does not function as general Blindsight at that extended range. It does not reveal mundane hidden creatures, physical writing, concealed objects, or a spirit behind total cover. Equal- or higher-Source-CL concealment remains contested.

#### Name the Intruder

**Bonus Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance

Choose one spirit, possessed creature, cursed creature, haunted object, or Resonance Marked creature you perceive. Use Soul Gaze’s normal diagnostic limits without requiring its Action. You may assign one Exorcist Designation.

If the target is an Intruder, Curse Source, or Restless Dead, it becomes Resonance Marked by you. If it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw, the mark is concealed until the start of your next turn but the Designation remains.

#### Ward of Invitation

You have Advantage on Cultivation Checks made to determine whether a possession, hosting, spirit bond, or haunting is willing, inherited, lawfully invited, coerced, or parasitic.

### CL18 — Grand Exorcism

You invoke the full authority of departure, rightful hosting, burial, and spiritual boundary.

**Action**  
**Area:** 60-foot Emanation  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance

Choose any number of allies, Hosts, Intruders, Restless Dead, fiends, demons, undead spirits, possessions, curse Anchors, and hostile spirit Assets in the area. Each hostile chosen creature makes a Charisma saving throw.

#### Failed Save

The target takes `10d10` Radiant or Psychic damage and suffers the result appropriate to its nature:

- **Possessing Intruder:** It is forced out of every Host in the area, cannot repossess those Hosts for the scene, and is either manifested in a legal space or sealed in a visible spiritual outline. If its Source CL is at least 5 lower than yours and it has no independent legal existence on the plane, it is expelled for the scene.
- **Extraplanar Spirit, Fiend, or Demon:** If unanchored and of lower Source CL, it is expelled to its home plane. If anchored, its sustaining Anchor becomes revealed and it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn.
- **Restless Dead or Native Ghost:** Choose to destroy a purely hostile residual imprint, send a willing soul onward, or reduce a coherent unwilling soul to 0 Hit Points without destroying it. A coherent soul with unfinished obligations may instead reveal the required funerary or narrative resolution.
- **Undead Body or Corpse-Spirit:** It is destroyed if reduced to 50 Hit Points or fewer by this activation. A unique equal- or higher-authority undead uses its own destruction and recovery rules.
