### CL10 — Hourglass Mark

You place a target inside the delay between intention and result.

**Action**  
**Range:** 60 feet  
**Cost:** 5 Resonance  
**Duration:** Up to 1 minute

Choose one creature you can perceive. It makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** The creature gains your **Hourglass Mark**. This is a special Resonance Mark. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the mark on a success.

**Successful Save:** It suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect until the start of your next turn.

You can maintain only one Hourglass Mark. Because it is one of your Resonance Marks, applying it replaces another Resonance Mark you placed on that creature, and applying an ordinary Resonance Mark to that creature replaces the Hourglass Mark unless this feature expressly says otherwise. Creating a new Hourglass Mark ends the previous one.

While the mark lasts, once per round when the marked creature begins one of the following activities, you may spend 1 Resonance and gain 1 Time Debt to apply the corresponding delay.

#### Delayed Movement

When it begins voluntary movement, reduce the distance available to that movement by 15 feet, minimum 0. If this prevents it from reaching a required destination, an action requiring that arrival must be redirected to another legal target or fails under its normal rules.

#### Delayed Strike

When it makes an attack roll, subtract `1d6` from the roll. Decide after seeing the d20 but before the outcome is finalized.

#### Delayed Technique

When it forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw against a technique, choose one target. That target adds `1d6` to its saving throw. This cannot modify an environmental or passive save whose source is no longer the marked creature.

#### Delayed Reaction

When it attempts a Reaction, the Reaction occurs only after the triggering action, movement, or technique fully resolves. If the trigger is no longer valid at that time, the Reaction does not occur and any resource committed specifically to that Reaction is not spent.

You cannot apply more than one Hourglass delay to the same roll, movement, technique, or Reaction.

#### Break the Glass

The marked creature or a creature adjacent to it can use an Action to strike, shatter, dispel, exorcise, or spiritually realign the mark.

The acting creature makes one of the following checks against your Cultivation Save DC:

- Intelligence (Arcana);
- Wisdom (Insight);
- Dexterity (Sleight of Hand);
- a Cultivation Check using an appropriate Source Rule.

On a success, the Hourglass Mark ends. Time, Fate, Spirit, Clock, Sound, anti-curse, and suitable conceptual severance effects can qualify.

---

### CL3 — Ripple of Before

Your soul recognizes the pressure of a moment immediately before the body understands it.

#### Before the Bell

**Reaction**  
**Trigger:** You roll Initiative, become Surprised, fail a Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Insight) check, or fail a Cultivation Check to notice an immediate spiritual danger  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance  
**Time Debt:** 1

Choose the result appropriate to the trigger:

- Add your Proficiency Bonus to the Initiative roll, ability check, or Cultivation Check. You decide after rolling but before the final outcome is declared.
- If Surprised, you can move up to half your Speed, speak a short warning, draw or stow one item, use Spiritual Sense, or take the Dodge action during your first turn. You remain Surprised and cannot use another Action or Bonus Action during that turn unless another Source Rule removes Surprise.
- If the check concerned an ambush, trap, possession, dream intrusion, concealed spirit, imminent attack, or immediate temporal disturbance, learn the direction of the danger even if the added bonus does not produce a success.

#### Echo of the Chosen Step

Once on each of your turns, immediately after you move at least 10 feet, you may record the space where that movement began as your **Before-Space** until the start of your next turn.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 1 Resonance  
**Time Debt:** 1

Return to your Before-Space by conceptual translation, provided it remains a legal destination within 30 feet.

This movement:

- does not provoke opportunity attacks;
- is not ordinary teleportation;
- can be contested by a Source Rule that seals time, Space, routes, or conceptual movement;
- restores only your position.

It does not undo attacks, damage, conditions, expended resources, opened doors, triggered hazards, or any event that occurred after you left the space.

#### Soul Splitting — Yesterday’s Witness

Your soul fragment can record one space it legally occupies as its Before-Space until the end of its next turn. During that turn, it can use its movement to return to the recorded space without spending your Resonance. It cannot transport you or another creature through this option and cannot return more than once per round.

---

### CL18 — The Well Has No Bottom

You reveal the local truth that every present moment rests above an immeasurable depth of moments that might have been.

**Action**  
**Range:** 90 feet  
**Area:** 30-foot-radius sphere  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute

The area becomes a **Well of Hours**, a spiritual-temporal field and Source Rule.

When the field appears, record the following for every creature of your choice currently in the area:

- its space;
- its current Hit Points;
- its ordinary conditions.

This record is its **Round Image**.

At the start of each of your turns, replace the Round Image of each chosen creature currently in the field with its current state. When a creature enters the field after it appears, you may choose it for the field. If chosen and still in the field, it gains a Round Image at the start of your next turn.

#### Friendly Current

Each willing creature you choose that starts its turn in the field chooses one benefit:

- move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks;
- stand from Prone without spending movement;
- draw or stow one item and use Spiritual Sense;
- gain Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × your Proficiency Bonus`;
- suppress one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect on itself until the end of the turn.

#### Hostile Undertow

The first time each round a hostile creature in the field voluntarily moves, makes an attack, activates a technique, or takes a Reaction, it makes a Wisdom saving throw.

**Failed Save:** Apply Delayed Movement, Delayed Strike, Delayed Technique, or Delayed Reaction without spending Resonance or gaining Time Debt. The creature also becomes Resonance Marked until the end of its next turn.

**Successful Save:** Choose one:

- reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
- it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.

A creature that succeeds against Hostile Undertow twice during the same activation becomes immune to it for the remainder of that activation unless your Source CL increases.

#### Return to the Bell

Once during the activation, when a creature of your choice in the field takes damage, fails a saving throw, is moved, gains a condition, or is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you may use your Reaction to return it to its Round Image.

- Place it in its recorded space or the nearest legal space within 15 feet.
- If the recorded Hit Point value is higher, set its Hit Points to that value.
- Remove ordinary conditions gained after the image was recorded.
- Restore no Resonance, Stamina, Qi, Hit Dice, item charges, consumed materials, actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, Concentration, Sphere resources, Insight uses, Domain activations, or other spent resources.
- Do not restore a destroyed Cultivation Asset, severed limb, broken Foundation, consumed soul, permanent Hidden Injury, completed death, or higher-authority consequence unless a successful Cultivation Check and the originating Source Rule both permit temporal restoration.

After using Return to the Bell:

- set your Time Debt to its maximum;
- take `3d10` Psychic damage.

This damage ignores Resistance and Immunity and cannot be redirected, deferred, transferred, or reduced by a Well of Hours feature.

#### Drink the Unlived Hour

Once on each of your turns, you may gain 1 Time Debt to use Borrowed Second without spending Resonance.

You can choose Borrowed Second’s weapon-attack or Mind Spike option only once during the entire activation of The Well Has No Bottom.

#### Collapse of the Well

When the field ends:

- every Deferred Consequence whose subject is inside it resolves immediately unless already answered;
- your remaining Time Debt is converted into Temporal Arrears normally.

You cannot activate The Well Has No Bottom again until:

1. you have no Time Debt;
2. you have no Temporal Arrears;
3. after the previous field ends, you complete the Temporal Arrears clearing procedure, even if you had no Arrears remaining.

This is a defined cultivation-recharge procedure, not a short-rest or long-rest limit.

A higher-Source-CL Time, Fate, Void, Samsara, Boundary, Seal, Formation, divine, artifact, or conceptual authority can contest individual operations of the field. Ordinary anti-magic does not automatically erase it unless that effect also suppresses cultivation Source Rules.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.yokai_channeler:
### CL14 — True Yokai Form

**Action**  
**Cost:** 6 Resonance  
**Duration:** The scene  
**Concentration:** No

Assume your inherited true form. You retain your game statistics, equipment, actions, and identity unless a feature says otherwise. Equipment can merge cosmetically into the form or remain worn if physically compatible; it is not destroyed or duplicated.

You gain the benefits of Unmasking without paying its cost, your natural weapon die becomes `1d10`, and gain the lineage package below.

#### Kitsune True Form

- Fly Speed 40 feet; hover through foxfire steps rather than wings.
- Resistance to Psychic or Fire damage, chosen when you transform.
- **Ninefold Feint:** Once per round when an attack misses you, move up to 15 feet and create a Dream Thread–like foxfire sign on the attacker. The sign lasts until the end of your next turn and lets you target it with Soul Gaze through ordinary invisibility within 60 feet.

#### Tengu True Form

- Fly Speed 50 feet.
- Resistance to Thunder or Force damage, chosen when you transform.
- **Mountain Wind Cut:** Once on each of your turns after moving at least 20 feet, one creature you hit with your natural weapon takes an extra `2d8` damage and must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall Prone or be pushed 15 feet, your choice.

#### Kappa True Form

- Swim Speed 60 feet and can breathe air and water.
- Resistance to Cold or Bludgeoning damage, chosen when you transform.
- **River Lock:** A creature Grappled by you cannot teleport or use incorporeal movement unless its Source CL exceeds yours or it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw when it attempts to do so.

#### Jorogumo True Form

- Climb Speed 50 feet, including ceilings, and web-walking.
- Resistance to Poison or Psychic damage, chosen when you transform.
- **Grand Silk:** As an Action, create a 20-foot-square web zone within 60 feet until the end of the scene. The zone is difficult terrain for enemies. A creature that enters for the first time on a turn or starts there makes a Dexterity saving throw, becoming Restrained until the end of its next turn on a failure. A creature can use its Action to repeat the save, ending the restraint on success. You can have one Grand Silk zone at a time.

#### True-Form Exposure

While in True Form, ordinary observers recognize that you are not wholly human, though they may not know the exact lineage. Identity concealment with equal or higher authority can alter this result; mundane disguise cannot.

### CL6 — Unmasking

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 2 Resonance  
**Duration:** The scene

Reveal a combat-capable portion of your yokai nature. Your Tell becomes obvious and cannot be suppressed while the feature remains active.

#### Yokai Natural Weapon

Choose an appropriate bite, claw, horn, wing-blade, tail, web-strike, water-heavy blow, or foxfire lash when you activate Unmasking. It is a simple cultivated natural weapon with which you are proficient. It uses Wisdom for attack and damage rolls, has a reach of 5 feet, and deals `1d8 + Wisdom modifier` damage of your lineage affinity or an appropriate physical type.

Once on each of your turns when you hit with the natural weapon or a creature fails its save against Mind Spike, deal additional damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus of your lineage affinity.

This is a weapon expression of your own body and soul. It is not a Sphere talent and does not count as a detached Cultivation Asset.

#### Unmasked Lineage Gift

- **Kitsune:** After you deal the additional damage, create one foxfire double in an adjacent space until the start of your next turn. The first attack against you before then has Disadvantage; on a miss, you may move 5 feet.
- **Tengu:** After you move at least 15 feet in a straight line, your next natural-weapon hit that turn deals an extra `1d8` Thunder damage and can push the target 10 feet.
- **Kappa:** You have Advantage on checks and saves against Grappled and Restrained. Once per turn on a natural-weapon hit, you may Grapple the target using your Cultivation Attack Modifier in place of Athletics.
- **Jorogumo:** Once per turn on a natural-weapon hit, place a **Silk Thread** on the target until the end of your next turn. While threaded, it cannot benefit from invisibility against you and has Disadvantage on the first check or save it makes to escape one of your movement or restraint effects.

### CL18 — Yokai Lord

You become a local sovereign expression of your inherited lineage rather than merely revealing an ancestral body.

**Bonus Action**  
**Cost:** 10 Resonance  
**Duration:** The scene  
**Concentration:** No

Assume True Yokai Form and manifest a **Yokai Court** in a 30-foot aura centered on you.

#### Court Authority

- Beasts, yokai, spirit-beasts, transformed creatures, and spiritually compromised creatures with lower Source CL know your lineage and broad emotional intent while in the aura.
- Such a hostile creature that first enters the aura on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Charisma saving throw.
- **Failed Save:** It is **Overawed** until the start of its next turn. While Overawed, it cannot take Reactions, cannot willingly move closer to attack you, and has Disadvantage on attacks against creatures other than you.
- **Successful Save:** It suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.
- A creature repeats no save merely for remaining in the aura; it saves again only after leaving and reentering or when you use Lordly Challenge.

#### Lordly Challenge

**Bonus Action, once per round**

Choose one beast, yokai, spirit-beast, transformed creature, or spiritually compromised creature within 60 feet. It makes a Charisma saving throw.

- **Failed Save:** It follows one simple, non-suicidal command on its next turn: approach, withdraw, release, reveal, kneel, cease pursuit, or attack a creature already hostile to it. If it takes damage from you or your allies before complying, the command ends.
- **Successful Save:** It suffers one ordinary Spiritual Pressure effect.

This is temporary lineage authority, not permanent taming, friendship, enslavement, or a companion bond. A substantially lower-Source-CL ordinary creature can be compelled for up to 1 minute if you maintain Concentration after the first failed save; it repeats the save at the end of each turn and whenever damaged.

#### Lineage Apotheosis

Gain one greater expression:

- **Kitsune — Palace of Foxfire:** Once during the activation, create up to `Proficiency Bonus` illusory doubles in spaces within 60 feet. Until destroyed by a successful Investigation check against your Cultivation Save DC or struck by an attack, each double can serve as the origin of one non-hostile Spirit Awakening feature. You still activate each feature only once and pay all costs.
- **Tengu — Heaven-Scouring Descent:** Once during the activation, move up to your fly Speed without provoking reactions and make one Cultivation Attack against every hostile creature whose space you pass within 5 feet of, maximum Proficiency Bonus targets. On a hit, deal `4d10 + Wisdom modifier` Thunder or Force damage.
- **Kappa — Court Beneath the River:** Once during the activation, create a 30-foot-radius water court centered on a point within 60 feet. It lasts for the scene, is difficult terrain for enemies, and permits you and willing allies to breathe, swim, and stand in it as though on solid ground. Hostile teleportation and forced passage across its boundary require a Charisma saving throw.
- **Jorogumo — Web of a Hundred Names:** Once during the activation, choose up to Proficiency Bonus creatures you can perceive within 60 feet. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, spectral silk links it to a point you choose in the Court. Its Speed becomes 0 until it uses an Action to repeat the save or an ally destroys the thread Anchor, which has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and Hit Points equal to `3 × Proficiency Bonus`.

#### Soul Splitting Expression — Masked Twin

While Soul Splitting is active, your Soul Fragment may display your Tell and use your Spiritual Sense. During Unmasking or True Yokai Form, the fragment may originate one natural-weapon attack you make, but this does not grant an additional attack or separate turn.

### CL3 — Yokai Mask

Your inheritance can be hidden, displayed, or used as a social and spiritual instrument.

#### Suppress or Reveal the Tell

You may suppress or reveal your Tell as a Bonus Action. Suppression defeats ordinary visual inspection but not Spiritual Sense, Soul Gaze, a lineage-specific detector, or equal- or higher-Source-CL identity revelation.

When a creature attempts to determine whether you are lying about your species, ancestry, or spiritual nature, you may use Wisdom instead of Charisma for the relevant Deception check.

#### Lineage Gift

Gain the gift of your chosen lineage:

- **Kitsune — Foxfire Misdirection:** When a creature within 30 feet makes an Insight check against you or an attack roll against an illusion, reflection, or duplicate created by you, use your Reaction and spend 1 Resonance to impose Disadvantage. If the roll fails, the creature becomes Resonance Marked by you.
- **Tengu — Wind-Perched Step:** Your jump distance doubles. When you fall, reduce the effective fall by `10 feet × Proficiency Bonus`. As a Reaction when pushed or knocked Prone, spend 1 Resonance to move 10 feet to a legal space and remain standing.
- **Kappa — River Body:** Gain a swim Speed equal to your Speed and can hold your breath for 1 hour. As a Reaction when you or an adjacent ally would be moved, spend 1 Resonance to reduce that movement by 10 feet and shift the creature 5 feet to another legal adjacent space.
- **Jorogumo — Wall-Clinging Thread:** Gain a climb Speed equal to your Speed and can move across ceilings while leaving both hands free. Once on each of your turns when you Resonance Mark a creature, you may reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the mark ends.

### CL10 — Yokai’s Bargain

Yokai bargains are voluntary exchanges enforced by hospitality, appetite, clever wording, and spiritual face. They are not Oath-Ledger debts, Soul-Collateral Contracts, or Karma judgments.

**Action or 10-minute negotiation**  
**Range:** 30 feet during action use; conversational range during negotiation  
**Cost:** 3 Resonance  
**Duration:** Up to 24 hours

Offer a bargain to one creature that can understand the terms. State:

- What each party will give, do, refrain from doing, reveal, or protect.
- The duration or completion condition.
- Whether the bargain uses a **Declared Claim** or an **Open Claim**. A Declared Claim selects one Claim use from the printed Breach list when the bargain forms. An Open Claim permits the nonbreaching party to choose any one printed Claim use after breach. No consequence outside that list is created by this feature.

The bargain forms only if both parties knowingly accept. Magical coercion that removes meaningful choice prevents formation unless the bargain’s Source Rule expressly allows coerced contracts.

Each party gains a visible-to-spiritual-senses **Bargain Mark**. A party can bear only one Bargain Mark from you at a time.

#### Permitted Benefits

The bargain may grant each party one of the following while it remains honored:

- Advantage on one defined category of skill check directly related to fulfilling the bargain.
- A 10-foot increase to one movement mode while traveling toward the bargain’s objective.
- Temporary Hit Points equal to `2 × Proficiency Bonus` at the start of the first scene in which the bargain is actively pursued.
- The ability to communicate telepathically within 1 mile for purposes related to the bargain.
- Permission to cross one ward, threshold, territory, or hospitality boundary controlled by the other party, if that party has authority to grant permission.

#### Breach

When a party knowingly breaches, the nonbreaching party immediately knows the broad category of breach and gains one **Yokai Claim** against the violator. The Bargain Mark remains until the claim is used or the parties reconcile.

The claimant may spend the Claim in one of these ways:

- Impose Disadvantage on one d20 Test the violator makes within 60 feet.
- Gain Advantage on one saving throw against the violator.
- Learn the violator’s direction while on the same plane for 1 hour, unless blocked by equal or higher spiritual concealment.
- Deal `4d10` Psychic damage to the violator as a Reaction when it directly benefits from the breach. The violator makes a Charisma saving throw, taking half damage on a success.

A Yokai Claim cannot force future obedience, seize a soul, create unlimited pursuit, or punish an ambiguous technical breach. If the bargain’s meaning is genuinely disputed, resolve it through the stated terms, witnesses, and a Cultivation Check rather than automatic punishment.
